(i) 非公民已提出有效的保護簽證申請，但尚未最終確定；
(ii) the non ‑ citizen could not be removed to the foreign country because of subsection 197C(3) if the non ‑ citizen were an unlawful non ‑ citizen;
(ii) 若非公民是非法非公民，則根據第 197C(3) 款，該非公民不能被驅逐到外國；
(iii) the non ‑ citizen is a child under 18.
(iii) 非公民是 18 歲以下的兒童。
Note: The rules of natural justice do not apply in relation to third country reception arrangements: see section 198AHAA.
注意：自然正義規則不適用於第三國接待安排：請參閱第 198AHAA 條。
(2) The Minister must give the non ‑ citizen notice that this section applies in relation to the non ‑ citizen.
(2) 部長必須向非公民發出通知，表明本節適用於該非公民。
(3) The notice:
（三）通知：
(a) must be given as soon as reasonably practicable after this section starts to apply in relation to the non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 必須在本條開始適用於非公民後在合理可行的範圍內盡快給予；和
(b) may be given orally or in writing.
(b) 可以口頭或書面提出。
(4) Despite any other provision of this Act or the regulations, the visa ceases to be in effect immediately after:
(4) 儘管本法或條例有任何其他規定，簽證在以下情況後立即停止生效：
(a) if the notice is given by a method specified in section 494B—the non ‑ citizen is taken to have received the notice; or
(a) 若通知是透過第 494B 條規定的方法發出的－則該非公民被視為已收到通知；或
(b) otherwise—the non ‑ citizen receives the notice.
(b) 否則－非公民收到通知。
Note 1: If the Minister gives a person a document by a method specified in section 494B, the person is taken to have received the document at the time specified in section 494C in respect of that method.
註 1：如果部長透過第 494B 條規定的方法向某人提供文件，則該人被視為在第 494C 條就該方法規定的時間收到該文件。
Note 2: The visa period for the visa ends when it ceases to be in effect under this subsection.
註2：簽證的簽證期限在其依本款不再有效時結束。
(5) The rules of natural justice do not apply to the giving of a notice under subsection (2).
(5) 自然正義規則不適用於依第 (2) 款所發出的通知。
(6) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), a permission to enter the foreign country may be unconditional or a permission to enter that is subject to the non ‑ citizen doing one or more things required by the foreign country that the non ‑ citizen is capable of doing before entering the country.
(6) 就第 (1)(b) 款而言，進入外國的許可可以是無條件的，也可以是要求非公民在進入該國之前完成外國要求的一項或多項其能夠完成的事情的許可。
(7) If:
(7) 如果：
(a) notice (the earlier notice ) is given to a non ‑ citizen under subsection (2) (including under a previous application of this subsection); and
(a) 根據第(2)款（包括根據本款的先前適用）向非公民發出通知（較早的通知）；和
(b) the non ‑ citizen is subsequently granted another Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the later visa ); and
(b) 該非公民隨後獲得另一個 070 子類（過橋（待遞解））簽證（後一個簽證）；和
(c) this section starts to apply in relation to the non ‑ citizen after the later visa is granted;
(c) 本節在後來的簽證取得後開始適用於非公民；
the Minister must give further notice under subsection (2) to the non ‑ citizen.
部長必須根據第(2)款向非公民發出進一步通知。
(8) For the purposes of paragraph (7)(c):
(8) 就第 (7)(c) 款而言：
(a) the country in relation to which paragraph (1)(b) is satisfied may be the same as, or different from, the country in relation to which paragraph (1)(b) was satisfied for the earlier notice; but
(a) 第 (1)(b) 款已滿足的國家可能與先前通知中第 (1)(b) 款滿足的國家相同或不同；但是
(b) the permission in relation to which paragraph (1)(b) is satisfied must be granted after the granting of the later visa.
(b) 與第(1)(b)款相關的許可必須在授予後一簽證後授予。
(9) This section does not affect the operation of other provisions of this Act or the regulations that have the effect that a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa ceases to be in effect on the happening of a particular event, upon the holder ceasing to have a particular status or otherwise.
(9) 本條不影響本法其他規定或規定的實施，這些規定使 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證在特定事件發生、持有人不再具有特定身份或其他情況下不再有效。

title: 76A Cessation of certain bridging visas, and grant of new visas, for certain non ‑ citizens
zh: 76A 停止向某些非公民發放某些過橋簽證並授予新簽證
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This section applies if:
(1) 本節適用於：
(a) a non ‑ citizen holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the first visa ) immediately before the commencement of this section; and
(a) 非公民在本節生效前持有子類 070（過橋（待遞解））簽證（第一個簽證）；和
(b) the first visa was granted to the non ‑ citizen without an application for the first visa being made by the non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 第一個簽證是在沒有申請第一個簽證的情況下授予非公民的；和
(c) the first visa was granted during the period that:
(c) 第一次簽證是在下列期間簽發的：
(i) starts at the start of 8 November 2023; and
(i) 自 2023 年 11 月 8 日開始；和
(ii) ends immediately before the commencement of this section; and
(ii) 在本條生效前結束；和
(d) at the time the first visa was granted, there was no real prospect of the removal of the non ‑ citizen from Australia becoming practicable in the reasonably foreseeable future.
(d) 在簽發第一份簽證時，在合理可預見的未來將非公民驅逐出澳洲的可能性並不存在。
(2) Despite any other provision of this Act or the regulations, the first visa ceases to be in effect immediately after the commencement of this section.
(2) 儘管本法或條例有任何其他規定，第一個簽證在本節生效後立即不再有效。
Note: The visa period for the first visa ends when it ceases to be in effect under this subsection.
注意：第一個簽證的簽證期限在其根據本款不再有效時結束。
(3) Despite any other provision of this Act or the regulations:
(3) 儘管本法或條例有任何其他規定：
(a) the non ‑ citizen is taken, immediately after the first visa ceases to be in effect under subsection (2), to have been granted another Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the second visa ); and
(a) 在第一個簽證根據第(2)款不再有效後，該非公民立即被授予另一個070子類（過橋（待遞解））簽證（第二個簽證）；和
(b) the second visa is taken to come into effect as soon as it is taken to be granted under paragraph (a) of this subsection.
(b) 第二個簽證在根據本款(a)款被認為被授予後立即生效。
Note: The visa period for the second visa begins when it is taken to be granted.
註：第二次簽證的簽證期限從被視為獲得批准時開始計算。
(4) This Act and the regulations apply, after the commencement of this section, in relation to the second visa in the same way as they would apply in relation to a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa granted under the regulations.
(4) 在本節生效後，本法和法規適用於第二個簽證，其適用方式與適用於根據法規授予的 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證的方式相同。
(5) Without limiting subsection (4), the following provisions of the regulations, as in force at the time the second visa is taken to be granted under paragraph (3)(a), apply in relation to the second visa:
(5) 在不限制第(4)款的情況下，在根據第(3)(a)款授予第二個簽證時有效的下列規定適用於第二個簽證：
(a) a provision specifying when a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa is in effect;
(a) 規定 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證何時生效的規定；
(b) a provision prescribing that a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa permits the visa holder to remain in Australia;
(b) 規定 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證允許簽證持有人留在澳洲的條款；
(c) a provision specifying the mandatory conditions to which a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa that is taken to be granted under paragraph (3)(a) is subject.
(c) 規定依第 (3)(a) 款授予的 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證須遵守的強制性條件的條款。

title: 76AA Effect of community safety order on visa held by non ‑ citizen etc.
zh: 76AA 社區安全令對非公民等持有的簽證的影響
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This section applies if:
(1) 本節適用於：
(a) a community safety order is made in relation to a non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 社區安全令是針對非公民制定的；和
(b) the order comes into force at a particular time (the relevant time ).
(b) 該命令在特定時間（相關時間）生效。
Non ‑ citizen who holds a visa (other than a criminal justice visa) at the relevant time
在相關時間持有簽證（刑事司法簽證除外）的非公民
(2) If the non ‑ citizen holds a visa (other than a criminal justice visa) at the relevant time, then, despite any other provision of this Act or the regulations, the following apply:
(2) 若非公民在相關時間持有簽證（刑事司法簽證除外），則不論本法或條例有任何其他規定，以下規定均適用：
(a) that visa ceases to be in effect at the relevant time;
(a) 該簽證在相關時間已不再有效；
(b) the non ‑ citizen is taken, immediately after the relevant time, to have been granted a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the BVR visa );
(b) 在相關時間之後，該非公民立即被授予 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證（BVR 簽證）；
(c) the BVR visa is taken to come into effect as soon as it is taken to be granted under paragraph (b).
(c) BVR 簽證一旦根據(b) 款被視為授予，即視為生效。
Note: The visa period for the visa mentioned in paragraph (a) ends at the relevant time and the visa period for the BVR visa begins when it is taken to be granted.
註：(a) 段中提到的簽證的簽證期限在相關時間結束，BVR 簽證的簽證期限從被視為授予時開始。
Non ‑ citizen who holds a criminal justice visa at the relevant time
在相關時間持有刑事司法簽證的非公民
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) the non ‑ citizen holds a criminal justice visa at the relevant time; and
(a) 非公民在相關時間持有刑事司法簽證；和
(b) the criminal justice visa ceases to be in effect at a particular time (the cessation time ) during the period in which the community safety order is in force in relation to the non ‑ citizen;
(b) 刑事司法簽證在社區安全令對非公民生效期間的特定時間（停止時間）停止生效；
then, despite any other provision of this Act or the regulations, the following apply:
那麼，無論本法或條例有任何其他規定，以下規定均適用：
(c) the non ‑ citizen is taken, immediately after the cessation time, to have been granted a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the BVR visa );
(c) 在終止時間之後，非公民立即被視為已獲得子類 070（過橋（待遞解））簽證（BVR 簽證）；
(d) the BVR visa is taken to come into effect as soon as it is taken to be granted under paragraph (c).
(d) BVR 簽證一旦根據(c) 款被視為授予，即視為生效。
Note: The visa period for the BVR visa begins when it is taken to be granted.
注意：BVR 簽證的簽證期限從被視為授予時開始計算。
Matters relating to the BVR visa taken to be granted to the non ‑ citizen
與授予非公民的 BVR 簽證有關的事項
(4) Subject to subsections (6) and (7), this Act and the regulations apply, after the commencement of this section, in relation to the BVR visa that is taken to be granted under paragraph (2)(b) or (3)(c) (as the case may be) in the same way as they would apply in relation to a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa granted under the regulations.
(4) 根據第 (6) 和 (7) 款，在本條生效後，本法和法規適用於根據第 (2)(b) 或 (3)(c) 款（視情況而定）授予的 BVR 簽證，其適用方式與適用於根據法規授予的 070 子類（過橋（待遞解）））的方式遞解簽證。
(5) Without limiting subsection (4), the following provisions of the regulations, as in force at the time the BVR visa is taken to be granted under paragraph (2)(b) or (3)(c) (as the case may be), apply in relation to the BVR visa:
(5) 在不限制第 (4) 款的情況下，根據第 (2)(b) 或 (3)(c) 款（視情況而定）授予 BVR 簽證時有效的以下法規規定適用於 BVR 簽證：
(a) a provision specifying when a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa is in effect;
(a) 規定 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證何時生效的規定；
(b) a provision prescribing that a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa permits the visa holder to remain in Australia;
(b) 規定 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證允許簽證持有人留在澳洲的條款；
(c) a provision specifying the conditions to which a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa that is taken to be granted under paragraph (2)(b) or (3)(c) (as the case may be) is subject.
(c) 規定根據第 (2)(b) 或 (3)(c) 款（視情況而定）授予的 070 子類（過橋（待遞解））簽證須遵守的條件的條款。
(6) The non ‑ citizen’s BVR visa must not be subject to either of the following conditions:
(6)非公民的BVR簽證不得符合下列條件之一：
(a) a condition requiring the non ‑ citizen to remain, between certain times of a day, at a particular address for the non ‑ citizen for the day;
(a) 要求非公民在一天中的某些時間之間留在該非公民當日的特定地址的條件；
(b) a condition requiring the non ‑ citizen to wear a monitoring device.
(b) 要求非公民配戴監控裝置的條件。
Minister must not do certain things while the community safety order is in force
社區安全令生效期間部長不得做某些事情
(7) The Minister must not do either of the following at any time while the community safety order made in relation to the non ‑ citizen is in force:
(7) 在針對非公民制定的社區安全令生效期間，部長不得在任何時間進行以下任何行為：
(a) invite the non ‑ citizen, for the purposes of the regulations, to apply for another Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa;
(a) 為本條例的目的，邀請非公民申請另一個 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證；
(b) grant (whether or not on application) the non ‑ citizen another Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa under the regulations.
(b) 依規定授予非公民另一份 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證（無論是否申請）。
Inconsistency between the community safety order and the BVR visa
社區安全令與 BVR 簽證不一致
(8) If:
(8) 如果：
(a) the community safety order that is in force in relation to the non ‑ citizen is a community safety supervision order; and
(a) 對非公民有效的社區安全令是社區安全監督令；和
(b) at a particular time, one or more conditions (the supervision order conditions ) are imposed on the non ‑ citizen by the community safety supervision order; and
(b) 在特定時間，社區安全監管令對非公民施加一項或多項條件（監管令條件）；和
(c) at that time, a condition to which the non ‑ citizen’s BVR visa is subject is inconsistent, in whole or in part, with any of the supervision order conditions;
(c) 當時，非公民的 BVR 簽證所適用的條件全部或部分與任何監管令條件不一致；
then, despite subsections (4) and (5), the BVR visa is to be taken, at that time, not to be subject to that condition to the extent of any such inconsistency.
那麼，儘管有第 (4) 和 (5) 款的規定，在當時所持有的 BVR 簽證，在任何此類不一致的情況下不受該條件的約束。
(9) If:
(9) 如果：
(a) the community safety order made in relation to the non ‑ citizen is a community safety detention order; and
(a) 針對非公民發布的社區安全令是社區安全拘留令；和
(b) the non ‑ citizen is unable, at a particular time, to comply with a condition to which the non ‑ citizen’s BVR visa is subject; and
(b) 非公民在特定時間內無法遵守非公民 BVR 簽證所須遵守的條件；和
(c) the non ‑ citizen is unable to comply with the condition only because the community safety detention order is in force in relation to the non ‑ citizen at that time;
(c) 該非公民無法遵守該條件，僅是因為社區安全拘留令當時對該非公民有效；
then, despite subsections (4) and (5), the BVR visa is to be taken, at that time, not to be subject to that condition.
那麼，儘管有第 (4) 和 (5) 款的規定，當時所持有的 BVR 簽證不受該條件的約束。
(10) Subsections (8) and (9) do not apply at any time while the community safety order made in relation to the non ‑ citizen is suspended.
(10) 當針對非公民發出的社區安全令暫停時，第 (8) 和 (9) 款在任何時間均不適用。
Definitions
定義
(11) In this section:
(11) 本節：
community safety detention order has the same meaning as in Division 395 of the Criminal Code .
社區安全拘留令與刑法第395條的涵義相同。
community safety order means a community safety detention order or a community safety supervision order.
社區安全令，指社區安全拘留令或社區安全監理令。
community safety supervision order has the same meaning as in Division 395 of the Criminal Code .
社區安全監察令與刑法第395條意義相同。
monitoring device means any electronic device capable of being used to determine or monitor the location of a person or an object or the status of an object.
監控設備是指任何能夠用於確定或監控人或物體的位置或物體的狀態的電子設備。

title: 76B Offence relating to monitoring conditions of certain bridging visas
zh: 76B 與監控某些過橋簽證條件有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) any of the following applies:
(b) 下列任何一項適用：
(i) at the time the visa was granted, there was no real prospect of the removal of the person from Australia becoming practicable in the reasonably foreseeable future;
(i) 在簽證被授予時，在合理可預見的未來內將該人驅逐出澳洲的可能性不存在；
(ii) the visa was granted under section 195A;
(ii) 簽證是根據第 195A 條授予的；
(iii) if the non ‑ citizen has previously held other Bridging R (Class WR) visas—the first of those visas was granted under section 195A; and
(iii) 如果非公民之前曾持有其他過橋 R（WR 級）簽證－第一個簽證是根據第 195A 條授予的；和
(c) the visa is subject to a monitoring condition; and
(c) 簽證受到監控條件的約束；和
(d) the person fails to comply with a requirement of the monitoring condition.
（四）不符合監控條件要求的。
Note: Section 4K of the Crimes Act 1914 , which deals with continuing and multiple offences, applies to this offence.
註：1914 年《犯罪法》第 4K 條涉及連續犯罪和多重犯罪，適用於此類犯罪。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。
(4) In this section:
(4) 本節：
monitoring condition is a mandatory condition that:
監控條件是強制性條件：
(a) requires the holder of a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa to do any of the following things:
(a) 要求 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證持有者做下列任何事情：
(i) to notify the Minister or Department of specified matters within a specified period or before or by a specified day;
(i) 在指定期限內或在指定日期之前或之前將指定事項通知部長或部門；
(ii) to report at a specified time or times, and at a specified place or in a specified manner;
(ii) 在指定時間、指定地點或以指定方式報告；
(iii) to attend at a specified place, on a specified day and at a specified time; and
(iii) 在指定地點、指定日期和指定時間出席；和
(b) is not a prescribed condition.
(b) 不是規定條件。

title: 76C Offence relating to requirement to remain at notified address
zh: 76C 與要求留在指定地址有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring the person to remain, between certain times of a day, at a particular address for the person for the day; and
(b) 簽證有一項條件，要求該人在一天中的某些時間之間留在該人當天的特定地址；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。

title: 76D Offences relating to monitoring device and related monitoring equipment
zh: 76D 與監控裝置及相關監控設備有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Requirement to wear monitoring device at all times
要求時時配戴監控裝置
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring the person to wear a monitoring device at all times; and
(b) 簽證有一項條件，要求申請人隨時配戴監控裝置；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Requirement to fit a monitoring device etc.
要求安裝監控設備等。
(2) A person commits an offence if:
(2) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring the person to allow an authorised officer to fit, install, repair or remove:
(b) 簽證有條件，要求該人允許授權人員安裝、安裝、修理或拆除：
(i) the person’s monitoring device; or
(i) 該人的監控設備；或
(ii) any related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device; and
(ii) 與該人的監控裝置相關的任何監控設備；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Requirements relating to good working order of monitoring device etc.
與監控裝置等良好工作狀態有關的要求
(3) A person commits an offence if:
(3) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring the person to take any specified steps, and any other reasonable steps, to ensure that the following remain in good working order:
(b) 簽證必須符合一項條件，要求該人採取任何指定步驟和任何其他合理步驟，以確保以下各項保持良好的工作狀態：
(i) the person’s monitoring device;
(i) 該人的監控設備；
(ii) any related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device; and
(ii) 與該人的監控裝置相關的任何監控設備；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(4) A person commits an offence if:
(4) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring that, if the person becomes aware that:
(b) 簽證須滿足一個條件，要求如果該人意識到：
(i) the person’s monitoring device is not in good working order; or
(i) 該人的監控設備工作狀態不佳；或
(ii) any related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device is not in good working order;
(ii) 與該人的監控裝置相關的任何監控設備均未處於良好的工作狀態；
the person must notify an authorised officer of that as soon as practicable; and
該人必須在切實可行範圍內盡快將此情況通知獲授權人員；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Note: Section 4K of the Crimes Act 1914 , which deals with continuing and multiple offences, applies to this offence.
註：1914 年《犯罪法》第 4K 條涉及連續犯罪和多重犯罪，適用於此類犯罪。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Exception
例外
(6) Subsections (1), (2), (3) and (4) do not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(6) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1)、(2)、(3) 及 (4) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。
Definitions
定義
(7) In this section:
(7) 本節：
monitoring device means any electronic device capable of being used to determine or monitor the location of a person or an object or the status of an object.
監控設備是指任何能夠用於確定或監控人或物體的位置或物體的狀態的電子設備。
related monitoring equipment , for a monitoring device, means any electronic equipment necessary for operating the monitoring device.
相關監控設備，對於監控裝置而言，是指操作監控裝置所需的任何電子設備。

title: 76DAA Offence relating to requirement not to perform certain work etc.
zh: 76DAA 與要求不執行某些工作等有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring that the person not perform any work, or participate in any regular organised activity, involving more than incidental contact with another person who is a minor or other vulnerable person; and
(b) 簽證有一個條件，要求該人不得從事任何工作或參加任何定期有組織的活動，而不僅僅是與未成年人或其他弱勢群體的偶然接觸；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。
(3) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), it does not matter whether the work or activity is for reward or otherwise.
(3) 就第 (1)(b) 款而言，工作或活動是否是為了報酬或其他目的並不重要。

title: 76DAB Offence relating to requirement not to go within certain distance of a school etc.
zh: 76DAB 與要求不得進入學校等一定距離內有關的犯罪行為。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the visa is subject to a condition requiring that the person not go within a particular distance of a school, childcare centre or day care centre; and
(b) 簽證有一個條件，要求該人不得前往學校、托兒中心或日託中心的特定距離範圍內；和
(c) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(c) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。

title: 76DAC Offence relating to requirement not to contact victim of offence etc.
zh: 76DAC 與要求不聯繫犯罪受害人等有關的犯罪行為。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa; and
(a) 此人持有 070 子類別（過橋（待遞解））簽證；和
(b) the person has been convicted of an offence involving violence or sexual assault; and
(b) 該人曾被判犯有涉及暴力或性侵犯的罪行；和
(c) the visa is subject to a condition requiring that the person not contact or attempt to contact:
(c) 簽證有一個條件，要求該人不得聯絡或試圖聯絡：
(i) the victim of the offence; or
(i) 犯罪行為的受害者；或
(ii) a member of the victim’s family; and
(ii) 受害人家屬；和
(d) the person fails to comply with the requirement of the condition.
(d) 該人未能遵守條件的要求。
Penalty: 5 years imprisonment or 300 penalty units, or both.
處罰：5 年監禁或 300 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。
(3) Without limiting what may be taken to be a reasonable excuse for the purposes of subsection (2), it is, for the purposes of that subsection, a reasonable excuse for failing to comply with the requirement of the condition if:
(3) 在不限制第 (2) 款目的的合理藉口的情況下，就該款而言，在以下情況下，它是未能遵守條件要求的合理藉口：
(a) the person referred to in subparagraph (1)(c)(i) or (ii):
(a) 第(1)(c)(i)或(ii)項所提及的人：
(i) is at least 16 years of age; and
(i) 年滿 16 歲；和
(ii) voluntarily consents to the contact or attempted contact; and
(ii) 自願同意接觸或嘗試接觸；和
(iii) has capacity to give that consent; or
(iii) 有能力給予同意；或
(b) the contact or attempted contact is (or would, but for this Act or the regulations, be) required or authorised by or under a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory.
(b) 聯邦、州或領地的法律或根據其法律要求或授權進行接觸或試圖接觸。

title: 76DA Mandatory 1 year imprisonment for offences
zh: 76DA 違法行為須判處 1 年監禁
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
If a person is convicted of an offence against section 76B, 76C, 76D, 76DAA, 76DAB or 76DAC, the court must impose a sentence of imprisonment of at least 1 year.
如果某人犯下違反第 76B、76C、76D、76DAA、76DAB 或 76DAC 條的罪行，法院必須判處至少 1 年監禁。

title: 76E Rules of natural justice do not apply to decision to grant certain bridging visas
zh: 76E 自然正義規則不適用於授予某些過橋簽證的決定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This section applies in relation to a decision to grant a non ‑ citizen a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the first visa ) if the first visa is subject to one or more prescribed conditions.
(1) 本節適用於授予非公民 070 子類（過橋（待遞解））簽證（第一個簽證）的決定，如果第一個簽證受一個或多個規定條件的約束。
(2) To avoid doubt, the rules of natural justice do not apply to the making of the decision.
(2) 為避免疑義，自然正義規則不適用於該決定的製定。
(3) As soon as practicable after making the decision, the Minister must:
(3) 做出決定後，部長必須盡快：
(a) give the non ‑ citizen, in the way that the Minister considers appropriate in the circumstances:
(a) 以部長認為適合情況的方式提供非公民：
(i) a written notice that sets out the decision; and
(i) 載明決定的書面通知；和
(ii) any other prescribed information; and
(ii) 任何其他規定資訊；和
(b) invite the person to make representations to the Minister, within the period and in the manner specified by the Minister, as to why the first visa should not be subject to one or more of the conditions prescribed for the purposes of subsection (1).
(b) 邀請該人在部長指定的期限內以部長指定的方式向部長提出陳述，說明為什麼第一個簽證不應受到第（1）款規定的一項或多項條件的約束。
(4) The Minister must grant the non ‑ citizen another Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa (the second visa ), under a prescribed provision of the regulations, that is not subject to any one or more of the conditions prescribed for the purposes of subsection (1) if:
(4) 部長必須根據法規的規定，向非公民授予另一份 070 子類（過橋（待遞解））簽證（第二簽證），該簽證不受第 (1) 款目的規定的任何一項或多項條件的限制，如果：
(a) the non ‑ citizen makes representations in accordance with the invitation; and
(a) 非公民依邀請提出陳述；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the Minister is not satisfied, on the balance of probabilities, that the non ‑ citizen poses a substantial risk of seriously harming any part of the Australian community by committing a serious offence; or
(i) 部長根據各種可能性的權衡，認為該非公民犯下嚴重罪行會構成對澳洲社會任何部分造成嚴重傷害的重大風險；或
(ii) if the Minister is satisfied, on the balance of probabilities, that the non ‑ citizen poses the substantial risk mentioned in subparagraph (i)—the Minister is not satisfied, on the balance of probabilities, that the imposition of that condition, or those conditions, is reasonably necessary, and reasonably appropriate and adapted, for the purpose of protecting any part of the Australian community from serious harm by addressing that substantial risk.
(ii) 如果部長在權衡可能性後確信該非公民構成第(i)項中提到的實質性風險－部長在權衡可能性後不認為施加該條件是合理必要的、合理適當的和適應性的，目的是透過解決該重大風險來保護澳洲社會的任何部分免受嚴重傷害。
Note: If the Minister grants the second visa, the first visa will cease to be in effect, and the visa period for the first visa will end, on the grant of the second visa (see subsections 68(4) and (5)).
注意：如果部長授予第二個簽證，第一個簽證將不再有效，並且第一個簽證的簽證期限將在第二個簽證授予後結束（請參閱第 68(4) 和 (5) 款）。
(4A) In determining whether to grant a visa in accordance with subsection (4), the Minister must decide whether to impose each condition prescribed for the purposes of subsection (1) in the same order as required by the regulations.
(4A) 在決定是否根據第 (4) 款授予簽證時，部長必須按照法規要求的順序決定是否施加為第 (1) 款規定的各項條件。
(5) The Minister must give the non ‑ citizen written notice of the decision and the reasons for the decision.
(5) 部長必須向非公民發出關於該決定的書面通知以及該決定的理由。
(6) To avoid doubt, nothing in this section prevents the grant, from time to time, of a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa to the non ‑ citizen.
(6) 為避免疑義，本節的任何內容均不妨礙不時授予非公民 070 類（過橋（待遞解））簽證。
(7) In this section:
(7) 本節：
serious offence has the same meaning as in Part 070 of Schedule 2 to the Migration Regulations 1994 .
嚴重犯罪的涵義與《1994 年移民條例》附表 2 第 070 部分的涵義相同。

title: 76F Powers of officers etc.
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Powers relating to monitoring devices and related monitoring equipment
與監控裝置及相關監控設備有關的權力
(1) An authorised officer may do all things necessary or convenient to be done for any of the following purposes in relation to a person who is subject to monitoring:
(1) 授權官員可以為以下任何目的對受監控的人採取一切必要或方便的行動：
(a) installing, fitting, or removing the person’s monitoring device or related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device;
(a) 安裝、安裝或拆除人員監控裝置或人員監控裝置的相關監控設備；
(b) maintaining, repairing or otherwise keeping in good working order the person’s monitoring device or related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device;
(b) 維護、修理或以其他方式維持人員監控裝置或人員監控裝置的相關監控設備處於良好的工作狀態；
(c) operating or using the person’s monitoring device or related monitoring equipment for the person’s monitoring device;
(c) 操作或使用個人監控裝置或與個人監控裝置相關的監控設備；
(d) determining or monitoring the location of:
(d) 確定或監控下列位置：
(i) the person; or
(i) 該人；或
(ii) an object, or the status of an object, that relates to the person;
(ii) 與該人有關的物體或物體的狀態；
through the operation of a monitoring device or related monitoring equipment.
透過監控裝置或相關監控設備的操作。
Collection, use and disclosure of information
資訊的收集、使用和揭露
(2) An authorised officer may collect, use, or disclose to any other person, information (including personal information) for any of the following purposes:
(2) 授權人員可以為以下任何目的收集、使用或向任何其他人揭露資訊（包括個人資訊）：
(a) determining whether a requirement of a condition of a visa held by a person who is subject to monitoring is being, or has been, complied with;
(a) 確定受監控人員所持簽證條件的要求是否正在或已被遵守；
(b) determining whether a person who is subject to monitoring has committed an offence against this Act or the regulations;
(b) 確定受監控的人是否犯有違反本法或條例的罪行；
(c) protecting the community in relation to persons who are subject to monitoring;
(c) 保護與受監控人員相關的社區；
(d) facilitating the location of a person subject to monitoring who is suspected of having failed to comply with a requirement of a condition of a visa held by the person;
(d) 協助定位涉嫌未遵守其所持簽證條件要求的受監控人員；
(e) facilitating the location of a person who is or has been subject to monitoring in the event that either or both of the following apply:
(e) 在下列任一或兩者適用的情況下，方便確定正在或曾經受到監控的人的位置：
(i) there is a real prospect of the removal of the person from Australia becoming practicable in the reasonably foreseeable future;
(i) 在合理可預見的未來，確實有可能將該人驅逐出澳洲；
(ii) a visa held by the person ceases to be in effect;
(ii) 該人所持有的簽證已不再有效；
(f) facilitating the performance of functions, and exercise of powers, of authorised officers under this Act (including this section) and the regulations in relation to persons who are or have been subject to monitoring.
(f) 促進授權官員根據本法（包括本節）和與正在或曾經受到監控的人員有關的法規履行職能和行使權力。
Powers may be exercised despite other laws
儘管有其他法律規定，仍可行使權力
(3) An authorised officer may exercise a power under subsection (1) or (2) despite any other provision of:
(3) 儘管有任何其他規定，授權官員仍可依第 (1) 或 (2) 款行使權力：
(a) this Act or the regulations (other than regulations made for the purposes of subsection (4) of this section); or
(a) 本法或條例（為本條第 (4) 款目的而製定的條例除外）；或
(b) any other law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory (whether written or unwritten).
(b) 聯邦、州或領地的任何其他法律（無論成文或不成文）。
Powers are exercisable subject to regulations
權力的行使須符合規定
(4) An authorised officer’s exercise of a power under subsection (1) or (2) is subject to any conditions, restrictions or other limitations that are prescribed by the regulations for the purposes of this subsection.
(4) 授權官員依第 (1) 或 (2) 款行使權力須遵守法規為本款目的而規定的任何條件、限製或其他限制。
Other powers not limited
其他權力不受限制
(5) The conferral of a power on an authorised officer by subsection (1) or (2) does not, by implication, limit any other powers that exist, or existed, for an authorised officer or any other person to do:
(5) 第 (1) 或 (2) 款授予授權官員的權力並不暗示限制授權官員或任何其他人已存在或已存在的任何其他權力：
(a) a thing authorised by either of those subsections; or
(a) 上述任何一小節授權的事物；或
(b) any other thing.
(b) 任何其他事情。
Definitions
定義
(6) In this section:
(6) 本節：
authorised officer , when used in subsection (1) or (2), includes:
當用於第(1)或(2)款時，授權人員包括：
(a) a person who is authorised in writing by the Minister, the Secretary or the Australian Border Force Commissioner for the purposes of that provision; and
(a) 為該條款之目的而獲得部長、秘書或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員書面授權的人；和
(b) a person who is included in a class of persons authorised in writing by the Minister, the Secretary or the Australian Border Force Commissioner for the purposes of that provision, including a person who becomes a member of the class after the authorisation is given.
(b) 為該條款的目的而被部長、部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員書面授權的人員類別中的人員，包括在獲得授權後成為該類別成員的人員。
Note: This definition does not limit the definition of authorised officer in subsection 5(1).
註：此定義並不限制第 5(1) 款授權人員的定義。
monitoring device has the same meaning as in section 76D.
監控裝置的意義與第76D條的意義相同。
related monitoring equipment , for a monitoring device, has the same meaning as in section 76D.
相關監控設備，對於監控設備而言，具有與第76D條相同的意義。
subject to monitoring : a person is subject to monitoring if the person holds a Subclass 070 (Bridging (Removal Pending)) visa that is subject to a condition requiring the person to wear a monitoring device at all times.
受監控：如果持有 070 子類（過橋（待遣返））簽證的人將受到監控，且該簽證須遵守要求該人始終佩戴監控設備的條件。

title: Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
zh: Subdivision AG — 有關簽證的其他規定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas

title: 77 Visas held during visa period
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
To avoid doubt, for the purposes of this Act, a non ‑ citizen holds a visa at all times during the visa period for the visa.
為避免疑問，就本法而言，非公民在簽證有效期內始終持有簽證。

title: 78 Children born in Australia
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a child born in Australia is a non ‑ citizen when born; and
(a) 在澳洲出生的兒童一出生即為非公民；和
(b) at the time of the birth:
(b) 出生時：
(i) one of the child’s parents holds a visa (other than a special purpose visa); and
(i) 孩子的父母之一持有簽證（特殊目的簽證除外）；和
(ii) the other parent is, under section 83, included in that visa or does not hold a visa (other than a special purpose visa);
(ii) 根據第 83 條，另一方父母包含在該簽證內或未持有簽證（特殊目的簽證除外）；
the child is taken to have been granted, at the time of the birth, a visa of the same kind and class and on the same terms and conditions (if any) as that visa.
該兒童在出生時被視為已獲得與該簽證相同種類和類別、相同條款和條件（如果有）的簽證。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) a child born in Australia is a non ‑ citizen when born; and
(a) 在澳洲出生的兒童一出生即為非公民；和
(b) at the time of the birth, each of the child’s parents holds a visa (other than a special purpose visa);
(b) 孩子出生時，其父母均持有簽證（特殊目的簽證除外）；
the child is taken to have been granted, at the time of the birth, visas of the same kind and class and on the same terms and conditions (if any) as each of those visas.
該兒童在出生時被視為已獲得與這些簽證相同種類和類別、相同條款和條件（如果有）的簽證。
(3) Subdivisions AA, AB, AC (other than section 68) and AH do not apply in relation to visas granted under this section.
(3) AA、AB、AC（第 68 條除外）和 AH 部分不適用於依本條授予的簽證。

title: 79 Effect on visa of leaving Australia
zh: 79 離開澳洲對簽證的影響
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
If the holder of a visa leaves Australia the holder may only re ‑ enter Australia because of the visa if:
如果簽證持有者離開澳大利亞，則只有在以下情況下，該持有者才能因簽證而重新進入澳大利亞：
(a) the visa is permission for the re ‑ entry; and
(a) 簽證是重新入境的許可；和
(b) the visa is in effect on re ‑ entry.
(b) 簽證在重新入境時生效。

title: 80 Certain persons taken not to leave Australia
zh: 80 某些人被禁止離開澳大利亞
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
A person is taken not to leave Australia if the person goes outside the migration zone on a vessel and:
如果一個人乘船離開移民區並且符合以下條件，則該人將被禁止離開澳洲：
(a) does not go (other than for transit purposes) to a foreign country; and
(a) 不前往外國（過境除外）；和
(b) remains a passenger, or a member of the crew, of that vessel while outside the migration zone; and
(b) 在遷移區之外仍是該船的乘客或船員；和
(c) is outside the migration zone for no longer than the prescribed period.
(c) 離開遷移區的時間不超過規定的時間。

title: 81 Extent of visa authority
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
(1) A visa to travel to Australia during a period is not permission to travel to it outside that period.
(1) 持有在一定期限內前往澳洲的簽證，不得在該期限之外前往澳洲。
(2) A visa to enter Australia within a period is not permission to so enter outside that period.
(2) 在一段時間內進入澳洲的簽證不允許在該期限之外進入澳洲。
(3) A visa to remain in Australia during a period is not permission to so remain outside that period.
(3) 在一段時間內留在澳洲的簽證並不意味著允許在該期限之外居留。

title: 82 When visas cease to be in effect
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
(1) A visa that is cancelled ceases to be in effect on cancellation.
(1) 被取消的簽證在取消時停止生效。
(2) A substantive visa held by a non ‑ citizen ceases to be in effect if another substantive visa (other than a special purpose visa) for the non ‑ citizen comes into effect.
(2) 如另一項實質簽證（特殊目的簽證除外）對某非公民生效，該非公民持有的實質簽證即停止生效。
(2AA) Despite subsection (2):
(2AA) 儘管有第 (2) 款的規定：
(a) a maritime crew visa held by a non ‑ citizen does not cease to be in effect if a substantive visa for the non ‑ citizen that is of a class specified by the Minister, by legislative instrument, for the purposes of this subsection comes into effect; and
(a) 如某非公民的另一項實質簽證生效，而該簽證屬於部長為本款目的以立法文書指定的類別，該非公民持有的海事船員簽證不會因此停止生效；並且
(b) a substantive visa held by a non ‑ citizen that is of a class specified by the Minister, by legislative instrument, for the purposes of this subsection does not cease to be in effect if a maritime crew visa for the non ‑ citizen comes into effect.
(b) 如某非公民的海事船員簽證生效，該非公民持有、且屬於部長為本款目的以立法文書指定類別的實質簽證，不會因此停止生效。
(2A) A temporary visa held by a non ‑ citizen ceases to be in effect if an enforcement visa for the non ‑ citizen comes into effect.
(2A) 如執法簽證對某非公民生效，該非公民持有的臨時簽證即停止生效。
(3) A bridging visa held by a non ‑ citizen ceases to be in effect if another visa (other than a special purpose visa or a maritime crew visa) for the non ‑ citizen comes into effect.
(3) 如另一項簽證（特殊目的簽證或海事船員簽證除外）對某非公民生效，該非公民持有的過橋簽證即停止生效。
(4) A visa ceases to be in effect when the holder leaves Australia because of a deportation order made under section 200.
(4) 如持有人因依第 200 條作出的驅逐令而離開澳洲，簽證在其離境時停止生效。
(5) A visa to travel to and enter Australia (whether also a visa to remain in Australia) during a particular period or until a particular date ceases to be in effect at the end of that period or on that date unless the holder of the visa:
(5) 准許持有人在特定期間內或截至特定日期前往及入境澳洲的簽證（不論該簽證是否亦准許留在澳洲），於該期間結束時或該日期停止生效，除非簽證持有人：
(a) has entered Australia in that period or on or before that date; and
(a) 已在該期間內，或在該日期當日或之前，入境澳洲；並且
(b) is in Australia at the end of that period or on that date.
(b) 在該期間結束時或該日期當日身處澳洲。
(6) A visa to travel to and enter Australia (whether also a visa to remain in Australia) during a particular period or until a particular date ceases to be in effect if the holder leaves Australia after that period or date.
(6) 准許持有人在特定期間內或截至特定日期前往及入境澳洲的簽證（不論該簽證是否亦准許留在澳洲），如持有人在該期間或日期之後離開澳洲，即停止生效。
(7) A visa to remain in Australia (whether also a visa to travel to and enter Australia) during a particular period or until a particular date ceases to be in effect at the end of that period or on that date.
(7) 准許持有人在特定期間內或截至特定日期留在澳洲的簽證（不論該簽證是否亦准許前往及入境澳洲），於該期間結束時或該日期停止生效。
(7A) A bridging visa permitting the holder to remain in, or to travel to, enter and remain in, Australia until a specified event happens, ceases to be in effect the moment the event happens.
(7A) 准許持有人留在澳洲，或前往、入境及留在澳洲，直至指定事件發生的過橋簽證，在該事件發生的一刻停止生效。
(8) A visa to remain in, but not re ‑ enter, Australia that is granted to a non ‑ citizen in Australia ceases to be in effect if the holder leaves Australia.
(8) 向身處澳洲的非公民批准、准許其留在澳洲但不准許再次入境澳洲的簽證，如持有人離開澳洲，即停止生效。
(9) This section does not affect the operation of other provisions of this Act under which a visa ceases to be in effect (such as sections 84E, 173 and 174).
(9) 本條不影響本法其他規定的適用，而簽證可依該等規定停止生效，例如第 84E、173 及 174 條。
(10) For the purposes of subsections (5), (6) and (7), particular date includes:
(10) 就第 (5)、(6) 及 (7) 款而言，『特定日期』包括：
(a) the date an event, specified in the visa, happens; or
(a) 簽證中指定的事件發生之日；或
(b) the date the holder ceases to have a status specified in the visa or the regulations.
(b) 持有人不再具有簽證或規例中指定身分之日。

title: 83 Certain persons taken to be included in spouse, de facto partner or parent’s visa
zh: 83 某些被視為包含在配偶、同居伴侶或父母簽證中的人員
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
(1) Where:
(1) 其中：
(a) a person’s name is included in the passport or other document of identity of the person’s spouse or de facto partner; and
(a) 某人的姓名包含在其配偶或同居伴侶的護照或其他身分文件中；和
(b) the person accompanies his or her spouse or de facto partner to Australia (whether before or after the commencement of this section);
(b) 該人陪同其配偶或同居伴侶前往澳洲（無論是在本節生效前或後）；
the person shall be taken to be included in any visa granted to the spouse or de facto partner evidence of which is endorsed on the passport or other document of identity if, and only if, the person’s name is included in the endorsement.
當且僅當此人的姓名包含在背書中時，才應將該人視為包含在授予配偶或同居伴侶的任何簽證中，且該簽證的證據已背書在護照或其他身分文件上。
Note: Subsection 5(1) defines de facto partner and spouse . For the purposes of this section, those definitions apply only in relation to visas granted on or after 1 July 2009: see the Same ‑ Sex Relationships (Equal Treatment in Commonwealth Laws—General Law Reform) Act 2008 . This section as in force before the amendment of this Act by that Act continues to apply in relation to visas granted before 1 July 2009.
註：第 5(1) 款定義了事實伴侶和配偶。就本節而言，這些定義僅適用於 2009 年 7 月 1 日或之後頒發的簽證：請參閱《2008 年同性關係（聯邦法律中的平等待遇 - 一般法律改革）法案》。本法修訂前有效的本節繼續適用於 2009 年 7 月 1 日之前頒發的簽證。
(2) Where:
(2) 其中：
(a) the name of a child is included in the passport or other document of identity of a parent of the child; and
(a) 兒童的姓名包含在兒童父母一方的護照或其他身分證明文件中；和
(b) the child accompanies that parent to Australia (whether before or after the commencement of this section);
(b) 子女陪同父母前往澳洲（無論是在本條生效前或後）；
the child shall be taken to be included in any visa granted to the parent evidence of which is endorsed on the passport or other document of identity if, and only if, the child’s name is included in the endorsement.
當且僅當兒童的姓名包含在背書中時，該兒童才應被視為包含在授予父母證據並在護照或其他身分文件上背書的任何簽證中。
Note: Subsection 5(1) defines child and parent . For the purposes of this section, those definitions apply only in relation to visas granted on or after 1 July 2009: see the Same ‑ Sex Relationships (Equal Treatment in Commonwealth Laws—General Law Reform) Act 2008 .
注意：第 5(1) 小節定義了 child 和 Parent 。就本節而言，這些定義僅適用於 2009 年 7 月 1 日或之後頒發的簽證：請參閱《2008 年同性關係（聯邦法律中的平等待遇 - 一般法律改革）法案》。

title: 84 Minister may suspend processing of visa applications
zh: 84 部長可能暫停處理簽證申請
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AG — Other provisions about visas
text:
(1) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine that dealing with applications for visas (including protection visas) of a specified class is to stop until a day specified in the determination (in this section called the resumption day ).
(1) 部長可以透過立法文書決定停止處理特定類別的簽證（包括保護簽證）申請，直至決定中指定的日期（本節中稱為恢復日）。
(2) On and after the commencement of an instrument made under subsection (1), no act is to be done in relation to any application for a visa of the class concerned until the resumption day.
(2) 在根據第(1)款制定的文書生效後，在恢復日之前，不得採取任何與相關類別簽證申請相關的行動。
(3) A determination under this section does not have any effect in relation to an application for a visa made by a person on the ground that he or she is the spouse, de facto partner or dependent child of:
(3) 本條規定的決定對於因以下人員的配偶、同居伴侶或受扶養子女而提出的簽證申請沒有任何效力：
(a) an Australian citizen; or
(a) 澳洲公民；或
(b) the holder of a permanent visa that is in effect; or
(b) 有效永久簽證的持有者；或
(c) a person who is usually resident in Australia and whose continued presence in Australia is not subject to a limitation as to time imposed by law.
(c) 通常居住在澳洲且其持續居住在澳洲不受法律規定的時間限制的人。
(4) Nothing in this section prevents an act being done to implement a decision to grant or to refuse to grant a visa if the decision had been made before the date of the determination concerned.
(4) 如果該決定是在相關決定日期之前做出的，則本節不阻止為執行授予或拒絕授予簽證的決定而採取的行動。
(5) For the purposes of this section, a child of a person is a dependent child if the child:
(5) 就本節而言，如果一個人的子女符合下列條件，則該子女是受扶養子女：
(a) does not have a spouse or de facto partner; and
(a) 沒有配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) is under 18; or
(i) 未滿 18 歲；或
(ii) is 18, 19 or 20 and is dependent on the person for:
(ii) 年滿 18 歲、19 歲或 20 歲且依賴該人：
(A) financial and psychological support; or
(A) 經濟和心理支持；或
(B) physical support.
（二）物質支持。
(6) In this section:
(6) 本節：
act means an act connected with performing functions or exercising powers under or for the purposes of this Act.
行為是指與依本法或為了本法的目的而履行職能或行使權力有關的行為。

title: Subdivision AGA — Arrival control determinations
zh: 細分 AGA — 到達控制決定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 84A Object of Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The object of this Subdivision is to allow temporary restrictions on the arrival of certain classes of temporary visa holders in Australia, where this is necessary to protect the integrity and sustainability of Australia’s immigration system, including when events or circumstances outside Australia mean that there is an increased risk that certain classes of temporary visa holders will not depart Australia when their visas cease to be in effect.
本細則的目的是允許對某些類別的臨時簽證持有者抵達澳洲進行臨時限制，這對於保護澳洲移民制度的完整性和可持續性是必要的，包括當澳洲境外的事件或情況意味著某些類別的臨時簽證持有者在簽證不再有效時不會離開澳洲的風險增加時。

title: 84B Minister may make arrival control determinations
zh: 84B 部長可以做出抵達控制決定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, make a determination (an arrival control determination ) specifying that section 84E (suspension of temporary visas held by non ‑ citizens) applies , either generally or in specified circumstances, to one or more specified classes of non ‑ citizens.
(1) 部長可以透過立法文書做出決定（入境控制決定），明確第 84E 條（暫停非公民持有的臨時簽證）一般或在特定情況下適用於一類或多類特定類別的非公民。
Note: Section 84F requires the Minister to cause a copy of an arrival control determination to be tabled in each House of the Parliament within 2 sitting days of that House after making the determination.
注意：第 84F 條要求部長在做出決定後，在議會各議院開會的 2 個工作天內，向議會各議院提交一份抵達控制決定的副本。
(2) Before making an arrival control determination, the Minister must be reasonably satisfied that:
(2) 在做出抵達控制決定之前，部長必須合理地確信：
(a) an event or circumstance has occurred, or is occurring, outside Australia; and
(a) 在澳洲境外發生或正在發生的事件或情況；和
(b) one or both of the following apply:
(b) 下列一項或兩項適用：
(i) having regard to the event or circumstance, non ‑ citizens of a kind to whom the determination is to apply may, if they enter Australia on a temporary visa, remain in Australia after the visa ceases to be in effect;
(i) 考慮到事件或情況，適用該決定的非公民如果持臨時簽證進入澳大利亞，則可以在簽證失效後留在澳大利亞；
(ii) if the event or circumstance had occurred, or had been occurring, at the time non ‑ citizens of a kind to whom the determination is to apply were to make an application for a temporary visa, the visa may not have been granted; and
(ii) 如果該事件或情況在該決定所適用的非公民申請臨時簽證時已經發生或正在發生，則該簽證可能不會被授予；和
(c) having regard to the object of this Subdivision, it is in the national interest to make the determination.
(c) 考慮到本款的目的，做出決定符合國家利益。
(3) Before making an arrival control determination, the Minister must obtain agreement in writing to the making of the determination from:
(3) 在做出抵達控制決定之前，部長必須獲得以下人員的書面同意：
(a) the Prime Minister; and
(a) 總理；和
(b) the Minister administering the Diplomatic Privileges and Immunities Act 1967 .
(b) 執行《1967 年外交特權和豁免法》的部長。
(4) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, revoke an arrival control determination made under subsection (1).
(4) 部長可透過立法文書撤銷依第 (1) 款所作出的抵達管制決定。
When arrival control determination is in force
當到達控制決定生效時
(5) An arrival control determination must specify the period for which the determination is in force, which must not be longer than the period that the Minister considers appropriate in all the circumstances.
(5) 抵達管制決定必須明確決定的有效期限，該期限不得長於部長在所有情況下認為適當的期限。
Note: Under subsection (6), an arrival control determination cannot be in force longer than the period of 6 months beginning on the day after the day the determination commences.
註：根據第（6）款，到達控制決定的有效期限不得超過自決定開始之日起的 6 個月。
(6) An arrival control determination is repealed at the earlier of the following times (unless revoked earlier under subsection (4)):
(6) 到達控制決定在以下時間中較早的時間被撤銷（除非根據第（4）款提前撤銷）：
(a) the end of the period specified for the purposes of subsection (5);
(a) 為第(5)款的目的而指定的期限結束；
(b) the end of the period of 6 months beginning on the day after the day the determination commences.
(b) 自裁決開始之日起的 6 個月期限結束。
Personal power etc.
個人實力等
(7) The power under subsection (1) or (4) may only be exercised by the Minister personally.
(7) 第 (1) 或 (4) 款規定的權力只能由部長親自行使。
(8) The rules of natural justice do not apply to an exercise of power under subsection (1) or (4).
(8) 自然正義規則不適用於依第 (1) 或 (4) 款行使權力。
(9) Subsection 33(3) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 does not apply to the power under subsection (1) of this section.
(9) 1901 年《法案解釋法》第 33(3) 款不適用於本條第 (1) 款規定的權力。
Note: An arrival control determination may not be varied or amended, but may be revoked under subsection (4) of this section.
註：到達控制決定不得變更或修改，但可依本節第 (4) 款撤銷。
(10) Nothing in this Act prevents the Minister from exercising the power in subsection (1) more than once in relation to:
(10) 本法中的任何規定不得阻止部長在以下方面多次行使第 (1) 款中的權力：
(a) the same event or circumstance; or
(a) 同一事件或情況；或
(b) the same class of non ‑ citizens.
(b) 同一類別的非公民。
(11) An arrival control determination may make different provision with respect to different classes of non ‑ citizens.
(11) 入境管制決定可以針對不同類別的非公民做出不同的規定。
(12) The Minister must ensure only one arrival control determination is in force in relation to a particular class of non ‑ citizens at any one time.
(12) 部長必須確保在任何時間只有一項入境管制決定對特定類別的非公民有效。
(13) Section 42 (disallowance) of the Legislation Act 2003 does not apply to:
(13) 2003 年立法法第 42 條（禁止）不適用於：
(a) an arrival control determination made under subsection (1); or
(a) 根據第(1)款所做的到達控制決定；或
(b) a revocation of an arrival control determination under subsection (4).
(b) 撤銷第(4)款規定的到達控制決定。

title: 84C Arrival control determination does not apply in relation to certain kinds of non ‑ citizens
zh: 84C 到達控制決定不適用於某些類型的非公民
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An arrival control determination does not apply at a particular time in relation to a non ‑ citizen if, at that time, the non ‑ citizen holds:
(1) 抵達管制決定在特定時間不適用於非公民，如果該非公民當時持有：
(a) a protection visa that is a temporary visa; or
(a) 保護簽證是臨時簽證；或
(b) a temporary safe haven visa; or
(b) 臨時避難簽證；或
(c) a visa classified by the regulations as a Temporary (Humanitarian Concern) (Class UO) visa; or
(c) 依法規分類為臨時（人道考量）（UO 類）簽證的簽證；或
(d) a bridging visa granted as a result of an application for a visa of a kind referred to in any of paragraphs (a), (b) or (c).
(d) 因申請(a)、(b)或(c)段所提及的簽證而獲得的過橋簽證。
Note 1: A protection visa is a visa of a class provided for by section 35A. Examples of protection visas that are temporary visas include temporary protection visas (see subsection 35A(3)) and safe haven enterprise visas (see subsection 35A(3A)).
註1：保護簽證是第35A條規定的類別的簽證。屬於臨時簽證的保護簽證範例包括臨時保護簽證（請參閱第 35A(3) 款）和避風港企業簽證（請參閱第 35A(3A) 款）。
Note 2: An arrival control determination does not cause permanent visas to cease to be in effect (see subsection 84E(1)). As a result, permanent visas such as permanent protection visas, or visas classified by the regulations as a Refugee and Humanitarian (Class XB) visa are not affected by an arrival control determination.
註 2：入境管制決定不會導致永久簽證不再有效（請參閱第 84E(1) 條）。因此，永久保護簽證等永久簽證或按法規分類為難民和人道主義（XB 類）簽證的簽證不受抵達管制決定的影響。
(2) Subsection (1) has effect in relation to a visa holder regardless of whether the visa is granted before, on or after the time the determination comes into force.
(2) 第(1)款對簽證持有者有效，不論簽證是在決定生效前、時或後授予的。
(3) An arrival control determination does not apply at any time in relation to a non ‑ citizen if the non ‑ citizen is in the migration zone at the time the determination commences.
(3) 如果非公民在決定開始時處於移民區，則入境管制決定在任何時候都不適用於該非公民。
(4) An arrival control determination does not apply in relation to a non ‑ citizen at a particular time if, at that time, the non ‑ citizen is:
(4) 抵達管制決定不適用於特定時間的非公民，如果該非公民當時是：
(a) the spouse, de facto partner or dependent child (within the meaning of the regulations) of:
(a) 配偶、同居伴侶或受扶養子女（在法規意義內）：
(i) an Australian citizen; or
(i) 澳洲公民；或
(ii) the holder of a permanent visa that is in effect; or
(ii) 有效永久簽證的持有者；或
(iii) a person who is usually resident in Australia and whose continued presence in Australia is not subject to a limitation as to time imposed by law; or
(iii) 通常居住在澳洲且其持續居住在澳洲不受法律規定的時間限制的人；或
(b) the parent of a child who is under 18 and who is in Australia; or
(b) 18 歲以下且在澳洲的兒童的父母；或
(c) the subject of a permitted travel certificate that is in force.
(c) 有效的允許旅行證明的主題。
Note: An arrival control determination does not apply to a non ‑ citizen if the Minister issues a permitted travel certificate in relation to the non ‑ citizen (see subsection 84D(1)). Under subsection 84D(5), a permitted travel certificate may not be revoked while the non ‑ citizen is in the migration zone.
註：如果部長為非公民簽發允許的旅行證明，則入境管制決定不適用於非公民（見第 84D(1) 款）。根據第 84D(5) 款，當非公民處於移民區時，不得吊銷允許的旅行證明。
(5) Subsections (1), (3) and (4) apply despite anything in an arrival control determination.
(5) 無論到達控制決定中有何情況，第 (1)、(3) 及 (4) 款均適用。

title: 84D Minister may certify that arrival control determination does not apply in relation to a particular non ‑ citizen
zh: 84D 部長可證明抵達管制決定不適用於特定非公民
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The Minister may issue a certificate (a permitted travel certificate ) providing that an arrival control determination does not apply in relation to a particular non ‑ citizen if the Minister is satisfied in all the circumstances that it is appropriate for the determination not to apply to that non ‑ citizen (whether or not the certificate is requested under subsection (2)).
(1) 如果部長在所有情況下都確信該決定不適用於該非公民（無論是否根據第 (2) 款要求提供該證明），則部長可以頒發證書（允許的旅行證書），規定抵達管制決定不適用於該非公民。
(2) A non ‑ citizen, or a person authorised to act on behalf of the non ‑ citizen, may make a request in writing to the Minister for a permitted travel certificate in relation to the non ‑ citizen.
(2) 非公民或被授權代表該非公民行事的人可以向部長提出書面請求，要求獲得與該非公民有關的允許旅行證明。
(3) If the Minister issues a permitted travel certificate in relation to a non ‑ citizen, the certificate has effect despite anything in the arrival control determination.
(3) 如果部長向非公民簽發允許旅行證明，則無論抵達控制決定中存在什麼情況，該證明仍然有效。
Note: An arrival control determination may specify that section 84E (suspension of temporary visas held by non ‑ citizens) applies, either generally or in specified circumstances, to one or more specified classes of non ‑ citizens.
註：入境管制決定可能會規定第 84E 條（暫停非公民持有的臨時簽證）一般或在特定情況下適用於一類或多類特定類別的非公民。
(4) A permitted travel certificate must be in writing.
(4) 允許的旅行證明必須是書面的。
(5) The Minister may, in writing, revoke a permitted travel certificate in relation to a non ‑ citizen at a particular time if the non ‑ citizen is not in the migration zone at that time.
(5) 如果非公民當時不在移民區，部長可以書面撤銷該非公民在特定時間的允許旅行證書。
Other matters
其他事項
(6) Each of the following is not a legislative instrument:
(6)下列各項不屬於立法文書：
(a) a permitted travel certificate;
(a) 允許的旅行證明；
(b) a revocation under subsection (5).
(b) 第(5)款規定的撤銷。
(7) The rules of natural justice do not apply to an exercise of power under subsection (1) or (5).
(7) 自然正義規則不適用於依第 (1) 或 (5) 款行使權力。
(8) The Minister does not have a duty to consider whether to exercise the power to issue a permitted travel certificate in relation to a particular non ‑ citizen, whether the Minister is requested to do so under subsection (2), or in any other circumstances.
(8) 部長沒有義務考慮是否行使向特定非公民頒發允許旅行證書的權力，無論是根據第(2)款要求部長這樣做，還是在任何其他情況下。
Report to Parliament
向議會報告
(9) The Minister must, as soon as practicable after the end of each period of 6 months beginning on 1 January or 1 July, cause a report to be laid before each House of the Parliament containing a statement of the number of permitted travel certificates issued under this section during the period.
(9) 部長必須在自 1 月 1 日或 7 月 1 日開始的每 6 個月期間結束後，盡快向議會各院提交一份報告，其中載有該期間內根據本節頒發的允許旅行證件數量的說明。

title: 84E Temporary visas of non ‑ citizens in class specified in arrival control determination cease to be in effect etc.
zh: 84E 到達控制決定中指定類別的非公民臨時簽證不再有效等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Temporary visa of non ‑ citizen not in the migration zone ceases to be in effect
不在移民區的非公民的臨時簽證不再有效
(1) A temporary visa held by a non ‑ citizen ceases to be in effect if an arrival control determination that is in force applies to the non ‑ citizen.
(1) 如果有效的入境管制決定適用於非公民，則該非公民持有的臨時簽證不再有效。
Note 1: In general, non ‑ citizens must not travel to Australia without a visa that is in effect (see section 42). Visa holders are usually required to enter Australia at a port (see section 43). A person who enters Australia must provide evidence of their identity (see section 166).
註 1：一般來說，非公民不得在沒有有效簽證的情況下前往澳洲（請參閱第 42 條）。簽證持有者通常需要從港口進入澳洲（見第 43 條）。進入澳洲的人必須提供身分證明（參見第 166 條）。
Note 2: An arrival control determination does not apply in relation to certain non ‑ citizens, including a non ‑ citizen who is in the migration zone at the time the determination commences, or a non ‑ citizen who is the subject of a permitted travel certificate that is in force (see section 84C).
註 2：入境管制決定不適用於某些非公民，包括決定開始時處於移民區的非公民，或持有有效的允許旅行證明的非公民（請參閱第 84C 條）。
Note 3: Under subsection 84D(5), a permitted travel certificate may not be revoked while the non ‑ citizen is in the migration zone.
註 3：依第 84D(5) 款，當非公民在移民區時，不得吊銷允許的旅行證明。
Temporary visa may come into effect again
臨時簽證可能再次生效
(2) If a temporary visa held by a non ‑ citizen has ceased to be in effect under subsection (1), the visa comes into effect again at a particular time during the visa period for the visa if, at that time:
(2) 如果非公民持有的臨時簽證根據第(1)款不再有效，則該簽證將在該簽證有效期內的特定時間再次生效，如果當時：
(a) the arrival control determination referred to in that subsection is revoked or otherwise ceases to be in effect; or
(a) 該款所指的到達管制決定被撤銷或以其他方式不再有效；或
(b) the non ‑ citizen ceases to be in a class of non ‑ citizens specified in the determination mentioned in paragraph (a); or
(b) 該非公民不再屬於(a)段所述決定中指定的非公民類別；或
(c) the non ‑ citizen becomes a non ‑ citizen to whom the determination mentioned in paragraph (a) does not apply.
(c) 該非公民成為不適用(a)款所述決定的非公民。
Other cessation provisions not limited or otherwise affected
其他不受限製或不受影響的停止條款
(3) This section does not limit, or otherwise affect, any other provision of this Act under which a visa ceases to be in effect.
(3) 本條不限製或以其他方式影響本法中簽證不再有效的任何其他規定。
Note: A non ‑ citizen’s visa may cease to be in effect under another provision of this Act. If that occurs, the visa period for the visa ends (see subparagraph (b)(i) of the definition of visa period in subsection 5(1)) and the non ‑ citizen will no longer hold the visa (see section 77).
註：根據本法的另一條款，非公民的簽證可能不再有效。如果發生這種情況，簽證的簽證期限結束（請參閱第 5(1) 小節中簽證期限定義的 (b)(i) 項），非公民將不再持有簽證（請參閱第 77 條）。

title: 84F Statement relating to arrival control determination etc. to be laid before Parliament
zh: 84F 向議會提交的有關抵達管制決定等的聲明
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) If the Minister makes an arrival control determination, the Minister must cause to be laid before each House of the Parliament:
(1) 若部長做出抵達控制決定，部長必須向議會各院提交以下決定：
(a) a copy of the determination; and
(a) 決定的副本；和
(b) a statement of the Minister’s reasons for making the determination.
(b) 部長作出該決定的理由的聲明。
(2) The Minister must comply with subsection (1) within 2 sitting days of each House of the Parliament after the day on which the determination is made.
(2) 部長必須在做出決定之日後的議會兩院開會 2 天內遵守第 (1) 款。
(3) A failure to comply with subsection (1) or (2) does not affect the validity of the determination.
(3) 不遵守第 (1) 或 (2) 款並不影響決定的有效性。

title: Subdivision AH — Limit on visas
zh: AH 細分 — 簽證限制
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 85 Limit on visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) Subject to subsection (2), the Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine the maximum number of:
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，部長可以透過立法文書確定以下人員的最大數量：
(a) the visas (including protection visas) of a specified class; or
(a) 特定類別的簽證（包括保護簽證）；或
(b) the visas (including protection visas) of specified classes;
（二）特定類別的簽證（包括保護簽證）；
that may be granted in a specified financial year.
可以在特定財政年度授予。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to temporary protection visas or safe haven enterprise visas.
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於臨時保護簽證或避風港企業簽證。

title: 86 Effect of limit
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
If:
如果：
(a) there is a determination of the maximum number of visas of a class or classes that may be granted in a financial year; and
(a) 確定一個財政年度可授予的一個或多個類別簽證的最大數量；和
(b) the number of visas of the class or classes granted in the year reaches that maximum number;
(b) 當年授予的類別或類別的簽證數量達到最高數量；
no more visas of the class or classes may be granted in the year.
當年不得再簽發該類別的簽證。

title: 87 Limit does not prevent visas for certain persons
zh: 87 限制並不妨礙某些人取得簽證
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) Section 86 does not prevent the grant of a visa to a person who applied for it on the ground that he or she is the spouse, de facto partner or dependent child of:
(1) 第 86 條並不妨礙向下列人士的配偶、同居伴侶或受扶養子女申請簽證：
(a) an Australian citizen; or
(a) 澳洲公民；或
(b) the holder of a permanent visa that is in effect; or
(b) 有效永久簽證的持有者；或
(c) a person who is usually resident in Australia and whose continued presence in Australia is not subject to a limitation as to time imposed by law.
(c) 通常居住在澳洲且其持續居住在澳洲不受法律規定的時間限制的人。
(2) For the purposes of this section, a child of a person is a dependent child if the child:
(2) 就本節而言，如果某人的子女符合下列條件，則該子女是受扶養子女：
(a) does not have a spouse or de facto partner; and
(a) 沒有配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) is under 18; or
(i) 未滿 18 歲；或
(ii) is 18, 19 or 20 and is dependent on the person for:
(ii) 年滿 18 歲、19 歲或 20 歲且依賴該人：
(A) financial and psychological support; or
(A) 經濟和心理支持；或
(B) physical support.
（二）物質支持。

title: 87A Limit does not prevent the grant of visas to certain people who are unable to meet health or character requirements before the limit applies because of circumstances beyond their control
zh: 87A 限制並不妨礙向某些因無法控制的情況而在限制適用之前無法滿足健康或品格要求的人發放簽證
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
If:
如果：
(a) a person has applied, whether before or after the commencement of this section, for the grant of a visa; and
(a) 一個人，無論是在本條生效之前或之後，已經申請了簽證的授予；和
(b) a time was or is reached when the grant of the visa to the person in a particular financial year was or is prevented by section 86; and
(b) 第 86 條阻止在特定財政年度向該人發放簽證的時間已達到或已達到；和
(c) the person was requested by the Minister after that time to satisfy requirements for the grant of the visa that relate to health or character; and
(c) 此後部長要求該人滿足與健康或品格相關的簽證發放要求；和
(d) after the making of the request referred to in paragraph (c) the person satisfies the requirements referred to in that paragraph in a financial year subsequent to the financial year in which the time referred to in paragraph (b) occurred; and
(d) 在提出(c)款所述的請求後，該人在(b)款所述時間發生的財政年度之後的財政年度滿足該款所述的要求；和
(e) the grant of the visa to the person at the time when the requirements referred to in paragraph (c) are satisfied would, apart from this section, be prevented by section 86; and
(e) 除本節外，第 86 條將阻止在滿足 (c) 段中提到的要求時向該人授予簽證；和
(f) the person was unable to satisfy the requirements referred to in paragraph (c) at a time when, apart from this section, section 86 would not have prevented the grant of the visa to the person; and
(f) 在除本條之外第 86 條不會阻止向該人授予簽證的情況下，該人無法滿足 (c) 段中提到的要求；和
(g) the Minister is satisfied that the person’s inability to satisfy the requirements referred to in paragraph (c) at a time mentioned in paragraph (e) was due to circumstances beyond the person’s control;
(g) 部長信納該人在(e)段所提及的時間無法滿足(c)段所提及的要求是由於該人無法控制的情況所造成的；
section 86 does not prevent the grant of the visa to the person.
第 86 條並不妨礙向該人授予簽證。

title: 88 Limit does not affect processing of applications
zh: 88 限制不影響申請的處理
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Section 86’s prevention of the grant of a visa does not prevent any other action related to the application for it.
第 86 條阻止授予簽證並不阻止與簽證申請相關的任何其他行動。

title: 89 Determination of limit not to mean failure to decide
zh: 89 限制的確定並不意味著未能決定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The fact that the Minister has neither granted nor refused to grant a visa of a class or classes to which a determination under section 85 applies does not mean, for any purpose, that the Minister has failed to make a decision to grant or refuse to grant the visa.
部長既沒有授予也沒有拒絕授予第 85 條所適用的決定所適用的一類或多類簽證這一事實，無論出於何種目的，並不意味著部長未能做出授予或拒絕授予簽證的決定。

title: 90 Order of dealing with limited visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The fact that an application for a visa of a class or classes to which a determination under section 85 applies has not been considered or disposed of although an application for another visa of the class or classes that was made later has been considered or disposed of does not mean, for any purpose, that the consideration or disposal of the earlier application is unreasonably delayed.
儘管後來提出的另一簽證申請已被考慮或處理，但根據第 85 條作出的決定所適用的一個或多個類別的簽證申請尚未被考慮或處理，這一事實並不意味著，出於任何目的，對較早申請的考慮或處理被無理拖延。

title: 91 Order of dealing with visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
If a determination under section 85 applies, or has applied, to visas of a class or classes, the Minister may consider or, subject to section 86, dispose of outstanding and further applications for such visas in such order as he or she considers appropriate.
如果第 85 條規定的決定適用或已經適用於某一類或多類簽證，部長可以考慮或根據第 86 條的規定，按照他或她認為適當的順序處理此類簽證的未決申請和進一步申請。

title: Subdivision AI — Safe third countries
zh: 細分人工智慧－安全的第三國
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 91A Reason for Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
This Subdivision is enacted because the Parliament considers that certain non ‑ citizens who are covered by the CPA, or in relation to whom there is a safe third country, should not be allowed to apply for a protection visa or, in some cases, any other visa. Any such non ‑ citizen who is an unlawful non ‑ citizen will be subject to removal under Division 8.
頒布該細則是因為議會認為某些受 CPA 保護的非公民或存在安全第三國的非公民不應被允許申請保護簽證，或在某些情況下申請任何其他簽證。任何此類非公民如果是非法非公民，將根據第 8 條被驅逐出境。

title: 91B Interpretation
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) In this Subdivision:
(1) 在本小節：
agreement includes a written arrangement or understanding, whether or not binding.
協議包括書面安排或諒解，無論是否具有約束力。
CPA means the Comprehensive Plan of Action approved by the International Conference on Indo ‑ Chinese Refugees, held at Geneva, Switzerland, from 13 to 14 June 1989.
CPA 是指 1989 年 6 月 13 日至 14 日在瑞士日內瓦舉行的印支難民問題國際會議所批准的綜合行動計畫。
(2) For the purposes of this Subdivision, if, apart from this section:
(2) 就本款而言，若除本節外：
(a) a colony, overseas territory or protectorate of a foreign country; or
(a) 外國的殖民地、海外領土或保護國；或
(b) an overseas territory for the international relations of which a foreign country is responsible;
(b) 由外國負責國際關係的海外領土；
is not a country in its own right, the colony, territory or protectorate is taken to be a country in its own right.
殖民地、領土或保護國本身不是一個國家，則該殖民地、領土或保護國被視為其本身的一個國家。

title: 91C Non ‑ citizens covered by Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This Subdivision applies to a non ‑ citizen at a particular time if:
(1) 本款在特定時間適用於非公民，如果：
(a) the non ‑ citizen is in Australia at that time; and
(a) 該非公民當時在澳洲；和
(b) at that time, the non ‑ citizen is covered by:
(b) 此時，該非公民受下列保護：
(i) the CPA; or
(i) 註冊會計師；或
(ii) an agreement, relating to persons seeking asylum, between Australia and a country that is, or countries that include a country that is, at that time, a safe third country in relation to the non ‑ citizen (see section 91D); and
(ii) 澳洲與一個或多個國家之間簽訂的與尋求庇護者有關的協議，該國家或國家包括當時對該非公民而言是安全的第三國的國家（見第91D條）；和
(c) the non ‑ citizen is not excluded by the regulations from the application of this Subdivision.
(c) 法規並未將非公民排除在本款的適用範圍之外。
(2) To avoid doubt, a country does not need to be prescribed as a safe third country at the time that the agreement referred to in subparagraph (1)(b)(ii) is made.
(2) 為避免疑義，在達成第(1)(b)(ii)項所述協議時，無需將一個國家規定為安全第三國。

title: 91D Safe third countries
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A country is a safe third country in relation to a non ‑ citizen if:
(1) 一個國家對非公民來說是安全的第三國，如果：
(a) the country is prescribed as a safe third country in relation to the non ‑ citizen, or in relation to a class of persons of which the non ‑ citizen is a member; and
(a) 對於非公民或非公民所屬的一類人來說，該國被規定為安全第三國；和
(b) the non ‑ citizen has a prescribed connection with the country.
(b) 非公民與國家有規定的聯繫。
(2) Without limiting paragraph (1)(b), the regulations may provide that a person has a prescribed connection with a country if:
(2) 在不限制第(1)(b)款的情況下，條例可以規定一個人與一個國家有規定的聯繫，如果：
(a) the person is or was present in the country at a particular time or at any time during a particular period; or
(a) 該人在特定時間或特定時期內的任何時間現在或曾經在該國；或
(b) the person has a right to enter and reside in the country (however that right arose or is expressed).
(b) 該人有權進入並居住在該國（無論該權利是如何產生或表達的）。
(3) The Minister must, within 2 sitting days after a regulation under paragraph (1)(a) is laid before a House of the Parliament, cause to be laid before that House a statement, covering the country, or each of the countries, prescribed as a safe third country by the regulation, about:
(3) 部長必須在第 (1)(a) 款規定的規定提交議會眾議院後 2 個開會日內，促使向眾議院提交一份聲明，涵蓋該規定規定為安全第三國的國家或每個國家，內容如下：
(a) the compliance by the country, or each of the countries, with relevant international law concerning the protection of persons seeking asylum; and
(a) 國家或每個國家遵守有關保護尋求庇護者的相關國際法的情況；和
(b) the meeting by the country, or each of the countries, of relevant human rights standards for the persons in relation to whom the country is prescribed as a safe third country; and
(b) 該國或每個國家滿足該國被規定為安全第三國的人員的相關人權標準；和
(c) the willingness of the country, or each of the countries, to allow any person in relation to whom the country is prescribed as a safe third country:
(c) 該國或每個國家是否願意允許與該國被規定為安全第三國的任何人：
(i) to go to the country; and
(i) 前往該國；和
(ii) to remain in the country during the period in which any claim by the person for asylum is determined; and
(ii) 在確定該人的庇護申請期間留在該國；和
(iii) if the person is determined to be a refugee while in the country—to remain in the country until a durable solution relating to the permanent settlement of the person is found.
(iii) 若該人在該國期間被認定為難民－則留在該國，直至找到有關該人永久定居的持久解決方案。
(4) A regulation made for the purposes of paragraph (1)(a) ceases to be in force at the end of 2 years after the regulation commences.
(4) 為第 (1)(a) 款的目的而製定的規定在該規定生效後 2 年後不再有效。

title: 91E Non ‑ citizens to which this Subdivision applies unable to make valid applications for certain visas
zh: 91E 本節適用的非公民無法對某些簽證提出有效申請
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Despite any other provision of this Act, if this Subdivision applies to a non ‑ citizen at a particular time and, at that time, the non ‑ citizen applies, or purports to apply, for a protection visa then, subject to section 91F:
儘管本法有任何其他規定，如果本款在特定時間適用於非公民，且該非公民在該時間申請或聲稱申請保護簽證，則根據第 91F 條：
(a) if the non ‑ citizen has not been immigration cleared at that time—neither that application nor any other application made by the non ‑ citizen for a visa is a valid application; or
(a) 若該非公民當時尚未獲得移民許可－該申請或該非公民提出的任何其他簽證申請都不是有效的申請；或
(b) if the non ‑ citizen has been immigration cleared at that time—neither that application nor any other application made by the non ‑ citizen for a protection visa is a valid application.
(b) 如果該非公民當時已獲得移民許可－該申請或該非公民提出的任何其他保護簽證申請都不是有效的申請。

title: 91F Minister may determine that section 91E does not apply to non ‑ citizen
zh: 91F 部長可以確定第 91E 條不適用於非公民
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) If the Minister thinks that it is in the public interest to do so, the Minister may, by written notice given to a particular non ‑ citizen, determine:
(1) 如果部長認為這樣做符合公共利益，部長可以透過向特定非公民發出書面通知來決定：
(a) that section 91E does not apply to an application for a visa made by the non ‑ citizen in the period starting when the notice is given and ending at the end of the seventh working day after the day that the notice is given; or
(a) 第91E條不適用於非公民在發出通知之日起至發出通知之日後第七個工作日結束期間提出的簽證申請；或
(b) that section 91G does not apply to an application for a visa made by the non ‑ citizen during the transitional period referred to in that section.
(b) 第91G條不適用於非公民在該條提及的過渡期內提出的簽證申請。
(2) The power under subsection (1) may only be exercised by the Minister personally.
(2) 第 (1) 款規定的權力只能由部長親自行使。
(3) If the Minister makes a determination under subsection (1), he or she is to cause to be laid before each House of the Parliament a statement that:
(3) 若部長依第 (1) 款做出決定，他或她應向議會各院提交一份聲明，內容如下：
(a) sets out the determination; and
(a) 列出決定；和
(b) sets out the reasons for the determination, referring in particular to the Minister’s reasons for thinking that his or her actions are in the public interest.
(b) 闡明做出該決定的理由，特別是部長認為其行為符合公共利益的理由。
(4) A statement under subsection (3) is not to include:
(4) 第 (3) 款規定的聲明不應包括：
(a) the name of the non ‑ citizen; or
(a) 非公民的姓名；或
(b) any information that may identify the non ‑ citizen; or
(b) 任何可識別該非公民身分的資訊；或
(c) if the Minister thinks that it would not be in the public interest to publish the name of another person connected in any way with the matter concerned—the name of that other person or any information that may identify that other person.
(c) 若部長認為公佈與相關事項有任何關係的另一人的姓名不符合公共利益，則該人的姓名或任何可識別該人身分的資訊。
(5) A statement under subsection (3) is to be laid before each House of the Parliament within 15 sitting days of that House after:
(5) 第 (3) 款規定的聲明應在議會各院開會後 15 天內提交：
(a) if the determination is made between 1 January and 30 June (inclusive) in a year—1 July in that year; or
(a) 若決定是在一年中的1月1日至6月30日（含）之間做出的－該年的7月1日；或
(b) if the determination is made between 1 July and 31 December (inclusive) in a year—1 January in the following year.
(b) 如果決定是在一年中的7月1日至12月31日（含）之間做出的－下一年的1月1日。
(6) The Minister does not have a duty to consider whether to exercise the power under subsection (1) in respect of any non ‑ citizen, whether he or she is requested to do so by the non ‑ citizen or by any other person, or in any other circumstances.
(6) 部長沒有義務考慮是否對任何非公民行使第 (1) 款規定的權力，無論是非公民或任何其他人要求他或她這樣做，還是在任何其他情況下。

title: 91G Applications made before regulations take effect
zh: 91G 法規生效前提出的申請
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) Subject to section 91F and subsection (3), if:
(1) 根據第 91F 條和第 (3) 款，如果：
(a) this Subdivision applies to a non ‑ citizen immediately after a regulation prescribing a country as a safe third country takes effect and did not apply to the non ‑ citizen immediately before that time; and
(a) 本款在規定一個國家為安全第三國的法規生效後立即適用於非公民，但在此之前不適用於非公民；和
(b) the regulation prescribes a day as the cut off day; and
(b) 法規規定某一天為截止日；和
(c) during the period (the transitional period ) from the beginning of the cut off day until immediately before that regulation takes effect, the non ‑ citizen made an application for a protection visa;
(c) 在從截止日開始到該規定生效之前的期間（過渡期），非公民提出了保護簽證申請；
then:
那麼：
(d) if the non ‑ citizen had not been immigration cleared at the time of making the application—that application, and any other application made by the non ‑ citizen for a visa made during the transitional period, ceases to be a valid application when the regulation takes effect; and
(d) 若該非公民在提出申請時尚未獲得移民許可，則該申請以及該非公民在過渡期內提出的任何其他簽證申請在該條例生效時不再是有效的申請；和
(e) if the non ‑ citizen had been immigration cleared at the time of making the application—that application, and any other application made by the non ‑ citizen for a protection visa made during the transitional period, ceases to be a valid application when the regulation takes effect; and
(e) 若該非公民在提出申請時已獲得移民許可，則該申請以及該非公民在過渡期內提出的任何其他保護簽證申請，在該條例生效時不再是有效的申請；和
(f) on and after the regulation takes effect, this Act applies as if the non ‑ citizen had applied for a protection visa immediately after the regulation takes effect.
(f) 在條例生效之日及之後，本法的適用如同非公民在條例生效後立即申請保護簽證一樣。
(2) To avoid doubt:
(2) 為避免疑問：
(a) paragraphs (1)(d) and (e) apply even if an application referred to in the paragraph concerned, or a decision in relation to such an application, is the subject of a review by, or an appeal or application to, the ART, a Federal Court or any other body or court; and
(a) 即使有關段落中提到的申請或與該申請有關的決定受到 ART、聯邦法院或任何其他機構或法院的審查或上訴或申請，第 (1)(d) 和 (e) 款仍然適用；和
(b) no visa may be granted to the non ‑ citizen as a direct, or indirect, result of such an application.
(b) 不得因此類申請的直接或間接結果而向非公民發放簽證。
(3) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a non ‑ citizen who, before the regulation referred to in that subsection takes effect, has:
(3) 第(1)款不適用於在該款提及的法規生效之前具有以下特徵的非公民：
(a) been granted a substantive visa as a result of an application referred to in that subsection; or
(a) 因該款所述的申請而獲得實質簽證；或
(b) been determined under this Act to be a non ‑ citizen who satisfies the criterion mentioned in subsection 36(2).
(b) 依本法被認定為符合第 36(2) 款所述標準的非公民。
(4) The cut off day specified in the regulation must not be:
（四）本規定規定的截止日不得為：
(a) before a day on which the Minister, by notice in the Gazette , announces that he or she intends that such a regulation will be made; or
(a) 在部長透過公報公告宣布他或她打算制定此類規定之前；或
(b) more than 6 months before the regulation takes effect.
(b) 條例生效前6個月以上。

title: Subdivision AJ — Temporary safe haven visas
zh: AJ 細分 — 臨時安全港簽證
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AJ — Temporary safe haven visas

title: 91H Reason for this Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision AJ — Temporary safe haven visas
text:
This Subdivision is enacted because the Parliament considers that a non ‑ citizen (other than an unauthorised maritime arrival or a transitory person) who holds a temporary safe haven visa, or who has not left Australia since ceasing to hold such a visa, should not be allowed to apply for a visa other than another temporary safe haven visa.
