title: Subdivision D — Enforcement
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 140K Sanctions for failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations
zh: 因未履行贊助義務而受到 140K 制裁
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Actions that may be taken in relation to approved sponsors
可以對批准的發起人採取的行動
(1) If a person is an approved sponsor and fails to satisfy an applicable sponsorship obligation, one or more of the following actions may be taken:
(1) 如果某人是經批准的擔保人，但未能履行適用的擔保義務，則可以採取以下一項或多項行動：
(a) the Minister may do one or more of the following:
(a) 部長可採取以下一項或多項行動：
(i) if regulations are prescribed under section 140L, bar the sponsor under subsection 140M(1) from doing certain things;
(i) 如果第 140L 條規定了規定，則根據第 140M(1) 條禁止保薦人做某些事情；
(ii) if regulations are prescribed under section 140L, cancel the person’s approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor under subsection 140M(1);
(ii) 如果第 140L 條規定了規定，則根據第 140M(1) 款取消該人作為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准；
(iii) apply for a civil penalty order;
(iii) 申請民事處罰令；
(iv) accept an undertaking under section 114 of the Regulatory Powers Act, for the purposes of this Subdivision from the person;
(iv) 就本款而言，接受該人根據《監管權力法》第 114 條所作出的承諾；
(v) if the Minister considers that the person has breached such an undertaking—apply for an order under section 115 of the Regulatory Powers Act, for the purposes of this Subdivision;
(v) 若部長認為該人違反了此類承諾－就本款而言，根據《監管權力法》第 115 條申請命令；
(b) the person may be issued with an infringement notice under regulations made for the purposes of section 506A as an alternative to proceedings for a civil penalty order;
(b) 根據為第 506A 條的而製定的法規，可以向該人發出侵權通知，作為民事處罰令訴訟的替代方式；
(c) an authorised officer may require and take a security under section 269 or enforce a security already taken under that section;
(c) 授權人員可依第 269 條要求並取得擔保，或強制執行已依該條所取得的擔保；
(d) an authorised officer may give the person a compliance notice under section 140RB.
(d) 授權官員可以根據第 140RB 條向該人發出合規通知。
Actions that may be taken in relation to former approved sponsors
可以對前批准的發起人採取的行動
(2) If a person was an approved sponsor and fails to satisfy an applicable sponsorship obligation, one or more of the following actions may be taken:
(2) 如果某人是經批准的擔保人，但未能履行適用的擔保義務，則可以採取以下一項或多項行動：
(a) the Minister may do one or more of the following:
(a) 部長可採取以下一項或多項行動：
(i) if regulations are prescribed under section 140L, bar the person under subsection 140M(2) from making future applications for approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor;
(i) 如果第 140L 條規定了相關規定，則禁止第 140M(2) 條規定的人員將來申請批准作為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人；
(ii) apply for a civil penalty order;
(ii) 申請民事處罰令；
(iii) accept an undertaking under section 114 of the Regulatory Powers Act, for the purposes of this Subdivision from the person;
(iii) 就本款而言，接受該人根據《監管權力法》第 114 條所做的承諾；
(iv) if the Minister considers that the person has breached such an undertaking—apply for an order under section 115 of the Regulatory Powers Act, for the purposes of this Subdivision;
(iv) 若部長認為該人違反了此類承諾－就本款而言，根據《監管權力法》第 115 條申請命令；
(b) the person may be issued with an infringement notice under regulations made for the purposes of section 506A as an alternative to proceedings for a civil penalty order;
(b) 根據為第 506A 條的而製定的法規，可以向該人發出侵權通知，作為民事處罰令訴訟的替代方式；
(c) an authorised officer may require and take a security under section 269 or enforce a security already taken under that section;
(c) 授權人員可依第 269 條要求並取得擔保，或強制執行已依該條所取得的擔保；
(d) an authorised officer may give the person a compliance notice under section 140RB.
(d) 授權官員可以根據第 140RB 條向該人發出合規通知。
(3) To avoid doubt, subsections (1) and (2) do not limit the circumstances in which:
(3) 為避免疑問，第 (1) 及 (2) 款不限制下列情況：
(a) the Minister may:
(a) 部長可以：
(i) bar an approved sponsor under section 140M from doing certain things; or
(i) 禁止依第 140M 條核准的保薦人從事某些活動；或
(ii) cancel a person’s approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor under section 140M; or
(ii) 根據第 140M 條取消某人作為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准；或
(b) an authorised officer may require and take a security under section 269 or enforce a security already taken under that section.
(b) 授權人員可依第 269 條要求並取得擔保，或強制執行已依該條所取得的擔保。
Publishing information about sanctions
發布有關製裁的信息
(4) The Minister must, subject to subsection (7), publish the information (including personal information) prescribed by the regulations if an action is taken under this section in relation to an approved sponsor or former approved sponsor who fails to satisfy an applicable sponsorship obligation.
(4) 若依本節對未履行適用擔保義務的經批准擔保人或前經批准擔保人採取行動，部長必須根據第 (7) 款公佈法規規定的資訊（包括個人資訊）。
(5) The Minister is not required to observe any requirements of the natural justice hearing rule in publishing information under subsection (4).
(5) 部長依第 (4) 款發布資訊時無須遵守自然正義聽證規則的任何要求。
(6) No civil liability arises from action taken by the Minister in good faith in publishing information under subsection (4).
(6) 部長依第 (4) 款善意發布資訊所採取的行動不會產生民事責任。
(7) The regulations may prescribe circumstances in which the Minister is not required to publish information under subsection (4).
(7) 條例可以規定部長無須依第 (4) 款公佈資訊的情況。

title: 140L Regulations may prescribe circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval cancelled
zh: 140L 法規可能規定保薦人可能被禁止或取消保薦人核准的情況
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Circumstances in which the Minister may take action
部長可以採取行動的情況
(1) The regulations may prescribe:
(1) 條例可以規定：
(a) either or both of the following:
(a) 以下一項或兩項：
(i) circumstances in which the Minister may take one or more of the actions mentioned in section 140M in relation to a person who is or was an approved sponsor if the Minister is reasonably satisfied that the person has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation in the manner (if any) or within the period (if any) prescribed by the regulations;
(i) 若部長合理地確信該人未能依照條例規定的方式（如有）或在規定的期限（如有）內履行擔保義務，則部長可以對該人採取第 140M 條中提到的一項或多項行動；
(ii) other circumstances in which the Minister may take one or more of the actions mentioned in section 140M; and
(ii) 部長可以採取第 140M 條中提到的一項或多項行動的其他情況；和
(b) the criteria to be taken into account by the Minister in determining what action to take under section 140M.
(b) 部長在決定依第 140M 條採取何種行動時應考慮的標準。
Circumstances in which the Minister must take action
部長必須採取行動的情況
(2) The regulations may prescribe either or both of the following:
(2) 條例可以規定以下一項或兩項：
(a) circumstances in which the Minister must take one or more of the actions mentioned in section 140M in relation to a person who is or was an approved sponsor if the Minister is reasonably satisfied that the person has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation in the manner (if any) or within the period (if any) prescribed by the regulations;
(a) 若部長合理地確信該人未能依照條例規定的方式（如有）或在規定的期限（如有）內履行擔保義務，則部長必須對該人採取第 140M 條中提到的一項或多項行動；
(b) other circumstances in which the Minister must take one or more of the actions mentioned in section 140M.
(b) 部長必須採取第 140M 條所提及的一項或多項行動的其他情況。
(3) Different circumstances and different criteria may be prescribed for:
(3) 可以針對以下情況規定不同的情況和不同的標準：
(a) different kinds of visa (however described); and
(a) 不同種類的簽證（無論如何描述）；和
(b) different classes in relation to which a person may be, or may have been, approved as a work sponsor or family sponsor.
(b) 一個人可能或可能已被批准為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的不同類別。

title: 140M Cancelling approval as a sponsor or barring a sponsor
zh: 140M 取消贊助商批准或禁止贊助商
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Actions that may be taken in relation to approved sponsors
可以對批准的發起人採取的行動
(1) If regulations are prescribed under section 140L, the Minister may (or must) take one or more of the following actions in relation to an approved sponsor:
(1) 如果第 140L 條規定了法規，部長可以（或必須）對批准的擔保人採取以下一項或多項行動：
(a) cancelling the approval of a person as a work sponsor or family sponsor in relation to a class to which the sponsor belongs;
(a) 取消某人作為與其所屬類別相關的工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准；
(b) cancelling the approval of a person as a work sponsor or family sponsor for all classes to which the sponsor belongs;
(b) 取消某人作為該擔保人所屬所有類別的工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准；
(c) barring the sponsor, for a specified period, from sponsoring more people under the terms of one or more existing specified approvals as a work sponsor or family sponsor for different kinds of visa (however described);
(c) 在指定期限內，禁止擔保人根據一項或多項現有指定批准的條款，作為不同種類簽證的工作擔保人或家庭擔保人擔保更多人（無論如何描述）；
(d) barring the sponsor, for a specified period, from making future applications for approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor in relation to one or more classes prescribed by the regulations for the purpose of subsection 140E(2).
(d) 在指定期限內，禁止擔保人未來申請批准為與第 140E(2) 款規定的法規規定的一個或多個類別相關的工作擔保人或家庭擔保人。
Action that may be taken in relation to former approved sponsors
可以對前批准的發起人採取的行動
(2) If regulations are prescribed under section 140L and a person was an approved sponsor, the Minister may (or must) bar the person, for a specified period, from making future applications for approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor in relation to one or more classes prescribed by the regulations for the purpose of subsection 140E(2).
(2) 如果第 140L 條規定了法規，並且某人是經批准的擔保人，則部長可以（或必須）禁止該人在指定期限內，為第 140E(2) 款的目的，就法規規定的一個或多個類別提出未來申請批准作為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人。

title: 140N Process for cancelling approval or barring approved sponsor
zh: 140N 取消批准或禁止批准的贊助商的流程
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The regulations may establish a process for the Minister to cancel the approval of a person as a work sponsor or family sponsor under section 140M.
(1) 法規可以建立一個程序，讓部長根據第 140M 條取消某人作為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准。
(2) The regulations may establish a process for the Minister to place a bar on a person under section 140M.
(2) 法規可以規定部長根據第 140M 條對某人實施限制的程序。
(3) Different processes may be prescribed for:
(3) 可以規定不同的流程：
(a) different kinds of visa (however described); and
(a) 不同種類的簽證（無論如何描述）；和
(b) different classes in relation to which a person may be, or may have been, approved as a work sponsor or family sponsor.
(b) 一個人可能或可能已被批准為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的不同類別。
(4) If the regulations provide for notification by the Minister of the decision to take action under section 140M, then the following provisions of the ART Act do not apply to the decision:
(4) 如果法規規定由部長通知根據第 140M 條採取行動的決定，則《ART 法》的以下規定不適用於該決定：
(a) section 267 (decision ‑ maker must have regard to rules when giving notice of decision);
(a) 第267條（決策者在發出決定通知時必須考慮規則）；
(b) section 268 (requesting reasons for a reviewable decision from decision ‑ maker).
(b) 第268條（要求決策者提供可審查決定的理由）。

title: 140O Waiving a bar
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(2) The Minister may, in prescribed circumstances, waive a bar placed on a person under section 140M.
(2) 在規定的情況下，部長可以免除根據第 140M 條對某人施加的限制。
(3) The regulations may prescribe the criteria to be taken into account by the Minister in determining whether to waive the bar.
(3) 法規可以規定部長在決定是否放棄禁令時要考慮的標準。
(4) Different circumstances and different criteria may be prescribed for:
(4) 可以針對以下情況規定不同的情況和不同的標準：
(a) different kinds of visa (however described); and
(a) 不同種類的簽證（無論如何描述）；和
(b) different classes in relation to which a person may be, or may have been, approved as a work sponsor or family sponsor.
(b) 一個人可能或可能已被批准為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的不同類別。

title: 140P Process for waiving a bar
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The regulations may establish a process for the Minister to waive a bar placed on a person under section 140M.
(1) 法規可以為部長建立一個程序，以免除根據第 140M 條對某人施加的限制。
(2) Different processes may be prescribed for:
(2) 可以規定不同的流程：
(a) different kinds of visa (however described); and
(a) 不同種類的簽證（無論如何描述）；和
(b) different classes in relation to which a person may be, or may have been, approved as a work sponsor or family sponsor.
(b) 一個人可能或可能已被批准為工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的不同類別。

title: 140Q Civil penalty—failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations
zh: 140Q 民事處罰－未能履行贊助義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person contravenes this subsection if:
(1) 某人違反本款規定，如果：
(a) the regulations impose a sponsorship obligation on the person; and
(a) 法規對該人施加擔保義務；和
(b) the person fails to satisfy the sponsorship obligation in the manner (if any) or within the period (if any) prescribed by the regulations.
(b) 未依法規規定的方式（如有）或期限（如有）履行擔保義務。
Civil penalty:
民事處罰：
(a) if the person is an approved work sponsor—240 penalty units; or
(a) 若此人是經批准的工作贊助人－240 個處罰單位；或
(b) in any other case—60 penalty units.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－60 個處罰單位。
(2) A person contravenes this subsection if:
(2) 若出現以下情況，則違反本款規定：
(a) the person (other than a Minister) is a party to a work agreement; and
(a) 該人（部長除外）是工作協議的一方；和
(b) the terms of the work agreement:
(b) 工作協議的條款：
(i) vary a sponsorship obligation that would otherwise be imposed on the person by the regulations; or
(i) 改變法規強加給該人的擔保義務；或
(ii) impose an obligation, identified in the agreement as a sponsorship obligation, on the person; and
(ii) 對該人施加協議中規定的擔保義務；和
(c) the person fails to satisfy the sponsorship obligation in the manner (if any) or within the period (if any) specified in the work agreement.
(c) 該人未能依照工作協議規定的方式（如有）或期限（如有）履行擔保義務。
Civil penalty: 240 penalty units.
民事處罰：240處罰單位。

title: 140RA Enforceable undertakings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Enforceable provision
可執行的規定
(1) Section 140H is enforceable , in relation to a sponsorship obligation, under Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act.
(1) 根據《監管權力法》第 6 部分，第 140H 條與擔保義務有關。
Note: Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act creates a framework for accepting and enforcing undertakings relating to compliance with provisions.
註：《監管權力法》第 6 部分創建了一個接受和執行與遵守規定有關的承諾的框架。
Authorised person
授權人
(2) For the purposes of Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, the Minister is an authorised person in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1).
(2) 就《監管權力法》第 6 部分而言，部長是第 (1) 款所述規定的授權人。
(2A) The Minister may, in writing, delegate the Minister’s powers and functions under Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act to an authorised officer in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1).
(2A) 部長可以書面形式將《監管權力法》第 6 部分規定的與第 (1) 款所述條款相關的部長權力和職能委託給授權官員。
(2B) The Minister may delegate a power or function under subsection (2A) only if the Minister is satisfied that the authorised officer has appropriate qualifications, training or experience to exercise the power or perform the function.
(2B) 只有當部長信納被授權官員具有行使權力或履行職能的適當資格、培訓或經驗時，部長才可以根據第 (2A) 款委託權力或職能。
(2C) An authorised officer exercising powers or performing functions under a delegation under subsection (2A) must comply with any directions of the Minister.
(2C) 根據第 (2A) 款的授權行使權力或履行職能的授權官員必須遵守部長的任何指示。
Relevant court
相關法院
(3) For the purposes of Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, an eligible court is a relevant court in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1).
(3) 就《監管權力法》第 6 部分而言，合格法院是指與第 (1) 款所述規定相關的相關法院。
Relationship with compliance notices
與合規通知的關係
(3A) The authorised person in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1) must not accept an undertaking from a person in relation to a sponsorship obligation if that person has been given a notice under section 140RB in relation to a contravention relating to the sponsorship obligation.
(3A) 如果某人已根據第 140RB 條收到與擔保義務相關的違規行為的通知，則與第 (1) 款所述規定相關的被授權人不得接受該人就擔保義務作出的承諾。
Enforceable undertaking may be published on the internet
可執行的承諾可以在網路上公佈
(4) The authorised person in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1) may publish an undertaking given in relation to the provision on the Department’s website.
(4) 與第 (1) 款所述規定相關的授權人可以在該部門的網站上公佈與該規定相關的承諾。
Extension to external Territories
擴展到外部領土
(5) Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, as it applies in relation to the provision mentioned in subsection (1), extends to a Territory to which this Act extends.
(5) 《監管權力法》第 6 部分在適用於第 (1) 款中提到的規定時，適用於本法適用的領土。
Note: See section 7 of this Act.
註：參見本法第 7 條。

title: 140RB Compliance notices
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Scope
適用範圍
(1) This section applies if an authorised officer reasonably believes that a person who is or was an approved work sponsor has contravened subsection 140Q(1) or (2) (failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations).
(1) 如果授權官員合理地認為現在或曾經是經批准的工作贊助商的人違反了第 140Q(1) 或 (2) 款（未能履行贊助義務），則本節適用。
Giving a compliance notice
發出合規通知
(2) The authorised officer may give the person a notice (a compliance notice ) specifying action that the person must, within such reasonable time as is specified in the notice, take or refrain from taking to address the contravention.
(2) 授權官員可以向該人發出通知（合規通知），具體說明該人必須在通知中指定的合理時間內採取或不採取的行動來解決違規行為。
Note: The compliance notice may be varied or revoked under subsection 33(3) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
注意：根據《1901 年法案解釋法》第 33(3) 款，合規通知可能會被更改或撤銷。
(3) The compliance notice may require the person to produce reasonable evidence of compliance with the notice.
(3) 遵守通知可以要求該人提出遵守通知的合理證據。
(4) The compliance notice must also:
(4) 合規通知也必須：
(a) set out the name of the person; and
(a) 列出該人的姓名；和
(b) set out the name of the authorised officer; and
(b) 列出授權官員的姓名；和
(c) set out a summary of the contravention; and
(c) 列出違規行為的摘要；和
(d) explain that a failure to comply with the notice may contravene a civil penalty provision; and
(d) 解釋不遵守通知可能違反民事處罰規定；和
(e) set out any other prescribed matters.
(e) 列出任何其他規定事項。
Person must comply with compliance notice
人員必須遵守合規通知
(5) A person who is given a compliance notice must comply with the notice.
(5) 收到遵守通知的人必須遵守該通知。
Note: It is not necessary to prove a person’s state of mind in proceedings for a civil penalty order (see section 486ZF).
注意：在民事處罰令訴訟中，無需證明一個人的精神狀態（參見第 486ZF 條）。
Civil penalty: 48 penalty units.
民事處罰：48個處罰單位。
Effect of compliance with compliance notice
遵守合規通知的效果
(6) A person who complies with a compliance notice is not taken by that compliance to have admitted to the contravention in relation to which the notice is given.
(6) 遵守遵守通知的人並非因該遵守而被視為承認與發出通知有關的違規行為。
Relationship with enforceable undertakings
與可執行承諾的關係
(7) An authorised officer must not give a person a compliance notice in relation to a contravention relating to a sponsorship obligation if:
(7) 在下列情況下，授權官員不得向某人發出與贊助義務相關的違規行為的合規通知：
(a) the person has given an undertaking under section 140RA in relation to that sponsorship obligation; and
(a) 該人已根據第 140RA 條就該擔保義務作出承諾；和
(b) the undertaking has not been withdrawn.
(b) 承諾尚未撤銷。
Relationship with civil penalty provisions
與民事處罰規定的關係
(8) The Minister must not apply for an order under subsection 486R(1) (civil penalty orders) in relation to a contravention of subsection 140Q(1) or (2) by a person if:
(8) 在下列情況下，部長不得根據第 486R(1) 款（民事處罰令）就某人違反第 140Q(1) 或 (2) 款的行為申請命令：
(a) an authorised officer has given the person a compliance notice in relation to the contravention; and
(a) 授權人員已向該人發出有關違規行為的合規通知；和
(b) either of the following subparagraphs applies:
(b) 下列任一分段適用：
(i) the notice has not been withdrawn, and the person has complied with the notice;
(i) 該通知尚未撤回，且該人已遵守該通知；
(ii) the person has made an application to a court for judicial review of the decision to give the notice and the application has not been completely dealt with.
(ii) 該人已向法院申請對發出通知的決定進行司法審查，但該申請尚未徹底處理。

title: Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
zh: 第 E 次分部 — 款項責任及追討
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts

title: 140S Liability to pay amounts
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
(1) This section applies if a person who is or was an approved sponsor is required to pay an amount of a kind prescribed in the regulations to the Commonwealth, a State or Territory or another person (the payee ) in relation to a sponsorship obligation.
(1) 如果現在或曾經是經批准的擔保人需要就擔保義務向聯邦、州或領地或其他人（收款人）支付法規中規定的金額，則本節適用。
(2) The payee may recover the amount as a debt due to the payee in an eligible court.
(2) 收款人可以在符合資格的法院追回該款項作為欠收款人的債務。
(3) To avoid doubt, an amount may be recovered under this section if proceedings for a civil penalty order are brought under Part 8D and discontinued or completed without the court making an order of a kind referred to in subsection 486S(4) in relation to the amount.
(3) 為避免疑義，如果民事處罰令程序根據第 8D 部分提起，並且在法院未就該金額作出第 486S(4) 款所述的命令的情況下中止或完成，則可以根據本條追回該金額。
(4) For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition of eligible court , the regulations may prescribe a court of a State or Territory in which an amount may be recovered under this section.
(4) 就合格法院定義的 (e) 款而言，條例可以規定可依本節追回款項的州或地區的法院。

title: 140SA Interest up to judgment
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
(1) A party to proceedings under section 140S may apply to the eligible court for an order under subsection (2).
(1) 第 140S 條規定的訴訟當事人可以向符合條件的法院申請第 (2) 款規定的命令。
(2) If an application is made under subsection (1), the eligible court must, unless good cause is shown to the contrary, either:
(2) 若依第 (1) 款提出申請，除非有充分理由相反，合格法院必須：
(a) order that there be included in the sum for which judgment is given interest at such rate as the eligible court thinks fit on the whole or any part of the money for the whole or any part of the period between:
(a) 命令在判決金額中包括以下期間的全部或任何部分款項的利息，利率按合格法院認為合適的利率計算：
(i) the date when the cause of action arose; and
(i) 訴訟事由發生的日期；和
(ii) the date as of which judgment is entered; or
(ii) 作出判決的日期；或
(b) without proceeding to calculate interest in accordance with paragraph (a)—order that there be included in the sum for which judgment is given, a lump sum instead of any such interest.
(b) 不依照(a)款繼續計算利息－命令在作出判決的金額中包含一筆一次性款項，而非任何此類利息。
(3) Subsection (2) does not:
(3) 第 (2) 款不：
(a) authorise the giving of interest upon interest or of a sum instead of such interest; or
(a) 授權支付利息或一筆款項代替利息；或
(b) apply in relation to any debt upon which interest is payable as of right, whether because of an agreement or otherwise; or
(b) 適用於任何有權支付利息的債務，無論是由於協議或其他原因；或者
(c) authorise the giving of interest, or a sum instead of interest, otherwise than by consent, upon any sum for which judgment is given by consent.
(c) 授權對經同意作出判決的任何款項支付利息，或以一筆款項代替利息，除非經同意。

title: 140SB Interest on judgment
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
A judgment debt under a judgment of an eligible court under section 140S carries interest:
合格法院依第 140S 條所作出的判決所產生的判決債務附帶利息：
(a) from the date as of which the judgment is entered; and
(a) 自判決作出之日起；和
(b) at the rate that would apply under section 52 of the Federal Court of Australia Act 1976 as if the debt were a judgment debt to which that section applies.
(b) 依照《1976 年澳洲聯邦法院法》第 52 條適用的利率，就好像該債務是該條適用的判決債務一樣。

title: 140SC Certain plaintiffs may choose small claims procedure in magistrates courts
zh: 140SC 某些原告可以選擇地方法院的小額索賠程序
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
(1) This section applies if:
(1) 本節適用於：
(a) a person brings proceedings under section 140S in a magistrates court; and
(a) 某人根據第 140S 條向地方法院提起訴訟；和
(b) the person indicates, in a manner prescribed by the regulations or by rules of court relating to that court, that the person wants a small claims procedure to apply in relation to the proceeding.
(b) 該人以與該法院有關的條例或法院規則規定的方式表明，該人希望針對該訴訟適用小額索賠程序。
(2) The procedure is governed by the following conditions:
(2) 該程序受下列條件約束：
(a) the court may not award an amount exceeding $5,000 or such higher amount as is prescribed;
(a) 法院裁決的金額不得超過 5,000 美元或規定的更高金額；
(b) the court may act in an informal manner, is not bound by any rules of evidence, and may act without regard to legal forms and technicalities;
(b) 法院可以非正式方式行事，不受任何證據規則的約束，並且可以不考慮法律形式和技術細節而行事；
(c) at any stage of the action, the court may amend the papers initiating the action if sufficient notice is given to any party adversely affected by the amendment;
(c) 在訴訟的任何階段，如果向受到修改不利影響的任何一方發出充分的通知，法院可以修改提起訴訟的文件；
(d) a person is not entitled to legal representation unless allowed by the court.
(d) 除非法院允許，否則個人無權獲得法律代理。
(3) If the court allows a person to have legal representation, the court may, if it thinks fit, do so subject to conditions designed to ensure that a party is not unfairly disadvantaged.
(3) 如果法院允許某人聘請法律代表，法院可以在其認為適當的情況下這樣做，但須遵守旨在確保一方不會受到不公平不利的條件。
(4) Despite paragraph (2)(d) and subsection (3):
(4) 儘管第 (2)(d) 款及第 (3) 款：
(a) in a case heard in a court of a State—if, in a particular proceeding (whatever the nature of the proceeding) the law of the State prohibits or restricts legal representation of the parties, the regulations may prohibit or restrict legal representation of the parties to the same extent as that law; and
(a) 在一州法院審理的案件中－如果在特定程序中（無論該程序的性質如何），該國法律禁止或限制當事人的法律代理，則法規可以在與該法律相同的範圍內禁止或限制當事人的法律代理；和
(b) in a case heard in a court of a Territory—the regulations may prohibit or restrict legal representation of the parties.
(b) 在領土法院審理的案件中－法規可以禁止或限制當事人的法律代理。

title: 140T Notice regarding amount of debt or other amount
zh: 140T 關於債務金額或其他金額的通知
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
(1) Where a debt, or other amount, that a person is required to pay to the Commonwealth becomes payable, the Minister may issue a notice in writing stating the amount of the debt or other amount.
(1) 當一個人需要向聯邦支付的債務或其他金額成為應付時，部長可以發出書面通知，說明債務或其他金額的金額。
(2) In any proceedings a notice under this section is prima facie evidence that the amount of the debt or other amount is that stated in the notice.
(2) 在任何訴訟中，根據本條發出的通知是債務金額或其他金額是通知中所述金額的初步證據。

title: 140U Liability is in addition to any other liability
zh: 140U 責任是任何其他責任之外的責任
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision E — Liability and recovery of amounts
text:
Any liability created under this Division is in addition to any liability created under:
根據本節規定產生的任何責任不包括根據以下規定產生的任何責任：
(a) this or any other Act; or
(a) 本法或任何其他法案；或
(b) regulations made under this or any other Act.
(b) 根據本法或任何其他法案製定的法規。

title: Subdivision F — Inspector powers
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 140UA Exercise of inspector powers
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An inspector may exercise powers under this Subdivision for a purpose set out in section 140X.
(1) 檢查員可以出於第 140X 條規定的目的行使本款規定的權力。
Note: Inspectors include Fair Work Inspectors (see section 140V).
註：檢查員包括公平工作檢查員（請參閱第 140V 節）。
(2) A Fair Work Inspector may, subject to section 706 of the Fair Work Act 2009 , exercise compliance powers under Subdivision D of Division 3 of Part 5 ‑ 2 of that Act for the purposes of this Subdivision.
(2) 公平工作監察員可依據 2009 年《公平工作法》第 706 條的規定，根據該法第 5-2 部分第 3 分部 D 分節，就本分節之目的行使合規權力。
Note: Under paragraph 706(1)(d) of the Fair Work Act 2009 , a Fair Work Inspector may exercise certain compliance powers for the purposes of a provision of another Act that confers functions or powers on Fair Work Inspectors.
註：根據《2009 年公平工作法》第 706(1)(d) 段，公平工作檢查員可以出於另一項授予公平工作檢查員職能或權力的法案的規定的目的行使某些合規權力。

title: 140V Inspectors
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Who is an inspector ?
誰是檢查員？
(1A) For the purposes of this Act, each of the following is an inspector :
(1A) 就本法而言，下列人員均為檢查員：
(a) a person, or a member of a class of persons, appointed under subsection (1) (an appointed inspector );
(a) 依第 (1) 款任命的個人或某一類人員中的成員（指定檢查員）；
(b) a Fair Work Inspector.
(b) 公平工作檢查員。
Appointed inspectors
指定檢查員
(1) The Minister may, by written instrument:
(1) 部長可以透過書面文書：
(a) appoint a person to be an inspector; or
(a) 任命一名人員為檢查員；或
(b) appoint a class of persons to be inspectors.
(b) 任命一類人員為檢查員。
(2) An appointed inspector is appointed for the period specified in the instrument of appointment, which must not be longer than the period specified in regulations made for the purposes of this subsection.
(2) 指定檢查員的任命期限在任命書規定的期限內，該期限不得長於為本款目的而製定的條例中規定的期限。
(3) An appointed inspector has the powers conferred on an inspector by this Division, or the regulations, that are specified in his or her instrument of appointment.
(3) 被任命的檢查員具有本司或規章授予檢查員的權力，這些權力在其任命書中明確規定。
Fair Work Inspectors
公平工作檢查員
(4) An inspector who is a Fair Work Inspector has the powers conferred on an inspector by this Division or the regulations.
(4) 作為公平工作檢查員的檢查員擁有本節或法規賦予檢查員的權力。
(5) A Fair Work Inspector continues to be an inspector for the purposes of this Act while he or she continues to be a Fair Work Inspector (under the Fair Work Act 2009 ).
(5) 公平工作檢查員在繼續擔任公平工作檢查員期間（根據《2009 年公平工作法》），繼續擔任本法中的檢查員。
Note: The Minister may give written directions specifying the manner in which, and any conditions and qualifications subject to which, powers conferred on inspectors are to be exercised: see section 499.
註：部長可以發出書面指示，具體說明授予檢查員的權力的行使方式以及任何條件和資格：請參閱第 499 節。

title: 140W Identity cards
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
General
一般
(1A) An inspector’s identity card is:
(1A) 檢查員的身分證是：
(a) for an appointed inspector—the identity card issued to the inspector under subsection (1); or
(a) 對於指定檢查員－依第(1)款發給檢查員的身分證；或
(b) for an inspector who is a Fair Work Inspector—the identity card issued to the inspector under the Fair Work Act 2009 (see section 702 of that Act).
(b) 對於作為公平工作檢查員的檢查員－根據《2009 年公平工作法》向檢查員發放的身份證（參見該法第 702 條）。
Identity cards—appointed inspectors
身分證－指定檢查員
(1) The Minister must issue an identity card to an appointed inspector.
(1) 部長必須發給指定的檢查員身分證。
(2) An identity card for an appointed inspector:
（二）指定檢查員的身分證：
(a) must be in the approved form and may include additional information that is not set out in the form; and
(a) 必須採用經批准的表格，並且可以包括表格中未列出的附加資訊；和
(b) must contain a recent photograph of the inspector.
(b) 必須包含檢查員的近期照片。
Identity card to be carried
需攜帶身分證
(3) An inspector must carry the identity card at all times when exercising powers as an inspector.
（三）檢查人員執行檢查職務時，必須隨身攜帶身分證。
Offence
進攻
(4) A person commits an offence if:
(4) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person has been issued with an identity card under subsection (1); and
(a) 該人已根據第(1)款取得身分證；和
(b) the person ceases to be an inspector; and
(b) 該人不再擔任檢查員；和
(c) the person does not return his or her identity card to the Secretary within 14 days after ceasing to be an inspector.
(c) 該人在不再擔任檢查員後 14 天內沒有將其身分證退還給部長。
Penalty: 1 penalty unit.
處罰：1 個處罰單位。
(5) An offence against subsection (4) is an offence of strict liability.
(5) 違反第 (4) 款的犯罪行為是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability, see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參閱《刑法》第6.1條。
(6) However, a person does not commit an offence against subsection (4) if the person’s identity card was lost or destroyed.
(6) 但是，如果一個人的身分證遺失或毀壞，則該人不構成違反第 (4) 款的行為。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (6): see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code .
註：被告就第（6）款的事項負舉證責任：參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款。

title: 140X Purpose for which powers of inspectors may be exercised
zh: 140X 檢查員行使權力的目的
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The powers of an inspector under this Subdivision may be exercised:
本款規定的檢查員的權力可以在以下情況下行使：
(a) for the purpose of investigating whether a sponsorship obligation is being, or has been, complied with by a person who is or was an approved work sponsor; or
(a) 為了調查現在或曾經是經批准的工作贊助人是否正在或已經履行贊助義務；或
(aaa) for the purpose of investigating whether a person who is or was an approved work sponsor has contravened subsection 140RB(5); or
(aaa) 為了調查現在或曾經是經批准的工作贊助人是否違反了第 140RB(5) 款；或
(aa) for the purpose of investigating whether a person who is or was an approved work sponsor has committed an offence, or contravened a civil penalty provision, under Subdivision C, D, E or F of Division 12 of this Part; or
(aa) 為調查現在或曾經是經批准的工作發起人的人員是否犯罪或違反本部分第 12 節 C、D、E 或 F 款規定的民事處罰規定的目的；或
(b) for a purpose prescribed by the regulations.
(b) 為法規規定的目的。

title: 140XA When powers of inspectors may be exercised
zh: 140XA 何時可以行使檢查員的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
An inspector may exercise powers under this Subdivision:
檢查員可依本款行使權力：
(a) at any time during working hours; or
(a) 工作時間內的任何時間；或
(b) at any other time, if the inspector reasonably believes that it is necessary to do so for the purposes referred to in section 140X.
(b) 在任何其他時間，如果檢查員合理地認為出於第 140X 條所述目的有必要這樣做。

title: 140XB Power of inspectors to enter premises or places
zh: 140XB 檢查員進入處所或場所的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An inspector may, without force, enter business premises or another place, if the inspector reasonably believes that there are records or documents relevant to the purposes referred to in section 140X on the premises or at the place, or accessible from a computer on the premises or at the place.
(1) 如果檢查員合理地相信營業場所或其他地方存在與第 140X 條所述目的相關的記錄或文件，或者可以透過營業場所或其他地方的電腦訪問，則檢查員可以在不使用武力的情況下進入營業場所或其他場所。
(2) The inspector must, either before or as soon as practicable after entering those premises or that place, show his or her identity card to the occupier, or another person who apparently represents the occupier, if the occupier or other person is present at the premises or place.
(2) 檢查員必須在進入該處所或地點之前或在進入該處所或地點後儘快向佔用人或明顯代表佔用人的其他人（如果佔用人或其他人在該處所或地點）出示其身份證。

title: 140XC Powers of inspectors while on premises or at a place
zh: 140XC 檢查員在場所或地點的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An inspector who enters premises or a place under section 140XB may exercise one or more of the following powers while on the premises or at the place:
(1) 根據第 140XB 條進入場所或場所的檢查員可以在場所或場所內行使以下一項或多項權力：
(a) inspect any work, process or object;
(a) 檢查任何工作、流程或物件；
(b) interview any person;
(b) 訪問任何人；
(c) require a person to tell the inspector who has custody of, or access to, a record or document;
(c) 要求某人告訴檢查員誰保管或接觸記錄或文件；
(d) require a person who has the custody of, or access to, a record or document to produce the record or document to the inspector either while the inspector is on the premises or at the place, or within a specified period;
(d) 要求保管或接觸記錄或文件的人在檢查員在場所或地點時或在規定期限內向檢查員出示該記錄或文件；
(e) inspect, and make copies of, any record or document that:
(e) 檢查並複製以下任何記錄或文件：
(i) is kept on the premises or at the place; or
(i) 保存在該處所或該地點；或
(ii) is accessible from a computer that is kept on the premises or at the place.
(ii) 可透過該處所或該地點的電腦存取。
(2) A Fair Work Inspector who enters premises or a place under the Fair Work Act 2009 for any compliance purpose under section 706 of that Act may, for a purpose mentioned in section 140X of this Act, exercise any of the powers mentioned in subsection (1) of this section while on the premises or at the place.
(2) 為本法第 140X 條所述目的，依據《2009 年公平工作法》第 706 條規定進入場所或場所的公平工作檢查員可以在該場所或場所行使本條第 (1) 款所述的任何權力。
Note: See also sections 140XG, 140XH and 140XI (which deal with self ‑ incrimination and produced documents etc.).
註：另請參閱第 140XG、140XH 和 140XI 節（涉及自證其罪和出示文件等）。

title: 140XD Persons assisting inspectors
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person (the assistant ) may accompany an inspector onto premises or to a place mentioned in subsection 140XC(1) to assist the inspector if:
(1) 在下列情況下，人員（助理）可以陪同檢查員進入場所或第 140XC(1) 款中提到的地點以協助檢查員：
(a) for any inspector—the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner is satisfied that:
(a) 對於任何檢查員－部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員確信：
(i) the assistance is necessary and reasonable; and
(i) 協助是必要且合理的；和
(ii) the assistant has suitable qualifications and experience to properly assist the inspector; or
(ii) 助理有適當的資格和經驗，能夠適當地協助檢查員；或
(b) for an inspector who is a Fair Work Inspector—the assistant is authorised to accompany the inspector onto the premises or to the place under section 710 of the Fair Work Act 2009 for any compliance purpose under section 706 of that Act.
(b) 對於公平工作檢查員－助理有權陪同檢查員進入《2009 年公平工作法》第 710 條規定的場所或地點，以達到該法第 706 條規定的任何合規目的。
(2) The assistant:
（二）助理：
(a) may do such things on the premises or at the place as the inspector requires to assist the inspector to exercise powers under this Subdivision; but
(a) 可在檢查員要求的場所或地點進行此類活動，以協助檢查員行使本款規定的權力；但是
(b) must not do anything that the inspector does not have power to do.
(b) 不得做任何檢查員無權做的事。
(3) Anything done by the assistant is taken for all purposes to have been done by the inspector.
(3) 助理所做的任何事情在任何意義上都被視為檢查員所做的。

title: 140XE Power to ask for person’s name and address
zh: 140XE 詢問某人姓名和地址的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An inspector may require a person to tell the inspector the person’s name and address if the inspector reasonably believes that the person has contravened a civil penalty provision.
(1) 如果檢查員合理地認為某人違反了民事處罰規定，檢查員可以要求該人告知該人的姓名和地址。
(2) If the inspector reasonably believes that the name or address is false, the inspector may require the person to give evidence of its correctness.
(2) 如果檢查員合理地認為該姓名或地址是虛假的，檢查員可以要求該人提供其正確性的證據。
(3) A person contravenes this subsection if:
(3) 若有下列情況，違反本款規定：
(a) the inspector requires the person to do a thing referred to in subsection (1) or (2); and
(a) 檢查員要求該人做第 (1) 或 (2) 款所提及的事；和
(b) the inspector advises the person that he or she may contravene a civil penalty provision if he or she fails to comply with the requirement; and
(b) 檢查員告知該人，如果他或她不遵守要求，他或她可能違反民事處罰規定；和
(c) the inspector shows his or her identity card to the person; and
(c) 檢查員向該人出示其身分證；和
(d) the person does not comply with the requirement.
(d) 該人不遵守要求。
Civil penalty: 60 penalty units.
民事處罰：60處罰單位。
(4) Subsection (3) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(4) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (3) 款不適用。

title: 140XF Power to require persons to produce records or documents
zh: 140XF 要求人員出示記錄或文件的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) An inspector may require a person, by notice, to produce a record or document to the inspector.
(1) 檢查員可以透過通知要求某人向檢查員出示記錄或文件。
(2) The notice must:
(2) 通知必須：
(a) be in writing; and
(a) 採用書面形式；和
(b) be served on the person; and
(b) 送達該人；和
(c) require the person to produce the record or document at a specified place within a specified period of at least 7 days.
(c) 要求該人在至少7天內在指定地點出示記錄或文件。
The notice may be served by sending the notice to the person’s fax number.
可以透過將通知發送至該人的傳真號碼的方式來送達通知。
(3) A person contravenes this subsection if:
(3) 若有下列情況，違反本款規定：
(a) the person is served with a notice to produce under subsection (1); and
(a) 該人收到根據第(1)款出示的通知；和
(b) the person fails to comply with the notice.
(b) 該人不遵守通知。
Civil penalty: 60 penalty units.
民事處罰：60處罰單位。
(4) Subsection (3) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(4) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (3) 款不適用。

title: 140XG Self ‑ incrimination
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person is not excused from producing a record or document under paragraph 140XC(1)(d), or subsection 140XF(1), on the ground that the production of the record or document might tend to incriminate the person or expose the person to a penalty.
(1) 不得以提供記錄或文件可能導致該人入罪或使其受到處罰為由，免除根據第 140XC(1)(d) 款或第 140XF(1) 小節出示記錄或文件的義務。
(2) However, in the case of an individual, none of the following are admissible in evidence against the individual in criminal proceedings:
(2) 但是，對個人而言，下列各項均不得在刑事訴訟中作為針對該個人的證據：
(a) the record or document produced;
(a) 所產生的記錄或文件；
(b) producing the record or document;
(b) 出示記錄或文件；
(c) any information, document or thing obtained as a direct or indirect consequence of producing the record or document;
(c) 作為產生該記錄或文件的直接或間接結果而獲得的任何資訊、文件或事物；
except in proceedings for an offence against section 137.1 or 137.2 of the Criminal Code (false or misleading information or documents) in relation to the information or document.
除非在針對與資訊或文件相關的《刑法》第 137.1 或 137.2 條（虛假或誤導性資訊或文件）的犯罪訴訟中。

title: 140XH Certain records and documents are inadmissible
zh: 140XH 某些記錄和文件不可接受
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The following are not admissible in evidence in criminal proceedings against an individual:
以下內容不可作為針對個人的刑事訴訟中的證據：
(a) any record or document inspected or copied under paragraph 140XC(1)(e) of which the individual had custody, or to which the individual had access, when it was inspected or copied;
(a) 根據第 140XC(1)(e) 段檢查或複製的、個人在檢查或複製時保管或存取的任何記錄或文件；
(b) any information, document or thing obtained as a direct or indirect consequence of inspecting or copying a record or document of which the individual had custody, or to which the individual had access, when it was inspected or copied under paragraph 140XC(1)(e).
(b) 在根據第 140XC(1)(e) 段檢查或複製個人保管的或個人有權存取的記錄或文件時，作為檢查或複製的直接或間接結果而獲得的任何資訊、文件或物品。

title: 140XI Power to keep records or documents
zh: 140XI 保留記錄或文件的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) If a record or document is produced to an inspector in accordance with this Subdivision, the inspector may:
(1) 若依本款向檢查員出示記錄或文件，檢查員可以：
(a) inspect, and make copies of, the record or document; and
(a) 檢查並複製記錄或文件；和
(b) keep the record or document for such period as is necessary.
(b) 將記錄或文件保留必要的期限。
(2) While an inspector keeps a record or document, the inspector must allow the following persons to inspect, or make copies of, the record or document at all reasonable times:
(2) 當檢查員保留記錄或文件時，檢查員必須允許以下人員在所有合理時間檢查或複製該記錄或文件：
(a) the person who produced the record or document;
(a) 出示記錄或文件的人；
(b) any person otherwise entitled to possession of the record or document;
(b) 任何其他有權佔有該記錄或文件的人；
(c) a person authorised by the person referred to in paragraph (b).
(c) 經(b)段所述人員授權的人。

title: 140XJ Disclosure of information by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner
zh: 140XJ 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員披露資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Information to which this section applies
本節適用的訊息
(1) This section applies to the following information:
(1) 本條適用於下列資訊：
(a) information acquired by an inspector in the course of performing functions, or exercising powers, as an inspector under this Subdivision;
(a) 檢查員在作為檢查員履行本款規定的職能或行使權力的過程中獲得的資訊；
(b) information acquired by a person in the course of assisting an inspector under section 140XD.
(b) 個人在根據第 140XD 條協助檢查員的過程中所獲得的資訊。
Disclosure that is necessary or appropriate, or likely to assist administration or enforcement
必要或適當的或可能協助管理或執行的揭露
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may disclose, or authorise the disclosure of, the information if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner reasonably believes:
(2) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員合理地認為以下情況，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以披露或授權披露該資訊：
(a) that it is necessary or appropriate to do so in the course of performing functions, or exercising powers, under Division 3A of Part 2 of this Act; or
(a) 在執行本法第 2 部分第 3A 部分所規定的職能或行使權力的過程中，有必要或適當地這樣做；或
(b) that the disclosure is likely to assist in the administration or enforcement of a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory.
(b) 該揭露可能有助於聯邦、州或地區法律的管理或執行。

title: Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
zh: 細分 G — 細分適用於合夥企業和非法人協會
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations

title: 140ZB Partnerships—sponsorship rights and obligations
zh: 140ZB 合作夥伴－贊助權利與義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) This Division, the regulations made under it and any other provision of this Act as far as it relates to this Division or the regulations, apply to a partnership as if it were a person, but with the changes set out in this section and sections 140ZC and 140ZD.
(1) 本節、根據本節制定的法規以及本法中與本節或法規相關的任何其他規定，像個人一樣適用於合夥企業，但有本節以及第 140ZC 和 140ZD 節中規定的變更。
(2) A sponsorship right that would otherwise be exercisable by the partnership is exercisable by each partner instead.
(2) 本應由合夥企業行使的贊助權，可由各合夥人行使。
(3) A sponsorship obligation that would otherwise be imposed on the partnership:
(3) 合夥應承擔的保薦義務：
(a) is imposed on each partner instead; but
(a) 強加給每位合夥人；但是
(b) may be discharged by any of the partners.
(b) 任何合夥人可解除。
(4) Subject to section 140ZC, the partners are jointly and severally liable to pay an amount in relation to a sponsorship obligation.
(4) 根據第 140ZC 條的規定，合夥人負有共同和個別支付與贊助義務相關的金額的責任。

title: 140ZC Partnerships—offences and civil penalties
zh: 140ZC 合作夥伴－犯罪和民事處罰
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) An offence against this Division that would otherwise be committed by a partnership is taken to have been committed by each partner in the partnership, at the time the offence is committed, who:
(1) 合夥企業本應犯下的違反本節規定的罪行，將被視為由合夥企業中的每個合夥人在犯下罪行時犯下，他們：
(a) did the relevant act or made the relevant omission; or
(a) 做出了相關行為或做出了相關不作為；或
(b) aided, abetted, counselled or procured the relevant act or omission; or
(b) 協助、教唆、慫恿或促使相關行為或不行為；或
(c) was in any way knowingly concerned in, or party to, the relevant act or omission (whether directly or indirectly or whether by any act or omission of the partner).
(c) 以任何方式故意參與或參與相關的作為或不作為（無論是直接或間接，或由合作夥伴的任何作為或不作為造成）。
(2) A civil penalty provision of this Division that would otherwise be contravened by a partnership is taken to have been contravened by each partner in the partnership, at the time of the conduct constituting the contravention, who:
(2) 合夥企業本來會違反的本節民事處罰規定，在構成違規行為時，將被視為合夥企業中的每個合夥人都已違反，該合夥企業：
(a) engaged in the conduct; or
(a) 從事該行為；或
(b) aided, abetted, counselled or procured the conduct; or
(b) 協助、教唆、慫恿或促成該行為；或
(c) was in any way knowingly concerned in, or party to, the conduct (whether directly or indirectly or whether by any act or omission of the partner).
(c) 以任何方式故意參與或參與該行為（無論是直接或間接，或由合作夥伴的任何作為或不作為造成）。
(3) If a partner in a partnership contravenes a civil penalty provision, the civil penalty that may be imposed on the partner must not exceed an amount equal to one ‑ fifth of the maximum penalty that could be imposed on a body corporate for the same contravention.
(3) 如果合夥企業中的合夥人違反了民事處罰規定，則對該合夥人可能處以的民事處罰不得超過法人團體因同一違法行為而可能處以的最高處罰金額的五分之一。
(4) For the purposes of subsections (1) and (2), to establish that a partnership engaged in particular conduct, it is sufficient to show that the conduct was engaged in by a partner:
(4) 就第 (1) 及 (2) 款而言，要確定合夥企業從事特定行為，只需證明該行為是由合夥人從事的：
(a) in the ordinary course of the business of the partnership; or
(a) 在合夥企業的正常業務過程中；或
(b) within the scope of the actual or apparent authority of the partner.
(b) 在合夥人實際或表面上的權力範圍內。
(5) For the purposes of subsection (1), to establish that a partnership had a particular state of mind when it engaged in particular conduct, it is sufficient to show that a relevant partner had the relevant state of mind.
(5) 就第 (1) 款而言，要確定合夥企業在從事特定行為時具有特定的心態，只需證明相關合夥人具有相關的心態即可。

title: 140ZD Partnership ceases to exist
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) If a partnership ceases to exist, the persons who were partners immediately before the cessation must continue to satisfy any applicable sponsorship obligation.
(1) 如果合夥企業終止，則終止前的合夥人必須繼續履行任何適用的擔保義務。
(2) Section 140ZB applies as if:
(2) 第 140ZB 條適用，如同：
(a) references to a partnership were to a partnership that ceases to exist; and
(a) 所提及的合夥企業是指不再存在的合夥企業；和
(b) references to partners of the partnership were to the persons who were partners immediately before the cessation.
(b) 凡提及合夥企業的合夥人，均指合夥企業終止前的合夥人。
(3) For the purpose of this section, a partnership ceases to exist if the dissolution of the partnership does not result in the creation of another partnership.
(3) 就本條而言，如果合夥企業的解散沒有導致另一個合夥企業的成立，則該合夥企業不再存在。

title: 140ZE Unincorporated associations—sponsorship rights and obligations
zh: 140ZE 非法人協會－贊助權利與義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) This Division, the regulations made under it and any other provision of this Act as far as it relates to this Division or the regulations, apply to an unincorporated association as if it were a person, but with the changes set out in this section and sections 140ZF and 140ZG.
(1) 本節、根據本節制定的法規以及本法中與本節或法規相關的任何其他規定，適用於非法人協會，就像它是一個人一樣，但有本節以及第 140ZF 和 140ZG 節中規定的變更。
(2) A sponsorship right that would otherwise be exercisable by the unincorporated association is exercisable by each member of the association’s committee of management instead.
(2) 本應由非法人協會行使的贊助權，可由協會管理委員會的每位成員行使。
(3) A sponsorship obligation that would otherwise be imposed on the unincorporated association:
(3) 非法人協會原本應承擔的贊助義務：
(a) is imposed on each member of the association’s committee of management instead; but
(a) 改為對協會管理委員會的每位成員實施；但是
(b) may be discharged by any of those members.
(b) 可由其中任何成員解職。
(4) Subject to section 140ZF, the members are jointly and severally liable to pay an amount in relation to a sponsorship obligation.
(4) 根據第 140ZF 條，會員有連帶責任支付與贊助義務相關的金額。

title: 140ZF Unincorporated associations—offences and civil penalties
zh: 140ZF 非法人協會－犯罪和民事處罰
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) An offence against this Division that would otherwise be committed by an unincorporated association is taken to have been committed by each member of the association’s committee of management, at the time the offence is committed, who:
(1) 非法人協會本應犯下的違反本節的罪行，將被視為由該協會管理委員會的每位成員在犯下罪行時犯下，他們：
(a) did the relevant act or made the relevant omission; or
(a) 做出了相關行為或做出了相關不作為；或
(b) aided, abetted, counselled or procured the relevant act or omission; or
(b) 協助、教唆、慫恿或促使相關行為或不行為；或
(c) was in any way knowingly concerned in, or party to, the relevant act or omission (whether directly or indirectly or whether by any act or omission of the member).
(c) 以任何方式故意參與或參與相關的作為或不作為（無論是直接或間接，或由會員的任何作為或不作為造成）。
(2) A civil penalty provision of this Division that would otherwise be contravened by an unincorporated association is taken to have been contravened by each member of the association’s committee of management, at the time of the conduct constituting the contravention, who:
(2) 非法人協會本來會違反的本節民事處罰規定，在構成違規行為時，被視為已被該協會管理委員會的每位成員所違反，他們：
(a) engaged in the conduct; or
(a) 從事該行為；或
(b) aided, abetted, counselled or procured the conduct; or
(b) 協助、教唆、慫恿或促成該行為；或
(c) was in any way knowingly concerned in, or party to, the conduct (whether directly or indirectly or whether by any act or omission of the member).
(c) 以任何方式故意參與或參與該行為（無論是直接或間接，或由會員的任何作為或不作為造成）。
(3) If a member of an unincorporated association’s committee of management contravenes a civil penalty provision, the civil penalty that may be imposed on the member must not exceed an amount equal to one ‑ fifth of the maximum penalty that could be imposed on a body corporate for the same contravention.
(3) 若非法人協會管理委員會的成員違反民事處罰規定，則對該成員可處以的民事處罰不得超過法人團體因同一違法行為可處以的最高處罰金額的五分之一。
(4) For the purposes of subsection (1), to establish that an unincorporated association had a particular state of mind when it engaged in particular conduct, it is sufficient to show that a relevant member of the association’s committee of management had the relevant state of mind.
(4) 就第 (1) 款而言，要確定非法人協會在從事特定行為時具有特定的心態，只需證明該協會管理委員會的相關成員具有相關的心態即可。

title: 140ZG Unincorporated association ceases to exist
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision G — Application of Division to partnerships and unincorporated associations
text:
(1) If an unincorporated association ceases to exist, the persons who were members of the association’s committee of management immediately before the cessation must continue to satisfy any applicable sponsorship obligation.
(1) 如果非法人協會終止存在，在終止前擔任協會管理委員會成員的人員必須繼續履行任何適用的贊助義務。
(2) Section 140ZE applies as if:
(2) 第 140ZE 條適用，如同：
(a) references to an unincorporated association were to an unincorporated association that ceases to exist; and
(a) 所提及的非法人協會是指已不存在的非法人協會；和
(b) references to members of the association’s committee of management were to the persons who were members immediately before the cessation.
(b) 所提及的協會管理委員會成員是指在該協會終止之前的成員。
(3) To avoid doubt, for the purpose of this section, an unincorporated association ceases to exist if the dissolution of the association does not result in the creation of another association.
(3) 為避免疑義，就本條而言，如果協會的解散未導致另一個協會的成立，則該非法人協會即告終止。

path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:

有關批准的工作贊助商等的個人信息
(1) The Minister may disclose personal information of a prescribed kind about a person mentioned in column 2 of an item of the following table to a person or body mentioned in column 3 of the item:

有關經批准的家庭擔保人的個人資訊等。
(1A) The Minister may disclose personal information of a prescribed kind about a person mentioned in column 2 of an item of the following table to a person or body mentioned in column 3 of the item:
(1A) 部長可以向該項目第 3 列中提到的個人或機構披露下表中第 2 列中提到的人員的規定類型的個人資訊：

個人資訊的揭露
第 1 欄 |第 2 欄 |第3欄

Regulations may prescribe circumstances for disclosure etc.
法規可以規定揭露的情況等。
(2) The regulations may prescribe circumstances in which the Minister may disclose the personal information under subsection (1) or (1A).
(2) 法規可以規定部長可以根據第 (1) 或 (1A) 款披露個人資訊的情況。

Notice of disclosure
揭露通知
(4) If the Minister discloses personal information under subsection (1) or (1A) (other than to an agency of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory prescribed by the regulations), the Minister must give written notice to the person about whom the information is disclosed of:
(4) 如果部長根據第 (1) 或 (1A) 款披露個人資訊（除了法規規定的聯邦機構或州或地區），部長必須向披露資訊的人發出書面通知：
(a) the disclosure; and
(a) 揭露；和
(b) the details of the personal information disclosed.
(b) 所揭露的個人資料的詳情。
Note: The Minister may also publish personal information relating to actions taken under section 140K (sanctions for failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations) (see subsection 140K(4)).
注意：部長也可以公佈與根據第 140K 條（對未能履行擔保義務的製裁）採取的行動有關的個人資訊（參見第 140K(4) 條）。

title: 140ZI Disclosure of personal information to Minister
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:

部長可以要求誰披露個人資訊 |

(2) For the purposes of:
(2) 為下列目的：
(a) paragraph 6.2(b) of Australian Privacy Principle 6; and
(a) 澳洲隱私權原則 6 第 6.2(b) 段；和

個人應本節要求而揭露的資訊被視為本法授權的揭露。

title: 140ZJ Unclaimed money
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) If a person who is or was an approved work sponsor has not paid an amount in relation to a sponsorship obligation because the person does not know the location of the intended recipient, the person may pay the amount to the Commonwealth.
(1) 如果現在或曾經是經批准的工作贊助人由於不知道預期接受者的位置而未支付與贊助義務相關的金額，則該人可以向聯邦支付該金額。
(2) The Commonwealth holds the amount in trust for the intended recipient.
(2) 聯邦為預期接收者以信託方式持有該金額。
(3) Payment of the amount to the Commonwealth is a sufficient discharge to the person, as against the intended recipient, for the amount paid.
(3) 向聯邦支付的金額足以使該人（相對於預期接受者）免除所支付的金額。

title: 140ZK Other regulation making powers not limited
zh: 140ZK 其他不受限制的監管制定權
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
Regulations made for the purposes of this Division do not limit the power to make regulations under any other provision of this or any other Act.
為本節目的製定的法規不限制根據本法或任何其他法案的任何其他條款制定法規的權力。

title: 140ZL Division binds the Crown
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This Division binds the Crown in right of the Commonwealth, of each of the States, of the Australian Capital Territory and of the Northern Territory.
(1) 本部分對澳洲聯邦、各州、澳洲首都領地和北領地的國王具有約束力。
(2) However, this Division does not make the Crown liable to be prosecuted for an offence.
(2) 然而，本節並未規定國王須因犯罪而被起訴。
(3) To avoid doubt, subsection (2) does not prevent the Crown being liable to pay a pecuniary penalty under this Division.
(3) 為避免疑問，第 (2) 款並不妨礙政府依本節規定繳納罰款。

title: Division 3B — Nominations
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 140ZM Nomination training contribution charge
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A person is liable to pay nomination training contribution charge to the Commonwealth in relation to a nomination by the person under section 140GB if the nomination is a nomination of a kind prescribed by the regulations.
(1) 如果提名屬於法規規定的類型，則個人有義務根據第 140GB 條向聯邦繳納提名培訓繳費。
(2) A person applying under the regulations, or in accordance with the terms of a work agreement, for approval of a nomination of a position in relation to the holder of, or an applicant or proposed applicant for, a visa, is liable to pay nomination training contribution charge to the Commonwealth in relation to the nomination if:
(2) 根據法規或工作協議條款申請批准與簽證持有者、申請人或擬申請人相關的職位提名的人，有義務向聯邦繳納與提名相關的提名培訓繳費，如果：
(a) the visa is of a kind (however described) prescribed by the regulations; and
(a) 簽證屬於法規規定的類型（無論如何描述）；和
(b) the nomination is a nomination of a kind prescribed by the regulations.
(b) 提名是條例規定的提名類型。

title: 140ZN Regulations about nomination training contribution charge
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 140ZO Recovery of nomination training contribution charge and late payment penalty
zh: 140ZO 追回提名培訓貢獻費及滯納金
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
If an amount of:
如果數量：
(a) nomination training contribution charge; or
(a) 提名培訓繳費；或
(b) a penalty in relation to the underpayment of such a charge;
(b) 因少付此類費用而受到的處罰；
is due and payable to the Commonwealth, the amount is a debt due to the Commonwealth and may be recovered by action in a court of competent jurisdiction.
到期應付英聯邦，該金額是欠英聯邦的債務，可以透過有管轄權的法院提起訴訟來追回。

title: 140ZP Notional application of nomination training contribution charge in relation to nominations by the Commonwealth
zh: 140ZP 與英聯邦提名相關的提名培訓繳款費的名義應用
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The Commonwealth is not liable to pay nomination training contribution charge that is payable under section 140ZM. However, it is the Parliament’s intention that the Commonwealth should be notionally liable to pay such charge.
(1) 聯邦沒有義務支付第 140ZM 條規定的提名訓練繳費。然而，議會的意圖是英聯邦在名義上有責任支付此類費用。
(2) The Finance Minister may give such written directions as are necessary or convenient for carrying out or giving effect to subsection (1) and, in particular, may give directions in relation to the transfer of money within an account, or between accounts, operated by the Commonwealth.
(2) 財政部長可以發出執行或實施第 (1) 款所必需或方便的書面指示，特別是可以就聯邦運營的帳戶內或帳戶之間的資金轉移發出指示。
(3) Directions under subsection (2) have effect, and must be complied with, despite any other Commonwealth law.
(3) 儘管有任何其他英聯邦法律，第 (2) 款下的指示仍然有效，並且必須遵守。
(4) A direction under subsection (2) is not a legislative instrument.
(4) 第 (2) 款的指示並非立法文書。
(5) In subsections (1) and (2), Commonwealth includes a Commonwealth entity (within the meaning of the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Act 2013 ) that cannot be made liable to taxation by a Commonwealth law.
(5) 在第 (1) 和 (2) 款中，聯邦包括不承擔聯邦法律規定的納稅義務的聯邦實體（在《2013 年公共治理、績效和責任法案》的含義內）。

title: 140ZQ Division binds the Crown
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) This Division binds the Crown in right of the Commonwealth, of each of the States, of the Australian Capital Territory and of the Northern Territory.
(1) 本部分對澳洲聯邦、各州、澳洲首都領地和北領地的國王具有約束力。
(2) However, this Division does not make the Crown liable to be prosecuted for an offence.
(2) 然而，本節並未規定國王須因犯罪而被起訴。
(3) To avoid doubt, subsection (2) does not prevent the Crown being liable to pay a pecuniary penalty under this Division.
(3) 為避免疑問，第 (2) 款並不妨礙政府依本節規定繳納罰款。

title: Division 4 — Criminal justice visitors
zh: 第 4 分部 — 刑事司法訪客
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: Subdivision A — Preliminary
zh: 第 A 次分部 — 總則
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 141 Object of Division
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
This Division is enacted so that, if the administration of criminal justice requires the presence in Australia of a non ‑ citizen, that non ‑ citizen may be brought to, or allowed to stay in, Australia for the purposes of that administration.
制定本部分的目的是，如果刑事司法要求非公民在澳大利亞，則可以出於刑事司法的目的將該非公民帶到澳大利亞或允許其留在澳大利亞。

title: 142 Interpretation
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
In this Division:
在本部門：
administration of criminal justice means:
刑事司法管理是指：
(a) an investigation to find out whether an offence has been committed; or
(a) 進行調查以確定是否有犯罪行為；或
(b) the prosecution of a person for an offence; or
(b) 起訴某人的犯罪行為；或
(c) the punishment by way of imprisonment of a person for the commission of an offence.
(c) 對犯罪者實施監禁處罰。
Australia means the migration zone.
澳洲的意思是移民區。
authorised official , in relation to a State, means a person authorised under section 144 to be an authorised official for that State.
授權官員 就一個州而言，是指根據第 144 條被授權擔任該州授權官員的人。
criminal justice certificate means:
刑事司法證書意味著：
(a) a criminal justice entry certificate; or
(a) 刑事司法進入證明書；或
(b) a criminal justice stay certificate.
(b) 刑事司法暫緩證明。
criminal justice entry certificate means:
刑事司法進入證書意味著：
(a) a certificate given under section 145; or
(a) 依第 145 條頒發的證書；或
(b) a certificate given under subsection 146(1) and endorsed under subsection 146(2).
(b) 依第 146(1) 款頒發並依第 146(2) 款簽署的證書。
criminal justice entry visa has the meaning given by section 155.
刑事司法入境簽證具有第 155 條規定的涵義。
criminal justice stay certificate means a certificate given under section 147 or 148.
刑事司法中止證明是指依第 147 條或第 148 條簽發的證明。
criminal justice stay visa has the meaning given by section 155.
刑事司法居留簽證具有第 155 條規定的涵義。
criminal justice stay warrant means a warrant described in section 151.
刑事司法中止令是指第 151 條所述的令狀。
criminal justice visa has the meaning given by section 38.
刑事司法簽證具有第 38 條規定的涵義。
State includes Territory.
州包括領土。

title: 143 Delegation by Minister
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The Minister may, in writing, delegate any of his or her powers under this Division to:
(1) 部長可以書面形式將本節規定的任何權力委託給：
(a) the Secretary of the Department; or
(a) 部門秘書；或
(b) an SES employee, or acting SES employee, in the Department.
(b) 該部門的 SES 員工或代理 SES 員工。
(2) Subject to subsection (3), the Minister may, in writing, delegate his or her power under section 147 to a commissioned police officer (within the meaning of the Australian Federal Police Act 1979 ).
(2) 根據第 (3) 款，部長可以根據第 147 條以書面形式將其權力委託給受委任的警官（根據 1979 年《澳大利亞聯邦警察法》的含義）。
(3) A delegation under subsection (2) must provide that:
(3) 第 (2) 款的授權必須規定：
(a) the power may only be exercised in relation to a person at a port; and
(a) 該權力只能針對港口的人員行使；和
(b) any certificate that is issued by the member is to remain in force for no longer than 5 days.
(b) 會員頒發的任何證書的有效期限不得超過 5 天。
(4) The Minister may, at any time, by written notice, revoke a certificate issued by a person exercising a power delegated under subsection (2).
(4) 部長可隨時透過書面通知撤銷依第 (2) 款行使權力的人所頒發的證書。

title: 144 Authorised officials
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The Minister may, in writing, appoint as an authorised official for a State for the purposes of this Division:
出於本節的目的，部長可以書面形式任命以下國家的授權官員：
(a) the Attorney ‑ General of the State; or
(a) 國家總檢察長；或
(b) a person holding an office under a law of the State that is like the office of the Director of Public Prosecutions; or
(b) 依國家法律擔任類似檢察長職務的人員；或
(c) the highest ranking member of the police force of the State.
(c) 國家警察部隊的最高級成員。

title: Subdivision B — Criminal justice certificates for entry
zh: B 部分 — 入境刑事司法證書
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — Criminal justice certificates for entry

title: 145 Commonwealth criminal justice entry certificate
zh: 145 英聯邦刑事司法入門證書
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — Criminal justice certificates for entry
text:
(1) If the Minister considers that:
(1) 如果部長認為：
(a) the temporary presence in Australia of a non ‑ citizen who is outside Australia is required for the purposes of:
(a) 基於以下目的，澳洲境外的非公民需要在澳洲臨時居留：
(i) the Extradition Act 1988 ; or
(i) 1988 年《引渡法》；或
(ia) the International War Crimes Tribunals Act 1995 ; or
(ia) 1995 年《國際戰爭罪法庭法》；或
(ib) the International Criminal Court Act 2002 ; or
(ib) 2002 年《國際刑事法院法》；或
(ii) the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 1987 ; or
(ii) 1987 年《刑事事項互助法》；或
(iii) the administration of criminal justice in relation to an offence against a law of the Commonwealth; and
(iii) 與違反聯邦法律的犯罪相關的刑事司法；和
(b) the presence of the non ‑ citizen in Australia for the relevant purposes would not hinder the national interest in any way to such an extent that the non ‑ citizen should not be present in Australia; and
(b) 該非公民因相關目的在澳洲的存在不會以任何方式妨礙國家利益，以致該非公民不應在澳洲存在；和
(c) satisfactory arrangements have been made to make sure that the person or organisation who wants the non ‑ citizen for the relevant purposes or the non ‑ citizen or both will meet the cost of bringing the non ‑ citizen to, keeping the non ‑ citizen in, and removing the non ‑ citizen from, Australia;
(c) 已作出令人滿意的安排，以確保出於相關目的需要非公民的個人或組織或非公民或兩者都將承擔將非公民帶到澳大利亞、將非公民留在澳大利亞以及將其從澳大利亞驅逐的費用；
the Minister may give a certificate that the presence of the non ‑ citizen in Australia is required for the administration of criminal justice.
部長可以出具證明，證明該非公民必須在澳洲居住才能進行刑事司法。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia does not include the cost of immigration detention (if any).
(2) 就第 (1)(c) 款而言，將該非公民留在澳洲的費用不包括移民拘留費用（如有）。

title: 146 State criminal justice entry certificate
zh: 146 國家刑事司法入門證書
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — Criminal justice certificates for entry
text:
(1) If an authorised official for a State considers that:
(1) 如果一個國家的授權官員認為：
(a) the temporary presence in Australia of a non ‑ citizen who is outside Australia is required for the purposes of the administration of criminal justice in relation to an offence against a law of the State; and
(a) 出於對違反國家法律的犯罪進行刑事司法的目的，需要在澳大利亞境外的非公民暫時居住在澳大利亞；和
(b) satisfactory arrangements have been made to make sure that the person or organisation who wants the non ‑ citizen for those purposes or the non ‑ citizen or both will meet the cost of bringing the non ‑ citizen to, keeping the non ‑ citizen in, and removing the non ‑ citizen from, Australia;
(b) 已作出令人滿意的安排，以確保出於這些目的而需要非公民的個人或組織或非公民或兩者都將承擔將非公民帶到澳大利亞、將非公民留在澳大利亞以及將其從澳大利亞驅逐的費用；
the official may give a certificate that the presence of the non ‑ citizen in Australia is required for the administration of criminal justice by the State.
該官員可以出具證明，證明該非公民必須在澳洲居住，以便國家實施刑事司法。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) a certificate has been given under subsection (1) about a non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 已根據第(1)款發出關於非公民的證明；和
(b) the Minister considers that the temporary presence of the non ‑ citizen in Australia in order to advance the administration of criminal justice by the State would not hinder the national interest in any way to such an extent that the non ‑ citizen should not be present in Australia;
(b) 部長認為，為了促進國家的刑事司法管理，該非公民暫時留在澳大利亞，不會以任何方式妨礙國家利益，以致該非公民不應留在澳大利亞；
the Minister may endorse the certificate with a statement that it is to be a criminal justice certificate for the purposes of this Division.
部長可以在該證書上簽署聲明，表明該證書將成為本司目的的刑事司法證書。
(3) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia does not include the cost of immigration detention (if any).
(3) 就第 (1)(b) 款而言，將該非公民留在澳洲的費用不包括移民拘留費用（如有）。

title: Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
zh: C 部分 — 刑事司法證明等，暫緩遣返或驅逐出境
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation

title: 147 Commonwealth criminal justice stay certificate
zh: 147 英聯邦刑事司法暫緩證明
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) an unlawful non ‑ citizen is to be, or is likely to be, removed or deported; and
(a) 非法非公民將被或可能被驅逐或驅逐出境；和
(b) the Minister considers that the non ‑ citizen should remain in Australia temporarily for the purposes of:
(b) 部長認為非公民應為以下目的暫時留在澳洲：
(i) the Extradition Act 1988 ; or
(i) 1988 年《引渡法》；或
(ia) the International War Crimes Tribunals Act 1995 ; or
(ia) 1995 年《國際戰爭罪法庭法》；或
(ib) the International Criminal Court Act 2002 ; or
(ib) 2002 年《國際刑事法院法》；或
(ii) the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 1987 ; or
(ii) 1987 年《刑事事項互助法》；或
(iii) the administration of criminal justice in relation to an offence against a law of the Commonwealth; and
(iii) 與違反聯邦法律的犯罪相關的刑事司法；和
(c) the Minister considers that satisfactory arrangements have been made to make sure that the person or organisation who wants the non ‑ citizen for the relevant purposes or the non ‑ citizen or both will meet the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia;
(c) 部長認為已作出令人滿意的安排，以確保出於相關目的而需要非公民的個人或組織或非公民或兩者都將承擔將該非公民留在澳大利亞的費用；
the Minister may give a certificate that the stay of the non ‑ citizen’s removal or deportation is required for the administration of criminal justice.
部長可以出具證明，證明刑事司法需要暫緩對非公民的驅逐或驅逐出境。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia does not include the cost of immigration detention (if any).
(2) 就第 (1)(c) 款而言，將該非公民留在澳洲的費用不包括移民拘留費用（如有）。

title: 148 State criminal justice stay certificate
zh: 148 國家刑事司法暫緩證明
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) an unlawful non ‑ citizen is to be, or is likely to be, removed or deported; and
(a) 非法非公民將被或可能被驅逐或驅逐出境；和
(b) an authorised official for a State considers that the non ‑ citizen should remain in Australia temporarily for the purposes of the administration of criminal justice in relation to an offence against a law of the State; and
(b) 國家授權官員認為該非公民應暫時留在澳大利亞，以便對違反該國法律的犯罪行為進行刑事司法；和
(c) that authorised official considers that satisfactory arrangements have been made to make sure that the person or organisation who wants the non ‑ citizen for those purposes or the non ‑ citizen or both will meet the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia;
(c) 該授權官員認為已作出令人滿意的安排，以確保出於這些目的而需要非公民的個人或組織或非公民或兩者都將承擔將該非公民留在澳大利亞的費用；
the official may give a certificate that the stay of the non ‑ citizen’s removal or deportation is required for the administration of criminal justice by the State.
該官員可以出具證明，證明國家刑事司法需要暫緩對非公民的驅逐或驅逐出境。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), the cost of keeping the non ‑ citizen in Australia does not include the cost of immigration detention (if any).
(2) 就第 (1)(c) 款而言，將該非公民留在澳洲的費用不包括移民拘留費用（如有）。

title: 149 Application for visa not to prevent certificate
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
A criminal justice stay certificate for a non ‑ citizen may be given even though an application for a visa for the non ‑ citizen has been made but not finalised.
即使非公民的簽證申請已提出但尚未最終完成，仍可向非公民提供刑事司法居留證明。

title: 150 Criminal justice stay certificates stay removal or deportation
zh: 150 刑事司法暫緩證明 暫緩遣返或驅逐出境
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
If a criminal justice stay certificate about a non ‑ citizen is in force, the non ‑ citizen is not to be removed or deported.
如果非公民的刑事司法居留證明有效，則該非公民不得被驅逐或驅逐出境。

title: 151 Certain warrants stay removal or deportation
zh: 151 某些逮捕令中止驅逐或驅逐出境
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
(1) If an unlawful non ‑ citizen is to be, or is likely to be, removed or deported, this Act does not prevent a court issuing for the purposes of the administration of criminal justice in relation to an offence against a law a warrant to stay the removal or deportation.
(1) 若非法非公民將被或可能被驅逐或驅逐出境，本法並不妨礙法院出於對違法犯罪進行刑事司法的目的發出暫緩驅逐或驅逐出境的逮捕令。
(2) If a criminal justice stay warrant about a non ‑ citizen is in force, the non ‑ citizen is not to be removed or deported.
(2) 若針對非公民的刑事司法中止令有效，則該非公民不得被驅逐或驅逐出境。
(3) If a court issues a criminal justice stay warrant about a non ‑ citizen, the applicant for the warrant is responsible for the costs of any maintenance or accommodation (other than immigration detention) of the non ‑ citizen while the warrant is in force.
(3) 若法院對非公民發出刑事司法暫緩令，則該令的申請人須承擔該非公民在該令生效期間的任何贍養或住宿費用（移民拘留除外）。

title: 152 Certain subjects of stay certificates and stay warrants may be detained etc.
zh: 152 某些持有中止證明書和中止令的主體可能會被扣留等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
If:
如果：
(a) a criminal justice stay certificate or a criminal justice stay warrant about a non ‑ citizen is in force; and
(a) 非公民的刑事司法中止證明或刑事司法中止令有效；和
(b) the non ‑ citizen does not have a visa to remain in Australia;
(b) 該非公民沒有留在澳洲的簽證；
the certificate or warrant does not limit any power under this Act relating to the detention of the non ‑ citizen.
該證書或逮捕令不限製本法規定的與拘留非公民有關的任何權力。

title: 153 Removal or deportation not contempt etc. if no stay certificate or warrant
zh: 153 若沒有居留證或逮捕令，驅逐或驅逐出境不構成藐視法庭罪
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
(1) Subject to subsection (2), if:
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，如果：
(a) this Act requires the removal or deportation of a non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 本法要求將非公民驅逐出境；和
(b) there is no criminal justice stay certificate or criminal justice stay warrant about the non ‑ citizen;
(b) 該非公民沒有刑事司法中止證明或刑事司法中止令；
any other law, or anything done under any other law, of the Commonwealth or a State (whether passed or made before or after the commencement of this section), not being an Act passed after that commencement expressed to be exempt from this section, does not prevent the removal or deportation.
聯邦或州的任何其他法律或根據任何其他法律制定的任何規定（無論是在本節生效之前或之後通過或製定的），如果不是該生效後通過的明確表示不受本節約束的法案，則不會阻止驅逐或驅逐出境。
(2) Subsection (1) does not permit the removal or deportation of a non ‑ citizen if that removal or deportation would be in breach of an order of the High Court, the Federal Court or the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2).
(2) 如果驅逐或驅逐出境將違反澳洲高等法院、聯邦法院或聯邦巡迴法院和家庭法院（第 2 分庭）的命令，則第 (1) 款不允許驅逐或驅逐非公民。

title: 154 Officer not liable—criminal justice stay certificates or warrants
zh: 154 官員不負責任－刑事司法暫緩證明或逮捕令
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Criminal justice certificates etc. staying removal or deportation
text:
An officer is not liable to any civil or criminal action for doing in good faith, or failing in good faith to do, any act or thing for the purpose of exercising a power under this Act to keep a person who is the subject of a criminal justice stay certificate or criminal justice stay warrant in immigration detention.
官員不因出於善意或未能善意採取任何行為或事情而承擔任何民事或刑事訴訟責任，其目的是根據本法行使權力，將刑事司法暫緩證明或刑事司法暫緩令的對象留在移民拘留中。

title: Subdivision D — Criminal justice visas
zh: D 部分 — 刑事司法簽證
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 155 Criminal justice visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A criminal justice visa may be a visa permitting a non ‑ citizen to travel to and enter, and remain temporarily in, Australia, to be known as a criminal justice entry visa.
(1) 刑事司法簽證可以是允許非公民前往澳洲並進入並暫時停留在澳洲的簽證，稱為刑事司法入境簽證。
(2) A criminal justice visa may be a visa permitting a non ‑ citizen to remain temporarily in Australia, to be known as a criminal justice stay visa.
(2) 刑事司法簽證可以是允許非公民暫時留在澳洲的簽證，稱為刑事司法居留簽證。

title: 156 Criterion for criminal justice entry visas
zh: 156 刑事司法入境簽證的標準
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
A criterion for a criminal justice entry visa for a non ‑ citizen is that a criminal justice entry certificate about the non ‑ citizen is in force.
非公民取得刑事司法入境簽證的一個標準是該非公民的刑事司法入境證明有效。

title: 157 Criterion for criminal justice stay visas
zh: 157 刑事司法居留簽證的標準
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
A criterion for a criminal justice stay visa for a non ‑ citizen is that either:
非公民取得刑事司法居留簽證的標準是：
(a) a criminal justice stay certificate about the non ‑ citizen is in force; or
(a) 該非公民的刑事司法暫緩證明有效；或
(b) a criminal justice stay warrant about the non ‑ citizen is in force.
(b) 針對該非公民的刑事司法中止令有效。

title: 158 Criteria for criminal justice visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
The criteria for a criminal justice visa for a non ‑ citizen are, and only are:
非公民刑事司法簽證的標準是且僅是：
(a) the criterion required by section 156 or 157; and
(a) 第 156 條或第 157 條所要求的標準；和
(b) the criterion that the Minister, having had regard to:
(b) 部長考慮的標準：
(i) the safety of individuals and people generally; and
(i) 個人和大眾的安全；和
(ii) in the case of a criminal justice entry visa, arrangements to ensure that if the non ‑ citizen enters Australia, the non ‑ citizen can be removed; and
(ii) 如果是刑事司法入境簽證，應作出安排，確保非公民進入澳洲後可以將其驅逐；和
(iii) any other matters that the Minister considers relevant;
(iii) 部長認為相關的任何其他事項；
has decided, in the Minister’s absolute discretion, that it is appropriate for the visa to be granted.
部長擁有絕對酌情權決定是否適合授予簽證。

title: 159 Procedure for obtaining criminal justice visa
zh: 159 取得刑事司法簽證的程序
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) If a criminal justice certificate, or a criminal justice stay warrant, in relation to a non ‑ citizen is in force, the Minister may consider the grant of a criminal justice visa for the non ‑ citizen.
(1) 如果與非公民相關的刑事司法證書或刑事司法中止令有效，部長可以考慮向非公民授予刑事司法簽證。
(2) If the Minister, after considering the grant of a criminal justice visa for a non ‑ citizen, is satisfied that the criteria for it have been met, the Minister may, in his or her absolute discretion:
(2) 如果部長在考慮向非公民授予刑事司法簽證後認為其標準已得到滿足，則部長可以全權酌情決定：
(a) grant it by causing a record of it to be made; and
(a) 以記錄方式授予；和
(b) give such evidence of it as the Minister considers appropriate.
(b) 提供部長認為適當的證據。

title: 160 Conditions of criminal justice visa
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) The regulations may provide that criminal justice visas are subject to specified conditions.
(1) 法規可規定刑事司法簽證須符合特定條件。
(2) It is a condition of a criminal justice entry visa for a non ‑ citizen that the non ‑ citizen must not do any work in Australia, whether for reward or otherwise.
(2) 非公民刑事司法入境簽證的一個條件是，該非公民不得在澳洲從事任何工作，無論是為了報酬或其他。
(3) In subsection (2):
(3) 第(2)款中：
work , in relation to a non ‑ citizen, does not include work for the purposes for which there is a criminal justice certificate or criminal justice stay warrant about the non ‑ citizen, including, if those purposes are or include the imprisonment of the non ‑ citizen, work as a prisoner.
與非公民相關的工作，不包括為該非公民持有刑事司法證書或刑事司法暫緩令的目的而進行的工作，包括，如果這些目的是或包括監禁該非公民，則包括作為囚犯的工作。

title: 161 Effect of criminal justice visas
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) A criminal justice entry visa for a non ‑ citizen is permission for the non ‑ citizen to travel to and enter and remain in Australia while it is in effect.
(1) 非公民刑事司法入境簽證是指在有效期內允許非公民前往澳洲並進入並留在澳洲。
(2) A criminal justice stay visa for a non ‑ citizen:
(2) 非公民的刑事司法居留簽證：
(a) is permission for the non ‑ citizen to remain in Australia while it is in effect; and
(a) 是非公民在有效期限內留在澳洲的許可；和
(b) if the non ‑ citizen is in immigration detention, entitles the non ‑ citizen to be released from that detention.
(b) 若該非公民被移民拘留，則該非公民有權從拘留中獲釋。
(3) A criminal justice visa for a person does not prevent the non ‑ citizen leaving Australia.
(3) 某人的刑事司法簽證並不妨礙該非公民離開澳洲。
(4) Subsection (3) does not limit the operation of any order or warrant of a court.
(4) 第 (3) 款不限制法院任何命令或授權令的實施。
(5) The holder of a criminal justice entry visa may not apply for a visa other than a protection visa.
（五）刑事司法入境簽證持有者不得申請保護簽證以外的簽證。
(6) If a non ‑ citizen who has held a criminal justice entry visa remains in Australia when the visa is cancelled, the non ‑ citizen may not make an application for a visa other than a protection visa.
(6) 如果持有刑事司法入境簽證的非公民在簽證被取消時仍留在澳大利亞，則該非公民不得申請保護簽證以外的簽證。

title: Subdivision E — Cancellation etc. of criminal justice certificates and criminal justice visas
zh: E 部分 — 刑事司法證照和刑事司法簽證的取消等
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
