title: 228A Application of Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
This Subdivision applies in and outside Australia.
本細則適用於澳洲境內外。

title: 228B Circumstances in which a non ‑ citizen has no lawful right to come to Australia
zh: 228B 非公民沒有合法權利進入澳洲的情況
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) For the purposes of this Subdivision, a non ‑ citizen has, at a particular time, no lawful right to come to Australia if, at that time:
(1) 就本款而言，非公民在特定時間沒有合法權利來澳大利亞，如果當時：
(a) the non ‑ citizen does not hold a visa that is in effect; and
(a) 非公民不持有有效簽證；和
(b) the non ‑ citizen is not covered by an exception referred to in subsection 42(2) or (2A); and
(b) 該非公民不屬於第 42(2) 或 (2A) 款所述的例外情況；和
(c) the non ‑ citizen is not permitted by regulations under subsection 42(3) to travel to Australia without a visa that is in effect.
(c) 根據第 42(3) 款的規定，非公民不得在沒有有效簽證的情況下前往澳洲。
(2) To avoid doubt, a reference in subsection (1) to a non ‑ citizen includes a reference to a non ‑ citizen seeking protection or asylum (however described), whether or not Australia has, or may have, protection obligations in respect of the non ‑ citizen because the non ‑ citizen is or may be a refugee, or for any other reason.
(2) 為避免疑問，第 (1) 款中提及的非公民包括尋求保護或庇護（無論如何描述）的非公民，無論澳大利亞是否因該非公民是或可能是難民或出於任何其他原因對該非公民有或可能有保護義務。

title: 229 Carriage of non ‑ citizens to Australia without documentation
zh: 229 運送無證件的非公民前往澳大利亞
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) The master, owner, agent, charterer and operator of a vessel on which a non ‑ citizen is brought into Australia on or after 1 November 1979 each commit an offence against this section if the non ‑ citizen, when entering Australia:
(1) 1979 年 11 月 1 日或之後將一名非公民帶入澳洲的船舶的船長、所有人、代理人、承租人和經營者，如果該非公民在進入澳洲時出現以下情況，則各自犯有違反本節的罪行：
(a) is not in possession of evidence of a visa that is in effect and that permits him or her to travel to and enter Australia; and
(a) 沒有有效的簽證證據並允許他或她前往和進入澳洲；和
(b) does not hold a special purpose visa; and
(b) 不持有特殊目的簽證；和
(c) is not eligible for a special category visa; and
(c) 沒有資格獲得特殊類別簽證；和
(d) does not hold an enforcement visa; and
(d) 不持有執行簽證；和
(e) is a person to whom subsection 42(1) applies.
(e) 是第 42(1) 條適用的人。
(1A) A person commits an offence if:
(1A) 若有下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person is a master, owner, agent, charterer or operator of an aircraft; and
(a) 該人是飛機的船長、所有者、代理人、包租人或操作人；和
(b) the person brings a non ‑ citizen into Australia by air on the aircraft; and
(b) 此人攜帶非公民乘飛機進入澳洲；和
(c) the non ‑ citizen is the holder of a maritime crew visa that is in effect.
(c) 該非公民持有有效的海事船員簽證。
(2) A person who commits an offence against this section is liable, upon conviction, to a fine not exceeding 100 penalty units.
(2) 違反本條規定的人，一經定罪，可處以不超過 100 個處罰單位的罰款。
(3) An offence against subsection (1) or (1A) is an offence of absolute liability.
(3) 違反第 (1) 或 (1A) 款的犯罪是絕對責任犯罪。
Note: For absolute liability , see section 6.2 of the Criminal Code .
註：關於絕對責任，請參閱《刑法》第 6.2 條。
(4) For the purposes of subsection (1), the defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to establishing that subsection 42(1) does not apply to a person because of subsection 42(2) or (2A) or regulations made under subsection 42(3).
(4) 就第 (1) 款而言，被告承擔舉證責任，證明第 42(1) 款由於第 42(2) 或 (2A) 款或根據第 42(3) 款制定的規定不適用於某人。
Note: For evidential burden , see section 13.3 of the Criminal Code .
註：證據負擔參見《刑法》第13.3條。
(5) It is a defence to a prosecution for an offence against subsection (1) in relation to the bringing of a non ‑ citizen into Australia on a vessel if it is established:
(5) 若下列事實成立，則可作為違反第(1)款有關用船隻將非公民帶入澳洲的罪行的起訴的抗辯：
(a) that the non ‑ citizen was, when he or she boarded or last boarded the vessel for travel to Australia, in possession of evidence of a visa that was in effect and that permitted him or her to travel to and enter Australia, being a visa that:
(a) 該非公民在登上或最後一次登上前往澳大利亞的船隻時，持有有效的簽證證據，並允許他或她前往和進入澳大利亞，該簽證：
(i) did not appear to have been cancelled; and
(i) 似乎未被取消；和
(ii) was expressed to continue in effect until, or at least until, the date of the non ‑ citizen’s expected entry into Australia;
(ii) 明確表示將繼續有效，直至或至少至該非公民預期進入澳洲之日；
(b) that the master of the vessel had reasonable grounds for believing that, when the non ‑ citizen boarded or last boarded the vessel for travelling to and entering Australia, the non ‑ citizen:
(b) 船長有合理的理由相信，當非公民登上或最後一次登上前往和進入澳洲的船隻時，非公民：
(i) was eligible for a special category visa; or
(i) 有資格獲得特殊類別簽證；或
(ii) was the holder of a special purpose visa; or
(ii) 持有特殊目的簽證；或
(iii) would, when entering Australia, be the holder of a special purpose visa; or
(iii) 進入澳洲時持有特殊目的簽證；或
(iv) was the holder of an enforcement visa; or
(iv) 持有執行簽證；或
(v) would, when entering Australia, be the holder of an enforcement visa; or
(v) 進入澳洲時持有執行簽證；或
(c) that the vessel entered Australia from overseas only because of:
(c) 船舶從海外進入澳洲只是因為：
(i) the illness of a person on board the vessel;
(i) 船上人員患病；
(ii) stress of weather; or
(ii) 天氣壓力；或
(iii) other circumstances beyond the control of the master.
(iii)其他船長無法控制的情況。
(5A) It is a defence to a prosecution for an offence against subsection (1A) in relation to the bringing of a non ‑ citizen into Australia on an aircraft if it is established that:
(5A) 對於違反第 (1A) 款有關將非公民乘飛機帶入澳洲的罪行的起訴，如果確定：
(a) the non ‑ citizen was, when he or she boarded or last boarded the aircraft for travel to Australia, in possession of evidence of another class of visa that was in effect and that permitted him or her to travel to and enter Australia, being a visa that:
(a) 該非公民在登上或最後一次登上前往澳大利亞的飛機時，持有有效的另一類簽證的證據，該簽證允許他或她前往和進入澳大利亞，該簽證：
(i) did not appear to have been cancelled; and
(i) 似乎未被取消；和
(ii) was expressed to continue in effect until, or at least until, the date of the non ‑ citizen’s expected entry into Australia; or
(ii) 明確表示將繼續有效，直至或至少至該非公民預期進入澳洲之日；或
(b) the aircraft entered Australia from overseas only because of:
(b) 飛機從海外進入澳洲只是因為：
(i) the illness of a person on board the aircraft; or
(i) 飛機上人員患病；或
(ii) stress of weather; or
(ii) 天氣壓力；或
(iii) other circumstances beyond the control of the master.
(iii)其他船長無法控制的情況。
(6) A defendant bears a legal burden in relation to the matters in subsection (5) or (5A).
(6) 被告就第(5)或(5A)款的事項承擔法律責任。

title: 230 Carriage of concealed persons to Australia
zh: 230 將隱藏人員運送到澳大利亞
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) The master, owner, agent and charterer of a vessel each commit an offence against this section if an unlawful non ‑ citizen is concealed on the vessel when it arrives in the migration zone.
(1) 若船舶抵達遷移區時非法非公民藏匿在船舶上，則船舶的船長、所有人、代理人和承租人均違反本節規定。
Penalty: 100 penalty units.
處罰：100 處罰單位。
(1A) The master, owner, agent and charterer of a vessel each commit an offence against this section if:
(1A) 船舶的船長、所有人、代理人和承租人均犯有違反本節的罪行，如果：
(a) a person is concealed on the vessel when it arrives in Australia; and
(a) 當船舶抵達澳洲時有人隱藏在船上；和
(b) the person would, if in the migration zone, be an unlawful non ‑ citizen.
(b) 如果該人在移民區，則該人將成為非法非公民。
Penalty: 100 penalty units.
處罰：100 處罰單位。
(1B) An offence against subsection (1) or (1A) is an offence of strict liability.
(1B) 違反第 (1) 或 (1A) 款的犯罪行為屬於嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the master of the vessel:
(2) 若船長有下列情況，則第 (1) 款不適用：
(a) as soon as it arrives in the migration zone, gives notice to an officer that the non ‑ citizen is on board; and
(a) 一旦到達移民區，就通知官員該非公民已在船上；和
(b) prevents the non ‑ citizen from landing without an officer having had an opportunity to question the non ‑ citizen.
(b) 在官員沒有機會詢問該非公民之前，阻止該非公民著陸。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matters in subsection (2) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告對第（2）款的事項負有舉證責任（見《刑法》第13.3（3）款）。
(2A) Subsection (1A) does not apply if the master of the vessel:
(2A) 若船長有以下情況，則第 (1A) 款不適用：
(a) as soon as it arrives in Australia, gives notice to an officer that the person is on board; and
(a) 一旦抵達澳大利亞，立即通知官員該人已在船上；和
(b) prevents the person from leaving the vessel without an officer having had an opportunity to question the person.
(b) 在高級官員沒有機會詢問該人的情況下，阻止該人離開船隻。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matters in subsection (2A) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告對第 (2A) 款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3(3) 款）。

title: 231 Master of vessel to comply with certain requests
zh: 第231章 船長遵守某些要求
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) The master of a vessel arriving in Australia must comply with any request by an authorised officer to:
(1) 到達澳洲的船舶的船長必須遵守授權官員的任何要求：
(a) give the authorised officer a list of all persons on the vessel and prescribed particulars of each of them; or
(a) 向授權官員提供船上所有人的名單以及每個人的規定詳細資料；或
(b) gather together those persons or such of them as are specified by the officer; or
(b) 召集官員指定的人員或人員；或
(c) make sure of the disembarkation from the vessel of those persons or such of them as are specified by the officer.
(c) 確保這些人員或官員指定的人員從船上下來。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) a person is on a vessel that has arrived in Australia; and
(a) 某人在抵達澳洲的船上；和
(b) that person’s name is not on a list of persons on the vessel given under subsection (1);
(b) 該人的姓名不在依第 (1) 款給予的船上人員名單上；
the person is taken, for the purposes of section 230, to have been concealed on the vessel when it arrived.
就第 230 條而言，該人被視為在船舶抵達時隱藏在船舶上。

title: 232 Penalty on master, owner, agent and charterer of vessel
zh: 232 船舶船長、所有人、代理人和承租人的處罰
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) Where:
(1) 其中：
(a) a non ‑ citizen:
(a) 非公民：
(i) enters Australia on a vessel; and
(i) 乘船進入澳洲；和
(ii) because he or she is not the holder of a visa that is in effect, or because of section 173, becomes upon entry an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(ii) 因為他或她不是有效簽證的持有者，或因為第173條，在入境時成為非法非公民；和
(iii) is a person to whom subsection 42(1) applies; or
(iii) 是第 42(1) 款适用的人；或
(b) a removee or deportee who has been placed on board a vessel for removal or deportation leaves the vessel in Australia otherwise than in immigration detention under this Act;
(b) 被安置在船上準備被驅逐或驅逐出境的被驅逐者或被驅逐者在澳洲離開該船，但本法規定的移民拘留除外；
the master, owner, agent and charterer of the vessel are each taken to commit an offence against this Act punishable by a fine not exceeding 100 penalty units.
船舶的船長、所有人、代理人和承租人均被視為違反本法，可處以不超過 100 個處罰單位的罰款。
(1A) An offence against subsection (1) is an offence of absolute liability.
(1A) 違反第 (1) 款的犯罪是絕對責任犯罪。
Note: For absolute liability , see section 6.2 of the Criminal Code .
註：關於絕對責任，請參閱《刑法》第 6.2 條。
(1B) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(a), the defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to establishing that subsection 42(1) does not apply to a person because of subsection 42(2) or (2A) or regulations made under subsection 42(3).
(1B) 就第 (1)(a) 款而言，被告承擔證據責任，證明第 42(1) 款因第 42(2) 或 (2A) 款或根據第 42(3) 款制定的規定而不適用於某人。
Note: For evidential burden , see section 13.3 of the Criminal Code .
註：證據負擔參見《刑法》第13.3條。
(2) It is a defence to a prosecution for an offence against subsection (1) in relation to the entry of a non ‑ citizen to Australia on a vessel if it is established:
(2) 若成立，則可作為違反第(1)款有關非公民乘船進入澳洲的罪行的起訴的辯護：
(a) that the non ‑ citizen was, when he or she boarded or last boarded the vessel for travel to Australia, in possession of evidence of a visa that was in effect and that permitted him or her to travel to and enter Australia, being a visa that:
(a) 該非公民在登上或最後一次登上前往澳大利亞的船隻時，持有有效的簽證證據，並允許他或她前往和進入澳大利亞，該簽證：
(i) did not appear to have been cancelled; and
(i) 似乎未被取消；和
(ii) was expressed to continue in effect until, or at least until, the date of the non ‑ citizen’s expected entry into Australia; or
(ii) 明確表示將繼續有效，直至或至少至該非公民預期進入澳洲之日；或
(b) that the master of the vessel had reasonable grounds for believing that, when the non ‑ citizen boarded or last boarded the vessel for travelling to and entering Australia, the non ‑ citizen:
(b) 船長有合理的理由相信，當非公民登上或最後一次登上前往和進入澳洲的船隻時，非公民：
(i) was eligible for a special category visa; or
(i) 有資格獲得特殊類別簽證；或
(ii) was the holder of a special purpose visa; or
(ii) 持有特殊目的簽證；或
(iii) would, when entering Australia, be the holder of a special purpose visa; or
(iii) 進入澳洲時持有特殊目的簽證；或
(iv) was the holder of an enforcement visa; or
(iv) 持有執行簽證；或
(v) would, when entering Australia, be the holder of an enforcement visa; or
(v) 進入澳洲時持有執行簽證；或
(c) that the vessel entered Australia from overseas only because of:
(c) 船舶從海外進入澳洲只是因為：
(i) the illness of a person on board the vessel; or
(i) 船上人员患病；或
(ii) stress of weather; or
(ii) 天氣壓力；或
(iii) other circumstances beyond the control of the master.
(iii)其他船長無法控制的情況。
(3) A defendant bears a legal burden in relation to the matters in subsection (2).
(3) 被告就第(2)款的事項負法律責任。

title: 233A Offence of people smuggling
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(1) 一個人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person organises or facilitates the bringing or coming to Australia, or the entry or proposed entry into Australia, of another person (the second person ); and
(a) 第一人組織或協助另一人（第二人）進入或來到澳大利亞，或進入或擬進入澳大利亞；和
(b) the second person is a non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 第二人是非公民；和
(c) the second person had, or has, no lawful right to come to Australia.
(c) 第二人曾經或現在沒有進入澳洲的合法權利。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Absolute liability applies to paragraph (1)(b).
(2) 绝对责任适用于第 (1)(b) 款。
Note: For absolute liability, see section 6.2 of the Criminal Code .
註：關於絕對責任，請參閱《刑法》第 6.2 條。
(3) For the purposes of this Act, an offence against subsection (1) is to be known as the offence of people smuggling.
(3) 就本法而言，違反第 (1) 款的犯罪行為稱為人口走私犯罪。

title: 233B Aggravated offence of people smuggling (danger of death or serious harm etc.)
zh: 233B 嚴重的人口走私罪（死亡或嚴重傷害等危險）
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) commits an offence against this section if the first person commits the offence of people smuggling (the underlying offence ) in relation to another person (the victim ) and either or both of the following apply:
(1) 如果一個人（第一人）針對另一個人（受害人）實施了人口走私犯罪（基本犯罪），並且以下任一或全部適用，則該人（第一人）犯有違反本節的罪行：
(b) in committing the underlying offence, the first person subjects the victim to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment (within the ordinary meaning of that expression);
(b) 在實施基本犯罪時，第一人使受害者遭受殘忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇（在該表述的一般意義內）；
(c) in committing the underlying offence:
(c) 在实施基本犯罪时：
(i) the first person’s conduct gives rise to a danger of death or serious harm to the victim; and
(i) 第一人的行為對受害人造成死亡或嚴重傷害的危險；和
(ii) the first person is reckless as to the danger of death or serious harm to the victim that arises from the conduct.
(ii) 第一人對該行為可能對受害人造成死亡或嚴重傷害的危險不計後果。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 20 years or 2,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 20 年監禁或 2,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Note: Sections 236A and 236B limit conviction and sentencing options for offences against this section.
註：第 236A 和 236B 條限制了違反本條規定的定罪和量刑選擇。
(2) There is no fault element for the physical element of conduct described in subsection (1), that the first person commits the underlying offence, other than the fault elements (however described), if any, for the underlying offence.
(2) 對於第 (1) 款所述的行為的身體要件，第一人犯下基本犯罪，不存在過錯要件，但基本犯罪的過錯要件（無論如何描述）除外（如果有的話）。
(3) To avoid doubt, the first person may be convicted of an offence against this section even if the first person has not been convicted of the underlying offence.
(3) 為避免疑義，即使第一人尚未被判犯有違反本條的罪行，也可能被判犯有違反本條的罪行。
(4) In this section:
(4) 本節：
serious harm has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
嚴重傷害與刑法中的意義相同。

title: 233C Aggravated offence of people smuggling (at least 5 people)
zh: 233C 嚴重人口走私罪（至少 5 人）
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(1) 一個人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person organises or facilitates the bringing or coming to Australia, or the entry or proposed entry into Australia, of a group of at least 5 persons (the other persons ); and
(a) 第一人組織或協助至少 5 人的團體（其他人）進入或來到澳大利亞，或進入或擬進入澳大利亞；和
(b) at least 5 of the other persons are non ‑ citizens; and
(b) 其他人中至少有 5 人是非公民；和
(c) the persons referred to in paragraph (b) who are non ‑ citizens had, or have, no lawful right to come to Australia.
(c) (b) 款所提及的非公民人士曾經或現在沒有合法權利來澳洲。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 20 years or 2,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 20 年監禁或 2,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Note: Sections 236A and 236B limit conviction and sentencing options for offences against this section.
註：第 236A 和 236B 條限制了違反本條規定的定罪和量刑選擇。
(2) Absolute liability applies to paragraph (1)(b).
(2) 绝对责任适用于第 (1)(b) 款。
Note: For absolute liability, see section 6.2 of the Criminal Code .
註：關於絕對責任，請參閱《刑法》第 6.2 條。
(3) If, on a trial for an offence against subsection (1), the trier of fact:
(3) 如果在違反第 (1) 款的罪行的審判中，事實審判者：
(a) is not satisfied that the defendant is guilty of that offence; and
(a) 不確信被告犯有該罪行；和
(b) is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the defendant is guilty of the offence of people smuggling;
(b) 毫無合理懷疑地確信被告犯有走私人口罪；
the trier of fact may find the defendant not guilty of an offence against subsection (1) but guilty of the offence of people smuggling, so long as the defendant has been accorded procedural fairness in relation to that finding of guilt.
事實審判者可以裁定被告沒有犯有違反第(1)款的罪行，但犯有走私罪，只要被告在有罪裁定方面獲得了程序公正。

title: 233D Supporting the offence of people smuggling
zh: 第233D條 支持人口販運罪
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(1) 一個人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person provides material support or resources to another person or an organisation (the receiver ); and
(a) 第一個人向另一個人或組織（接收者）提供物質支持或資源；和
(b) the support or resources aids the receiver, or a person or organisation other than the receiver, to engage in conduct constituting the offence of people smuggling.
(b) 支持或資源協助接收者或接收者以外的個人或組織從事構成偷運人口罪的行為。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the conduct constituting the offence of people smuggling relates, or would relate, to:
(2) 若構成偷運人口罪的行為涉及或可能涉及以下方面，則第 (1) 款不適用：
(a) the first person; or
(a) 第一人；或
(b) a group of persons that includes the first person.
(b) 包括第一人在內的一組人。
(3) To avoid doubt, the first person commits an offence against subsection (1) even if the offence of people smuggling is not committed.
(3) 為避免疑義，即使沒有犯走私人口罪，第一人也犯有違反第 (1) 款的罪行。

title: 233E Concealing and harbouring non ‑ citizens etc.
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(1) 一個人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person conceals another person (the second person ); and
(a) 第一個人隱藏另一個人（第二個人）；和
(b) the second person is a non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 第二人是非公民；和
(c) the first person engages in the conduct with the intention that the second person will enter Australia in contravention of this Act.
(c) 第一個人的行為意圖是讓第二個人違反本法進入澳洲。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(2) 某人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person conceals another person (the second person ); and
(a) 第一個人隱藏另一個人（第二個人）；和
(b) the second person is an unlawful non ‑ citizen or a deportee; and
(b) 第二人是非法非公民或被驅逐者；和
(c) the first person engages in the conduct with the intention of preventing discovery by an officer of the second person.
(c) 第一個人的行為是為了防止第二個人的官員發現。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(3) A person (the first person ) commits an offence if:
(3) 一個人（第一人）在下列情況下犯罪：
(a) the first person harbours another person (the second person ); and
(a) 第一個人窩藏另一個人（第二個人）；和
(b) the second person is an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee.
(b) 第二人是非法非公民、被驅逐者或被驅逐者。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 234 False documents and false or misleading information etc. relating to non ‑ citizens
zh: 234 與非公民有關的虛假文件和虛假或誤導性資訊等
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person shall not, in connexion with the entry, proposed entry or immigration clearance, of a non ‑ citizen (including that person himself or herself) into Australia or with an application for a visa or a further visa permitting a non ‑ citizen (including that person himself or herself) to remain in Australia:
(1) 在非公民（包括該人本人）進入澳洲、擬入境或辦理出入境手續時，或在申請簽證或允許非公民（包括該人本人）留在澳洲的進一步簽證時，任何人不得：
(a) present, or cause to be presented, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act a document which is forged or false;
(a) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或人員出示或促使出示偽造或虛假的文件；
(b) make, or cause to be made, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act a statement that, to the person’s knowledge, is false or misleading in a material particular; or
(b) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或個人作出或促使作出據其所知在重要細節上虛假或誤導性的聲明；或
(c) deliver, or cause to be delivered, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act, or otherwise furnish, or cause to be furnished for official purposes of the Commonwealth, a document containing a statement or information that is false or misleading in a material particular.
(c) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或人員交付或促使他人交付，或以其他方式提供或促使為聯邦官方目的提供含有重大細節虛假或誤導性陳述或資訊的文件。
(2) A person shall not transfer or part with possession of a document:
(2) 任何人不得轉讓或放棄文件的佔有：
(a) with intent that the document be used to help a person, being a person not entitled to use it, to gain entry, or to remain in, Australia or to be immigration cleared; or
(a) 意圖將該文件用於幫助無權使用該文件的人進入或留在澳洲或獲得移民許可；或
(b) where the person has reason to suspect that the document may be so used.
(b) 該人有理由懷疑該文件可能被如此使用。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 234A Aggravated offence of false documents and false or misleading information etc. relating to non ‑ citizens (at least 5 people)
zh: 234A 與非公民（至少 5 人）有關的虛假文件和虛假或誤導性資訊等的嚴重犯罪
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person must not, in connection with:
(1) 任何人不得：
(a) the entry or proposed entry into Australia, or the immigration clearance, of a group of 5 or more non ‑ citizens (which may include that person), or of any member of such a group; or
(a) 5名或以上非公民（可能包括該人）或該團體中任何成員的入境或擬入境澳洲或出入境許可；或
(b) an application for a visa or a further visa permitting a group of 5 or more non ‑ citizens (which may include that person), or any member of such a group, to remain in Australia;
(b) 申請簽證或進一步簽證，允許 5 名或更多非公民（可能包括該人）或該團體的任何成員留在澳洲；
do any of the following:
執行下列任一操作：
(c) present, or cause to be presented, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act a document that the person knows is forged or false;
(c) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或個人出示或促使出示該人明知是偽造或虛假的文件；
(d) make, or cause to be made, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act a statement that the person knows is false or misleading in a material particular;
(d) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或個人作出或促使作出該人明知在重要細節上存在虛假或誤導性的聲明；
(e) deliver, or cause to be delivered, to an officer or a person exercising powers or performing functions under this Act, or otherwise give, or cause to be given, for official purposes of the Commonwealth, a document containing a statement or information that the person knows is false or misleading in a material particular.
(e) 向依本法行使權力或履行職能的官員或個人交付或促使他人交付，或出於聯邦官方目的以其他方式給予或促使給予包含該人明知在重要細節上存在虛假或誤導性陳述或信息的文件。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 20 years or 2,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 20 年監禁或 2,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Note: Sections 236A and 236B limit conviction and sentencing options for offences against this section.
註：第 236A 和 236B 條限制了違反本條規定的定罪和量刑選擇。
(2) A person must not transfer or part with possession of a document or documents:
(2) 任何人不得轉讓或放棄一份或多份文件的佔有：
(a) with the intention that the document or documents be used to help a group of 5 or more people, none of whom are entitled to use the document or documents, or any member of such a group, to gain entry into or remain in Australia, or to be immigration cleared; or
(a) 意圖使用該文件或文件來幫助 5 人或以上的團體（其中任何人均無權使用該文件或文件）或該團體的任何成員進入或留在澳大利亞，或獲得移民許可；或
(b) if the person has reason to suspect that the document or documents may be so used.
(b) 若該人有理由懷疑該一份或多份文件可能被如此使用。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 20 years or 2,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 20 年監禁或 2,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Note: Sections 236A and 236B limit conviction and sentencing options for offences against this section.
註：第 236A 和 236B 條限制了違反本條規定的定罪和量刑選擇。

title: 236 Offences relating to visas
zh: 236 與簽證有關的犯罪行為
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person uses a visa with the intention of:
(a) 該人使用簽證的目的是：
(i) travelling to Australia; or
(i) 前往澳洲；或
(ii) remaining in Australia; or
(ii) 留在澳洲；或
(iii) identifying himself or herself; and
(iii) 表明自己的身分；和
(b) the visa is a visa that was granted to another person.
(b) 該簽證是授予他人的簽證。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) A person commits an offence if:
(2) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person has a visa in his or her possession or under his or her control; and
(a) 該人持有或控制簽證；和
(b) the visa is a visa that was not granted to the person.
(b) 該簽證並非授予該人的簽證。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(3) Subsection (2) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(3) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (2) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (3) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（3）款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款）。
(4) The fault element for paragraph (2)(a) is intention.
(4) 第(2)(a)款的過失要件是故意。
Note: Section 5.2 of the Criminal Code defines intention .
註：《刑法》第 5.2 條定義了意圖。

title: 236A No discharge without conviction for certain offences
zh: 236A 某些罪行未經定罪不得開除
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
The court may only make an order under section 19B of the Crimes Act 1914 (discharge of offenders without conviction) in respect of a charge for an offence against section 233B, 233C or 234A if the person charged was aged under 18 when the offence was alleged to have been committed.
如果被指控的人在被指控犯罪時年齡未滿 18 歲，則法院只能根據 1914 年《犯罪法》第 19B 條（未經定罪釋放罪犯）就違反第 233B、233C 或 234A 條的指控作出命令。
Note: See also section 236D, which relates to age.
註：另請參閱第 236D 節，其中涉及年齡。

title: 236B Mandatory minimum penalties for certain offences
zh: 236B 某些違法行為的強制最低處罰
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) This section applies if a person is convicted of an offence against section 233B, 233C or 234A.
(1) 若某人犯有違反第 233B、233C 或 234A 條的罪行，則本條適用。
(2) This section does not apply if it is established on the balance of probabilities that the person was aged under 18 years when the offence was committed.
(2) 若根據可能性平衡確定該人犯罪時年齡未滿 18 歲，則本條不適用。
(3) The court must impose a sentence of imprisonment of at least:
(3) 法院必須判處至少以下徒刑：
(a) if the conviction is for an offence against section 233B—8 years; or
(a) 若因違反第 233B 條而被定罪－8 年；或
(b) if the conviction is for a repeat offence—8 years; or
(b) 如因重複犯罪而被定罪－8年；或
(c) in any other case—5 years.
(c) 在任何其他情況下－5 年。
(4) The court must also set a non ‑ parole period of at least:
(4) 法院也必須規定至少以下的非假釋期間：
(a) if the conviction is for an offence to which paragraph (3)(a) or (b) applies—5 years; or
(a) 若定罪是針對第 (3)(a) 或 (b) 款適用的罪行－5 年；或
(b) in any other case—3 years.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－3 年。
(5) A person’s conviction for an offence is for a repeat offence if:
(5) 在下列情況下，一個人的犯罪定罪是重複犯罪：
(a) in proceedings after the commencement of this section (whether in the same proceedings as the proceedings relating to the offence, or in previous proceedings), a court:
(a) 在本條生效後的訴訟中（無論是在與犯罪有關的同一訴訟中，還是在先前的訴訟中），法院：
(i) has convicted the person of another offence, being an offence against section 233B, 233C or 234A of this Act; or
(i) 已判定該人犯下另一項罪行，即違反本法第 233B、233C 或 234A 條的罪行；或
(ii) has found, without recording a conviction, that the person has committed another such offence; or
(ii) 在沒有定罪紀錄的情況下，發現該人再次犯下此類罪行；或
(b) in proceedings after the commencement of the Border Protection (Validation and Enforcement Powers) Act 2001 (whether in the same proceedings as the proceedings relating to the offence, or in previous proceedings), a court:
(b) 在 2001 年《邊境保護（驗證和執行權力）法》啟動後的訴訟中（無論是與犯罪相關的訴訟在同一訴訟中，還是在先前的訴訟中），法院：
(i) has convicted the person of another offence, being an offence against section 232A or 233A of this Act as in force before the commencement of this section; or
(i) 已判定該人犯下另一項罪行，即違反本條生效前有效的本法第 232A 或 233A 條的罪行；或
(ii) has found, without recording a conviction, that the person has committed another such offence.
(ii) 在未記錄定罪的情況下發現該人再次犯下此類罪行。
(6) In this section:
(6) 本節：
non ‑ parole period has the same meaning as it has in Part IB of the Crimes Act 1914 .
不得假釋期間的意思與 1914 年《犯罪法》第 IB 部分的意思相同。

title: 236C Time in immigration detention counts for sentencing etc.
zh: 236C 移民拘留時間計入量刑等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) This section applies to the court when imposing a sentence on, or setting a non ‑ parole period for, a person convicted of an offence against this Subdivision.
(1) 本節適用於法院對犯有違反本款規定的罪行的人判處刑罰或設定不得假釋期限。
(2) The court must take into account any period that the person has spent in immigration detention during the period:
(2) 法院必須考慮該人在此期間被移民拘留的任何時間：
(a) starting when the offence was committed; and
(a) 從犯罪發生時開始；和
(b) ending when the person is sentenced for the offence.
(b) 當該人因犯罪被判刑時結束。
Note: This enables the court to take into account time spent while not in punitive detention.
注意：這使法院能夠考慮非懲罰性拘留期間所花費的時間。
(3) Neither section 236B nor this section prevents section 16E of the Crimes Act 1914 from applying to the imposition of the sentence or the setting of the non ‑ parole period.
(3) 第 236B 條及本條均不妨礙 1914 年《犯罪法》第 16E 條適用於判處刑罰或設定非假釋期。
Note: Section 16E of the Crimes Act 1914 applies State law to aspects of sentencing for federal offences, subject to specified exceptions.
註：1914 年《犯罪法》第 16E 條將州法律適用於聯邦犯罪的量刑，但有特定的例外情況。

title: 236D Burden and standard of proof in relation to age
zh: 236D 與年齡有關的負擔和舉證標準
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
If, in proceedings relating to an offence against this Subdivision:
如果在與違反本款的犯罪有關的訴訟中：
(a) the defendant claims to have been aged under 18 at the time the offence was alleged to have been, or was, committed, and
(a) 被告聲稱在被指控實施或曾經實施犯罪時年齡未滿 18 歲，且
(b) the prosecution disputes this claim;
(b) 檢方對此主張提出異議；
the prosecution bears the burden of proving, on the balance of probabilities, that the defendant was aged 18 or over at that time.
控方有責任在權衡可能性的情況下證明被告當時已年滿18歲或以上。

title: 236E Evidentiary certificates in proceedings for offences
zh: 236E 犯罪訴訟中的證據證明
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
Issuing a certificate
頒發證書
(1) A written certificate may be issued under this subsection if an authorisation authorises the exercise of maritime powers in relation to a vessel or aircraft (the target vessel or aircraft ). The certificate may be issued by:
(1) 若授權書授權對船舶或飛機（目標船舶或飛機）行使海事權力，則可依本款簽發書面證書。此證書可由以下機構頒發：
(a) the authorising officer who gave the authorisation; or
(a) 給予授權的授權官員；或
(b) a maritime officer who boards the target vessel or aircraft in accordance with the authorisation.
(b) 根據授權登上目標船隻或飛機的海事官員。
Note: For definitions for this section, see subsection (6).
註：本節的定義請參閱第（6）款。
Certificate is prima facie evidence of the matters in it
證書是其中事項的表面證據
(2) The certificate is to be received in proceedings for an offence against this Subdivision as prima facie evidence of the matters stated in the certificate.
(2) 該證書應在違反本款規定的犯罪訴訟中收到，作為該證書中所述事項的表面證據。
Matters that can be specified in a certificate
證明書可記載的事項
(3) The certificate may specify one or more of the following:
(3) 證書可以註明以下一項或多項：
(a) the location of the target vessel or aircraft during the exercise of those maritime powers;
(a) 行使這些海上權力期間目標船隻或飛機的位置；
(b) the location, during the exercise of those maritime powers, of a Commonwealth ship or Commonwealth aircraft from which the exercise of those maritime powers was directed or coordinated;
(b) 在行使這些海上權力期間，指揮或協調行使這些海上權力的英聯邦船舶或英聯邦飛機的位置；
(c) the contents of any list of passengers on board the target vessel or aircraft, or passenger cards relating to passengers on board the target vessel or aircraft;
(c) 目標船隻或飛機上的任何乘客名單的內容，或與目標船隻或飛機上的乘客有關的乘客卡；
(d) the number of passengers on board the target vessel or aircraft;
(d) 目標船隻或飛機上的乘客人數；
(e) the number of crew on board the target vessel or aircraft;
(e) 目標船隻或飛機上的船員人數；
(f) details about anything a maritime officer did under subsection 64(1), or section 66, of the Maritime Powers Act 2013 (about securing things) in the exercise of those maritime powers;
(f) 海事官員在行使海事權力時根據《2013 年海事權力法》第 64(1) 款或第 66 條（關於保護物品）所做的任何事情的詳細資訊；
(j) any other matter prescribed under subsection (5).
(j) 第(5)款規定的任何其他事項。
(4) Subsection (2) does not apply to so much of the certificate as specifies whether a person is the master, owner, agent or charterer of the target vessel or aircraft.
(4) 第(2)款不適用於證書中規定某人是否為目標船舶或飛機的船長、所有人、代理人或承租人的部分。
(5) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, prescribe other matters that may be specified in a certificate issued under subsection (1).
(5) 部長可以透過立法文書規定在依第 (1) 款頒發的證書中規定的其他事項。
Definitions
定義
(6) In this section:
(6) 本節：
authorisation has the same meaning as in the Maritime Powers Act 2013 .
授權與 2013 年海事權力法中的意義相同。
authorising officer has the same meaning as in the Maritime Powers Act 2013 .
授權官員與 2013 年海事權力法中的含義相同。
Commonwealth aircraft has the same meaning as in the Maritime Powers Act 2013 .
英聯邦飛機的含義與《2013 年海事權力法》中的含義相同。
Commonwealth ship has the same meaning as in the Maritime Powers Act 2013 .
英聯邦船舶與 2013 年海事權力法中的意義相同。
maritime powers has the same meaning as in the Maritime Powers Act 2013 .
海事權力與2013年海事權力法中的意義相同。

title: 236F Evidentiary certificates—procedural matters
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision A — People smuggling and related offences
text:
(1) A certificate issued under subsection 236E(1) must not be admitted in evidence in proceedings for an offence unless:
(1) 依第 236E(1) 款頒發的證書不得在犯罪訴訟中被接納為證據，除非：
(a) the person charged with the offence; or
(a) 被指控犯罪的人；或
(b) a lawyer who has appeared for the person in those proceedings;
(b) 在這些訴訟中代表該人出庭的律師；
has, at least 28 days before the certificate is sought to be so admitted, been given a copy of the certificate together with notice of the intention to produce the certificate as evidence in the proceedings.
在尋求如此承認該證書之前至少28天已獲得該證書的副本以及打算出示該證書作為訴訟中的證據的通知。
(2) If, under section 236E, a certificate is admitted in evidence in proceedings for an offence, the person charged with the offence may require the person who signed the certificate to be:
(2) 如果根據第 236E 條，證書在犯罪訴訟中被接受為證據，則被指控犯罪的人可以要求簽署該證書的人是：
(a) called as a witness for the prosecution; and
(a) 傳喚出庭作證；和
(b) cross ‑ examined as if the person who signed the certificate had given evidence of the matters stated in the certificate.
(b) 進行交叉審查，就好像簽署證書的人已經就證書中所述事項提供了證據一樣。
(3) However, subsection (2) does not entitle the person charged to require the person who signed the certificate to be called as a witness for the prosecution unless:
(3) 然而，第 (2) 款無權被指控者要求傳喚簽署證書的人作為控方證人，除非：
(a) the prosecutor has been given at least 21 days’ notice of the person’s intention to require the person who signed the certificate to be so called; and
(a) 檢察官已至少提前 21 天收到該人要求簽署證書的人的意圖的通知；和
(b) the court, by order, allows the person charged to require the person who signed the certificate to be so called.
(b) 法院依命令允許被指控人要求簽署證書的人是這樣稱呼的。
(4) Any evidence given in support, or in rebuttal, of a matter stated in a certificate issued under subsection 236E(1) must be considered on its merits, and the credibility and probative value of such evidence must be neither increased nor diminished by reason of this section.
(4) 任何支持或反駁根據第 236E(1) 款頒發的證書中所述事項的證據，必須根據其優點進行考慮，並且此類證據的可信度和證明價值不得因本條而增加或減少。

title: Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
zh: B 部分 — 與濫用允許澳洲公民或永久居民的配偶等成為永久居民的法律有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 237 Reason for Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
This Subdivision was enacted because:
制定本細分的原因是：
(a) under the regulations, a person satisfies a criterion for certain visas that give, or might lead to, authorisation for the person’s permanent residence in Australia if the person is the spouse or de facto partner of, and has a genuine and continuing relationship, involving a shared life to the exclusion of all others with, either an Australian citizen or a permanent resident of Australia; and
(a) 根據法規，如果某人是澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民的配偶或同居伴侶，並與其擁有真正且持續的關係，涉及共同生活（排除所有其他人），則該人滿足某些簽證的標準，從而獲得或可能導致該人在澳洲永久居留；和
(c) some persons attempt to get permanent residence under the regulations by:
(c) 有些人試圖透過以下方式取得永久居留權：
(i) entering into a married relationship that is not intended to be a genuine and continuing relationship involving a shared life to the exclusion of all others; or
(i) 所建立的婚姻關係並非旨在成為一種真正的、持續的關係，涉及共同生活，排除所有其他人；或
(ii) pretending to be a de facto partner of another person.
(ii) 假扮他人的事實上的伴侶。

title: 238 Interpretation
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
In this Subdivision:
在這個細分中：
criterion includes part of a criterion.
標準包括標準的一部分。
preliminary visa , means a visa that is usually applied for by persons applying, or intending to apply, for a permanent visa.
初步簽證，是指通常由申請或打算申請永久簽證的人申請的簽證。
stay visa means:
居留簽證的意思是：
(a) a permanent visa; or
(a) 永久簽證；或
(b) a preliminary visa.
(b) 初步簽證。

title: 239 Application of Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
(1) This Subdivision applies in and outside Australia.
(1) 本款適用於澳洲境內及境外。
(2) This Subdivision applies to marriages solemnized outside Australia as well as those solemnized in Australia.
(2) 本款適用於在澳洲境外以及在澳洲舉行的婚姻。

title: 240 Offence to arrange marriage to obtain permanent residence
zh: 第240條 安排婚姻以獲得永久居留權的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
(1) A person must not arrange a marriage between other persons with the intention of assisting one of those other persons to get a stay visa by satisfying a criterion for the visa because of the marriage.
(1) 一個人不得安排其他人之間的婚姻，目的是幫助其中一人因婚姻而滿足簽證標準，從而獲得居留簽證。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) applies whether or not the intention is achieved.
(2) 無論意圖是否實現，第 (1) 款均適用。
(3) It is a defence to an offence against subsection (1) if the defendant proves that, although one purpose of the marriage was to assist a person to get a stay visa, the defendant believed on reasonable grounds that the marriage would result in a genuine and continuing marital relationship.
(3) 如果被告證明，雖然結婚的目的之一是協助某人獲得居留簽證，但被告有合理理由相信該婚姻將建立真正且持續的婚姻關係，則可以對第 (1) 款的犯罪行為進行抗辯。
Note: A defendant bears a legal burden in relation to the matter in subsection (3) (see section 13.4 of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（3）款的事項承擔法律責任（見《刑法》第13.4條）。

title: 241 Offence to arrange pretended de facto relationship to obtain permanent residence
zh: 第241條 安排假裝同居關係以獲得永久居留權的犯罪行為
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
(1) If a person knows or believes on reasonable grounds that 2 other persons are not de facto partners of each other, the person must not make arrangements that make, or help to make, it look as if those other persons are such de facto partners with the intention of assisting one of those other persons to get a stay visa by appearing to satisfy a criterion for the visa because of being such de facto partners.
(1) 如果一個人知道或有合理理由相信另外 2 個人不是彼此的事實上的伴侶，則該人不得做出安排，使其他人看起來像是這樣的事實上的伴侶，並意圖協助其中一個人獲得居留簽證，因為他們是這樣的事實上的伴侶，看起來滿足簽證的標準。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 10 years or 1,000 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 10 年監禁或 1,000 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) applies whether or not the intention is achieved.
(2) 無論意圖是否實現，第 (1) 款均適用。

title: 243 Offences relating to application for permanent residence because of marriage or de facto relationship
zh: 243 與因婚姻或同居關係而申請永久居留有關的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
(1) A person must not apply for a stay visa on the basis of satisfying a criterion for the visa because of being the spouse or de facto partner of another person if, at the time of the application, the applicant does not intend to live permanently with the other person in a married relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5F(2)) or de facto relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5CB(2)), as appropriate.
(1) 若申請人在申請時不打算以婚姻關係（第 5F(2) 款意義內）或同居關係（第 5CB(2) 款意義內）與另一人永久居住，則不得因是另一人的配偶或同居伴侶而申請居留簽證。
(2) A non ‑ citizen in Australia convicted of an offence under subsection (1) becomes an unlawful non ‑ citizen.
(2) 在澳洲被判犯有第 (1) 款所述罪行的非公民將成為非法非公民。
(3) A person must not nominate an applicant for a stay visa on the basis of the applicant satisfying a criterion for the visa because of being the spouse or de facto partner of the person if, at the time of the application, the person does not intend to live permanently with the applicant in a married relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5F(2)) or de facto relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5CB(2)), as appropriate.
(3) 若申請人在申請時不打算以婚姻關係（第 5F(2) 款含義內）或同居關係（第 5CB(2) 款含義內）與申請人永久居住（視情況而定），則不得以申請人因是該人的配偶或同居伴侶而滿足簽證標準為由提名該申請人。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years.
刑罰：監禁2年。

title: 245 Offences of making false or unsupported statements
zh: 245 作出虛假或無事實依據的陳述的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision B — Offences relating to abuse of laws allowing spouses etc. of Australian citizens or of permanent residents to become permanent residents
text:
(1) A person must not make a statement, or give information, in writing, to an officer in relation to the consideration for the purposes of this Act or the regulations of any of the following questions:
(1) 任何人不得就本法或條例中以下任何問題的考慮以書面形式向官員發表聲明或提供資訊：
(a) whether or not other persons are in a married relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5F(2));
(a) 其他人是否處於婚姻關係（第 5F(2) 款意義內）；
(b) whether or not other persons are in a de facto relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5CB(2)) with one another;
(b) 其他人之間是否存在事實上的關係（第 5CB(2) 款意義內）；
if:
如果：
(d) the person knows that the statement or information is false or misleading in a material particular; and
(d) 該人知道該陳述或資訊在重要細節上是虛假的或具有誤導性的；和
(e) the statement is made, or the information is given, in a document that describes, and shows the penalty for, an offence against this subsection.
(e) 在描述違反本款的行為並顯示其處罰的文件中作出陳述或提供資訊。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months.
處罰：監禁 12 個月。
(3) A person must not make a statement, or give information, in writing, to an officer in relation to the consideration for the purposes of this Act or the regulations of any of the following questions:
(3) 任何人不得就本法或條例中以下任何問題的考慮以書面形式向官員發表聲明或提供資訊：
(a) whether or not other persons are in a married relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5F(2));
(a) 其他人是否處於婚姻關係（第 5F(2) 款意義內）；
(b) whether or not other persons are in a de facto relationship (within the meaning of subsection 5CB(2)) with one another;
(b) 其他人之間是否存在事實上的關係（第 5CB(2) 款意義內）；
if:
如果：
(d) the statement or information is false or misleading in a material particular; and
(d) 該陳述或資訊在重要細節上是虛假的或具有誤導性的；和
(e) the person making the statement, or giving the information, did not make appropriate inquiries to satisfy himself or herself that the statement or information was neither false nor misleading; and
(e) 作出陳述或提供資訊的人沒有進行適當的調查以使自己確信該陳述或資訊既不虛假也不具有誤導性；和
(f) the statement is made, or the information is given, in a document that describes, and shows the penalty for, an offence against this subsection.
(f) 在描述違反本款的行為並顯示其處罰的文件中作出陳述或提供資訊。
Penalty for a contravention of this subsection: 120 penalty units.
違反本款規定的處罰：120 個處罰單位。

title: Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
zh: 第 C 次分部 — 與非公民工作有關的罪行及民事處罰

title: 245AA Overview
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) This Subdivision creates offences, and provides for civil penalties, to deal with the following situations:
(1) 本款規定下列情形的犯罪行為，並規定民事處罰：
(aa) where a person coerces, or exerts undue influence or undue pressure on, a lawful non ‑ citizen to accept or agree to an arrangement in relation to work:
(aa) 若某人強迫合法非公民或對其施加不當影響或不當壓力，要求其接受或同意與工作有關的安排：
(i) involving a breach of a work ‑ related condition applying to a visa held by the lawful non ‑ citizen; or
(i) 涉及違反適用於合法非公民持有的簽證的工作相關條件；或
(ii) to avoid an adverse effect on the lawful non ‑ citizen’s status as a lawful non ‑ citizen; or
(ii) 避免對合法非公民的合法非公民身份產生不利影響；或
(iii) to satisfy certain requirements to provide information or documents about work the lawful non ‑ citizen has done in Australia;
(iii) 滿足提供有關合法非公民在澳洲所做工作的資訊或文件的某些要求；
(ab) where a person coerces, or exerts undue influence or undue pressure on, an unlawful non ‑ citizen to accept or agree to an arrangement in relation to work to avoid an adverse effect on the unlawful non ‑ citizen’s continued presence in Australia;
(ab) 某人脅迫非法非公民，或對其施加不當影響或不當壓力，使其接受或同意與工作有關的安排，以避免對該非法非公民在澳洲的繼續居留造成不利影響；
(a) where a person allows an unlawful non ‑ citizen to work, or refers an unlawful non ‑ citizen for work;
(a) 某人允許非法非公民工作，或推薦非法非公民工作；
(b) where a person allows a non ‑ citizen to work, or refers a non ‑ citizen for work, in breach of the non ‑ citizen’s visa conditions.
(b) 某人違反非公民簽證條件，允許非公民工作或推薦非公民工作。
(2) This Subdivision uses a number of terms that are defined in the following sections:
(2) 本節使用了以下各節中定義的一些術語：
(a) section 14 (defines unlawful non ‑ citizen );
(a) 第 14 條（非法非公民的定義）；
(b) section 245AG (defines work and allows to work);
(b) 第 245AG 條（定義工作並允許工作）；
(ba) section 245AGA (defines arrangement in relation to work );
(ba) 第 245AGA 條（定義與工作相關的安排）；
(c) section 245AH (defines exploited ).
(c) 第 245AH 條（定義「利用」）。
(3) To avoid doubt, section 245AF sets out some circumstances in which this Subdivision does not apply.
(3) 為避免疑問，第 245AF 條規定了本款不適用的一些情況。

title: 245AAA Coercing etc. a lawful non ‑ citizen to work in breach of work ‑ related conditions
zh: 245AAA 強迫合法非公民等違反工作相關條件工作
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) contravenes this subsection if:
(1) 某人（第一人）違反本款規定，如果：
(a) the first person coerces, or exerts undue influence or undue pressure on, another person (the worker ) to accept or agree to an arrangement in relation to work; and
(a) 第一人強迫另一人（工人）或對其施加不當影響或不當壓力，使其接受或同意與工作有關的安排；和
(b) the worker is a lawful non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 工人是合法的非公民；和
(c) the work is done, or is to be done, by the worker in Australia, whether for the first person or someone else; and
(c) 該工作是由工人在澳洲完成或將要完成的，無論是為第一人還是其他人；和
(d) the worker holds a visa that is subject to a work ‑ related condition; and
(d) 工人持有受工作相關條件限制的簽證；和
(e) either:
(e) 任一：
(i) the worker is in breach of the work ‑ related condition solely because of doing the work in accordance with the arrangement; or
(i) 工人僅因依照安排從事工作而違反了與工作有關的條件；或
(ii) the worker would be in breach of the work ‑ related condition if the worker were to do the work in accordance with the arrangement.
(ii) 若工人依照安排進行工作，則將違反與工作相關的條件。
Note: For the meaning of arrangement in relation to work , see section 245AGA.
註：有關工作安排的含義，請參閱第 245AGA 節。
Offence
進攻
(2) A person commits an offence if the person contravenes subsection (1). The physical elements of the offence are set out in that subsection.
(2) 若某人違反第 (1) 款，則構成犯罪。該罪名的身體要件已在該小節中列出。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years or 360 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁或 360 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(3) For the purposes of subsection (2), the fault element for paragraphs (1)(b), (c), (d) and (e) is knowledge or recklessness by the first person.
(3) 就第 (2) 款而言，第 (1)(b)、(c)、(d) 及 (e) 款的過失要素是第一人知情或魯莽。
Civil penalty provision
民事處罰規定
(4) A person is liable to a civil penalty if the person contravenes subsection (1).
(4) 若某人違反第 (1) 款，將受到民事處罰。
Note: It is not necessary to prove a person’s state of mind in proceedings for a civil penalty order (see section 486ZF).
注意：在民事處罰令訴訟中，無需證明一個人的精神狀態（參見第 486ZF 條）。
Civil penalty: 240 penalty units.
民事處罰：240處罰單位。

title: 245AAB Coercing etc. an unlawful non ‑ citizen to work—adverse effect on presence in Australia
zh: 245AAB 強迫非公民非法工作等－對在澳洲的存在產生不利影響
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) contravenes this subsection if:
(1) 某人（第一人）違反本款規定，如果：
(a) the first person coerces, or exerts undue influence or undue pressure on, another person (the worker ) to accept or agree to an arrangement in relation to work; and
(a) 第一人強迫另一人（工人）或對其施加不當影響或不當壓力，使其接受或同意與工作有關的安排；和
(b) the worker is an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 工人是非法非公民；和
(c) the work is done, or is to be done, by the worker in Australia, whether for the first person or someone else; and
(c) 該工作是由工人在澳洲完成或將要完成的，無論是為第一人還是其他人；和
(d) the first person’s conduct mentioned in paragraph (a) results in the worker believing that, if the worker does not accept or agree to the arrangement, there will be an adverse effect on the worker’s continued presence in Australia.
(d) (a) 段中提到的第一人的行為導致工人相信，如果他不接受或同意該安排，將會對該工人繼續留在澳洲產生不利影響。
Note: For the meaning of arrangement in relation to work , see section 245AGA.

(2) A person commits an offence if the person contravenes subsection (1). The physical elements of the offence are set out in that subsection.
(2) 若某人違反第 (1) 款，則構成犯罪。該罪名的身體要件已在該小節中列出。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years or 360 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁或 360 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(3) For the purposes of subsection (2), the fault element for paragraphs (1)(b), (c) and (d) is knowledge or recklessness by the first person.
(3) 就第 (2) 款而言，第 (1)(b)、(c) 及 (d) 款的過失要素是第一人知情或魯莽。
Civil penalty provision
民事處罰規定
(4) A person is liable to a civil penalty if the person contravenes subsection (1).
(4) 若某人違反第 (1) 款，將受到民事處罰。
Note: It is not necessary to prove a person’s state of mind in proceedings for a civil penalty order (see section 486ZF).
注意：在民事處罰令訴訟中，無需證明一個人的精神狀態（參見第 486ZF 條）。
Civil penalty: 240 penalty units.
民事處罰：240處罰單位。

title: 245AAC Coercing etc. a lawful non ‑ citizen to work—adverse effect on status etc.
zh: 245AAC 強迫合法非公民工作等－對身分等產生不利影響。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) A person (the first person ) contravenes this subsection if:
(1) 某人（第一人）違反本款規定，如果：
(a) the first person coerces, or exerts undue influence or undue pressure on, another person (the worker ) to accept or agree to an arrangement in relation to work; and
(a) 第一人強迫另一人（工人）或對其施加不當影響或不當壓力，使其接受或同意與工作有關的安排；和
(b) the worker is a lawful non ‑ citizen (other than a holder of a permanent visa); and
(b) 該工人是合法的非公民（永久簽證持有者除外）；和
(c) the work is done, or is to be done, by the worker in Australia, whether for the first person or someone else; and
(c) 該工作是由工人在澳洲完成或將要完成的，無論是為第一人還是其他人；和
(d) the first person’s conduct mentioned in paragraph (a) results in the worker believing that, if the worker does not accept or agree to the arrangement:
(d) (a) 段中提到的第一人的行為導致工人相信，如果工人不接受或不同意該安排：
(i) there will be an adverse effect on the worker’s status as a lawful non ‑ citizen; or
(i) 將對工人的合法非公民身分產生不利影響；或
(ii) the worker will be unable to provide information or documents about work the worker has done in Australia that the worker is required, under this Act or the regulations, to provide in connection with a visa held by the worker or an application for a visa by the worker.
(ii) 該工人將無法提供有關該工人在澳洲所做的工作的資訊或文件，而根據本法或法規，該工人必須提供與該工人持有的簽證或該工人的簽證申請有關的資訊或文件。
Note: For the meaning of arrangement in relation to work , see section 245AGA.
註：有關工作安排的含義，請參閱第 245AGA 節。
Offence
進攻
(2) A person commits an offence if the person contravenes subsection (1). The physical elements of the offence are set out in that subsection.
(2) 若某人違反第 (1) 款，則構成犯罪。該罪名的身體要件已在該小節中列出。

title: 245AF Circumstances in which this Subdivision does not apply
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

text:
To avoid doubt, this Subdivision does not apply where:
為避免疑問，本細則不適用於以下情況：
(a) a detainee in immigration detention voluntarily engages in an activity of a kind approved in writing by the Secretary for the purposes of this paragraph; or
(a) 移民拘留中的被拘留者自願從事部長為本段目的書面批准的活動；或
(b) a prisoner in a prison or remand centre of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory engages in an activity as a prisoner; or
(b) 聯邦、州或地區監獄或還押中心的囚犯以囚犯身分從事活動；或
(c) a person engages in an activity in compliance with:
(c) 一個人從事符合下列規定的活動：
(i) a sentence passed, or an order made, under subsection 20AB(1) of the Crimes Act 1914 (community service orders etc.); or
(i) 根據 1914 年《犯罪法》第 20AB(1) 款所作出的判決或作出的命令（社區服務命令等）；或
(ii) a community service order, a work order, a sentence of periodic detention, an attendance centre order, a sentence of weekend detention, an attendance order, or a similar sentence or order, passed or made under the law of a State or Territory.
(ii) 社區服務令、工作令、定期拘留判決、出勤中心令、週末拘留判決、出勤令或根據州或領地法律通過或作出的類似判決或命令。

title: 245AG Meaning of work and allows to work
zh: 245AG 工作的含義和允許工作
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) In this Subdivision:
(1) 在本小節：
work means any work, whether for reward or otherwise.
工作是指任何工作，無論是為了報酬還是其他。
(2) In this Subdivision, a person allows a person to work if, and only if:
(2) 在本節中，當且僅當以下情況時，一個人允許另一個人工作：
(a) the first person employs the second person under a contract of service; or
(a) 第一個人依服務契約僱用第二個人；或
(b) the first person engages the second person, other than in a domestic context, under a contract for services; or
(b) 除在國內情況外，第一人依服務契約僱用第二人；或
(ba) the first person participates in an arrangement, or any arrangement included in a series of arrangements, for the performance of work by the second person for:
(ba) 第一人參與一項安排或一系列安排中包含的任何安排，以便第二人執行以下工作：
(i) the first person; or
(i) 第一人稱；或
(ii) another participant in the arrangement or any such arrangement; or
(ii) 該安排或任何此類安排的另一位參與者；或
(c) the first person bails or licenses a chattel to the second person or another person with the intention that the second person will use the chattel to perform a transportation service; or
(c) 第一人將動產保釋或許可給第二人或另一人，目的是讓第二人使用該動產來提供運輸服務；或者
(d) the first person leases or licenses premises, or a space within premises, to the second person or another person with the intention that the second person will use the premises or space to perform sexual services within the meaning of the Criminal Code (see the Dictionary to the Criminal Code ); or
(d) 第一人向第二人或其他人租赁或许可场所或场所内的空间，目的是让第二人使用该场所或空间进行《刑法典》含义内的性服务（参见《刑法典》词典）；或
(e) the prescribed circumstances exist.
(e) 存在規定的情形。
(3) In paragraph (2)(d):
(3) 在第 (2)(d) 款：
premises means:
前提是指：
(a) an area of land or any other place, whether or not it is enclosed or built on; or
(a) 一塊土地或任何其他地方，不論其是否封閉或建於其上；或
(b) a building or other structure; or
(b) a building or other structure;或
(c) a vehicle or vessel.
(c) 车辆或船只。

title: 245AGA Meaning of arrangement in relation to work
zh: 245AGA 與工作有關的安排的意義
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) For the purposes of this Subdivision, arrangement in relation to work means an arrangement, in connection with a person (the first person ) allowing another person to work, for the other person to:
(1) 就本款而言，與工作有關的安排是指與一個人（第一人）有關允許另一個人工作的安排，以使另一個人：
(a) accept certain conditions; or
(a) accept certain conditions;或
(b) perform, or refrain from performing, an activity, whether for the first person or someone else; or
(b) 執行或不執行某項活動，無論是為第一人或其他人；或
(c) participate in, or refrain from participating in, an activity, whether for the first person or someone else.
(c) 參加或不參加某項活動，不論是第一人或其他人。
(2) To avoid doubt, a reference in subsection (1) to an activity includes a reference to a work ‑ related activity or a non ‑ work ‑ related activity.
(2) 為避免疑問，第 (1) 款所提及的活動包括提及工作相關活動或非工作相關活動。
Examples: An arrangement in relation to work includes, but is not limited to, an arrangement for a person to:
範例：與工作相關的安排包括但不限於安排某人：
(a) accept unsafe housing provided or arranged by the first person or another person; or
(a) 接受第一人或另一人提供或安排的不安全住房；或
(b) surrender the person’s passport to the first person or another person; or
(b) 將該人的護照交給第一人或另一人；或
(c) perform sexual favours for the first person or another person.
(c) 為第一個人或另一個人提供性好處。

title: 245AH Meaning of exploited
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
For the purposes of this Subdivision, a person is exploited if the person is subjected to exploitation within the meaning of the Criminal Code (see section 271.1A of the Criminal Code ).
就本款而言，如果一個人遭受了《刑法》含義內的剝削（參見《刑法》第 271.1A 條），則該人被剝削。

title: 245AJ Criminal liability of executive officers of bodies corporate
zh: 245AJ 法人團體執行官的刑事責任
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) An executive officer of a body corporate commits an offence if:
(1) 法人團體的執行官在下列情況下構成犯罪：
(a) the body commits an offence (the work ‑ related offence ) against this Subdivision; and
(a) 該機構犯有違反本款的罪行（與工作有關的罪行）；和
(b) the officer knew that, or was reckless or negligent as to whether, the work ‑ related offence would be committed; and
(b) 該官員知道或魯莽或疏忽是否會犯下與工作有關的罪行；和
(c) the officer was in a position to influence the conduct of the body in relation to the work ‑ related offence; and
(c) 該官員能夠影響該機構在與工作有關的犯罪方面的行為；和
(d) the officer failed to take all reasonable steps to prevent the work ‑ related offence being committed.
(d) 該官員未能採取一切合理措施來防止與工作有關的犯罪行為發生。
(2) An offence against subsection (1) is punishable on conviction by a pecuniary penalty not exceeding one ‑ fifth of the maximum pecuniary penalty that a court could impose on the body corporate for the work ‑ related offence.
(2) 违反第(1)款的罪行一经定罪，可处以不超过法院可对法人团体因工作相关罪行处以最高罚款五分之一的罚款。
Reasonable steps to prevent the offence
防止犯罪的合理步驟
(3) In determining whether the executive officer of the body corporate failed to take all reasonable steps to prevent the work ‑ related offence being committed by the body, a court must have regard to:
(3) 在确定该法人团体的执行官是否未能采取一切合理措施来防止该团体实施与工作有关的犯罪行为时，法院必须考虑：
(a) what action (if any) the officer took towards ensuring that the body’s employees, agents and contractors had a reasonable knowledge and understanding of the requirements to comply with this Subdivision, insofar as those requirements affected the employees, agents or contractors concerned; and
(a) 該官員採取了哪些行動（如果有）來確保該機構的僱員、代理人和承包商對遵守本款的要求有合理的了解和理解，只要這些要求影響到有關僱員、代理人或承包商；和
(b) what action (if any) the officer took when he or she became aware that the body was committing the work ‑ related offence.
(b) 當該官員意識到該機構正在實施與工作有關的犯罪行為時，他或她採取了什麼行動（如果有）。
(4) Subsection (3) does not limit subsection (1).
(4)第(3)款不限制第(1)款。
Definition
定義
(5) In this section:
(5) 本節：
executive officer of a body corporate means:
法人团体的执行官是指：
(a) a director of the body corporate; or
(a) 法人团体的董事；或
(b) the chief executive officer (however described) of the body corporate; or
(b) 法人團體的執行長（無論如何描述）；或
(c) the chief financial officer (however described) of the body corporate; or
(c) 法人團體的財務長（無論如何描述）；或
(d) the secretary of the body corporate.
(d) 法人团体的秘书。

title: 245AK Civil liability of executive officers of bodies corporate
zh: 245AK 法人团体执行官的民事责任
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) An executive officer of a body corporate contravenes this subsection if:
(1) 法人團體的執行官違反本款規定，如果：
(a) the body contravenes (the work ‑ related contravention ) a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision; and
(a) 該機構違反了本節中的民事處罰規定（與工作有關的違規行為）；和
(b) the officer knew that, or was reckless or negligent as to whether, the work ‑ related contravention would occur; and
(b) 該官員知道是否會發生與工作有關的違規行為，或魯莽或疏忽；和
(c) the officer was in a position to influence the conduct of the body in relation to the work ‑ related contravention; and
(c) 該官員能夠影響該機構在與工作有關的違規行為方面的行為；和
(d) the officer failed to take all reasonable steps to prevent the work ‑ related contravention.
(d) 該官員未能採取一切合理措施來防止與工作有關的違規行為。
Civil penalty provision
民事處罰規定
(2) An executive officer of a body corporate is liable to a civil penalty if the officer contravenes subsection (1).
(2) 法人團體的執行官員如果違反第 (1) 款，將受到民事處罰。
Note: Section 486ZF (which provides that a person’s state of mind does not need to be proven in proceedings for a civil penalty order) does not apply in relation to this subsection.
注意：第 486ZF 條（規定在民事處罰令訴訟中不需要證明一個人的精神狀態）不適用於本款。
Civil penalty: 240 penalty units.
民事處罰：240處罰單位。
Reasonable steps to prevent the contravention
采取合理措施防止违规行为
(3) In determining whether the executive officer of the body corporate failed to take all reasonable steps to prevent the work ‑ related contravention by the body, a court must have regard to:
(3) 在確定法人團體的執行官是否未能採取一切合理措施來防止該團體發生與工作有關的違法行為時，法院必須考慮：
(a) what action (if any) the officer took towards ensuring that the body’s employees, agents and contractors had a reasonable knowledge and understanding of the requirements to comply with this Subdivision, insofar as those requirements affected the employees, agents or contractors concerned; and
(a) 該官員採取了哪些行動（如果有）來確保該機構的僱員、代理人和承包商對遵守本款的要求有合理的了解和理解，只要這些要求影響到有關僱員、代理人或承包商；和
(b) what action (if any) the officer took when he or she became aware that the body was engaging in the work ‑ related contravention.
(b) 當該官員意識到該機構正在從事與工作有關的違規行為時，他或她採取了什麼行動（如果有）。
(4) Subsection (3) does not limit subsection (1).
(4)第(3)款不限制第(1)款。
Definitions
定義
(5) In this section:
(5) 本節：
executive officer of a body corporate means:
法人团体的执行官是指：
(a) a director of the body corporate; or
(a) 法人团体的董事；或
(b) the chief executive officer (however described) of the body corporate; or
(b) 法人團體的執行長（無論如何描述）；或
(c) the chief financial officer (however described) of the body corporate; or
(c) 法人團體的財務長（無論如何描述）；或
(d) the secretary of the body corporate.
(d) 法人团体的秘书。
negligent : an executive officer of a body corporate is negligent as to whether a work ‑ related contravention would occur if the officer’s conduct involves:
疏忽：法人團體的執行官對於是否會發生與工作有關的違規行為有疏忽，如果該官員的行為涉及：
(a) such a great falling short of the standard of care that a reasonable person would exercise in the circumstances; and
(a) 嚴重低於正常人在這種情況下應採取的謹慎標準；和
(b) such a high risk that the work ‑ related contravention would occur;
(b) 發生與工作有關的違規行為的風險如此之高；
that the conduct merits the imposition of a pecuniary penalty.
该行为值得处以罚款。
reckless : an executive officer of a body corporate is reckless as to whether a work ‑ related contravention would occur if:
魯莽：在以下情況下，法人團體的執行官對於是否會發生與工作有關的違規行為是魯莽的：
(a) the officer is aware of a substantial risk that the work ‑ related contravention would occur; and
(a) 該官員意識到發生工作相關違規行為的重大風險；和
(b) having regard to the circumstances known to the officer, it is unjustifiable to take the risk.
(b) 考慮到該官員已知的情況，冒險是不合理的。

title: 245AL Contravening civil penalty provisions
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) This section applies if a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision provides that a person contravening another provision of this Subdivision (the conduct rule provision ) is liable to a civil penalty.
(1) 若本款的民事處罰條款規定，違反本款其他條款（行為規則條款）的人應受到民事處罰，則本節適用。
(2) For the purposes of this Act, the person is taken to contravene the civil penalty provision if the person contravenes the conduct rule provision.
(2) 就本法而言，如果該人違反行為規則規定，則該人被視為違反民事處罰規定。

title: 245ALA Enforceable undertakings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
Enforceable provisions
可執行的規定
(1) The following provisions are enforceable under Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act:
(1) 以下規定可依《監管權力法》第 6 部分強制執行：
(a) a work ‑ related offence;
(a) 與工作有關的犯罪；
(b) a work ‑ related provision.
(b) 與工作相關的規定。
Note: Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act creates a framework for accepting and enforcing undertakings relating to compliance with provisions.
註：《監管權力法》第 6 部分創建了一個接受和執行與遵守規定有關的承諾的框架。
Authorised person
授權人
(2) For the purposes of Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, the Minister is an authorised person in relation to the provisions mentioned in subsection (1).
(2) 就《監管權力法》第 6 部分而言，部長是第 (1) 款所述規定的授權人。
(3) The Minister may, in writing, delegate the Minister’s powers and functions under Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act to an authorised officer in relation to the provisions mentioned in subsection (1).
(3) 部長可以書面形式將《監管權力法》第 6 部分規定的與第 (1) 款所述規定相關的部長權力和職能委託給授權官員。
(4) The Minister may delegate a power or function under subsection (3) only if the Minister is satisfied that the authorised officer has appropriate qualifications, training or experience to exercise the power or perform the function.
（4）只有當部長信納被授權官員具有行使權力或履行職能的適當資格、培訓或經驗時，部長才可以根據第（3）款委託權力或職能。
(5) An authorised officer exercising powers or performing functions under a delegation under subsection (3) must comply with any directions of the Minister.
（5）根據第（3）款的授權，授權官員根據第（3）款的授權行使權力或履行職能，必須遵守部長的任何指示。
Relevant court
相關法院
(6) For the purposes of Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, an eligible court is a relevant court in relation to the provisions mentioned in subsection (1).
(6) 就《監管權力法》第 6 部分而言，合格法院是指與第 (1) 款所述規定有關的相關法院。
Enforceable undertaking may be published on the internet
可執行的承諾可以在網路上公佈
(7) An authorised person in relation to a provision mentioned in subsection (1) may publish an undertaking given in relation to the provision on the Department’s website.
（7）與第（1）款中提到的規定相關的授權人可以在該部門的網站上公佈與該規定相關的承諾。
Extension to external Territories
擴展到外部領土
(8) Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act, as it applies in relation to the provisions mentioned in subsection (1), extends to a Territory to which this Act extends.
(8) 《監管權力法》第 6 部分在適用於第 (1) 款中提到的規定時，適用於本法適用的領土。
Note: See section 7 of this Act.
註：參見本法第 7 條。
Relationship with civil penalty orders
與民事處罰令的關係
(9) The Minister must not apply for an order under subsection 486R(1) (civil penalty orders) in relation to a contravention of a work ‑ related provision by a person if an undertaking given by the person under Part 6 of the Regulatory Powers Act in relation to the contravention has not been withdrawn.
(9) 如果某人根據《監管權力法》第 6 部分作出的與違反行為有關的承諾尚未撤回，則部長不得根據第 486R(1) 款（民事處罰令）就某人違反工作相關規定的行為申請命令。

title: 245AM Geographical scope of offence and civil penalty provisions
zh: 245AM 犯罪的地理範圍和民事處罰規定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
Offences
罪行
(1) Section 15.2 of the Criminal Code (extended geographical jurisdiction—category B) applies to an offence against this Subdivision.
(1) 《刑法》第 15.2 條（擴展地域管轄權－B 類）適用於違反本款的犯罪。
Contraventions of civil penalty provisions
違反民事處罰規定
(2) An order must not be made against a person in civil proceedings relating to a contravention by the person of a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision unless:
(2) 不得在民事訴訟中針對某人違反本節民事處罰規定的行為發出命令，除非：
(a) the person’s conduct that allegedly contravenes the provision occurs:
(a) 該人涉嫌違反規定的行為發生在：
(i) wholly or partly in Australia; or
(i) 全部或部分在澳洲；或
(ii) wholly or partly on board an Australian aircraft or an Australian ship; or
(ii) 全部或部分登上澳洲飛機或澳洲船舶；或
(b) the person’s conduct that allegedly contravenes the provision occurs wholly outside Australia and, at the time of the alleged contravention, the person is:
(b) 該人涉嫌違反該規定的行為完全發生在澳洲境外，並且在發生涉嫌違反行為時，該人是：
(i) an Australian citizen; or
(i) 澳洲公民；或
(ii) a resident of Australia; or
(ii) 澳洲居民；或
(iii) a body corporate incorporated by or under a law of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory; or
(iii) 由澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律成立或依其法律成立的法人團體；或
(c) all of the following conditions are satisfied:
(c) 滿足以下所有條件：
(i) the person’s conduct allegedly contravenes the provision because of section 486ZD (the ancillary contravention );
(i) 該人的行為據稱因第 486ZD 條（從屬違規）而違反了該規定；
(ii) the conduct occurs wholly outside Australia;
(ii) 該行為完全發生在澳洲境外；
(iii) the conduct constituting the primary contravention to which the ancillary contravention relates occurs, or is intended by the person to occur, wholly or partly in Australia or wholly or partly on board an Australian aircraft or an Australian ship.
(iii) 構成與從屬違法行為有關的主要違法行為的行為全部或部分發生在澳大利亞，或全部或部分發生在澳大利亞飛機或澳大利亞船舶上，或該人意圖發生。
Defences relating to contraventions of civil penalty provisions
與違反民事處罰規定有關的抗辯
(3) In civil proceedings relating to a primary contravention by a person, it is a defence if:
(3) 在與某人的主要違法行為有關的民事訴訟中，如果出現以下情況，則屬於抗辯：
(a) the conduct constituting the alleged primary contravention occurs wholly in a foreign country, but not on board an Australian aircraft or an Australian ship; and
(a) 構成所指控的主要違法行為的行為完全發生在外國，而不是發生在澳洲飛機或澳洲船舶上；和
(b) the person is neither:
(b) 此人既不是：
(i) an Australian citizen; nor
(i) 澳洲公民；也不
(ii) a body corporate incorporated by or under a law of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory; and
(ii) 由澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律成立或依其法律成立的法人團體；和
(c) there is not in force in:
(c) 在下列情況下沒有生效：
(i) the foreign country where the conduct constituting the alleged primary contravention occurs; or
(i) 構成所指控的主要違法行為的外國；或
(ii) the part of the foreign country where the conduct constituting the alleged primary contravention occurs;
(ii) 構成所指控的主要違法行為的外國地區；
a law of that foreign country, or a law of that part of that foreign country, that provides for a pecuniary or criminal penalty for such conduct.
該外國或該外國該地區的法律規定對此類行為進行罰款或刑事處罰。
(4) In civil proceedings relating to a contravention (the ancillary contravention ) by a person of a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision because of section 486ZD, it is a defence if:
(4) 在涉及某人因第 486ZD 條而違反本款民事處罰規定（從屬違規）的民事訴訟中，如果滿足以下條件，則屬於抗辯：
(a) the conduct constituting the alleged ancillary contravention occurs wholly in a foreign country, but not on board an Australian aircraft or an Australian ship; and
(a) 構成所指控的從屬違法行為完全發生在外國，而不是發生在澳洲飛機或澳洲船舶上；和
(b) the conduct (the primary conduct ) constituting the primary contravention to which the ancillary contravention relates occurs, or is intended by the person to occur, wholly in a foreign country, but not on board an Australian aircraft or an Australian ship; and
(b) 構成與從屬違法行為有關的主要違法行為的行為（主要行為）完全發生在外國，或該人意圖發生，但不是在澳大利亞飛機或澳大利亞船舶上發生；和
(c) the person is neither:
(c) 此人既不是：
(i) an Australian citizen; nor
(i) 澳洲公民；也不
(ii) a body corporate incorporated by or under a law of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory; and
(ii) 由澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律成立或依其法律成立的法人團體；和
(d) there is not in force in:
(d) 下列情況並未生效：
(i) the foreign country where the primary conduct occurs or is intended by the person to occur; or
(i) 主要行為發生地或該人意圖發生的外國；或
(ii) the part of the foreign country where the primary conduct occurs or is intended by the person to occur;
(ii) 主要行為發生地或該人意圖發生的外國地區；
a law of that foreign country, or a law of that part of that foreign country, that provides for a pecuniary or criminal penalty for the primary conduct.
該外國或該外國該地區的法律規定對主要行為進行罰款或刑事處罰。
(5) A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (3) or (4).
(5)被告就第(3)或(4)款的事項負舉證責任。
Attorney ‑ General’s consent needed for certain proceedings
某些程序需要總檢察長的同意
(6) Civil proceedings relating to a contravention of a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision must not be commenced without the Attorney ‑ General’s written consent if:
(6) 在下列情況下，未經總檢察長書面同意，不得啟動與違反本款民事處罰規定相關的民事訴訟：
(a) the conduct constituting the alleged contravention occurs wholly in a foreign country; and
(a) 構成所指控的違法行為的行為完全發生在外國；和
(b) at the time of the alleged contravention, the person alleged to have contravened the provision is neither:
(b) 在被指控的違反行為發生時，被指控違反該規定的人既不是：
(i) an Australian citizen; nor
(i) 澳洲公民；也不
(ii) a body corporate incorporated by or under a law of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory.
(ii) 由澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律成立或依其法律成立的法人團體。
When conduct taken to occur partly in Australia
當行為部分發生在澳洲時
(7) For the purposes of this section, if a person sends a thing, or causes a thing to be sent:
(7) 就本節而言，如果某人發送物品或導致物品被發送：
(a) from a point outside Australia to a point in Australia; or
(a) 從澳洲境外的一點到澳洲境內的一點；或者
(b) from a point in Australia to a point outside Australia;
(b) 從澳洲境內的一點到澳洲境外的一點；
that conduct is taken to have occurred partly in Australia.
該行為被認為部分發生在澳洲。
(8) For the purposes of this section, if a person sends, or causes to be sent, an electronic communication:
(8) 就本條而言，如果某人發送或促使發送電子通訊：
(a) from a point outside Australia to a point in Australia; or
(a) 從澳洲境外的一點到澳洲境內的一點；或者
(b) from a point in Australia to a point outside Australia;
(b) 從澳洲境內的一點到澳洲境外的一點；
that conduct is taken to have occurred partly in Australia.
該行為被認為部分發生在澳洲。
Definitions
定義
(9) In this section:
(9) 本節：
Australian aircraft has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
澳洲飛機與刑法中的意義相同。
Australian ship has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
澳洲船舶與刑法中的意義相同。
electronic communication has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
電子通訊與刑法中的意義相同。
foreign country has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
外國與刑法中的意義相同。
point has the same meaning as in section 16.2 of the Criminal Code .
該點與《刑法》第 16.2 條的涵義相同。
primary contravention means a contravention of a civil penalty provision in this Subdivision other than because of section 486ZD.
主要違規是指除第 486ZD 條以外的其他違反本款民事處罰規定的行為。
resident of Australia has the same meaning as in the Criminal Code .
澳洲居民的含義與刑法中的含義相同。

title: 245AN Charge and trial for an aggravated offence
zh: 245AN 嚴重犯罪的指控和審判
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12 — Offences etc. in relation to entry into, and remaining in, Australia
Subdivision C — Offences and civil penalties in relation to work by non ‑ citizens
text:
(1) If the prosecution intends to prove an offence against subsection 245AD(1) or (2), the charge must allege that the worker referred to in that subsection has been exploited.
(1) 如果檢方打算證明違反第 245AD(1) 或 (2) 款的罪行，則指控必須聲稱該款中提到的工人受到了剝削。
(2) If the prosecution intends to prove an offence against subsection 245AEB(1) or (2), the charge must allege that the prospective worker referred to in that subsection has been or will be exploited:
(2) 如果檢方打算證明違反第 245AEB(1) 或 (2) 款的罪行，則指控必須聲稱該款中提到的未來工人已經或將被剝削：
