Power to detain and move aircraft
扣押和移動飛機的權力
(8) An officer may detain the aircraft and bring it, or cause it to be brought, to a port, or to another place, that he or she considers appropriate if the officer reasonably suspects that the aircraft is or has been involved in a contravention, either in or outside Australia, of this Act.
(8) 如果官員有合理理由懷疑飛機正在或已經涉及澳大利亞境內或境外的違反本法的行為，則該官員可以扣留飛機並將其帶到或促使將其帶到他或她認為適當的港口或其他地方。
People on detained aircraft
被扣飛機上的人
(8A) If an officer detains an aircraft under this section, any restraint on the liberty of any person found on the aircraft that results from the detention of the aircraft is not unlawful, and proceedings, whether civil or criminal, in respect of that restraint may not be instituted or continued in any court against the Commonwealth, the officer or any person assisting the officer in detaining the aircraft.
(8A) 如果官員根據本條扣留飛機，則因扣留飛機而對飛機上任何人的自由進行的任何限制均不違法，並且不得在任何法院針對聯邦、官員或協助官員扣留飛機的任何人提起或繼續與該限制有關的訴訟，無論是民事還是刑事訴訟。
Jurisdiction of High Court
高等法院的管轄權
(8B) Nothing in subsection (8A) is intended to affect the jurisdiction of the High Court under section 75 of the Constitution.
(8B) 第 (8A) 款的任何內容均無意影響《憲法》第 75 條規定的高等法院的管轄權。
Powers of officers in respect of people found on detained aircraft
官員對於在被扣留飛機上發現的人員的權力
(9) If an officer detains an aircraft under this section, the officer may:
(9) 若官員依本條扣留飛機，該官員可以：
(a) detain any person found on the aircraft and bring the person, or cause the person to be brought, to the migration zone; or
(a) 拘留在航空器上發現的任何人員，並將該人或促使將該人帶到遷移區；或
(b) take the person, or cause the person to be taken, to a place outside Australia.
(b) 將該人帶到或促使該人被帶到澳洲境外的地方。
Powers to move people
感動人心的力量
(9A) For the purpose of moving a person under subsection (9), an officer may, within or outside Australia:
(9A) 為了根據第 (9) 款轉移人員，官員可以在澳洲境內或境外：
(a) place the person on a ship or aircraft; or
(a) 將人員安置在船舶或飛機上；或
(b) restrain the person on a ship or aircraft; or
(b) 將人員限制在船舶或飛機上；或
(c) remove the person from a ship or aircraft.
(c) 將人員從船舶或飛機上移走。
Protection if officers etc. act in good faith
官員等善意行事時的保護
(9B) Proceedings, whether civil or criminal, may not be instituted or continued, in respect of any action taken under subsection (9A), against the Commonwealth, an officer or any person assisting an officer if the officer or person who took the action acted in good faith and used no more force than was authorised by subsection (10).
(9B) 若採取行動的官員或人員善意行事且使用的武力不超過第 (10) 款授權的力度，則不得就根據第 (9A) 款採取的任何行動向聯邦、官員或任何協助官員的人提起或繼續訴訟，無論是民事還是刑事訴訟。
Use of necessary and reasonable force
使用必要且合理的武力
(10) An officer may use such force as is necessary and reasonable in the exercise of a power under this section.
(10) 官員在行使本條規定的權力時可以使用必要且合理的武力。
Limit on use of force to board and search aircraft
限制使用武力登機和搜查飛機
(11) In boarding and searching the aircraft and searching or examining goods found on the aircraft, an officer must not damage the aircraft or goods by forcing open a part of the aircraft or goods unless:
(11) 在登機和搜查飛機以及搜查或檢查飛機上發現的貨物時，官員不得強行打開飛機或貨物的一部分來損壞飛機或貨物，除非：
(a) the person (if any) apparently in charge of the aircraft has been given a reasonable opportunity to open that part or the goods; or
(a) 明顯負責飛機的人（如果有）已獲得合理的機會打開該部分或貨物；或
(b) it is not reasonably practicable to give that person such an opportunity.
(b) 給予該人這樣的機會是不合理可行的。
This subsection has effect despite paragraphs (3)(a) and (b) and subsection (10).
儘管有第(3)(a)和(b)款以及第(10)款的規定，本款仍然有效。
Limit on use of force to arrest or detain person on aircraft
限制在飛機上使用武力逮捕或拘留人員
(12) In arresting or detaining a person found on the aircraft, an officer:
(12) 在逮捕或拘留飛機上發現的人員時，官員：
(a) must not use more force, or subject the person to greater indignity, than is necessary and reasonable to make the arrest or detention, or to prevent the person escaping after the arrest or detention; and
(a) 不得使用超出逮捕或拘留或防止逮捕或拘留後逃跑所需和合理程度的更多武力或使該人遭受更大的侮辱；和
(b) must not do anything likely to cause the person grievous bodily harm unless the officer believes on reasonable grounds that doing the thing is necessary to protect life or prevent serious injury of another person (including the officer).
(b) 不得做任何可能導致人員嚴重身體傷害的事情，除非該官員有合理理由相信該行為對於保護他人生命或防止他人（包括該官員）遭受嚴重傷害是必要的。
This subsection has effect despite paragraph (3)(f) and subsection (10).
儘管有第(3)(f)款和第(10)款的規定，本款仍然有效。
Limit on use of force to arrest fleeing person
限制使用武力逮捕逃亡者
(13) In arresting a person found on the aircraft who is fleeing to escape arrest, an officer must not do anything likely to cause the person grievous bodily harm unless:
(13) 在逮捕在飛機上逃亡的人員時，官員不得採取任何可能對該人造成嚴重身體傷害的行為，除非：
(a) the person has, if practicable, been called on to surrender and the officer believes on reasonable grounds that the person cannot be apprehended in any other way; or
(a) 在可行的情況下，該人已被要求自首，且該官員有合理理由相信該人不能以任何其他方式被逮捕；或
(b) the officer believes on reasonable grounds that doing the thing is necessary to protect life or prevent serious injury of another person (including the officer).
(b) 警官有合理理由相信，這樣做對於保護他人生命或防止他人（包括警官）遭受嚴重傷害是必要的。
This subsection applies in addition to subsection (12) and has effect despite paragraph (3)(f) and subsection (10).
本款除了第(12)款之外也適用，並且儘管第(3)(f)款和第(10)款也具有效力。
Complying with requirement by officer
遵守官員的要求
(15) A person must not refuse or fail to comply with a requirement made by an officer under this section.
(15) 任何人不得拒絕或不遵守官員依本節提出的要求。
Penalty: 100 penalty units.
處罰：100 處罰單位。
(15A) Subsection (15) does not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(15A) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (15) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (15A) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告承擔與第 (15A) 款相關的舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3(3) 款）。
(15B) An offence against subsection (15) is an offence of strict liability.
(15B) 違反第 (15) 款的犯罪是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
Evidence may be used in prosecutions etc.
證據可用於起訴等。
(16) To avoid doubt, if, when exercising powers under this section, an officer obtains evidence of the commission of an offence against a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory, then that evidence may be used, or given to another body for use, in:
(16) 為避免疑義，如果官員在根據本條行使權力時獲得了違反聯邦、州或領地法律的犯罪證據，則該證據可用於或提供給其他機構用於：
(a) investigating the offence; or
(a) 調查犯罪行為；或
(b) proceedings for the prosecution for the offence.
(b) 對該罪行的起訴程序。
However, this subsection does not override or limit the operation of a law of a State about the evidence that may be used in proceedings for the prosecution for an offence against a law of that State.
然而，本款並未推翻或限制一國法律關於在起訴違反該國法律的犯罪的訴訟中可能使用的證據的法律的實施。
Section not to limit officer’s other powers
不限制官員其他權力的條款
(17) This section does not limit the use by an officer of any other powers under this Act.
(17) 本條不限制官員使用本法規定的任何其他權力。
Definition of officer
官員的定義
(18) In this section, officer means an officer within the meaning of section 5, and includes:
(18) 在本條中，官員是指第 5 條意義內的官員，包括：
(a) any person who is in command, or a member of the crew, of the aircraft from which the relevant request under section 245E was made; and
(a) 根據第 245E 條提出相關請求的飛機的任何機長或機組人員；和
(b) a member of the Australian Defence Force.
(b) 澳洲國防軍成員。
Interpretation
解讀
(19) In this section:
(19) 本節：
(a) a reference to a person found on the aircraft includes a reference to a person suspected on reasonable grounds by an officer of having landed from or left the aircraft; and
(a) 提及在航空器上發現的人員包括提及被官員基於合理理由懷疑從航空器著陸或離開航空器的人員；和
(b) a reference to goods found on the aircraft includes a reference to goods suspected on reasonable grounds by an officer of having been removed from the aircraft.
(b) 提及在飛機上發現的貨物包括提及官員有合理理由懷疑已從飛機上移走的貨物。

title: 245FA Searches of people on certain ships or aircraft
zh: 245FA 對某些船舶或飛機上人員的搜查
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
text:
(1) For the purposes set out in subsection (2), a person, and the person’s clothing and any property under the immediate control of the person, may, without warrant, be searched if the person:
(1) 為第 (2) 款規定的目的，如果該人符合以下條件，則可以在沒有搜索證的情況下對其進行搜查：
(a) is on an aircraft that has been detained under subsection 245F(8); or
(a) 位於依第 245F(8) 款被扣留的飛機上；或
(b) has been placed on a ship or aircraft under subsection 245F(9A).
(b) 已依第 245F(9A) 款放置在船舶或飛機上。
Note: Division 13 of Part 2 provides search powers in respect of persons who are in immigration detention.
註：第 2 部分第 13 條規定了對被移民拘留的人員進行搜索的權力。
(2) The purpose for which a person, and the person’s clothing and any property under the immediate control of the person, may be searched under this section is to find out whether the person is carrying, or there is hidden on the person, in the clothing or in the property, a weapon or other thing capable of being used to inflict bodily injury or to help the person to escape.
(2) 根據本條規定，搜索一個人及其直接控制下的衣服和任何財產的目的是查明該人是否攜帶或隱藏在該人的衣服或財產中，武器或其他能夠用於造成人身傷害或幫助該人逃跑的物品。
(3) If, in the course of a search under this section, a weapon or other thing referred to in subsection (2) is found, an officer:
(3) 如果在根據本條進行搜索的過程中發現了第 (2) 款中提到的武器或其他物品，則官員：
(a) may take possession of the weapon or other thing; and
(a) 可以佔有武器或其他物品；和
(b) may retain the weapon or other thing for such time as he or she thinks necessary for the purposes of this Act.
(b) 為本法的目的，可以在他或她認為必要的時間內保留武器或其他物品。
(4) This section does not authorise an officer, or another person conducting a search pursuant to subsection (5), to remove any of the person’s clothing, or to require a person to remove any of his or her clothing, except the person’s outer garments (including but not limited to the person’s overcoat, coat, jacket, gloves, shoes and head covering).
(4) 本節未授權官員或根據第 (5) 款進行搜查的其他人脫掉該人的任何衣服，或要求該人脫掉他或她的任何衣服，但該人的外衣（包括但不限於該人的大衣、外套、夾克、手套、鞋子和頭巾）除外。
(5) A search under this section of a person, and the person’s clothing, must be conducted by:
(5) 依本節規定對人員及其衣物進行搜索必須由下列人員進行：
(a) an officer of the same sex as the person; or
(a) 與該人性別相同的官員；或者
(b) in a case where an officer of the same sex as the person is not available to conduct the search—any other person who is of the same sex and:
(b) 若未與該人同性別的官員進行搜索－任何其他同性別的人，且：
(i) is requested by an officer; and
(i) 應官員要求；和
(ii) agrees;
(ii) 同意；
to conduct the search.
進行搜尋。
(6) An action or proceeding, whether civil or criminal, does not lie against a person who, at the request of an officer, conducts a search under this section if the person acts in good faith and does not contravene subsection (7).
(6) 如果一個人應官員的請求根據本條進行搜查，並且該人善意行事且不違反第 (7) 款，則該訴訟或程序，無論是民事還是刑事，均不針對該人。
(7) An officer or other person who conducts a search under this section must not use more force, or subject a person to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary in order to conduct the search.
(7) 依本條進行搜索的官員或其他人員不得使用比進行搜索合理必要的更多的武力或使他人受到更大的侮辱。
(8) In this section, officer has the same meaning as it has in section 245F.
(8) 在本條中，「官員」的意思與第 245F 條的涵義相同。

title: Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
zh: 第 12B 分部 — 航空器及船舶的乘客與機組、船員資料申報
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships

title: 245I Definitions
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
(1) In this Division:
(1) 本部門：
approved fall ‑ back reporting system means a system approved under section 245K.
核准的備用報告系統是指依第245K條核准的系統。
approved primary reporting system means a system approved under section 245J.
經批准的主要報告系統是指根據第 245J 節批准的系統。
approved primary reporting system for crew , for an aircraft or ship of a kind to which this Division applies, means the system approved under section 245J for reporting on crew on an aircraft or ship of that kind.
核准的機組人員主要報告系統，對於本節適用的飛機或船舶，是指根據第 245J 節批准的用於報告該類飛機或船舶上的機組人員的系統。
approved primary reporting system for passengers , for an aircraft or ship of a kind to which this Division applies, means the system approved under section 245J for reporting on passengers on an aircraft or ship of that kind.
核准的乘客主要報告系統，對於本節適用的飛機或船舶，是指根據第 245J 條批准的用於報告該類飛機或船舶上乘客的系統。
arrival means:
到達意味著：
(a) in relation to an aircraft—the aircraft coming to a stop after landing; or
(a) 就飛機而言－飛機降落後停止；或
(b) in relation to a ship—the securing of the ship for the loading or unloading of passengers, cargo or ship’s stores.
(b) 就船舶而言－為裝卸乘客、貨物或船舶物料而對船舶進行繫固。
kind of aircraft or ship to which this Division applies means a kind of aircraft or ship specified in the regulations as a kind of aircraft or ship to which this Division applies.
本節適用的航空器或船舶種類，是指規章中指定為本節適用的航空器或船舶種類的航空器或船舶。
Note: Kind has a meaning affected by subsection (2).
註：種類具有受第（2）款影響的涵義。
operator of an aircraft or ship for a particular flight or voyage means:
執行特定航班或航程的飛機或船舶的運營商是指：
(a) the airline or shipping line responsible for the operation of the aircraft or ship for the flight or voyage; or
(a) 負責營運該航班或航程的飛機或船舶的航空公司或航運公司；或
(b) if there is no such airline or shipping line, or no such airline or shipping line that is represented by a person in Australia—the pilot of the aircraft or the master of the ship.
(b) 如果沒有這樣的航空公司或航運公司，或沒有這樣的航空公司或航運公司由澳洲境內的人員代表－飛機的飛行員或船長。
(2) For the purposes of this Division (and of regulations and approvals made for the purposes of provisions of this Division), a kind of aircraft or ship may be identified by reference to matters including all or any of the following:
(2) 就本節（以及為本節規定而製定的法規和批准）而言，可以參考包括以下全部或任何內容在內的事項來識別飛機或船舶的種類：
(a) the type, size or capacity of the aircraft or ship;
(a) 飛機或船舶的種類、尺寸或容量；
(b) the kind of operation or service the aircraft or ship is engaged in on the flight or voyage to or from Australia;
(b) 飛機或船舶在往返澳洲的航班或航程所從事的營運或服務類型；
(c) other circumstances related to the aircraft or ship or its use, or related to the operator of the aircraft or ship.
(c) 與飛機或船舶或其使用有關，或與飛機或船舶的操作人有關的其他情況。

title: 245J Approval of primary reporting systems
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
(1) The Secretary must, for each kind of aircraft or ship to which this Division applies, by legislative instrument, approve a system for the purposes of reporting under this Division. The system may be an electronic system or a system requiring reports to be provided in documentary form.
(1) 對於本節適用的每種飛機或船舶，部長必須透過立法文書批准一個用於根據本節進行報告的系統。該系統可以是電子系統或要求以文件形式提供報告的系統。
Note 1: An approval under this subsection can be varied or revoked under subsection 33(3) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
註 1：根據 1901 年《法案解釋法》第 33(3) 款，可以更改或撤銷本款下的批准。
Note 2: It is anticipated that, ultimately, documentary systems will be phased out and all approved systems will be electronic systems.
註2：預計文件系統最終將被淘汰，所有核准的系統都將是電子系統。
(2) Under subsection (1), the Secretary may, for a kind of aircraft or ship, approve a single system for reporting on both passengers and crew or may approve one system for reporting on passengers, and another system for reporting on crew.
(2) 根據第 (1) 款，部長可以針對某種飛機或船舶批准一種報告乘客和機組人員的單一系統，或者可以批准一種報告乘客的系統和另一種報告機組人員的系統。
(2A) The information about passengers or crew that is to be reported by a system must be about:
(2A) 系統要報告的有關乘客或機組人員的資訊必須是：
(a) if the system is for reporting on passengers—passengers individually; or
(a) 若係統用於通報旅客－個別旅客；或
(b) if the system is for reporting on crew—members of the crew individually; or
(b) 若該系統用於報告機組人員－機組人員的個人情況；或
(c) if the system is for reporting on both passengers and crew—passengers individually and members of the crew individually.
(c) 如果系統用於報告乘客和機組人員－乘客個人和機組人員個人。
(3) The instrument of approval of a system for reporting on passengers or crew must also specify the information (including personal identifiers) about passengers or crew that is to be reported by that system.
(3) 旅客或機組人員報告系統的批准書也必須明確該系統報告的旅客或機組人員的資訊（包括個人識別資訊）。

title: 245K Approval of fall ‑ back reporting systems
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
(1) The Secretary must, by legislative instrument, approve one or more systems as fall ‑ back reporting systems. A system may be an electronic system or a system requiring reports to be provided in documentary form.
(1) 部長必須透過立法文書批准一個或多個系統作為後備報告系統。系統可以是電子系統或要求以文件形式提供報告的系統。
Note: An approval under this subsection can be varied or revoked under subsection 33(3) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
注意：根據《1901 年法案解釋法》第 33(3) 款，可以更改或撤銷本款下的批准。
(1A) The information about passengers or crew that is to be reported by a system must be about:
(1A) 系統要報告的有關乘客或機組人員的資訊必須是：
(a) if the system is for reporting on passengers—passengers individually; or
(a) 若係統用於通報旅客－個別旅客；或
(b) if the system is for reporting on crew—members of the crew individually; or
(b) 若該系統用於報告機組人員－機組人員的個人情況；或
(c) if the system is for reporting on both passengers and crew—passengers individually and members of the crew individually.
(c) 如果系統用於報告乘客和機組人員－乘客個人和機組人員個人。
(2) The instrument of approval of a system must also specify the information (including personal identifiers) about passengers or crew that is to be reported by that system.
(2) 系統的核准文件也必須規定該系統要報告的乘客或機組人員的資訊（包括個人識別碼）。

title: 245L Obligation to report on persons arriving in Australia
zh: 245L 報告抵達澳洲人員的義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
Aircraft and ships to which section applies
本節適用的飛機和船舶
(1) This section applies to an aircraft or ship of a kind to which this Division applies that is due to arrive at a place in Australia from a place outside Australia.
(1) 本節適用於本節適用的、將從澳洲境外地點抵達澳洲境內的飛機或船舶。
Obligation to report on passengers and crew
報告乘客和機組人員的義務
(2) The operator of the aircraft or ship must, in accordance with this section:
(2) 飛機或船舶的運作人必須依本節：
(a) report to the Department, using the approved primary reporting system for passengers, on each passenger who will be on board the aircraft or ship at the time of its arrival at the place in Australia; and
(a) 使用經批准的乘客主要報告系統向該部門報告在飛機或船舶抵達澳大利亞地點時將登上飛機或船舶的每位乘客的情況；和
(b) report to the Department, using the approved primary reporting system for crew, on each member of the crew who will be on board the aircraft or ship at the time of its arrival at the place in Australia.
(b) 使用經批准的機組人員主要報告系統，向該部門報告飛機或船舶抵達澳洲地點時將在其上的每位機組人員的情況。
Note 1: This obligation must be complied with even if the information concerned is personal information.
註1：即使相關資訊是個人訊息，也必須遵守該義務。
Note 2: Section 245N contains an offence for failure to comply with this subsection.
註 2：第 245N 條包含不遵守本款規定的犯罪行為。
Information to be reported
需報告的信息
(3) A report on passengers or crew under subsection (2) must include the information relating to those passengers or crew that is specified, as mentioned in subsection 245J(3), in relation to the relevant approved primary reporting system.
(3) 第 (2) 款規定的關於乘客或機組人員的報告必須包括第 245J(3) 款中提到的與經批准的相關主要報告系統相關的乘客或機組人員的相關資訊。
Deadline for reporting—aircraft
報告截止日期—飛機
(4) A report on passengers or crew on an aircraft must be given not later than:
(4) 有關飛機上乘客或機組人員的報告必須不遲於：
(a) if the flight from the last place outside Australia is likely to take not less than 3 hours—3 hours before the aircraft’s likely time of arrival at the place in Australia; or
(a) 如果從澳洲境外最後一個地點出發的航班可能需要不少於 3 小時－飛機可能抵達澳洲境內地點前 3 小時；或
(b) if the flight from the last place outside Australia is likely to take less than 3 hours—one hour before the aircraft’s likely time of arrival at the place in Australia.
(b) 如果從澳洲境外最後一個地點起飛的航班可能需要不到 3 小時－飛機可能抵達澳洲境內地點的時間前一小時。
Deadline for reporting—ships
報告截止日期—船舶
(5) A report on passengers or crew on a ship must be given not later than:
(5) 船上乘客或船員的報告必須不遲於：
(a) the start of the prescribed period before the ship’s estimated time of arrival at the place in Australia; or
(a) 船舶預計抵達澳洲地點之前規定期限的開始時間；或
(b) if the journey is of a kind described in regulations made for the purposes of this paragraph—the start of the shorter period specified in those regulations before the ship’s estimated time of arrival at the place in Australia.
(b) 如果旅程屬於為本段目的而製定的法規中所描述的類型－這些法規中規定的在船舶預計抵達澳洲地點之前的較短時期的開始時間。
(5A) Regulations made for the purposes of paragraph (5)(b) may prescribe matters of a transitional nature (including prescribing any saving or application provisions) arising out of the making of regulations for those purposes.
(5A) 為第 (5)(b) 款目的而製定的法規可以規定因為此目的製定法規而產生的過渡性事項（包括規定任何保存或應用規定）。

title: 245LA Obligation to report on persons departing from Australia
zh: 245LA 報告離開澳洲的人員的義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
Aircraft and ships to which section applies
本節適用的飛機和船舶
(1) This section applies to an aircraft or ship of a kind to which this Division applies that is due to depart from a place in Australia on a flight or voyage to a place outside Australia (whether or not after calling at other places in Australia).
(1) 本節適用於本節所適用的飛機或船舶，該飛機或船舶將在飛行或航程中從澳洲某個地點出發前往澳洲境外的地點（無論是否在停靠澳洲其他地點之後）。
Obligation to report on passengers and crew
報告乘客和機組人員的義務
(2) The operator of the aircraft or ship must, in accordance with this section:
(2) 飛機或船舶的運作人必須依本節：
(a) report to the Department, using the approved primary reporting system for passengers, on each passenger who is on, or is expected to be on, the flight or voyage (including any part of the flight or voyage); and
(a) 使用經批准的乘客主要報告系統，向部門報告正在或預計將在航班或航程（包括航班或航程的任何部分）上的每位乘客；和
(b) report to the Department, using the approved primary reporting system for crew, on each member of the crew who is on, or is expected to be on, the flight or voyage (including any part of the flight or voyage).
(b) 使用經批准的機組人員主要報告系統，向部門報告正在或預計將在航班或航程（包括航班或航程的任何部分）上的每位機組人員的情況。
Note 1: This obligation must be complied with even if the information concerned is personal information.
註1：即使相關資訊是個人訊息，也必須遵守該義務。
Note 2: Section 245N contains an offence for failure to comply with this subsection.
註 2：第 245N 條包含不遵守本款規定的犯罪行為。
(3) However, if:
(3) 但是，如果：
(a) on the flight or voyage, the aircraft or ship calls at one or more places in Australia before departing to the place outside Australia; and
(a) 在航班或航程中，飛機或船舶在出發前往澳洲境外之前經停澳洲境內的一個或多個地點；和
(b) the regulations prescribe that a report under subsection (2) must only relate to the part of the flight or voyage that is from the last place in Australia to the place outside Australia;
(b) 條例規定，第 (2) 款規定的報告必須僅涉及從澳洲最後地點到澳洲境外地點的航班或航程部分；
then the report must be on each passenger or crew member who is on, or is expected to be on, that part of the flight or voyage.
那麼該報告必須針對在該部分航班或航程中或預計將在該部分航班或航程中的每位乘客或機組人員。
Information to be reported
需報告的信息
(4) A report on a passenger or crew member under subsection (2) must include the information relating to the passenger or crew member that is specified, as mentioned in subsection 245J(3), in relation to the relevant approved primary reporting system.
(4) 根據第 (2) 款提出的關於乘客或機組人員的報告必須包括第 245J(3) 款中提到的、與相關批准的主要報告系統相關的、與乘客或機組人員有關的資訊。
Deadline for providing a report
提供報告的截止日期
(5) A report on a passenger or crew member under subsection (2) must be provided:
(5) 必須依第 (2) 款提供有關乘客或機組人員的報告：
(a) if the regulations prescribe a period or periods before the aircraft’s or ship’s departure from a place for the giving of a report under subsection (2) in relation to the passenger or crew member—not later than the start of that period or each of those periods; and
(a) 若法規規定在飛機或船舶離開某個地點之前的一個或多個時期根據第 (2) 款提供與乘客或機組人員有關的報告，則不得遲於該時期或每個時期的開始；和
(b) if the regulations prescribe an event or events for the giving of a report under subsection (2) in relation to the passenger or crew member—at the time of that event or each of those events; and
(b) 若法規規定需要根據第 (2) 款就乘客或機組人員提供報告，則在該事件或每一個事件發生時；和
(c) if the regulations prescribe a time or times for the giving of a report under subsection (2) in relation to the passenger or crew member—at that time or each of those times.
(c) 如果法規規定了根據第 (2) 款就乘客或機組人員提交報告的一個或多個時間－在該時間或每個時間。
(6) To avoid doubt, more than one report may be required to be provided under subsection (2) in relation to a passenger or crew member.
(6) 為避免疑問，可能需要根據第 (2) 款就乘客或機組人員提供多於一份報告。
Note: For example, if regulations made for the purposes of subsection (5) prescribe a period of 48 hours before the aircraft’s or ship’s departure from a place on the flight or voyage and also prescribe an event of the passenger or crew member checking ‑ in for the flight or voyage, then 2 reports would be required to be provided under this section in relation to the passenger or crew member.
註：例如，如果為第(5)款的目的而製定的規定規定了飛機或船舶從航班或航程中的某個地點出發前48小時的期限，並且還規定了乘客或機組人員辦理航班或航程登記的事件，則需要根據本條提供與乘客或機組人員有關的2份報告。

title: 245LB Dealing with information collected under this Division etc.
zh: 245LB 處理本部所收集的資訊等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
Collection of personal information
個人資訊的收集
(1) The Department may collect information (including personal identifiers) in a report provided under this Division.
(1) 該部門可以在根據本節提供的報告中收集資訊（包括個人識別碼）。
Access to, and disclosure of, personal information
存取和披露個人信息
(2) The following provisions:
（二）下列規定：
(a) section 336D (which authorises access to identifying information);
(a) 第 336D 條（授權存取識別資訊）；
(b) section 336E (other than subsection 336E(1)) and section 336F (which authorise disclosure of identifying information);
(b) 第 336E 條（第 336E(1) 條除外）及第 336F 條（授權揭露識別資訊）；
(c) a provision of an instrument made under section 336D or 336F;
(c) 依據第 336D 或 336F 條所訂定的文書的規定；
apply to personal information (other than personal identifiers) collected under this Division in the same way as they apply to identifying information.
適用於依本節收集的個人資訊（個人識別碼除外），其方式與適用於識別資訊相同。
Effect on interpretation
對解釋的影響
(4) This section does not, by implication, affect the interpretation of any other provision of this Act or an instrument made under this Act.
(4) 本節並不暗示影響本法任何其他條款或依本法制定的文書的解釋。

title: 245M Approved fall ‑ back reporting systems may be used in certain circumstances
zh: 245M 核准的後備報告系統可在某些情況下使用
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
(1) This section applies if:
(1) 本節適用於：
(a) the approved primary reporting system for reporting on passengers or crew on an aircraft or ship is an electronic system; and
(a) 批准的用於報告飛機或船舶上乘客或機組人員的主要報告系統是電子系統；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the operator of the aircraft or ship cannot report on some or all of the passengers or crew (the relevant passengers or crew ) using the approved primary reporting system because the system is not working; or
(i) 飛機或船舶的操作人無法使用經批准的主要報告系統報告部分或全部乘客或機組人員（相關乘客或機組人員），因為該系統無法正常運作；或
(ii) the Secretary permits the operator of the aircraft or ship to report on some or all of the passengers or crew (the relevant passengers or crew ) using an approved fall ‑ back reporting system.
(ii) 部長允許飛機或船舶的運營商使用經批准的後備報告系統報告部分或全部乘客或機組人員（相關乘客或機組人員）。
(2) Sections 245L and 245LA apply in relation to the relevant passengers or crew as if:
(2) 第 245L 及 245LA 條適用於相關乘客或機組人員，如同：
(a) the reference in subsections 245L(2) and 245LA(2) to the approved primary reporting system for passengers, or the approved primary reporting system for crew, were instead a reference to an approved fall ‑ back reporting system; and
(a) 第245L(2)和245LA(2)款中提及經批准的乘客主要報告系統或經批准的機組人員主要報告系統，而是指經批准的後備報告系統；和
(b) the reference in subsections 245L(3) and 245LA(4) to the information that is specified, as mentioned in subsection 245J(3), in relation to the relevant approved primary reporting system were instead a reference to the information that is specified, as mentioned in subsection 245K(2), in relation to the approved fall ‑ back reporting system that the operator uses in relation to the relevant passengers or crew.
(b) 第 245L(3) 和 245LA(4) 款所提及的與經批准的相關主要報告系統有關的第 245J(3) 款所規定的信息，是指與第 245K(2) 款所提及的與運營人對相關乘客或機組人員使用的經批准後備報告系統有關的所規定的信息。

title: 245N Offence for failure to comply with reporting obligations
zh: 245N 未遵守報告義務的罪行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 12B — Reporting on passengers and crew of aircraft and ships
text:
(1) An operator of an aircraft or ship who intentionally contravenes subsection 245L(2) or 245LA(2) commits an offence punishable, on conviction, by a penalty not exceeding 120 penalty units.
(1) 飛機或船舶的經營者故意違反第 245L(2) 或 245LA(2) 款的行為，一經定罪，可處以不超過 120 個處罰單位的處罰。
(2) An operator of an aircraft or ship who contravenes subsection 245L(2) or 245LA(2) commits an offence punishable, on conviction, by a penalty not exceeding 60 penalty units.
(2) 飛機或船舶的經營者違反第 245L(2) 或 245LA(2) 款的規定，一經定罪，可處以不超過 60 個處罰單位的處罰。
Note: See also paragraph 504(1)(jaa) (which deals with the payment of a penalty as an alternative to prosecution).
註：另請參閱第 504(1)(jaa) 段（該段涉及支付罰款作為起訴的替代方法）。
(3) An offence against subsection (2) is an offence of strict liability.
(3) 違反第 (2) 款的犯罪行為是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
(4) An operator of an aircraft or ship commits a separate offence under subsection (1) or (2) in relation to each passenger or member of the crew in relation to whom the operator contravenes subsection 245L(2) or 245LA(2).
(4) 飛機或船舶的操作人對其違反第 245L(2) 或 245LA(2) 款的每位乘客或機組人員犯有第 (1) 或 (2) 款規定的單獨罪行。

title: Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
zh: 第 13 分部 — 檢查、搜查、拘留及身分識別
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification

title: 246 Appointment of boarding stations
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The Governor ‑ General may, by Proclamation, appoint a place in a port to be the boarding station for that port for the purposes of this Act.
(1) 為本法的目的，總督可以透過公告指定港口的一個地點作為該港口的登船站。
(2) Where a boarding station for a port is for the time being appointed or continued under the Customs Act 1901 ‑ 1957 , that boarding station shall be deemed to be appointed under this section as the boarding station for that port for the purposes of this Act.
(2) 如果某個港口的登船站目前根據《1901 - 1957 年海關法》指定或繼續存在，則就本法而言，該登船站應被視為根據本條被指定為該港口的登船站。

title: 247 Vessels to enter ports and be brought to boarding stations
zh: 247艘船舶進入港口並被帶到登船站
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The master of a vessel which has entered Australia from overseas shall not suffer the vessel to enter any place other than a port.
(1) 從海外進入澳洲的船舶的船長不得允許船舶進入港口以外的任何地方。
Penalty: 200 penalty units.
處罰：200 處罰單位。
(2) The master of a vessel (other than an aircraft) from overseas bound to or calling at a port:
（二）從境外前往或停靠港口的船舶（航空器除外）的船長：
(a) shall, if so required by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner, bring the vessel (other than an aircraft) to for boarding under this Act at the boarding station appointed for that port; and
(a) 若部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員要求，應將船隻（飛機除外）帶到為該港口指定的登船站，以便根據本法登船；和
(b) shall not move the vessel (other than an aircraft) from that boarding station until permitted to do so by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner.
(b) 在取得部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員允許之前，不得將船隻（飛機除外）移離該登船站。
Penalty: 200 penalty units.
處罰：200 處罰單位。
(2A) Subsection (2) does not apply if the master moves the vessel from the boarding station with the intention of leaving the port.
(2A) 若船長將船舶從登船站移離港口，則第 (2) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2A) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告承擔與第 (2A) 款相關的舉證責任（參見《刑法》第 13.3(3) 款）。
(3) The master of an aircraft from overseas arriving in Australia shall not suffer the aircraft to land at any other proclaimed airport until the aircraft has first landed:
(3) 從海外抵達澳洲的飛機的機長在飛機首次降落前不得允許飛機降落在任何其他宣布的機場：
(a) at such proclaimed airport for which a boarding station is appointed as is nearest to the place at which the aircraft entered Australia; or
(a) 在指定的離飛機進入澳洲地點最近的指定機場；或
(b) at such other airport for which a boarding station is appointed as has been approved by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner, in writing, as an airport at which that aircraft, or a class of aircraft in which that aircraft is included, may land on arriving in Australia from overseas.
(b) 經部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員書面批准指定登機站的其他機場，作為該飛機或該飛機所屬的一類飛機從海外抵達澳洲時可以降落的機場。
Penalty: 200 penalty units.
處罰：200 處罰單位。
(4) The master of an aircraft which is engaged on an air service or flight from a place overseas to a place in Australia:
(4) 從事從海外某處飛往澳洲某處的航空服務或航班的飛機的機長：
(a) shall not suffer the aircraft to land at a proclaimed airport for which a boarding station is not appointed;
(a) 不得讓航空器降落在未指定登機站的已宣布的機場；
(b) shall, as soon as practicable after the aircraft lands at a proclaimed airport, bring the aircraft for boarding to the boarding station appointed for that airport; and
(b) 航空器降落在指定機場後，應盡快將航空器帶到為該機場指定的登機站登機；和
(c) shall not move the aircraft from that boarding station until permitted to do so by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner.
(c) 在部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員允許之前，不得將飛機從登機站移走。
Penalty: 200 penalty units.
處罰：200 處罰單位。
(5) It is a defence to a prosecution for an offence against subsection (1), (3) or (4) if the person charged proves that he or she was prevented from complying with the subsection by stress of weather or other reasonable cause.
(5) 若被指控的人證明他或她因天氣壓力或其他合理原因而無法遵守第 (1)、(3) 或 (4) 款的罪行，則可作為對起訴的抗辯。
Note: A defendant bears a legal burden in relation to the matters in subsection (5) (see section 13.4 of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（5）款事項承擔法律責任（見刑法第13.4條）。
(5A) An offence against any of subsections (1) to (4) is an offence of strict liability.
(5A) 違反第 (1) 至 (4) 款任何一項的犯罪行為屬於嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
(6) While a vessel is at a boarding station, an officer may go and remain on board the vessel for the purposes of this Act.
(6) 當船舶停泊在登船站時，出於本法的目的，官員可以前往並留在船上。
(7) The master of a vessel shall do all things reasonably required by an officer to facilitate the boarding of the vessel under this section and the performance by the officer of duties for the purposes of this Act.
(7) 船長應採取高級船員合理要求的一切措施，以便利高級船員根據本條登船以及高級船員履行本法規定的職責。
Penalty for any contravention of this subsection: 100 penalty units.
對任何違反本款規定的處罰：100 個處罰單位。
(8) An offence against subsection (7) is an offence of strict liability.
(8) 違反第 (7) 款的犯罪行為屬於嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。

title: 248 Exemption
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Where the Minister is satisfied that it is no longer necessary for the purposes of this Act that a provision of section 247 should continue to apply in relation to a vessel, the Minister shall, by writing under his or her hand, exempt the master of that vessel from liability to comply with that provision.
如果部長認為就本法而言不再需要第 247 條的規定繼續適用於船舶，則部長應以親筆書面形式免除該船舶船長遵守該規定的責任。

title: 249 Certain persons may be prevented from entering or landing
zh: 249 某些人可能被阻止進入或著陸
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) An officer may:
(1) 官員可以：
(a) prevent a person whom the officer reasonably suspects to be an unlawful non ‑ citizen from leaving a vessel on which the person arrived in Australia; or
(a) 阻止官員合理懷疑為非法非公民的人離開其抵達澳洲的船隻；或
(b) prevent a removee or deportee from leaving a vessel on which he or she has been placed;
(b) 阻止被遣送者或被驅逐者離開其被安置的船隻；
and may take such action and use such force as are necessary for that purpose.
並可為此目的採取必要的行動和使用武力。
(1AA) An officer may prevent a person from leaving a vessel on which the person arrived in Australia if the officer reasonably suspects that the person:
(1AA) 如果官員有合理理由懷疑某人：
(a) is seeking to enter the migration zone; and
(a) 正在尋求進入遷移區；和
(b) would, if in the migration zone, be an unlawful non ‑ citizen.
(b) 若在移民區內，將成為非法非公民。
(1A) To avoid doubt, and without limiting the generality of subsections (1) and (1AA), if a person of a kind referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or subsection (1AA) is on board a vessel (other than an aircraft), the actions that may be taken by an officer under subsections (1) and (1AA) include:
(1A) 為避免疑問，且在不限制第 (1) 和 (1AA) 款一般性的情況下，如果第 (1)(a) 款或第 (1AA) 款所述人員在船舶（飛機除外）上，則官員根據第 (1) 和 (1AA) 款可採取的行動包括：
(a) requiring the vessel to travel to a port; and
(a) 要求船舶前往港口；和
(b) requiring the person to remain on the vessel until it arrives at the port.
(b) 要求該人留在船上直至船舶到達港口。
(2) The master of a vessel may, in relation to persons on board the vessel, do all things which an officer is, under subsections (1) and (1AA), authorised to do.
(2) 船長可以就船上的人員執行第 (1) 和 (1AA) 款規定的高級官員授權執行的所有事項。

title: 250 Detention of suspected offenders
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) In this section:
(1) 本節：
suspect means a non ‑ citizen who:
嫌疑人是指以下非公民：
(a) travelled, or was brought, to the migration zone; and
(a) 前往或被帶到遷移區；和
(b) is believed by an authorised officer on reasonable grounds to have been on board a vessel (not being an aircraft) when it was used in connection with the commission of an offence against a law in force in the whole or any part of Australia.
(b) 授權官員有合理理由相信，當船舶（不是飛機）用於實施違反澳洲全境或任何部分現行法律的犯罪行為時，該船舶已在該船舶上（不是飛機）。
(2) For the purposes of section 189, an officer has a suspicion described in that section about a person if, but not only if, the person is a suspect.
(2) 就第 189 條而言，如果（但不限於）某人是嫌疑人，則警官對該人有該條所述的懷疑。
(3) A non ‑ citizen detained because of subsection (2) may be kept in immigration detention for:
(3) 因第(2)款而被拘留的非公民可因下列原因被拘留在移民拘留所：
(a) such period as is required for:
(a) 下列事項所需的期限：
(i) the making of a decision whether to prosecute the suspect in connection with the offence concerned; or
(i) 決定是否起訴有關犯罪的嫌疑人；或
(ii) instituting such a prosecution; and
(ii) 提起此類起訴；和
(b) if such a prosecution is instituted within that period—such further period as is required for the purposes of the prosecution.
(b) 如果在該期限內提起此類起訴－為起訴目的所需的更長期限。
(4) Without limiting the generality of paragraph (3)(b), the period that is required for the purposes of a prosecution includes any period required for:
(4) 在不限制第 (3)(b) 款的一般性的情況下，起訴所需的期限包括以下情況所需的任何期限：
(a) any proceedings in connection with the prosecution; and
(a) 與起訴有關的任何程序；和
(b) the serving of any custodial sentence imposed because of the prosecution; and
(b) 因起訴而被判處的任何監禁刑期的服刑；和
(c) the institution of, and any proceedings in connection with, any appeal from any decision in relation to the prosecution.
(c) 針對與檢方有關的任何決定提出上訴以及與之相關的任何程序。
(5) If the period for which a person may be kept in immigration detention under subsection (3) ends, he or she:
(5) 若一個人依第 (3) 款可被移民拘留的期限結束，他或她：
(a) must, unless he or she has become the holder of a visa, that is in effect, to remain in Australia, be expeditiously removed from Australia under section 198; and
(a) 除非他或她已成為留在澳洲的有效簽證持有者，否則必須根據第 198 條迅速將其驅逐出澳洲；和
(b) may, at the direction of an authorised officer, continue to be detained under section 189 until so removed.
(b) 可根據授權官員的指示，根據第 189 條繼續被拘留，直至被驅逐。

title: 251 Powers of entry and search
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) An officer may at any time board and search a vessel if the officer reasonably suspects there is on board the vessel:
(1) 若官員合理懷疑船上有下列人員，則官員可以隨時登船並搜索船隻：
(a) an unlawful non ‑ citizen; or
(a) 非法非公民；或
(b) a person seeking to enter the migration zone who would, if in the migration zone, be an unlawful non ‑ citizen.
(b) 尋求進入移民區的人，如果進入移民區，他將成為非法非公民。
(2) The master of a vessel shall do all things reasonably required by an officer to facilitate the boarding and searching of the vessel by the officer under subsection (1).
(2) 船長應採取官員合理要求的一切措施，以方便官員根據第 (1) 款登船和搜查船隻。
Penalty: 100 penalty units.
處罰：100 處罰單位。
(2A) An offence against subsection (2) is an offence of strict liability.
(2A) 違反第 (2) 款的犯罪是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
(3) A reference in subsection (1) or (2) to a vessel includes a reference to an Australian resources installation and to an Australian sea installation.
(3) 第 (1) 或 (2) 款所提及的船舶包括澳洲資源設施和澳洲海洋設施。
(4) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may issue to an officer a search warrant in accordance with the prescribed form.
(4) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以依照規定的表格向官員發出搜查令。
(5) A search warrant shall be expressed to remain in force for a specified period not exceeding 3 months and ceases to be in force at the expiration of the specified period.
（五）搜索令應明示在不超過三個月的指定期限內有效，並在指定期限屆滿時失效。
(6) An officer having with him or her a search warrant issued to him or her under this section and remaining in force may, at any time in the day or night with such assistance as the officer thinks necessary, enter and search any building, premises, vessel, vehicle or place in which the officer has reasonable cause to believe there may be found:
(6) 持有根據本條向他或她發出的且仍然有效的搜查令的官員，可以在白天或晚上的任何時間，在該官員認為必要的協助下，進入並搜查該官員有合理理由相信可能發現以下內容的任何建築物、處所、船隻、車輛或場所：
(a) an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee;
(a) 非法非公民、被驅逐者或被驅逐者；
(b) a person to whom a temporary visa has been issued subject to a condition with respect to the work that is to be performed by that person;
(b) 已取得臨時簽證但須遵守與該人將要從事的工作有關的條件的人；
(c) any document, book or paper relating to the entry or proposed entry into Australia of a person in circumstances in which that person:
(c) 與某人入境或擬入境澳洲有關的任何文件、書籍或文件，且該人：
(i) would have become a prohibited immigrant within the meaning of this Act as in force from time to time before the commencement of the Migration Amendment Act 1983 ; or
(i) 將成為 1983 年《移民修正案》生效之前不時生效的本法含義內的禁止移民；或者
(ii) would have become a prohibited non ‑ citizen within the meaning of this Act as in force from time to time after the commencement of the Migration Amendment Act 1983 but before the commencement of section 4 of the Migration Legislation Amendment Act 1989 ; or
(ii) 在《1983年移民修正法》生效之後、《1989年移民立法修正法》第4條生效之前，將成為本法所指的禁止非公民；或
(iii) would have been an illegal entrant within the meaning of the Act as in force from time to time after the commencement of section 4 of the Migration Legislation Amendment Act 1989 but before 1 September 1994; or
(iii) 在 1989 年《移民立法修正案》第 4 條生效後但在 1994 年 9 月 1 日之前，屬於該法所指的非法入境者；或
(iv) would have become, or would become, an unlawful non ‑ citizen; or
(iv) 本來會成為或將成為非法非公民；或
(d) any passport or document of identity of, or any ticket for the conveyance from a place within Australia to a place outside Australia of an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee;
(d) 任何非法非公民、被遣返者或被驅逐者的護照或身分文件，或從澳洲境內某地前往澳洲境外某處的任何機票；
and may seize any such document, book, paper, passport, document of identity or ticket, as the case may be, and impound and detain it for such time as the officer thinks necessary.
並可扣押任何此類文件、書籍、紙張、護照、身分證明文件或機票（視情況而定），並扣押和扣押該等文件，期限為該官員認為必要的時間。
(7) For the purposes of the exercise of his or her powers under this section an officer may stop any vessel or vehicle.
(7) 為了行使其本條所規定的權力，官員可以攔截任何船隻或車輛。
(8) An officer may use such reasonable force as is necessary for the exercise of his or her powers under this section.
(8) 官員可以使用必要的合理武力來行使其本條規定的權力。

title: 251A Searches of detainees etc.—prohibited things
zh: 251A 搜索被拘留者等－禁止的事情
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) A thing is a prohibited thing in relation to a person in detention (whether or not the person is detained in an immigration detention facility), or in relation to an immigration detention facility, if:
(1) 與被拘留者（無論該人是否被拘留在移民拘留設施中）相關或與移民拘留設施相關的物品屬於禁止物品，如果：
(a) both:
(a) 兩者：
(i) possession of the thing is unlawful because of a law of the Commonwealth, or a law of the State or Territory in which the person is detained or in which the facility is located; and
(i) 根據澳洲聯邦法律或該人被拘留或設施所在的州或地區的法律，佔有該物品是非法的；和
(ii) the thing is determined under paragraph (2)(a); or
(ii) 該事項是根據第 (2)(a) 款確定的；或
(b) the thing is determined under paragraph (2)(b).
(b) 該事項依第(2)(b)款決定。
Example 1: A thing may be a prohibited thing in relation to an immigration detention facility for the purposes of a search of such a facility under section 252BA and the seizure of prohibited things in the course of such a search under section 252C or 252CA.
範例 1：出於根據第 252BA 條搜查移民拘留設施的目的以及根據第 252C 或 252CA 條在搜查過程中扣押違禁物品的目的，某物可能是與移民拘留設施相關的違禁物品。
Example 2: A mobile phone may, if determined under paragraph (2)(b), be a prohibited thing in relation to a person in detention even if the person is not detained in an immigration detention facility.
範例 2：如果根據第 (2)(b) 款確定，對於被拘留者來說，行動電話可能屬於違禁物品，即使該人沒有被拘留在移民拘留設施中。
(2) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine a thing for the purposes of subsection (1) if the Minister is satisfied that:
(2) 若部長信納：
(a) possession of the thing is prohibited by law in a place or places in Australia; or
(a) 在澳洲的一個或多個地方，法律禁止擁有該物品；或
(b) possession or use of the thing in an immigration detention facility might be a risk (an immigration detention facility risk ) to the health, safety or security of persons in the facility, or to the order of the facility .
(b) 在移民拘留設施中擁有或使用該物品可能會對設施內人員的健康、安全或保障或設施的秩序構成風險（移民拘留設施風險）。
Examples: The following things may be determined to be prohibited things if the Minister is satisfied that they pose a risk mentioned in paragraph (b):
例：如果部長信納以下物品構成（b）段中提到的風險，則可以將其確定為禁止物品：
(a) mobile phones;
(a) 行動電話；
(b) SIM cards;
(b) SIM 卡；
(c) computers and other electronic devices designed to be capable of being connected to the internet.
(c) 設計為能夠連接到網際網路的電腦和其他電子設備。
(3) However, if a medication or health care supplement is determined under paragraph (2)(b), the medication or supplement is not a prohibited thing in relation to a particular person detained in an immigration detention facility if the medication or supplement has been prescribed or supplied for the person’s individual use by a health service provider authorised for the purpose by the person in charge of the facility.
(3) 但是，如果根據第 (2)(b) 款確定了藥物或保健補充劑，則該藥物或補充劑對於被拘留在移民拘留設施中的特定人員來說不是違禁物品，前提是該藥物或補充劑是由該設施負責人為此目的授權的醫療服務提供者開具或提供供該人個人使用的。
(4) Despite any regulations made for the purposes of paragraph 44(2)(b) of the Legislation Act 2003 , section 42 of that Act (disallowance of legislative instruments) applies to a legislative instrument made under subsection (2) of this section.
(4) 儘管為《2003 年立法法》第 44(2)(b) 段的目的製定了任何法規，該法第 42 條（禁止立法文書）仍適用於根據本條第 (2) 款制定的立法文書。
(5) An immigration detention facility is:
(5) 移民拘留設施是：
(a) a detention centre established under this Act (see section 273); or
(a) 依本法設立的拘留中心（參閱第 273 條）；或
(b) another place approved by the Minister in writing for the purposes of subparagraph (b)(v) of the definition of immigration detention in subsection 5(1).
(b) 為第 5(1) 款移民拘留定義第 (b)(v) 項的目的，經部長書面批准的另一個地點。

title: 251AA Searches of detainees etc.—exercise of powers relating to prohibited things determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b)
zh: 251AA 對被拘留者等的搜索－行使與第 251A(2)(b) 段所確定的禁止事項有關的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Purpose and belief relating to immigration detention facility risks
與移民拘留設施風險相關的目的和信念
(1) The exercise of a power covered by subsection (7) is authorised only if the purpose of exercising the power is to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk .
(1) 只有當行使第 (7) 款所涵蓋的權力的目的是為了防止或減輕移民拘留設施風險時，才可以授權行使該權力。
(2) The exercise by a person of a power covered by paragraph (7)(b) is authorised only if the person believes on reasonable grounds that exercising the power is necessary to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk.
(2) 只有當一個人有合理理由相信行使該權力對於防止或減輕移民拘留設施風險是必要的時，該人才能行使第 (7)(b) 款所涵蓋的權力。
(3) The exercise by a person of a power covered by paragraph (7)(c) or (d) to seize or request a thing, on the basis that the thing is a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b), is authorised only if the person believes on reasonable grounds that:
(3) 某人基於第 251A(2)(b) 款確定的禁止物品，行使第 (7)(c) 或 (d) 款所涵蓋的權力來扣押或索要某物，只有當該人有合理理由相信：
(a) the thing is such a prohibited thing; and
(a) 該物品屬於禁止物品；和
(b) exercising the power is necessary to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk.
(b) 行使該權力對於防止或減輕移民拘留設施風險是必要的。
Temporary return of seized things
暫時退還扣押的物品
(4) If a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) has been seized under a power covered by paragraph (7)(c) of this section, the person who owns the thing, or who last controlled it before its seizure, may make a request to an authorised officer for its return for a particular period.
(4) 如果根據本條第 (7)(c) 款所涵蓋的權力扣押了第 251A(2)(b) 款規定的違禁物品，則擁有該物品或在扣押前最後控制該物品的人可以向授權官員請求在特定期限內歸還該物品。
(5) On a request by a person under subsection (4), an authorised officer must:
(5) 應某人依第 (4) 款提出的請求，授權官員必須：
(a) return the thing to the person for the period requested; or
(a) 在要求的期限內將物品歸還給該人；或
(b) if the authorised officer believes on reasonable grounds that it is necessary to do so to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk:
(b) 如果授權官員有合理理由認為有必要這樣做以防止或減輕移民拘留設施的風險：
(i) return the thing to the person for a specified period shorter than that requested; or
(i) 在比要求的時間短的指定期限內將物品歸還給該人；或
(ii) refuse to return the thing to the person.
(ii) 拒絕將物品歸還給該人。
Note: The return of a thing under this subsection for a period does not prevent the further exercise of a power covered by subsection (7) in relation to the thing during that period, subject to this section (see subsection (9)).
註：在一段時間內歸還本款規定的物品並不妨礙在該期限內進一步行使第（7）款所涵蓋的與該物品有關的權力，但須遵守本條（見第（9）款）。
Return of seized things if no longer necessary for them to be retained
如果不再需要保留被扣押的物品，則將其歸還
(6) If a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) has been seized under a power covered by paragraph (7)(c) of this section, an authorised officer must take all reasonable steps to return the thing to the person who owns the thing, or last controlled it before its seizure, if the officer no longer believes, on reasonable grounds, that it is necessary to retain the thing to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk.
(6) 如果根據本條第 (7)(c) 款所涵蓋的權力扣押了根據第 251A(2)(b) 款確定的禁止物品，則授權官員必須採取一切合理措施，將該物品歸還給該物品的所有者或在扣押前最後控制該物品的人，並且該官員基於合理理由不再認為有必要保留該物品以防止或減輕移民的風險。
Note 1: For the return or forfeiture of such prohibited things when the owner or controller ceases to be in detention, see subsections 252(4A), (4D) and (4E) and section 252CB.
註 1：有關當所有人或控制者不再被拘留時返還或沒收此類違禁物品的信息，請參閱第 252(4A)、(4D) 和 (4E) 款以及第 252CB 款。
Note 2: The return of a thing as a result of this subsection does not prevent the further exercise of a power covered by subsection (7) in relation to the thing, subject to this section (see subsection (9)).
註 2：因本款而歸還物品並不妨礙進一步行使第（7）款所涵蓋的與該物品有關的權力，但須遵守本條（見第（9）款）。
Powers covered
涵蓋的權力
(7) This subsection covers the following powers:
(7) 本款涵蓋以下權力：
(a) the power of the Minister to make a direction under subsection 251B(6) in relation to the seizure of a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b);
(a) 部長有權依第 251B(6) 款就扣押依第 251A(2)(b) 款所確定的違禁物品發出指示；
(b) the power of an authorised officer, or an authorised officer’s assistant, to conduct a search or a screening procedure in relation to any prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b), under the following provisions:
(b) 授權官員或授權官員的助理有權根據以下規定對根據第 251A(2)(b) 段確定的任何違禁物品進行搜查或篩選程序：
(i) section 252 (searches of detainees etc.—general powers of personal search and seizure);
(i) 第 252 條（搜索被拘留者等－個人搜索和扣押的一般權力）；
(ii) section 252AA (searches of detainees—screening procedures);
(ii) 第 252AA 條（搜索被拘留者－篩選程序）；
(iii) section 252A (searches of detainees—strip searches);
(iii) 第 252A 條（對被拘留者的搜索－脫衣搜查）；
(iv) section 252BA (searches of certain immigration detention facilities—general);
(iv) 第 252BA 條（對某些移民拘留設施的搜索－一般性）；
(v) section 252BB (searches of certain immigration detention facilities—authorised officers’ assistants);
(v) 第 252BB 條（對某些移民拘留設施的搜索－授權官員的助理）；
(c) the power of an authorised officer to seize a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b), under the following provisions:
(c) 授權官員依下列規定扣押依第 251A(2)(b) 段所確定的違禁物品的權力：
(i) paragraph 252(4A)(a) (seizure during searches under section 252);
(i) 第 252(4A)(a) 段（依第 252 條搜索期間扣押）；
(ii) subsection 252CA(2) (seizure during screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities);
(ii) 第 252CA(2) 款（在對被拘留者進行篩檢和脫衣搜查以及搜索設施期間扣押）；
(d) the following powers of an authorised officer, in relation to an immigration detention facility:
(d) 授權官員對於移民拘留設施的下列權力：
(i) the power, under paragraph 252G(4)(e), to request that a person leave a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) in a specified place;
(i) 根據第 252G(4)(e) 段的權力，要求某人將根據第 251A(2)(b) 段確定的禁止物品留在指定地點；
(ii) the power, under subsection 252G(7), to refuse entry to the facility to a person who does not comply with such a request.
(ii) 根據第 252G(7) 款，有權拒絕不遵守此類請求的人員進入該設施。
(8) In this section, a reference to the exercise of a power under a provision of this Act includes a reference to:
(8) 在本節中，提及依本法條款行使權力時包括：
(a) the exercise of any particular aspect of the power under any particular part of that provision, and of any related power (or any particular aspect of such a related power); and
(a) 行使該條款任何特定部分規定的權力的任何特定方面，以及任何相關權力（或此類相關權力的任何特定方面）；和
(b) the exercise of the power (or a related power mentioned in paragraph (a)) in any particular way.
(b) 以任何特定方式行使權力（或（a）段所提及的相關權力）。
Example: A reference in this section to the exercise of a power of the Minister to make a direction under subsection 251B(6) in relation to a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) includes a reference to the exercise of that power by the Minister in relation to the following, as specified in the direction:
例：本節提及部長依第 251B(6) 款就第 251A(2)(b) 款所確定的禁止事項行使權力作出指示，包括提及部長就下列事項行使該權力，如指示所規定：
(a) any particular relevant seizure power (or all such powers);
(a) 任何特定的相關扣押權（或所有此類權力）；
(b) any particular class of persons, things or immigration detention facilities (or all such persons, things or facilities);
(b) 任何特定類別的人、物或移民拘留設施（或所有此類人、物或設施）；
(c) any particular circumstances.
(c) 任何特殊情況。
(9) To avoid doubt, but subject to this section:
(9) 為避免疑問，但受本條約束：
(a) the return of a thing to a person under subsection (5) for a period does not prevent the further exercise of a power covered by subsection (7) in relation to the thing during that period; and
(a) 在一段時間內根據第 (5) 款將物品返還給某人並不妨礙在此期間進一步行使第 (7) 款所涵蓋的與該物品有關的權力；和
(b) the return of a thing to a person after taking all reasonable steps under subsection (6) for its return does not prevent the further exercise of a power covered by subsection (7) in relation to the thing.
(b) 在根據第 (6) 款採取一切合理步驟歸還物品後，將物品返還給某人並不妨礙進一步行使第 (7) 款所涵蓋的與該物品有關的權力。

title: 251AB Searches of detainees etc.—access to alternative means of communication
zh: 251AB 搜索被拘留者等－取得替代通訊方式
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) Without limiting section 256 (person in immigration detention may have access to certain advice, facilities etc.), the Secretary must ensure that a detainee who is detained in an immigration detention facility is given access to an alternative means of communication, which meets the requirements under subsection (2) of this section, if:
(1) 在不限制第 256 條（移民拘留所中的人可以獲得某些建議、設施等）的情況下，部長必須確保被拘留在移民拘留設施中的被拘留者能夠獲得滿足本節第 (2) 款要求的替代通訊方式，如果：
(a) a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) has been seized from the detainee under:
(a) 依第 251A(2)(b) 段所確定的違禁物品已從被拘留者手中沒收：
(i) paragraph 252(4A)(a) (seizure during personal searches under section 252); or
(i) 第 252(4A)(a) 段（依第 252 條在個人搜索期間扣押）；或
(ii) subsection 252CA(2) (seizure during screening, strip search or facility search); and
(ii) 第 252CA(2) 款（在安檢、脫衣搜索或設施搜索期間扣押）；和
(b) the thing is a device that a person may use to communicate with another person; and
(b) 該物品是一個人可以用來與另一個人通訊的設備；和
(c) the thing has not been returned to the detainee.
(c) 該物品尚未歸還給被拘留者。
(2) The alternative means of communication must be reasonably sufficient to enable the detainee to:
(2) 替代通訊方式必須夠合理，以使被拘留者能夠：
(a) communicate with a member of the family unit of the detainee; or
(a) 與被拘留者家屬溝通；或
(b) communicate with any person outside the immigration detention facility for the purposes of:
(b) 為以下目的與移民拘留設施外的任何人溝通：
(i) obtaining legal advice; or
(i) 取得法律建議；或
(ii) obtaining support of a prescribed kind; or
(ii) 獲得規定種類的支持；或
(iii) communicating governmental or political matters.
(iii) 傳達政府或政治事務。

title: 251AC Further limits on certain powers—implied freedom of political communication
zh: 251AC 對某些權力的進一步限制－隱含的政治溝通自由
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Each of the following powers may not be exercised to the extent (if any) that the exercise of the power would infringe any constitutional doctrine of implied freedom of political communication:
行使以下每項權力時（如有），不得侵犯任何隱含政治溝通自由的憲法原則：
(a) the power under subsection 251A(2) (power to determine prohibited things);
(a) 第 251A(2) 條規定的權力（確定禁止事項的權力）；
(b) a power covered by subsection 251AA(7) (powers relating to certain prohibited things).
(b) 第 251AA(7) 條涵蓋的權力（與某些禁止事項有關的權力）。

title: 251B Searches of detainees etc.—exercise of powers generally
zh: 251B 搜索被拘留者等－一般權力的行使
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Visibility or intentional concealment of things—search etc. powers
事物的可見性或故意隱藏－搜索等權力
(1) An authorised officer may exercise a power to search for a thing under section 252 or 252BA:
(1) 授權人員可依第 252 或 252BA 條行使搜索物品的權力：
(a) whether or not the thing is visible to the authorised officer:
(a) 授權人員是否可以看到該物品：
(i) in the case of a search under section 252—immediately before the start of the search; or
(i) 在根據第 252 條進行搜索的情況下－在搜索開始之前；或
(ii) in the case of a search of an immigration detention facility under section 252BA—immediately before the start of the search of the facility, or of any area of the facility covered by the search; and
(ii) 如果根據第 252BA 條對移民拘留設施進行搜查－在開始搜索該設施或搜查所覆蓋的設施的任何區域之前；和
(b) if the thing is not visible to the authorised officer at that time—whether or not the thing had been intentionally concealed.
(b) 如果當時授權官員看不到該物品－不論該物品是否被故意隱藏。
Note: Section 252 covers searches of detainees and certain non ‑ citizens. Section 252BA covers searches of immigration detention facilities.
註：第 252 條涵蓋對被拘留者和某些非公民的搜索。第 252BA 條涵蓋移民拘留設施的搜索。
(2) An authorised officer may conduct a screening procedure for a thing under section 252AA, or a strip search for a thing under section 252A, whether or not the thing had been intentionally concealed before the screening procedure or strip search was conducted.
(2) 授權人員可以根據第 252AA 條對物品進行篩檢程序，或根據第 252A 條對物品進行脫衣搜查，無論該物品在進行篩檢程序或脫衣搜查之前是否被故意隱藏。
Note: Section 252AA covers screening procedures for detainees. Section 252A covers strip searches of detainees. These sections authorise searches for things which are not visible immediately before the procedure or search starts to be conducted.
註：第 252AA 條涵蓋了被拘留者的篩檢程序。第 252A 條涵蓋對被拘留者的脫衣搜查。這些部分授權在程式或搜尋開始進行之前搜尋不可見的事物。
Visibility or intentional concealment of things—seizure powers
事物的可見性或故意隱藏－扣押權
(3) An authorised officer may seize a thing under section 252 in the course of a search under that section, or under section 252C or 252CA in the course of a search under section 252BA:
(3) 授權官員可以在根據第 252 條進行搜查的過程中扣押該條規定的物品，或者在根據第 252BA 條進行搜查的過程中根據第 252C 或 252CA 條扣押物品：
(a) whether or not the thing was visible to the authorised officer:
(a) 該物品是否對授權人員可見：
(i) in the case of a search under section 252—immediately before the start of the search; or
(i) 在根據第 252 條進行搜索的情況下－在搜索開始之前；或
(ii) in the case of a search of an immigration detention facility under section 252BA—immediately before the start of the search of the facility, or of any area of the facility covered by the search; and
(ii) 如果根據第 252BA 條對移民拘留設施進行搜查－在開始搜索該設施或搜查所覆蓋的設施的任何區域之前；和
(b) if the thing was not visible to the authorised officer at that time—whether or not the thing had been intentionally concealed.
(b) 如果當時授權官員看不到該物品－不論該物品是否是故意隱藏的。
(4) An authorised officer may seize a thing under section 252C or 252CA, in the course of the conduct of a screening procedure under section 252AA or of a strip search under section 252A, whether or not the thing had been intentionally concealed before the screening procedure or strip search was conducted.
(4) 授權人員可以在根據第 252AA 條進行篩檢程序或根據第 252A 條進行脫衣搜查的過程中，扣押第 252C 或 252CA 條規定的物品，無論該物品在進行篩檢程序或脫衣搜查之前是否被故意隱藏。
Powers do not limit each other
權力不互相限制
(5) A power may be exercised under any of sections 252, 252AA, 252A, 252BA, 252C and 252CA in relation to a person, immigration detention facility or thing irrespective of whether any powers are exercised in relation to the person, immigration detention facility or thing under another of those sections.
(5) 可以根據第 252、252AA、252A、252BA、252C 和 252CA 條中的任何一條對人、移民拘留設施或事物行使權力，無論是否根據這些條中的另一條對人、移民拘留設施或事物行使任何權力。
Directions requiring seizure powers to be exercised
要求行使檢取權力的指示
(6) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, direct that an authorised officer (or an authorised officer in a specified class of relevant officers) must seize a thing by exercising one or more specified relevant seizure powers (or all relevant seizure powers) in relation to one or more of the following:
(6) 部長可以透過立法文書指示授權官員（或特定類別相關官員中的授權官員）必須透過行使一項或多項特定的相關扣押權（或所有相關扣押權）來扣押與以下一項或多項相關的物品：
(a) a person in a specified class of persons, or all persons, to whom the relevant seizure power relates;
(a) 與相關扣押權有關的特定類別人員或所有人；
Example: All detainees in a specified immigration detention facility, or all detainees in such a facility other than those who are unauthorised maritime arrivals.
例如：特定移民拘留設施中的所有被拘留者，或此類設施中除未經授權的海上抵達者之外的所有被拘留者。
(b) a specified thing, a thing in a specified class of things, or all things, to which the relevant seizure power relates;
(b) 與相關扣押權相關的特定物品、特定類別物品中的物品或所有物品；
(c) a specified immigration detention facility, an immigration detention facility in a specified class of such facilities, or all immigration detention facilities;
(c) 特定的移民拘留設施、特定類別的移民拘留設施或所有移民拘留設施；
(d) any circumstances specified in the directions.
(d) 指示中指定的任何情況。
Example: A direction could specify a particular period during which the direction is to take effect, or the duration of a specified event.
範例：指令可以指定指令生效的特定時間段，或指定事件的持續時間。
Note 1: The Minister may give a direction under subsection (6) only to prevent or lessen an immigration detention facility risk: see subsection 251AA(1).
註 1：部長只能依據第 (6) 款發出指示，以防止或減輕移民拘留設施風險：請參閱第 251AA(1) 款。
Note 2: Despite any direction given under subsection (6), a thing cannot be seized if the seizure is not authorised under subsection 251AA(3) (which relates to preventing or lessening immigration detention facility risks).
註 2：儘管根據第 (6) 款給出了任何指示，但如果未根據第 251AA(3) 款（涉及防止或減輕移民拘留設施風險）授權扣押，則不得扣押物品。
(7) A relevant seizure power is a power to seize a thing under any of the following provisions:
(7) 相關扣押權是指依下列規定扣押物品的權力：
(a) paragraph 252(4)(a) or (4A)(a) (searches of detainees etc.—general powers of personal search and seizure);
(a) 第 252(4)(a) 或 (4A)(a) 段（搜索被拘留者等－個人搜索和扣押的一般權力）；
(b) subsection 252C(1) (screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities—seizure (general));
(b) 第 252C(1) 款（對被拘留者進行篩選及脫衣搜索及設施搜索－扣押（一般））；
(c) subsection 252CA(2) (screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities—seizure of certain prohibited things).
(c) 第 252CA(2) 款（對被拘留者進行篩檢和脫衣搜查以及搜索設施－扣押某些違禁物品）。
(8) Subsection (6) does not empower the Minister to give directions that would be inconsistent with this Act or the regulations.
（8）第（6）款並未授權部長發出與本法或法規不一致的指示。

title: 252 Searches of detainees etc.—general powers of personal search and seizure
zh: 252 被拘留者等的搜索－個人搜索和扣押的一般權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Scope
適用範圍
(1) This section applies in relation to the following persons:
(1) 本條適用於下列人員：
(a) a detainee;
(a) 被拘留者；
(b) a person who is a non ‑ citizen, if:
(b) 非公民，如果：
(i) the person has not been immigration cleared; and
(i) 該人尚未獲得移民許可；和
(ii) an authorised officer has reasonable grounds for suspecting there are reasonable grounds for cancelling the person’s visa; and
(ii) 授權官員有合理理由懷疑有合理理由取消該人的簽證；和
(iii) the person is not in detention.
(iii) 該人沒有被拘留。
Powers of authorised officers
獲授權人員的權力
(2) An authorised officer may, without warrant, search a person, the person’s clothing and any property under the immediate control of the person for any thing that may be seized from the person under paragraph (4)(a) or (4A)(a), whether or not the officer has any suspicion that the person has such a thing on the person’s body, in the person’s clothing or in any such property.
(2) 授權官員可以在沒有搜查證的情況下搜查某人、該人的衣服以及該人直接控制下的任何財產，以查找根據第 (4)(a) 或 (4A)(a) 款可能從該人身上扣押的任何物品，無論該官員是否懷疑該人的身上、該人的衣服或任何此類財產中存在此類物品。
(3) An authorised officer may detain a person for the purpose of searching the person in accordance with this section.
(3) 授權官員可以根據本節的規定，出於搜索目的而拘留某人。
Seizure
癲癇發作
(4) Subject to subsection (4C), an authorised officer:
(4) 根據第 (4C) 款，授權人員：
(a) may, in the course of a search under this section, seize any of the following:
(a) 在依本條進行搜索的過程中，可以扣押以下任何物品：
(i) a weapon or other thing capable of being used to inflict bodily injury or to help any detainee to escape from immigration detention (a weapon or escape aid );
(i) 能夠用於造成人身傷害或協助任何被拘留者逃離移民拘留所的武器或其他物品（武器或逃生輔助工具）；
(ii) a document or other thing that is, or may be, evidence for grounds for cancelling the visa of the person who is being searched ( visa cancellation evidence in relation to the person);
(ii) 作為或可能作為取消被搜查者簽證理由的證據的文件或其他物品（與該人相關的簽證取消證據）；
(iii) a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(a) (other than a prohibited thing that is also a weapon or escape aid, or visa cancellation evidence); and
(iii) 根據第 251A(2)(a) 段確定的違禁物品（同時也是武器或逃生輔助工具或簽證取消證據的違禁物品除外）；和
(b) may retain the thing for such time as the authorised officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this Act.
(b) 可以在授權官員認為為本法目的所需的時間內保留該物品。
Note 1: Paragraph 251A(2)(a) covers things the possession of which is unlawful.
註 1：第 251A(2)(a) 段涵蓋非法佔有的物品。
Note 2: Subparagraph (a)(iii) of this subsection does not apply in relation to certain detainees and non ‑ citizens (see subsection (4B)).
註2：本款(a)(iii)項不適用於某些被拘留者及非公民（請參閱第(4B)款）。
(4A) Subject to subsection (4C), an authorised officer:
(4A) 根據第 (4C) 款，授權人員：
(a) may, in the course of a search under this section, seize a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) (other than a prohibited thing that is also a weapon or escape aid, or visa cancellation evidence); and
(a) 在根據本節進行搜索的過程中，可以扣押根據第 251A(2)(b) 段確定的違禁物品（同時也是武器或逃生輔助工具或簽證取消證據的違禁物品除外）；和
(b) must, if it appears that the prohibited thing is owned or was controlled by a detainee, take all reasonable steps, when that detainee ceases to be in detention, to return it to that detainee; and
(b) 如果違禁物品似乎由被拘留者擁有或控制，則必須在該被拘留者不再被拘留時採取一切合理步驟將其歸還給該被拘留者；和
(c) must, if it appears that the prohibited thing is owned or was controlled by a person other than a detainee, take all reasonable steps to return it to that person.
(c) 如果違禁物品似乎由被拘留者以外的人擁有或控制，則必須採取一切合理措施將其返還給該人。
Note 1: Paragraph 251A(2)(b) covers the determination of a thing as a prohibited thing if the Minister is satisfied that its possession or use in an immigration detention facility might be a risk to the health, safety or security of persons in the facility, or to the order of the facility.
註 1：第 251A(2)(b) 段涵蓋瞭如果部長信納移民拘留設施中擁有或使用某物可能對設施內人員的健康、安全或保障或設施的秩序構成風險，則將其確定為違禁物。
Note 2: Paragraph (a) of this subsection does not apply in relation to certain detainees and non ‑ citizens (see subsection (4B)).
註2：本款(a)款不適用於某些被拘留者及非公民（請參閱第(4B)款）。
Note 3: A prohibited thing that is seized under paragraph (a) of this subsection may be returned to a detainee, temporarily or indefinitely, before the detainee ceases to be in detention (see subsections 251AA(4), (5) and (6)).
註 3：依本款 (a) 款扣押的違禁物品可以在被拘留者停止拘留之前暫時或無限期地歸還給被拘留者（請參閱第 251AA(4)、(5) 和 (6) 款）。
(4B) The seizure of a prohibited thing under subparagraph (4)(a)(iii) or paragraph (4A)(a) is not authorised if the seizure is from:
(4B) 若扣押來自下列情況，則不得扣押第 (4)(a)(iii) 款或第 (4A)(a) 款規定的違禁物品：
(a) a detainee covered by a residence determination who is residing at the place specified in the determination; or
(a) 居住地決定所涵蓋且居住在決定中指定地點的被拘留者；或
(b) a non ‑ citizen covered by paragraph (1)(b).
(b) 第(1)(b)款所涵蓋的非公民。
Note: However, if a prohibited thing is also a weapon or escape aid, or visa cancellation evidence, it can be seized from such a person under subparagraph (4)(a)(i) or (ii).
註：但是，如果違禁物品也是武器或逃生輔助工具，或簽證取消證據，則可以根據第 (4)(a)(i) 或 (ii) 項從此類人身上扣押。
(4C) If an authorised officer has the power to seize a thing under paragraph (4)(a) or (4A)(a), the officer must seize the thing if a direction under subsection 251B(6) has the effect of requiring the officer to seize the thing.
(4C) 若授權官員有權扣押第 (4)(a) 或 (4A)(a) 款規定的物品，且第 251B(6) 款下的指示具有要求該官員扣押該物品的效力，則該官員必須扣押該物品。
Note 1: An authorised officer does not have the power to seize a prohibited thing under paragraph (4)(a) or (4A)(a) if subsection (4B) applies in relation to the thing.
註1：若第(4B)款適用於與第(4)(a)或(4A)(a)款有關的禁止物品，則獲授權人員無權扣押該物品。
Note 2: An authorised officer has the power to seize a prohibited thing under paragraph (4A)(a) only if the exercise of the power is authorised under subsection 251AA(3) (which relates to preventing or lessening immigration detention facility risks).
註 2：只有在第 251AA(3) 款（涉及預防或減輕移民拘留設施風險）授權行使該權力的情況下，授權官員才有權扣押第 (4A)(a) 款規定的違禁物品。
Forfeiture of seized things
沒收扣押的物品
(4D) A prohibited thing seized under paragraph (4A)(a) is forfeited to the Commonwealth if the authorised officer considers on reasonable grounds, after taking all reasonable steps to return the thing under paragraph (4A)(b) or (c), that:
(4D) 若授權官員在採取一切合理步驟歸還第 (4A)(b) 或 (c) 款規定的物品後，基於合理理由認為：
(a) its owner or the person who last controlled the thing cannot be identified; or
(a) 無法辨識其所有者或最後控制該物品的人；或
(b) the thing is abandoned; or
(b) 該物品被遺棄；或
(c) if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a detainee—the thing cannot be returned to that detainee when that detainee ceases to be in detention; or
(c) 若該物品似乎由被拘留者擁有或控制－當該被拘留者不再被拘留時，該物品不能歸還給該被拘留者；或
(d) if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a person other than a detainee—the thing cannot be returned to that person.
(d) 如果該物品似乎由被拘留者以外的其他人擁有或控制－則該物品不能歸還給該人。
(4E) If a prohibited thing is forfeited under subsection (4D), the authorised officer may dispose of it in any way the officer thinks appropriate.
(4E) 如果根據第 (4D) 款規定沒收違禁物品，授權官員可以以其認為適當的任何方式處置該物品。
Related matters
相關事宜
(5) This section does not authorise an authorised officer, or another person conducting a search pursuant to subsection (6) to remove any of the person’s clothing, or to require a person to remove any of his or her clothing.
(5) 本節未授權授權人員或依第 (6) 款進行搜索的其他人脫掉該人的任何衣服，或要求該人脫掉他或她的任何衣服。
(6) A search under this section of a person, and the person’s clothing, shall be conducted by:
(6) 依本節規定對人員及其服裝進行搜索應由下列人員進行：
(a) an authorised officer of the same sex as the person; or
(a) 與該人同性別的授權官員；或
(b) in a case where an authorised officer of the same sex as the person is not available to conduct the search—any other person who is of the same sex and:
(b) 若未與該人同性別的授權官員進行搜索－任何其他同性別的人，且：
(i) is requested by an authorised officer; and
(i) 應授權人員的要求；和
(ii) agrees;
(ii) 同意；
to conduct the search.
進行搜尋。
(7) An action or proceeding, whether civil or criminal, does not lie against a person who, at the request of an authorised officer, conducts a search under this section if the person acts in good faith and does not contravene subsection (8).
(7) 如果一個人應授權官員的請求根據本條進行搜查，且該人善意行事並且不違反第 (8) 款，則該訴訟或程序，無論是民事還是刑事，均不針對該人。
(8) An authorised officer or other person who conducts a search under this section shall not use more force, or subject a person to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary in order to conduct the search.
(8) 依本條進行搜索的授權官員或其他人員不得使用比進行搜索合理必要的更多的武力或使他人受到更大的侮辱。

title: 252AA Searches of detainees—screening procedures
zh: 252AA 對被拘留者的搜索－篩選程序
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) An authorised officer may, without warrant, conduct a screening procedure in relation to a detainee, other than a detainee to whom section 252F applies, for any of the following things on the detainee’s body, in the detainee’s clothing or in a thing in the detainee’s possession:
(1) 授權官員可在沒有搜索令的情況下對被拘留者（第 252F 條適用的被拘留者除外）進行篩選程序，檢查被拘留者身上、被拘留者的衣服或被拘留者擁有的物品中的以下任何物品：
(a) a weapon or escape aid;
(a) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(b) a prohibited thing.
(b) 禁止的事物。
(1A) An authorised officer may conduct a screening procedure under subsection (1) in relation to a detainee for a thing mentioned in that subsection whether or not the officer has any suspicion that the detainee has such a thing on the detainee’s body, in the detainee’s clothing or in a thing in the detainee’s possession.
(1A) 授權官員可以根據第 (1) 款對被拘留者執行該款中提到的物品的篩選程序，無論該官員是否懷疑被拘留者身上、被拘留者的衣服或被拘留者擁有的物品中存在此類物品。
(2) An authorised officer who conducts a screening procedure under this section must not use greater force, or subject the detainee to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary in order to conduct the screening procedure.
(2) 根據本節進行篩選程序的授權官員不得使用比進行篩檢程序合理必要的更大的武力或使被拘留者遭受更大的侮辱。
(3) This section does not authorise an authorised officer to remove any of the detainee’s clothing, or to require a detainee to remove any of his or her clothing.
(3) 本節未授權授權官員脫掉被拘留者的任何衣服，或要求被拘留者脫掉其任何衣服。
(5) In this section:
(5) 本節：
conducting a screening procedure , in relation to a detainee, means:
對被拘留者進行篩檢程序是指：
(a) causing the detainee to walk, or to be moved, through screening equipment; or
(a) 導致被拘留者步行或移動通過安檢設備；或
(b) passing hand ‑ held screening equipment over or around the detainee or around things in the detainee’s possession; or
(b) 在被拘留者上方或周圍或被拘留者擁有的物品周圍傳遞手持式篩檢設備；或
(c) passing things in the detainee’s possession through screening equipment or examining such things by X ‑ ray.
(c) 將被拘留者擁有的物品通過安檢設備或透過 X 光檢查此類物品。
screening equipment means a metal detector or similar device for detecting objects or particular substances.
檢查設備是指用於檢測物體或特定物質的金屬探測器或類似裝置。

title: 252A Searches of detainees—strip searches
zh: 252A 對被拘留者的搜查－脫衣搜查
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) An authorised officer may, without warrant, conduct a strip search of a detainee, other than a detainee to whom section 252F applies, for any of the following things on the detainee’s body, in the detainee’s clothing, or in a thing in the detainee’s possession:
(1) 授權官員可在沒有搜查令的情況下，對除第 252F 條適用的被拘留者以外的被拘留者進行脫衣搜查，以檢查被拘留者身體、被拘留者衣服或被拘留者佔有的物品中的以下任何物品：
(a) a weapon or escape aid;
(a) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(b) a prohibited thing.
(b) 禁止的事物。
Note: Section 252B sets out rules for conducting a strip search under this section.
註：第 252B 條規定了根據本條進行脫衣搜索的規則。
(2) A strip search of a detainee means a search of the detainee’s body or clothing or of a thing in the detainee’s possession. It may include:
(2) 對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查，指對被拘留者的身體、衣物或其占有的物品進行搜查。它可能包括：
(a) requiring the detainee to remove some or all of the detainee’s clothing; and
(a) 要求被拘留者脫掉部分或全部衣服；和
(b) an examination of that clothing and of the detainee’s body (but not of the detainee’s body cavities).
(b) 檢查被拘留者的衣物和身體（但不檢查被拘留者的體腔）。
(3) A strip search of a detainee may be conducted by an authorised officer only if:
(3) 只有在下列情況下，授權官員才可以對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查：
(a) an officer suspects on reasonable grounds that there is on the detainee’s body, in the detainee’s clothing or in a thing in the detainee’s possession any of the following things:
(a) 官員有合理理由懷疑被拘留者的身體、被拘留者的衣服或被拘留者擁有的物品中存在以下任何物品：
(i) a weapon or escape aid;
(i) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(ii) a prohibited thing; and
(ii) 禁止的物品；和
(b) the officer referred to in paragraph (a) suspects on reasonable grounds that it is necessary to conduct a strip search of the detainee to recover that weapon or other thing; and
(b) (a) 款所提及的官員有合理理由懷疑有必要對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查以收回武器或其他物品；和
(c) the strip search is authorised as follows:
(c) 脫衣搜索的授權如下：
(i) if the detainee is at least 18—the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner, or an SES Band 3 employee in the Department (who is not the officer referred to in paragraphs (a) and (b) nor the authorised officer conducting the strip search), authorises the strip search because he or she is satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for those suspicions;
(i) 如果被拘留者年满 18 岁，则部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员或该部门的 SES Band 3 雇员（不是 (a) 和 (b) 段中提到的官员，也不是进行脱衣搜查的授权官员），授权进行脱衣搜查，因为他或她确信这些怀疑有合理的理由；
(ii) if the detainee is at least 10 but under 18—a magistrate orders the strip search because he or she is satisfied that there are reasonable grounds for those suspicions.
(ii) 如果被拘留者年满 10 岁但未满 18 岁——治安法官下令进行脱衣搜查，因为他或她确信这些怀疑有合理的理由。
(3A) An officer may form a suspicion on reasonable grounds for the purposes of paragraph (3)(a) on the basis of:
(3A) 為第 (3)(a) 款的目的，官員可以根據以下合理理由提出懷疑：
(a) a search conducted under section 252 (whether by that officer or another officer); or
(a) 依第 252 條進行的搜索（無論是由該官員或另一名官員）；或
(b) a screening procedure conducted under section 252AA (whether by that officer or another officer); or
(b) 依據第 252AA 條進行的篩選程序（無論是由該官員或另一名官員）；或
(c) any other information that is available to the officer.
(c) 官員可獲得的任何其他資訊。
(4) An authorisation of a strip search given for the purposes of paragraph (3)(c):
(4) 為第 (3)(c) 款之目的而給予的脫衣搜索授權：
(a) may be given by telephone, fax or other electronic means; and
(a) 可透過電話、傳真或其他電子方式提供；和
(b) must be recorded in writing, and signed by the person giving the authorisation, within one business day after it is given.
(b) 必須以書面記錄，並在授權後的一個工作天內由授權人簽名。
(5) A failure to comply with paragraph (4)(b) does not affect the validity of a strip search conducted on the basis of that authorisation.
(5) 不遵守第 (4)(b) 款並不影響根據該授權進行的脫衣搜索的有效性。
(6) The power to authorise a strip search under paragraph (3)(c) cannot be delegated to any other person.
(6) 第 (3)(c) 款規定的授權脫衣搜索的權力不得委託給任何其他人。
(6A) A power conferred on a magistrate by this section is conferred on the magistrate in a personal capacity and not as a court or a member of a court.
(6A) 本條授予治安法官的權力是以個人身分而非法院或法院成員的身分授予治安法官的。
(6B) The magistrate need not accept the power conferred.
(6B) 治安法官無須接受所授予的權力。
(6C) A magistrate exercising a power under this section has the same protection and immunity as if he or she were exercising that power as, or as a member of, the court of which the magistrate is a member.
(6C) 依據本條行使權力的治安法官享有與以其所在法院或其成員行使該權力相同的保護和豁免權。
(8) In this section:
(8) 本節：
business day means a day that is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in the place where the authorisation is given.
工作日是指除授權地週六、週日或國定假日以外的日子。
SES Band 3 employee means an SES employee with a classification of Senior Executive Band 3, and includes an SES employee who has been temporarily assigned duties that have been allocated a classification of Senior Executive Band 3.
SES Band 3 员工是指具有高级管理人员等级 3 类别的 SES 员工，包括临时分配职责并被分配高级管理人员等级 3 类别的 SES 员工。

title: 252B Searches of detainees—rules for conducting a strip search
zh: 252B 對被拘留者的搜索－進行脫衣搜查的規則
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) A strip search of a detainee under section 252A:
(1) 依第 252A 條對被拘留者進行脫衣搜索：
(a) must not subject the detainee to greater indignity than is reasonably necessary to conduct the strip search; and
(a) 不得使被拘留者受到比進行脫衣搜索合理必要的侮辱更大的侮辱；和
(b) must be conducted in a private area; and
(b) 必須在私人區域進行；和
(c) must be conducted by an authorised officer of the same sex as the detainee; and
(c) 必須由與被拘留者同性別的授權官員進行；和
(d) subject to subsections (2), (3) and (5), must not be conducted in the presence or view of a person who is of the opposite sex to the detainee; and
(d) 根據第 (2)、(3) 及 (5) 款，不得在與被拘留者異性在場或有異性在場的情況下進行；和
(e) subject to subsections (2), (3) and (5), must not be conducted in the presence or view of a person whose presence is not necessary for the purposes of the strip search; and
