(e) 根據第(2)、(3)和(5)款的規定，不得在脫衣搜查不需要的人在場或在場的情況下進行；和
(f) must not be conducted on a detainee who is under 10; and
(f) 不得對 10 歲以下的被拘留者進行；和
(g) if the detainee is at least 10 but under 18, or is incapable of managing his or her affairs—must be conducted in the presence of:
(g) 若被拘留者年滿 10 歲但未滿 18 歲，或無能力管理其事務－必須在下列人員在場的情況下進行：
(i) the detainee’s parent or guardian if that person is in immigration detention with the detainee and is readily available at the same place; or
(i) 被拘留者的父母或監護人，如果該人與被拘留者一起被移民拘留並且可以在同一地點隨時聯繫到；或
(ii) if that is not acceptable to the detainee or subparagraph (i) does not apply—another person (other than an authorised officer) who is capable of representing the detainee’s interests and who, as far as is practicable in the circumstances, is acceptable to the detainee; and
(ii) 如果被拘留者不能接受或第 (i) 項不適用－有能力代表被拘留者利益並且在情況可行的情況下為被拘留者所接受的另一人（授權官員除外）；和
(h) subject to subsection (4), if the detainee is at least 18, and is not incapable of managing his or her affairs—must be conducted in the presence of another person (if any) nominated by the detainee, if that other person is readily available at the same place as the detainee, and willing to attend the strip search within a reasonable time; and
(h) 根據第 (4) 款，如果被拘留者年滿 18 歲，且並非無能力管理其事務，則必須在被拘留者指定的另一人（如有）在場的情況下進行，前提是該人隨時可以與被拘留者在同一地點，並願意在合理時間內參加脫衣搜查；和
(i) must not involve a search of the detainee’s body cavities; and
(i) 不得搜索被拘留者的體腔；和
(j) must not involve the removal of more items of clothing, or more visual inspection, than the authorised officer conducting the search believes on reasonable grounds to be necessary to determine whether there is on the detainee, in the detainee’s clothing or in a thing in the detainee’s possession any of the following things:
(j) 脫去的衣物或目視檢查的數量不得超過進行搜查的授權官員認為有合理理由確定被拘留者、被拘留者的衣服或被拘留者擁有的物品中是否存在以下任何物品所必需的數量：
(i) a weapon or escape aid;
(i) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(ii) a prohibited thing; and
(ii) 禁止的物品；和
(k) must not be conducted with greater force than is reasonably necessary to conduct the strip search.
(k) 進行脫衣搜查時所使用的力量不得超過合理所需的力量。
(2) Paragraphs (1)(d) and (e) do not apply to a parent or guardian, or person present because of subparagraph (1)(g)(ii), if the detainee has no objection to that person being present.
(2) 若被拘留者不反對父母或監護人或因第 (1)(g)(ii) 項而在場的人，則第 (1)(d) 和 (e) 款不適用於該人在場。
(3) Paragraphs (1)(d) and (e) do not apply to a person nominated by the detainee under paragraph (1)(h) to attend the strip search.
(3) 第 (1)(d) 及 (e) 款不適用於被拘留者依第 (1)(h) 款指定參加脫衣搜索的人員。
(4) Neither:
(4) 兩者都不是：
(a) a detainee’s refusal or failure to nominate a person under paragraph (1)(h) within a reasonable time; nor
(a) 被拘留者拒絕或未能在合理時間內提名第 (1)(h) 款規定的人員；也不
(b) a detainee’s inability to nominate a person under that paragraph who is readily available at the same place as the detainee and willing to attend the strip search within a reasonable time;
(b) 被拘留者無法根據該款指定一個人，該人可以隨時與被拘留者在同一地點並願意在合理時間內參加脫衣搜查；
prevents a strip search being conducted.
防止進行脫衣搜查。
(5) A strip search of a detainee may be conducted with the assistance of another person if the authorised officer conducting the strip search considers that to be necessary for the purposes of conducting it. That person must not be of the opposite sex to the detainee unless:
(5) 如果進行脫衣搜查的授權官員認為有必要，可以在另一個人的協助下對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查。該人不得與被拘留者是異性，除非：
(a) the person is a medical practitioner; and
(a) 該人是一名醫生；和
(b) a medical practitioner of the same sex as the detainee is not available within a reasonable time.
(b) 在合理時間內無法找到與被拘留者同性別的醫生。
(6) An action or proceeding, whether civil or criminal, does not lie against a person who, at the request of an authorised officer, assists in conducting a strip search if the person acts in good faith and does not contravene this section.
(6) 如果某人應授權官員的請求協助進行脫衣搜查，則該人善意行事並且不違反本節規定，則無論是民事還是刑事訴訟或程序，均不針對該人。
(7) A detainee must be provided with adequate clothing if during or as a result of a strip search any of his or her clothing is:
(7) 若在脫衣搜索期間或脫衣搜索後，被拘留者的任何衣物出現以下情況，則必須為其提供足夠的衣物：
(a) damaged or destroyed; or
(a) 損壞或毀壞；或
(b) seized under section 252C or 252CA .
(b) 依第 252C 或 252CA 條扣押。

title: 252BA Searches of certain immigration detention facilities—general
zh: 252BA 對某些移民拘留設施的搜索－一般規定
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Search
搜尋
(1) An authorised officer may, without warrant, conduct a search of an immigration detention facility operated by or on behalf of the Commonwealth, including, without limitation, a search covering any or all of the following:
(1) 授權官員可在沒有搜查令的情況下對由聯邦或代表聯邦運營的移民拘留設施進行搜查，包括但不限於對以下任何或全部內容進行搜查：
(a) accommodation areas;
(a) 住宿區；
(b) administrative areas;
(b) 行政區域；
(c) common areas;
(c) 公共區域；
(d) detainees’ personal effects;
(d) 被拘留者的個人物品；
(e) detainees’ rooms;
(e) 被拘留者的房間；
(f) medical examination areas;
(f) 體檢區；
(g) storage areas.
(g) 儲存區。
(2) An authorised officer may conduct a search of the facility for any of the following things:
(2) 授權官員可以對設施進行搜查以查找以下任何物品：
(a) a weapon or escape aid;
(a) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(b) a prohibited thing.
(b) 禁止的事物。
(3) An authorised officer may search the facility for a thing under subsection (2) whether or not the officer has any suspicion that there is such a thing at the facility.
(3) 授權官員可以在設施中搜查第 (2) 款規定的物品，無論該官員是否懷疑設施中存在此類物品。
Note: See also sections 252C and 252CA in relation to the seizure of things in the course of a search under this section.
註：另請參閱第 252C 和 252CA 條中有關在本節下搜索過程中扣押物品的內容。
Conduct of search
搜尋的進行
(4) Without limiting subsections (1) and (2), an authorised officer may use a dog in conducting a search under this section.
(4) 在不限制第 (1) 和 (2) 款的情況下，授權官員可以使用狗根據本條進行搜索。
(5) If an authorised officer uses a dog in conducting a search under this section, the officer must:
(5) 如果授權官員根據本條使用狗進行搜查，則該官員必須：
(a) take all reasonable precautions to prevent the dog touching any person (other than the officer); and
(a) 採取一切合理的預防措施，防止狗接觸任何人（官員除外）；和
(b) keep the dog under control while conducting the search.
(b) 進行搜索時控制狗。
(6) If an authorised officer uses a dog in accordance with subsection (5) in conducting a search under this section, that use of the dog is not unlawful only because of the behaviour of the dog (including the touching of any person by the dog).
(6) 如果授權官員根據第 (5) 款使用狗進行本條下的搜查，則僅因為狗的行為（包括狗觸摸任何人），使用狗並不違法。
(7) An authorised officer who conducts a search under this section must not use more force against a person or property, or subject a person to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary in order to conduct the search.
(7) 依本條進行搜查的授權官員不得對人員或財產使用比進行搜索合理必要的更多武力，或使人員遭受更大的侮辱。

title: 252BB Searches of certain immigration detention facilities—authorised officers’ assistants
zh: 252BB 對某些移民拘留設施的搜索－授權官員的助理
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Authorised officers may be assisted by other persons
授權人員可以得到其他人的協助
(1) An authorised officer may be assisted by other persons in exercising powers or performing functions or duties in conducting a search under section 252BA (other than under subsection 252BA(4)), or under section 252C, 252CA or 252CB in relation to such a search, if that assistance is necessary and reasonable. A person giving such assistance is the authorised officer’s assistant .
(1) 授權人員在根據第 252BA 條（第 252BA(4) 款除外）或根據第 252C、252CA 或 252CB 條進行搜查時，可以得到其他人的協助，如果這種協助是必要且合理的，則該協助是必要且合理的。提供此類協助的人是授權官員的助理。
Note: Subsection 252BA(4) provides for an authorised officer to use a dog to conduct a search of an immigration detention facility. Sections 252C, 252CA and 252CB deal with the seizure of things in the course of a search under section 252BA and their return in certain circumstances.
注意：第 252BA(4) 款規定授權官員可以使用狗對移民拘留設施進行搜索。第 252C、252CA 和 252CB 條涉及在根據第 252BA 條進行搜查時扣押物品以及在某些情況下返還物品的問題。
Powers of an authorised officer’s assistant
獲授權人員助理的權力
(2) In connection with a search of an immigration detention facility under section 252BA, an authorised officer’s assistant:
(2) 在根據第 252BA 條搜索移民拘留設施時，授權官員的助理：
(a) may enter the facility; and
(a) 可以進入該設施；和
(b) may exercise any of the same powers, and perform any of the same functions and duties, as are conferred on the authorised officer in relation to the search under that section (other than under subsection 252BA(4)) and sections 252C, 252CA and 252CB; and
(b) 可以行使與根據該條（第 252BA(4) 款除外）和第 252C、252CA 和 252CB 條授予授權官員有關搜查的任何相同權力，並履行任何相同職能和職責；和
(c) must do so in accordance with any directions given to the assistant by the authorised officer.
(c) 必須依照授權官員向助理發出的任何指示行事。
(3) A power exercised by an authorised officer’s assistant as mentioned in subsection (2) is taken for all purposes to have been exercised by the authorised officer.
(3)第(2)款中提到的由授權官員的助理行使的權力就所有目的而言均被視為由授權官員行使。
(4) A function or duty performed by an authorised officer’s assistant as mentioned in subsection (2) is taken for all purposes to have been performed by the authorised officer.
（4）第（2）款中提到的由授權官員的助理所履行的職能或職責就所有目的而言均被視為由授權官員履行。
(5) Section 251B applies in relation to the exercise of a power, or the performance of a function or duty, by an authorised officer’s assistant in the same way as it applies in relation to such an exercise or performance by the authorised officer.
(5) 第 251B 條適用於授權官員的助理行使權力或履行職能或職責，其適用方式與授權官員的此類行使或履行相同。
(6) If a direction is given under paragraph (2)(c) in writing, the direction is not a legislative instrument.
(6) 若依第 (2)(c) 款以書面形式發出指示，則該指示並非立法文書。

title: 252C Screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities—seizure (general)
zh: 252C 對被拘留者進行篩檢和脫衣搜查以及設施搜索－扣押（一般）
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Seizure
癲癇發作
(1) Subject to subsection (2), in the course of the conduct of a screening procedure under section 252AA, or of a search under section 252A or 252BA, an authorised officer may seize a thing that:
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，在根據第 252AA 條進行篩選程序或根據第 252A 或 252BA 條進行搜索的過程中，授權官員可以扣押以下物品：
(a) is a weapon or escape aid; or
(a) 是武器或逃脫輔助工具；或
(b) is a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(a); or
(b) 屬於第 251A(2)(a) 條規定的禁止物品；或
(c) is forfeitable to the Commonwealth (otherwise than under subsection (2A)); or
(c) 可沒收給英聯邦（第 (2A) 款規定的情況除外）；或
(d) in any other case—might provide evidence of the commission of an offence against this Act.
(d) 在任何其他情況下－可能提供違反本法的犯罪證據。
Note 1: Section 252AA deals with screening detainees, section 252A deals with strip searches of detainees and section 252BA deals with searches of certain immigration detention facilities.
註 1：第 252AA 條涉及篩選被拘留者，第 252A 條涉及對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查，第 252BA 條涉及對某些移民拘留設施的搜查。
Note 2: Paragraph 251A(2)(a) covers things the possession of which is unlawful.
註 2：第 251A(2)(a) 段涵蓋非法佔有的物品。
(2) If an authorised officer has the power to seize a thing under subsection (1), the officer must seize the thing if a direction under subsection 251B(6) has the effect of requiring the officer to seize the thing.
(2) 若授權官員有權依第 (1) 款扣押某物，且第 251B(6) 款的指示具有要求該官員扣押該物品的效力，則該官員必須扣押該物品。
Forfeiture of seized things
沒收扣押的物品
(2A) The following things are forfeited to the Commonwealth if seized under subsection (1):
(2A) 若依第 (1) 款扣押，下列物品將被沒收給聯邦：
(a) a weapon or escape aid;
(a) 武器或逃脫輔助工具；
(b) a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(a).
(b) 依據第 251A(2)(a) 條所確定的禁止物品。
(3) An authorised officer must not return a thing that is forfeited or forfeitable to the Commonwealth. Instead, the authorised officer must, as soon as practicable, give the thing to a constable (within the meaning of the Crimes Act 1914 ).
(3) 授權官員不得將被沒收或可沒收的物品歸還給聯邦。相反，授權官員必須在可行的情況下盡快將物品交給警察（根據 1914 年《犯罪法》的含義）。
Return of seized things
返還扣押的物品
(4) Section 252CB applies to any thing seized under paragraph (1)(d) after the earliest of the following events happens:
(4) 第 252CB 條適用於下列事件發生後依第 (1)(d) 款扣押的任何物品：
(a) the end of the period of 60 days after the thing was seized, or at the end of a longer period ordered by a magistrate under section 252E, unless proceedings mentioned in paragraph (b) of this subsection are instituted before the end of that period (or that longer period);
(a) 物品被扣押後 60 天的期限結束，或治安法官根據第 252E 條下令的較長期限結束時，除非本款 (b) 段提到的訴訟是在該期限（或該較長期限）結束之前提起的；
(b) proceedings in respect of which the thing might provide evidence (including any appeal to a court in relation to those proceedings) are completed;
(b) 該物可能提供證據的訴訟程序（包括就這些訴訟程序向法院提出的任何上訴）已完成；
(c) it is decided that the thing is not to be used in evidence.
(c) 決定該物品不作為證據。
Note: Section 252CB provides for the return of things seized under paragraph (1)(d) of this section and section 252CA.
註：第 252CB 條規定返還依本條第 (1)(d) 款及第 252CA 條扣押的物品。
(5) Despite subsection (4), section 252CB does not apply to a thing if an authorised officer is authorised (by a law, or an order of a court or a tribunal, of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory), otherwise than under this section, to retain, destroy or dispose of the thing.
(5) 儘管有第 (4) 款的規定，如果授權官員被授權（根據聯邦、州或領地的法律或法院或法庭的命令），除本條規定外，保留、銷毀或處置該物品，則第 252CB 條不適用於該物品。

title: 252CA Screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities—seizure of certain prohibited things
zh: 252CA 對被拘留者進行篩檢和脫衣搜查以及設施搜查－扣押某些違禁物品
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Scope—certain prohibited things
範圍－某些禁止的事物
(1) This section applies in relation to a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b), unless subsection 252C(1) applies in relation to the prohibited thing.
(1) 本條適用於依第 251A(2)(b) 段所確定的禁止物品，除非第 252C(1) 款適用於該禁止物品。
Note 1: Paragraph 251A(2)(b) covers the determination of a thing as a prohibited thing if the Minister is satisfied that its possession or use in an immigration detention facility might be a risk to the health, safety or security of persons in the facility, or to the order of the facility.
註 1：第 251A(2)(b) 段涵蓋瞭如果部長信納移民拘留設施中擁有或使用某物可能對設施內人員的健康、安全或保障或設施的秩序構成風險，則將其確定為違禁物。
Note 2: For the seizure of other things obtained by screening detainees, by a strip search of detainees or by a search of certain immigration detention facilities, see section 252C.
註 2：對於透過篩選被拘留者、對被拘留者進行脫衣搜查或搜索某些移民拘留設施而獲得的其他物品的扣押，請參閱第 252C 條。
Seizure
癲癇發作
(2) Subject to subsection (4), in the course of the conduct of a screening procedure under section 252AA, or of a search under section 252A or 252BA, an authorised officer may seize a thing to which this section applies.
（2）根據第（4）款，在根據第 252AA 條進行篩選程序或根據第 252A 或 252BA 條進行搜索的過程中，授權官員可以扣押本條適用的物品。
(3) However, subsection (2) does not authorise the seizure of a medication or health care supplement in the course of a search under section 252BA if there are reasonable grounds for an authorised officer conducting the search to consider that:
(3) 然而，如果進行搜索的授權官員有合理理由認為：
(a) the medication or supplement is possessed or controlled by a particular detainee; and
(a) 藥物或補充劑由特定被拘留者擁有或控制；和
(b) the medication or supplement is not a prohibited thing in relation to the particular detainee because of subsection 251A(3).
(b) 根據第 251A(3) 款，對於特定被拘留者來說，藥物或補充劑不是禁止物品。
Note: Section 252BA deals with searches of certain immigration detention facilities. Subsection 251A(3) deals with medications and health care supplements that are prescribed or supplied for a person’s individual use.
注意：第 252BA 條涉及對某些移民拘留設施的搜索。第 251A(3) 款涉及為個人使用而開立或提供的藥物和保健補充劑。
(4) If an authorised officer has the power to seize a thing under subsection (2), the officer must seize the thing if a direction under subsection 251B(6) has the effect of requiring the officer to seize the thing.
(4) 如果授權官員有權根據第 (2) 款扣押某物，且第 251B(6) 款下的指示具有要求該官員扣押該物品的效力，則該官員必須扣押該物品。
Note 1: An authorised officer does not have the power to seize a medication or health care supplement under subsection (2) if subsection (3) applies in relation to the medication or supplement.
註 1：如果第 (3) 款適用於藥物或保健補充劑，授權人員無權根據第 (2) 款扣押藥物或保健補充劑。
Note 2: An authorised officer has the power to seize a prohibited thing under subsection (2) only if the exercise of the power is authorised under subsection 251AA(3) (which relates to preventing or lessening immigration detention facility risks).
註 2：只有在第 251AA(3) 款（涉及預防或減輕移民拘留設施風險）授權行使該權力的情況下，授權官員才有權根據第 (2) 款扣押違禁物品。
Note 3: A prohibited thing that is seized under subsection (2) may be returned to a detainee, temporarily or indefinitely, before the detainee ceases to be in detention (see subsections 251AA(4), (5) and (6)).
註 3：依第 (2) 款扣押的違禁物品可以在被拘留者停止拘留之前暫時或無限期地歸還給被拘留者（見第 251AA(4)、(5) 和 (6) 款）。
Return of seized things
返還扣押的物品
(5) Section 252CB applies to a thing that is seized under subsection (2) of this section.
(5) 第 252CB 條適用於依本條第 (2) 款扣押的物品。
Note: Section 252CB provides for the return of things seized under this section and of certain things seized under section 252C.
註：第 252CB 條規定退還依本條扣押的物品以及依第 252C 條扣押的某些物品。

title: 252CB Screening and strip searches of detainees and searches of facilities—return of seized things
zh: 252CB 對被拘留者進行篩檢和脫衣搜查以及設施搜查——歸還扣押的物品
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Reasonable steps to return seized things
歸還被扣押物品的合理步驟
(1) If this section applies, because of subsection 252C(4) or 252CA(5), in relation to a thing that has been seized under paragraph 252C(1)(d) or subsection 252CA(2), an authorised officer:
(1) 若本條因第 252C(4) 或 252CA(5) 款而適用於依第 252C(1)(d) 款或第 252CA(2) 款扣押的物品，則授權人員：
(a) must, if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a detainee, take all reasonable steps to return it to the detainee when that detainee ceases to be in detention; and
(a) 如果該物品似乎由被拘留者擁有或控制，則必須在被拘留者不再被拘留時採取一切合理步驟將其返還給被拘留者；和
(b) must, if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a person other than a detainee, take all reasonable steps to return it to the person.
(b) 如果該物品似乎由被拘留者以外的人擁有或控制，則必須採取一切合理措施將其返還給該人。
Note 1: This section applies to a thing seized under paragraph 252C(1)(d) because it might provide evidence of the commission of an offence under this Act. This section also applies to a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) that is seized under subsection 252CA(2).
註 1：本節適用於根據第 252C(1)(d) 段扣押的物品，因為它可能提供實施本法規定的犯罪的證據。本條也適用於依第 251A(2)(b) 段所認定並依第 252CA(2) 款扣押的違禁物品。
Note 2: A prohibited thing that is seized under subsection 252CA(2) may be returned to a detainee, temporarily or indefinitely, before the detainee ceases to be in detention (see subsections 251AA(4), (5) and (6)).
註 2：依第 252CA(2) 款扣押的違禁物品可以在被拘留者停止拘留之前暫時或無限期地歸還給被拘留者（參見第 251AA(4)、(5) 和 (6) 款）。
Forfeiture and disposal of seized things if they cannot be returned
如果無法歸還，則沒收和處置扣押的物品
(2) However, the thing is forfeited to the Commonwealth if, after taking all reasonable steps to return it under paragraph (1)(a) or (b) of this section, the authorised officer considers on reasonable grounds that:
(2) 但是，如果在根據本條第 (1)(a) 或 (b) 款採取一切合理步驟歸還物品後，授權官員基於合理理由認為：
(a) its owner or the person who last controlled the thing cannot be identified; or
(a) 無法辨識其所有者或最後控制該物品的人；或
(b) the thing is abandoned; or
(b) 該物品被遺棄；或
(c) if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a detainee—the thing cannot be returned to the detainee when the detainee ceases to be in detention; or
(c) 若該物品似乎由被拘留者擁有或控制－當被拘留者不再被拘留時，該物品不能歸還給被拘留者；或
(d) if it appears that the thing is owned or was controlled by a person other than a detainee—the thing cannot be returned to the person.
(d) 如果該物品似乎由被拘留者以外的其他人擁有或控制－則該物品不能歸還給該人。
(3) If a prohibited thing is forfeited under subsection (2), the authorised officer may dispose of it in any way the officer thinks appropriate.
(3) 若依第 (2) 款規定沒收違禁物品，授權官員可以以其認為適當的任何方式處置該物品。

title: 252D Retention of certain seized things for extended period—application for order by magistrate
zh: 第 252D 條 延長扣留某些物品－向裁判官申請命令
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) This section applies if an authorised officer seized a thing under paragraph 252C(1)(d) and proceedings in respect of which the thing might provide evidence have not commenced before the end of:
(1) 如果授權人員根據第 252C(1)(d) 段扣押了物品，並且該物品可能提供證據的訴訟程序在下列時間結束之前尚未開始，則本條適用：
(a) 60 days after the authorised officer seizes the thing; or
(a) 授權人員扣押該物品後 60 天；或
(b) a period previously specified in an order of a magistrate under section 252E.
(b) 先前根據第 252E 條由治安法官發出的命令中指定的期限。
(2) The authorised officer may apply to a magistrate for an order that the officer may retain the thing for a further period.
(2) 授權官員可以向治安法官申請命令，允許該官員進一步保留該物品。
(3) Before making the application, the authorised officer must:
(3) 在提出申請之前，授權人員必須：
(a) take reasonable steps to discover which persons’ interests would be affected by the retention of the thing; and
(a) 採取合理措施來發現哪些人的利益會因保留該物品而受到影響；和
(b) if it is practicable to do so, notify each person who the authorised officer believes to be such a person of the proposed application.
(b) 如果可行的話，將擬議的申請通知授權官員認為是這樣的人的每個人。

title: 252E Retention of certain seized things for extended period—order by magistrate
zh: 252E 長期保留某些被扣押的物品－治安法官的命令
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The magistrate may order that the authorised officer who made an application under section 252D may retain the thing if the magistrate is satisfied that it is necessary for the authorised officer to do so:
(1) 如果治安法官認為授權官員有必要這樣做，則治安法官可以命令根據第 252D 條提出申請的授權官員可以保留該物品：
(a) for the purposes of an investigation as to whether an offence has been committed; or
(a) 為了調查是否有犯罪行為；或
(b) to enable evidence of an offence to be secured for the purposes of a prosecution.
(b) 為起訴目的取得犯罪證據。
(2) The order must specify the period for which the authorised officer may retain the thing.
(2) 命令必須指定授權人員可以保留該物品的期限。
(3) A power conferred on a magistrate by this section is conferred on the magistrate in a personal capacity and not as a court or a member of a court.
(3) 本條授予治安法官的權力是以個人身分而非法院或法院成員的身分授予治安法官的。
(4) The magistrate need not accept the power conferred.
(4) 裁判官不必接受所授予的權力。
(5) A magistrate exercising a power under this section has the same protection and immunity as if he or she were exercising that power as, or as a member of, the court of which the magistrate is a member.
(5) 依據本條行使權力的治安法官享有與以其所在法院或其成員行使該權力相同的保護和豁免權。

title: 252F Detainees held in State or Territory prisons or remand centres
zh: 252F 州或地區監獄或還押中心關押的被拘留者
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) This section applies to a detainee if:
(1) 本條適用於被拘留者，如果：
(a) he or she is held in immigration detention in a prison or remand centre of a State or Territory; and
(a) 他或她被關押在州或地區的監獄或還押中心的移民拘留中；和
(b) a law of that State or Territory confers a power to search persons, or things in the possession of persons, serving sentences or being held in the prison or remand centre.
(b) 該州或地區的法律賦予搜索正在服刑或被關押在監獄或還押中心的人員或人員所擁有的物品的權力。
(2) To the extent that the State or Territory law confers that power, or affects the exercise of that power, it applies to the detainee as though it were a law of the Commonwealth.
(2) 如果州或地區法律授予該權力，或影響該權力的行使，則該權力適用於被拘留者，就如同其是聯邦法律一樣。
(3) Sections 252AA and 252A of this Act do not apply to a detainee to whom this section applies.
(3) 本法第 252AA 和 252A 條不適用於本條適用的被拘留者。

title: 252G Persons entering immigration detention facilities—screening powers
zh: 252G 進入移民拘留設施的人員－篩選權
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) An officer may request that a person about to enter an immigration detention facility operated by or on behalf of the Commonwealth do one or more of the following:
(1) 官員可以要求即將進入由聯邦或代表聯邦運營的移民拘留設施的人執行以下一項或多項操作：
(a) walk through screening equipment;
(a) 走過篩選設備；
(b) allow an officer to pass hand ‑ held screening equipment over or around the person or around things in the person’s possession;
(b) 允許官員將手持式篩選設備從該人上方或周圍或該人所擁有的物品周圍通過；
(c) allow things in the person’s possession to pass through screening equipment or to be examined by X ‑ ray.
(c) 允許該人擁有的物品通過安檢設備或接受 X 光檢查。
(1A) An officer may make a request to a person under subsection (1) whether or not, before making the request, the officer has any suspicion that there is in the person’s possession a thing mentioned in subsection (3).
(1A) 官員可以根據第 (1) 款向某人提出請求，無論在提出請求之前該官員是否懷疑該人擁有第 (3) 款中提到的物品。
(2) Screening equipment means a metal detector or similar device for detecting objects or particular substances.
(2) 檢查設備是指用於偵測物體或特定物質的金屬探測器或類似裝置。
(3) An authorised officer may request that a person do something under subsection (4) if the person is about to enter an immigration detention facility operated by or on behalf of the Commonwealth, and the officer suspects on reasonable grounds that there is in the person’s possession:
(3) 如果該人即將進入由聯邦或代表聯邦運營的移民拘留設施，並且授權官員有合理理由懷疑該人持有以下物品，則授權官員可以要求該人根據第 (4) 款採取行動：
(a) a thing that:
(a) 某事物：
(i) might endanger the safety of the detainees, staff or other persons at the facility; or
(i) 可能危及設施內被拘留者、工作人員或其他人員的安全；或
(ii) might disrupt the order or security arrangements at the facility; or
(ii) 可能擾亂設施的秩序或安全安排；或
(b) a prohibited thing.
(b) 禁止的事物。
(3A) A request may be made under subsection (4) that a person do something whether or not a request is also made under subsection (1) that the person do something.
(3A) 可以根據第 (4) 款提出要求某人做某事的請求，無論是否也根據第 (1) 款提出要求該人做某事的請求。
(4) An authorised officer may request that the person do one or more of the following:
(4) 授權官員可以要求該人執行以下一項或多項操作：
(a) allow the authorised officer to inspect the things in the person’s possession;
(a) 允許授權人員檢查該人所擁有的物品；
(b) remove some or all of the person’s outer clothing such as a coat, jacket or similar item;
(b) 脫掉該人的部分或全部外衣，例如外套、夾克或類似物品；
(c) remove items from the pockets of the person’s clothing;
(c) 從該人的衣服口袋中取出物品；
(d) open a thing in the person’s possession, or remove the thing’s contents, to allow the authorised officer to inspect the thing or its contents;
(d) 打開該人所佔有的物品，或取出該物品的內容物，以允許授權人員檢查該物品或其內容物；
(e) leave a thing in the person’s possession, or some or all of its contents, in a place specified by the authorised officer, if the officer suspects on reasonable grounds that the thing or anything in its contents:
(e) 若授權官員有合理理由懷疑該物品或其內容物：
(i) might endanger the safety of the detainees, staff or other persons at the immigration detention facility; or
(i) 可能危及移民拘留設施中被拘留者、工作人員或其他人員的安全；或
(ii) might disrupt the order or security arrangements at the facility; or
(ii) 可能擾亂設施的秩序或安全安排；或
(iii) is a prohibited thing.
(iii) 是禁止的事情。
(5) Subject to subsections (6) and (6A), a person who leaves a thing (including any of its contents) in a place specified by an authorised officer is entitled to its return when the person leaves the immigration detention facility.
(5) 根據第 (6) 和 (6A) 款，將物品（包括其任何內容物）留在授權官員指定地點的人有權在離開移民拘留設施時將其歸還。
(6) If possession of the thing, or any of those contents, by the person is unlawful under a Commonwealth law or in the State or Territory in which the immigration detention facility is located:
(6) 如果根據聯邦法律或在移民拘留設施所在的州或地區，該人擁有該物品或其中任何內容是非法的：
(a) the thing or the contents must not be returned to the person; and
(a) 物品或內容物不得退還給該人；和
(b) an authorised officer must, as soon as practicable, give the thing or the contents to a constable (within the meaning of the Crimes Act 1914 ).
(b) 授權官員必須在可行的情況下盡快將物品或內容物交給警察（根據 1914 年《犯罪法》的含義）。
(6A) If a person leaves a prohibited thing determined under paragraph 251A(2)(b) in a place as mentioned in subsection (5) of this section, it is forfeited to the Commonwealth if an authorised officer considers on reasonable grounds, after taking all reasonable steps to return the thing to the person for the purposes of subsection (5), that:
(6A) 如果某人將根據第 251A(2)(b) 款確定的違禁物品留在本條第 (5) 款所述的地點，且授權官員在出於第 (5) 款的目的採取一切合理步驟將該物品歸還給該人後，基於合理理由認為，該物品將被聯邦沒收：
(a) its owner or a person who controls the thing cannot be identified; or
(a) 無法辨識其所有者或控制該物品的人；或
(b) the thing is abandoned; or
(b) 該物品被遺棄；或
(c) the thing otherwise cannot be returned to the person.
(c) 否則該物品不能退還給該人。
Note: Paragraph 251A(2)(b) covers the determination of a thing as a prohibited thing if the Minister is satisfied that its possession or use in an immigration detention facility might be a risk to the health, safety or security of persons in the facility, or to the order of the facility.
註：第 251A(2)(b) 段涵蓋瞭如果部長信納移民拘留設施中擁有或使用某物可能對設施內人員的健康、安全或保障或設施的秩序構成風險，則將其確定為違禁物。
(6B) If a prohibited thing is forfeited under subsection (6A), the authorised officer may dispose of it in any way the officer thinks appropriate.
(6B) 如果根據第 (6A) 款規定沒收違禁物品，授權官員可以以其認為適當的任何方式處置該物品。
(7) A person who is about to enter an immigration detention facility may be refused entry if he or she does not comply with a request under this section.
(7) 即將進入移民拘留設施的人如果不遵守本節規定的請求，可能會被拒絕入境。

title: 253 Detention of deportee
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) Where an order for the deportation of a person is in force, an officer may, without warrant, detain a person whom the officer reasonably supposes to be that person.
(1) 如果驅逐令生效，官員可以在沒有逮捕令的情況下拘留該官員合理認為是該人的人。
(2) A person detained under subsection (1) or (10) may, subject to this section, be kept in immigration detention or in detention as a deportee in accordance with subsection (8).
(2) 依第 (1) 或 (10) 款被拘留的人，可依本節的規定，被拘留在移民拘留所或依第 (8) 款作為被驅逐者拘留。
(3) Where an officer detains a person under subsection (1) or (10), the officer shall forthwith inform the person of the reason for the detention and shall, if that person so requests, furnish to him or her, as soon as practicable, particulars of the deportation order.
(3) 若官員依第 (1) 或 (10) 款拘留某人，該官員應立即告知該人拘留的原因，並應在該人提出要求時，盡快向他或她提供驅逐令的詳細資料。
(4) If a person detained under this section (in this subsection called the detained person ) claims, within 48 hours after the detention and while the detained person is detention, that he or she is not the person in respect of whom the deportation order is in force, the person to whom the claim is made shall:
(4) 如果根據本條被拘留的人（在本款中稱為被拘留人）在拘留後 48 小時內且在被拘留人被拘留期間聲稱他或她不是驅逐令對其生效的人，則接受索賠的人應：
(a) if that last ‑ mentioned person is an officer—ask the detained person; or
(a) 如果最後提到的人是官員－詢問被拘留者；或
(b) in any other case—cause an officer to ask the detained person;
(b) 在任何其他情況下－促使官員詢問被拘留者；
to make a statutory declaration to that effect, and, if the person detained makes such a declaration, the officer who asked him or her to make the declaration shall take him or her before a prescribed authority within 48 hours after the making of the declaration, or, if it is not practicable to take him or her before a prescribed authority within that time, as soon as practicable after the expiration of that period.
為此目的作出法定聲明，如果被拘留者作出了這樣的聲明，要求其作出聲明的官員應在做出聲明後 48 小時內將其帶到規定的當局，或者，如果在該時間內無法將其帶到規定的當局，則應在該期限屆滿後儘快將其帶到規定的當局。
(5) If a detained person who is required under subsection (4) to be brought before a prescribed authority within a particular period, is not so brought before a prescribed authority, the person shall be released.
(5) 若依第 (4) 款要求在特定期限內將被拘留者帶見規定當局，但未將其帶見規定當局，則應釋放該人。
(6) Where a person is brought before a prescribed authority under this section, the prescribed authority shall inquire into the question whether there are reasonable grounds for supposing that that person is a deportee and, if the prescribed authority is satisfied that there are such reasonable grounds, the prescribed authority shall, by writing under his or her hand, declare accordingly.
(6) 當一個人根據本條被帶到指定當局面前時，指定當局應調查是否有合理理由假定該人是被驅逐者的問題，如果指定當局確信有這種合理理由，則指定當局應以書面形式作出相應聲明。
(7) Where a prescribed authority makes a declaration in accordance with subsection (6), the detained person may be held in detention as a deportee in accordance with subsection (8), but otherwise the prescribed authority shall direct the release of that person and he or she shall be released accordingly.
(7) 若規定機關依第 (6) 款作出聲明，被拘留者可依第 (8) 款作為被驅逐者被拘留，但規定機關應指示釋放該人，並應相應釋放。
(8) A deportee may be kept in immigration detention or such detention as the Minister, Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner directs:
(8) 被驅逐者可被拘留在移民拘留所或部長、秘書或澳洲邊境部隊專員指示的拘留所：
(a) pending deportation, until he or she is placed on board a vessel for deportation;
(a) 等待驅逐出境，直到他或她被安置在船上等待驅逐；
(b) at any port or place in Australia at which the vessel calls after he or she has been placed on board; or
(b) 在船舶安置在船上後停靠的澳洲任何港口或地點；或
(c) on board the vessel until its departure from its last port or place of call in Australia.
(c) 船上直至其離開澳洲的最後一個港口或停靠地。
(9) In spite of anything else in this section, the Minister, Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may at any time order the release (either unconditionally or subject to specified conditions) of a person who is in detention under this section.
(9) 無論本條有其他規定，部長、部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可隨時下令釋放（無條件或符合特定條件）依本條被拘留的人。
(10) An officer may, without warrant, detain a person who:
(10) 官員可以在沒有逮捕證的情況下拘留下列人員：
(a) has been released from detention under subsection (9) subject to conditions; and
(a) 已根據第(9)款的規定從拘留中釋放，但有條件；和
(b) has breached any of those conditions.
(b) 違反了任何這些條件。
(11) Nothing contained in, or done under, this section prevents the Supreme Court of a State or Territory or the High Court from ordering the release from detention of a person held in detention under this section where the Court finds that there is no valid deportation order in force in relation to that person.
(11) 如果州或地區最高法院或高等法院認為不存在與該人有關的有效驅逐令，則本條中包含的任何內容或根據本條採取的任何措施均不得下令釋放根據本條被拘留的人。

title: 254 Removees and deportees held in other custody
zh: 254 被其他拘留所關押的被驅逐者和被驅逐者
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) This section applies if a person is a removee or a deportee and is in the custody of an authority of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory, otherwise than under this Act.
(1) 若一個人是被驅逐者或被驅逐者，並由聯邦、州或領地當局監管（本法規定除外），則本節適用。
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may give the person written notice:
(2) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可向該人發出書面通知：
(a) if the person is a deportee:
(a) 若該人是被驅逐者：
(i) stating that a deportation order has been made; and
(i) 聲明已發出驅逐令；和
(ii) setting out particulars of the deportation order; and
(ii) 列出驅逐令的詳情；和
(b) if the person is a removee—stating that the person is to be removed; and
(b) 若該人是被驅逐者－表示該人將被驅逐；和
(c) in any case—stating that, from the time when the person would otherwise be entitled to be released from the custody referred to in subsection (1) (the custody transfer time ), the person will be kept in immigration detention.
(c) 在任何情況下－說明，從該人有權從第 (1) 款中提到的拘留中釋放的時間（拘留轉移時間）起，該人將被移民拘留。
(2A) If a removee is given notice under subsection (2):
(2A) 若依第 (2) 款向被驅逐者發出通知：
(a) the authority who has custody of the removee immediately before the custody transfer time is taken from the custody transfer time to be an officer for the purposes of the application of Division 7 of Part 2 in relation to the removee; and
(a) 出於適用第 2 部分第 7 節與被轉移者相關的目的，在託管轉移時間之前對被轉移者進行監護的當局從託管轉移時間起被視為官員；和
(b) the removee is taken from the custody transfer time to be detained by the authority in the capacity of such an officer in the exercise of the powers conferred by that Division.
(b) 被移送者不再被當局以此類官員的身份行使該部門授予的權力而拘留。
(3) If a deportee is given notice under subsection (2):
(3) 若依第 (2) 款向被驅逐者發出通知：
(a) the authority who has custody of the deportee immediately before the custody transfer time is taken from the custody transfer time to be an officer for the purposes of the application of subsection 253(1) in relation to the deportee; and
(a) 為適用第 253(1) 款與被驅逐者有關的目的，在監管移交時間之前對被驅逐者進行監管的當局從監管移交時間起被視為官員；和
(b) the deportee is taken from the custody transfer time to be detained by the authority in the capacity of such an officer in the exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 253(1); and
(b) 當局以此類官員的身份行使第 253(1) 款賦予的權力，將被驅逐者從拘留移交時間中取出；和
(c) subsection 253(3) does not apply in relation to the deportee.
(c) 第 253(3) 條不適用於被驅逐者。

title: 255 Prescribed authorities
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The Minister may appoint as a prescribed authority for the purposes of section 253 a person who is or has been a Judge of a Federal Court or of the Supreme Court of a State or Territory or a barrister or solicitor of the High Court or of the Supreme Court of a State of not less than 5 years’ standing.
(1) 部長可以為第 253 條的目的任命一名現任或曾經擔任聯邦法院或州或領地最高法院法官的人，或者任職不少於 5 年的高等法院或州最高法院的出庭律師或事務律師，作為規定的權力機構。
(2) The Governor ‑ General may arrange with the Governor ‑ in ‑ Council of a State for the performance by persons who hold office as Police, Stipendiary or Special Magistrates in that State of the functions of a prescribed authority under section 253.
(2) 總督可以與州總督會同州議會作出安排，讓在該州擔任警察、領薪官或特別治安法官的人員履行第 253 條規定的權力機構的職能。
(3) Notice of an arrangement under subsection (2) shall be published in the Gazette .
(3) 第 (2) 款規定的安排公告應在公報上公佈。
(4) Where an arrangement under subsection (2) is in force, a person who holds an office specified in the arrangement is a prescribed authority for the purposes of section 253.
(4) 當第 (2) 款規定的安排生效時，擔任該安排中指定職位的人是第 253 條所指的規定當局。
(5) A person who holds office as a Police, Stipendiary or Special Magistrate of a Territory is a prescribed authority for the purposes of section 253.
(5) 就第 253 條而言，擔任警察、領俸官或特別法官的人是規定的權力人。
(6) A prescribed authority shall make a thorough investigation of the matter which he or she is required to inquire into, without regard to legal forms, and shall not be bound by any rules of evidence but may inform himself or herself on any relevant matter in such manner as he or she thinks fit.
(6) 規定的機關應對其需要調查的事項進行徹底調查，不論其法律形式如何，並且不受任何證據規則的約束，但可以以其認為適當的方式告知自己任何有關事項。

title: 256 Person in immigration detention may have access to certain advice, facilities etc.
zh: 256 被移民拘留的人可以獲得某些建議、設施等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
Where a person is in immigration detention under this Act, the person responsible for his or her immigration detention shall, at the request of the person in immigration detention, give to him or her application forms for a visa or afford to him or her all reasonable facilities for making a statutory declaration for the purposes of this Act or for obtaining legal advice or taking legal proceedings in relation to his or her immigration detention.
當一個人根據本法被移民拘留時，負責其移民拘留的人應根據被移民拘留者的要求，向其提供簽證申請表，或向其提供一切合理的便利，以便就本法的目的作出法定聲明，或就其移民拘留獲得法律建議或提起法律訴訟。

title: 257 Persons may be required to answer questions
zh: 第257章 可能需要人回答問題
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) For the purpose of determining whether a person who is in immigration detention under this Act is an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee, an officer may put to that person such questions as the officer considers necessary and may move that person from place to place.
(1) 為了確定根據本法被移民拘留的人是否為非法非公民、被驅逐者或被驅逐者，官員可以向該人提出其認為必要的問題，並可以將該人從一個地方轉移到另一個地方。
(2) Where an officer puts a question to a person in accordance with subsection (1) after having informed that person that he or she is required to answer the question, that person shall not:
(2) 若官員在通知某人他或她需要回答問題後根據第 (1) 款向該人提出問題，則該人不得：
(a) refuse or fail to answer the question; or
(a) 拒絕或未能回答問題；或
(b) in answer to the question, make a statement which is false or misleading in a material particular.
(b) 在回答問題時，在重要細節上作出虛假或誤導性的陳述。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months.
處罰：監禁 6 個月。
(2A) An offence against subsection (2) is an offence of strict liability.
(2A) 違反第 (2) 款的犯罪是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。
(3) Where subsection (2) is applicable in relation to a question put to a person, that person is not excused from answering the question on the ground that the answer might tend to incriminate him or her, but the answer to the question shall not be used as evidence against that person in any proceedings other than proceedings under that subsection.
(3) 當第(2)款適用於向某人提出的問題時，該人不得以該答案可能導致他或她入罪為由而免於回答該問題，但該問題的答案不得在該款規定以外的任何訴訟中用作對該人不利的證據。

title: 257A Person may be required to provide personal identifiers
zh: 257A 人可能需要提供個人識別資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) Subject to subsection (3), the Minister or an officer may, in writing or orally, require a person to provide one or more personal identifiers for the purposes of this Act or the regulations.
(1) 根據第 (3) 款，部長或官員可以書面或口頭形式要求個人提供一個或多個個人身份識別信息，以用於本法或法規的目的。
(2) Without limiting subsection (1), the purposes referred to in that subsection include any of the purposes referred to in subsection 5A(3).
(2) 在不限制第 (1) 款的情況下，該款中提到的目的包括第 5A(3) 款中提到的任何目的。
Only citizens entering Australia etc. may be required to provide personal identifiers
只有進入澳大利亞等的公民可能需要提供個人身份識別信息
(3) If the Minister or officer knows or reasonably believes that a person is a citizen, the person must not be required to provide one or more personal identifiers under subsection (1) unless section 166, 170 or 175 applies in relation to the person.
(3) 如果部長或官員知道或有理由相信某人是公民，則不得要求該人根據第 (1) 款提供一個或多個個人身份識別信息，除非第 166、170 或 175 條適用於該人。
When requirement under subsection (1) must be made
何時必須提出第(1)款的要求
(4) The Minister or an officer must require a person to provide one or more personal identifiers under subsection (1) if prescribed circumstances exist.
(4) 如有規定情況，部長或官員必須根據第 (1) 款要求個人提供一個或多個個人識別資訊。
How personal identifiers must be provided
必須如何提供個人識別資訊
(5) If a person is required to provide one or more personal identifiers under subsection (1), those personal identifiers must be:
(5) 如果一個人根據第 (1) 款被要求提供一個或多個個人標識符，這些個人標識符必須是：
(a) provided by way of one or more identification tests carried out by an authorised officer or an authorised system; or
(a) 透過由授權人員或授權系統進行的一項或多項身分測試提供；或
(b) if another way is specified by the Minister or officer—provided in that specified way.
(b) 如果部長或官員指定了其他方式－以該指定方式提供。
Note: If the types of identification tests that the authorised officer may carry out are specified under section 5D, then each identification test must be of a type so specified.
附註：如果第 5D 條規定了授權人員可以進行的識別測試的類型，則每次識別測試必須屬於如此指定的類型。
(6) If paragraph (5)(b) applies, the person must comply with any requirements specified by the Minister or officer in providing one or more personal identifiers in the way specified under that paragraph.
(6) 若第 (5)(b) 款適用，則此人必須遵守部長或官員規定的任何要求，以該款規定的方式提供一個或多個個人識別資訊。
Multiple requirements for personal identifiers may be made
可能會對個人識別碼提出多項要求
(7) A person may be required to provide one or more personal identifiers under subsection (1):
(7) 根據第 (1) 款，一個人可能需要提供一個或多個個人識別資訊：
(a) more than once; and
(a) 超過一次；和
(b) whether or not the person has previously complied with a requirement under this Act or the regulations to provide one or more personal identifiers.
(b) 該人之前是否遵守本法或法規的要求，提供一個或多個個人識別資訊。
Other provisions not limited or otherwise affected
不受限製或以其他方式影響的其他規定
(8) This section does not limit, or otherwise affect, any other provision of this Act under which a personal identifier may be required, provided or presented.
(8) 本節不限製或以其他方式影響本法中可能要求、提供或出示個人識別碼的任何其他規定。

title: 258 Minister may determine that specified persons are not to be required to provide personal identifiers etc.
zh: 258 部長可以決定不要求特定人員提供個人識別資訊等。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
The Minister may determine, by legislative instrument, that:
部長可以透過立法文書確定：
(a) a specified person, or a person included in a specified class of persons, must not be required to provide under section 257A:
(a) 不得要求特定人員或特定類別人員中的人員依第 257A 條提供：
(i) any personal identifiers; or
(i) 任何個人識別資料；或
(ii) one or more specified kinds of personal identifiers; or
(ii) 一種或多種指定類型的個人識別碼；或
(b) a specified person, or a person included in a specified class of persons, must not be required in specified circumstances to provide under section 257A:
(b) 不得要求特定人員或特定類別人員中的人員在特定情況下依第 257A 條提供：
(i) any personal identifiers; or
(i) 任何個人識別資料；或
(ii) one or more specified kinds of personal identifiers.
(ii) 一種或多種指定類型的個人識別碼。

title: 258A When detainees must not be required to provide personal identifiers under section 257A
zh: 258A 根據第 257A 條，不得要求被拘留者提供個人識別資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
A person must not be required to provide a personal identifier under section 257A if:
在以下情況下，不得要求個人根據第 257A 條提供個人識別資訊：
(a) the person is in immigration detention (but not only because he or she is detained for questioning detention (see section 192)); and
(a) 該人被移民拘留（但不僅是因為他或她因詢問拘留而被拘留（見第 192 條））；和
(b) the person has, during that detention, provided a personal identifier of that type under Division 13AA.
(b) 該人在拘留期間根據第 13AA 條提供了該類型的個人識別資訊。

title: 258B Information to be provided—authorised officers carrying out identification tests
zh: 258B 須提供的資訊－授權人員進行身分識別測試
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) Before an authorised officer carries out an identification test on a person for the purposes of section 257A, the authorised officer must inform the person of such matters as are prescribed.
(1) 在授權人員為第 257A 條之目的對某人進行身分識別測試之前，授權人員必須將規定的事項告知該人。
(2) For the purposes of subsection (1), the authorised officer informs the person of a matter if the authorised officer informs the person of the matter, through an interpreter if necessary, in a language (including sign language or braille) in which the person is able to communicate with reasonable fluency.
(2) 就第 (1) 款而言，如果授權官員透過口譯員（如有必要）以該人能夠相當流利地交流的語言（包括手語或點字）向該人告知該事項，則該授權官員將該事項告知該人。
(3) The authorised officer may comply with this section by giving to the person, in accordance with the regulations, a form setting out the information specified in the regulations. However, the information must be in a language (including braille) in which the person is able to communicate with reasonable fluency.
(3) 授權官員可以按照本規定向該人提供一份表格，其中列出了規定中規定的信息，從而遵守本節規定。但是，該資訊必須採用該人能夠以合理流利程度進行溝通的語言（包括點字）。

title: 258D Regulations may prescribe manner for carrying out identification tests
zh: 258D 法規可以規定進行識別測試的方式
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The regulations may prescribe the manner in which an identification test is to be carried out on a person under section 257A.
(1) 法規可以規定根據第 257A 條對人員進行身分識別測試的方式。
(2) The regulations may prescribe the procedure and requirements that apply if a personal identifier is provided under section 257A by the person otherwise than by way of an identification test.
(2) 如果個人根據第 257A 條以除身份測試以外的方式提供個人身份識別信息，則法規可以規定適用的程序和要求。

title: 258E General rules for carrying out identification tests
zh: 258E 進行鑑定測試的一般規則
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
An identification test that an authorised officer carries out under section 257A:
授權人員根據第 257A 條進行的識別測試：
(a) must be carried out in circumstances affording reasonable privacy to the person; and
(a) 必須在為該人提供合理隱私的情況下進行；和
(b) must not be carried out in the presence or view of a person whose presence is not necessary for the purposes of the identification test or required or permitted by another provision of this Act; and
(b) 不得在身分測試所不需要的人員在場或在場的情況下進行，或本法其他條款要求或允許的人員在場；和
(c) must not involve the removal of more clothing than is necessary for carrying out the test; and
(c) 脫除的衣物不得超過進行測試所需的衣物；和
(d) must not involve more visual inspection than is necessary for carrying out the test.
(d) 目視檢查不得超出進行測試所需的範圍。

title: 258F Person must not be required to provide personal identifiers in a cruel, inhuman or degrading way etc.
zh: 258F 不得以殘忍、不人道或有辱人格的方式要求個人提供個人識別資訊。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
For the purposes of this Act, a requirement to provide a personal identifier, or the provision of a personal identifier, in a particular way under section 257A is not of itself taken:
就本法而言，第 257A 條規定的提供個人識別碼的要求或以特定方式提供個人識別碼本身並不適用：
(a) to be cruel, inhuman or degrading; or
(a) 殘忍、不人道或有辱人格；或
(b) to be a failure to treat a person with humanity and with respect for human dignity.
(b) 未能以人性和尊重人的尊嚴對待他人。
However, nothing in this Act authorises the Minister or an officer to require a person to provide a personal identifier under section 257A in a cruel, inhuman or degrading way, or in a way that fails to treat the person with humanity and with respect for human dignity.
然而，本法中沒有任何內容授權部長或官員根據第 257A 條要求某人以殘忍、不人道或有辱人格的方式，或以不人道和尊重人的尊嚴的方式提供個人身份識別資訊。

title: 258G Authorised officer may get help to carry out identification tests
zh: 258G 授權人員可能會獲得協助來進行身分識別測試
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
An authorised officer may ask another authorised officer or an officer to help him or her to carry out the identification test, and the other person may give that help.
授權人員可以要求另一位授權人員或一名官員幫助他或她進行身分測試，而另一人可以提供協助。

title: 259 Detention of vessel for purpose of search
zh: 第259章 為搜查目的而扣留船隻
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may, by notice in writing to the master of a vessel which has arrived in Australia not more than one month before the date of the notice, order that the vessel remain at a port or place for a reasonable time specified in the notice for the purpose of enabling a search of the vessel to be made in order to ascertain whether there are on the vessel any unlawful non ‑ citizens or any persons seeking to enter Australia in circumstances in which they would become unlawful non ‑ citizens.
(1) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可在通知日期前一個月內向已抵達澳洲的船舶的船長發出書面通知，命令該船舶在通知中指定的港口或地點停留一段合理的時間，以便對船舶進行搜查，以確定船上是否有非法非公民或任何在可能成為非法非公民的情況下試圖進入澳洲的人。
(2) The master of a vessel in respect of which an order is in force under this section shall not, during the time specified in the order, move the vessel without the consent of the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner.
(2) 根據本條發出的命令對其生效的船舶的船長，在命令規定的時間內，未經部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員同意，不得移動船舶。
Penalty: 200 penalty units.
處罰：200 處罰單位。
(3) An offence against subsection (2) is an offence of strict liability.
(3) 違反第 (2) 款的犯罪行為是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。

title: 260 Detention of vessel pending recovery of penalty
zh: 第260章 扣押船隻等待追回罰款
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may, in writing, direct an officer to detain a vessel where, in the Secretary’s or Australian Border Force Commissioner’s opinion, the master, owner, agent or charterer of the vessel has been guilty of an offence against this Act.
(1) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員認為船舶的船長、所有人、代理人或承租人犯有違反本法的罪行，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以書面指示官員扣留船舶。
(2) Where a direction is given under subsection (1):
(2) 依第 (1) 款發出指示時：
(a) the officer specified in the direction may detain the vessel at the place where it is found or cause it to be brought to another place specified by the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner and detain it at that place; and
(a) 指示中指定的官員可以在發現船隻的地點扣留船隻，或將其帶到部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員指定的另一個地點並在該地點扣留；和
(b) the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner shall forthwith give notice of the detention to the master, owner, charterer or agent of the vessel.
(b) 部長或澳洲邊境專員應立即向船舶的船長、所有人、承租人或代理人發出扣留通知。
(3) For the purposes of the detention and other lawful dealings with the vessel, the officer specified in the direction is entitled to obtain such seizure warrant issued under Division 1 of Part XII of the Customs Act 1901 or other aid as may be obtained under a law of the Commonwealth with respect to the seizure of vessels or goods.
(3) 為了扣押船舶和進行其他合法處理船舶的目的，指示中指定的官員有權獲得根據《1901 年海關法》第 XII 部分第 1 分部簽發的扣押令或根據澳洲聯邦法律可以獲得的與扣押船舶或貨物有關的其他援助。
(4) The detention of a vessel under this section shall cease if a bond with 2 sufficient sureties to the satisfaction of the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner is given by the master, owner, agent or charterer of the vessel for the payment of any penalties that may be imposed in respect of the alleged offence.
(4) 如果船舶的船長、所有人、代理人或承租人提供了令部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員滿意的 2 名足夠擔保人的保證金，以支付可能因所指控的犯罪行為而處以的任何罰款，則根據本節對船舶的扣留應停止。
(5) If, while the vessel is detained under this section, default is made in payment of any penalties imposed in respect of an offence against this Act by the master, owner, agent or charterer of the vessel, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may seize the vessel, and the like proceedings shall thereupon be taken for forfeiting and condemning the vessel as in the case of a vessel seized for breach of the Customs Act 1901 , and the vessel shall be sold.
(5) 如果船舶根據本條被扣留期間，船舶的船長、所有人、代理人或承租人未能繳納因違反本法而施加的任何罰款，則部長或澳大利亞邊防專員可以扣押該船舶，並應立即採取與因違反《1901 年海關法》而被扣押的船舶相同的程序，沒收和譴責該船舶，並應出售該船舶。
(6) The proceeds of the sale shall be applied firstly in payment of the penalties referred to in subsection (5) and of all costs awarded in connexion with the proceedings in which the penalties were imposed or incurred in and about the sale and the proceedings leading to the sale, and the balance shall be payable to the owner and other persons having interests in the vessel before the condemnation and sale.
(6) 出售收益應首先用於支付第(5)款所述的罰款以及與在出售過程中施加或發生的罰款的程序以及導致出售的程序相關的所有費用，餘款應支付給船東和在廢止和出售之前在船舶上擁有利益的其他人。
(7) Division 13A does not limit the operation of this section.
(7) 第 13A 條不限製本節的運作。

title: 261 Disposal of dilapidated vessels etc.
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13 — Examination, search, detention and identification
text:
(1) If a non ‑ citizen who enters Australia:
(1) 如果是進入澳洲的非公民：
(a) is required to comply with section 166 (immigration clearance); and
(a) 需要遵守第 166 條（移民許可）；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) does not comply; or
(i) 不遵守；或
(ii) on complying, is detained under section 189;
(ii) 遵守規定後，依第 189 條被拘留；
the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may, in writing, direct an officer to seize the vessel on which the non ‑ citizen came to Australia.
部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以書面指示官員扣押該非公民前往澳洲所乘坐的船隻。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) a vessel is seized under subsection (1) or section 261B; and
(a) 依第 (1) 款或第 261B 條扣押船舶；和
(b) the vessel has not been forfeited and condemned under section 260 or condemned as forfeited under Division 13A; and
(b) 該船舶未根據第 260 條被沒收和宣告無效，或根據第 13A 條被宣告沒收；和
(c) the vessel has not been ordered by a court to be delivered to a person or otherwise dealt with; and
(c) 法院尚未下令將船舶交付給某人或以其他方式處理；和
(d) the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner is satisfied that the vessel is in such a poor condition that its custody or maintenance involves expense out of proportion to its value; and
(d) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員確信該船隻狀況不佳，以至於其保管或維護費用與其價值不成比例；和
(e) a person other than the Commonwealth does not meet, or make arrangements that the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner considers are satisfactory to meet, that expense;
(e) 英聯邦以外的人沒有支付該費用，或沒有作出部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員認為滿意的安排來支付該費用；
the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may in writing, direct an officer to sell, destroy or otherwise dispose of the vessel.
部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以書面指示官員出售、銷毀或以其他方式處置船隻。
(3) The officer must comply with the direction.
(3) 執法人員必須服從指揮。
(4) The proceeds of a sale are to be applied firstly in payment of costs incurred by the Commonwealth in the custody or maintenance of the vessel, and in selling or disposing of the vessel, and, subject to subsection (5), the balance is to be paid to the owner and any other persons with interests in the vessel before its sale.
(4) 出售所得收益應首先用於支付聯邦在保管或維護船舶以及出售或處置船舶時產生的費用，並且根據第(5)款的規定，餘額應在出售前支付給船東和任何其他在船舶上擁有權益的人。
(5) If:
(5) 如果：
(a) a person owes a debt to the Commonwealth under this Act; and
(a) 一個人根據本法欠聯邦債務；和
(b) an amount by way of the balance of the proceeds of a sale (the balance amount ) is payable to the person under subsection (4);
(b) 依據第(4)款，應向該人支付一筆銷售收益餘額（餘額）；
the Commonwealth may apply the balance amount in payment of the debt, and the debt is reduced accordingly. The amount applied must not exceed the amount of the debt.
聯邦可將餘額用於償還債務，債務相應減少。申請的金額不得超過債務金額。
(6) Division 13A does not limit the operation of this section.
(6) 第 13A 條不限製本節的運作。

title: Division 13AA — Identification of immigration detainees
zh: 第 13AA 分部 — 被移民拘留人士的身分識別
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: Subdivision A — Provision of personal identifiers
zh: 子部分 A — 提供個人識別訊息
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision A — Provision of personal identifiers

title: 261AA Immigration detainees must provide personal identifiers
zh: 261AA 移民被拘留者必須提供個人識別資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision A — Provision of personal identifiers
text:
(1) A non ‑ citizen who is in immigration detention must (other than in the prescribed circumstances) provide to an authorised officer one or more personal identifiers.
(1) 被移民拘留的非公民必須（規定情況除外）向授權官員提供一個或多個個人識別資訊。
(1A) An authorised officer must not require, for the purposes of subsection (1), a person to provide a personal identifier other than any of the following (including any of the following in digital form):
(1A) 為第 (1) 款的目的，授權人員不得要求任何人提供除以下任何內容（包括以下任何數字形式）以外的個人識別碼：
(a) fingerprints or handprints of the person (including those taken using paper and ink or digital livescanning technologies);
(a) 人員的指紋或手印（包括使用紙張和墨水或數位生命掃描技術採集的指紋或手印）；
(b) a measurement of the person’s height and weight;
(b) 測量該人的身高和體重；
(c) a photograph or other image of the person’s face;
(c) 該人臉部的照片或其他影像；
(d) the person’s signature;
(d) 該人的簽名；
(e) any other personal identifier of a type prescribed for the purposes of this paragraph.
(e) 為本段規定的類型的任何其他個人識別碼。
Note: Division 13AB sets out further restrictions on the personal identifiers that minors and incapable persons can be required to provide.
注意：第 13AB 條對未成年人和無行為能力人士可能需要提供的個人識別資訊做出了進一步限制。
(2) The one or more personal identifiers are to be provided by way of one or more identification tests carried out by the authorised officer in accordance with this Division.
(2) 一個或多個個人識別碼應透過授權官員根據本節進行的一項或多項身分測試來提供。
Note: Subject to certain restrictions, section 261AE allows reasonable force to be used to carry out identification tests under this Division.
注意：在受到某些限制的情況下，第 261AE 條允許使用合理的武力來進行本節規定的識別測試。
(3) However, this Division does not apply to a non ‑ citizen who:
(3) 然而，本節不適用於以下非公民：
(a) is in immigration detention only because he or she is detained under section 192; and
(a) 僅因根據第 192 條被拘留而被移民拘留；和
(b) has provided a personal identifier in accordance with a requirement under section 257A.
(b) 已根據第 257A 條的要求提供個人識別資訊。

title: 261AB Authorised officers must require and carry out identification tests
zh: 261AB 授權官員必須要求並進行身分識別測試
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision A — Provision of personal identifiers
text:
(1) The authorised officer must, other than in the circumstances prescribed for the purposes of subsection 261AA(1):
(1) 除第 261AA(1) 款規定的情況外，授權官員必須：
(a) require, in writing or orally, the non ‑ citizen to provide one or more personal identifiers, of the type or types prescribed, by way of one or more identification tests carried out by the authorised officer; and
(a) 以書面或口頭方式要求非公民通過授權官員進行的一項或多項身份測試，提供規定類型的一項或多項個人身份識別信息；和
(b) carry out the one or more identification tests on the non ‑ citizen.
(b) 對非公民進行一項或多項身分測試。
(2) However:
(2) 但是：
(a) if the types of identification tests that the authorised officer may carry out is specified under section 5D—each identification test must be of a type so specified; and
(a) 如果第 5D 條規定了授權人員可以進行的身份測試的類型－每次身份測試必須屬於如此規定的類型；和
(b) each identification test must be carried out in accordance with Subdivision B; and
(b) 每項識別測試必須按照 B 部分進行；和
(c) unless the authorised officer has reasonable grounds to believe that the non ‑ citizen is not a minor or an incapable person—each identification test must be carried out in accordance with the additional requirements of Division 13AB.
(c) 除非授權官員有合理的理由相信該非公民不是未成年人或無行為能力的人，否則每次識別測試必須按照第 13AB 節的附加要求進行。

title: 261AC Information to be provided before carrying out identification tests
zh: 261AC 進行鑑定測試前應提供的信息
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision A — Provision of personal identifiers
text:
(1) Before carrying out an identification test, the authorised officer must:
(1) 在進行身分測試之前，授權人員必須：
(a) inform the non ‑ citizen that the non ‑ citizen may ask that an independent person be present while the identification test is carried out and that the test be carried out by a person of the same sex as the non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 告知非公民，在進行身份識別測試時，該非公民可以要求一名獨立人士在場，並且測試應由與該非公民同性別的人進行；和
(b) inform the non ‑ citizen of such other matters as are specified in the regulations.
(b) 將條例中規定的其他事項告知非公民。
(2) For the purposes of subsection (1), the authorised officer informs the non ‑ citizen of a matter if the authorised officer informs the non ‑ citizen of the matter, through an interpreter if necessary, in a language (including sign language or braille) in which the non ‑ citizen is able to communicate with reasonable fluency.
(2) 就第(1)款而言，如果授權官員在必要時透過口譯員以非公民能夠相當流利地交流的語言（包括手語或點字）向非公民通報某事項，則授權官員將此事告知非公民。
(3) The authorised officer may comply with this section by giving to the non ‑ citizen, in accordance with the regulations, a form setting out the information specified in the regulations. However, the information must be in a language (including braille) in which the non ‑ citizen is able to communicate with reasonable fluency.
(3) 授權官員可以依照本條規定，向非公民提供一份表格，其中列出了條例中規定的資訊。然而，訊息必須採用非公民能夠以相當流利的方式進行溝通的語言（包括點字）。

title: Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
zh: B 部分 — 如何進行鑑定測試
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out

title: 261AD General rules for carrying out identification tests
zh: 261AD 進行鑑定測試的一般規則
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
An identification test under this Division:
本部門的鑑定測試：
(a) must be carried out in circumstances affording reasonable privacy to the non ‑ citizen; and
(a) 必須在為非公民提供合理隱私的情況下進行；和
(b) if the non ‑ citizen so requests and it is practicable to comply with the request—must not be carried out in the presence or view of a person who is of the opposite sex to the non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 若非公民提出要求，且符合該要求是可行的－則不得在與該非公民異性的人在場或在其視線範圍內進行；和
(c) must not be carried out in the presence or view of a person whose presence is not necessary for the purposes of the identification test or is not required or permitted by another provision of this Act; and
(c) 不得在身分測試不需要的人員在場或在場的情況下進行，或本法其他條款未要求或允許的人員在場；和
(d) must not involve the removal of more clothing than is necessary for carrying out the test; and
(d) 脫去的衣服不多於進行測試所需的衣服；和
(e) must not involve more visual inspection than is necessary for carrying out the test; and
(e) 目視檢查不得超出進行測試所需的範圍；和
(f) if the test is one of 2 or more identification tests to be carried out on the non ‑ citizen—must be carried out at the same time as the other identification tests, if it is practicable to do so.
(f) 如果測驗是對非公民進行的兩項或多項身分測驗之一－如果可行的話，必須與其他身分測驗同時進行。

title: 261AE Use of force in carrying out identification tests
zh: 261AE 在進行身分識別測試時使用武力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
When use of force is permitted
當允許使用武力時
(1) Subject to subsection (2) and section 261AF, an authorised officer, or a person authorised under section 261AG to help the authorised officer, may use reasonable force:
(1) 根據第 (2) 款和第 261AF 條，授權官員或根據第 261AG 條授權幫助授權官員的人可以使用合理的武力：
(a) to enable the identification test to be carried out; or
(a) 使鑑定測試得以進行；或
(b) to prevent the loss, destruction or contamination of any personal identifier or any meaningful identifier derived from the personal identifier.
(b) 防止任何個人識別碼或從個人識別碼派生的任何有意義的標識符遺失、毀壞或污染。
However, this section does not authorise the use of force against a minor or an incapable person, or if the personal identifier in question is a person’s signature.
然而，本節並不授權對未成年人或無行為能力的人使用武力，或者如果所涉及的個人識別碼是一個人的簽名。
(2) The officer or person must not use force unless:
(2) 官員或個人不得使用武力，除非：
(a) the non ‑ citizen required to provide the personal identifier in question has refused to allow the identification test to be carried out; and
(a) 被要求提供有關個人識別資訊的非公民拒絕進行身份識別測試；和
(b) all reasonable measures to carry out the identification test without the use of force have been exhausted; and
(b) 已用盡所有不使用武力進行識別測試的合理措施；和
(c) use of force in carrying out the identification test is authorised under subsection (4).
(c) 在進行身分識別測試時使用武力是根據第(4)款授權的。
Applications for authorisation to use force
申請授權使用武力
(3) An authorised officer may apply to a senior authorising officer (who is not an officer referred to in subsection (1)) for an authorisation to use force in carrying out the identification test.
(3) 授權官員可以向高級授權官員（不是第（1）款中提到的官員）申請授權在進行身份識別測試時使用武力。
Authorisation to use force
授權使用武力
(4) The senior authorising officer may authorise the use of force in carrying out the identification test if he or she is reasonably satisfied that:
(4) 如果高级授权官员合理地确信：
(a) the non ‑ citizen required to provide the personal identifier in question has refused to allow the identification test to be carried out; and
(a) 被要求提供有關個人識別資訊的非公民拒絕進行身份識別測試；和
(b) all reasonable measures to carry out the identification test without the use of force have been exhausted.
(b) 已用盡所有不使用武力進行識別測試的合理措施。
(5) An authorisation under subsection (4):
(5) 第(4)款规定的授权：
(a) may be given by telephone, fax or other electronic means; and
(a) 可透過電話、傳真或其他電子方式提供；和
(b) must be recorded in writing, and signed by the person giving the authorisation, within one business day after it is given.
(b) 必須以書面記錄，並在授權後的一個工作天內由授權人簽名。
(6) A failure to comply with paragraph (5)(b) does not affect the validity of an identification test carried out on the basis of that authorisation.
(6) 不遵守第 (5)(b) 款並不影響根據該授權進行的身份測試的有效性。
(7) The power to give an authorisation under subsection (4) cannot be delegated to any other person.
（7）第（4）款規定的授權權力不得委託給任何其他人。
Definition
定義
(8) In this section:
(8) 本節：
senior authorising officer means an officer whom the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner has authorised, or who is included in a class of officers whom the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner has authorised, to perform the functions of a senior authorising officer under this section.
高級授權官員是指部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員授權的官員，或屬於部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員授權的一類官員，以履行本節規定的高級授權官員的職能。

title: 261AF Identification tests not to be carried out in cruel, inhuman or degrading manner etc.
zh: 261AF 鑑定測試不得以殘忍、不人道或有辱人格等方式進行。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
For the purposes of this Act, the carrying out of the identification test is not of itself taken:
就本法而言，進行識別測試本身並不意味著：
(a) to be cruel, inhuman or degrading; or
(a) 殘忍、不人道或有辱人格；或
(b) to be a failure to treat a person with humanity and with respect for human dignity.
(b) 未能以人性和尊重人的尊嚴對待他人。
However, nothing in this Act authorises the carrying out of the identification test in a cruel, inhuman or degrading manner, or in a manner that fails to treat a person with humanity and with respect for human dignity.
然而，本法並未授權以殘忍、不人道或有辱人格的方式或不以人道和尊重人的尊嚴對待他人的方式進行身份識別測試。

title: 261AG Authorised officer may get help to carry out identification tests
zh: 261AG 授權官員可能會獲得協助來進行身分識別測試
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
An authorised officer may ask another authorised officer or an officer to help him or her to carry out the identification test, and the other person may give that help.
授權人員可以要求另一位授權人員或一名官員幫助他或她進行身分測試，而另一人可以提供協助。

title: 261AH Identification tests to be carried out by authorised officer of same sex as non ‑ citizen
zh: 261AH 身分識別測試由與非公民相同性別的授權官員進行
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
If the non ‑ citizen requests that the identification test be carried out by an authorised officer of the same sex as the non ‑ citizen, the test must only be carried out by an authorised officer of the same sex as the non ‑ citizen.
如果非公民要求由與非公民同性別的授權官員進行身分測試，則該測試只能由與非公民同性別的授權官員進行。

title: 261AI Independent person to be present
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
The identification test must be carried out in the presence of an independent person if:
在下列情況下，鑑定測試必須在獨立人員在場的情況下進行：
(a) force is used in carrying out the identification test; or
(a) 在進行識別測試時使用了武力；或
(b) both of the following apply:
(b) 下列兩項均適用：
(i) the non ‑ citizen requests that an independent person be present while the identification test is being carried out;
(i) 非公民要求在進行身分驗證時有一名獨立人士在場；
(ii) an independent person is readily available at the same place as the non ‑ citizen and is willing to attend the test within a reasonable time.
(ii) 獨立人士可隨時與該非公民在同一地點並願意在合理時間內參加考試。

title: 261AJ Recording of identification tests
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
(1) An authorised officer may video record the carrying out of the identification test.
(1) 授權人員可以錄影的身分測試。
(2) If the carrying out of the identification test is not video recorded, the authorised officer may decide that the identification test must be carried out in the presence of an independent person.
(2) 如果身分測試的進行沒有進行錄影記錄，授權官員可以決定身分測試必須在獨立人員在場的情況下進行。

title: 261AK Retesting
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision B — How identification tests are carried out
text:
When retesting is permitted
當允許重新測試時
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) an authorised officer has carried out an identification test (the earlier test ) on a non ‑ citizen in accordance with this Division (including a test authorised under subsection (4)); and
(a) 授權官員已根據本節的規定對非公民進行了身份識別測試（先前的測試）（包括根據第（4）款授權的測試）；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) a personal identifier that is provided as a result of the earlier test being carried out is unusable; or
(i) 因先前進行的測試而提供的個人識別碼無法使用；或
(ii) an authorised officer or an officer is not satisfied about the integrity of that personal identifier;
(ii) 授權官員或官員對該個人識別碼的完整性不滿意；
the officer who carried out the earlier test or another officer may require the non ‑ citizen to provide the personal identifier again, and may carry out the test again in accordance with this Division, if:
進行先前測試的官員或其他官員可以要求非公民再次提供個人身份識別信息，並可以根據本節再次進行測試，如果：
(c) the requirement is made while the earlier test is being carried out or immediately after it was carried out; or
(c) 該要求是在先前的測試正在進行時或剛進行後提出的；或
(d) carrying out the test again is authorised under subsection (4).
(d) 依第(4)款授權再次進行測試。
(2) If the non ‑ citizen is required under subsection (1) to provide the personal identifier again, the non ‑ citizen is taken, for the purposes of this Division, not to have provided the personal identifier as a result of the earlier test being carried out.
(2) 如果根據第 (1) 款要求非公民再次提供個人身份識別信息，則就本節而言，由於先前進行的測試，該非公民將被視為未提供個人身份識別信息。
Applications for authorisation to retest
申請授權重新測試
(3) An authorised officer may apply for an authorisation to carry out the test again. The application is to be made to:
(3) 授權人員可以申請授權再次進行測試。申請須提交至：
(a) if the earlier test was not a test authorised under subsection (4)—a senior authorising officer (who is not an officer referred to in subsection (1)); or
(a) 如果先前的測試不是根據第 (4) 款授權的測試－高級授權官員（不是第 (1) 款中提到的官員）；或
(b) if the earlier test was a test authorised under subsection (4) by a senior authorising officer—the Secretary, Australian Border Force Commissioner or an SES Band 3 employee in the Department (who is not an officer referred to in subsection (1)).
(b) 如果先前的測試是由高級授權官員（部長、澳洲邊境部隊專員或該部門的 SES 3 級僱員（不是第 (1) 款中提到的官員））根據第 (4) 款授權的測試。
Authorisation to retest
授權重新測試
(4) The senior authorising officer, Secretary, Australian Border Force Commissioner or SES Band 3 employee (as the case requires) may authorise the test to be carried out again if:
(4) 高級授權官員、秘書、澳洲邊境部隊專員或 SES Band 3 員工（視情況需要）可授權再次進行測試，如果：
(a) he or she is reasonably satisfied that the personal identifier that is provided as a result of the earlier test being carried out is unusable; or
(a) 他或她合理地認為，由於先前進行的測試而提供的個人識別碼無法使用；或
(b) he or she is not reasonably satisfied about the integrity of that personal identifier.
(b) 他或她對該個人識別碼的完整性不滿意。
(5) An authorisation under subsection (4):
(5) 第(4)款规定的授权：
(a) may be given by telephone, fax or other electronic means; and
(a) 可透過電話、傳真或其他電子方式提供；和
(b) must be recorded in writing, and signed by the person giving the authorisation, within one business day after it is given.
(b) 必須以書面記錄，並在授權後的一個工作天內由授權人簽名。
(6) A failure to comply with paragraph (5)(b) does not affect the validity of an identification test carried out on the basis of that authorisation.
(6) 不遵守第 (5)(b) 款並不影響根據該授權進行的身份測試的有效性。
(7) The power to give an authorisation under subsection (4) cannot be delegated to any other person.
（7）第（4）款規定的授權權力不得委託給任何其他人。
Use of force
使用武力
(8) An authorisation under subsection (4) does not authorise the use of force in carrying out an identification test.
(8) 第 (4) 款的授權並未授權在進行身分識別測試時使用武力。
Note: See section 261AE on the use of force in carrying out identification tests.
註：請參閱第 261AE 條有關在進行身分識別測試時使用武力的內容。
Effect of refusing to authorise retesting
拒絕授權重新測試的影響
(9) If an application for an authorisation to carry out an identification test again on a non ‑ citizen is refused, the non ‑ citizen is taken, for the purposes of this Act, to have complied with any requirement under this Act to provide the personal identifier in question.
(9) 如果對非公民再次進行身分識別測試的授權申請被拒絕，則就本法而言，該非公民被視為已遵守本法規定的提供相關個人識別資訊的任何要求。
Definitions
定義
(10) In this section:
(10) 本節：
senior authorising officer means an officer (other than an SES Band 3 employee in the Department) whom the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner has authorised, or who is included in a class of officers whom the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner has authorised, to perform the functions of a senior authorising officer under this section.
高級授權官員是指部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員授權的官員（除部門中的 SES Band 3 僱員外），或屬於部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員授權的一類官員，以履行本節規定的高級授權官員的職能。
SES Band 3 employee means an SES employee with a classification of Senior Executive Band 3, and includes an SES employee who has been temporarily assigned duties that have been allocated a classification of Senior Executive Band 3.
SES Band 3 员工是指具有高级管理人员等级 3 类别的 SES 员工，包括临时分配职责并被分配高级管理人员等级 3 类别的 SES 员工。

title: Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
zh: C 部分 — 與身分識別測試錄影相關的義務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests

title: 261AKA Definitions
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
In this Subdivision, unless the contrary intention appears:
在本款中，除非出现相反意图：
permitted provision , of a video recording, has the meaning given by subsection 261AKD(2).
錄影的允許提供具有第 261AKD(2) 款規定的含義。
provide , in relation to a video recording, includes provide access to the recording.
提供 與視訊記錄相關，包括提供對記錄的存取。
related document means a document that contains information, derived from a video recording made under section 261AJ or from a copy of such a recording, from which the identity of the individual on whom the identification test in question was carried out is apparent or can reasonably be ascertained.
相關文件是指包含根據第 261AJ 條製作的視訊記錄或此類記錄的副本中獲得的資訊的文件，從中可以明顯地或可以合理地確定接受有關身份識別測試的個人的身份。
video recording means a video recording made under section 261AJ or a copy of such a recording, and includes a related document.
視訊錄製是指根據第 261AJ 條製作的視訊錄製或此類錄製的副本，並包括相關文件。

title: 261AKB Accessing video recordings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person accesses a video recording; and
(a) 该人访问视频记录；和
(b) the person is not authorised under section 261AKC to access the video recording for the purpose for which the person accessed it.
(b) 根據第 261AKC 條，該人未被授權出於其存取目的而存取視訊記錄。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years, or 120 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁，或 120 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) This section does not apply if the access is through the provision of a video recording that is a permitted provision.
(2) 如果透過允許提供的視訊記錄進行訪問，則本節不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任（見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款）。

title: 261AKC Authorising access to video recordings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
(1) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may, in writing, authorise a specified person, or any person included in a specified class of persons, to access:
(1) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以書面授權特定人員或特定類別中的任何人員存取：
(a) all video recordings; or
(a) 所有视频记录；或
(b) a specified video recording, or video recordings of a specified kind.
(b) 指定的視訊記錄或指定類型的視訊記錄。
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must specify in an authorisation under this section, as the purpose or purposes for which access is authorised, one or more of the following purposes:
(2) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員必須在本節規定的授權中指定以下一個或多個目的作為授權訪問的目的：
(a) providing a video recording to another person in accordance with this Subdivision;
(a) 根据本款向他人提供录像；
(b) administering or managing the storage of video recordings;
(b) 管理或管理錄影的儲存；
(c) making a video recording available to the person to whom it relates;
(c) 提供相關人員錄影；
(d) modifying related documents in order to correct errors or ensure compliance with appropriate standards;
(d) 修改相關文件以糾正錯誤或確保符合適當的標準；
(e) any purpose connected with determining whether a civil or criminal liability has arisen from a person carrying out or helping to carry out an identification test under this Act;
(e) 與確定根據本法進行或協助進行身分識別測試的人是否產生民事或刑事責任有關的任何目的；
(f) complying with laws of the Commonwealth or the States or Territories.
(f) 遵守澳洲聯邦、州或領地的法律。
(3) However, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must not specify as a purpose for which access is authorised a purpose that will include or involve the purpose of:
(3) 但是，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員不得將授權訪問的目的指定為包括或涉及以下目的：
(a) investigating an offence against a law of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory (other than an offence involving whether an identification test was carried out lawfully); or
(a) 調查違反聯邦、州或領地法律的犯罪行為（涉及身分識別測試是否合法進行的犯罪行為除外）；或
(b) prosecuting a person for such an offence;
(b) 起訴犯有此類罪行的人；
if the identifying information in question relates to a personal identifier of a prescribed type.
如果所涉及的識別資訊涉及規定類型的個人識別碼。

title: 261AKD Providing video recordings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person’s conduct causes a video recording to be provided to another person; and
(a) 該人的行為導致錄影提供給他人；和
(b) the provision of the recording is not a permitted provision of the recording.
(b) 提供錄音不屬於允許提供的錄音。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years, or 120 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁，或 120 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) A permitted provision of a video recording is a provision of the recording that:
(2) 允許提供的錄影記錄是指下列記錄的提供：
