(a) is for the purpose of administering or managing the storage of video recordings; or
(a) 為管理或管理錄影儲存的目的；或
(b) is for the purpose of making the video recording in question available to the non ‑ citizen to whom it relates; or
(b) 目的是向與其相關的非公民提供有關錄影；或
(c) is for the purpose of a proceeding, before a court, the ART or another tribunal, relating to the non ‑ citizen to whom the video recording in question relates; or
(c) 是為了在法院、ART 或其他法庭提起訴訟，涉及與相關錄影紀錄相關的非公民；或
(d) is for any purpose connected with determining whether a civil or criminal liability has arisen from a person carrying out or helping to carry out an identification test under this Act; or
(d) 用於與確定根據本法進行或協助進行身分識別測試的人是否產生民事或刑事責任有關的任何目的；或
(e) is for the purpose of an investigation by the Information Commissioner under the Privacy Act 1988 or the Ombudsman relating to carrying out an identification test; or
(e) 是為了資訊專員根據《1988 年隱私法》或監察員進行與身分識別測試相關的調查；或
(f) is made to a prescribed body or agency for the purpose of the body or agency inquiring into the operation of provisions of this Act relating to carrying out an identification test; or
(f) 向規定的機構或機構提出，以便該機構或機構調查本法有關進行身份識別測試的規定的實施情況；或
(g) takes place with the written consent of the non ‑ citizen to whom the video recording in question relates.
(g) 在取得與相關影片相關的非公民的書面同意的情況下進行。
(3) However, a provision of a video recording is not a permitted provision of the recording if:
(3) 但是，在下列情況下，提供錄影記錄不屬於允許提供的記錄：
(a) it constitutes a disclosure of identifying information relating to a personal identifier of a prescribed type; and
(a) 構成與規定類型的個人識別碼相關的身份資訊的揭露；和
(b) it is for the purpose of:
(b) 其目的是：
(i) investigating an offence against a law of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory (other than an offence involving whether an identification test was carried out lawfully); or
(i) 調查違反聯邦、州或領地法律的犯罪行為（涉及身分識別測試是否合法進行的犯罪行為除外）；或
(ii) prosecuting a person for such an offence.
(ii) 因此類罪行而起訴某人。

title: 261AKE Unauthorised modification of video recordings
zh: 261AKE 未經授權修改錄影記錄
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
A person commits an offence if:
若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person causes any unauthorised modification of a video recording; and
(a) 該人對視訊記錄進行任何未經授權的修改；和
(b) the person intends to cause the modification; and
(b) 該人意圖引起修改；和
(c) the person knows that the modification is unauthorised.
(c) 該人知道該修改未經授權。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years, or 120 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁，或 120 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 261AKF Unauthorised impairment of video recordings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
A person commits an offence if:
若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person causes any unauthorised impairment of:
(a) 該人造成任何未經授權的損害：
(i) the reliability of a video recording; or
(i) 錄影的可靠性；或
(ii) the security of the storage of a video recording; or
(ii) 錄影儲存的安全性；或
(iii) the operation of a system by which a video recording is stored; and
(iii) 儲存錄影的系統的操作；和
(b) the person intends to cause the impairment; and
(b) 該人有意造成損害；和
(c) the person knows that the impairment is unauthorised.
(c) 該人知道該損害是未經授權的。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years, or 120 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁，或 120 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 261AKG Meanings of unauthorised modification and unauthorised impairment etc.
zh: 261AKG 未經授權的修改和未經授權的損害等的含義。
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
(1) In this Subdivision:
(1) 在本小節：
(a) modification of a video recording; or
(a) 修改錄影；或
(b) impairment of the reliability of a video recording; or
(b) 錄影的可靠性受損；或
(c) impairment of the security of the storage of a video recording; or
(c) 損害錄影儲存的安全性；或
(d) impairment of the operation of a system by which a video recording is stored;
(d) 損害儲存錄影的系統的運作；
by a person is unauthorised if the person is not entitled to cause that modification or impairment.
如果一個人無權造成該修改或損害，則該人未經授權。
(2) Any such modification or impairment caused by the person is not unauthorised merely because he or she has an ulterior purpose for causing it.
(2) 該人造成的任何此類修改或損害並非僅因他或她有不可告人的目的而未經授權。
(3) For the purposes of an offence under this Subdivision, a person causes any such unauthorised modification or impairment if the person’s conduct substantially contributes to it.
(3) 就本款規定的犯罪而言，如果該人的行為對任何此類未經授權的修改或損害有重大貢獻，則該人造成任何此類未經授權的修改或損害。
(4) For the purposes of subsection (1), if:
(4) 就第 (1) 款而言，如果：
(a) a person causes any modification or impairment of a kind mentioned in that subsection; and
(a) 某人造成該款所提及的任何修改或損害；和
(b) the person does so under a warrant issued under the law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory;
(b) 該人依據聯邦、州或領地法律所簽發的逮捕令這樣做；
the person is entitled to cause that modification or impairment.
該人有權造成這種改變或損害。

title: 261AKH Destroying video recordings
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Subdivision C — Obligations relating to video recordings of identification tests
text:
A person commits an offence if:
若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person is the person who has day ‑ to ‑ day responsibility for the system under which a video recording is stored; and
(a) 該人是對儲存錄影記錄的系統負有日常責任的人；和
(b) the person fails physically to destroy the recording, and all copies of the recording, within 10 years after it was made.
(b) 該人未能在錄製後 10 年內銷毀該錄音及其所有副本。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 2 years, or 120 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 2 年監禁，或 120 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: Division 13AB — Identification of minors and incapable persons
zh: 第 13AB 分部 — 未成年人及無行為能力人士的身分識別
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13AB — Identification of minors and incapable persons

title: 261AL Minors
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13AB — Identification of minors and incapable persons
text:
Minors less than 15 years old
15歲以下未成年人
(1) A person who is less than 15 years old must not be required under Division 13AA of this Part to provide a personal identifier other than a personal identifier consisting of:
(1) 根據本部分第 13AA 節的規定，不得要求 15 歲以下的人提供除包含以下內容的個人識別碼以外的個人識別碼：
(a) a measurement of the person’s height and weight; or
(a) 測量該人的身高和體重；或
(b) the person’s photograph or other image of the person’s face.
(b) 該人的照片或該人臉部的其他影像。
Persons present while identification test is carried out
進行身份測試時在場的人員
(5) If a person who is a minor provides a personal identifier, in accordance with a requirement under Division 13AA of this Part, by way of an identification test carried out by an authorised officer, the test must be carried out in the presence of:
(5) 如果未成年人根據本部分第 13AA 部分的要求，透過授權官員進行的身份測試提供個人身份識別信息，則測試必須在以下人員在場的情況下進行：
(a) a parent or guardian of the minor; or
(a) 未成年人的父母或監護人；或
(b) an independent person.
(b) 獨立人士。
(6) However, if the Minister is the minor’s guardian, the test must be carried out in the presence of an independent person other than the Minister.
(6) 但是，如果部長是未成年人的監護人，則測試必須在部長以外的獨立人士在場的情況下進行。

title: 261AM Incapable persons
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13AB — Identification of minors and incapable persons
text:
Incapable persons
無行為能力人士
(1) A person who is an incapable person must not be required under Division 13AA of this Part to provide a personal identifier other than a personal identifier consisting of:
(1) 不得依本部分第 13AA 款要求無行為能力人提供個人識別資訊，但由下列內容組成的個人識別資訊除外：
(a) a measurement of the person’s height and weight; or
(a) 測量該人的身高和體重；或
(b) the person’s photograph or other image of the person’s face.
(b) 該人的照片或該人臉部的其他影像。
Persons present while identification test is carried out
進行身份測試時在場的人員
(4) If a person who is an incapable person provides a personal identifier, in accordance with a requirement under Division 13AA of this Part, by way of an identification test carried out by an authorised officer, the test must be carried out in the presence of:
(4) 如果無行為能力人根據本部分第 13AA 條的要求，透過授權官員進行的身份識別測試提供個人身份識別信息，則測試必須在以下人員在場的情況下進行：
(a) a parent or guardian of the incapable person; or
(a) 無行為能力人的父母或監護人；或
(b) an independent person.
(b) 獨立人士。

title: Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
zh: 第 13A 分部 — 用於某些罪行的物品自動被沒收
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences

title: Subdivision A — Automatic forfeiture
zh: 細分 A — 自動沒收
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences

title: 261A Forfeiture of things used in certain offences
zh: 261A 沒收用於某些犯罪行為的物品
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
text:
(1) The following things are forfeited to the Commonwealth:
(1) 下列物品將歸聯邦沒收：
(a) a vessel used or involved in a contravention of this Act (where the contravention occurred in Australia), if the contravention involved:
(a) 使用或涉及違反本法的船舶（如果該違法行為發生在澳洲），如果該違法行為涉及：
(i) the bringing or coming to Australia of one or more persons who were, or upon entry into Australia became, unlawful non ‑ citizens; or
(i) 將一名或多名非法非公民或進入澳洲後成為非法非公民的人帶到或來到澳洲；或者
(ii) the entry or proposed entry into Australia of one or more such persons;
(ii) 一名或多名此類人員入境或擬入境澳洲；
(b) a vehicle or equipment:
(b) 車輛或設備：
(i) on a vessel described in paragraph (a) at the time of the contravention mentioned in that paragraph; or
(i) 在(a)段所述的船舶上發生該段所提及的違規行為時；或
(ii) used or involved in the contravention referred to in that paragraph.
(ii) 使用或參與該段所述的違法行為。
(2) Despite subsection (1), a vessel that:
(2) 儘管有第(1)款的規定，船舶：
(a) was used or involved in a contravention of this Act of a kind referred to in that subsection; and
(a) 曾經被利用或參與該款所述的違反本法的行為；和
(b) at the time of the contravention, was being used in the course of a regular public transport operation;
(b) 發生違規時，正在正常公共運輸運作過程中使用；
is not forfeited to the Commonwealth if both the master and the owner of the vessel:
如果船長和船東都符合以下條件，則不會被聯邦沒收：
(c) did not know; and
(c) 不知道；和
(d) could not reasonably be expected to have known;
(d) 無法合理地預期知道；
that it was used or involved in the contravention.
它被使用或涉及違規行為。
(3) In this section:
(3) 本節：
regular public transport operation , in relation to a vessel, means an operation of the vessel for the purpose of a service that:
常規公共交通運作 就船舶而言，指為提供以下服務而進行的船舶運作：
(a) is provided for a fee payable by persons using the service; and
(a) 是為使用該服務的人所支付的費用而提供的；和
(b) is conducted in accordance with fixed schedules to or from fixed terminals over specific routes; and
(b) 依照固定時刻表經由特定路線往返於固定航站；和
(c) is available to the general public on a regular basis.
(c) 定期對外開放。

title: Subdivision B — Seizure
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences

title: 261B Seizure of things used in certain offences
zh: 261B 扣押用於某些犯罪行為的物品
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
text:
(1) An authorised officer may seize a thing in Australia, or may order an officer to seize a thing in Australia, if:
(1) 授權官員可以在澳洲扣押物品，或可以命令官員在澳洲扣押物品，如果：
(a) the thing is forfeited under section 261A; or
(a) 該物品依第 261A 條被沒收；或
(b) the authorised officer reasonably suspects that the thing is forfeited under section 261A.
(b) 授權官員有理由懷疑該物品已根據第 261A 條被沒收。
(2) If an officer is ordered by an authorised officer to seize a thing under subsection (1), the officer may seize the thing.
(2) 如果授權官員命令官員扣押第 (1) 款規定的物品，則該官員可以扣押該物品。

title: Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
zh: C 分部 — 處理自動沒收的扣押物品
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited

title: 261C Application of this Subdivision
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
This Subdivision sets out rules about a thing that an officer seizes under section 261B.
本細則規定了有關官員根據第 261B 條扣押的物品的規則。

title: 261D Notice of seizure
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
(1) The officer must give written notice of the seizure of the thing to the owner of the thing. However, if the owner cannot be identified after reasonable inquiry, the officer must give the notice to the person in whose possession or custody or under whose control the thing was immediately before it was seized.
(1) 官員必須向物品所有者發出扣押物品的書面通知。然而，如果經過合理詢問後仍無法確定物主的身份，官員必須向該物在被扣押前佔有、保管或控制的人發出通知。
(2) If the officer cannot conveniently give the notice to the person referred to in subsection (1) in person, the officer may give written notice of the seizure of the thing by fixing the notice to a prominent part of the thing.
(2) 如果官員無法方便地親自向第 (1) 款中提到的人發出通知，官員可以透過將通知固定在物品的顯著部分來發出扣押該物品的書面通知。
(3) The notice must:
(3) 通知必須：
(a) identify the thing; and
(a) 辨識該事物；和
(b) state that the thing has been seized; and
(b) 聲明該物品已被扣押；和
(c) specify the reason for the seizure; and
(c) 說明扣押的原因；和
(d) state that the thing will be condemned as forfeited unless:
(d) 聲明該物品將被視為沒收，除非：
(i) the owner of the thing, or the person who had possession, custody or control of the thing immediately before it was seized, gives the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner, within 21 days, a claim for the thing; or
(i) 該物品的所有者，或在該物品被扣押前佔有、保管或控制該物品的人，在 21 天內向部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員提出對該物品的索賠；或
(ii) within 21 days, the Minister gives a written order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited; and
(ii) 在 21 天內，部長發出書面命令，規定該物品不得被視為沒收；和
(e) specify the address of the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner.
(e) 註明部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員的地址。
Note: Section 261F condemns the thing if it is not claimed within 21 days, unless the Minister gives an order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited. Section 261H condemns the thing if a claim is made, but the claimant does not get a court order supporting the claim, unless the Minister gives an order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited.
註：第 261F 條規定，如果在 21 天內沒有認領該物品，則該物品將被宣告無效，除非部長下令該物品不得被宣告為沒收。如果提出索賠，第 261H 條將譴責該物品，但索賠人未獲得支持該索賠的法院命令，除非部長下令該物品不被判定為沒收。
(4) A claim under subparagraph (3)(d)(i) must:
(4) 第 (3)(d)(i) 項下的索賠必須：
(a) be in writing; and
(a) 採用書面形式；和
(b) be in English; and
(b) 使用英語；和
(c) state an address for service on the person making the claim.
(c) 說明索賠人的送達地址。

title: 261E Dealing with thing before it is condemned
zh: 261E 未受譴責之前就處理它
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
(1) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may, on behalf of the Commonwealth, cause the thing to be disposed of or destroyed if:
(1) 在下列情況下，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以代表聯邦促使該物品被處置或銷毀：
(a) its custody or maintenance creates serious difficulties; or
(a) 其保管或維護造成嚴重困難；或
(b) the expenses of its custody or maintenance between its seizure and condemnation are likely to be greater than its value.
(b) 在扣押和譴責之間保管或維持其費用可能大於其價值。
(2) If the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner causes the thing to be disposed of, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may cause the disposal to be subject to specified conditions.
(2) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員要求處置該物品，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以要求該處置遵守特定條件。

title: 261F Thing condemned if not claimed in time
zh: 261F 不及時認領的東西會被譴責
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
(1) By force of this subsection, the thing is condemned as forfeited to the Commonwealth 21 days after notice of seizure of the thing has been given under section 261D, unless:
(1) 根據本款規定，在根據第 261D 條發出扣押通知後 21 天，該物品將被宣告沒收給聯邦，除非：
(a) the following conditions are satisfied:
(a) 符合以下條件：
(i) within the 21 days, the owner of the thing or the person who had possession, custody or control of it immediately before it was seized gives the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner a written claim for the thing;
(i) 在 21 天內，該物品的所有者或在該物品被扣押前佔有、保管或控制該物品的人向部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員提交對該物品的書面索賠；
(ii) the claim is in English;
(ii) 索賠是英文的；
(iii) the claim sets out an address for service on the person making the claim; or
(iii) 索賠書列出了索賠人的送達地址；或
(b) within the 21 days, the Minister gives a written order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited.
(b) 在 21 天內，部長發出書面命令，規定該物品不得被沒收。
Note: Section 261I requires things condemned as forfeited to be dealt with in accordance with the Secretary’s directions.
註：第 261I 條要求被判沒收的物品依照部長的指示處理。
(2) A person may claim the thing even if it is disposed of or destroyed before or after the claim.
(2) 一個人可以主張該物品，即使它在主張之前或之後被處置或毀壞。

title: 261G Dealing with claim for thing
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
(1) If the thing is claimed under section 261F:
(1) 如果根據第 261F 條對物品提出索賠：
(a) an officer may retain possession of the thing whether or not any proceedings for the condemnation of the thing have been instituted; and
(a) 官員可以保留對物品的佔有，無論是否已提起對該物品的譴責程序；和
(b) the Minister may give a written order that the thing is not condemned as forfeited; and
(b) 部長可發出書面命令，保證該物品不被宣告沒收；和
(c) unless an order has already been made under paragraph (b), the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may give the claimant a written notice stating that the thing will be condemned as forfeited unless:
(c) 除非已根據(b)款下達命令，否則部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可向索賠人發出書面通知，說明該物品將被沒收，除非：
(i) the claimant institutes proceedings against the Commonwealth within one month to recover the thing, or for a declaration that the thing is not forfeited; or
(i) 索賠人在一個月內向聯邦提起訴訟，以收回該物品，或聲明該物品未被沒收；或
(ii) within one month, the Minister gives a written order that the thing is not condemned as forfeited.
(ii) 在一個月內，部長發出書面命令，不將該物品視為沒收。
Note 1: An officer may retain possession even if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner does not give notice. If so, the claimant will be able to recover the thing only if a court orders its release to the claimant.
註 1：即使部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員沒有發出通知，官員也可以保留財產。如果是這樣，只有法院下令將物品釋放給原告時，原告才能收回該物品。
Note 2: If the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner does give the notice and the claimant institutes proceedings, whether the claimant recovers the thing will depend on the outcome of the proceedings.
註2：如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員確實發出通知並且索賠人提起訴訟，索賠人是否收回物品將取決於訴訟結果。
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may give the notice to the claimant by posting it prepaid as a letter to the last address of the claimant that is known to the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner. If the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner does so, the letter is taken to be properly addressed for the purposes of section 29 of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
(2) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以將通知以預付費信的形式郵寄至部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員所知的索賠人的最後地址，從而向索賠人發出通知。如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員這樣做，則該信函將被視為已根據《1901 年法案解釋法》第 29 條的規定得到妥善處理。
(3) Subsection (2) does not limit the ways in which the notice may be given.
(3) 第(2)款不限制發出通知的方式。
Note: Sections 28A and 29 of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 explain how a notice can be given, and when it is taken to be given.
註：1901 年《法案解釋法》第 28A 和 29 條解釋如何發出通知以及何時發出通知。

title: 261H What happens if thing is claimed
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
(1) This section applies if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner gives the claimant a notice under section 261G about instituting proceedings:
(1) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員根據第 261G 條向索賠人發出有關提起訴訟的通知，則本條適用：
(a) to recover the thing; or
(a) 收回該物品；或
(b) for a declaration that the thing is not forfeited.
(b) 聲明該物品未被沒收。
(2) If, within the period of one month after the notice is given:
(2) 若在通知發出後一個月內：
(a) the claimant does not institute such proceedings; and
(a) 索賠人沒有提起此類訴訟；和
(b) the Minister does not give a written order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited;
(b) 部長未發出書面命令，表示該物品不被判定為沒收；
the thing is condemned as forfeited to the Commonwealth immediately after the end of that period.
該時期結束後，該物品立即被判沒收給英聯邦。
(3) If the claimant institutes such proceedings within the period of one month after the notice is given, the thing is condemned as forfeited to the Commonwealth unless:
(3) 如果索賠人在發出通知後一個月內提起訴訟，則該物品將被宣告沒收，歸聯邦所有，除非：
(a) before the end of the proceedings, the Minister gives a written order that the thing is not to be condemned as forfeited; or
(a) 在訴訟程序結束之前，部長發出書面命令，表明該物品不被判定為沒收；或
(b) at the end of the proceedings, there is:
(b) 程序結束時，有：
(i) an order for the claimant to recover the thing; or
(i) 要求索賠人收回該物品的命令；或
(ii) if the thing has been sold or disposed of—an order for the Commonwealth to pay the claimant an amount in respect of the thing; or
(ii) 若該物品已被出售或處置－聯邦向索賠人支付與該物品有關的款項的命令；或
(iii) a declaration that the thing is not forfeited.
(iii) 該物品未被沒收的聲明。
(4) For the purposes of subsection (3), if the proceedings go to judgment, they end:
(4) 就第 (3) 款而言，如果訴訟程序進入判決，則結束：
(a) if no appeal against the judgment is lodged within the period for lodging such an appeal—at the end of that period; or
(a) 若在提出上訴的期限內沒有對判決提出上訴－則在該期限結束時；或
(b) if an appeal against the judgment is lodged within that period—when the appeal lapses or is finally determined.
(b) 若在該期限內提出針對判決的上訴－當上訴失效或最終裁決時。
(5) Proceedings relating to the thing may be instituted or continued even if it is disposed of or destroyed.
(5) 即使該物已被處置或銷毀，有關該物的訴訟仍可提起或繼續。
(6) If the court hearing the proceedings decides that it would have ordered that the thing be delivered to a person apart from the fact that the thing had been disposed of or destroyed, the court may make such orders as the court considers appropriate, including an order that the Commonwealth pay the person an amount equal to:
(6) 如果審理訴訟的法院決定，除了該物品已被處置或銷毀這一事實之外，它還會命令將該物品交付給某人，則法院可以發布法院認為適當的命令，包括命令聯邦向該人支付相當於以下金額的金額：
(a) if the thing has been sold before the end of the proceedings—the proceeds of the sale of the thing, less such costs incurred by the Commonwealth in respect of the thing as the court considers appropriate; or
(a) 若該物品在訴訟程序結束前已被出售－出售該物品的收益減去法院認為適當的聯邦就該物品所產生的費用；或者
(b) if the thing has been disposed of (except by sale) or destroyed before the end of the proceedings—the market value of the thing at the time it was disposed of or destroyed, less such costs incurred by the Commonwealth in respect of the thing as the court considers appropriate.
(b) 若該物品在訴訟程序結束前已被處置（除出售外）或銷毀－該物品被處置或銷毀時的市場價值，減去法院認為適當的聯邦就該物品所產生的費用。

title: 261I Dealing with thing after it is condemned
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision C — Dealing with things seized as automatically forfeited
text:
If the thing is condemned as forfeited to the Commonwealth, the thing must be dealt with or disposed of in accordance with the directions of the Secretary.
如果該物品被宣告為聯邦沒收，則該物品必須按照部長的指示進行處理或處置。

path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences

path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

Sections 260 and 261 do not limit the operation of this Division.
第 260 條和第 261 條不限製本部門的運作。

zh: E 細分 — 部長命令不得將物品視為沒收
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision E — Minister’s order that a thing not be condemned as forfeited

title: 261K Minister’s order that a thing not be condemned
zh: 261K 部长命令不得谴责某事
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 13A — Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences
Subdivision E — Minister’s order that a thing not be condemned as forfeited
text:
(1) A power of the Minister under this Division to give a written order that a thing is not to be condemned as forfeited must be exercised by the Minister personally.
(1) 部長在本部門下發出書面命令不得將物品視為沒收的權力必須由部長親自行使。
(2) The Minister does not have a duty to consider whether to exercise such a power in respect of any thing, whether the Minister is requested to do so by any person, or in any other circumstances.
(2) 部長沒有義務考慮是否就任何事項行使此類權力，無論是否任何人要求部長這樣做，或在任何其他情況下。
(3) If the Minister makes an order under this Division that a thing is not to be condemned as forfeited, he or she must cause to be laid before each House of the Parliament a statement that sets out:
(3) 如果部長根據本部門命令，某物不被宣告沒收，他或她必須向議會各院提交一份聲明，其中規定：
(a) the order; and
(a) 命令；和
(b) the Minister’s reasons for making the order.
(b) 部长下达命令的理由。
(4) A statement under subsection (3) is to be laid before each House of the Parliament within 15 sitting days of that House after:
(4) 第 (3) 款規定的聲明應在議會各院開會後 15 天內提交：
(a) if the order is made between 1 January and 30 June (inclusive) in a year—1 July in that year; or
(a) 若該命令是在一年中的 1 月 1 日至 6 月 30 日（含）之間作出的－該年的 7 月 1 日；或
(b) if the order is made between 1 July and 31 December (inclusive) in a year—1 January in the following year.
(b) 若該命令是在一年中的 7 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日（含）之間作出的－下一年的 1 月 1 日。

path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

zh: 第 14 分部 — 向某些人追偿费用
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons

title: 262 Liability to the Commonwealth for the cost of keeping, maintaining and removing certain persons
zh: 262 對聯邦承擔保留、維持和遷移某些人員的費用的責任
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
(1) A person who:
(1) 符合以下条件的人：
(a) is, or has been, detained under section 189; and
(a) 正在或已根據第 189 條被拘留；和
(b) was on board a vessel (not being an aircraft) when it was used in connection with the commission of an offence against this Act or against a prescribed law in force in the Commonwealth or in a State or Territory, being a law relating to the control of fishing; and
(b) 當船隻（不是飛機）用於實施違反本法或違反聯邦或州或地區現行規定法律（與捕魚管制有關的法律）的犯罪行為時，在船隻（不是飛機）上；和
(ba) is convicted of the offence;
(ba) 被判有罪；
and the master, owner, agent and charterer of the vessel on which the person travelled to Australia, are, jointly and severally, liable to pay the Commonwealth:
該人前往澳洲所乘船舶的船長、所有人、代理人和承租人有責任共同或分別向聯邦支付：
(c) the amount applicable to the person under subsection (2) for the cost of keeping and maintaining the person while the person is in immigration detention; and
(c) 依第 (2) 款適用於該人在移民拘留期間的保管和維持費用的金額；和
(d) the cost of transporting the person, and a person holding the person, from the vessel to the place of immigration detention; and
(d) 將該人以及拘留該人的人從船隻運送到移民拘留地點的費用；和
(e) the cost of transporting the person, and a person holding the person, between places of immigration detention; and
(e) 在移民拘留地點之間運送該人和拘留該人的人的費用；和
(f) if the person is returned to the vessel or another vessel—the cost of transporting the person, and a person holding the person, from the place of immigration detention to the vessel or that other vessel; and
(f) 如果該人被送回該船或另一艘船－將該人以及持有該人的人從移民拘留地點運送到該船或該另一艘船的費用；和
(g) if the person is, or is to be, removed from Australia at the expense of the Commonwealth—the cost of that removal (including the cost of transporting a person holding the person).
(g) 如果該人正在或將要被移出澳大利亞，費用由聯邦承擔－移送費用（包括運送該人的人員的費用）。
(2) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine a daily amount for the keeping and maintaining of a person in immigration detention at a specified place in a specified period.
(2) 部長可以透過立法文書確定在特定時間內在特定地點拘留和維持移民拘留者的每日金額。
(3) An amount determined under subsection (2) is to be no more than the cost to the Commonwealth of detaining a person at that place in that period.
（3）根據第（2）款確定的金額不得超過聯邦在該期間在該地點拘留一個人的費用。
(4) To avoid doubt, the liability to pay the Commonwealth an amount under subsection (1) may be enforced:
(4) 為避免疑義，可強制執行第 (1) 款規定的向聯邦支付款項的責任：
(a) at the time the person is convicted of an offence mentioned in paragraph (1)(b); or
(a) 該人被判犯有第 (1)(b) 款所述罪行時；或
(b) after the person has served the whole or a part of any sentence imposed upon the person because of his or her conviction of an offence mentioned in paragraph (1)(b).
(b) 該人因犯下第 (1)(b) 款所述罪行而被判處全部或部分刑期後。

title: 263 Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner able to issue notice of debt
zh: 263 秘書或澳洲邊境專員能夠發出債務通知
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
If:
如果：
(a) a person is liable to pay to the Commonwealth an amount under section 262; and
(a) 個人有責任根據第 262 條向聯邦繳納一筆款項；和
(b) the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner gives written notice to the person giving particulars of the liability and stating that the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner requires payment of a specified amount not exceeding that amount;
(b) 部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员向该人发出书面通知，提供责任详情，并说明部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员要求支付不超过该金额的指定金额；
the specified amount is a debt recoverable by the Commonwealth from the person:
指定金額是聯邦可向以下人士追討的債務：
(c) in a court of competent jurisdiction; or
(c) 有管轄權的法院；或
(d) by garnishee notice under section 264.
(d) 依第 264 條發出扣押人通知。

title: 264 Garnishee notice
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
(1) If an amount ( debt ) is a debt recoverable from a person ( debtor ) by the Commonwealth under section 263 or 265, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may by written notice given to another person:
(1) 如果一笔金额（债务）是联邦根据第 263 条或第 265 条可向某人（债务人）追偿的债务，则部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员可通过向另一人发出书面通知：
(a) from whom any money is due or accruing, or may become due, to the debtor; or
(a) 債務人到期或應計或可能到期的任何款項；或
(b) who holds, or may later hold, money for or on account of the debtor; or
(b) 為債務人或持有金錢或日後可能持有金錢給債務人的人；或
(c) who holds, or may later hold, money on account of some other person for payment to the debtor; or
(c) 為其他人持有或以後可能持有金錢以支付給債務人的人；或
(d) who has authority from some other person to pay money to the debtor;
(d) 獲得他人授權向債務人付款的人；
require the person to whom the notice is given to pay to the Commonwealth:
要求收到通知的人向聯邦繳納：
(e) an amount specified in the notice, not exceeding the debt or the amount of the relevant money; or
(e) 通知中指定的金額，但不得超過債務或相關款項的金額；或
(f) such amount as is specified in the notice out of each payment that the person becomes liable from time to time to make to the debtor until that debt is paid.
(f) 通知中指定的該人不時有責任向債務人支付的每筆付款中的金額，直至該債務得到償付。
(2) The time for making a payment in compliance with a notice under subsection (1) is such time as is specified in it, not being a time before:
(2) 根據第 (1) 款的通知進行付款的時間是通知中指定的時間，而不是早於以下時間的時間：
(a) the relevant money becomes due or is held; or
(a) 有關款項到期或被持有；或
(b) the end of the period of 14 days after the notice is given.
(b) 發出通知後 14 天的期限結束。
(3) If the debtor is in Australia when the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner gives the notice, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must give a copy of the notice to the debtor.
(3) 如果部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员发出通知时债务人在澳大利亚，则部长或澳大利亚边境部队专员必须向债务人提供通知副本。
(4) A person who makes a payment to the Commonwealth in compliance with the notice is taken to have made the payment under the authority of the person who owes the debt to the Commonwealth and of any other person concerned.
(4) 依照通知向聯邦付款的人被視為在欠聯邦債務的人和任何其他有關人員的授權下進行了付款。
(5) If, after the notice is given to a person, an amount is paid by another person in reduction or satisfaction of the debt, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must notify the person given the notice accordingly, and the amount specified in the notice is taken to be reduced by the amount paid.
(5) 如果在向某人發出通知後，另一人支付了一筆款項以減少或清償債務，則部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員必須相應地通知收到通知的人，並且通知中指定的金額被視為減去已支付的金額。
(6) If money is not due, or repayable, to a person on demand unless a condition is fulfilled, the money is taken, for the purposes of this section, to be due or repayable on demand, even though the condition has not been fulfilled.
(6) 若除非符合某一條件，否則款項未依要求到期或應償還給某人，則就本條而言，即使該條件尚未滿足，該款項也應依要求到期或應償還。

title: 265 Debt from failure to comply with garnishee notice
zh: 第265章 不遵守扣押通知而產生的債務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
(1) If a person ( garnishee debtor ):
(1) 如果一個人（被抵押債務人）：
(a) is given a notice under section 264 in respect of a debt; and
(a) 根據第 264 條收到關於債務的通知；和
(b) fails to comply with the notice to the extent that the garnishee debtor is capable of complying with it;
(b) 在被扣押債務人有能力遵守的範圍內未能遵守通知；
then the amount of the debt outstanding is recoverable from the garnishee debtor by the Commonwealth by:
那麼聯邦可以透過以下方式從被扣押債務人處收回未償債務金額：
(c) legal proceedings in a court of competent jurisdiction; or
(c) 在有管轄權的法院進行法律訴訟；或
(d) a garnishee notice under section 264.
(d) 第 264 條規定的扣押通知。
(2) The reference in subsection (1) to the amount of the debt outstanding is a reference to whichever is the lesser of:
(2) 第 (1) 款所指的未償債務金額是指下列兩者中的較小者：
(a) as much of the amount required by the notice under section 264 to be paid by the garnishee debtor as the garnishee debtor was able to pay; or
(a) 依第 264 條發出的通知要求被扣押債務人支付的金額為被扣押債務人有能力支付的金額；或
(b) as much of the debt due at the time when the notice was given as remains due from time to time.
(b) 發出通知時的到期債務與不時到期的債務金額相同。
(3) If the Commonwealth recovers:
(3) 如果英聯邦恢復：
(a) the whole or a part of the debt due by the garnishee debtor; or
(a) 被扣押債務人到期的全部或部分債務；或
(b) the whole or a part of the debt due by the debtor (within the meaning of section 264);
(b) 債務人到期的全部或部分債務（第 264 條意義內）；
then:
那麼：
(c) both debts are reduced by the amount that the Commonwealth has so recovered; and
(c) 兩項債務均減少英聯邦已收回的金額；和
(d) the amount specified in the notice under section 264 is taken to be reduced by the amount so recovered.
(d) 依第 264 條發出的通知中指定的金額應減去如此追回的金額。

title: 266 Future debts
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
For the purposes of this Division, an amount is a future debt in relation to a person if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner believes on reasonable grounds that the person will, under section 262, become liable to pay the amount to the Commonwealth.
就本節而言，如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員有合理理由相信該人將根據第 262 條有責任向聯邦支付該金額，則該金額即為與該人相關的未來債務。

title: 267 Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may freeze amounts to secure future debts
zh: 267 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以凍結金額以確保未來的債務
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
(1) If there is a future debt in relation to a person ( future debtor ), the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may by written notice given to another person:
(1) 如果某個人（未來債務人）有未來債務，部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以透過向另一個人發出書面通知：
(a) from whom any money is due or accruing, or may become due, to the future debtor; or
(a) 未來債務人的任何款項到期或應計或可能到期；或
(b) who holds, or may later hold, money for or on account of the future debtor; or
(b) 為或代表未來債務人持有或以後可能持有金錢的人；或
(c) who holds, or may later hold, money on account of some other person for payment to the future debtor; or
(c) 為其他人持有或日後可能持有金錢以支付給未來債務人的人；或
(d) who has authority from some other person to pay money to the future debtor;
(d) 取得其他人授權付款給未來債務人的人；
require the other person to retain for the period, not exceeding 28 days, specified in that notice:
請另一人保留該通知中規定的不超過 28 天的期限：
(e) an amount specified in the notice, not exceeding the future debt or the amount of the relevant money; or
(e) 通知中指定的金額，不得超過未來債務或相關款項的金額；或
(f) such amount as is specified in the notice out of each payment that the person becomes liable from time to time to make to the future debtor until that debt is paid.
(f) 通知中指定的每筆付款中該人不時有責任向未來債務人支付的金額，直至該債務得到償付。
(2) If the future debtor is in Australia when the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner gives the notice, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must give a copy of the notice to the future debtor.
(2) 如果當部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員發出通知時未來債務人在澳大利亞，則部長或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員必須向未來債務人提供一份通知副本。
(3) If, after the notice is given to a person, an amount is paid by another person in respect of the future debt, the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must notify the person given the notice accordingly, and the amount specified in the notice is taken to be reduced by the amount paid.
(3) 如果在向某人發出通知後，另一人就未來債務支付了一筆金額，則部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員必須相應地通知收到通知的人，並且通知中指定的金額將被視為減去已支付的金額。
(4) If money is not due, or repayable, to a person on demand unless a condition is fulfilled, the money is taken, for the purposes of this section, to be due or repayable on demand even though the condition has not been fulfilled.
(4) 若除非符合某一條件，否則款項未依要求到期或應償還給某人，則就本條而言，即使條件尚未滿足，該款項仍應依要求到期或應償還。

title: 268 Application of Division to the Crown
zh: 第268章 王權分割的應用
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14 — Recovery of costs from certain persons
text:
(1) This Division binds the Crown in right of the Commonwealth, of each of the States, of the Australian Capital Territory and of the Northern Territory.
(1) 本部分對澳洲聯邦、各州、澳洲首都領地和北領地的國王具有約束力。
(2) For the purposes of this Division, a notice may be given to the Commonwealth, a State or Territory by giving it to a person employed by the Commonwealth, State or Territory, respectively, being a person who, under a law of the Commonwealth, State or Territory, respectively, has a duty of disbursing public money, and a notice so given is taken, for the purposes of this section, to have been given to the Commonwealth, the State or the Territory, as the case may be.
(2) 就本節而言，向聯邦、州或領地發出通知的方式是，將通知分別發送給受聯邦、州或領地僱用的人員，該人員分別根據聯邦、州或領地的法律有義務支付公共資金，並且就本條而言，如此發出的通知被視為已向聯邦、州或領地發出。領土，視情況而定。

title: Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
zh: 第 14A 分部 — 監控學生簽證條件的遵守情況
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions

title: Subdivision A — Preliminary
zh: 第 A 次分部 — 總則
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions

title: 268AA Definitions
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
text:
In this Division:
在本部門：
attendance notice means a notice given under section 268BD.
出席通知是指依第 268BD 條發出的通知。
document includes copy of a document.
文件包括文件的副本。
education provider means an institution or other body or person in Australia that provides, has provided or seeks to provide courses of education or of training to persons who hold student visas.
教育提供者是指在澳洲向持有學生簽證的人員提供、已提供或尋求提供教育或培訓課程的機構或其他團體或個人。
monitoring warrant means a warrant issued under section 268CE or 268CZD.
監控令是指依第 268CE 或 268CZD 條所簽發的搜索令。
occupier :
佔用人：
(a) in relation to premises comprising a vehicle or vessel—means the person apparently in charge of the vehicle or vessel; and
(a) 就包含車輛或船隻的場所而言－指明顯負責該車輛或船隻的人；和
(b) in any case—includes a person who apparently represents the occupier.
(b) 在任何情況下－包括明顯代表佔用人的人。
premises means:
前提是指：
(a) an area of land or any other place, whether or not it is enclosed or built on; or
(a) 一塊土地或任何其他地方，不論其是否封閉或建於其上；或
(b) a building or other structure; or
(b) a building or other structure;或
(c) a vehicle or vessel;
(c) 車輛或船隻；
and includes a part of any such premises.
並包括任何此類場所的一部分。
production notice means a notice given under section 268BA.
生產通知是指依第 268BA 條發出的通知。
visa monitoring purpose means a purpose of determining whether the conditions of a particular student visa or visas, or of student visas generally, are being or have been complied with.
簽證監控目的是指確定特定學生簽證或一般學生簽證的條件是否正在或已被遵守的目的。

title: 268AB Division binds the Crown
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
text:
(1) This Division binds the Crown in each of its capacities.
(1) 本部分對國王的每一項職能均具有約束力。
(2) However, nothing in this Division makes the Crown in any capacity liable to be prosecuted for an offence.
(2) 然而，本節的任何內容均不規定國王以任何身分應因犯罪而受到起訴。

title: 268AD Powers conferred on magistrates in their personal capacity
zh: 268AD 授予治安法官個人身分的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
text:
(1) A power conferred on a magistrate by section 268BQ, 268CE, 268CU or 268CZD is conferred on the magistrate in a personal capacity and not as a court or a member of a court.
(1) 第 268BQ、268CE、268CU 或 268CZD 條授予治安法官的權力是以個人身分而非法院或法院成員的身分授予治安法官的。
(2) The magistrate need not accept the power conferred.
(2) 治安法官無須接受所授予的權力。
(3) A magistrate exercising a power mentioned in subsection (1) has the same protection and immunity as if he or she were exercising that power as, or as a member of, the court of which the magistrate is a member.
(3) 行使第 (1) 款所述權力的治安法官享有與以其所屬法院或其成員行使該權力相同的保護和豁免。

title: Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
zh: B 部分 — 需要資訊和文件的通知
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents

title: 268BA Production notices
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) This section applies if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner reasonably believes that an individual specified in subsection (4) has, or has access to, information or documents that are relevant to a visa monitoring purpose.
(1) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員合理地認為第 (4) 款中指定的個人擁有或有權存取與簽證監控目的相關的資訊或文件，則本節適用。
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may give the individual a written notice requiring him or her to:
(2) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以向個人發出書面通知，要求他或她：
(a) give any information or documents relevant to the visa monitoring purpose to an authorised officer; or
(a) 向授權官員提供與簽證監控目的相關的任何資訊或文件；或
(b) show any such documents to an authorised officer; or
(b) 向授權人員出示任何此類文件；或
(c) make copies of any such documents and give the copies to an authorised officer.
(c) 複製任何此類文件並將副本交給授權官員。
Note: The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may also give the individual an attendance notice: see section 268BD.
注意：部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員也可以向個人發出出勤通知：請參閱第 268BD 節。
(3) If the information or documents are in a particular form then the production notice may require the information or documents to be given in that form.
(3) 如果資訊或文件採用特定形式，則製作通知可以要求以該形式提供資訊或文件。
(4) The individuals who may be given a production notice are:
(4) 可能收到生產通知的個人是：
(a) an officer or employee of an education provider; or
(a) 教育機構的管理人員或員工；或
(b) a consultant to an education provider; or
(b) 教育機構的顧問；或
(c) a partner in an education provider; or
(c) 教育機構的合作夥伴；或
(d) an individual trading as an education provider.
(d) 作為教育提供者進行交易的個人。
(5) A production notice under this section may be given even if any relevant student visa is no longer in effect or the holder of any such visa is no longer enrolled in a course provided by the education provider.
(5) 即使任何相關學生簽證不再有效或任何此類簽證的持有者不再就讀教育機構提供的課程，也可以根據本節發出出示通知。

title: 268BB Contents of the production notice
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) A production notice must:
(1) 生產通知必須：
(a) state that it is given under section 268BA; and
(a) 說明它是根據第 268BA 條給予的；和
(b) set out the effects of sections 268BH, 268BI and 268BJ; and
(b) 闡明第 268BH、268BI 和 268BJ 條的影響；和
(c) state how and by when the information or documents must be given or shown.
(c) 說明必須提供或出示資訊或文件的方式和時間。
(2) In so far as the notice covers information or documents:
(2) 就通知涵蓋的資訊或文件而言：
(a) that relate to any extent to the calendar year in which the notice is given; and
(a) 與發出通知的日曆年有任何程度的關係；和
(b) that are required to be given or shown on the premises where they are currently located;
(b) 需要在其目前所在場所提供或出示的資訊；
the time mentioned in paragraph (1)(c) must be at least 24 hours after the notice is given.
第(1)(c)款所述的時間必須至少為發出通知後24小時。
(3) In so far as the notice covers any other information or documents, the time mentioned in paragraph (1)(c) must be at least 72 hours after the notice is given.
(3) 就通知涵蓋的任何其他資訊或文件而言，第 (1)(c) 款所提及的時間必須至少為通知發出後 72 小時。

title: 268BC Serving production notices
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must give a production notice to an individual:
(1) 部長或澳洲邊境專員必須向個人發出出示通知：
(a) by delivering it to the individual personally; or
(a) 親自交付給個人；或
(b) by:
(b) 通過：
(i) leaving it at the address of the individual’s place of residence or business last known to the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner; and
(i) 將其留在部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員最後所知的個人居住地或營業地的地址；和
(ii) taking reasonably practicable action to draw the individual’s attention to the notice; or
(ii) 採取合理可行的行動提請個人注意該通知；或
(c) by sending it by ordinary or any other class of pre ‑ paid post to the individual’s place of residence or business last known to the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner.
(c) 透過普通或任何其他類別的預付費郵件將其發送至部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員最後所知的個人居住地或營業地點。
(2) However, if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner uses the method in paragraph (1)(c), the time mentioned in paragraph 268BB(1)(c) must be at least 14 days after the notice is given (instead of at least 24 hours or 72 hours).
(2) 但是，如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員使用第 (1)(c) 款中的方法，第 268BB(1)(c) 款中提到的時間必須是發出通知後至少 14 天（而不是至少 24 小時或 72 小時）。
Note: Section 29 of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 sets out when the notice is taken to have been given if the notice is posted to the individual.
註：1901 年《法案解釋法》第 29 條規定瞭如果將通知郵寄給個人，則何時視為已發出通知。

title: 268BD Attendance notices
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) This section applies if the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner reasonably believes that an individual specified in subsection (3) has, or has access to, information or documents that are relevant to a visa monitoring purpose.
(1) 如果部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員合理地認為第 (3) 款中指定的個人擁有或有權存取與簽證監控目的相關的資訊或文件，則本節適用。
(2) The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may give the individual written notice requiring the individual to attend before an authorised officer and answer questions about the matter.
(2) 部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員可以向個人發出書面通知，要求該個人出席授權官員並回答有關此事的問題。
Note: The Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner may also give the individual a production notice: see section 268BA.
注意：部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員也可以向個人發出出示通知：請參閱第 268BA 節。
(3) The individuals who may be given an attendance notice are:
(3) 可以收到出席通知的個人是：
(a) an officer or employee of an education provider; or
(a) 教育機構的管理人員或員工；或
(b) a consultant to an education provider; or
(b) 教育機構的顧問；或
(c) a partner in an education provider; or
(c) 教育機構的合作夥伴；或
(d) an individual trading as an education provider.
(d) 作為教育提供者進行交易的個人。
(4) An attendance notice under this section may be given even if any relevant student visa is no longer in effect or the holder of any such visa is no longer enrolled in a course provided by the education provider.
(4) 即使任何相關學生簽證不再有效或任何此類簽證的持有者不再就讀教育機構提供的課程，也可以根據本節發出出勤通知。

title: 268BE Contents of attendance notice
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) An attendance notice must:
(1) 出席通知必須：
(a) state that it is given under section 268BD; and
(a) 說明它是根據第 268BD 條給予的；和
(b) set out the effects of sections 268BH, 268BI and 268BJ; and
(b) 闡明第 268BH、268BI 和 268BJ 條的影響；和
(c) state where and when the individual is to attend.
(c) 說明個人出席的地點和時間。
The time mentioned in paragraph (c) must be at least 14 days after the notice is given.
(c) 段所述的時間必須至少為發出通知後 14 天。
(2) An attendance notice may be included in the same document as a production notice, if the notices are being given to the same individual.
(2) 若通知是發給同一個人，出席通知可以與出示通知包含在同一文件中。

title: 268BF Scales of expenses
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
The regulations may prescribe scales of expenses to be allowed to persons required to give information or documents under this Subdivision.
法規可以規定根據本款要求提供資訊或文件的人員的費用範圍。

title: 268BG Reasonable compensation for giving copies
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
A person is entitled to be paid by the Commonwealth reasonable compensation for complying with a requirement covered by paragraph 268BA(2)(c) (copies of documents given under production notices).
個人有權因遵守第 268BA(2)(c) 段（根據生產通知提供的文件副本）所涵蓋的要求而獲得聯邦合理補償。

title: 268BH Offence: failing to comply with a notice
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) A person who refuses or fails to comply with a production or attendance notice commits an offence.
(1) 拒絕或不遵守出示或出席通知的人即屬犯罪。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months.
處罰：監禁 6 個月。
(2) However, a person does not commit an offence in relation to a production notice if the person complied with the notice to the extent that it was practicable to do so within the period allowed by the notice.
(2) 然而，如果一個人在通知允許的期限內切實可行地遵守了通知，則該人不構成與出示通知有關的犯罪。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2): see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code .
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任：參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款。
(3) An offence against subsection (1) is an offence of strict liability.
(3) 違反第 (1) 款的犯罪行為是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。

title: 268BI Offence: giving false or misleading information
zh: 268BI 罪行：提供虛假或誤導性資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
A person who gives false or misleading information in the course of complying or purporting to comply with a production or attendance notice commits an offence.
任何人在遵守或聲稱遵守出示或出席通知的過程中提供虛假或誤導性資訊即屬犯罪。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months.
處罰：監禁 12 個月。

title: 268BJ Offence: giving false or misleading document
zh: 268BJ 罪行：提供虛假或誤導性文件
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) A person who gives or shows a document that is false or misleading in a material particular, in the course of complying or purporting to comply with a production or attendance notice, commits an offence.
(1) 任何人在遵守或聲稱遵守出示或出席通知的過程中，提供或出示在重大事項上虛假或具有誤導性的文件，即屬犯罪。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months.
處罰：監禁 12 個月。
(2) However, the person does not commit the offence if the document is accompanied by a written statement signed by the person:
(2) 但是，如果該文件附有該人簽署的書面聲明，則該人不構成犯罪：
(a) stating that the document is, to the person’s knowledge, false or misleading in the material particular concerned; and
(a) 聲明據該人所知，該文件在相關資料中存在虛假或誤導性；和
(b) setting out or referring to the material particular.
(b) 列出或提及具體資料。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2): see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code .
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任：參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款。

title: 268BK Information and documents that incriminate a person
zh: 268BK 使某人有罪的資訊和文件
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) A person is not excused from the requirement to comply with a production or attendance notice on the ground that doing so might tend to incriminate the person or expose the person to a penalty.
(1) 不得以遵守出示或出勤通知可能會導致該人入罪或受到處罰為由，免除該人遵守出示或出勤通知的要求。
(2) However, if the person is an individual:
(2) 但是，如果該人是個人：
(a) the information, document or answer to the question; or
(a) 資訊、文件或問題的答案；或
(b) any other information, document or thing obtained as a direct or indirect result of complying with a notice;
(b) 因遵守通知而直接或間接取得的任何其他資訊、文件或物品；
is not admissible in evidence against the individual in any criminal proceedings other than proceedings under, or arising out of, section 268BI or 268BJ.
除根據第 268BI 或 268BJ 條提起的訴訟之外，不得在任何刑事訴訟中採納為針對該個人的證據。

title: 268BL Copies of documents
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
An authorised officer, or another officer with an authorised officer’s permission, may:
授權官員或另一位授權官員許可的官員可以：
(a) inspect a document given or shown to the authorised officer under this Subdivision; and
(a) 檢查依本款向授權官員提供或出示的文件；和
(b) make and retain copies of, or take and retain extracts from, such a document; and
(b) 製作並保留該文件的副本，或摘錄並保留該文件的摘錄；和
(c) retain a copy of a document given to the authorised officer in accordance with a requirement covered by paragraph 268BA(2)(c) (copies of documents given under production notices).
(c) 保留根據第 268BA(2)(c) 段所涵蓋的要求提供給授權官員的文件副本（根據生產通知提供的文件副本）。

title: 268BM Officer may retain documents
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) An authorised officer, or another officer with an authorised officer’s permission, may retain a document given to the authorised officer under this Subdivision:
(1) 授權官員或經授權官員許可的另一名官員可以保留根據本款向授權官員提供的文件：
(a) for the purposes of this Act; or
(a) 為本法之目的；或
(b) for the purposes of an investigation as to whether an offence has been committed; or
(b) 為了調查是否有犯罪行為；或
(c) to enable evidence of an offence to be secured for the purposes of a prosecution.
(c) 為起訴目的取得犯罪證據。
(2) However, the document must not be retained for longer than 60 days after the authorised officer was given the document.
(2) 但是，在授權官員收到該文件後，該文件的保留時間不得超過 60 天。
Note: The authorised officer may apply to retain the document for a further period: see section 268BP.
注意：授權官員可以申請進一步保留該文件：請參閱第 268BP 節。

title: 268BN Owner of document must be given copy
zh: 268BN 必須向文件所有者提供副本
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) If an officer retains a document under section 268BM, then the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner must as soon as practicable:
(1) 如果官員根據第 268BM 條保留文件，則部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員必須盡快：
(a) certify a copy of the document to be a true copy; and
(a) 證明該文件的副本是真實副本；和
(b) give the copy to the person (the owner ) otherwise entitled to possession of the document.
(b) 將副本交給有權佔有該文件的人（所有者）。
(2) The certified copy must be received in all courts and tribunals as evidence as if it had been the original.
(2) 所有法院和法庭都必須收到經過核證的副本作為證據，就像它是原件一樣。
(3) Until the certified copy is given, the owner, or a person authorised by the owner, may inspect and make copies of, or take and retain extracts from, the original document at the times and places that the Secretary or Australian Border Force Commissioner thinks appropriate.
(3) 在提供核證副本之前，所有者或所有者授權的人可以在部長或澳洲邊境部隊專員認為適當的時間和地點檢查和複製原始文件，或取得並保留原始文件的摘錄。

title: 268BO Retaining documents
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) This section applies 60 days after a document is given to an authorised officer under this Subdivision.
(1) 本節在向本節規定的授權官員提供文件後 60 天適用。
(2) The authorised officer must take reasonable steps to return the document to the person who gave the officer the document or to the owner if that person is not entitled to possess it.
(2) 授權官員必須採取合理措施將文件返還給向其提供文件的人，或者如果該人無權佔有文件，則歸還給文件所有人。
(3) However, the authorised officer does not have to take those steps if:
(3) 但是，如果出現以下情況，授權官員不必採取這些步驟：
(a) the authorised officer may retain the document because of an order under section 268BQ; or
(a) 授權官員可以根據第 268BQ 條下的命令保留該文件；或者
(b) the authorised officer is otherwise authorised (by a law, or an order of a court, of the Commonwealth or a State) to retain, destroy or dispose of the document.
(b) 授權官員另有授權（根據聯邦或州的法律或法院命令）保留、銷毀或處置該文件。

title: 268BP Officer may apply to magistrate or ART member for a further period
zh: 268BP 官員可以向治安法官或 ART 成員申請延長期限
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) An authorised officer given a document under this Subdivision, or another officer who is currently retaining such a document, may apply to a magistrate or ART member for an order that the officer may retain the document for a further period.
(1) 根據本款獲得文件的授權官員，或目前保留此類文件的其他官員，可以向治安法官或 ART 成員申請命令，要求該官員可以進一步保留該文件。
(2) The application must be made before the end of:
(2) 申請必須在以下日期結束前提出：
(a) 60 days after the document was given to the authorised officer; or
(a) 文件交給授權官員後 60 天；或
(b) a period previously specified in an order of a magistrate or ART member under section 268BQ.
(b) 治安法官或 ART 成員根據第 268BQ 條先前發出的命令中指定的期限。
(3) Before making the application, the officer must:
(3) 在提出申請之前，官員必須：
(a) take reasonable steps to discover which persons’ interests would be affected by the retention of the document; and
(a) 採取合理措施來發現哪些人的利益會因保留該文件而受到影響；和
(b) if it is practicable to do so, notify each person who the officer believes to be such a person of the proposed application.
(b) 如可行，請將擬議的申請通知該官員認為是該人的每個人。

title: 268BQ Magistrate or ART member may order retention for further period
zh: 268BQ 地方法官或 ART 成員可以下令進一步保留
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision B — Notices requiring information and documents
text:
(1) The magistrate or ART member may order that the officer who made the application under section 268BP may retain the document if the magistrate or ART member is satisfied that it is necessary for the officer to retain it:
(1) 如果治安法官或 ART 成員認為有必要保留該文件，則治安法官或 ART 成員可以命令根據第 268BP 條提出申請的官員可以保留該文件：
(a) for the purposes of this Act; or
(a) 為本法之目的；或
(b) for the purposes of an investigation as to whether an offence has been committed; or
(b) 為了調查是否有犯罪行為；或
(c) to enable evidence of an offence to be secured for the purposes of a prosecution.
(c) 為起訴目的取得犯罪證據。
(2) The order must specify the period for which the officer may retain the document.
(2) 該命令必須指定該官員可以保留該文件的期限。

title: Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
zh: C 部分 — 搜尋教育機構的場所
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises

title: 268CA Authorised officer may enter premises for a visa monitoring purpose
zh: 268CA 授權官員可以出於簽證監控目的進入場所
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) An authorised officer may for a visa monitoring purpose:
(1) 授權官員可以出於簽證監控目的：
(a) enter any premises:
(a) 進入任何場所：
(i) occupied by an education provider for the purposes of providing courses of education or of training; or
(i) 由教育機構佔用提供教育或訓練課程；或
(ii) at which it is reasonable to believe there might be a thing belonging to or possessed by an education provider, or an activity conducted by or with the consent of the provider, that is relevant to a visa monitoring purpose (whether or not those premises are occupied by the provider); and
(ii) 有理由相信可能存在屬於教育機構或由教育機構擁有的物品，或由教育機構進行或經其同意進行的活動，與簽證監控目的相關（無論這些場所是否由教育機構佔用）；和
(b) exercise the monitoring powers set out in section 268CI.
(b) 行使第 268CI 條規定的監督權力。
(2) An authorised officer is not authorised to enter premises under subsection (1) unless:
(2) 授權人員無權進入第 (1) 款規定的場所，除非：
(a) the occupier of the premises has consented to the entry and the officer has shown his or her identity card if requested by the occupier; or
(a) 房屋佔用人已同意進入，如果佔用人要求，官員也已出示其身分證；或
Note: Section 268CC sets out the requirements for obtaining the occupier’s consent.
註：第 268CC 條規定了取得佔用人同意的要求。
(b) the entry is made under a monitoring warrant.
(b) 記錄是根據監控令進行的。
Note: Monitoring warrants are issued under section 268CE or 268CZD.
註：監控令是根據第 268CE 或 268CZD 條簽發的。
(3) The powers in this Subdivision may be exercised even if any relevant student visa is no longer in effect or the holder of any such visa is no longer enrolled in a course provided by the education provider.
(3) 即使任何相關學生簽證不再有效或任何此類簽證的持有者不再就讀教育機構提供的課程，也可以行使本節中的權力。

title: 268CB Being on premises with consent
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) An authorised officer may enter premises under section 268CA with the consent of the occupier of the premises at any reasonable time of the day or night.
(1) 經場所佔用人同意，授權人員可依第 268CA 條在白天或夜間的任何合理時間進入場所。
(2) However, the authorised officer must leave the premises if the occupier asks the officer to do so.
(2) 但是，如果佔用人要求授權人員離開該場所，則授權人員必須離開該場所。

title: 268CC Consent
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) Before obtaining the consent of a person for the purposes of paragraph 268CA(2)(a), the authorised officer must inform the person that he or she may refuse consent.
(1) 在出於第 268CA(2)(a) 條的目的獲得某人的同意之前，授權官員必須告知該人他或她可以拒絕同意。
(2) An entry of an authorised officer with the consent of a person is not lawful unless the person voluntarily consents to the entry.
(2) 授權官員在徵得某人同意的情況下進入是不合法的，除非該人自願同意進入。

title: 268CD Authorised officer may apply for monitoring warrant
zh: 268CD 授權人員可申請監控令
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) An authorised officer may apply to a magistrate or ART member for a monitoring warrant in relation to premises mentioned in subsection 268CA(1).
(1) 授權官員可以向治安法官或 ART 成員申請與第 268CA(1) 款中提到的場所有關的監控令。
Note: Monitoring warrants may also be obtained by telephone, fax or other electronic means in urgent circumstances: see section 268CZD.
注意：在緊急情況下也可以透過電話、傳真或其他電子方式取得監控命令：請參閱第 268CZD 節。
(2) The officer must give the magistrate or ART member an information on oath or affirmation that sets out the grounds for seeking the warrant.
(2) 該官員必須向治安法官或 ART 成員提供宣誓或誓言訊息，說明尋求搜索令的理由。

title: 268CE Magistrate or ART member may issue monitoring warrant
zh: 268CE 裁判官或 ART 成員可發出監控令
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
The magistrate or ART member may issue a monitoring warrant if he or she is satisfied that it is reasonably necessary that one or more authorised officers have access to the premises mentioned in subsection 268CA(1) for a visa monitoring purpose.
如果治安法官或 ART 成員確信一名或多名授權官員出於簽證監控目的有合理必要進入第 268CA(1) 款中提到的場所，則他或她可以簽發監控令。

title: 268CF Magistrate or ART member may require more information
zh: 268CF 法官或 ART 成員可能需要更多信息
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) The magistrate or ART member may require an authorised officer or other person to give the magistrate or ART member further information on oath or affirmation concerning the grounds on which the monitoring warrant is being sought before issuing it.
(1) 治安法官或 ART 成員可以要求授權官員或其他人員在簽發監控令之前向治安法官或 ART 成員提供有關尋求監控令的理由的宣誓或確認的進一步資訊。
(2) The information may be given either orally or by affidavit.
(2) 該資訊可以口頭或宣誓方式提供。
(3) The magistrate or ART member must not issue the warrant until the officer or other person has given the required information.
(3) 在官員或其他人提供所需資訊之前，治安法官或 ART 成員不得簽發搜索令。

title: 268CG Contents of monitoring warrant
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) A monitoring warrant must:
(1) 監控令必須：
(a) authorise one or more authorised officers:
(a) 授權一名或多名授權人員：
(i) to enter the premises; and
(i) 進入場所；和
(ii) to exercise the powers under section 268CI in relation to the premises; and
(ii) 根據第 268CI 條行使與該處所相關的權力；和
(b) state whether the entry is authorised at any time of the day or night or during specified hours of the day or night; and
(b) 說明是否在白天或晚上的任何時間或在白天或晚上的指定時間內允許進入；和
(c) state the day and time at which it ceases to have effect (which must be no later than 7 days after it is issued); and
(c) 說明其失效的日期和時間（不得晚於發布後 7 天）；和
(d) state the purpose for which the warrant is issued; and
(d) 說明簽發逮捕令的目的；和
(e) state that the warrant is issued under section 268CE.
(e) 說明該搜索令是根據第 268CE 條簽發的。
(2) The authorised officers do not have to be named in the warrant.
(2) 授權官員不必在授權令中註明姓名。

title: 268CH Use of reasonable force and assistance
zh: 268CH 使用合理的武力和協助
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
An authorised officer may use such assistance and force as is necessary and reasonable in entering the premises under a monitoring warrant and exercising the powers under section 268CI.
授權人員可使用必要且合理的協助和武力，根據監控令進入場所並根據第 268CI 條行使權力。

title: 268CI Monitoring powers of authorised officers
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) For the purposes of this Subdivision, the following are the monitoring powers that an authorised officer may exercise in relation to premises under section 268CA:
(1) 就本節而言，以下是授權人員可依據第 268CA 條對場所行使的監督權力：
(a) to search the premises, and any receptacle on the premises, for any thing on the premises belonging to or possessed by the education provider that might be relevant to a visa monitoring purpose;
(a) 搜索場所以及場所內的任何容器，尋找屬於教育機構或由教育機構擁有的任何可能與簽證監控目的相關的物品；
(b) to examine any such thing;
(b) 檢查任何此類事物；
(c) to examine any activity that is conducted on the premises by, or with the consent of, the education provider that might be relevant to a visa monitoring purpose;
(c) 檢視教育機構在其場所內進行的或經教育機構同意進行的任何可能與簽證監控目的相關的活動；
(d) to take photographs or make video or audio recordings or sketches on the premises of any such activity or thing;
(d) 在任何此類活動或事物的場所拍照或製作影片、錄音或素描；
(e) to inspect any document on the premises belonging to or possessed by the education provider that might be relevant to a visa monitoring purpose;
(e) 檢查屬於或由教育機構擁有的場所內可能與簽證監控目的相關的任何文件；
(f) to take extracts from or make copies of any such document;
(f) 摘錄或複製任何此類文件；
(g) to take onto the premises any equipment and materials that the authorised officer requires for the purpose of exercising powers in relation to the premises;
(g) 將授權人員為行使與該處所有關的權力而需要的任何設備和材料帶入該處所；
(h) the powers in subsections (2), (3) and (5).
(h) 第(2)、(3)和(5)款中的權力。
(2) For the purposes of this Subdivision, the monitoring powers include the power to operate equipment that is on the premises to see whether:
(2) 就本節而言，監控權力包括操作場所內設備的權力，以查看是否：
(a) the equipment; or
(a) 設備；或
(b) a disk, tape or other storage device that:
(b) 磁碟、磁帶或其他儲存設備：
(i) is on the premises; and
(i) 在場所內；和
(ii) can be used with the equipment or is associated with it;
(ii) 可與設備一起使用或與之相關；
contains information belonging to the education provider that is relevant to a visa monitoring purpose.
包含屬於教育機構的與簽證監控目的相關的資訊。
(3) For the purposes of this Division, the monitoring powers include the following powers in relation to information described in subsection (2) that is found in the exercise of the power under that subsection:
(3) 就本节而言，监督权力包括与第 (2) 款所述信息相关的以下权力，这些信息是在行使该款规定的权力时发现的：
(a) to operate facilities that are on the premises to put the information in documentary form and remove the documents so produced;
(a) 營運場所內的設施，以文件形式記錄資訊並移除由此產生的文件；
(b) to operate such facilities to transfer the information to a disk, tape or other storage device that:
(b) 操作此類設施將資訊傳輸至磁碟、磁帶或其他儲存設備，從而：
(i) is brought to the premises for the exercise of the power; or
(i) 被帶至場所行使權力；或
(ii) is on the premises and the use of which for that purpose has been agreed to in writing by the education provider or occupier (as appropriate);
(ii) 位於場所內，且教育機構或占用人（視情況而定）已書面同意為此目的使用該場所；
(c) to remove from the premises a disk, tape or other storage device to which the information has been transferred in exercise of the power under paragraph (b).
(c) 從場所移走在行使(b)款規定的權力時已轉移資訊的磁碟、磁帶或其他儲存設備。
(4) The powers mentioned in subsections (2) and (3) must be exercised in accordance with sections 268CO, 268CP and 268CQ.
(4) 第(2)及(3)款所述權力必須依據第268CO、268CP及268CQ條行使。
(5) If an authorised officer, during a search of premises, reasonably believes that there is on the premises a thing that might afford evidence of the commission of an offence against this Act or the regulations, the Crimes Act 1914 or the Criminal Code , the monitoring powers include securing the thing pending the obtaining of a warrant to seize it.
(5) 如果授权官员在搜查房屋时合理地认为该房屋内存在可能提供违反本法或条例、《1914 年犯罪法》或《刑法》的犯罪证据的物品，则监控权力包括在获得扣押令之前保护该物品。

title: 268CJ Authorised officer on premises with consent may ask questions
zh: 268CJ 經同意的場所內授權官員可以提出問題
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
An authorised officer who is only authorised to enter premises because the occupier of the premises consented to the entry may:
僅因場所佔用人同意進入而被授權進入場所的授權人員可以：
(a) ask the occupier to:
(a) 要求佔用人：
(i) answer any questions that are relevant to a visa monitoring purpose; and
(i) 回答與簽證監控目的相關的任何問題；和
(ii) give or show the officer any document requested by the officer that is relevant to the matter; or
(ii) 向該官員提供或出示該官員要求的與該事項相關的任何文件；或
(b) ask any person on the premises to answer any questions that may facilitate the exercise of monitoring powers in relation to the premises.
(b) 要求該場所內的任何人回答任何可能有助於行使與該場所有關的監督權力的問題。
Note: A person could commit an offence if, under this section, the person gives false or misleading information or shows a document that is false or misleading in a material particular: see sections 268CM and 268CN.
注意：根據本節，如果某人提供虛假或誤導性資訊或出示在重要細節上虛假或誤導性的文件，則可能構成犯罪：請參閱第 268CM 和 268CN 條。

title: 268CK Authorised officer on premises under warrant may ask questions
zh: 268CK 根據授權令在場所內的授權人員可以提出問題
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
An authorised officer who is authorised to enter premises by a monitoring warrant may:
監控令授權進入場所的授權人員可以：
(a) require the occupier of the premises to:
(a) 要求場所佔用人：
(i) answer any questions that are relevant to a visa monitoring purpose; and
(i) 回答與簽證監控目的相關的任何問題；和
(ii) give or show the officer any document requested by the officer that is relevant to a visa monitoring purpose; or
(ii) 向官員提供或出示其要求的與簽證監控目的相關的任何文件；或
(b) require any person on the premises to answer any questions that may facilitate the exercise of monitoring powers in relation to the premises.
(b) 要求場所內的任何人回答任何可能有助於行使與場所有關的監督權力的問題。
Note 1: A person could commit an offence if the person fails to comply with a requirement under this section: see section 268CL.
註 1：如果不遵守本節的要求，則可能構成犯罪：請參閱第 268CL 條。
Note 2: A person could commit an offence if, under this section, the person gives false or misleading information or shows a document that is false or misleading in a material particular: see sections 268CM and 268CN.
註 2：根據本節規定，如果某人提供虛假或誤導性資訊或出示在重要細節上虛假或誤導性的文件，則可能構成犯罪：請參閱第 268CM 和 268CN 條。

title: 268CL Offence: failure to answer question
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if the person refuses or fails to comply with a requirement under section 268CK (officer on premises under warrant may ask questions).
(1) 若拒絕或未遵守第 268CK 條的要求，即構成犯罪（現場警官可依逮捕令提出問題）。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months.
處罰：監禁 6 個月。
(2) However, a person does not commit an offence if answering the question or giving or showing the document might tend to incriminate the person or expose the person to a penalty.
(2) 但是，如果回答問題或提供或出示文件可能導致該人入罪或受到處罰，則該人不構成犯罪。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2): see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code .
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任：參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款。
(3) An offence against subsection (1) is an offence of strict liability.
(3) 違反第 (1) 款的犯罪行為是嚴格責任犯罪。
Note: For strict liability , see section 6.1 of the Criminal Code .
註：嚴格責任請參考刑法第6.1條。

title: 268CM Offence: giving false or misleading information
zh: 268CM 罪行：提供虛假或誤導性資訊
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
A person who gives false or misleading information in the course of complying or purporting to comply with a request under section 268CJ or a requirement under section 268CK commits an offence.
任何人在遵守或聲稱遵守第 268CJ 條下的請求或第 268CK 條下的要求的過程中提供虛假或誤導性信息，即屬犯罪。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months.
處罰：監禁 12 個月。

title: 268CN Offence: giving or showing documents that are false or misleading in material particulars
zh: 268CN 犯罪：提供或出示在重要細節上虛假或具有誤導性的文件
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) A person who gives or shows a document that is false or misleading in a material particular, in the course of complying or purporting to comply with a request under section 268CJ or a requirement under section 268CK, commits an offence.
(1) 任何人在遵守或聲稱遵守第 268CJ 條規定的請求或第 268CK 條規定的要求的過程中，提供或出示在重大事項上虛假或誤導性的文件，即構成犯罪。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months.
處罰：監禁 12 個月。
(2) However, the person does not commit an offence if the document is accompanied by a written statement signed by the person:
(2) 但是，如果該文件附有該人簽署的書面聲明，則該人不構成犯罪：
(a) stating that the document is, to the person’s knowledge, false or misleading in the material particular concerned; and
(a) 聲明據該人所知，該文件在相關資料中存在虛假或誤導性；和
(b) setting out or referring to the material particular.
(b) 列出或提及具體資料。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subsection (2): see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code .
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任：參見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款。

title: 268CO Use of electronic equipment in exercising monitoring powers
zh: 268CO 使用電子設備行使監控權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
In order to exercise monitoring powers, an authorised officer or a person assisting may operate electronic equipment on the premises if he or she reasonably believes that this can be done without damaging the equipment or data recorded on the equipment.
為了行使監控權力，授權人員或協助人員可以在場所內操作電子設備，如果他或她合理地認為可以在不損壞設備或設備上記錄的資料的情況下進行操作。
Note: Compensation may be payable in certain circumstances if the equipment or data is damaged: see section 268CY.
注意：在某些情況下，如果設備或資料損壞，可能需要支付賠償金：請參閱第 268CY 節。

title: 268CP Use of electronic equipment by experts
zh: 268CP 專家對電子設備的使用
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) This section applies if the authorised officer or a person assisting reasonably believes that:
(1) 若授權人員或協助人員有理由相信以下情況，則本節適用：
(a) there is on the premises information belonging to the education provider concerned:
(a) 校內有屬於相關教育機構的資料：
(i) that is relevant to a visa monitoring purpose; and
(i) 與簽證監控目的有關；和
(ii) that might be accessible by operating electronic equipment that is on the premises; and
(ii) 可透過操作場所內的電子設備進行存取；和
(b) expert assistance is required to operate the equipment; and
(b) 操作設備需要專家協助；和
(c) if he or she does not take action under subsection (2), the information might be destroyed, altered or otherwise interfered with.
(c) 如果他或她不根據第 (2) 款採取行動，資訊可能會被銷毀、更改或以其他方式受到干擾。
(2) The authorised officer or person assisting may do whatever is necessary to secure the equipment.
(2) 授權官員或協助人員可以採取一切必要措施來保護設備。
(3) Before doing so, the authorised officer or person assisting must give notice to the occupier of the premises of:
(3) 在此之前，授權官員或協助人員必須向場所佔用人發出以下通知：
(a) his or her intention to secure equipment; and
(a) 他或她取得設備的意圖；和
(b) the fact that the equipment may be secured for up to 24 hours.
(b) 設備的安全時間最長可達 24 小時。
(4) The equipment may only be secured until the earlier of:
(4) 設備只能在以下時間之前得到保護：
(a) 24 hours later; or
(a) 24小時後；或
(b) the equipment being operated by the expert.
(b) 專家正在操作的設備。

title: 268CQ Extension of period
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) If an authorised officer or a person assisting reasonably believes that the expert assistance will not be available within 24 hours, he or she may apply to a magistrate or ART member for an extension of the period.
(1) 如果授權官員或協助人員合理地認為 24 小時內無法提供專家協助，他或她可以向治安法官或 ART 成員申請延長期限。
(2) The authorised officer or a person assisting must give notice to the occupier of the premises of his or her intention to apply for an extension. The occupier is entitled to be heard in relation to that application.
(2) 授權官員或協助人員必須將其申請延期的意圖通知房屋佔用人。佔用人有權就該申請發表意見。
(3) The provisions of this Subdivision relating to the issue of monitoring warrants apply, with such modifications as are necessary, to the issue of an extension.
(3) 本節有關簽發監控令的規定，經過必要的修改後，適用於延期的簽發。

title: 268CR Powers without warrant in emergency situations
zh: 268CR 在緊急情況下無需授權的權力
path: Part 2 — Arrival, presence and departure of persons
Division 14A — Monitoring compliance with student visa conditions
Subdivision C — Searching education providers’ premises
text:
(1) This section applies when an authorised officer is on premises under section 268CA if the officer reasonably suspects that:
(1) 當授權官員根據第 268CA 條在場所內時，如果該官員有理由懷疑：
(a) a thing relevant to an offence against this Act or the regulations, the Crimes Act 1914 or the Criminal Code is on the premises; and
(a) 場所內有與違反本法或條例、1914 年犯罪法或刑法典相關的物品；和
(b) it is necessary to exercise a power under subsection (2) in order to prevent the thing from being concealed, lost or destroyed; and
(b) 有必要行使第(2)款規定的權力，以防止該物品被隱藏、遺失或毀壞；和
