(i) 就本法或條例規定的任何事項收取和收取費用，包括與審查根據本法或條例作出的決定有關的應付費用，無論此類審查是否由本法或根據本法規定；或
(ii) the charging and recovery of fees in respect of English language tests conducted by or on behalf of the Department;
(ii) 由教育部或代表教育部進行的英語語言測試的收費和回收；
(iii) the way, including the currency, in which fees are to be paid; or
(iii) 支付費用的方式，包括貨幣；或
(iv) the persons who may be paid fees on behalf of the Commonwealth;
(iv) 可以代表聯邦收取費用的人員；
(b) making provision for the remission, refund or waiver of fees of a kind referred to in paragraph (a) or for exempting persons from the payment of such fees;
(b) 制定減免、退款或免除(a)款所述費用的規定，或免除個人支付此類費用的規定；
(c) making provision for or in relation to the furnishing or obtaining of information with respect to:
(c) 就提供或取得以下方面的資訊作出規定：
(i) persons on board a vessel arriving at a port in Australia in the course of, or at the conclusion of, a voyage or flight that commenced at, or during which the vessel called at, a place outside Australia; and
(i) 在航行或飛行過程中或結束時到達澳大利亞港口的船上人員，該航行或飛行從澳大利亞境外的某個地方開始，或在該過程中停靠在澳大利亞境外的某個地方；和
(ii) persons on board a vessel leaving a port in Australia and bound for, or calling at, a place outside Australia; and
(ii) 離開澳洲港口前往或停靠澳洲境外某個地點的船上人員；和
(iii) persons on board an aircraft arriving at or departing from an airport in Australia, being an aircraft operated by an international air carrier;
(iii) 抵達或離開澳洲機場的飛機上的人員，該飛機是由國際航空公司營運的飛機；
(d) making provision for and in relation to the use that may be made by persons or bodies other than officers of the Department of information collected pursuant to regulations made under paragraph (c);
(d) 就除部門官員以外的個人或機構對根據(c)段製定的規定收集的資訊的使用作出規定；
(e) making provision for and in relation to:
(e) 為以下方面作出規定：
(i) the giving of documents to;
(i) 提供以下人員文件；
(ii) the lodging of documents with; or
(ii) 提交文件；或
(iii) the service of documents on;
(iii) 文件送達；
the Minister, the Secretary or any other person or body, for the purposes of this Act;
就本法而言，部長、秘書或任何其他個人或機構；
(f) prescribing the practice and procedure in relation to proceedings before a Commissioner or a prescribed authority under this Act, including the summoning of witnesses, the production of documents, the taking of evidence on oath or affirmation, the administering of oaths or affirmations and the payment of expenses of witnesses;
(f) 規定與根據本法向專員或指定機構進行的訴訟有關的慣例和程序，包括傳喚證人、出示文件、在宣誓或宣誓後取證、宣誓或宣誓的管理以及證人費用的支付；
(g) requiring assurances of support to be given, in such circumstances as are prescribed or as the Minister thinks fit, in relation to persons seeking to enter, or remain in, Australia and providing for the enforcement of assurances of support and the imposition on persons who give assurances of support of liabilities in respect of the maintenance of, and other expenditure in connexion with, the persons in respect of whom the assurances of support are given;
(g) 要求在規定的情況下或部長認為合適的情況下，對尋求進入或留在澳洲的人提供贍養保證的人的贍養費和其他支出相關的責任；
(i) enabling a person who is alleged to have contravened section 137 to pay to the Commonwealth, as an alternative to prosecution, a prescribed penalty, not exceeding 10 penalty units;
(i) 使被指控違反第 137 條的人能夠向聯邦繳納不超過 10 個罰款單位的規定罰款，作為起訴的替代辦法；
(j) enabling a person who is alleged to have contravened section 229 or 230 to pay to the Commonwealth, as an alternative to prosecution, a prescribed penalty, not exceeding:
(j) 使被指控違反第 229 或 230 條規定的人能夠向聯邦繳納規定的罰款，作為起訴的替代辦法，但不得超過：
(i) in the case of a natural person—30 penalty units; and
(i) 如果是自然人－30個處罰單位；和
(ii) in the case of a body corporate—100 penalty units; and
(ii) 若是法人團體－100 個罰金單位；和
(jaa) enabling a person who is alleged to have committed an offence against subsection 245N(2) to pay to the Commonwealth, as an alternative to prosecution, a prescribed penalty, not exceeding 10 penalty units; and
(jaa) 使被指控犯有第 245N(2) 款罪行的人能夠向聯邦繳納不超過 10 個罰款單位的規定罰款，作為起訴的替代辦法；和
(ja) enabling a person who is alleged to have committed an offence against subsection 280(1) to pay to the Commonwealth, as an alternative to prosecution, a penalty of 12 penalty units; and
(ja) 允許被指控違反第 280(1) 款規定的人向聯邦繳納 12 個罰款單位的罰款，作為起訴的替代辦法；和
(k) prescribing penalties, of imprisonment for a period not exceeding 6 months or a fine not exceeding 10 penalty units, in respect of offences against the regulations; and
(k) 對違反條例的行為規定處罰，即不超過 6 個月的監禁或不超過 10 個處罰單位的罰款；和
(l) making provision for matters that, under the Education Services for Overseas Students Act 2000 , are required or permitted to be prescribed in regulations made under this Act.
(l) 對《2000 年海外學生教育服務法》中要求或允許在根據本法制定的法規中規定的事項作出規定。
(2) Section 14 of the Legislation Act 2003 does not prevent, and has not prevented, regulations whose operation depends on a country or other matter being specified or certified by the Minister in an instrument in writing made under the regulations after the commencement of the regulations.
(2) 2003 年《立法法》第 14 條不阻止、也從未阻止過其實施取決於國家或部長在條例生效後根據條例制定的書面文書中指定或認證的其他事項的條例。
(2A) The regulations that may be made under paragraph (1)(e) include, but are not limited to, regulations specifying circumstances in which a document is to be taken to have been given in a specified way.
(2A) 依第 (1)(e) 款可能製定的規定包括但不限於規定文件被視為以特定方式提供的情況的規定。
(3) The regulations that may be made under paragraph (1)(e) include, but are not limited to, regulations providing that a document given to, or served on, a person in a specified way shall be taken for all purposes of this Act and the regulations to have been received by the person at a specified or ascertainable time.
(3) 根據第 (1)(e) 款可能製定的法規包括但不限於規定以特定方式向某人提供或送達的文件應用於本法的所有目的的法規以及該人在指定或可確定的時間收到的法規。
(3A) The Evidence Act 1995 does not affect the operation of regulations made for the purposes of paragraph (1)(e).
(3A) 1995 年《證據法》不影響為第 (1)(e) 款目的而製定的法規的實施。
(4) Regulations in respect of a matter referred to in paragraph (1)(g) may apply in relation to maintenance guarantees given before the commencement of this Part in accordance with the regulations that were in force under any of the Acts repealed by this Act.
(4) 有關第 (1)(g) 款所述事項的規定可適用於本部分生效前根據本法廢除的任何法案中有效的規定提供的贍養擔保。
(5) An assurance of support given, after the commencement of this subsection, in accordance with regulations under paragraph (1)(g) continues to have effect, and may be enforced, in accordance with such regulations in spite of any change in circumstances whatsoever.
(5) 在本款生效後，根據第 (1)(g) 款的規定提供的支持保證繼續有效，並且無論情況發生任何變化，都可以根據這些規定強制執行。
(5A) The following have effect only in relation to assurances of support that were given before 1 July 2004 and are not assurances of support in relation to which Chapter 2C of the Social Security Act 1991 applies or applied:
(5A) 以下內容僅對 2004 年 7 月 1 日之前提供的贍養保證有效，並非適用或適用 1991 年社會安全法第 2C 章的贍養保證：
(a) subsection (5) of this section;
(a) 本條第(5)款；
(b) regulations made under paragraph (1)(g) (whether before, on or after the commencement of this subsection) providing for:
(b) 依第 (1)(g) 款制定的條例（無論是在本款生效前、時或之後）規定：
(i) the enforcement of assurances of support; or
(i) 執行支援保證；或者
(ii) the imposition on persons who give assurances of support of liabilities in respect of the maintenance of, and other expenditure in connection with, the persons in respect of whom the assurances of support are given.
(ii) 向提供贍養保證的人徵收與提供贍養保證的人有關的贍養費和其他支出方面的責任。
(6) In this section:
(6) 本節：
international air carrier means an air transport enterprise that operates an air service between Australia and a place outside Australia.
國際航空承運人是指在澳洲與澳洲境外之間經營航空服務的航空運輸企業。

title: 505 Regulations about visa criteria
text:
To avoid doubt, regulations for the purpose of prescribing a criterion for visas of a class may provide that the Minister, when required to decide whether an applicant for a visa of the class satisfies the criterion:
為避免疑問，規定某類簽證標準的法規可以規定，當需要決定該類簽證申請人是否符合該標準時，部長：
(a) is to get a specified person or organisation, or a person or organisation in a specified class, to:
(a) 是讓特定的個人或組織，或特定類別的個人或組織：
(i) give an opinion on a specified matter; or
(i) 對特定事項發表意見；或
(ii) make an assessment of a specified matter; or
(ii) 對特定事項進行評估；或
(iii) make a finding about a specified matter; or
(iii) 就特定事項作出調查結果；或
(iv) make a decision about a specified matter; and
(iv) 對特定事項作出決定；和
(b) is:
(b) 是：
(i) to have regard to that opinion, assessment, finding or decision in; or
(i) 考慮該意見、評估、調查結果或決定；或
(ii) to take that opinion, assessment, finding or decision to be correct for the purposes of;
(ii) 認為該意見、評估、調查結果或決定是正確的；
deciding whether the applicant satisfies the criterion.
決定申請人是否符合標準。

title: 506 Regulations about passenger cards
zh: 第506章 關於旅客卡的規定
text:
(1) Regulations under paragraph 504(1)(c) may provide for the giving of different information about different classes of people.
(1) 第 504(1)(c) 條規定的規定可以規定提供有關不同類別人員的不同資訊。
(2) The regulations are to provide for the giving of information, in the form of answers to questions on a form, to be known as a passenger card, by non ‑ citizens travelling to Australia, other than non ‑ citizens exempted by the regulations.
(2) 法規規定，前往澳洲旅行的非公民（法規豁免的非公民除外）必須以回答表格上的問題的形式提供信息，稱為旅客卡。
(3) The questions for a non ‑ citizen required by subsection (2) may include, but are not limited to, questions about any or all of the following:
(3) 第 (2) 款要求向非公民提出的問題可包括但不限於以下任何或全部問題：
(a) the non ‑ citizen’s health;
(a) 非公民的健康；
(b) any criminal convictions in Australia or a foreign country of the non ‑ citizen;
(b) 該非公民在澳洲或外國被定罪的任何刑事案件；
(c) the purpose of the new arrival’s going to Australia;
(c) 新抵達澳洲的目的；
(d) any unpaid debts to the Commonwealth of the non ‑ citizen;
(d) 非公民對聯邦的任何未償債務；
(e) any removal or deportation from, or refusal of admission into, Australia or a foreign country of the non ‑ citizen.
(e) 將非公民驅逐出澳洲或外國，或拒絕其入境。

title: 506A Regulations may provide for infringement notices
text:
(1) The regulations may provide for a person who is alleged to have contravened a civil penalty provision to pay a penalty to the Commonwealth as an alternative to proceedings for a civil penalty order against the person.
(1) 條例可以規定被指控違反民事處罰規定的人向聯邦繳納罰款，作為針對該人的民事處罰令訴訟的替代方案。
(2) The penalty must not exceed one ‑ fifth of the maximum penalty that a court could impose on the person for a contravention of the civil penalty provision.
(2) 處罰不得超過法院因違反民事處罰規定而可判處的最高處罰的五分之一。

title: 506B Tax file numbers
text:
Request for tax file numbers
索取税号
(1) The Secretary may request any of the persons mentioned in subsection (2) to provide the tax file number of a person (the relevant person ) who is an applicant for, or holder or former holder of, a visa of a kind (however described) prescribed by the regulations.
(1) 部長可以要求第 (2) 款中提到的任何人提供法規規定的某種簽證（無論如何描述）的申請人、持有人或前持有人的人（相關人）的稅號。
(2) For the purposes of subsection (1), the persons are any of the following:
(2) 就第 (1) 款而言，這些人是以下任何一種：
(a) the applicant, holder or former holder;
(a) 申請人、持有人或前持有人；
(b) an approved sponsor of the applicant, holder or former holder;
(b) 申請人、持有人或前持有人的核准擔保人；
(c) a former approved sponsor of the applicant, holder or former holder;
(c) 申请人、持有人或前持有人的前批准担保人；
(d) a person who has nominated the applicant or holder in an approved nomination that has not ceased under the regulations;
(d) 在已核准的提名中提名申請人或持有人的人，且提名未依規定終止；
(e) a person who nominated the holder or former holder in an approved nomination that has ceased under the regulations.
(e) 在已根據條例規定終止的已批准提名中提名持有人或前持有人的人。
(3) A person to whom a request is made under subsection (1) who is lawfully in possession of the tax file number may disclose the tax file number in accordance with the request.
(3) 根據第 (1) 款向合法擁有稅務檔案號碼的人提出請求的人可以根據請求披露稅務檔案號碼。
Verification of tax file numbers
验证税号
(4) The Secretary may provide the tax file number to the Commissioner of Taxation for the purpose of verifying the tax file number.
(4) 秘書可以向稅務專員提供稅號，以核實稅號。
(5) On receiving the tax file number, the Commissioner of Taxation may give the Secretary a written notice in accordance with the following table.
(5) 收到稅號後，稅務局局長可依下表向秘書發出書面通知。
Notices of the Commissioner of Taxation
Item | If … | the Commissioner may give the Secretary written notice …
1 | the Commissioner is satisfied that the number is correct | informing the Secretary accordingly.
2 | (a) the Commissioner is satisfied that the tax file number is not correct; and (b) the Commissioner is satisfied that the relevant person has a tax file number; | of the correct tax file number.
3 | (a) the Commissioner is satisfied that the tax file number is not correct; and (b) the Commissioner is not satisfied that the relevant person has a tax file number; | informing the Secretary accordingly.
税务局局长的通知
項目 |如果…|專員可以向部長發出書面通知…
1 |專員確信該數字是正確的 | informing the Secretary accordingly.
2 | (a) 稅務局局長確信稅號不正確； (b) 稅務局局長確信相關人員有稅號； | of the correct tax file number.
3 | (a) 稅務局局長確信稅號不正確； (b) 稅務局局長不確信相關人員有稅號；| 相應地通知秘書。
Commissioner of Taxation may provide tax file number
税务专员可以提供税号
(6) The Commissioner of Taxation may provide the tax file number of a person to the Secretary if the Secretary advises the Commissioner that the person is a relevant person.
(6) 如果秘書告知稅務專員該人是相關人員，則稅務專員可以向秘書提供該人的稅務檔案號碼。
Use, records or disclosures of tax file numbers
Use, records or disclosures of tax file numbers
(7) A tax file number provided under this section may be used, recorded or disclosed by an officer for any purposes prescribed by the regulations.
(7) 官員可以出於法規規定的任何目的使用、記錄或揭露根據本節提供的稅號。

title: 507 Marital or relationship status
text:
(1) The Sex Discrimination Act 1984 , to the extent that it applies to the status or condition of being the spouse or de facto partner of another person, does not operate in relation to:
(1) 《1984 年性別歧視法》在適用於作為他人的配偶或同居伴侶的身份或條件的範圍內，不適用於：
(a) regulations, or the making of regulations, that, for the purposes of dealing with an application for a visa, specify:
(a) 為處理簽證申請而製定的法規或法規，具體規定：
(i) the nature and incidents of the relationship between a person and another person; or
(i) 一個人與另一個人之間關係的性質和事件；或
(ii) the period for which a relationship of a specified kind must have existed between a person and another person;
(ii) 一個人與另一個人之間必須存在特定種類的關係的期限；
before the person is taken to be the de facto partner of the other person; or
在該人被視為另一人的事實上的伴侶之前；或
(b) the performance of any function, the exercise of any power or the fulfilment of any responsibility, in connection with the administration of any such regulation.
(b) 與任何此類法規的管理有關的任何職能的履行、任何權力的行使或任何責任的履行。
(2) To avoid doubt, subsection (1) does not prevent the Sex Discrimination Act 1984 from applying in relation to the marital or relationship status of persons making or administering regulations covered by subsection (1).
(2) 為避免疑問，第 (1) 款並不妨礙《1984 年性別歧視法》適用於制定或執行第 (1) 款所涵蓋法規的人員的婚姻或關係狀況。

title: Endnote 1—About the endnotes
text:
The endnotes provide information about this compilation and the compiled law.
尾註提供了有關本彙編和已彙編法律的資訊。
The following endnotes are included in every compilation:
每個彙編中都包含以下尾註：
Endnote 1—About the endnotes
尾註 1——關於尾註
Endnote 2—Abbreviation key
尾註 2——縮寫鍵
Endnote 3—Legislation history
尾註 3——立法歷史
Endnote 4—Amendment history
尾註 4——修改歷史
Abbreviation key—Endnote 2
縮寫鍵－尾註 2
The abbreviation key sets out abbreviations that may be used in the endnotes.
縮寫鍵列出了尾註中可能使用的縮寫。
Legislation history and amendment history—Endnotes 3 and 4
立法歷史和修訂歷史—尾註3和4
Amending laws are annotated in the legislation history and amendment history.
修改法律在立法史和修改史都有註釋。
The legislation history in endnote 3 provides information about each law that has amended (or will amend) the compiled law. The information includes commencement details for amending laws and details of any application, saving or transitional provisions that are not included in this compilation.
尾註 3 中的立法歷史提供了已修訂（或將修訂）法律彙編的每項法律的資訊。這些資訊包括修訂法律的開始細節以及本彙編中未包含的任何應用、保存或過渡條款的詳細資訊。
The amendment history in endnote 4 provides information about amendments at the provision (generally section or equivalent) level. It also includes information about any provision of the compiled law that has been repealed in accordance with a provision of the law.
尾註 4 中的修訂歷史記錄提供了有關條款（通常是章節或同等級別）級別修訂的資訊。它還包括有關已根據法律條款廢除的已編纂法律的任何條款的資訊。
Editorial changes
編輯修改
The Legislation Act 2003 authorises First Parliamentary Counsel to make editorial and presentational changes to a compiled law in preparing a compilation of the law for registration. The changes must not change the effect of the law. Editorial changes take effect from the compilation registration date.
《2003 年立法法》授權第一議會律師在準備登記法律彙編時對已彙編的法律進行編輯和表述上的修改。變更不得改變法律的效力。編輯修改自編譯註冊之日起生效。
If the compilation includes editorial changes, the endnotes include a brief outline of the changes in general terms. Full details of any changes can be obtained from the Office of Parliamentary Counsel.
如果彙編包含編輯性更改，則尾註包括通用術語更改的簡要概述。任何變更的完整細節可以從議會法律顧問辦公室獲得。
Misdescribed amendments
錯誤描述的修正案
A misdescribed amendment is an amendment that does not accurately describe how an amendment is to be made. If, despite the misdescription, the amendment can be given effect as intended, then the misdescribed amendment can be incorporated through an editorial change made under section 15V of the Legislation Act 2003 .
錯誤描述的修正案是指沒有準確描述如何進行修正案的修正案。儘管有錯誤描述，如果修正案能夠如預期生效，那麼可以根據《2003 年立法法》第 15V 條進行編輯修改，將錯誤描述的修正案納入其中。
If a misdescribed amendment cannot be given effect as intended, the amendment is not incorporated and “(md not incorp)” is added to the amendment history.
如果錯誤描述的修正案無法如預期生效，則該修正案不會被納入，並且「（md not incorp）」將添加到修正案歷史中。

title: 1.01 Name of Regulations
text:
These Regulations are the Migration Regulations 1994 .
本條例是1994年移民條例。

title: Division 1.2 — Interpretation
text:
Note: This Division sets out definitions that apply to the Regulations as a whole. Elsewhere in the Regulations there may be definitions that have more limited application. A term defined in section 5 of the Act has the same meaning in the Regulations, in the absence of a contrary intention.
註：本部分所列的定義適用於整個條例。在條例的其他地方，可能有一些應用範圍更有限的定義。在沒有相反含義的情況下，該法第 5 條中定義的術語在條例中具有相同的含義。

title: 1.03 Definitions
text:
In these Regulations, unless the contrary intention appears:
在本條例中，除非有相反意思表示：
AASES form , for a secondary exchange student, means an Acceptance Advice of Secondary Exchange Student form from the relevant State or Territory education authority, containing the following declarations:
對於中學交換生來說，AAES 表格是指相關州或領地教育機構所簽發的中學交換生錄取通知書，其中包含以下聲明：
(a) a declaration made by the student’s exchange organisation, accepting the student;
(a) 學生交流組織所做的接受學生的聲明；
(b) a declaration made by the student’s parents, or the person or persons having custody of the student, agreeing to the exchange.
(b) 學生家長或學生監護人同意交換的聲明。
academic year means a period that is specified by the Minister as an academic year in an instrument in writing for this definition.
學年是指部長在書面文件中為此定義指定的學年期間。
additional applicant charge means the charge explained in subregulation 2.12C(4).
額外申請人費用是指第 2.12C(4) 款所解釋的費用。
adequate arrangements for health insurance means arrangements to be covered by health insurance:
健康保險的充分安排是指健康保險涵蓋的安排：
(a) that meet the requirements for health insurance specified in an instrument under regulation 1.15L for the purposes of this paragraph; or
(a) 符合第 1.15L 條中為本段目的而製定的文書中規定的健康保險要求；或
(b) if no such requirements are specified—that are adequate in the circumstances.
(b) 如未規定此類要求－則在具體情況下已足夠。
adoption has the meaning set out in regulation 1.04.
採納具有第 1.04 條規定的涵義。
Note: adopt and adopted have corresponding meanings: see Acts Interpretation Act 1901 , section 18A.
註：採用和採用有相應意義：參見《1901 年法案解釋》第 18A 條。
adoption compliance certificate means an adoption compliance certificate within the meaning of the Family Law (Bilateral Arrangements—Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 2023 or the Family Law (Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 1998 .
收養合規證書是指《2023 年家庭法（雙邊安排—跨國收養）條例》或《1998 年家庭法（海牙跨國收養公約）條例》含義內的收養合規證書。
Adoption Convention means the Convention on Protection of Children and Cooperation in Respect of Intercountry Adoption signed at The Hague on 29 May 1993.
《收養公約》指 1993 年 5 月 29 日在海牙簽署的《跨國收養方面保護兒童及合作公約》。
Note: The text of the Adoption Convention is set out in Schedule 1 to the Family Law (Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 1998 .
註：《收養公約》的文字載於《1998 年家庭法（跨國收養海牙公約）條例》附表 1。
Adoption Convention country means a country that is a Convention country under the Family Law (Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 1998 .
收養公約國家指依據 1998 年《家庭法（跨國收養海牙公約）條例》屬於公約國家的國家。
adverse information has the meaning given by regulation 1.13A.
不良資訊具有第 1.13A 條規定的涵義。
aged care service has the same meaning as in the Aged Care Act 1997 .
老年護理服務與 1997 年老年護理法中的意義相同。
aged dependent relative , in relation to a person who is an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or an eligible New Zealand citizen, means a relative who:
老年受扶養親屬，就澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合資格的紐西蘭公民而言，是指符合以下條件的親屬：
(a) does not have a spouse or de facto partner; and
(a) 沒有配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) has been dependent on that person for a reasonable period, and remains so dependent; and
(b) 已依賴該人一段合理的時間，並且仍然如此依賴；和
(c) is old enough to be granted an age pension under the Social Security Act 1991 .
(c) 已達到 1991 年《社會保障法》規定的年齡，可以領取退休金。
aged parent means a parent who is old enough to be granted an age pension under the Social Security Act 1991 .
年邁父母是指年齡足以依據《1991 年社會安全法》領取退休金的父母。
aircraft safety inspector means a person who:
飛機安全檢查員是指以下人員：
(a) is employed by a foreign government to inspect the safety procedures of international air carriers or the safety of aircraft; and
(a) 受外國政府僱用檢查國際航空承運人的安全程序或飛機的安全；和
(b) travels to Australia on an aircraft in the course of that employment; and
(b) 在受僱期間搭乘飛機前往澳洲；和
(c) will depart Australia on an aircraft in the course of that employment or as a passenger.
(c) 在工作期間或以乘客身分搭乘飛機離開澳洲。
airline crew member means:
航空公司機組人員是指：
(a) a person who:
(a) 一個人：
(i) is employed by an international air carrier as an aircrew member; and
(i) 受僱於國際航空公司擔任空勤人員；和
(ii) travels to Australia in the course of his or her employment as a member of the crew of an aircraft; and
(ii) 在擔任飛機機組員期間前往澳洲；和
(iii) will depart Australia in the course of his or her employment as a member of the crew of, or a passenger on, an aircraft; or
(iii) 在擔任飛機機組人員或乘客期間離開澳洲；或
(b) an aircraft safety inspector.
(b) 航空器安全檢查員。
airline positioning crew member means a person who:
航空公司定位機組人員是指下列人士：
(a) is employed by an international air carrier as an aircrew member; and
(a) 受僱於國際航空公司擔任機組人員；和
(b) travels to Australia in the course of his or her employment as a passenger on an aircraft; and
(b) 在擔任飛機乘客期間前往澳洲；和
(c) will depart Australia as a member of the crew of an aircraft.
(c) 將以飛機機組員的身分離開澳洲。
annual market salary rate , for a proposed occupation nominated under section 140GB of the Act or an occupation in relation to which a position is nominated under regulation 5.19, means the earnings an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident earns or would earn for performing equivalent work on a full ‑ time basis for a year in the same workplace at the same location.
年市場工資率，對於根據該法第 140GB 條提名的擬議職業或根據第 5.19 條提名職位的職業，是指澳大利亞公民或澳大利亞永久居民在同一地點的同一工作場所全職從事同等工作一年所賺取或將賺取的收入。
ANZSCO has the meaning specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this definition.
ANZSCO 具有部長在書面文件中對此定義指定的含義。
APEC means Asia ‑ Pacific Economic Co ‑ operation.
APEC 指亞太經濟合作組織。
APEC economy means each of the following:
APEC經濟是指以下各項：
(a) Australia;
(a) 澳洲；
(b) Brunei Darussalam;
(b) 汶萊達魯薩蘭國；
(c) Canada;
(c) 加拿大；
(d) Chile;
(d) 智利；
(e) PRC;
(e) 中國；
(f) Hong Kong;
(f) 香港；
(g) Indonesia;
(g) 印尼；
(h) Japan;
(h) 日本；
(i) the Republic of Korea;
(i) 大韓民國；
(j) Malaysia;
(j) 馬來西亞；
(k) Mexico;
(k) 墨西哥；
(l) New Zealand;
(l) 紐西蘭；
(m) Papua New Guinea;
(m) 巴布亞紐幾內亞；
(n) Peru;

附表 3 标准是指附表 3 的条款中规定的标准，通过编号引用附表 3 标准是指对该附表中编号的条款中规定的标准的引用。
school ‑ age dependant , in relation to a person, means a member of the family unit of the person who has turned 5, but has not turned 18.
學齡家屬，就一個人而言，是指已年滿 5 歲但未年滿 18 歲的人的家庭成員。
score , in relation to a language test, means any score or result, however described, from the test, including any combination of scores or results from the test or components of the test.
分數 ，就語言測驗而言，是指測驗中的任何分數或結果（無論如何描述），包括測驗或測驗組成部分的分數或結果的任何組合。
secondary exchange student means an overseas secondary school student participating in a secondary school student exchange program approved by the State or Territory education authority that administers the program.
中學交換生是指參加經管理該計畫的州或領地教育機構所批准的中學生交換計畫的海外中學生。
secondary sponsored person has the meaning given by subregulation 2.57(1).
第二擔保人具有第 2.57(1) 款規定的涵義。
Secretary of Social Services means the Secretary of the Department that is administered by the Minister administering section 1061ZZGD of the Social Security Act 1991 .
社會服務部長是指由負責 1991 年《社會保障法》第 1061ZZGD 條的部長管理的部門的秘書。
settled , in relation to an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or an eligible New Zealand citizen, means lawfully resident in Australia for a reasonable period.
就澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合資格的紐西蘭公民而言，定居是指在澳洲合法居住一段合理的時間。
skilled occupation has the meaning given by regulation 1.15I.
熟練職業具有第 1.15I 條規定的含義。
Skills Assessment Department means the Department administered by the Skills Assessment Minister.
技能評估部門是指由技能評估部長管理的部門。
Skills Assessment Minister means the Minister responsible for skills assessment services.
技能評估部長是指負責技能評估服務的部長。
Skills Assessment Secretary means the Secretary of the Skills Assessment Department.
技能評估秘書是指技能評估部的秘書。
SOFA forces civilian component member means a person who:
SOFA 部隊文職成員指下列人員：
(a) is, for the purposes of a Status of Forces Agreement between Australia and Fiji, France, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Republic of the Philippines, Singapore, Turkey or the United States of America, a member of the civilian component of the armed forces of one of those countries; and
(a) 就澳洲與斐濟、法國、日本、馬來西亞、紐西蘭、巴布亞紐幾內亞、菲律賓共和國、新加坡、土耳其或美利堅合眾國之間的部隊地位協定而言，是這些國家之一武裝部隊文職部分的成員；和
(b) holds a national passport that is in force and a certificate that he or she is a member of the civilian component of the armed forces of the relevant country.
(b) 持有有效的國民護照以及證明其是相關國家武裝部隊文職人員的證明。
SOFA forces member means a person who:
SOFA 部隊成員指下列人員：
(a) is, for the purposes of a Status of Forces Agreement between Australia and Fiji, France, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Republic of the Philippines, Singapore, Turkey or the United States of America, a member of the armed forces of one of those countries; and
(a) 就澳洲與斐濟、法國、日本、馬來西亞、紐西蘭、巴布亞紐幾內亞、菲律賓共和國、新加坡、土耳其或美利堅合眾國之間的部隊地位協定而言，是這些國家之一的武裝部隊成員；和
(b) holds military identity documents and movement orders issued from an official source of the relevant country.
(b) 持有由相關國家官方來源簽發的軍人身分證件和行動令。
specialist skills income threshold means $135,000.
專業技能收入門檻為 135,000 美元。
Note: This amount is indexed under regulation 5.42A.
註：該金額依據第 5.42A 條編製索引。
special processing area has the meaning given by subregulation 5.41C(3).
特殊處理區域具有第 5.41C(3) 款規定的涵義。
special program sponsor means a person who:
特別項目發起人是指以下人員：
(a) is an approved work sponsor; and
(a) 是經批准的工作發起人；和
(b) is approved as a work sponsor in relation to the special program sponsor class by the Minister under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, on the basis of an application made before 19 November 2016.
(b) 根據 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前提出的申請，由部長根據該法第 140E(1) 款批准為與特別計劃贊助商類別相關的工作贊助商。
special return criterion means a criterion set out in a clause of Schedule 5, and a reference to a special return criterion by number is a reference to the criterion set out in the clause so numbered in that Schedule.
特殊退貨標準是指附表 5 的條款中規定的標準，透過編號提及特殊退貨標準是指該附表中編號的條款中規定的標準。
specified Subclass 417 work means work that:
指定子類別 417 工作是指下列工作：
(a) was carried out in one or more areas of Australia specified for the purposes of this definition by the Minister under regulation 1.15FAA; and
(a) 在部長根據第 1.15FAA 條規定為本定義指定的澳大利亞一個或多個地區進行；和
(b) was of one or more kinds specified for the purposes of this definition by the Minister under regulation 1.15FAA.
(b) 屬於部長依第 1.15FAA 條規定為本定義目的指定的一種或多種。
specified Subclass 462 work means work that:
指定子類別 462 工作是指下列工作：
(a) was carried out in one or more areas of Australia specified for the purposes of this definition by the Minister under regulation 1.15FA; and
(a) 是在部長根據第 1.15FA 條規定為本定義指定的澳大利亞一個或多個地區進行的；和
(b) was of one or more kinds specified for the purposes of this definition by the Minister under regulation 1.15FA.
(b) 屬於部長依第 1.15FA 條規定為本定義目的指定的一種或多種。
sponsor has the meaning given by subregulation 1.20(1).
發起人具有第 1.20(1) 款規定的含義。
sponsorship means an undertaking of the kind referred to in regulation 1.20 to sponsor an applicant.
擔保是指第 1.20 條所提及的擔保申請人的承諾。
sponsorship end day , in relation to a nomination under subsection 140GB(1) of the Act, means the day on which the approval as a standard business sponsor of the person who made the nomination ceases.
擔保結束日，就該法案第 140GB(1) 款下的提名而言，是指提名人作為標準商業擔保人的批准終止的日期。
standard business sponsor means a person who:
標準商業贊助商是指以下人員：
(a) is an approved work sponsor; and
(a) 是經批准的工作發起人；和
(b) is approved as a work sponsor in relation to the standard business sponsor class by the Minister under subsection 140E(1) of the Act.
(b) 根據該法第 140E(1) 款，被部長批准為與標準業務贊助商類別相關的工作贊助商。
statutory function has the meaning given by subregulation 5.41C(3).
法定職能具有第 5.41C(3) 條所賦予的涵義。
step ‑ child , in relation to a parent, means:
step ‑ child ，就父母而言，意味著：
(a) a person who is not the child of the parent but who is the child of the parent’s current spouse or de facto partner; or
(a) 不是父母的子女，而是父母現任配偶或同居伴侶的子女的人；或
(b) a person who is not the child of the parent but:
(b) 不是父母子女的人，但：
(i) who is the child of the parent’s former spouse or former de facto partner; and
(i) 父母的前配偶或前同居伴侶的子女；和
(ii) who has not turned 18; and
(ii) 未滿 18 歲；和
(iii) in relation to whom the parent has:
(iii) 就父母而言：
(A) a parenting order in force under the Family Law Act 1975 under which the parent is the person with whom a child is to live, or who is to be responsible for the child’s long ‑ term or day ‑ to ‑ day care, welfare and development; or
(A) 根據 1975 年《家庭法》有效的養育令，根據該令，父母是與孩子一起生活的人，或負責孩子的長期或日常照護、福利和發展的人；或
(B) guardianship or custody, whether jointly or otherwise, under a Commonwealth, State or Territory law or a law in force in a foreign country.
(B) 根據聯邦、州或領地法律或外國現行法律的共同或其他形式的監護或保管。
student visa means any of the following subclasses of visa:
學生簽證是指以下任何簽證子類：
(aa) a Subclass 500 (Student) visa;
(aa) 500 類（學生）簽證；
(a) a Subclass 570 (Independent ELICOS Sector) visa;
(a) 570 子類（獨立 ELICOS 部門）簽證；
(b) a Subclass 571 (Schools Sector) visa;
(b) 571 類（學校部門）簽證；
(c) a Subclass 572 (Vocational Education and Training Sector) visa;
(c) 572 類（職業教育訓練部門）簽證；
(d) a Subclass 573 (Higher Education Sector) visa;
(d) 573 類（高等教育部門）簽證；
(e) a Subclass 574 (Postgraduate Research Sector) visa;
(e) 574 類（研究生研究部門）簽證；
(f) a Subclass 575 (Non ‑ Award Sector) visa;
(f) 575 類（非獎勵部門）簽證；
(g) a Subclass 576 (Foreign Affairs or Defence Sector) visa.
(g) 576 子類（外交或國防部門）簽證。
Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa includes a Subclass 420 (Temporary Work (Entertainment)) visa.
420 子類（娛樂）簽證包括 420 子類（臨時工作（娛樂））簽證。
Note: Amendments of these Regulations that commenced on 24 November 2012 renamed the Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa.
註：2012 年 11 月 24 日開始實施的這些法規修正案將 420 類（娛樂）簽證重新命名為 420 類（娛樂）簽證。
Subclass 576 (Foreign Affairs or Defence Sector) visa includes a Subclass 576 (AusAID or Defence Sector) visa.
576 子類（外交或國防部門）簽證包括 576 子類（澳洲國際開發署或國防部門）簽證。
Note: Amendments of these Regulations that commenced on 1 July 2014 renamed the Subclass 576 (AusAID or Defence Sector) visa.
註：2014 年 7 月 1 日開始實施的這些條例修正案將 576 類（澳洲國際開發署或國防部門）簽證重新命名。
subsequent temporary application charge means the charge explained in subregulations 2.12C(5) and (6).
後續臨時申請費用是指第2.12C(5)和(6)款所解釋的費用。
substituted Subclass 600 visa means:
替代 600 子類簽證意味著：
(a) a Subclass 600 (Visitor) visa that was granted following a decision by the Minister to substitute a more favourable decision under section 351 or 501J, or repealed section 417, of the Act; or
(a) 部長根據該法第 351 或 501J 條決定替換更有利的決定或廢除該法第 417 條後頒發的 600 類（訪客）簽證；或
(b) a Subclass 676 (Tourist) visa that was granted, before 23 March 2013, following a decision by the Minister to substitute a more favourable decision under section 351 or 501J, or repealed section 417, of the Act.
(b) 在部長根據該法第 351 或 501J 條決定替換更有利的決定或廢除第 417 條後，於 2013 年 3 月 23 日之前授予的 676 類（旅遊）簽證。
Note: Before these Regulations were amended on 23 March 2013, a visa described in paragraph (b) was referred to as a “substituted Subclass 676 visa”.
註：在2013年3月23日修訂本條例之前，(b)段所述的簽證被稱為「替代的676子類簽證」。
superior English has the meaning given by regulation 1.15EA.
高級英語具有第 1.15EA 條規定的含義。
superyacht means a sailing ship or motor vessel of a kind that is specified by the Minister under regulation 1.15G to be a superyacht.
超級遊艇是指部長依第 1.15G 條指定為超級遊艇的帆船或機動船。
superyacht crew sponsor means a person who:
超級遊艇船員贊助商是指以下人員：
(a) is an approved work sponsor; and
(a) 是經批准的工作發起人；和
(b) is approved as a work sponsor in relation to the superyacht crew sponsor class by the Minister under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, on the basis of an application made before 19 November 2016.
(b) 根據 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前提出的申請，由部長根據該法第 140E(1) 款批准為與超級遊艇船員贊助商類別相關的工作贊助商。
temporary activities sponsor means a person who:
臨時活動贊助者是指下列人員：
(a) is an approved work sponsor; and
(a) 是經批准的工作發起人；和
(b) is approved as a work sponsor in relation to the temporary activities sponsor class by the Minister under subsection 140E(1) of the Act.
(b) 根據該法第 140E(1) 款，被部長批准為與臨時活動贊助商類別相關的工作贊助商。
temporary skilled migration income threshold means $79,423.
臨時技術移民收入門檻為 79,423 美元。
Note: This amount is indexed under regulation 5.42A.
註：該金額依據第 5.42A 條編製索引。
temporary work sponsor means any of the following:
臨時工作贊助者是指以下任何一種：
(a) a special program sponsor;
(a) 特別計劃贊助商；
(b) an entertainment sponsor;
(b) 娛樂贊助商；
(c) a superyacht crew sponsor;
(c) 超級遊艇船員贊助商；
(d) a long stay activity sponsor;
(d) 長期住宿活動贊助商；
(e) a training and research sponsor.
(e) 培訓和研究贊助商。
the Act means the Migration Act 1958 .
該法案是指 1958 年移民法案。
tourism means participation in activities of a recreational nature including amateur sporting activities, informal study courses, relaxation, sightseeing and travel.
旅遊是指參與娛樂性質的活動，包括業餘體育活動、非正式學習課程、放鬆、觀光和旅行。
TPV/SHEV transition day means the day Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment (Transitioning TPV/SHEV Holders to Resolution of Status Visas) Regulations 2023 commences.
TPV/SHEV 過渡日指 2023 年移民修正案（將 TPV/SHEV 持有者過渡到身分簽證解決）條例附表 1 開始的日期。
training and research sponsor means a person who:
培訓和研究資助者是指以下人員：
(a) is an approved work sponsor; and
(a) 是經批准的工作發起人；和
(b) is approved as a work sponsor in relation to the training and research sponsor class by the Minister under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, on the basis of an application made before 19 November 2016.
(b) 根據 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前提出的申請，由部長根據該法第 140E(1) 款批准為與培訓和研究贊助者類別相關的工作贊助者。
transitional 457 worker means a person who held a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa at any time occurring on or after 18 April 2017.
過渡性 457 工人是指在 2017 年 4 月 18 日或之後的任何時間持有 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證的人。
transitional 482 worker means a person who on 20 March 2019:
過渡性 482 工人是指在 2019 年 3 月 20 日符合以下條件的人員：
(a) held a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa in the Medium ‑ term stream; or
(a) 持有中期類別 482（臨時技能短缺）簽證；或
(b) was an applicant for a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa in the Medium ‑ term stream that was subsequently granted.
(b) 是中期類別 482（臨時技能短缺）簽證的申請人，隨後獲得批准。
transit passenger means a person who:
過境旅客是指以下人員：
(a) enters Australia by aircraft; and
(a) 搭飛機進入澳洲；和
(b) holds a confirmed onward booking to leave Australia to travel to a third country on the same or another aircraft within 8 hours of the person’s arrival in Australia; and
(b) 持有已確認的續程預訂，在抵達澳洲後 8 小時內乘坐同一架或另一架飛機離開澳洲前往第三國；和
(d) holds documentation necessary to enter the country of his or her destination.
(d) 持有進入目的地國家所需的文件。
unwanted transfer of critical technology has the meaning given by subregulation 1.15Q(1).
關鍵技術的非自願轉移具有第 1.15Q(1) 款規定的含義。
vocational English has the meaning given in regulation 1.15B.
職業英語具有第 1.15B 條中給出的含義。
weapons of mass destruction determination means a determination mentioned in any of the following provisions:
大規模殺傷性武器的認定是指下列任何條款中所提及的認定：
(a) sub ‑ subparagraph 2.43(1)(a)(i)(B);
(a) 第 2.43(1)(a)(i)(B) 分段；
(b) subparagraph 2.43(1)(a)(ii);
(b) 第 2.43(1)(a)(ii) 項；
(c) paragraph (b) of public interest criterion 4003;
(c) 公共利益準則 4003 (b) 段；
(d) public interest criterion 4003A.
(d) 公共利益準則 4003A。
work means an activity that, in Australia, normally attracts remuneration.
在澳大利亞，工作是指通常能獲得報酬的活動。
working age means:
工作年齡是指：
(a) in the case of a female, under 60 years of age; and
(a) 女性，年齡在 60 歲以下；和
(b) in the case of a male, under 65 years of age.
(b) 男性，年齡在 65 歲以下。
workplace exploitation matter has the meaning given by subregulation 1.15R(2).
工作場所剝削事項具有第 1.15R(2) 款規定的涵義。

title: 1.04 Adoption
text:
(1) A person (in this regulation called the adoptee ) is taken to have been adopted by a person (in this regulation called the adopter ) if, before the adoptee attained the age of 18 years, the adopter assumed a parental role in relation to the adoptee under:
(1) 如果在被收養人年滿 18 歲之前，收養人在以下情況下對被收養人承擔了父母角色，則視為被收養人（在本條例中稱為收養人）收養：
(a) formal adoption arrangements made in accordance with, or recognised under, the law of a State or Territory of Australia relating to the adoption of children; or
(a) 根據澳洲州或領地有關兒童收養的法律所作出或承認的正式收養安排；或
(b) formal adoption arrangements made in accordance with the law of another country, being arrangements under which the persons who were recognised by law as the parents of the adoptee before those arrangements took effect ceased to be so recognised and the adopter became so recognised; or
(b) 根據另一國法律所做的正式收養安排，即在這些安排生效之前法律承認為被收養人父母的人不再得到如此承認，而收養人則得到如此承認的安排；或
(c) other arrangements entered into outside Australia that, under subregulation (2), are taken to be in the nature of adoption.
(c) 根據第 (2) 款，在澳洲境外達成的其他安排被視為收養性質。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), arrangements are taken to be in the nature of adoption if:
(2) 就第 (1)(c) 款而言，如果符合以下條件，則安排被視為收養性質：
(a) the arrangements were made in accordance with the usual practice, or a recognised custom, in the culture or cultures of the adoptee and the adopter; and
(a) 安排是按照被收養人和收養人的一種或多種文化中的通常做法或公認的習俗作出的；和
(b) the child ‑ parent relationship between the adoptee and the adopter is significantly closer than any such relationship between the adoptee and any other person or persons, having regard to the nature and duration of the arrangements; and
(b) 考慮到安排的性質和期限，被收養者與收養者之間的子女父母關係比被收養者與任何其他人之間的任何此類關係更為密切；和
(c) the Minister is satisfied that:
(c) 部長信納：
(i) formal adoption of the kind referred to in paragraph (1)(b):
(i) 第(1)(b)款所述類型的正式通過：
(A) was not available under the law of the place where the arrangements were made; or
(A) 依安排所在地的法律不可用；或
(B) was not reasonably practicable in the circumstances; and
(B) 在當時的情況下不合理可行；和
(ii) the arrangements have not been contrived to circumvent Australian migration requirements.
(ii) 這些安排並非旨在規避澳洲移民要求。

title: 1.04A Foreign Affairs recipients and Foreign Affairs students
zh: 1.04A 外交事務獲獎者和外交事務學生
text:
(1) In this regulation:
（一）本規定：
cease , in relation to a full ‑ time course of study or training, includes to complete, to withdraw from, or to be excluded from, that course.
就全日制學習或培訓課程而言，停止包括完成、退出或被排除在該課程之外。
Foreign Affairs student visa means a student visa granted to a person who, as an applicant:
外交學生簽證是指授予符合以下條件的申請人的學生簽證：
(a) satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(a) 滿足授予簽證的主要標準；和
(b) was a student in a full ‑ time course of study or training under a scholarship scheme or training program approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister.
(b) 是根據外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長批准的獎學金計畫或培訓計畫參加全日制學習或培訓的學生。
(2) A person is a Foreign Affairs recipient if:
(2) 若符合下列條件，則該人為外交事務受益人：
(a) either:
(a) 任一：
(i) the person is the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa and has ceased:
(i) 該人是外交學生簽證的持有者並且已停止：
(A) the full ‑ time course of study or training to which that visa relates; or
(A) 與簽證相關的全日制學習或培訓課程；或
(B) another course approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister in substitution for that course; or
(B) 外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長批准的替代該課程的另一門課程；或
(ii) if the person is not the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa—the person has in the past been the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa and has ceased:
(ii) 如果該人不是外交學生簽證的持有者－該人過去曾是外交學生簽證的持有者，並且已經不再持有：
(A) the full ‑ time course of study or training to which the last Foreign Affairs student visa held by the person related; or
(A) 與該人最後持有的外交學生簽證相關的全日制學習或培訓課程；或者
(B) another course approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister in substitution for that course; and
(B) 外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長批准的替代該課程的另一門課程；和
(b) the person has not spent at least 2 years outside Australia since ceasing the course.
(b) 自從停止課程以來，該人沒有在澳洲境外待過至少 2 年。
(3) A person is a Foreign Affairs student if:
(3) 若符合以下條件，則為外交學生：
(a) the person has been approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister to undertake a full ‑ time course of study or training under a scholarship scheme or training program approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister; and
(a) 此人已獲得外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長的批准，可以根據外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長批准的獎學金計劃或培訓計劃進行全日制學習或培訓；和
(b) the person is:
(b) 此人是：
(i) the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa granted in circumstances where the person intended to undertake the full ‑ time course of study or training; or
(i) 外交學生簽證持有者，該簽證的持有者是在打算接受全日制學習或培訓的情況下獲得的；或
(ii) an applicant for a student visa whose application shows an intention to undertake a full ‑ time course of study or training; and
(ii) 學生簽證申請人，其申請顯示有意參加全日制學習或培訓課程；和
(c) in the case of a person mentioned in subparagraph (b)(i)—the person has not ceased:
(c) 對於(b)(i)項所提及的人－該人尚未停止：
(i) the full ‑ time course of study or training to which the visa relates; or
(i) 與簽證相關的全日制學習或訓練課程；或
(ii) another course approved by the Foreign Minister or AusAID Minister in substitution for that course.
(ii) 外交部長或澳洲國際開發署部長批准的替代該課程的另一門課程。

title: 1.04B Defence student
text:
A person is a Defence student if:
如果滿足以下條件，則該人是國防生：
(a) the person has been approved by the Defence Minister to undertake a full ‑ time course of study or training under a scholarship scheme or training program approved by the Defence Minister; and
(a) 此人已獲得國防部長批准，可以根據國防部長批准的獎學金計劃或培訓計劃進行全日制學習或培訓；和
(b) the person is:
(b) 此人是：
(i) the holder of a student visa granted in circumstances where the person intended to undertake the course of study or training; or
(i) 持有學生簽證的人，該簽證是在該人打算參加學習或培訓課程的情況下獲得的；或
(ii) an applicant for a student visa whose application shows an intention to undertake the course of study or training; and
(ii) 學生簽證申請人，其申請顯示有意參加學習或培訓課程；和
(c) in the case of a person mentioned in subparagraph (b)(i)—the person has not ceased, completed, withdrawn from, or been excluded from:
(c) 若是(b)(i)項所提及的人－該人尚未停止、完成、退出或被排除在下列活動之外：
(i) the course of study or training to which the visa relates; or
(i) 與簽證相關的學習或訓練課程；或
(ii) another course approved by the Defence Minister in substitution for that course.
(ii) 國防部長核准的另一個替代該課程的課程。

title: 1.05 Balance of family test
text:
(1) For the purposes of this regulation:
(1) 就本條例而言：
(a) a person is a child of another person (the parent ) if the person is a child or step ‑ child of:
(a) 若一個人是另一個人（父母）的子女或繼子女，則該人是：
(i) the parent; or
(i) 家長；或
(ii) a current spouse or current de facto partner of the parent; and
(ii) 父母目前的配偶或目前同居伴侶；和
(b) if the whereabouts of a child of the parent are unknown, the child is taken to be resident in the child’s last known usual country of residence.
(b) 若父母子女下落不明，該子女將被視為居住在該子女最後已知的常居住國。
(2) For this regulation:
(2) 對於本規定：
(a) a child of the parent is an eligible child if the child is:
(a) 父母的孩子是合格的孩子，如果孩子是：
(i) an Australian citizen; or
(i) 澳洲公民；或
(ii) an Australian permanent resident usually resident in Australia; or
(ii) 澳洲永久居民，通常居住在澳洲；或
(iii) an eligible New Zealand citizen usually resident in Australia; and
(iii) 通常居住在澳洲的符合資格的紐西蘭公民；和
(b) any other child of the parent is an ineligible child .
(b) 父母的任何其他子女均不符合資格。
(2A) An ineligible child is taken to be resident overseas.
(2A) 不符合資格的兒童被視為海外居民。
(2B) The overseas country in which an ineligible child is taken to reside is:
(2B) 不符合資格的兒童被帶到居住的海外國家是：
(a) the overseas country in which the child is usually resident; or
(a) 孩子通常居住的海外國家；或
(b) the last overseas country in which the child was usually resident; or
(b) 兒童通常居住的最後一個海外國家；或
(c) if the child no longer has a right of return to the country mentioned in paragraph (a) or (b)—the child’s country of citizenship.
(c) 如果兒童不再有權利回到 (a) 或 (b) 段中提到的國家－兒童的國籍國。
(2C) A parent satisfies the balance of family test if the number of eligible children is greater than or equal to the number of ineligible children.
(2C) 如果符合資格的子女人數大於或等於不符合資格的子女人數，則父母一方符合家庭平衡測試。
(2D) However, if the greatest number of children who are:
(2D) 但是，如果最大數量的兒童是：
(a) ineligible children; and
(a) 不符合資格的兒童；和
(b) usually resident in a particular overseas country;
(b) 通常居住在特定的海外國家；
is less than the number of eligible children, then the parent satisfies the balance of family test.
少於符合資格的兒童人數，則該家長符合家庭平衡測試。
(3) In applying the balance of family test, no account is to be taken of a child of the parent:
(3) 在應用家庭平衡測試時，不考慮父母的子女：
(a) if the child has been removed by court order, by adoption or by operation of law (other than in consequence of marriage) from the exclusive custody of the parent; or
(a) 若孩子已被法院命令、收養或法律實施（婚姻除外）從父母的專屬監護權中移除；或
(b) if the child is resident in a country where the child suffers persecution or abuse of human rights and it is not possible to reunite the child and the parent in another country; or
(b) 若兒童居住在其人權受到迫害或侵犯的國家，且不可能在另一個國家使兒童與父母團聚；或
(c) if the child:
(c) 如果孩子：
(i) is resident in a refugee camp operated by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees; and
(i) 居住在聯合國難民事務高級專員管理的難民營；和
(ii) is registered by the Commissioner as a refugee.
(ii) 已被專員登記為難民。

title: 1.05A Dependent
text:
(1) Subject to subregulation (2), a person (the first person ) is dependent on another person if:
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，一個人（第一人）依賴另一個人，如果：
(a) at the time when it is necessary to establish whether the first person is dependent on the other person:
(a) 當需要確定第一人是否依賴另一人：
(i) the first person is, and has been for a substantial period immediately before that time, wholly or substantially reliant on the other person for financial support to meet the first person’s basic needs for food, clothing and shelter; and
(i) 第一個人在該時間之前的相當長一段時間內完全或實質上依賴另一個人的經濟支持來滿足第一個人對食物、衣服和住所的基本需求；和
(ii) the first person’s reliance on the other person is greater than any reliance by the first person on any other person, or source of support, for financial support to meet the first person’s basic needs for food, clothing and shelter; or
(ii) 第一個人對另一人的依賴大於第一個人對任何其他人或支持來源的依賴，以獲取經濟支持以滿足第一人對食物、衣服和住所的基本需求；或
(b) the first person is wholly or substantially reliant on the other person for financial support because the first person is incapacitated for work due to the total or partial loss of the first person’s bodily or mental functions.
(b) 由於第一人的身體或精神功能全部或部分喪失而喪失工作能力，因此第一人完全或實質上依賴另一人提供經濟支持。
(2) A person (the first person ) is dependent on another person for the purposes of an application for:
(2) 某人（第一人）因申請以下目的而依賴另一人：
(d) a protection visa; or
(d) 保護簽證；或
(ea) a Refugee and Humanitarian (Class XB) visa; or
(ea) 難民和人道主義（XB 類）簽證；或
(i) a Temporary Safe Haven (Class UJ) visa;
(i) 臨時避風港（UJ 類）簽證；
if the first person is wholly or substantially reliant on the other person for financial, psychological or physical support.
如果第一個人完全或實質上依賴另一個人的經濟、心理或生理支持。

title: 1.06 References to classes of visas
text:
A class of visas may be referred to:
一類簽證可以指：
(a) in the case of a class of visas referred to in Schedule 1—by the code allotted to the class in the heading of the item in Schedule 1 that relates to that class of visas; or
(a) 如果是附表 1 中提到的簽證類別－按附表 1 中與該簽證類別相關的項目標題中分配給該類別的代碼；或
(b) in the case of a transitional visa, by the following codes:
(b) 若是過渡簽證，則依下列代碼：
(i) transitional (permanent): BF;
(i) 過渡性（永久）：BF；
(ii) transitional (temporary): UA.
(ii) 過渡（暫時）：UA。
Note: For example, a Special Program (Temporary) (Class TE) visa may be referred to as a Class TE visa.
注意：例如，特殊計劃（臨時）（TE 類）簽證可能被稱為 TE 類簽證。

title: 1.07 References to subclasses of visas
text:
(1) A reference to a visa of a particular subclass (for example, ‘a visa of Subclass 414’) is a reference to a visa granted on satisfaction of the criteria for the grant of the visa, or the grant of the visa in a stream, set out in the Part of Schedule 2 that bears the number of the subclass.
(1) 提及特定子類簽證（例如，「子類 414 簽證」）是指滿足簽證授予標準而授予的簽證，或在附表 2 帶有子類編號的部分中規定的流中授予簽證。
Note: The criteria for the grant of the visa may include criteria described as a ‘stream’: see subregulation 2.03(1A).
註：授予簽證的標準可能包括被描述為「流」的標準：請參閱第 2.03(1A) 款。
(2) A reference to an applicant for a visa of a particular subclass is a reference to an applicant who applies for a visa of a class that may, under Schedule 1, be granted on satisfaction of the criteria for the grant of the visa, or the grant of the visa in a stream, set out in the Part of Schedule 2 that bears the number of the subclass.
(2) 特定子類簽證申請人是指申請某一類簽證的申請人，該類簽證可根據附表 1 在滿足附表 2 帶有子類編號的部分中規定的簽證授予標準或分批授予簽證的標準時獲得批准。
Note: The criteria for the grant of the visa may include criteria described as a ‘stream’: see subregulation 2.03(1A).
註：授予簽證的標準可能包括被描述為「流」的標準：請參閱第 2.03(1A) 款。

title: 1.08 Compelling need to work
text:
For the purposes of these Regulations, a non ‑ citizen has a compelling need to work if and only if:
就本條例而言，非公民有迫切的工作需要，當且僅當：
(a) he or she is in financial hardship; or
(a) 他或她有經濟困難；或
(d) he or she:
(d) 他或她：
(i) is an applicant for a Temporary Business Entry (Class UC) visa who seeks to satisfy the criteria for the grant of a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa; and
(i) 是臨時商務入境（UC 類）簽證的申請人，並尋求滿足授予 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證的標準；和
(ii) is identified in an approved nomination of an occupation made by:
(ii) 在核准的職業提名中被確定：
(A) a standard business sponsor; or
(A) 標準的商業贊助商；或
(B) a former standard business sponsor; or
(B) 前標準業務贊助商；或
(C) a party to a labour agreement;
(C) 勞動協約一方；
who is specified in the application for that visa; and
該簽證申請中指定的人；和
(iii) appears to the Minister, on the basis of information contained in the application, to satisfy the criteria for the grant of that visa.
(iii) 根據申請中包含的信息，部長認為符合授予該簽證的標準。

title: 1.09 Criminal detention
text:
For the purposes of these Regulations, a person is in criminal detention if he or she is:
本條例有下列情形之一的，處刑事拘留：
(a) serving a term of imprisonment (including periodic detention) following conviction for an offence; or
(a) 犯罪定罪後服刑（包括定期拘留）；或
(b) in prison on remand;
(b) 監獄還押；
but not if he or she is:
但如果他或她是：
(c) subject to a community service order; or
(c) 遵守社區服務令；或
(d) on parole after serving part of a term of imprisonment; or
(d) 服完部分刑期後獲得假釋；或
(e) on bail awaiting trial.
(e) 保釋候審。

title: 1.09A De facto partner and de facto relationship
text:
(1) For subsection 5CB(3) of the Act, this regulation sets out arrangements for the purpose of determining whether 1 or more of the conditions in paragraphs 5CB(2)(a), (b), (c) and (d) of the Act exist.
(1) 對於該法案第 5CB(3) 款，本條例規定了確定該法案第 5CB(2)(a)、(b)、(c) 和 (d) 款中的一項或多項條件是否存在的安排。
Note 1: See regulation 2.03A for the prescribed criteria applicable to de facto partners.
註 1：適用於事實合夥人的規定標準請參閱第 2.03A 條。
Note 2: The effect of subsection 5CB(1) of the Act is that a person is the de facto partner of another person (whether of the same sex or a different sex) if the person is in a de facto relationship with the other person.
註 2：該法第 5CB(1) 款的效果是，如果一個人與另一個人有事實上的關係，則該人是另一個人（無論是同性或異性）的事實上的伴侶。
Subsection 5CB(2) sets out conditions about whether a de facto relationship exists, and subsection 5CB(3) permits the regulations to make arrangements in relation to the determination of whether 1 or more of those conditions exist.
第 5CB(2) 款規定了事實關係是否存在的條件，第 5CB(3) 款允許法規就確定是否存在其中一項或多項條件做出安排。
(2) If the Minister is considering an application for:
(2) 若部長正在考慮以下申請：
(a) a Partner (Migrant) (Class BC) visa; or
(a) 伴侶（移民）（BC 類）簽證；或
(b) a Partner (Provisional) (Class UF) visa; or
(b) 伴侶（臨時）（UF 類）簽證；或
(c) a Partner (Residence) (Class BS) visa; or
(c) 伴侶（居住）（BS 級）簽證；或
(d) a Partner (Temporary) (Class UK) visa;
(d) 伴侶（臨時）（英國類）簽證；
the Minister must consider all of the circumstances of the relationship, including the matters set out in subregulation (3).
部長必須考慮該關係的所有情況，包括第 (3) 款所規定的事項。
(3) The matters for subregulation (2) are:
(3) 第(2)款的事項是：
(a) the financial aspects of the relationship, including:
(a) 關係的財務面，包括：
(i) any joint ownership of real estate or other major assets; and
(i) 房地產或其他主要資產的任何共同所有權；和
(ii) any joint liabilities; and
(ii) 任何連帶責任；和
(iii) the extent of any pooling of financial resources, especially in relation to major financial commitments; and
(iii) 財政資源匯集的程度，特別是與重大財政承諾相關的程度；和
(iv) whether one person in the relationship owes any legal obligation in respect of the other; and
(iv) 關係中的一方是否對另一方負有任何法律義務；和
(v) the basis of any sharing of day ‑ to ‑ day household expenses; and
(v) 日常家庭開支的分擔依據；和
(b) the nature of the household, including:
(b) 家庭性質，包括：
(i) any joint responsibility for the care and support of children; and
(i) 照顧和撫養兒童的任何共同責任；和
(ii) the living arrangements of the persons; and
(ii) 人員的生活安排；和
(iii) any sharing of the responsibility for housework; and
(iii) 分擔家務責任；和
(c) the social aspects of the relationship, including:
(c) 關係的社會面，包括：
(i) whether the persons represent themselves to other people as being in a de facto relationship with each other; and
(i) 這些人是否向其他人表明彼此之間存在事實上的關係；和
(ii) the opinion of the persons’ friends and acquaintances about the nature of the relationship; and
(ii) 該人的朋友和熟人對關係性質的看法；和
(iii) any basis on which the persons plan and undertake joint social activities; and
(iii) 該人計劃和進行聯合社會活動的任何基礎；和
(d) the nature of the persons’ commitment to each other, including:
(d) 人員相互承諾的性質，包括：
(i) the duration of the relationship; and
(i) 關係的持續時間；和
(ii) the length of time during which the persons have lived together; and
(ii) 兩人共同居住的時間長度；和
(iii) the degree of companionship and emotional support that the persons draw from each other; and
(iii) 人們彼此之間的陪伴和情感支持的程度；和
(iv) whether the persons see the relationship as a long ‑ term one.
(iv) 人們是否認為這種關係是長期的。
(4) If the Minister is considering an application for a visa of a class other than a class mentioned in subregulation (2), the Minister may consider any of the circumstances mentioned in subregulation (3).
（4）如果部長正在考慮第（2）款中提到的類別以外的其他類別的簽證申請，部長可以考慮第（3）款中提到的任何情況。

title: 1.11 Main business
text:
(1) For the purposes of these Regulations and subject to subregulation (2), a business is a main business in relation to an applicant for a visa if:
(1) 就本條例而言，並根據第 (2) 款，如果滿足以下條件，則該企業是與簽證申請人相關的主要企業：
(a) the applicant has, or has had, an ownership interest in the business; and
(a) 申請人擁有或曾經擁有該企業的所有權權益；和
(b) the applicant maintains, or has maintained, direct and continuous involvement in management of the business from day to day and in making decisions affecting the overall direction and performance of the business; and
(b) 申請人維持或一直維持直接和持續參與企業的日常管理以及影響企業整體方向和績效的決策；和
(c) the value of the applicant’s ownership interest, or the total value of the ownership interests of the applicant and the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner, in the business is or was:
(c) 申請人在企業中的所有權權益的價值，或申請人和申請人的配偶或同居伴侶的所有權權益的總價值現在或曾經是：
(i) if the business is operated by a publicly listed company—at least 10% of the total value of the business; or
(i) 若該業務由上市公司營運－至少佔該業務總價值的 10%；或
(ii) if:
(ii) 若：
(A) the business is not operated by a publicly listed company; and
(A) 該業務並非由上市公司經營；和
(B) the annual turnover of the business is at least AUD400 000;
(B) 企業年營業額至少為AUD400,000；
at least 30% of the total value of the business; or
至少佔企業總價值的30%；或
(iii) if:
(三) 如果：
(A) the business is not operated by a publicly listed company; and
(A) 該業務並非由上市公司經營；和
(B) the annual turnover of the business is less than AUD400 000;
(B) 企業年營業額低於AUD400,000；
at least 51% of the total value of the business; and
至少佔企業總價值的51%；和
(d) the business is a qualifying business.
(d) 該企業是合格企業。
(2) If an applicant has, or has had, an ownership interest in more than 1 qualifying business that would, except for this subregulation, be a main business in relation to the applicant, the applicant must not nominate more than 2 of those qualifying businesses as main businesses.
(2) 若申請人擁有或曾經擁有超過 1 個合格企業的所有權權益，且除本款外，該企業將成為與申請人相關的主要業務，則申請人不得指定其中超過 2 個合格企業為主要業務。

title: 1.11A Ownership for the purposes of certain Parts of Schedule 2
zh: 1.11A 就附表 2 某些部分而言的所有權
text:
(1) Subject to subregulation (4), for Parts 188 and 888 of Schedule 2, ownership by an applicant, or the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner, of an asset, an eligible investment or an ownership interest, includes beneficial ownership only if the beneficial ownership is evidenced in accordance with subregulation (2).
(1) 根據第 (4) 款，對於附表 2 第 188 和 888 部分，申請人或申請人的配偶或同居伴侶對資產、合格投資或所有權權益的所有權，僅在受益所有權按照第 (2) 款得到證明的情況下才包括受益所有權。
(2) To evidence beneficial ownership of an asset, eligible investment or ownership interest, the applicant must show to the Minister:
(2) 為了證明資產、合格投資或所有權權益的受益所有權，申請人必須向部長證明：
(a) a trust instrument; or
(a) 信託工具；或
(b) a contract; or
(b) 合約；或
(c) any other document capable of being used to enforce the rights of the applicant, or the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner, as the case requires, in relation to the asset, eligible investment or ownership interest;
(c) 任何其他能夠用於執行申請人、申請人的配偶或同居伴侶（視情況需要）與資產、合格投資或所有權權益有關的權利的文件；
stamped or registered by an appropriate authority under the law of the jurisdiction where the asset, eligible investment or ownership interest is located.
由適當機構依據資產、合格投資或所有權權益所在司法管轄區的法律蓋章或登記。
(3) A document shown under subregulation (2) does not evidence beneficial ownership, for subregulation (1), for any period earlier than the date of registration or stamping by the appropriate authority.
(3) 依第 (2) 款出示的文件不能證明第 (1) 款中早於有關當局登記或蓋章日期的任何時期的實益所有權。
(4) Beneficial ownership is not required to be evidenced in accordance with subregulation (2) if the person who has legal ownership of the asset, eligible investment or ownership interest in relation to which the applicant, or the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner, has beneficial ownership:
(4) 如果對與申請人或申請人的配偶或同居伴侶擁有資產、合格投資或所有者權益的合法所有權的人擁有受益所有權，則無需根據第 (2) 款證明受益所有權：
(a) is a dependent child of the applicant; and
(a) 是申請人的受扶養子女；和
(b) made a combined application with the applicant; and
(b) 與申請人共同提出申請；和
(c) has not reached the age at which, in the jurisdiction where the asset, eligible investment or ownership interest is located, he or she can claim the benefits of ownership of the asset, eligible investment or ownership interest.
(c) 未達到在該資產、合格投資或所有權權益所在司法管轄區可主張該資產、合格投資或所有權權益所有權權益的年齡。

title: 1.11B ETA ‑ eligible passport
text:
(1) A passport is an ETA ‑ eligible passport in relation to an application for a visa if:
(1) 在以下情況下，護照是符合簽證申請的 ETA 資格的護照：
(a) it is a valid passport of a kind specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister as an ETA ‑ eligible passport; and
(a) 它是部長制定的立法文書中指定為符合 ETA 資格的護照類型的有效護照；和
(b) the conditions (if any) specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for passports of that kind are satisfied in relation to that application.
(b) 部長為此類護照制定的立法文書中規定的與該申請相關的條件（如果有）得到滿足。
(2) A passport is an ETA ‑ eligible passport in relation to a visa of a particular Subclass if:
(2) 符合以下條件的護照是與特定子類簽證相關的 ETA 合格護照：
(a) it is an ETA ‑ eligible passport in accordance with subregulation (1); and
(a) 根據第 (1) 款，它是符合 ETA 標準的護照；和
(b) it is specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister to be an ETA ‑ eligible passport for that Subclass.
(b) 在部長制定的立法文件中指定為該子類別的 ETA 合格護照。
(3) A passport is an ETA ‑ eligible passport for the purposes of regulation 1.15J if it is a valid passport of a kind specified for paragraph (1)(a).
(3) 就第 1.15J 條而言，如果護照是第 (1)(a) 款規定的有效護照，則該護照是符合 ETA 資格的護照。

title: 1.11C eVisitor eligible passport
text:
A passport is an eVisitor eligible passport if:
若符合以下條件，護照即為符合電子訪客資格的護照：
(a) it is a valid passport of a kind specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph to be an eVisitor eligible passport; and
(a) 它是部長在書面文書中指定的有效護照，本款規定為符合電子訪客資格的護照；和
(b) the conditions (if any) specified in the instrument are satisfied.
(b) 符合文書中規定的條件（如有）。

title: 1.12 Member of the family unit
text:
Scope
適用範圍
(1) This regulation has effect for the purposes of the definition (the main definition ) of member of the family unit in subsection 5(1) of the Act.
(1) 本條例適用於該法第 5(1) 款中家庭單位成員的定義（主要定義）。
General rule
一般規則
(2) A person is a member of the family unit of another person (the family head ) if the person:
(2) 一個人是另一個人（戶主）家庭單位的成員，如果該人：
(a) is a spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(a) 是戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(b) is a child or step ‑ child of the family head or of a spouse or de facto partner of the family head (other than a child or step ‑ child who is engaged to be married or has a spouse or de facto partner) and:
(b) 是戶主或其配偶或同居伴侶的子女或繼子女（已訂婚或有配偶或同居伴侶的子女或繼子女除外），且：
(i) has not turned 18; or
(i) 尚未年滿 18 歲；或
(ii) has turned 18, but has not turned 23, and is dependent on the family head or on the spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(ii) 已年滿 18 歲，但未年滿 23 歲，並依賴戶主或戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(iii) has turned 23 and is under paragraph 1.05A(1)(b) dependent on the family head or on the spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(iii) 已年滿 23 歲，並且根據第 1.05A(1)(b) 段依賴戶主或戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(c) is a dependent child of a person who meets the conditions in paragraph (b).
(c) 是符合(b) 款條件的人的受扶養子女。
This subregulation has effect subject to the later subregulations of this regulation.
本細則的效力受本細則後續細則的約束。
Protection, refugee and humanitarian visas
保護、難民和人道簽證
(3) Subregulation (4) has effect for the purposes of the main definition so far as it is relevant to a provision of the Act or these Regulations applying in relation to any of the following visas:
(3) 第 (4) 款就主要定義而言具有效力，只要它與適用於以下任何簽證的法案或本條例的規定有關：
(a) a Protection (Class XA) visa;
(a) 保護（XA 類）簽證；
(b) a Refugee and Humanitarian (Class XB) visa;
(b) 難民和人道（XB 類）簽證；
(c) a Temporary Protection (Class XD) visa;
(c) 臨時保護（XD 類）簽證；
(d) a Safe Haven Enterprise (Class XE) visa;
(d) 避風港企業（XE 類）簽證；
(e) a Resolution of Status (Class CD) visa;
(e) 身分決議（CD 類）簽證；
(f) a Temporary Safe Haven (Class UJ) visa;
(f) 臨時避風港（UJ 類）簽證；
(g) a Temporary (Humanitarian Concern) (Class UO) visa;
(g) 臨時（人道考量）（UO 類）簽證；
(h) a Territorial Asylum (Residence) (Class BE) visa.
(h) 領土庇護（居住）（BE 類）簽證。
(4) A person is a member of the family unit of another person (the family head ) if the person is:
(4) 一個人是另一個人（戶主）家庭單位的成員，如果該人是：
(a) a spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(a) 戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(b) a dependent child of:
(b) 受扶養子女：
(i) the family head; or
(i) 戶主；或
(ii) a spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(ii) 戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(c) a dependent child of a dependent child of:
(c) 以下人員的受扶養子女的受扶養子女：
(i) the family head; or
(i) 戶主；或
(ii) a spouse or de facto partner of the family head; or
(ii) 戶主的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(d) a relative, of the family head or of a spouse or de facto partner of the family head, who:
(d) 戶主或戶主配偶或同居伴侶的親屬，他們：
(i) does not have a spouse or de facto partner; and
(i) 沒有配偶或同居伴侶；和
(ii) is usually resident in the family head’s household; and
(ii) 通常居住在戶主的家庭中；和
(iii) is dependent on the family head.
(iii) 仰賴戶主。
Member of the family unit of applicant for a new visa on the basis of earlier status as member of the family unit
申請人以先前家庭成員身分為基礎申請新簽證的家庭成員
(5) In addition to subregulation (2), a person is a member of the family unit, of an applicant for a visa (the new visa ) described in column 1 of an item of the following table who seeks to satisfy the primary criteria for the new visa, if, at the time of the application for the new visa, the person:

(a) a spouse or de facto partner of the applicant or holder; or
(a) 申請人或持有人的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(b) a dependent child of the applicant or holder, or of that spouse or de facto partner of the applicant or holder, who is unmarried and has not turned 18.
(b) 申請人或持有人、申請人或持有人的配偶或同居伴侶的未婚且未滿 18 歲的受扶養子女。

(7) 國家創新（BX類）簽證申請人的家庭成員，且在申請時未滿18歲，如果：

(a) 此人是：

(i) 與申請人共同申請簽證的申請人的父母；或
