(c) if the person is a multiple passport holder—specify the country that the person holds a passport for and wants to travel to; and
(c) 如果此人持有多本護照－請具體說明此人持有護照並希望前往哪個國家；和
(d) be made while the person whose travel will be funded is the holder of the Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, the Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa, the Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa, the Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa, the Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, the Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, the Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or the Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa.
(d) 旅遊資助者持有 401 類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、402 類（培訓和研究）簽證、408 類（臨時活動）簽證、416 類（特殊項目）簽證、457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（技能）需求）簽證、482 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（技能）需求）簽證、482 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（技能）需求）簽證、482 類）簽證、類 494）
(4) Without limiting paragraph (2)(c), a person is taken to have paid reasonable and necessary costs if:
(4) 在不限制第 (2)(c) 款的情況下，如果出現以下情況，則認為一個人已經支付了合理且必要的費用：
(a) the costs include the cost of travel from the primary sponsored person’s usual place of residence in Australia to the place of departure from Australia; and
(a) 費用包括從主要被擔保人在澳洲的常住地到離開澳洲的地點的旅行費用；和
(b) the costs include the cost of travel from Australia to the country the person specifies in accordance with subregulation (3); and
(b) 費用包括從澳洲前往該人根據第 (3) 款指定的國家的旅行費用；和
(c) the costs are paid within 30 days of receiving the request for costs; and
(c) 在收到費用請求後 30 天內支付費用；和
(d) the costs are for economy class air travel or the equivalent of economy class air travel.
(d) 費用適用於經濟艙航空旅行或同等經濟艙航空旅行。
(5) The obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
（五）第（二）款所述義務：
(a) starts to apply:
(a) 開始適用：
(i) if the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa—on the day the primary sponsored person is granted the visa; or
(i) 若主要被擔保人持有 402 類（訓練和研究）簽證－在主要被擔保人取得簽證之日；或
(ia) if the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa or a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa—on the day the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person is granted the visa; or
(ia) 若主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有 408 類（臨時活動）簽證或 416 類（特殊計畫）簽證－在主要擔保人或次要擔保人取得簽證的當天；或
(ii) if the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa:
(ii) 若主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有 401 類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證、457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（需求技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時簽證））：
(A) on the day on which the Minister approves a nomination by the person that identifies the primary sponsored person; or
(A) 部長批准確定主要擔保人的提名之日；或
(B) if the primary sponsored person does not hold the visa on the day the Minister approves the nomination—on the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted the visa on the basis of being identified in an approved nomination by the person; and
(B) 如果主要被擔保人在部長批准提名之日沒有持有簽證－主要被擔保人根據該人批准的提名中的身份被授予簽證之日；和
(b) for a primary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(b) 對於主要被擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination under section 140GB of the Act by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長根據該法第 140GB 條批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that is in effect and is:
(ii) 主要被擔保人取得有效的進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) if the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa—a visa that is not a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; or
(A) 如果主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證－該簽證不是 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 子類（需求技能）簽證或 482 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 子類（需求技能）簽證或 482 子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；或
(B) in any other case—a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person; and
(B) 在任何其他情況下－與主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the primary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 主要被擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, the Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa, the Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa, the Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa, the Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, the Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, the Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 401類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、402類（培訓和研究）簽證、408類（臨時活動）簽證、416類（特殊項目）簽證、457類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482類（需求技能）簽證、482類（保有技能）短缺）簽證或簽證或 494 簽證
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the primary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the primary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 當主要擔保人離開澳洲時，主要擔保人持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和
(II) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa, a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa, a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa, a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa;
（二）主擔保人最後持有的實質簽證是401類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、402類（培訓和研究）簽證、408類（臨時活動）簽證、416類（特殊項目）簽證、457類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482類（需求技能）
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect; and

(c) for a secondary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(c) 對於第二擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the secondary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that is in effect and is:
(ii) 第二被保證人取得有效的進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) if the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa—a visa that is not a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; or
(A) 如果二次擔保人持有的最後一張實質簽證是 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證－該簽證不是 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 子類（需求技能）簽證或 482 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 子類（需求技能）簽證或 482 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；或臨時技能短缺）簽證；或臨時技能短缺）簽證；
(B) in any other case—a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person; and
(B) 在任何其他情況下－與第二擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the secondary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 第二擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, the Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa, the Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa, the Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, the Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, the Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or the Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 401 類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、408 類（臨時活動）簽證、416 類（特殊計劃）簽證、457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（需求技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類簽證或雇主已有效的
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the secondary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the secondary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 二次擔保人離開澳洲時持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和

（二）二次擔保人最近持有的實質簽證為401類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、408類（臨時活動）簽證、416類（特殊項目）簽證、457類（臨時工作（技術簽證））簽證、482類（需求技能）簽證、482類（臨時技能）短缺）或 494 雇主；
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect.

title: 2.80A Obligation to pay travel costs—domestic worker (executive)
zh: 2.80A 支付差旅費用的義務－家事工人（高階主管）
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was a temporary activities sponsor, or a long stay activity sponsor, of a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人的臨時活動發起人或長期停留活動發起人的人，如果：
(a) the sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.224 (domestic worker) of Schedule 2; or
(a) 被擔保人持有 408 類（臨時活動）簽證，該簽證是在主要被擔保人滿足附表 2 第 408.224 條（家庭工人）中的標準的基礎上頒發的；或
(b) the last substantive visa held by the sponsored person was a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.224 (domestic worker) of Schedule 2.
(b) 被擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證，該簽證是根據主要被擔保人滿足附表 2 第 408.224 條（家庭工人）中的標準而授予的。
(1A) This regulation also applies to a person who is or was a long stay activity sponsor of a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person if:
(1A) 本規定也適用於現在或曾經是主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人的長期住宿活動擔保人，如果：
(a) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) stream; or
(a) 主要被擔保人持有家庭工人（高階主管）類別的 401 子類別（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證；或
(b) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) stream.
(b) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是家庭工人（行政人員）流中的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證。
(2) The person must pay the travel costs of the sponsored person:
（2）該人必須支付被擔保人的旅費：
(a) that will enable the sponsored person to travel to Australia, and leave Australia; and
(a) 這將使被擔保人能夠前往澳洲並離開澳洲；和
(b) that have not already been paid in accordance with this regulation; and
(b) 尚未依本規定支付的；和
(c) that are reasonable and necessary.
(c) 合理且必要的。
(3) Without limiting paragraph (2)(c), a person is taken to have paid reasonable and necessary costs if:
(3) 在不限制第 (2)(c) 款的情況下，如果出現以下情況，則認為一個人已經支付了合理且必要的費用：
(a) the costs include the cost of travel:
(a) 費用包含旅費：
(i) to Australia; and
(i) 前往澳洲；和
(ii) from the place of arrival in Australia to the sponsored person’s usual place of residence in Australia; and
(ii) 從抵達澳洲的地點至被擔保人在澳洲的常住地；和
(b) the costs include the cost of travel from the sponsored person’s usual place of residence in Australia to the place of departure from Australia; and
(b) 費用包括從被擔保人在澳洲的常住地到澳洲出發地的旅行費用；和
(c) the costs include the cost of travel from Australia to the country from which the sponsored person came to Australia; and
(c) 費用包括從澳洲到被擔保人來澳洲的國家的旅行費用；和
(d) the costs are for economy class air travel or the equivalent of economy class air travel.
(d) 費用適用於經濟艙航空旅行或同等經濟艙航空旅行。
(4) The obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(4) 第(2)款所述義務：
(aa) if subregulation (1) applies—starts to apply on the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted the visa referred to in that subregulation; or
(aa) 若第 (1) 款適用－自主要被擔保人取得該款所述簽證之日起開始適用；或
(a) if subregulation (1A) applies—starts to apply on:
(a) 若第(1A)款適用－開始適用於：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination by the person in which the primary sponsored person is identified; or
(i) 部長批准確定主要擔保人的提名之日；或
(ii) if the primary sponsored person does not hold a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) Stream on the day the Minister approves the nomination—the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted the visa on the basis of being identified in an approved nomination by the person; and
(ii) 如果主要被擔保人在部長批准提名之日沒有持有家政工人（行政）類別的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證，則主要被擔保人根據其批准的提名中的身份獲得簽證的日期；和
(b) for a primary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(b) 對於主要被擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination under section 140GB of the Act by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長根據該法第 140GB 條批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that:
(ii) 主要被保證人取得進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) is a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person; and
(A) 是與主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(B) is in effect; and
(B) 有效；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the primary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 主要被擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) Stream or the Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 家庭工人（行政人員）類別中的 401 子類別（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證或 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證已不再有效；
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the primary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the primary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 當主要擔保人離開澳洲時，主要擔保人持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和
(II) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) Stream or a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa;
(II) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是家庭工人（行政人員）流中的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證或 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證；
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect; and
過橋簽證已不再有效；和
(c) for a secondary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(c) 對於第二擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination under section 140GB of the Act by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長根據該法第 140GB 條批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the secondary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that:
(ii) 第二被保證人取得進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) is a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person; and
(A) 是與第二擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(B) is in effect; and
(B) 有效；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the secondary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 第二擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) Stream or the Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 家庭工人（行政人員）類別中的 401 子類別（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證或 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證已不再有效；
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the secondary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the secondary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 二次擔保人離開澳洲時持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和
(II) the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Executive) Stream or a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa;
(II) 二次擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是家庭工人（行政人員）流中的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證或 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證；
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect.

title: 2.81 Obligation to pay costs incurred by the Commonwealth to locate and remove unlawful non ‑ citizen
zh: 2.81 聯邦有義務支付因尋找和驅逐非法非公民而產生的費用
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was an approved work sponsor.
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是經批准的工作發起人的人。
(2) The person must pay costs incurred by the Commonwealth:
(2) 該人必須支付聯邦產生的費用：
(a) if the costs were incurred by the Commonwealth in taking either or both of the following actions in relation to the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person:
(a) 若聯邦因對主要擔保人或次要擔保人採取以下一項或兩項行動而產生費用：
(i) locating, as an unlawful non ‑ citizen, the primary sponsored person or the secondary sponsored person;
(i) 找出作為非法非公民的主要擔保人或次要擔保人；
(ii) removing, as an unlawful non ‑ citizen, the primary sponsored person or the secondary sponsored person from Australia; and
(ii) 將主要擔保人或次要擔保人作為非法非公民驅逐出澳洲；和
(b) if the Minister has requested the payment of the costs by written notice in the manner specified in subregulation (5); and
(b) 若部長已依照第 (5) 款規定的方式透過書面通知要求支付費用；和
(c) if the costs were incurred by the Commonwealth within the period mentioned in subregulation (6).
(c) 若費用是在第 (6) 款所述期間內由聯邦承擔的。
(3) However, if the person has already paid the costs of return travel in accordance with the sponsorship obligation mentioned in regulation 2.80 (the return costs ), the person is liable to pay to the Commonwealth only the difference between:
(3) 但是，如果該人已經根據第 2.80 條（回程費用）中提到的擔保義務支付了回程旅行費用，則該人只需向聯邦支付以下差額：
(a) the lesser of:
(a) 以下較小者：
(i) the actual costs incurred by the Commonwealth in taking 1 or more of the actions mentioned in paragraph (2)(a); or
(i) 聯邦因採取第 (2)(a) 款所述的一項或多項行動而產生的實際成本；或
(ii) the costs up to the limit prescribed under paragraph 140J(1)(a) of the Act, as prescribed in subregulation (4); and
(ii) 依照第 (4) 款的規定，費用不超過該法第 140J(1)(a) 段所規定的限額；和
(b) the return costs that have already been paid by the person.
(b) 該人已支付的退貨費用。
(4) For paragraph 140J(1)(a) of the Act, the limit in relation to the obligation at subregulation (2) is $10 000.
(4) 對於該法第 140J(1)(a) 段，第 (2) 款義務的限額為 10 000 美元。
(5) For paragraph (2)(b), the notice from the Minister requesting the payment of costs must:
(5) 對於第 (2)(b) 款，部長要求支付費用的通知必須：
(a) be given using a method mentioned in section 494B of the Act; and
(a) 使用該法第 494B 條所提及的方法給予；和
(b) specify a date for compliance not earlier than 7 days after the date a person will be taken, by section 494C of the Act, to have received the notice.
(b) 規定遵守日期，不得早於依該法第 494C 條規定某人收到通知之日後 7 天。
(6) For paragraph 2(c):
(6) 對於第 2(c) 段：
(a) in relation to a primary sponsored person—the period within which the Commonwealth must incur the costs:
(a) 對於主要被擔保人－聯邦必須承擔費用的期限：
(i) starts on the day on which the primary sponsored person becomes an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(i) 從主要被擔保人成為非法非公民之日開始；和
(ii) ends at the moment when the primary sponsored person leaves Australia; and
(ii) 在主要擔保人離開澳洲時結束；和
(b) in relation to a secondary sponsored person—the period within which the Commonwealth must incur the costs:
(b) 對於第二擔保人－聯邦必須承擔費用的期限：
(i) starts on the day on which the secondary sponsored person becomes an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(i) 從第二被擔保人成為非法非公民之日開始；和
(ii) ends at the moment when the secondary sponsored person leaves Australia.
(ii) 在第二擔保人離開澳洲時結束。
(7) The obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
（七）第（二）款所述義務：
(a) in relation to a primary sponsored person:
(a) 就主要擔保人而言：
(i) starts to apply on the day on which the primary sponsored person becomes an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(i) 從主要擔保人成為非法非公民之日開始適用；和
(ii) ends 5 years after the time at which the primary sponsored person leaves Australia; and
(ii) 在主要擔保人離開澳洲後 5 年結束；和
(b) in relation to a secondary sponsored person:
(b) 就第二擔保人而言：
(i) starts to apply on the day on which the secondary sponsored person becomes an unlawful non ‑ citizen; and
(i) 從第二擔保人成為非法非公民之日起開始適用；和
(ii) ends 5 years after the time at which the secondary sponsored person leaves Australia.
(ii) 在第二擔保人離開澳洲後 5 年結束。
(8) In this regulation:
（八）本規定：
costs , in relation to the removal of a former primary sponsored person or a former secondary sponsored person from Australia, has the same meaning as in paragraph (b) of the definition of costs in section 207 of the Act.
就將前主要擔保人或前次要擔保人移出澳洲而言，費用與該法第 207 條中費用定義 (b) 段的含義相同。

title: 2.82 Obligation to keep records
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was an approved work sponsor.
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是經批准的工作發起人的人。
(2) The person must keep records:
(2) 該人必須保存記錄：
(a) of a kind:
(a) 某種：
(i) if the person is a standard business sponsor—specified in subregulation (3); or
(i) 若該人是第 (3) 款所指定的標準商業擔保人；或
(ii) if the person is a party to a work agreement—specified in subregulations (3) and (3A); or
(ii) 若該人是第 (3) 及 (3A) 款所指定的工作協議的一方；或
(iii) if the person is a temporary activities sponsor, a temporary work sponsor or a professional development sponsor—specified in paragraphs (3)(a) and (b); and
(iii) 如果該人是第 (3)(a) 和 (b) 段中指定的臨時活動贊助商、臨時工作贊助商或專業發展贊助商；和
(aa) of a kind specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing (if any) made for this subparagraph; and
(aa) 部長在為本項制定的書面文書（如有）中指定的類型；和
(b) in a reproducible format; and
(b) 以可複製的格式；和
(c) either:
(c) 任一：
(i) in the manner specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing (if any) made for this subparagraph; or
(i) 依照部長在為本項制定的書面文書（如有）中指定的方式；或
(ii) if the record is a record mentioned in subparagraph (3)(a)(iii), (3)(e)(i), (3)(e)(ii) or paragraph (3)(g)—in a manner that is capable of being verified by an independent person; and
(ii) 如果該記錄是第 (3)(a)(iii)、(3)(e)(i)、(3)(e)(ii) 或第 (3)(g) 段所述的記錄－以能夠由獨立人士核實的方式進行；和
(d) for the period specified in subregulation (4), (5) or (6).
(d) 第(4)、(5)或(6)款規定的期限。
(3) For paragraph (2)(a), the records are:
(3) 對於第 (2)(a) 款，記錄為：
(a) if the obligation mentioned in regulation 2.80 applies to the person:
(a) 如果第 2.80 條所提及的義務適用於該人：
(i) a record of the written request by the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person for the payment of return travel costs; and
(i) 主要擔保人或次要擔保人支付回程旅行費用的書面請求記錄；和
(ii) a record of when the written request for the payment of return travel costs was received by the person; and
(ii) 該人何時收到支付回程旅行費用的書面請求的記錄；和
(iii) a record of how the person complied with the request to pay return travel costs, including:
(iii) 該人如何遵守支付回程旅行費用請求的記錄，包括：
(A) the costs paid; and
(A) 已支付的費用；和
(B) who the costs were paid for; and
(B) 費用由誰支付；和
(C) the date of the payment of the costs; and
(C) 費用支付日期；和
(b) if the obligation mentioned in regulation 2.84 applies to the person:
(b) 如果第 2.84 條所提及的義務適用於該人：
(i) a record of a notification to Immigration of an event specified in regulation 2.84 for the person; and
(i) 向移民局發出關於該人第 2.84 條規定的事件的通知記錄；和
(ii) a record of the particulars of the notification of the event, including:
(ii) 事件通知詳情的記錄，包括：
(A) the date on which the person notified Immigration of the event; and
(A) 該人將此事件通知移民局的日期；和
(B) the method by which the notification was provided; and
(B) 提供通知的方法；和
(C) where the notification was provided; and
(C) 通知是在哪裡提供的；和
(c) if:
(c) 如果：
(i) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa; or
(i) 主要保證人持有 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（需求技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時））簽證；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa;
(ii) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（需求技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時））簽證；
a record of the tasks performed by the primary sponsored person in relation to work undertaken in relation to the nominated occupation; and
主要擔保人所執行的與提名職業相關的工作的記錄；和
(d) a record of the location or locations at which the tasks mentioned in paragraph (c) were performed; and
(d) 執行(c)段所述任務的一個或多個地點的記錄；和
(e) if the obligation mentioned in regulation 2.79 or 2.79A applies to the person:
(e) 如果第 2.79 或 2.79A 條中提到的義務適用於該人：
(i) a record of the money paid to the primary sponsored person; and
(i) 支付給主要擔保人的款項記錄；和
(ii) a record of the money applied or dealt with in any way on the primary sponsored person’s behalf or as the primary sponsored person directed; and
(ii) 代表主要被擔保人或依照主要被擔保人的指示以任何方式使用或處理資金的記錄；和
(iii) a record of the non ‑ monetary benefits provided to the primary sponsored person, including the agreed value and the time at which, or the period over which, those benefits were provided; and
(iii) 向主要被擔保人提供的非貨幣福利的記錄，包括商定的價值以及提供這些福利的時間或期限；和
(iv) if there is an equivalent worker or workers in the person’s workplace—a record of the terms and conditions that apply, or did apply, to an equivalent worker or workers, including the period over which the terms and conditions applied; and
(iv) 若該人的工作場所存在同等工人，則適用或確實適用於同等工人的條款和條件的記錄，包括條款和條件適用的期限；和
(f) a copy of the written contract of employment under which the primary sponsored person is employed; and
(f) 主要擔保人受僱的書面僱傭合約副本；和
(g) if the person was approved as a standard business sponsor before 12 August 2018 and was lawfully operating a business in Australia at the time of:
(g) 如果該人在 2018 年 8 月 12 日之前被批准為標準企業擔保人，並且在以下時間在澳洲合法經營企業：
(i) the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor; or
(i) 該人被批准為標準業務發起人；或
(ii) the approval of a variation to the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor;
(ii) 批准對該人作為標準業務發起人的批准的變更；
all records showing that the person has complied with requirements relating to training specified by the Minister in an instrument in force before 12 August 2018 under subregulation 2.87B(2) (as in force before 12 August 2018); and
所有記錄顯示該人已遵守部長在 2018 年 8 月 12 日之前生效的文書中根據第 2.87B(2) 款（2018 年 8 月 12 日之前生效）規定的培訓要求；和
(h) records to substantiate the annual turnover (within the meaning of the Migration (Skilling Australians Fund) Charges Regulations 2018 ) for nominations in relation to which the person is liable for nomination training contribution charge.
(h) 確認與提名相關的人員需繳納提名培訓繳費的年度營業額（根據《2018 年移民（澳洲技能基金）收費條例》的含義）的記錄。
(3A) For subparagraph (2)(a)(ii), the records are the records specified in the work agreement as records that must be kept.
(3A) 對於第(2)(a)(ii)項，記錄是工作協議中規定必須保存的記錄。
(4) If the person is or was approved as a work sponsor in a class of sponsor under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, the obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(4) 如果該人現在或曾經被批准為該法第 140E(1) 款規定的某類擔保人中的工作擔保人，則第 (2) 款中提到的義務：
(a) starts to apply on the day on which the person is approved as a work sponsor in a class of sponsor under subsection 140E(1) of the Act; and
(a) 從該人根據該法第 140E(1) 款被批准為某類擔保人中的工作擔保人之日起開始申請；和
(b) ends 2 years after the first day on which each of the following occurs concurrently:
(b) 在下列各項同時發生的第一天後 2 年後結束：
(i) the person ceases to be an approved work sponsor;
(i) 該人不再是經批准的工作贊助人；
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。
(5) If the person is or was a party to a work agreement, the obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(5) 若該人是或曾經是工作協議的一方，則第 (2) 款所提及的義務：
(a) starts to apply on the day on which the work agreement commences; and
(a) 自工作協議生效之日起開始適用；和
(b) ends 2 years after the first day on which each of the following occurs concurrently:
(b) 在下列各項同時發生的第一天後 2 年後結束：
(i) the person ceases to be a party to a work agreement;
(i) 該人不再是工作協議的一方；
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。
(6) However, the obligation mentioned in subregulation (2) does not require a person to keep a record for a period of more than 5 years.
(6) 但是，第 (2) 款所提及的義務並未要求個人保存記錄的時間超過 5 年。

title: 2.83 Obligation to provide records and information to the Minister
zh: 2.83 向部長提供記錄和資訊的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was an approved work sponsor.
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是經批准的工作發起人的人。
(2) The person must provide records or information to the Minister:
(2) 該人必須向部長提供記錄或資訊：
(a) if the Minister has requested the provision of the records or information by written notice in the manner specified in subregulation (3); and
(a) 若部長已依照第 (3) 款規定的方式透過書面通知要求提供記錄或資訊；和
(b) if the records requested by the Minister:
(b) 若部長要求提供記錄：
(i) are records the person is required to keep under a law of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory that applies to the person; or
(i) 是根據適用於該人的聯邦或州或地區的法律要求該人保存的記錄；或
(ii) are records the person is required to keep under regulation 2.82; and
(ii) 是根據第 2.82 條要求該人保存的記錄；和
(c) if the records or information relates to:
(c) 若記錄或資訊涉及：
(i) the administration of Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act and the Regulations made under that Division; or
(i) 管理該法案第 2 部分第 3A 部分以及根據該部分制定的條例；或者
(ii) if the person is a party to a work agreement—the administration of the work agreement; and
(ii) 若該人是工作協議的一方－工作協議的管理；和
(d) in the manner, and within the timeframe, requested by the Minister in the notice mentioned in subregulation (3).
(d) 依照部長在第（3）款中提到的通知中要求的方式和時間範圍內進行。
(3) A notice from the Minister requesting the provision of records or information must:
(3) 部長要求提供記錄或資訊的通知必須：
(a) be given using a method mentioned in section 494B of the Act; and
(a) 使用該法第 494B 條所提及的方法給予；和
(b) specify a date for compliance not earlier than 7 days after the date on which a person will be taken, by section 494C of the Act, to have received the document.
(b) 規定遵守日期，不得早於依該法第 494C 條規定某人收到該文件之日後 7 天。
(4) If the person is or was approved as a work sponsor in a class of sponsor under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, the obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(4) 如果該人現在或曾經被批准為該法第 140E(1) 款規定的某類擔保人中的工作擔保人，則第 (2) 款中提到的義務：
(a) starts to apply on the day on which the person is approved as a work sponsor under section 140E of the Act; and
(a) 從該人根據該法第 140E 條被批准為工作贊助商之日起開始申請；和
(b) ends 2 years after the first day on which each of the following occurs concurrently:
(b) 在下列各項同時發生的第一天後 2 年後結束：
(i) the person ceases to be an approved work sponsor; and
(i) 該人不再是經批准的工作贊助人；和
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。
(5) If the person is or was a party to a work agreement, the obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(5) 若該人是或曾經是工作協議的一方，則第 (2) 款所提及的義務：
(a) starts to apply on the day on which the work agreement commences; and
(a) 自工作協議生效之日起開始適用；和
(b) ends 2 years after the first day on which each of the following occurs concurrently:
(b) 在下列各項同時發生的第一天後 2 年後結束：
(i) the person ceases to be a party to a work agreement;
(i) 該人不再是工作協議的一方；
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。

title: 2.85 Obligation to secure an offer of a reasonable standard of accommodation
zh: 2.85 確保提供合理住宿標準的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was:
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是以下人員：
(a) an approved work sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(a) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人相關的經批准的工作擔保人，如果：
(iii) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Professional Development stream; or
(iii) 主要擔保人持有專業發展類別的 402 子類（培訓和研究）簽證；或
(iv) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Professional Development stream; or
(iv) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是專業發展類別的 402 類（訓練和研究）簽證；或
(b) a special program sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(b) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人相關的特別計畫擔保人，如果：
(i) either:
(i) 任一：
(A) the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa; or
(A) 主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有 416 類（特殊計畫）簽證；或
(B) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa; and
(B) 主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 416 類（特殊項目）簽證；和
(ii) the position in the activity in relation to which the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was granted the Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa is a volunteer role; or
(ii) 與主要擔保人或次要擔保人獲得 416 類（特殊項目）簽證相關的活動中的職位是志願者角色；或
(ba) a temporary activities sponsor or a special program sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(ba) 與主要被贊助人或次要被贊助人相關的臨時活動贊助商或特別項目贊助商，如果：
(i) the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.228 (special program) of Schedule 2, or the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was such a visa; and
(i) 主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人持有408子類（臨時活動）簽證，其授予的基礎是主要被擔保人滿足附表2第408.228條（特殊計劃）中的標準，或者主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人持有的最後一個實質性簽證就是此類簽證；和
(ii) the position in the activity in relation to which the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was granted the visa is a volunteer role; or
(ii) 與主要擔保人或次要擔保人取得簽證相關的活動中的職位是志工角色；或
(c) an entertainment sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(c) 與主要贊助人或次要贊助人有關的娛樂贊助商，如果：
(i) either:
(i) 任一：
(A) the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa; or
(A) 主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有 420 類（娛樂）簽證；或
(B) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was a Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa; and
(B) 主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 420 類（娛樂）簽證；和
(ii) the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person was identified in a nomination of an occupation, a program or an activity that is a volunteer role; or
(ii) 主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人在職業、計劃或活動的提名中被確定為志願者角色；或
(d) an approved work sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(d) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人相關的經批准的工作擔保人，如果：
(i) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Sport stream, or the Religious Worker stream, in relation to a volunteer role; or
(i) 主要被擔保人持有與志工角色相關的體育類別或宗教工作者類別的 401 子類別（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Sport stream, or the Religious Worker stream, in relation to a volunteer role; or
(ii) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是與志工角色相關的體育類別或宗教工作者類別的 401 子類別（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證；或
(iii) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.222 (sport), 408.223 (religious worker) or 408.229A (entertainment) of Schedule 2 in relation to a volunteer role; or
(iii) 主要被擔保人持有 408 子類（臨時活動）簽證，其基礎是主要被擔保人滿足附表 2 中與志願者角色相關的第 408.222 條（體育）、408.223（宗教工作者）或 408.229A（娛樂）中的標準；或或
(iv) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a visa referred to in subparagraph (iii); or
(iv) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是第(iii)項所提及的簽證；或
(e) an approved work sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person, if:
(e) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人相關的經批准的工作擔保人，如果：
(i) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Occupational Trainee stream in relation to a volunteer role; or
(i) 主要保證人持有與志工角色相關的職業實習生類別 402（訓練與研究）簽證；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Occupational Trainee stream in relation to a volunteer role; or
(ii) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是與志工角色相關的職業實習生流中的 402 子類（培訓和研究）簽證；或
(iii) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 407 (Training) visa in relation to a volunteer role; or
(iii) 主要被擔保人持有與志工角色相關的 407 類（訓練）簽證；或
(iv) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 407 (Training) visa in relation to a volunteer role.
(iv) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是與志工角色相關的 407 類（訓練）簽證。
(2) The person must secure 1 or more offers of accommodation for the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person that:
(2) 該人必須為主要擔保人或次要擔保人獲得 1 份或多份住宿優惠，且符合以下條件：
(a) will provide for a reasonable standard of accommodation; and
(a) 將提供合理的住宿標準；和
(b) will ensure that the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person has accommodation while the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person is in Australia.
(b) 將確保主要擔保人或次要擔保人在澳洲期間有住宿。
Example: If accommodation that has been secured becomes unavailable, the approved work sponsor must secure another offer of accommodation for the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person.
例如：如果已獲得的住宿無法提供，則批准的工作贊助商必須為主要贊助人或次要贊助人提供另一份住宿。
(3) For subregulation (2)(a), accommodation is of a reasonable standard if the accommodation:
(3) 對於第 (2)(a) 款，如果住宿符合下列條件，則住宿符合合理標準：
(a) meets all relevant State or Territory and local government regulations regarding fire, health and safety; and
(a) 符合州或領地以及地方政府有關消防、健康和安全的所有相關法規；和
(b) offers 24 ‑ hour access; and
(b) 提供 24 小時訪問；和
(c) provides meals or a self ‑ catering kitchen; and
(c) 提供膳食或自助式廚房；和
(d) is clean and well ‑ maintained; and
(d) 乾淨且維護良好；和
(e) has a lounge area; and
(e) 設有休息區；和
(f) has adequate laundry facilities or a laundry service; and
(f) 有足夠的洗衣設施或洗衣服務；和
(g) provides power for lighting, cooking and refrigeration; and
(g) 提供照明、烹飪和冷凍電力；和
(h) has an adequate ratio of guests to bathroom facilities; and
(h) 客人與浴室設施的比例適當；和
(i) has uncrowded sleeping areas; and
(i) 睡眠區不擁擠；和
(j) provides appropriate gender segregated areas and bathroom facilities; and
(j) 提供適當的性別隔離區域和浴室設施；和
(k) allows adequate privacy and secure storage for personal items.
(k) 允許足夠的隱私和安全存放個人物品。
(4) The obligation mentioned in subregulation (2):
(4) 第(2)款所述義務：
(a) starts to apply:
(a) 開始適用：
(i) if the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.222 (sport), 408.223 (religious worker), 408.228 (special program) or 408.229A (entertainment) of Schedule 2, or a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa—on the day on which the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person is granted the visa; or
(i) 若主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人持有408子類（臨時活動）簽證，且該簽證是根據主要被擔保人滿足附表2第408.222（體育）、408.223（宗教工作者）、408.228（特殊項目）或408.229A（娛樂）條款簽證或保險
(ii) if the primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person holds a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa, a Subclass 407 (Training) visa or a Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa:
(ii) 若主要擔保人或次要擔保人持有 401 類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證、407 類（訓練）簽證或 420 類（娛樂）簽證：
(A) on the day on which the Minister approves a nomination by the person that identifies the primary sponsored person; or
(A) 部長批准確定主要擔保人的提名之日；或
(B) if the primary sponsored person does not hold the visa on the day the Minister approves the nomination—on the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted the visa on the basis of being identified in an approved nomination by the person; or
(B) 若主要被擔保人在部長批准提名之日沒有持有簽證－主要被擔保人根據該人批准的提名中的身分被授予簽證之日；或
(iii) if the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Professional Development stream—on the day the visa is granted; or
(iii) 如果主要擔保人持有專業發展類別的 402 子類（培訓和研究）簽證－在簽證授予之日；或
(iv) if the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa in the Occupational Trainee stream:
(iv) 如果主要擔保人持有職業實習生類別的 402 子類別（培訓和研究）簽證：
(A) on the day the Minister approves a nomination by the person that identifies the primary sponsored person; or
(A) 部長批准確定主要擔保人的提名之日；或
(B) if the primary sponsored person does not hold the visa on the day the Minister approves the nomination—on the day the primary sponsored person is granted the visa on the basis of being identified in an approved nomination by the person; and
(B) 若主要被擔保人在部長批准提名之日未持有簽證－主要被擔保人根據其批准的提名中的身份而獲得簽證之日；和
(b) for a primary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(b) 對於主要被擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination under section 140GB of the Act by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長根據該法第 140GB 條批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the primary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that:
(ii) 主要被保證人取得進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) is a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person; and
(A) 是與主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(B) is in effect; and
(B) 有效；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the primary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 主要被擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the visa mentioned in subregulation (1) has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 第(1)款所述簽證不再有效；
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the primary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the primary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 當主要擔保人離開澳洲時，主要擔保人持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和
(II) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a visa mentioned in subregulation (1);
（二）主擔保人最近持有的實質簽證是第（一）款所述的簽證；
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect; and
過橋簽證已不再有效；和
(c) for a secondary sponsored person—ends on the earliest of:
(c) 對於第二擔保人－結束於下列最早者：
(i) the day on which the Minister approves a nomination under section 140GB of the Act by another approved work sponsor in which the primary sponsored person is identified; and
(i) 部長根據該法第 140GB 條批准另一位經批准的工作贊助人的提名並確定主要贊助人的日期；和
(ii) the day on which the secondary sponsored person is granted a further substantive visa that:
(ii) 第二被保證人取得進一步實質簽證的日期：
(A) is a visa of a different subclass to the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person; and
(A) 是與第二擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證不同子類的簽證；和
(B) is in effect; and
(B) 有效；和
(iii) the first day on which each of the following has occurred:
(iii) 下列各項發生的第一天：
(A) the secondary sponsored person has left Australia;
(A) 第二擔保人已離開澳洲；
(B) the visa mentioned in subregulation (1) has ceased to be in effect;
(B) 第(1)款所述簽證不再有效；
(C) if:
(C) 如果：
(I) the secondary sponsored person held a Subclass 020 (Bridging B) visa when the secondary sponsored person left Australia; and
(I) 二次擔保人離開澳洲時持有020類（過橋B）簽證；和
(II) the last substantive visa held by the secondary sponsored person was a visa mention in subregulation (1);
(II) 二級擔保人持有的最後一次實質簽證是第(1)款所提及的簽證；
the bridging visa has ceased to be in effect.
過橋簽證已不再有效。

title: 2.86 Obligation to ensure primary sponsored person works or participates in nominated occupation, program or activity
zh: 2.86 確保主要擔保人工作或參與指定職業、計畫或活動的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to:
（一）本規定適用於：
(a) a person who is or was an approved work sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person if:
(a) 是或曾經是與主要被擔保人相關的經批准工作擔保人的人，如果：
(i) the primary sponsored person holds a visa in relation to which the primary sponsored person was required to be nominated by an approved work sponsor; or
(i) 主要被擔保人持有與其相關的簽證，且該簽證需要由經批准的工作擔保人提名；或
(ii) an occupation, a program or an activity was required to be nominated in relation to the primary sponsored person by an approved work sponsor; and
(ii) 需要由經批准的工作贊助人提名與主要贊助人相關的職業、計劃或活動；和
(b) a person who is or was an approved work sponsor in relation to a person who was a primary sponsored person if:
(b) 一個人現在或曾經是與主要被擔保人相關的經批准的工作擔保人，如果：
(i) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a visa in relation to which the primary sponsored person was required to be nominated by an approved work sponsor; or
(i) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是主要擔保人需要由經批准的工作擔保人提名的簽證；或
(ii) an occupation, a program or an activity was required to be nominated in relation to the primary sponsored person by an approved work sponsor.
(ii) 需要由經批准的工作贊助人提名與主要贊助人相關的職業、計劃或活動。
(2) If the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa, or the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa, the person must ensure that the primary sponsored person:
(2) 如果主要擔保人持有 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（需求技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時））簽證，或主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質性簽證是 457 類（臨時）簽證工作（282 類）簽證494 子類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時））簽證，申請人必須確保主要擔保人：
(a) works in the nominated occupation; and
(a) 在指定職業中工作；和
(b) does not work in an occupation unless both of the following apply:
(b) 除非符合下列條件，否則不得從事某職業：
(i) the occupation was nominated by the person in relation to the primary sponsored person under subsection 140GB(1) of the Act;
(i) 該職業是由與主要擔保人相關的人根據該法第 140GB(1) 條提名的；
(ii) the nomination was approved by the Minister under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act.
(ii) 提名已根據該法第 140GB(2) 條獲得部長批准。
(2A) If:
(2A) 如果：
(a) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa, or the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; and
(a) 主要被擔保人持有457子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（急需技能）簽證或482子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證，或主要被擔保人持有的最後一個實質性簽證是457子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（急需技能）或簽證類是482（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（急需技能）或簽證子類
(b) the nominated occupation is not an occupation specified by the Minister in an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(13);
(b) 提名職業並非部長在依第 2.72(13) 條所訂定的文書中所指定的職業；
the person must ensure that:
該人必須確保：
(c) if the person is, or was, a standard business sponsor who was lawfully operating a business in Australia at the time of the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the person’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor—the primary sponsored person is engaged only as:
(c) 如果此人現在是或曾經是標準業務擔保人，並且在該人被批准為標準業務擔保人時，或在最後一次批准對該人作為標準業務擔保人的批准期限的變更時，該擔保人正在澳大利亞合法經營業務——主要被擔保人僅從事以下活動：
(i) an employee of the person; or
(i) 該人的僱員；或
(ii) an employee of an associated entity of the person; or
(ii) 該人的關聯實體的僱員；或
(d) if the person is or was a standard business sponsor who was not lawfully operating a business in Australia, and was lawfully operating a business outside Australia, at the time of the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the person’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor—the primary sponsored person is engaged only as an employee of the person; or
(d) 如果此人是或曾經是標準商業擔保人，但未在澳大利亞合法經營業務，而在澳大利亞境外合法經營業務，則在該人被批准為標準商業擔保人時，或在最後批准對該人作為標準商業擔保人的批准期限的變更時——主要被擔保人僅作為該人的僱員；或
(e) if the person is or was a party to a work agreement—the primary sponsored person is engaged only as an employee of the person.
(e) 若該人是或曾經是工作協議的一方－主要擔保人僅作為該人的僱員。
(2AA) If:
(2AA) 如果：
(aa) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa, or the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa or a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; and
(aa) 主要被擔保人持有457子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（需求技能）簽證或482子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證，或主要被擔保人持有的最後一個實質性簽證是457子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（需求技能）或簽證子類是482（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482子類（需求技能）或簽證子類
(ab) the nominated occupation is not an occupation specified by the Minister in an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(13); and
(ab) 提名職業不是部長在根據第 2.72(13) 款制定的文書中指定的職業；和
(ac) the person is, or was, a standard business sponsor;
(ac) 該人現在或曾經是標準商業贊助商；
the person must ensure that:
該人必須確保：
(a) the primary sponsored person is employed under a written contract of employment; and
(a) 主要被擔保人是根據書面僱傭合約受僱的；和
(b) if the person is, or was, a standard business sponsor who was lawfully operating a business in Australia at the time of the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the person’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor:
(b) 如果此人現在是或曾經是標準商業擔保人，並且在該人被批准為標準商業擔保人時，或在最後一次批准該人作為標準商業擔保人的批准期限變更時，該擔保人正在澳大利亞合法經營業務：
(i) the person does not engage in activities that relate to the recruitment of a visa holder, an applicant for a visa or a proposed applicant for a visa for the purpose of supplying the holder, applicant or proposed applicant to a business that is not associated with the person; and
(i) 此人不從事與招聘簽證持有者、簽證申請人或擬定簽證申請人有關的活動，目的是向與此人無關的企業提供簽證持有者、申請人或擬定申請人；和
(ii) the person does not engage in activities that relate to the hire of a visa holder to a business that is not associated with the person; and
(ii) 此人不從事與僱用簽證持有者到與此人無關的企業有關的活動；和
(c) if the person is or was a standard business sponsor who was not lawfully operating a business in Australia, and was lawfully operating a business outside Australia, at the time of the person’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the person’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor:
(c) 如果此人現在或曾經是標準商業擔保人，但當時並未在澳大利亞合法經營業務，而是在澳大利亞境外合法經營業務，則在該人被批准為標準商業擔保人時，或在最後批准對該人作為標準商業擔保人的批准期限的變更時：
(i) the person does not engage in activities that relate to the recruitment of a visa holder, an applicant for a visa or a proposed applicant for a visa for the purpose of supplying the holder, applicant or proposed applicant to any other business; and
(i) 此人不從事與招聘簽證持有者、簽證申請人或擬議簽證申請人有關的活動，以向簽證持有人、申請人或擬議簽證申請人提供任何其他企業；和
(ii) the person does not engage in activities that relate to the hire of a visa holder to any other business.
(ii) 此人不從事與僱用簽證持有者從事任何其他業務相關的活動。
(2AB) The person’s obligation in subregulation (2AA) applies only in relation to the following:
(2AB) 第 (2AA) 款中該人的義務僅適用於下列情況：
(a) a primary sponsored person who holds a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa on the basis of satisfying the criteria in subclause 457.223(4) of Schedule 2 (as in force before 18 March 2018);
(a) 持有 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證且符合附表 2 第 457.223(4) 款（2018 年 3 月 18 日之前生效）中的標準的主要擔保人；
(b) a primary sponsored person whose last substantive visa was a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa held on the basis of satisfying the criteria in subclause 457.223(4) of Schedule 2 (as in force before 18 March 2018);
(b) 主要擔保人，其最後的實質簽證是基於滿足附表 2 第 457.223(4) 款（2018 年 3 月 18 日之前生效）中的標準而持有的 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；
(c) a primary sponsored person who holds a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa in the Short ‑ term stream or Medium ‑ term stream (as in force before 7 December 2024) ;
(c) 持有短期流或中期流（2024 年 12 月 7 日之前生效）的 482 子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證的主要擔保人；
(d) a primary sponsored person whose last substantive visa was a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa in the Short ‑ term stream or Medium ‑ term stream (as in force before 7 December 2024);

(a) 該人現在或曾經是：
(i) a temporary activities sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person (the sponsored person ); or
(i) 與主要被贊助人或次要被贊助人（被贊助人）相關的臨時活動贊助人；或
(ii) a long stay activity sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person (the sponsored person ); and
(ii) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人（被擔保人）相關的長期住宿活動擔保人；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the primary sponsored person holds a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Religious Worker stream or the Domestic Worker stream; or
(i) 主要被擔保人持有宗教工人類別或家庭工人類別的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the primary sponsored person was a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa in the Religious Worker stream or the Domestic Worker stream; or
(ii) 主要擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是宗教工人流或家庭工人流的 401 子類（臨時工作（長期居留活動））簽證；或
(iii) the sponsored person holds a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted to the sponsored person on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.223 (religious worker) or 408.224 (domestic worker) of Schedule 2; or
(iii) 被擔保人持有408子類（臨時活動）簽證，其基礎是主要被擔保人滿足附表2第408.223條（宗教工作者）或408.224（家庭工人）中的標準；或
(iv) the last substantive visa held by the sponsored person was a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa granted to the sponsored person on the basis that the primary sponsored person satisfied the criteria in clause 408.223 (religious worker) or 408.224 (domestic worker) of Schedule 2;
(iv) 被擔保人持有的最後一個實質簽證是408子類（臨時活動）簽證，根據主要被擔保人滿足附表2第408.223條（宗教工作者）或408.224（家庭工人）中的標準而授予被擔保人；
the person must not recover or seek to recover from the sponsored person any expenditure by the person in relation to financial support of the sponsored person in Australia.
該人不得向被擔保人追回或尋求追回與被擔保人在澳洲的經濟支持有關的任何支出。
(3) If the person is or was approved as a work sponsor in a class of sponsor under subsection 140E(1) of the Act, the obligations mentioned in subregulations (1A), (1B) and (2A):
(3) 如果該人現在或曾經根據該法第 140E(1) 款被批准為某類擔保人中的工作擔保人，則第 (1A)、(1B) 和 (2A) 款中提到的義務：
(a) start to apply on the day on which the person is approved as a work sponsor; and
(a) 從該人被批准為工作贊助商之日開始申請；和
(b) end on the day on which each of the following has occurred:
(b) 在下列各項發生之日結束：
(i) the person ceases to be an approved work sponsor;
(i) 該人不再是經批准的工作贊助人；
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。
(4) If the person is or was a party to a work agreement, the obligations mentioned in subregulations (1A), (1B) and (2A):
(4) 如果該人是或曾經是工作協議的一方，則第 (1A)、(1B) 和 (2A) 款中提到的義務：
(a) start to apply on the day on which the work agreement commences; and
(a) 從工作協議開始之日開始適用；和
(b) end on the day on which each of the following has occurred:
(b) 在下列各項發生之日結束：
(i) the person ceases to be a party to a work agreement;
(i) 該人不再是工作協議的一方；
(ii) there is no primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person in relation to the person.
(ii) 不存在與該人相關的主要擔保人或次要擔保人。

title: 2.87C Obligation not to engage in discriminatory recruitment practices
zh: 2.87C 不參與歧視性招募行為的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.1 — Sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who:
(1) 本規定適用於下列人員：
(a) is or was a standard business sponsor; and
(a) 是或曾經是標準商業贊助商；和
(b) is lawfully operating a business in Australia.
(b) 在澳洲合法經營業務。
(2) The person must not engage in, or have engaged in, discriminatory recruitment practices during the period of the person’s approval as a work sponsor.
(2) 在其被批准為工作贊助人期間不得從事或曾經從事歧視性招募行為。
(3) The obligation referred to in subregulation (2):
(3) 第(2)款所述義務：
(a) starts to apply on the day the person is, or was, approved as a standard business sponsor; and
(a) 從該人被批准為標準商業擔保人之日起開始申請；和
(b) ends when the person ceases, or ceased, to be a standard business sponsor.
(b) 當該人不再或不再是標準商業贊助商時結束。

title: Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
zh: 第 2.19.2 款 — 經批准的家庭擔保人等的擔保義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.

title: 2.87CA Sponsorship obligations
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140H(1) of the Act, each of the obligations mentioned in this Subdivision is a sponsorship obligation.
(1) 就該法案第 140H(1) 款而言，本款中提到的每項義務都是擔保義務。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 140HA(2A)(aa) of the Act, the following expenses are prescribed:
(2) 就該法第 140HA(2A)(aa) 條而言，規定了以下費用：
(a) medical, hospital or other health ‑ related expenses arising from the treatment of a person in a public hospital or other public health facility;
(a) 因在公立醫院或其他公共衛生機構接受治療而產生的醫療、住院或其他健康相關費用；
(b) expenses arising from the provision of an aged care service to a person, on or after 17 April 2019 and before 1 January 2020, by an approved provider of a kind mentioned in section 8 ‑ 6 of the Aged Care Act 1997 as in force immediately before 1 January 2020;
(b) 在2019年4月17日或之後以及2020年1月1日之前，由2020年1月1日之前生效的《1997年老年護理法》第8-6節中提到的經批准的提供者向某人提供老年護理服務而產生的費用；
(c) expenses arising from the provision of an aged care service to a person, on or after 1 January 2020 and before the commencement of the Aged Care Act 2024 , by an approved provider of a kind mentioned in section 63F of the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission Act 2018 as in force immediately before the commencement of the Aged Care Act 2024 ;
(c) 在 2020 年 1 月 1 日或之後以及《2024 年老年護理法》生效之前，由《2024 年老年護理法》生效前有效的《2018 年老年護理品質和安全委員會法》第 63F 條中提到的經批准的提供者向個人提供老年護理服務而產生的費用；
(d) expenses arising from the delivery of a funded aged care service to a person by a registered provider that is a government entity or a local government authority (within the meaning of the Aged Care Act 2024 ).
(d) 由作為政府實體或地方政府機構的註冊提供者（根據 2024 年《老年護理法》的含義）向個人提供資助的老年護理服務而產生的費用。

title: 2.87CB Obligation to keep records
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
(1) A person who is or was an approved family sponsor must keep records of a kind, and in a manner, specified in an instrument under subregulation (2) during the period:
(1) 現在或曾經是經批准的家庭擔保人的人必須在以下期間保存第 (2) 款文書中規定的種類和方式的記錄：
(a) starting on the sponsorship start day for the person; and
(a) 從該人的擔保開始日開始；和
(b) ending 2 years after the day the person ceases to be an approved family sponsor.
(b) 在該人不再是經批准的家庭擔保人之日起 2 年後結束。
(2) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify either or both of the following for the purposes of subregulation (1):
(2) 部長可以透過立法文書，為第 (1) 款的目的指定以下一項或兩項：
(a) a kind of record;
(a) 一種記錄；
(b) a manner of keeping records of that kind.
(b) 保存此類記錄的方式。

title: 2.87CC Obligation to give records to the Minister
zh: 2.87CC 向部長提供記錄的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
(1) If a person who is or was an approved family sponsor is given a notice under subregulation (2) during the period:
(1) 如果現在或曾經是經批准的家庭擔保人在此期間根據第 (2) 款收到通知：
(a) starting on the sponsorship start day for the person; and
(a) 從該人的擔保開始日開始；和
(b) ending 2 years after the day the person ceases to be an approved family sponsor;
(b) 在該人不再是經批准的家庭擔保人之日起 2 年後結束；
the person must comply with the notice.
該人必須遵守該通知。
(2) The Minister may, by written notice given to a person who is or was an approved family sponsor, request the person to give, within a specified period and in a specified manner, either or both of the following to the Minister:
(2) 部長可以透過向現在或曾經是經批准的家庭擔保人發出書面通知，要求該人在規定期限內以規定方式向部長提供以下一項或兩項：
(a) a record of a kind that the person is required to keep under regulation 2.87CB;
(a) 根據第 2.87CB 條要求該人保存的記錄；
(b) records:
(b) 記錄：
(i) that the person is required to keep under a law of the Commonwealth, or of a State or Territory, that applies to the person; and
(i) 根據適用於該人的澳洲聯邦、州或地區的法律，該人必須保存；和
(ii) that relate to the administration of Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act and the regulations made under that Division.
(ii) 與該法案第 2 部分第 3A 部分以及根據該部分制定的法規的管理有關的內容。
(3) The period specified in the notice must not end less than 7 days after the person is taken to have received the notice.
(3) 通知中指定的期限不得少於被視為收到通知後 7 天。
Note: See section 494C of the Act for when a person is taken to have received a document given by one of the methods specified in section 494B of the Act.
註：有關何時視為某人已收到通過該法案第 494B 節指定的方法之一提供的文件，請參閱該法案第 494C 節。

title: 2.87CD Obligation to give information to Immigration when certain events occur
zh: 2.87CD 發生某些事件時向移民局提供資訊的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
(1) If an event mentioned in subregulation (2) occurs in relation to a person who is an approved family sponsor, the person must give details of the event to Immigration:
(1) 如果第 (2) 款中提到的事件與經批准的家庭擔保人有關，則該人必須向移民局提供該事件的詳細資訊：
(a) within 28 days of the event occurring; and
(a) 事件發生後 28 天內；和
(b) in the manner specified in an instrument under subregulation (3).
(b) 依照第(3)款文書中規定的方式。
(2) The events are the following:
(2) 事件如下：
(a) a change to any information provided to Immigration whether in the person’s application for approval as a family sponsor or otherwise;
(a) 向移民局提供的任何資訊的變更，無論是該人申請家庭擔保人批准或以其他方式；
(b) the person is charged with, or convicted of, an offence;
(b) 該人被指控或被判有罪；
(c) a debt the person has incurred to the Commonwealth becomes overdue;
(c) 該人欠聯邦的債務逾期；
(d) the person becomes the subject of an apprehended violence order, or a similar order, issued under a law of a State or Territory or a foreign country;
(d) 該人成為根據州、地區或外國法律發布的暴力逮捕令或類似命令的對象；
(e) a person sponsored by the person dies.
(e) 由該人擔保的人死亡。
(3) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify a manner for the purposes of paragraph (1)(b).
(3) 部長可以透過立法文書，為第 (1)(b) 款的目的指定一種方式。

title: 2.87CE Obligation to pay outstanding public health debt of sponsored person
zh: 2.87CE 支付被擔保人未償公共衛生債務的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person (the first person ) who is or was the parent sponsor of another person (the sponsored person ).
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是另一人（被擔保人）的父母擔保人的人（第一人）。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) the sponsored person has an outstanding public health debt; and
(a) 被擔保人有未償還的公共衛生債務；和
(b) the debt relates to an expense incurred by the sponsored person:
(b) 債務與被擔保人所發生的費用有關：
(i) during the period in which the first person is the parent sponsor of the sponsored person; or
(i) 第一人是被擔保人的父母擔保人期間；或
(ii) during the period after the first person ceases to be the parent sponsor of the sponsored person but before the sponsored person next leaves Australia or is granted a permanent visa;
(ii) 在第一人不再是被擔保人的父母擔保人之後但在被擔保人下次離開澳洲或獲得永久簽證之前的期間；
the first person must, as soon as practicable, pay the debt in full.
第一個人必須盡快全額償還債務。

title: 2.87CF Obligation to support sponsored person financially and in respect of accommodation
zh: 2.87CF 為被擔保人提供經濟和住宿方面支援的義務
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Subdivision 2.19.2 — Sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.
text:
A person who is or was the parent sponsor of another person (the sponsored person ) must assist the sponsored person, to the extent necessary, financially and in relation to accommodation during the period:
一個人現在或曾經是另一個人（被擔保人）的父母擔保人，必須在必要的範圍內，在經濟上和住宿方面協助被擔保人：
(a) starting at the time the sponsored person is granted a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa; and
(a) 從被擔保人取得 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證之時開始；和
(b) ending at the time:
(b) 結束時間：
(i) a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa held by the sponsored person has ceased to be in effect and the sponsored person has left Australia; or
(i) 被擔保人持有的 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證已不再有效且被擔保人已離開澳洲；或
(ii) the sponsored person is granted a substantive visa.
(ii) 被擔保人取得實質簽證。

title: Division 2.19A — Publishing information about sanctions
zh: 第 2.19A 分部 — 公布制裁資料
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act

title: 2.87D Publishing information about sanctions
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140K(4) of the Act, the information that must be published by the Minister under that subsection is the following:
(1) 就該法案第 140K(4) 款而言，部長必須根據該款公佈的資訊如下：
(a) information that identifies the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor who failed to satisfy an applicable sponsorship obligation;
(a) 識別未能履行適用贊助義務的經批准保薦人或前經批准保薦人的資訊；
(b) the applicable sponsorship obligation that the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor failed to satisfy;
(b) 核准保薦人或前核准保薦人未能履行的適用保薦義務；
(c) information relating to the action taken under section 140K of the Act in relation to the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor.
(c) 與根據該法第 140K 條對經批准的擔保人或前經批准的擔保人採取的行動有關的資訊。
(2) For the purposes of subsection 140K(7) of the Act, the Minister is not required to publish information under subsection 140K(4) of the Act that relates to an approved family sponsor or former approved family sponsor.
(2) 就該法案第 140K(7) 款而言，部長無需根據該法案第 140K(4) 款公佈與經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人有關的資訊。

title: Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled
zh: 第 2.20 分部 — 可禁止擔保人提供擔保或取消其擔保核准的情況
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled

title: 2.88 Preliminary
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled
text:
For subparagraphs 140L(1)(a)(i) and (ii) of the Act, each of the circumstances mentioned in this Division is a circumstance in which the Minister may take one or more of the actions mentioned in section 140M of the Act.
對於該法案第 140L(1)(a)(i) 和 (ii) 款，本節中提到的每種情況都是部長可以採取該法案第 140M 節中提到的一項或多項行動的情況。
Note: The Minister cannot take action against a party to a work agreement under section 140M of the Act. The terms of the work agreement will provide for whether the agreement can be cancelled or whether the person can be barred from doing certain things under the agreement.
注意：部長不能根據該法第 140M 條對工作協議的一方採取行動。工作協議的條款將規定是否可以取消協議或是否可以禁止該人根據協議做某些事情。

title: 2.89 Failure to satisfy sponsorship obligation
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was:
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是以下人員：
(a) a standard business sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person; or
(a) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人相關的標準業務擔保人；或
(b) a professional development sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person; or
(b) 與主要被擔保人相關的專業發展擔保人；或
(c) a temporary work sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person; or
(c) 與主要被擔保人或次要被擔保人有關的臨時工作擔保人；或
(d) a temporary activities sponsor in relation to a primary sponsored person or a secondary sponsored person; or
(d) 與主要贊助人或次要贊助人有關的臨時活動贊助人；或
(e) a parent sponsor.
(e) 家長擔保人。
(2) For subparagraph 140L(1)(a)(i) of the Act, the circumstance is that the Minister is satisfied that the person has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation mentioned in Division 2.19.
(2) 對於該法第 140L(1)(a)(i) 款，情況是部長信納該人未能履行第 2.19 節中提到的擔保義務。
(3) For paragraph 140L(1)(b) of the Act, the criteria that the Minister must take into account in determining what action (if any) to take under section 140M of the Act in relation to the circumstance mentioned in subregulation (2) are:
(3) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(b) 段，部長在確定根據該法案第 140M 條針對第 (2) 款所述情況採取何種行動（如果有）時必須考慮的標準是：
(a) the past and present conduct of the person in relation to Immigration; and
(a) 該人過去和現在與移民有關的行為；和
(b) the number of occasions on which the person has failed to satisfy the sponsorship obligation; and
(b) 該人未能履行擔保義務的次數；和
(c) the nature and severity of the circumstances relating to the failure to satisfy the sponsorship obligation, including the period of time over which the failure has occurred; and
(c) 與未履行擔保義務有關的情況的性質和嚴重程度，包括未能履行擔保義務的時間段；和
(d) the period of time over which the person has been an approved sponsor; and
(d) 該人成為核准擔保人的時間；和
(e) whether, and the extent to which, the failure to satisfy the sponsorship obligation has had a direct or indirect impact on another person; and
(e) 未能履行擔保義務是否對他人產生直接或間接影響以及影響程度；和
(f) whether, and the extent to which, the failure to satisfy the sponsorship obligation was intentional, reckless or inadvertent; and
(f) 未能履行贊助義務是否是故意、魯莽或無意的，以及其程度；和
(g) whether, and the extent to which, the person has cooperated with Immigration, including whether the person informed Immigration of the failure; and
(g) 該人是否與移民局合作以及合作程度，包括該人是否向移民局通報了合作失敗的情況；和
(h) the steps (if any) the person has taken to rectify the failure to satisfy the sponsorship obligation, including whether the steps were taken at the request of Immigration or otherwise; and
(h) 該人為糾正未能履行擔保義務而採取的措施（如果有），包括這些措施是應移民局的要求還是以其他方式採取的；和
(i) the processes (if any) the person has implemented to ensure future compliance with the sponsorship obligation; and
(i) 該人為確保未來遵守贊助義務而實施的流程（如果有）；和
(j) the number of other sponsorship obligations that the person has failed to satisfy, and the number of occasions on which the person has failed to satisfy other sponsorship obligations; and
(j) 該人未能履行其他擔保義務的次數，以及該人未能履行其他擔保義務的次數；和
(k) any other relevant factors.
(k) 任何其他相關因素。

title: 2.90 Provision of false or misleading information
zh: 2.90 提供虛假或誤導性訊息
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was:
(1) 本規定適用於現在或曾經是以下人員：
(a) a standard business sponsor; or
(a) 標準商業贊助商；或
(b) a professional development sponsor; or
(b) 專業發展贊助商；或
(c) a temporary work sponsor; or

(d) a temporary activities sponsor; or
(d) 臨時活動贊助商；或
(e) a parent sponsor.
(e) 家長擔保人。
(2) For subparagraph 140L(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, an additional circumstance is that the Minister is satisfied that the person has provided false or misleading information to Immigration or the ART.
(2) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(a)(ii) 款，另一種情況是部長信納該人向移民局或 ART 提供了虛假或誤導性資訊。
(3) For paragraph 140L(1)(b) of the Act, the criteria that the Minister must take into account in determining what action (if any) to take under section 140M of the Act in relation to the circumstance mentioned in subregulation (2) are:
(3) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(b) 段，部長在確定根據該法案第 140M 條針對第 (2) 款所述情況採取何種行動（如果有）時必須考慮的標準是：
(a) the purpose for which the information was provided; and
(a) 提供資訊的目的；和
(b) the past and present conduct of the person in relation to Immigration; and
(b) 該人過去和現在與移民有關的行為；和
(c) the nature of the information; and
(c) 資訊的性質；和
(d) whether, and the extent to which, the provision of false or misleading information has had a direct or indirect impact on another person; and
(d) 提供虛假或誤導性資訊是否對他人產生直接或間接影響以及影響程度；和
(e) whether the information was provided in good faith; and
(e) 資訊是否是善意提供的；和
(f) whether the person notified Immigration immediately upon discovering that the information was false or misleading; and
(f) 該人在發現資訊不實或具有誤導性後是否立即通知移民局；和
(g) any other relevant factors.
(g) 任何其他相關因素。

path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act

text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was:

(a) the person no longer satisfies the criteria prescribed under subsection 140E(1) or (1A) of the Act at the time the person was approved as a work sponsor or family sponsor (as the case may be); or

(3) For paragraph 140L(1)(b) of the Act, the criteria that the Minister must take into account in determining what action (if any) to take under section 140M of the Act in relation to the circumstance mentioned in subregulation (2) are:

(a) the nature of the applicable sponsorship criteria that the person no longer meets; and
(a) 該人不再符合適用擔保標準的性質；和

(d) 該人為確保該人將來滿足適用標準而採取的步驟（如果有）；和
(e) any other relevant factors.

title: 2.92 Contravention of law
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act

text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is or was:

Contravention of law by person
人身违法行为
(2) For subparagraph 140L(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, an additional circumstance for the person is that the Minister is satisfied that the person has been found by a court or a competent authority to have contravened a Commonwealth, State or Territory law.
(2) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(a)(ii) 款，該人的另一個情況是部長信納該人已被法院或主管當局認定為違反了聯邦、州或領地法律。
(3) For paragraph 140L(1)(b) of the Act, the criteria that the Minister must take into account in determining what action (if any) to take under section 140M of the Act in relation to the circumstances mentioned in subregulation (2) are:
(3) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(b) 段，部長在確定根據該法案第 140M 條針對第 (2) 款所述情況採取何種行動（如果有）時必須考慮的標準是：
(a) the past and present conduct of the person; and
(a) 該人過去和現在的行為；和
(b) the nature of the law that the person has contravened; and
(b) 該人所違反的法律的性質；和
(c) the gravity of the unlawful activity; and
(c) 非法活動的嚴重性；和
(d) any other relevant factors.
(d) 任何其他相關因素。
Contravention of law by primary sponsored person
主要担保人违法
(4) For subparagraph 140L(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, an additional circumstance for a standard business sponsor, a temporary activities sponsor or a temporary work sponsor, in relation to a primary sponsored person, is that the Minister is satisfied that each of the following applies:
(4) 對於該法第 140L(1)(a)(ii) 款，標準業務贊助商、臨時活動贊助商或臨時工作贊助商與主要贊助人相關的附加情況是，部長信納以下各項均適用：
(a) the primary sponsored person has been found by a court or a competent authority to have contravened a Commonwealth, State or Territory law;
(a) 主要被擔保人被法院或主管機關認定違反了聯邦、州或領地法律；
(b) the law was a law relating to the licensing, registration or membership of the primary sponsored person in relation to the primary sponsored person’s approved occupation;
(b) 該法律是與主要擔保人的批准職業有關的主要擔保人的許可、註冊或會員資格有關的法律；
(c) the primary sponsored person was required to comply with the law in order to work in the occupation nominated by the standard business sponsor, temporary activities sponsor or temporary work sponsor and approved by the Minister.
(c) 主要擔保人必須遵守法律，才能從事標準商業擔保人、臨時活動擔保人或臨時工作擔保人提名並經部長批准的職業。
(5) For paragraph 140L(1)(b) of the Act, the criteria that the Minister must take into account in determining what action (if any) to take under section 140M of the Act in relation to the circumstances mentioned in subregulation (4) are:
(5) 對於該法案第 140L(1)(b) 段，部長在確定根據該法案第 140M 條針對第 (4) 款所述情況採取何種行動（如果有）時必須考慮的標準是：
(a) whether the person took reasonable steps to prevent the primary sponsored person from contravening a law relating to a licensing, registration or membership requirement of the primary sponsored person’s approved occupation; and
(a) 該人是否採取合理措施防止主要擔保人違反與主要擔保人批准的職業的許可、註冊或會員資格要求相關的法律；和
(b) whether any other primary sponsored person, while in the employ of the person, has been found by a court or a competent authority to have contravened a law relating to a licensing, registration or membership requirement; and
(b) 法院或主管機關是否發現任何其他主要保證人在受僱期間違反了與許可、註冊或會員資格要求有關的法律；和
(c) the processes (if any) the person has implemented to ensure future compliance with the licensing, registration or membership requirements of a primary sponsored person’s approved occupation; and
(c) 該人為確保未來遵守主要擔保人批准的職業的許可、註冊或會員資格要求而實施的流程（如果有）；和
(d) any other relevant factors.
(d) 任何其他相關因素。

title: 2.94B Change of circumstances relating to approved family sponsor etc.
zh: 2.94B 與核准的家庭擔保人等有關的情況發生變化
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.20 — Circumstances in which sponsor may be barred or sponsor’s approval may be cancelled
text:
For the purposes of subparagraph 140L(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, an additional circumstance in relation to a person (the first person ) who is or was an approved family sponsor of another person (the sponsored person ) is that the Minister is satisfied of any of the following:
就該法案第 140L(1)(a)(ii) 款而言，對於現在或曾經是另一人（被擔保人）經批准的家庭擔保人的人（第一人）而言，另一種情況是部長對以下任何一項感到滿意：
(a) the first person has been involved in:
(a) 第一人參與：
(i) activities that endanger or threaten any individual; or
(i) 危害或威脅任何個人的活動；或
(ii) activities disruptive to, or violence threatening harm to, the Australian community or a group within the Australian community;
(ii) 對澳洲社區或澳洲社區內的群體進行破壞性或暴力威脅傷害的活動；
(b) adverse information about the first person, or another person associated with the first person, has become known to Immigration;
(b) 移民局已了解有關第一人或與第一人有關的其他人的不利資訊；
(c) the first person, or the sponsored person, has an outstanding public health debt;
(c) 第一人或被擔保人有未償還的公共衛生債務；
(d) there has been a material change in the circumstances on the basis of which the first person was approved as a family sponsor.
(d) 第一個人被批准為家庭擔保人的情況有重大變化。
