title: 2.95 Preliminary
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.21 — Process to bar sponsor or cancel sponsor’s approval
text:
(1) This Division applies to a person who is or was an approved sponsor (other than a party to a work agreement).
(1) 本節適用於現在或曾經是經批准的擔保人的人（工作協議的一方除外）。
Note: The Minister cannot take action against a party to a work agreement under section 140M of the Act. The terms of the work agreement will provide for whether the agreement can be cancelled or whether the person can be barred from doing certain things under the agreement.
注意：部長不能根據該法第 140M 條對工作協議的一方採取行動。工作協議的條款將規定是否可以取消協議或是否可以禁止該人根據協議做某些事情。
(2) If the Minister is taking action against a person under section 140M of the Act, the Minister must do so in accordance with the process set out in this Division.
(2) 如果部長根據該法第 140M 條對某人採取行動，則部長必須按照本節規定的程序進行。

title: 2.96 Notice of intention to take action
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.21 — Process to bar sponsor or cancel sponsor’s approval
text:
(1) If the Minister is considering taking action under section 140M of the Act in relation to the person, the Minister must give a written notice to the person.
(1) 如果部長正在考慮根據該法第 140M 條對該人採取行動，部長必須向該人發出書面通知。
(2) The notice must:
(2) 通知必須：
(a) specify details of the circumstances prescribed under section 140L of the Act in relation to which action is being considered; and
(a) 詳細說明該法第 140L 條規定的與正在考慮採取行動有關的情況；和
(b) specify details of the actions that the Minister may take; and
(b) 詳細說明部長可能採取的行動；和
(c) specify the address for providing a response to the Minister; and
(c) 指定向部長提供答覆的地址；和
(d) be given using a method mentioned in section 494B of the Act; and
(d) 使用該法第 494B 條所提及的方法給予；和
(e) specify a date for a response not earlier than 7 days after the date a person is taken to have received the notice by section 494C of the Act.
(e) 指定回覆日期，不得早於依該法第 494C 條視為收到通知之日後 7 天。

title: 2.97 Decision
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.21 — Process to bar sponsor or cancel sponsor’s approval
text:
The Minister must consider a response before making a decision if the person:
如果此人出現以下情況，部長必須在做出決定之前考慮回應：
(a) provides a response to the Minister before the date mentioned in paragraph 2.96(2)(e); or
(a) 在第 2.96(2)(e) 段提到的日期之前向部長做出答复；或
(b) provides a response:
(b) 提供回应：
(i) after the date mentioned in paragraph 2.96(2)(e); and
(i) 第 2.96(2)(e) 段所提及的日期之後；和
(ii) before the Minister has made the decision.
(ii) 在部長做出決定之前。

title: 2.98 Notice of decision
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.21 — Process to bar sponsor or cancel sponsor’s approval
text:
(1) If the Minister decides to take action under section 140M of the Act, the Minister must notify the person, in writing, of the following matters:
(1) 若部長決定根據該法第 140M 條採取行動，部長必須以書面通知該人以下事項：
(a) the decision taken by the Minister, including the effect of the decision;
(a) 部長所做的決定，包括決定的效力；
(b) the grounds for making the decision;
(b) 作出決定的理由；
(c) if the person has a right to have the decision reviewed by application under Part 5 of the Act—state:
(c) 若該人有權根據該法第 5 節的規定通過申請複審該決定－說明：
(i) that the decision can be reviewed by the ART; and
(i) ART 可以對該決定進行審查；和
(ii) the time in which the application for review may be made; and
(ii) 可以提出複審申請的時間；和
(iii) who can apply for the review; and
(iii) 誰可以申請複審；和
(iv) where the application for review may be made;
(iv) 申請可在何處提出複審；
(d) if an action is to bar the person:
(d) 如採取行動禁止該人：
(i) details of how the person can apply for a waiver of the bar; and
(i) 該人如何申請律師資格豁免的詳細資料；和
(ii) the address to which a request for a waiver, if made, must be sent.
(ii) 豁免請求（如提出）必須寄送至的地址。
(2) If a notice is issued under regulation 2.96, and the Minister decides to take no action under section 140M of the Act, the Minister must notify the person, in writing, of the decision to take no action.
(2) 如果根據第 2.96 條發出通知，並且部長決定根據該法第 140M 條不採取行動，則部長必須以書面形式通知該人不採取行動的決定。

title: Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval
zh: 第 2.22 分部 — 豁免對擔保人核准的禁制
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval

title: 2.99 Application
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval
text:
This Division applies to a person who is or was an approved sponsor other than a party to a work agreement.
本節適用於現在或曾經是經批准的擔保人（工作協議一方除外）的人。

title: 2.100 Circumstances in which a bar may be waived
zh: 2.100 可以豁免律師資格的情況
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval
text:
For subsection 140O(2) of the Act, a circumstance in which the Minister may waive a bar is that the Minister has received a request from the person to waive the bar.
對於該法第 140O(2) 款，部長可以放棄禁令的情況是，部長已收到該人提出的放棄禁令的請求。

title: 2.101 Criteria for waiving a bar
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140O(3) of the Act, the criteria to be taken into account by the Minister in determining whether to waive a bar placed on an approved work sponsor are:
(1) 就該法第 140O(3) 條而言，部長在決定是否免除對已批准工作贊助商的限制時要考慮的標準是：
(a) whether the person has made the request to waive the bar in accordance with the process set out in regulation 2.102; and
(a) 該人是否已按照第 2.102 條規定的程序提出了放棄禁令的請求；和
(b) if the Minister has not previously refused to waive the bar:
(b) 如果部长之前没有拒绝放弃律师资格：
(i) whether the interests of Australia would be significantly affected if the bar were not waived; and
(i) 如果不放棄該限制，澳洲的利益是否會受到重大影響；和
(ii) whether a substantial trade opportunity would be lost if the bar were not waived; and
(ii) 如果不放棄該限制，是否會喪失大量貿易機會；和
(iii) whether there would be a significant detriment to the Australian community if the bar were not waived; and
(iii) 如果不放棄該禁令，是否會對澳洲社會造成重大損害；和
(iv) whether the person’s inability to sponsor a proposed primary sponsored person would significantly damage Australia’s relations with the government of another country; and
(iv) 該人無法擔保擬議的主要擔保人是否會嚴重損害澳洲與其他國家政府的關係；和
(v) whether significant new evidence or information has come to light which was not available at the time the decision to place the bar was made; and
(v) 是否發現了在做出限制決定時無法獲得的重要新證據或資訊；和
(c) if the Minister has previously refused to waive the bar, whether the circumstances relevant to the making of the earlier decision have changed substantially.
(c) 如果部长此前曾拒绝放弃禁令，则与做出先前决定相关的情况是否发生了重大变化。
(2) For the purposes of subsection 140O(3) of the Act, the criteria to be taken into account by the Minister in determining whether to waive a bar placed on an approved family sponsor are:
(2) 就该法第 140O(3) 款而言，部长在决定是否免除对经批准的家庭担保人的限制时要考虑的标准是：
(a) whether the person has made the request to waive the bar in accordance with the process set out in regulation 2.102; and
(a) 該人是否已按照第 2.102 條規定的程序提出了放棄禁令的請求；和
(b) whether significant new evidence or information has come to light which was not available at the time the decision to place the bar was made; and
(b) 是否發現了在作出禁止決定時無法獲得的重要新證據或資訊；和
(c) whether there are exceptional circumstances that justify waiving the bar.
(c) 是否存在需要放弃限制的特殊情况。

title: 2.102 Process to waive a bar
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
Division 2.22 — Waiving a bar on sponsor’s approval
text:
(1) For section 140P of the Act, the Minister may waive a bar placed on the person under section 140M of the Act in accordance with the process set out in this regulation.
(1) 对于该法案第 140P 条，部长可以根据本条例规定的程序，免除根据该法案第 140M 条对该人施加的禁令。
(2) A request from the person to the Minister to waive the bar must:
(2) 個人向部長提出的豁免禁令的請求必須：
(a) be in writing; and
(a) 採用書面形式；和
(b) be sent to the address specified in the notice from the Minister mentioned in regulation 2.98.
(b) 发送至第 2.98 条中提到的部长通知中指定的地址。

title: Division 2.22A — Inspectors
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act

title: 2.102A Period of appointment
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
For subsection 140V(2) of the Act, the period specified in an instrument of appointment issued under subsection 140V(1) of the Act must not exceed 4 years.
对于该法第 140V(2) 款，根据该法第 140V(1) 款颁发的任命书中指定的期限不得超过 4 年。

title: 2.102C Purposes for which powers of inspectors may be exercised
zh: 2.102C 檢查員行使權力的目的
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
For paragraph 140X(b) of the Act, the purposes for which an inspector may exercise his or her powers are:
对于该法第 140X(b) 款，检查员行使其权力的目的是：
(a) determining whether a term or a condition of a work agreement is being, or has been, complied with; and
(a) 确定工作协议的条款或条件是否正在或已经得到遵守；和
(b) determining whether a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act exists or has existed; and
(b) 确定该法第 140L 条规定的情况是否存在或已经存在；和
(c) investigating a circumstance, if a circumstance exists or has existed, in order to assist the Minister in determining what (if any) action to take under section 140M of the Act.
(c) 調查某種情況（如果某種情況存在或已經存在），以協助部長決定根據該法第 140M 條採取什麼（如果有）行動。
Note 1: These purposes are additional to the purpose of determining whether a sponsorship obligation is being, or has been, complied with—see paragraph 140X(a) of the Act.
注 1：这些目的是确定担保义务是否正在或已经得到遵守的目的的补充——参见该法案第 140X(a) 段。
Note 2: Section 140L of the Act allows the regulations to prescribe circumstances in which an approved sponsor may be barred or an approved sponsor’s approval may be cancelled. These circumstances are prescribed in Division 2.20.
注 2：该法案第 140L 条允许法规规定可能禁止批准的担保人或可能取消批准的担保人的批准的情况。這些情況在第 2.20 節中有規定。
Note 3: Section 140M of the Act enables the Minister to cancel the approval of an approved sponsor or to bar an approved sponsor if regulations are prescribed under section 140L of the Act.
註 3：如果該法案第 140L 條規定了相關規定，該法案第 140M 條允許部長取消對已批准擔保人的批准或禁止批准擔保人。

For the purposes of subsection 140S(1) of the Act, the amount that a person is required to pay under subregulation 2.87CE(2) is prescribed in relation to the sponsorship obligation mentioned in that subregulation.
就該法案第 140S(1) 款而言，個人根據第 2.87CE(2) 款需要支付的金額是根據該款中提到的擔保義務而規定的。

title: 2.103 Disclosure of personal information by Minister—approved work sponsors etc.
zh: 2.103 部長批准的工作發起人等披露個人資訊
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
Information about visa holders or former visa holders
有關簽證持有者或前簽證持有者的信息
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(1) of the Act, the kinds of information about a holder, or former holder, of a visa of a kind mentioned in subregulation (2A) that may be disclosed by the Minister in accordance with that subsection are:
(1) 就該法第 140ZH(1) 款而言，部長可依該款揭露第 (2A) 款所述簽證持有人或前持有人的資訊類型：
(a) information relating to a failure to comply with a visa condition; and
(a) 與未遵守簽證條件有關的資訊；和
(b) information about the immigration status of the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(b) 有關簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的移民身分的資訊；和
(c) information about the terms and conditions of employment of the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(c) 有關簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的就業條款和條件的資訊；和
(d) information about costs incurred by the Commonwealth in relation to the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(d) 有關英聯邦與簽證持有人或前簽證持有人有關的費用的資訊；和
(e) information about an allegation made by the visa holder or former visa holder (or presumed to be made by the visa holder or former visa holder) that:
(e) 有關簽證持有人或前簽證持有人（或推定由簽證持有人或前簽證持有人）提出的指控的資訊：
(i) an approved work sponsor, or a former approved work sponsor, of the visa holder or former visa holder has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation under Subdivision 2.19.1 (which deals with sponsorship obligations of approved work sponsors etc.); or
(i) 簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的經批准的工作擔保人或前經批准的工作擔保人未能履行第 2.19.1 款（涉及經批准的工作擔保人的擔保義務等）下的擔保義務；或
(ii) a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act may exist in relation to an approved work sponsor, or former approved work sponsor, of the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(ii) 該法第 140L 條規定的情況可能存在於簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的經批准的工作擔保人或前經批准的工作擔保人身上；和
(f) information about a debt, relating to the visa holder or former visa holder, owed by an approved work sponsor or former approved work sponsor.
(f) 經核准的工作擔保人或前核准的工作擔保人所欠的與簽證持有人或前簽證持有人有關的債務資訊。
Information about approved work sponsors or former approved work sponsors
有關批准的工作發起人或前批准的工作發起人的信息
(2) For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(1) of the Act, the kinds of information about an approved work sponsor, or former approved work sponsor, of a holder or former holder of a visa of a kind mentioned in subregulation (2A) that may be disclosed by the Minister in accordance with that subsection are:
(2) 就該法第 140ZH(1) 款而言，部長可根據該款披露有關第 (2A) 款所述簽證持有者或前任持有者的經批准的工作贊助者或前批准的工作贊助者的資訊類型：
(a) information relating to a failure, or a possible failure, to satisfy a sponsorship obligation prescribed under subsection 140H(1) of the Act; and
(a) 與未能或可能未能履行該法案第 140H(1) 款規定的擔保義務有關的資訊；和
(b) information that a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act may exist; and
(b) 可能存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況的資訊；和
(c) information about a warning given in relation to the possible existence of a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act; and
(c) 有關因可能存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況而發出警告的資訊；和
(d) information about an action taken under section 140M of the Act; and
(d) 有關根據該法第 140M 條採取的行動的資訊；和
(e) information about a pecuniary penalty imposed for a contravention of section 140Q of the Act; and
(e) 有關因違反該法第 140Q 條而被處以罰款的資訊；和
(f) information about a warning given in relation to a possible contravention of section 140Q of the Act; and
(f) 有關可能違反該法第 140Q 條的行為的警告訊息；和
(g) information about an infringement notice issued under section 506A of the Act; and
(g) 有關根據該法第 506A 條發出的侵權通知的資訊；和
(h) information about the outcome of monitoring by an inspector exercising powers under Subdivision F of Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act; and
(h) 有關檢查員根據該法第 2 部分第 3A 節 F 分節行使權力的監測結果的資訊；和
(i) information provided to the Minister in accordance with regulation 2.83; and
(i) information provided to the Minister in accordance with regulation 2.83;和
(j) information provided to Immigration in accordance with regulation 2.84; and
(j) 根據第 2.84 條向移民局提供的資訊；和
(k) information relevant to the performance of a function by a Commonwealth, State or Territory agency of a kind mentioned in subregulation (3).
(k) 與聯邦、州或地區機構履行第 (3) 款中提到的職能相關的資訊。
Note: Regulation 2.83 prescribes a sponsorship obligation to provide records and information to the Minister. Regulation 2.84 prescribes a sponsorship obligation to provide information to Immigration when certain events occur.
註：第 2.83 條規定擔保人有義務向部長提供記錄和資訊。第 2.84 條規定擔保人有義務在發生某些事件時向移民局提供資訊。
Prescribed visas
規定簽證
(2A) For the purposes of column 2 of items 1 and 2 of the table in subsection 140ZH(1) of the Act, the kinds of visa mentioned in regulation 2.56 (other than a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa) are prescribed.
(2A) 就該法案第 140ZH(1) 小節表中第 1 項和第 2 項第 2 欄而言，規定了第 2.56 條中提到的簽證種類（870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證除外）。
Prescribed agencies
訂明機構
(3) For the purposes of column 3 of items 1 and 2 of the table in subsection 140ZH(1) of the Act, a Commonwealth, State or Territory agency responsible for the regulation of one or more of the following matters is prescribed:
(3) 就該法第 140ZH(1) 款表第 1 項和第 2 項第 3 欄而言，規定了負責監管以下一項或多項事項的聯邦、州或領地機構：
(a) education;
(a) 教育；
(b) fair trading;
(b) 公平交易；
(c) health;
(c) 健康；
(d) industrial relations;
(d) 勞資關係；
(e) law enforcement;
(e) 執法；
(f) public safety;
(f) 公共安全；
(g) registration and licensing in relation to an occupation;
(g) 與職業相關的註冊和許可；
(h) taxation;
(h) 稅收；
(i) trade practices;
(i) 貿易慣例；
(j) workplace safety;
(j) 工作場所安全；
(k) workplace training.
(k) 工作場所培訓。

title: 2.103A Disclosure of personal information by Minister—approved family sponsors etc.
zh: 2.103A 部長批准的家庭擔保人等披露個人資訊。
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
Information about visa holders or former visa holders
有關簽證持有者或前簽證持有者的信息
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(1A) of the Act, the kinds of information about a holder, or former holder, of a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa that may be disclosed by the Minister in accordance with that subsection are:
(1) 就該法案第 140ZH(1A) 款而言，部長可根據該款披露有關 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證持有者或前持有者的資訊類型：
(a) information relating to a failure to comply with a visa condition; and
(a) 與未遵守簽證條件有關的資訊；和
(b) information about the immigration status of the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(b) 有關簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的移民身分的資訊；和
(c) information about costs incurred by the Commonwealth in relation to the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(c) 有關英聯邦與簽證持有者或前簽證持有者相關的費用的資訊；和
(d) information about an allegation made by the visa holder or former visa holder (or presumed to be made by the visa holder or former visa holder) that:
(d) 有關簽證持有人或前簽證持有人（或推定由簽證持有人或前簽證持有人）提出的指控的資訊：
(i) an approved family sponsor, or a former approved family sponsor, of the visa holder or former visa holder has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation under Subdivision 2.19.2 (which deals with sponsorship obligations of approved family sponsors etc.); or
(i) 簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人未能履行第 2.19.2 款（涉及經批准的家庭擔保人的擔保義務等）下的擔保義務；或
(ii) a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act may exist in relation to an approved family sponsor, or former approved family sponsor, of the visa holder or former visa holder; and
(ii) 該法第 140L 條規定的情況可能與簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人有關；和
(e) information about a debt, relating to the visa holder or former visa holder, owed by an approved family sponsor or former approved family sponsor.
(e) 經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人所欠簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的債務資訊。
Information about approved family sponsors or former approved family sponsors
有關經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人的信息
(2) For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(1A) of the Act, the kinds of information about an approved family sponsor, or former approved family sponsor, of a holder or former holder of a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa that may be disclosed by the Minister in accordance with that subsection are:
(2) 就該法案第 140ZH(1A) 款而言，部長可根據該款披露有關 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證持有人或前持有人的經批准的家庭擔保人或前經批准的家庭擔保人的信息類型：
(a) information relating to a failure, or a possible failure, to satisfy a sponsorship obligation prescribed under subsection 140H(1) of the Act; and
(a) 與未能或可能未能履行該法案第 140H(1) 款規定的擔保義務有關的資訊；和
(b) information that a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act (which is about circumstances in which an approved sponsor may be barred or an approved sponsor’s approval cancelled) may exist; and
(b) 可能存在該法案第 140L 條規定的情況（即禁止批准的擔保人或取消批准的擔保人的批准的情況）的資訊；和
(c) information about a warning given in relation to the possible existence of a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act (which is about circumstances in which an approved sponsor may be barred or an approved sponsor’s approval cancelled); and
(c) 關於可能存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況（即可能禁止批准的擔保人或取消批准的擔保人的批准的情況）而發出警告的訊息；和
(d) information about an action taken under section 140M of the Act (which is about cancelling approval as an approved sponsor or barring such a sponsor); and
(d) 有關根據該法案第 140M 條採取的行動的資訊（關於取消作為已批准擔保人的批准或禁止此類擔保人）；和
(e) information about a pecuniary penalty imposed for a contravention of section 140Q of the Act (which is a civil penalty provision about failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations); and
(e) 有關因違反該法第 140Q 條而被處以罰款的資訊（這是關於未能履行擔保義務的民事處罰條款）；和
(f) information about a warning given in relation to a possible contravention of section 140Q of the Act (which is a civil penalty provision about failing to satisfy sponsorship obligations); and
(f) 有關因可能違反該法案第 140Q 條（這是關於未能履行贊助義務的民事處罰條款）的行為而發出的警告的資訊；和
(g) information about an infringement notice issued under section 506A of the Act; and
(g) 有關根據該法第 506A 條發出的侵權通知的資訊；和
(h) information provided to the Minister in accordance with regulation 2.87CC; and
(h) 根據第 2.87CC 條向部長提供的資訊；和
(i) information provided to Immigration in accordance with regulation 2.87CD; and
(i) 根據第 2.87CD 條向移民局提供的資訊；和
(j) information relevant to the performance of a function by a Commonwealth, State or Territory agency of a kind mentioned in subregulation (4).
(j) 與聯邦、州或地區機構履行第 (4) 款中提到的職能相關的資訊。
Prescribed visa
規定簽證
(3) For the purposes of column 2 of items 1, 2 and 5 of the table in subsection 140ZH(1A) of the Act, the Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa is prescribed.
(3) 就該法案第 140ZH(1A) 款表格第 1、2 和 5 項第 2 欄而言，規定了 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證。
Prescribed agencies
訂明機構
(4) For th e purposes of column 3 of items 1 to 5 of the table in subsection 140ZH(1A) of the Act, a Commonwealth, State or Territory agency responsible for the regulation of one or more of the following matters is prescribed:
(4) 就該法第 140ZH(1A) 款表格第 1 至 5 項第 3 欄而言，規定了負責監管以下一項或多項事項的聯邦、州或領地機構：
(a) health;
(a) 健康；
(b) law enforcement;
(b) 執法；
(c) public safety;
(c) 公共安全；
(d) taxation.
(d) 稅收。

title: 2.104 Circumstances in which the Minister may disclose personal information
zh: 2.104 部長可以披露個人資訊的情況
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(2) of the Act, this regulation sets out the circumstances in which the Minister may disclose personal information under subsection 140ZH(1) or (1A) of the Act.
(1) 就該法案第 140ZH(2) 款而言，本條例規定了部長可以根據該法案第 140ZH(1) 或 (1A) 款披露個人資訊的情況。
(2) Each of the following are circumstances in which the Minister may disclose personal information to a visa holder or a former visa holder:
(2) 在下列情況下，部長可以向簽證持有者或前簽證持有者披露個人資訊：
(a) the disclosure of the information may assist Immigration in determining:
(a) 資訊的揭露可以幫助移民局確定：
(i) whether an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor has failed to satisfy a sponsorship obligation; or
(i) 核准保薦人或前核准保薦人是否未能履行保薦義務；或
(ii) whether a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act exists in relation to an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor of the visa holder or the former visa holder;
(ii) 簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的核准擔保人或前核准擔保人是否存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況；
(b) the disclosure of the information may assist the visa holder or former visa holder to recover a debt under section 140S of the Act;
(b) 揭露資訊可以幫助簽證持有人或前簽證持有人根據該法第 140S 條追討債務；
(c) the disclosure of the information will notify the visa holder or the former visa holder that their approved sponsor or former approved sponsor has been sanctioned:
(c) 資訊揭露將通知簽證持有者或前簽證持有者其批准的擔保人或前批准的擔保人已受到製裁：
(i) for a failure to satisfy a sponsorship obligation prescribed under section 140H of the Act; or
(i) 未履行該法第 140H 條規定的擔保義務；或
(ii) due to the existence of a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act;
(ii) 由於存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況；
(d) the disclosure of the information will notify the visa holder or the former visa holder of the outcome of an allegation made by the visa holder or the former visa holder in relation to an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor.
(d) 資訊揭露將通知簽證持有者或前簽證持有者有關簽證持有者或前簽證持有者對經批准的擔保人或前經批准的擔保人提出的指控的結果。
(3) Each of the following are circumstances in which the Minister may disclose personal information to an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor:
(3) 在下列情况下，部长可以向经批准的担保人或前经批准的担保人披露个人信息：
(a) the disclosure of the information may assist the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor:
(a) 資訊的揭露可以幫助核准的保薦人或前核准的保薦人：
(i) to respond to a claim that a sponsorship obligation has not been satisfied; or
(i) 对未履行赞助义务的索赔作出回应；或
(ii) to respond to a claim that a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act exists; or
(ii) 对存在该法第 140L 条规定的情况的索赔作出回应；或
(iii) to satisfy a sponsorship obligation; or
(iii) 履行贊助義務；或
(iv) to meet a liability to a visa holder or a former visa holder;
(iv) 履行对签证持有人或前签证持有人的责任；
(b) the disclosure of the information will notify the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor that he or she is no longer the approved sponsor of a visa holder or a former visa holder;
(b) 披露信息将通知批准担保人或前批准担保人，他或她不再是签证持有人或前签证持有人的批准担保人；
(c) if the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor is an approved work sponsor or former approved work sponsor—the disclosure of the information will notify that sponsor of the cancellation of a visa held by a person who is or was a primary sponsored person, or a secondary sponsored person, of that sponsor;
(c) 若核准的擔保人或前核准的擔保人是核准的工作擔保人或前核准的工作擔保人－揭露資訊將通知該擔保人，現在或曾經是該擔保人的主要擔保人或次要擔保人所持有的簽證已被取消；
(d) if the approved sponsor or former approved sponsor is an approved family sponsor or former approved family sponsor—the disclosure of the information will notify that sponsor of the cancellation of a visa held by a person who is or was sponsored by that sponsor.
(d) 如果核准的擔保人或前核准的擔保人是核准的家庭擔保人或前核准的家庭擔保人－揭露資訊將通知該擔保人，現在或曾經由該擔保人擔保的人所持有的簽證已被取消。
(4) Each of the following are circumstances in which the Minister may disclose personal information to an agency of the Commonwealth or a State or Territory of a kind mentioned in subregulation 2.103(3) or 2.103A(4):
(4) 在下列情况下，部长可以向第 2.103(3) 或 2.103A(4) 款中提到的联邦机构或州或地区机构披露个人信息：
(a) the disclosure of the information may assist the agency to perform its functions;
(a) 信息的披露可能有助于该机构履行其职能；
(b) the disclosure of the information may assist Immigration in determining:
(b) 信息的披露可以帮助移民局确定：
(i) whether an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor has satisfied a sponsorship obligation; or
(i) 核准保薦人或前核准保薦人是否已履行保薦義務；或
(ii) whether a circumstance prescribed under section 140L of the Act exists in relation to an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor.
(ii) 核准擔保人或前核准擔保人是否存在該法第 140L 條規定的情況。

title: 2.105 Circumstances in which a recipient may use or disclose personal information
zh: 2.105 接收者可以使用或披露个人信息的情况
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
For the purposes of subsection 140ZH(3) of the Act, the circumstance in which a recipient of personal information disclosed under subsection 140ZH(1) or (1A) of the Act may use or disclose that information is that the information is to be used or disclosed by the recipient in the same circumstances in which it was disclosed to the recipient.
就該法案第 140ZH(3) 款而言，根據該法案第 140ZH(1) 或 (1A) 款披露的個人資訊的接收者可以使用或披露該資訊的情況是，接收者將在與向接收者披露該資訊相同的情況下使用或披露該資訊。

title: 2.106 Disclosure of personal information to Minister
path: Part 2A — Sponsorship applicable to Division 3A of Part 2 of the Act
text:
For subsection 140ZI(1) of the Act, the kind of personal information that the Minister may request an approved sponsor or a former approved sponsor of a visa holder or a former visa holder to disclose to the Minister is the contact details of the visa holder or the former visa holder.
對於該法案第 140ZI(1) 款，部長可以要求簽證持有人的批准擔保人或前批准擔保人或前簽證持有人向部長披露的個人資訊是簽證持有人或前簽證持有人的聯絡資訊。
Examples
範例
1 a postal address
1 郵寄地址
2 a residential address
2 居住地址
3 a telephone number
3 電話號碼
4 a personal website
4 個人網站
5 an email address.
5 電子郵件地址。

title: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
zh: 第 3 部 — 入境查驗及資料收集
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information

title: Division 3.1 — Information to be given
zh: 第 3.1 分部 — 須提供的資料
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information

title: 3.01 Provision of information (general requirement)
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) In this regulation:
（一）本規定：
officer includes a clearance officer.
官員包括一名清關官員。
(2) This regulation applies to:
(2) 本規定適用於：
(a) a person who is an overseas passenger:
(a) 海外旅客：
(i) arriving on board a vessel at a port in Australia in the course of, or at the conclusion of, an overseas flight or an overseas voyage; or
(i) 在海外航班或海外航程過程中或結束時乘船抵達澳洲港口；或
(ii) leaving Australia on board a vessel bound for or calling at a place outside Australia; and
(ii) 搭乘開往或停靠澳洲境外地點的船隻離開澳洲；和
(b) a person on board an aircraft arriving at, or departing from, an airport in Australia, being an aircraft operated by an international air carrier;
(b) 在抵達或離開澳洲機場的飛機上的人員，該飛機是由國際航空公司營運的飛機；
other than:
除了：
(c) a person included in a class of persons set out in an item in Part 1 of Schedule 9, being an item in which the word “no” appears in column 4; and
(c) 屬於附表 9 第 1 部分某項所列人員類別的人，即第 4 欄中出現「否」一詞的項目；和
(d) a person who, under regulation 3.06, is not required to complete a passenger card; and
(d) 根據第 3.06 條，無需填寫乘客卡的人員；和
(e) a person who enters Australia:
(e) 進入澳洲的人：
(i) on a non ‑ military ship; and
(i) 在非軍艦上；和
(ii) as a member of the crew of that non ‑ military ship, or as a member of the family unit of a member of the crew of that non ‑ military ship.
(ii) 作為該非軍用船舶的船員，或作為該非軍用船舶船員的家庭成員。
(3) A person to whom this regulation applies who is arriving in Australia must:
(3) 本規定適用的抵達澳洲的人必須：
(a) complete a passenger card:
(a) 填寫旅客卡：
(i) in relation to the person and to any other person that person is in charge of on the relevant flight or voyage; and
(i) 與該人以及該人在相關航班或航程中負責的任何其他人有關；和
(ii) in accordance with directions set out on the passenger card; and
(ii) 依照乘客卡上的指示；和
(b) provide the completed passenger card to an officer.
(b) 將填妥的乘客卡提供給工作人員。
(4) An officer may require a person to whom this regulation applies to provide to the officer information about that person in respect of any of the following matters:
(4) 官員可以要求本條例適用的人員向官員提供有關該人的以下任何事項的資訊：
(a) name;
(a) 姓名；
(b) date of birth and country of birth;
(b) 出生日期和出生國家；
(c) citizenship;
(c) 公民身分；
(d) sex, and marital or relationship status;
(d) 性別、婚姻或關係狀況；
(e) usual occupation;
(e) 平常職業；
(f) passport number;
(f) 護照號碼；
(g) if the person is not:
(g) 若該人不是：
(i) an Australian citizen; or
(i) 澳洲公民；或
(ii) a person who is eligible for the grant of a Special Category visa; or
(ii) 有資格獲得特殊類別簽證的人；或
(iii) a person who will on entry be taken to hold a special purpose visa;
(iii) 入境時將被帶去持有特殊目的簽證的人；
the number of the Australian visa held by the person;
該人持有的澳洲簽證號碼；
(h) flight number of aircraft or name of ship in relation to the relevant flight or voyage;
(h) 與相關航班或航程相關的飛機航班號碼或船舶名稱；
(i) country in which the person boarded, or intends to disembark from, the aircraft or ship;
(i) 該人登上或打算下機或船舶的國家；
(j) if the person is entering Australia—the intended address of the person in Australia.
(j) 如果該人要進入澳洲－該人在澳洲的預定地址。

title: 3.02 Passenger cards for persons entering Australia
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) A passenger card for a person entering Australia must include the following questions, or substantially similar questions:
(1) 進入澳洲的人員的旅客卡必須包含以下問題或基本上類似的問題：
(a) “Do you currently suffer from tuberculosis?”;
(a) 「您目前有肺結核嗎？」；
(b) “Do you have any criminal conviction/s?”.
(b) 「您有任何刑事定罪嗎？」。
(2) The questions set out in subregulation (1):
(2) 第(1)款規定的問題：
(a) may be printed on the passenger card in any order; and
(a) 旅客卡可依任何順序印上；和
(b) may be numbered in any way.
(b) 可以用任何方式編號。
(3) The passenger card may include instructions for completing it, including instructions that questions are to be answered by ticks or other symbols.
(3) 旅客卡可包含填寫說明，包括以勾號或其他符號回答問題的說明。

title: 3.03 Evidence of identity and visa for persons entering Australia (Act s 166)
zh: 3.03 進入澳洲人員的身份和簽證證明（第 166 條）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1A) For the purposes of subparagraph 166(1)(a)(i) of the Act, an image of a person’s face is prescribed as other evidence of the person’s identity and Australian citizenship.
(1A) 就该法案第 166(1)(a)(i) 项而言，人脸图像被规定为该人身份和澳大利亚公民身份的其他证据。
(1) For paragraph 166(1)(b) of the Act, the information required to be provided to a clearance authority is that set out in regulation 3.02.
(1) 对于该法第 166(1)(b) 段，需要向清算机构提供的信息是第 3.02 条中规定的信息。
(2A) For the purposes of subsection 166(3) of the Act, a person who seeks to comply with subparagraph 166(1)(a)(i) of the Act by presenting an image of the person’s face must do so by presenting themselves to an authorised system.
(2A) 就該法案第 166(3) 款而言，想要透過展示個人臉部圖像來遵守該法案第 166(1)(a)(i) 款的人必須透過向授權系統展示自己來實現這一目的。
(2) For subsection 166(3) of the Act, an Australian citizen who is required to comply with section 166 of the Act must provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer.
(2) 對於該法案第 166(3) 款，需要遵守該法案第 166 條規定的澳洲公民必須向清關官員提供完整的乘客卡。
(3) For subsection 166(3) of the Act, a non ‑ citizen who is required to comply with section 166 of the Act must:
(3) 对于该法第 166(3) 款，需要遵守该法第 166 条的非公民必须：
(a) if the non ‑ citizen is taken to hold a special purpose visa—provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer if required by Part 1 of Schedule 9 and present:
(a) 如果非公民被認為持有特殊目的簽證－根據附表 9 第 1 部分的要求，向清關官員提供完整的乘客卡並出示：
(i) the non ‑ citizen’s passport to an authorised system; or
(i) 授權系統的非公民護照；或
(ii) an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system; or
(ii) 通过向授权系统展示非公民的面部图像；或
(iii) evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in that Part, to a clearance officer; and
(iii) 根据该部分的规定，向清关官员提供非公民身份的证据；和
(b) if the non ‑ citizen is eligible to hold a special category visa:
(b) 如果非公民有资格持有特殊类别签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present a New Zealand passport that is in force to a clearance authority; and
(i) 通过向授权系统展示非公民的脸部图像或向清关机构出示有效的新西兰护照；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(d) if the non ‑ citizen holds an Electronic Travel Authority (Class UD) visa:
(d) 如果非公民持有电子旅行授权（UD 类）签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(e) if the non ‑ citizen is a person mentioned in paragraph 1223A(1)(c) of Schedule 1, as in force before 23 March 2013, who holds a Temporary Business Entry (Class UC) visa:
(e) 如果非公民是2013年3月23日之前有效的附表1第1223A(1)(c)段提到的持有临时商务入境（UC类）签证的人：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(ea) if the non ‑ citizen holds a Subclass 600 (Visitor) visa granted on the basis of an application which was taken to have been validly made under regulation 2.07AA:
(ea) 如果非公民持有根据第 2.07AA 条被视为有效提出的申请而授予的 600 类（访客）签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(f) if the non ‑ citizen holds a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) or Subclass 676 (Tourist) visa granted on the basis of an Internet application:
(f) 如果非公民持有基于互联网申请授予的 417 类（工作假期）或 676 类（旅游）签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(fa) if the non ‑ citizen holds a Subclass 600 (Visitor) visa granted on the basis of an Internet application:
(fa) 如果非公民持有基于互联网申请授予的 600 类（访客）签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer; and
(ii) 向清关官员提供完整的乘客卡；和
(g) if the non ‑ citizen holds a Visitor (Class TV) visa:
(g) 如果非公民持有访客（TV类）签证：
(i) present an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system or present evidence of the non ‑ citizen’s identity, as specified in Part 1 of Schedule 9, to a clearance authority; and
(i) 透過向授權系統展示非公民的臉部圖像，或按照附表 9 第 1 部分的規定，向清關機構出示非公民身份的證據；和
(ii) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer.
(ii) 提供清關官員完整的乘客卡。
Note: Internet application is defined in regulation 1.03.
註：網路應用的定義請參閱第 1.03 條。
(4) For the purposes of subsection 166(3) of the Act, a non ‑ citizen who is required to comply with section 166 of the Act (other than a non ‑ citizen mentioned in subregulation (3)) must:
(4) 就该法第 166(3) 款而言，需要遵守该法第 166 条的非公民（第 (3) 款中提到的非公民除外）必须：
(a) present:
(a) 呈現：
(i) an image of the non ‑ citizen’s face by presenting themselves to an authorised system; or
(i) 通过向授权系统展示非公民的面部图像；或
(ii) the non ‑ citizen’s passport to a clearance authority; and
(ii) 清關機構的非公民護照；和
(b) if the non ‑ citizen’s visa is evidenced by a label and a clearance officer asks for the label to be shown—present the label to a clearance officer; and
(b) 如果非公民簽證有標籤證明，且清關官員要求出示標籤－向清關官員出示該標籤；和
(c) provide a completed passenger card to a clearance officer.
(c) 提供清關官員完整的乘客卡。
(5) In this regulation:
（五）本規定：
authorised system means an automated system that is an authorised system for the purposes of section 166 of the Act.
授權系統是指根據該法案第 166 條的規定屬於授權系統的自動化系統。

title: 3.03AA Evidence of identity and providing information—non ‑ military ships (Act s 166)
zh: 3.03AA 身分證明和資訊提供－非軍用船舶（第 166 條法案）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a person who is the holder of a Maritime Crew (Temporary) (Class ZM) visa.
(1) 本規定適用於海事船員（臨時）（ZM 類）簽證持有者。
Note: This regulation does not apply to holders of a Subclass 988 (Maritime Crew) visa who are petroleum export tanker crew members: see item 12 of Part 2 of Schedule 9.
註：本規定不適用於持有 988 類（海事船員）簽證的石油出口油輪船員：請參閱附表 9 第 2 部分第 12 項。
(2) For paragraph 166(1)(b) of the Act, the information is as much of the information in the table as is required by a clearance officer:
(2) 對於該法案第 166(1)(b) 段，資訊為清關官員要求的表中資訊：
Item | Information
If the person arrives in Australia on a non ‑ military ship
101 | a document that identifies the person as being a member of the crew of the non ‑ military ship on which the person arrived (for example, a contract of employment, a crew list, a supernumerary crew list or a seafarer identity card)
102 | a document that indicates that the person is a member of the family unit of a member of the crew of a non ‑ military ship (for example, a marriage certificate, a birth certificate or an adoption certificate)
104 | a statement from the master, owner, agent, charterer or operator of a non ‑ military ship that the person is: (a) a member of the crew of the non ‑ military ship; or (b) a member of the family unit of a member of the crew of the non ‑ military ship; or (c) a member of the family unit of a person who is under an offer to become a member of the crew of the non ‑ military ship
105 | any information mentioned in subregulation 3.01(4)
If the person arrives in Australia by air
201 | a document that indicates the person is under an offer to become a member of the crew of a non ‑ military ship (a prospective member of the crew )
202 | a document that indicates that the person is a member of the family unit of: (a) a member of the crew of a non ‑ military ship; or (b) a prospective member of the crew; (for example, a marriage certificate, a birth certificate or an adoption certificate)
204 | a statement from the master, owner, agent, charterer or operator of a non ‑ military ship that the person is: (a) a prospective member of the crew; or (b) a member of the family unit of a member of the crew of the non ‑ military ship; or (c) a member of the family unit of a person who is a prospective member of the crew
205 | any information mentioned in subregulation 3.01(4)
項目 |訊息
如果此人乘坐非軍艦抵達澳大利亞
101 | 101證明該人是其抵達所乘坐的非軍用船舶船員的文件（例如，僱傭合約、船員名單、編外船員名單或海員身分證）
102 | 102表明此人是非軍艦船員家庭成員的文件（例如結婚證書、出生證明或收養證明）
104 | 104 非軍用船舶的船長、所有人、代理人、承租人或經營者的聲明，表明該人是： (a) 非軍用船舶的船員； (b) 非軍用船舶船員的家庭成員； (c) 受邀成為非軍用船舶船員的人員的家庭成員
105 | 105第 3.01(4) 款中提到的任何信息
如果此人乘飛機抵達澳大利亞
201 | 201顯示此人被邀請成為非軍艦船員（未來船員）的文件
202 | 202表示該人是下列家庭成員的文件： (a) 非軍用船舶的船員； (b) 未來的船員；或（例如結婚證書、出生證明或收養證明）
204 | 204 非軍用船舶的船長、所有人、代理人、承租人或經營者所發出的聲明，顯示該人是： (a) 未來的船員； (b) 非軍用船舶船員的家庭成員； (c) 未來船員的家庭成員
205 | 205第 3.01(4) 款中提到的任何信息
(3) For subsection 166(3) of the Act, if the person enters Australia as:
(3) 對於該法第 166(3) 款，如果該人以下列身分進入澳洲：
(a) a member of the crew on a non ‑ military ship; or
(a) 非軍用船舶上的船員；或
(b) a member of the family unit of a member of the crew of a non ‑ military ship;
(b) 非軍用船舶船員的家庭成員；
the requirements relating to passenger cards in subregulations 3.03(3) and (4) do not apply in relation to the person.
第3.03(3)及(4)款中有關乘客卡的規定不適用於該人。

title: 3.03AB Exemption from requirements to complete a passenger card where Australia Travel Declaration provided
zh: 3.03AB 提供澳洲旅遊聲明的情況下，免除填寫旅客卡的要求
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) The requirements relating to completing or providing a passenger card in these Regulations do not apply to a person who is arriving in Australia if:
(1) 本條例中有關填寫或提供乘客卡的要求不適用於抵達澳洲的人員，如果：
(a) the person has submitted an Australia Travel Declaration; and
(a) 該人已提交澳洲旅行聲明；和
(aa) the person has received an electronic message, generated by the departmental system that processes such declarations, showing that the person has submitted that declaration; and
(aa) 該人已收到處理此類申報的部門系統產生的電子訊息，表明該人已提交該申報；和
(ab) if requested by a clearance officer, the person:
(ab) 若清關官員要求，該人：
(i) presents the electronic message to the clearance officer; and
(i) 向清關官員提交電子資訊；和
(ii) confirms to the clearance officer that the information provided in the Australia Travel Declaration is correct; and
(ii) 向清關官員確認澳洲旅遊申報中提供的資訊正確無誤；和
(b) before an event referred to in subparagraph 172(1)(a)(iii) or (b)(iii) of the Act occurs:
(b) 在該法第 172(1)(a)(iii) 或 (b)(iii) 項所述事件發生之前：
(i) the person has not withdrawn the Australia Travel Declaration; and
(i) 該人尚未撤回澳洲旅遊聲明；和
(ii) a clearance officer does not require the person to provide a completed passenger card under subregulation (2).
(ii) 清關官員並未要求該人依第 (2) 款提供完整的乘客卡。
(2) A clearance officer may require the person to provide a completed passenger card if circumstances specified in an instrument under subregulation (3) exist.
(2) 若有第 (3) 款規定的文書中規定的情況，清關官員可以要求該人提供完整的乘客卡。
(3) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify a matter for the purposes of subregulation (2).
(3) 部長可以透過立法文書，為第 (2) 款的目的指定一個事項。

title: 3.04 Place and time for giving evidence (Act, s 167)
zh: 3.04 作證的地點和時間（法案第 167 條）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
For the purposes of subsection 167(2) of the Act (which deals with the time and place at which a person who enters Australia must comply with section 166):
就該法案第 167(2) 款（涉及進入澳洲的人必須遵守第 166 條的時間和地點）而言：
(a) the place at which a person who is required to comply with section 166 must do so is:
(a) 被要求遵守第 166 條的人必須遵守的地點是：
(i) a regional or area office of Immigration; or
(i) 地區或地區移民辦公室；或
(ii) at any place where there is a clearance officer, including a port; and
(ii) 任何有清關官員的地方，包括港口；和
(b) the period within which the person must do so is 2 working days after he or she enters Australia.
(b) 該人必須在進入澳洲後 2 個工作天內這樣做。

title: 3.05 Allowed inhabitants of the Protected Zone (Act, s 168(2))
zh: 3.05 保護區允許的居民（法案第 168(2) 條）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
For the purposes of subsection 168(2) of the Act (which deals with compliance with section 166 by allowed inhabitants of the Protected Zone):
就該法第 168(2) 款（涉及保護區內獲準居民遵守第 166 款的規定）而言：
(a) the place at which an allowed inhabitant of the Protected Zone who is required to comply with section 166 must do so is:
(a) 被要求遵守第 166 條規定的保護區允許居民必須遵守的地點是：
(i) a regional or area office of Immigration; or
(i) 地區或地區移民辦公室；或
(ii) at any place where there is a clearance officer, including a port; and
(ii) 任何有清關官員的地方，包括港口；和
(b) the period within which the inhabitant must do so is 5 working days after he or she goes to a part of the migration zone outside the protected area.
(b) 居民必須這樣做的期限是其前往保護區外遷徙區後的5個工作天內。

title: 3.06 Persons not required to comply with s 166 of the Act (Act, s 168(3))
zh: 3.06 無須遵守該法案第 166 條的人員（法案第 168(3) 條）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
For the purposes of subsection 168(3) of the Act (which deals with the classes of person not required to give information under section 166), each class of person set out in Part 2 of Schedule 9 is prescribed.
為了該法案第 168(3) 款（涉及第 166 條中不需要提供資訊的人員類別）的目的，規定了附表 9 第 2 部分中列出的每一類人員。

title: 3.06A Designated foreign dignitaries
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) For item 10 of Part 2 of Schedule 9 (which deals with persons not required to comply with section 166 of the Act), a person is a designated foreign dignitary if:
(1) 對於附表 9 第 2 部分第 10 項（涉及無需遵守該法第 166 條的人員），如果滿足以下條件，則該人為指定外國政要：
(a) the Minister specifies the person in an instrument in writing for this paragraph; or
(a) 部長在本款的書面文件中指定該人；或
(b) the person is included in a class of persons specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph.
(b) 此人屬於部長在本款書面文書中指定的人員類別。
(2) The Minister must specify a person or a class in accordance with arrangements approved in writing by the Minister.
(2) 部長必須依照部長書面批准的安排指定一個人或一個類別。
(3) If the person is specified in an instrument for paragraph (1)(a), the period in which the person is a designated foreign dignitary:
(3) 若該人在第 (1)(a) 款的文書中指明，則該人作為指定外國政要的期限：
(a) starts when the Minister specifies the person; and
(a) 從部長指定人員時開始；和
(b) ends at the time, or in the way, mentioned in the instrument.
(b) 在文書中提及的時間或方式結束。
(4) If the person is included in a class of persons specified in an instrument for paragraph (1)(b), the period in which the person is a designated foreign dignitary:
(4) 若該人屬於第 (1)(b) 款文書中規定的人員類別，則該人作為指定外國政要的期限：
(a) starts when the person becomes a member of the class; and
(a) 從該人成為班級成員時開始；和
(b) ends at the time, or in the way, mentioned in the instrument.
(b) 在文書中提及的時間或方式結束。
(5) For item 10 of Part 2 of Schedule 9, a person is a designated foreign dignitary if the person is an accompanying member of the immediate family of a person who is a designated foreign dignitary in accordance with subregulation (1).
(5) 對於附表 9 第 2 部分第 10 項，如果某人是根據第 (1) 款被指定的外國政要的人的直系親屬的隨行成員，則該人是被指定的外國政要。
Note: Regulation 1.12AA explains when a person is a member of the immediate family of another person.
註：第 1.12AA 條解釋了一個人何時是另一個人的直系親屬。
(6) An instrument made under paragraph (1)(a) or (b) is not a legislative instrument.
(6) 依第 (1)(a) 或 (b) 款制定的文書並非立法文書。
Note: The effect of section 168 of the Act, regulation 3.06 and Part 2 of Schedule 9 to these Regulations is that a designated foreign dignitary is not required to comply with the requirements of section 166 of the Act relating to the giving of information.
註：該法第 168 條、本條例第 3.06 條和附表 9 第 2 部分的作用是，指定的外國政要無需遵守該法第 166 條有關提供資訊的要求。

title: 3.07 Persons taken not to leave Australia (Act, s 80(c))
zh: 3.07 被帶離澳洲的人員（法案第 80(c) 條）
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
For the purposes of paragraph 80(c) of the Act, the prescribed period is 30 days.
就該法第 80(c) 段而言，規定期限為 30 天。

title: 3.08 Offence—failure to complete a passenger card
zh: 3.08 違法行為－未填寫乘客卡
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) A person who is required by these Regulations to complete a passenger card must not fail to do so.
(一)本條例規定填報旅客卡的人員不得不填報。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(2) Strict liability applies to subregulation (1).
(2) 嚴格責任適用於第 (1) 款。

title: 3.09 Evidence of identity—domestic travel on overseas vessels
zh: 3.09 身分證明－乘坐海外船舶進行國內旅行
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) In this regulation:
（一）本規定：
authorised system means an automated system that is an authorised system for the purposes of section 170 of the Act.
授權系統是指就該法案第 170 條而言屬於授權系統的自動化系統。
boarding pass means a document that permits a person to board an aircraft, given to the person by the operator of the aircraft.
登機證是指由飛機運營商向該人提供的允許某人登機的文件。
officer includes a clearance officer.
官員包括一名清關官員。
overseas vessel has the meaning given by section 165 of the Act.
海外船舶具有該法第 165 條規定的涵義。
Note: Vessel includes an aircraft: see s 5(1) of the Act.
註：船舶包括飛機：參見該法案第 5(1) 條。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 170(1)(a) of the Act, each of the following is prescribed as evidence of a person’s identity:
(2) 就該法第 170(1)(a) 條而言，以下各項均被規定為個人身分的證據：
(a) an image of the person’s face;
(a) 人臉的圖像；
(b) a passport issued to the person that is in force and bears a photograph and the full name of the person;
(b) 發給該人的有效護照，並附上該人的照片和全名；
(c) a licence to drive a motor vehicle issued to the person under a law of the Commonwealth, or a State or Territory, that is in force and bears a photograph and the full name of the person;
(c) 根據澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律向該人頒發的有效的機動車輛駕駛執照，該執照上有該人的照片和全名；
(d) a document issued to the person by:
(d) 由下列人員簽發給該人的文件：
(i) the Commonwealth or a State or Territory; or
(i) 聯邦、州或地區；或
(ii) a Commonwealth, State or Territory authority;
(ii) 聯邦、州或地區當局；
that is in force and bears a photograph and the full name of the person;
該文件有效並附有照片和該人的全名；
(e) if the person travels, or appears to intend to travel, on an overseas vessel that is an aircraft—a valid aviation security identification card (within the meaning of the Aviation Transport Security Regulations 2005 ) that:
(e) 如果該人乘坐或似乎打算乘坐海外船舶（即飛機）旅行－有效的航空安全身份證（按照 2005 年《航空運輸安全條例》的含義），該卡：
(i) was issued to the person by the operator of the aircraft or the operator of an airport in Australia; and
(i) 由飛機運營商或澳大利亞機場運營商向該人簽發；和
(ii) is in force and bears a photograph and the full name of the person.
(ii) 有效並附有照片和姓名。
(3) For the purposes of subsection 170(2) of the Act, a person who seeks to comply with paragraph 170(1)(a) of the Act by presenting an image of the person’s face must do so by presenting themselves to an authorised system.
(3) 就該法案第 170(2) 款而言，想要透過展示個人臉部圖像來遵守該法案第 170(1)(a) 款的人必須透過向授權系統展示自己來實現這一目的。
(4) If a person to whom this regulation applies is boarding or disembarking from an overseas vessel that is an aircraft, an officer may require the person to show the officer the person’s boarding pass.
(4) 若本條適用的人員正在登上或離開作為飛機的海外船舶，官員可以要求該人員出示該人員的登機證。
(5) An officer may require a person who is travelling with a person:
(5) 官員可以要求與他人同行的人：
(a) who is under 18; and
(a) 未滿 18 歲；和
(b) in respect of whom a document cannot be produced to the officer as required;
(b) 無法依要求向官員出示相關人員的文件；
to write on the boarding pass issued to the first ‑ mentioned person the full name of the second ‑ mentioned person.
在發給第一個提到的人的登機證上寫下第二個提到的人的全名。

title: 3.10 Use of information
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) With the written consent of the Minister, use may be made of information collected under this Part in respect of persons, being information that:
(1) 經部長書面同意，可以使用根據本部分收集的有關人員的信息，即：
(a) is collected from passenger cards or passports, or contained in notified data bases (or both), by an officer of any Department or authority of the Commonwealth, or of a State or Territory; and
(a) 由聯邦、州或領地的任何部門或當局的官員從乘客卡或護照中收集，或包含在通知資料庫（或兩者）中；和
(b) is concerned with any of the following matters, namely law enforcement, national security, national intelligence, education, health, community services, social welfare, employment, labour, taxation, statistics, quarantine, customs, excise.
(b) 涉及下列任何事項，即執法、國家安全、國家情報、教育、衛生、社區服務、社會福利、就業、勞工、稅務、統計、檢疫、海關、消費稅。
(2) The consent of the Minister for the use of information concerned with a matter specified in subregulation (1) may be given in respect of a particular occasion or any number of occasions.
(2) 部長同意使用與第 (1) 款規定的事項有關的資訊可以針對一個特定場合或多次場合。
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) the Commonwealth has entered into an agreement with another country in relation to the provision of information concerning international movements of air traffic and persons on international flights; and
(a) 英聯邦已與另一國家就提供有關國際空中交通和國際航班人員流動的資訊達成協議；和
(b) the Minister is satisfied that the provision to that country of the information specified in subregulation (4) would facilitate the handling of aircraft or of persons travelling to destinations outside Australia;
(b) 部長信納向該國提供第 (4) 款所規定的資訊將有助於處理飛往澳洲境外目的地的飛機或人員；
the Minister may cause that information to be provided to the immigration authorities of that country.
部長可以要求將該資訊提供給該國的移民當局。
(3A) If:
(3A) 如果：
(a) the Commonwealth has entered into an agreement with an international air carrier in relation to the provision of information concerning persons on international flights; and
(a) 英聯邦已與國際航空公司就提供國際航班上人員的資訊達成協議；和
(b) the Minister is satisfied that the provision to that international air carrier of the information specified in subregulation (4) would facilitate the handling of persons travelling to destinations outside Australia;
(b) 部長信納向該國際航空公司提供第 (4) 款所規定的資訊將有助於處理前往澳洲境外目的地的人員；
the Minister may cause that information to be provided to that international air carrier.
部長可以要求將該資訊提供給該國際航空公司。
(4) For paragraph (3)(b), in relation to a person travelling to (or to and beyond) the country mentioned in that paragraph, and for paragraph (3A)(b), in relation to a person travelling with the international air carrier mentioned in that paragraph, the following information is specified:
(4) 對於第 (3)(b) 款，對於前往（或前往或出境）該款所述國家的人員，以及對於第 (3A)(b) 款，對於搭乘該款所述國際航空承運人旅行的人員，指定以下資訊：
(a) name;
(a) 姓名；
(b) date of birth;
(b) 出生日期；
(c) citizenship;
(c) 公民身分；
(ca) sex;
(ca) 性別；
(cb) class and subclass of visa;
(cb) 簽證類別和子類別；
(cc) when the visa ceases to be in effect;
(cc) 簽證不再有效時；
(d) passport number;
(d) 護照號碼；
(e) date of departure from Australia;
(e) 離開澳洲的日期；
(f) flight number;
(f) 航班號碼；
(g) place of intended disembarkation;
(g) 預定下船地點；
(h) ultimate destination.
(h) 最終目的地。
Note: Under the Act, a visa is an Australian visa issued in accordance with the Act.
註：根據該法案，簽證是指依照該法案簽發的澳洲簽證。
(5) If the Commonwealth enters into an agreement of a kind referred to in paragraph (3)(a) or (3A)(a):
(5) 如果英聯邦簽訂第 (3)(a) 或 (3A)(a) 款所提及的協議：
(a) the Minister must, as soon as is practicable, cause notice of the fact to be published in the Gazette ; and
(a) 部長必須盡快在公報上公佈該事實；和
(b) information must not be made available under the agreement earlier than the day after the day on which the notice is published.
(b) 依協議提供的資訊不得早於通知發布之日的次日。

title: 3.10A Access to movement records
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) For subparagraph 488(2)(a)(vii) of the Act, Commonwealth, State or Territory legislation specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this subregulation is prescribed.
(1) 對於該法第 488(2)(a)(vii) 款，規定了部長在本款書面文書中指定的聯邦、州或地區立法。
Note: Under subsection 488(1) of the Act, a person must not read, examine, reproduce, use or disclose any part of the movement records. However, subparagraph 488(2)(a)(vii) of the Act permits the Minister to authorise an officer to perform 1 or more of those actions for the purposes of prescribed Commonwealth, State or Territory legislation.
注意：根據該法第 488(1) 款，任何人不得閱讀、檢查、複製、使用或揭露移動記錄的任何部分。然而，該法第 488(2)(a)(vii) 款允許部長授權一名官員為了規定的聯邦、州或領地立法的目的執行其中一項或多項行動。
(2) For paragraph 488(2)(g) of the Act:
(2) 對於該法第 488(2)(g) 段：
(a) an agency of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph is prescribed; and
(a) 部長在本款書面文書中指定的聯邦、州或地區機構；和
(b) an employee of a prescribed agency who is specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph is prescribed; and
(b) 部長在本款書面文書中指定的指定機構的僱員；和
(c) a purpose specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph is prescribed.
(c) 規定了部長在書面文件中就本款規定的目的。
Note: Under subsection 488(1) of the Act, a person must not read, examine, reproduce, use or disclose any part of the movement records. However, paragraph 488(2)(g) of the Act permits the Minister to authorise a prescribed employee of a prescribed agency of the Commonwealth, or of a State or Territory, to perform 1 or more of those actions for a prescribed purpose.
注意：根據該法第 488(1) 款，任何人不得閱讀、檢查、複製、使用或揭露移動記錄的任何部分。然而，該法第 488(2)(g) 段允許部長授權聯邦、州或領地指定機構的指定僱員為指定目的執行其中一項或多項行動。

title: 3.11 Production of deportee or removee
zh: 3.11 被驅逐者或被驅逐者的出示
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) If a person has been placed on board a vessel for the purpose of:
(1) 如果某人被安置在船上的目的是：
(a) deportation from Australia under an order made by the Minister under the Act; or
(a) 根據部長根據該法發布的命令被驅逐出澳洲；或
(b) removal from Australia;
(b) 被驅逐出澳洲；
an officer may require the master to produce the deportee or removee to the officer at any time before the vessel’s departure from its last port of call in Australia.
官員可以要求船長在船舶離開澳洲最後一個停靠港之前隨時向官員出示被驅逐者或被驅逐者。
(2) The master must not fail to comply with a requirement under subregulation (1).
(2) 船長不得不遵守第(1)款的要求。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(3) Subregulation (2) does not apply if the master has a reasonable excuse.
(3) 若船長有合理的理由，則第(2)款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subregulation (3) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（3）款的事項負舉證責任（見《刑法》第13.3（3）款）。

title: 3.12 Offences by master of vessel
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
The master of a vessel must not:
船長不得：
(a) refuse or neglect to afford all reasonable facilities to an officer for the performance of the officer’s duties; or
(a) 拒絕或忽視提供官員其履行職責所需的一切合理便利；或
(b) deliver to an officer, under these Regulations, a list or statement that is incorrect in a material particular.
(b) 根據本條例，向官員提供在重要細節上不正確的清單或陳述。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。

title: Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
zh: 第 3.2 分部 — 海外船舶乘客及船員的資料
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels

title: 3.13 Interpretation
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
In this Division:
在本部門：
civilian vessel means a vessel other than a vessel of the regular armed forces of a Government recognised by Australia.
民用船隻是指澳洲承認的政府正規武裝部隊船隻以外的船隻。
international cargo ship :
國際貨船：
(a) means a civilian vessel that:
(a) 指民用船舶：
(i) has a gross tonnage of at least 500 tons; and
(i) 總噸位至少 500 噸；和
(ii) either:
(ii) 任一：
(A) is used wholly or principally to provide sea transportation of cargo; or
(A) 全部或主要用於提供海上貨物運輸；或
(B) is used to provide services to ships or shipping; and
(B) 用於向船舶或航運提供服務；和
(b) does not include any of the following:
(b) 不包括下列任何一項：
(i) an international passenger cruise ship;
(i) 國際客運遊輪；
(ii) a fishing vessel;
(ii) 漁船；
(iii) a fishing support vessel;
(iii) 漁業支援船；
(iv) a pleasure craft.
(iv) 遊艇。
international passenger aircraft means an aircraft that is being used to provide a regular international passenger air service or an international passenger charter air service.
國際客機是指用於提供定期國際客運航空服務或國際客運包機服務的飛機。
international passenger charter air service means a service of providing air transportation of persons:
國際客運包機服務是指提供以下人員航空運輸的服務：
(a) from:
(一) 來自：
(i) a place outside Australia to a place in Australia; or
(i) 澳洲境外地點至澳洲境內地點；或
(ii) a place in Australia to a place outside Australia; and
(ii) 澳洲境內的某個地點至澳洲境外的某個地點；和
(b) that is provided:
(b) 規定：
(i) by an airline operator that provides a regular international passenger air service; and
(i) 由提供定期國際客運航空服務的航空公司營運商提供；和
(ii) in return for a fee payable by persons using the service; and
(ii) 作為使用該服務的人應支付的費用的回報；和
(c) that is not conducted in accordance with an international airline licence granted under Part 3 of the Air Navigation Regulations 2026 .
(c) 未依照《2026 年空中航行條例》第 3 部分所授予的國際航空公司許可證進行。
international passenger cruise ship means a ship that:
國際客運遊輪是指符合以下條件的船舶：
(a) has sleeping facilities for at least 100 persons (other than crew members); and
(a) 擁有至少可容納 100 人（機組人員除外）的睡眠設施；和
(b) is being used to provide an international passenger sea transportation service.
(b) 用於提供國際客運海上運輸服務。
international passenger sea transportation service means a service of providing sea transportation of persons:
國際海上客運服務是指提供以下人員海上運輸的服務：
(a) from:
(一) 來自：
(i) a place outside Australia to a place in Australia; or
(i) 澳洲境外地點至澳洲境內地點；或
(ii) a place in Australia to a place outside Australia; and
(ii) 澳洲境內的某個地點至澳洲境外的某個地點；和
(b) that is provided in return for a fee payable by persons using the service; and
(b) 提供該服務是為了換取使用該服務的人所支付的費用；和
(c) that is available to the general public.
(c) 可供公眾使用。
master includes owner, charterer, and agent in Australia.
船長包括澳洲的船東、承租人、代理人。
regular international passenger air service means a service of providing air transportation of persons:
定期國際客運航空服務是指提供以下人員航空運輸的服務：
(a) from:
(一) 來自：
(i) a place outside Australia to a place in Australia; or
(i) 澳洲境外地點至澳洲境內地點；或
(ii) a place in Australia to a place outside Australia; and
(ii) 澳洲境內的某個地點至澳洲境外的某個地點；和
(b) that is provided in return for a fee payable by persons using the service; and
(b) 提供該服務是為了換取使用該服務的人所支付的費用；和
(c) that is conducted in accordance with:
(c) 依下列規定進行：
(i) an international airline licence granted under Part 3 of the Air Navigation Regulations 2026 ; and
(i) 根據《2026 年空中航行條例》第 3 部分授予的國際航空公司許可證；和
(ii) fixed schedules from fixed airports outside Australia over specific routes to fixed airports in Australia; and
(ii) 從澳洲境外固定機場經特定航線前往澳洲境內固定機場的固定時刻表；和
(d) that is available to the general public on a regular basis.
(d) 定期對外開放。
Note: Vessel includes an aircraft: see the Act, s 5(1).
註：船舶包括飛機：參見該法案第 5(1) 條。

title: 3.13A Information about passengers and crew to be given before arrival and departure of certain aircraft and ships
zh: 3.13A 在某些飛機和船舶抵達和離開之前提供有關乘客和機組人員的信息
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
For the definition of kind of aircraft or ship to which this Division applies in subsection 245I(1) of the Act, the following kinds of aircraft or ship are a kind of aircraft or ship to which Division 12B of the Act applies:
對於該法第 245I(1) 小節中適用本節的飛機或船舶種類的定義，以下飛機或船舶種類是該法第 12B 節適用的飛機或船舶種類：
(a) an international passenger aircraft;
(a) 國際客機；
(b) an international passenger cruise ship;
(b) 國際客運遊輪；
(c) an international cargo ship.
(c) 國際貨船。
Note: Division 12B of the Act deals with the reporting of persons due to arrive at, or depart from, a place in Australia.
註：該法案第 12B 部分涉及對抵達或離開澳洲某個地點的人員進行報告。

title: 3.13B Obligation to report on persons arriving on ships—reporting periods for journey from last port outside Australia
zh: 3.13B 報告登船人員的義務－從澳洲境外最後一個港口出發的旅程報告期
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
(1) For paragraph 245L(5)(a) of the Act, the prescribed period is 96 hours.
(1) 對於該法第 245L(5)(a) 段，規定期限為 96 小時。
(2) For paragraph 245L(5)(b) of the Act, the period mentioned in an item in the following table is specified for a journey of the kind mentioned in the item.
(2) 對於該法第 245L(5)(b) 段，下表中的一項中提到的期限是針對該項中提到的此類旅程指定的。
Reporting periods for certain journeys
Item | Likely duration of ship’s journey | Specified period
1 | 72 hours or more but less than 96 hours | 72 hours
2 | 48 hours or more but less than 72 hours | 48 hours
3 | 24 hours or more but less than 48 hours | 24 hours
4 | Less than 24 hours | 12 hours
某些旅程的報告期
項目 |船舶航行的可能持續時間|指定期間
1 | 72 小時以上但 96 小時以下 | 72小時
2 | 48小時以上且72小時以下| 48小時
3 | 24小時以上48小時以下 | 24小時
4 |不到24小時| 12小時

title: 3.13C Report on departing person to relate to flight or voyage from the last place in Australia to a place outside Australia
zh: 3.13C 離境人員報告，涉及從澳洲最後地點到澳洲境外地點的航班或航程
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
For paragraph 245LA(3)(b) of the Act, a report under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act must only relate to the part of a flight or voyage that is from the last place in Australia to a place outside Australia.
對於該法案第 245LA(3)(b) 段，根據該法案第 245LA(2) 小節提出的報告必須僅涉及從澳洲最後地點到澳洲境外地點的航班或航程部分。

title: 3.13D Obligation to report on persons departing from Australia—deadline for providing report
zh: 3.13D 報告離開澳洲的人員的義務－提供報告的截止日期
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
Deadline for reporting on persons departing on an international passenger aircraft
報告國際客機出發人員的截止日期
(1) For subsection 245LA(5) of the Act, a report under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act on a passenger or crew member who is on, or is expected to be on, a flight to be undertaken by an international passenger aircraft must be provided:
(1) 對於該法第 245LA(5) 款，必須根據該法第 245LA(2) 款提供關於乘坐或預計乘坐國際客機航班的乘客或機組人員的報告：
(a) before the passenger or crew member is required to present evidence of his or her identity to a clearance authority in relation to his or her departure; or
(a) 在乘客或機組人員被要求向清關機構出示與其離境有關的身份證明之前；或
(b) if a report on the passenger or crew member has been made under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act and after the report was made the passenger or crew member changes his or her departing flight—before the passenger or crew member boards the departing flight; or
(b) 如果已根據該法第 245LA(2) 款對乘客或機組人員進行了報告，並且在做出報告後，乘客或機組人員更改了其離港航班－在乘客或機組人員登上離港航班之前；或
(c) for a passenger or crew member transiting through Australia without being immigration cleared and for whom a report under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act has not been made in relation to the person’s departure from Australia—before the passenger or crew member boards the departing flight.
(c) 對於未經出入境許可而過境澳洲的乘客或機組人員，並且在乘客或機組人員登上出發航班之前，尚未根據該法第 245LA(2) 款就其離開澳洲作出報告。
Deadline for reporting on persons departing on an international passenger cruise ship
報告國際客輪出發人員的截止日期
(2) For subsection 245LA(5) of the Act, a report under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act on a passenger or crew member who is on, or is expected to be on, a voyage to be undertaken by an international passenger cruise ship must be provided before the ship departs a place in Australia for a place outside Australia.
(2) 對於該法第 245LA(5) 款，在該船離開澳大利亞境內前往澳大利亞境外某地之前，必鬚根據該法第 245LA(2) 款提供關於國際客輪正在或預計將進行的航程中的乘客或船員的報告。
Deadline for reporting on persons departing on an international cargo ship
報告國際貨船出發人員的截止日期
(3) For subsection 245LA(5) of the Act, a report under subsection 245LA(2) of the Act on a passenger or crew member who is on, or is expected to be on, a voyage to be undertaken by an international cargo ship must be provided before the ship departs a place in Australia for a place outside Australia.
(3) 對於該法案第 245LA(5) 款，必須在船舶離開澳洲境內前往澳洲境外地點之前，根據該法案第 245LA(2) 款，提供關於國際貨船正在或預計將進行的航程的乘客或船員的報告。

title: 3.14 Information about overseas passengers to be given on arrival of inbound civilian vessel
zh: 3.14 入境民用船舶抵港時應提供的境外旅客資訊
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a civilian vessel arrives at a port in Australia (in this regulation called the relevant port ); and
(a) 民用船舶抵達澳洲港口（本條例稱為相關港口）；和
(b) the vessel carries overseas passengers;
(b) 船舶載有海外乘客；
the master must, on the request of an officer, give the officer, to the best of the master’s knowledge and belief, the particulars set out in subregulation (2), (3) or (4), as the case requires.
船長必須應高級人員的要求，按照船長所知及所信，向該高級人員提供第(2)、(3)或(4)款所列的詳情(視情況需要而定)。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(1A) If the officer requests the particulars be given in a particular way, the master must give the particulars in that way.
(1A) 如果高級船員要求以特定方式提供詳細信息，則船長必須以該方式提供詳細信息。
(2) If the last port entered by the vessel before its arrival at the relevant port was outside Australia, the particulars are:
(2) 若船舶抵達相關港口之前最後進入的港口是澳洲境外，詳情如下：
(a) each passenger’s full name; and
(a) 每位乘客的全名；和
(b) each passenger’s date of birth; and
(b) 每位乘客的出生日期；和
(c) the country of issue and number of each passenger’s passport; and
(c) 每位旅客護照的簽發國和號碼；和
(d) the citizenship of each passenger; and
(d) 每位乘客的公民身分；和
(e) the intended address in Australia (if any) of each passenger; and
(e) 每位乘客在澳洲的預定地址（如有）；和
(f) the place in Australia (if any) at which each passenger’s journey in the vessel ends.
(f) 每位乘客在船上的旅程結束的澳洲地點（如有）。
(3) If there are overseas passengers on the vessel whose journey is to end at the relevant port, the particulars in respect of each of those passengers are:
(3) 如果船上有境外乘客且其旅程將在有關港口結束，則該等乘客的詳細資訊如下：
(a) his or her full name; and
(a) 他或她的全名；和
(b) his or her date of birth; and
(b) 他或她的出生日期；和
(c) the country of issue and number of his or her passport; and
(c) 護照的簽發國和號碼；和
(d) his or her citizenship; and
(d) 他或她的公民身分；和
(e) his or her intended address in Australia.
(e) 他或她在澳洲的預定地址。
(4) If:
(4) 如果：
(a) there are passengers on the vessel who:
(a) 船上有乘客：
(i) were on board the vessel when it left a place outside Australia; and
(i) 當船舶離開澳洲境外時在船上；和
(ii) intend to travel in the vessel beyond Australia; and
(ii) 打算搭船前往澳洲境外；和
(b) the master has not previously been asked by an officer to give particulars of those passengers;
(b) 先前沒有官員要求船長提供這些乘客的詳細資料；
the particulars of each of those passengers are:
每位乘客的詳細資訊如下：
(c) his or her full name; and
(c) 他或她的全名；和
(d) his or her date of birth; and
(d) 他或她的出生日期；和
(e) the country of issue and number of his or her passport; and
(e) 護照的簽發國和號碼；和
(f) his or her citizenship.
(f) 他或她的公民身分。
(5) The master must, if asked to do so by an officer, give the officer a specified number (not exceeding 6) of copies of a document containing particulars given under this regulation.
(5) 若高級船員提出要求，船長必須向該高級船員提供規定數量（不超過 6 份）的載有根據本條提供的詳情的文件副本。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。

title: 3.15 Medical certificate
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
(1) If particulars are given to an officer under subregulation 3.14(2), the medical officer of the vessel must also give the officer a certificate signed by him or her that certifies that, in his or her opinion:
(1) 如果根據第 3.14(2) 款向高級官員提供詳細信息，船舶醫務官員還必須向該高級官員提供一份由他或她簽署的證書，證明他或她認為：
(a) no passenger on the vessel; or
(a) 船上沒有乘客；或
(b) no passenger on the vessel other than a passenger named in the certificate;
(b) 除證書上指定的乘客外，船上沒有其他乘客；
is suffering from:
正在遭受：
(c) tuberculosis; or
(c) 結核病；或
(d) a disease or condition that is, or may result in the applicant being, a threat to public health in Australia or a danger to the Australian community; or
(d) 患有或可能導致申請人對澳洲公共衛生構成威脅或對澳洲社區構成危險的疾病或病症；或
(e) a disease or condition that, during the person’s proposed period of stay in Australia, would be likely to:
(e) 在該人擬在澳洲期間，患有以下疾病或病症：
(i) result in a significant cost to the Australian community in the areas of health care or community services; or
(i) 在醫療保健或社區服務領域為澳洲社區帶來巨大成本；或
(ii) prejudice the access of an Australian citizen or permanent resident to health care or community services.
(ii) 妨礙澳洲公民或永久居民獲得醫療保健或社區服務。
(2) If a passenger is named in the certificate as suffering from a disease or condition referred to in paragraph (1)(c), (d) or (e), the certificate must also set out the disease or condition from which the passenger is suffering.
(2) 若證書中註明乘客患有第 (1)(c)、(d) 或 (e) 款所述的疾病或病症，則證書也必須列明該乘客所患的疾病或病症。
(3) If a vessel has no medical officer, the certificate must be signed and given by the master to the best of his or her knowledge and belief.
(3) 若船舶沒有醫護人員，證書必須由船長據其所知和所信簽署並簽發。
(4) The master must, if asked to do so by the officer, give the officer a specified number (not exceeding 6) of copies of the certificate.
(4) 若高級船員提出要求，船長必須向高級船員提供指定數量（不超過 6 份）的證書副本。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。

title: 3.16 Information about overseas passengers—outbound civilian vessel
zh: 3.16 境外旅客資訊－出境民用船舶
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a civilian vessel leaves a port in Australia on an overseas voyage or an overseas flight; and
(a) 民用船舶離開澳洲港口進行海外航行或海外航班；和
(b) the vessel carries overseas passengers:
(b) 船舶載有海外乘客：
(i) who were on board the vessel when it left a place outside Australia, and who intend to travel in the vessel beyond Australia; or
(i) 當船隻離開澳洲境外時，誰在船上，以及打算搭乘該船前往澳洲境外的人；或
(ii) who joined the vessel at that port;
(ii) 在該港口上船；
the master of the vessel must give an officer a list setting out, to the best of the master’s knowledge and belief, the following particulars of each of those passengers:
船長必須向高級船員提供一份名單，據船長所知和所信，列出每位乘客的以下詳細資訊：
(c) his or her full name;
(c) 他或她的全名；
(d) his or her date of birth;
(d) 他或她的出生日期；
(e) the country of issue and number of his or her passport;
(e) 護照的簽發國和號碼；
(f) his or her citizenship;
(f) 他或她的公民身分；
(g) the place where his or her journey in the vessel ends.
(g) 他或她在船上的旅程結束的地方。
(2) The master must, if asked to do so by an officer, give the officer a specified number (not exceeding 6) of copies of a document containing particulars given under this regulation.
(2) 若高級船員提出要求，船長必須向該高級船員提供規定數量（不超過 6 份）的載有根據本條提供的詳情的文件副本。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。

title: 3.17 Information about crew
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
Division 3.2 — Information about passengers and crew on overseas vessels
text:
Members of crew
船員
(1) The master of a civilian vessel that enters Australia must, at any port of call in Australia, if so requested by an officer:
(1) 進入澳洲的民用船舶的船長必須在澳洲的任何停靠港，如果官員提出要求：
(a) notify the officer of the number of members of the crew and give the officer the following particulars in respect of each member of the crew:
(a) 將船員人數通知高級官員，並向高級官員提供每位船員的以下詳細資訊：
(i) his or her full name;
(i) 他或她的全名；
(ii) his or her date of birth;
(ii) 他或她的出生日期；
(iii) his or her citizenship;
(iii) 他或她的公民身分；
(iv) the country of issue and number of his or her passport; and
(iv) 護照的簽發國和號碼；和
(b) if the vessel is a ship, produce to the officer the ship’s articles.
(b) 若該船舶是一艘船舶，則向高級船員出示船上的物品。
(1A) If the officer requests the particulars be given in a particular way, the master must give the particulars in that way.
(1A) 如果高級船員要求以特定方式提供詳細信息，則船長必須以該方式提供詳細信息。
Persons other than passengers and crew for discharge outside Australia
除乘客和機組人員外需在澳洲境外卸貨的人員
(2) The master of a civilian vessel that is a ship must, at the first port of call in Australia of the ship, give an officer particulars of the name and citizenship of every person on board other than:
(2) 民用船舶的船長必須在船舶在澳大利亞的第一個停靠港向高級船員提供船上每個人的姓名和公民身份的詳細信息，但以下人員除外：
(a) a passenger; or
(a) 乘客；或
(b) a member of the crew whose name appears on the ship’s articles as a member of the crew for discharge at a port outside Australia.
(b) 姓名作為在澳洲境外港口卸貨的船員姓名出現在船舶物品上的船員。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(3) If the officer requests the particulars be given in a particular way, the master must give the particulars in that way.
(3) 如果高級船員要求以特定方式提供詳細信息，則船長必須以該方式提供詳細信息。

title: Division 3.3 — Examination, search and detention
zh: 第 3.3 分部 — 檢查、搜查及拘留
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information

title: 3.19 Periods within which evidence to be shown to officer
zh: 3.19 向官員提出證據的期限
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
For subsections 188(2) and (3) of the Act, the periods are:
對於該法第 188(2) 及 (3) 款，期限為：
(a) if the requirement is oral—5 minutes; or
(a) 若要求是口頭的－5分鐘；或

(b) 如果要求是書面的－48 小時。

title: 3.20 Information to be provided—authorised officers carrying out identification tests
zh: 3.20 需提供的資訊－授權人員進行身分識別測試
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) For subsection 258B(1) of the Act, the matters are:
(1) 對於該法第 258B(1) 款，事項如下：
(a) the reason why a personal identifier is required to be provided; and
(a) 需要提供個人識別資訊的原因；和
(b) how a personal identifier may be collected; and
(b) 如何收集個人識別資訊；和
(c) how any personal identifier that is collected may be used; and
(c) 如何使用所收集的任何個人識別碼；和
(d) the circumstances in which a personal identifier may be disclosed to a third party; and
(d) 可能向第三方揭露個人識別資訊的情況；和
(e) notification that a personal identifier may be produced in evidence in a court or tribunal in relation to the person who provided the personal identifier; and
(e) 關於可以在法庭或法庭上出示個人識別碼作為與提供個人識別碼的人有關的證據的通知；和
(f) notification that the Privacy Act 1988 applies to a personal identifier, and that the person has a right to make a complaint to the Australian Information Commissioner about the handling of personal information; and
(f) 通知《1988 年隱私權法》適用於個人識別符，該人有權就個人資訊的處理向澳洲資訊專員提出投訴；和
(g) notification that the Freedom of Information Act 1982 gives a person access to certain information and documents in the possession of the Government of the Commonwealth and of its agencies, and that the person has a right under that Act to seek access to that information or those documents under that Act, and to seek amendment of records containing personal information that is incomplete, incorrect, out of date or misleading; and
(g) 通知，《1982 年資訊自由法》允許個人獲取聯邦政府及其機構擁有的某些資訊和文件，並且該個人有權根據該法尋求獲取該資訊或該法規定的那些文件，並尋求修改包含不完整、不正確、過時或誤導性個人資訊的記錄；和
(h) if the person is a minor or incapable person—information concerning how a personal identifier is to be obtained from a minor or incapable person.
(h) 若該人是未成年或無行為能力人－有關如何從未成年人或無行為能力人處取得個人識別資訊的資訊。
(2) For subsection 258B(3) of the Act, if a form is to be given to a person, it must be given to the person at a time that gives the person enough time to read and understand the form before the identification test is conducted.
(2) 對於該法案第 258B(3) 款，如果要向某人提供表格，則必須在進行身份識別測試之前給予該人足夠的時間閱讀和理解該表格。

title: 3.21 Procedure and requirements—identification test not carried out
zh: 3.21 程序與要求－未進行鑑定試驗
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) For subsection 258D(2) of the Act, subregulation (2) prescribes the procedures and requirements that apply if:
(1) 對於該法第 258D(2) 款，第 (2) 款規定了以下情況下適用的程序和要求：
(a) a person has applied for a visa; and
(a) 某人已申請簽證；和
(b) at the time of making the application the person is outside Australia; and
(b) 提出申請時，該人在澳洲境外；和
(c) the person is required to provide a personal identifier under section 257A of the Act otherwise than by way of an identification test, in relation to the application.
(c) 根據該法案第 257A 條，該人必須提供與申請相關的個人身份識別信息，而不是通過身份測試的方式。
(2) For subregulation (1), the person must be informed of the following matters:
(2) 對於第 (1) 款，必須告知該人以下事項：
(a) the reason why a personal identifier is required to be provided;
(a) 需要提供個人識別資訊的原因；
(b) how a personal identifier may be collected;
(b) 如何收集個人識別資料；
(c) how any personal identifier that is collected may be used;
(c) 如何使用所收集的任何個人識別碼；
(d) the circumstances in which a personal identifier may be disclosed to a third party;
(d) 可能向第三方揭露個人識別資料的情況；
(e) that a personal identifier may be produced in evidence in a court or tribunal in relation to the person;
(e) 個人身分識別資料可在法庭或法庭上出示作為與該人有關的證據；
(f) that the Privacy Act 1988 applies to a personal identifier, and that the person has a right to make a complaint to the Australian Information Commissioner about the handling of personal information;
(f) 《1988 年隱私權法》適用於個人識別符，該人有權就個人資訊的處理向澳洲資訊專員提出投訴；
(g) that the Freedom of Information Act 1982 gives a person access to certain information and documents in the possession of the Government of the Commonwealth and its agencies, and that the person has a right under that Act to seek access to that information or those documents under that Act, and to seek amendment of records containing personal information that is incomplete, incorrect, out of date or misleading.
(g) 1982 年《資訊自由法》允許個人取得聯邦政府及其機構擁有的某些資訊和文件，且該個人有權根據該法尋求取得該資訊或該法規定的文件，並尋求修改包含不完整、不正確、過時或誤導性個人資訊的記錄。
(3) The person may be informed of the matters in writing or orally.
(3) 可以書面或口頭告知本人。
(4) The manner in which the person is informed of the matters need not involve an officer or authorised officer informing the person of the matters.
(4) 向該人通報該事項的方式不需要由官員或授權官員向該人通報該事項。

title: Division 3.4 — Identification of immigration detainees
