path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information

title: 3.30 Immigration detainees must provide personal identifiers
zh: 3.30 移民被拘留者必須提供個人識別資訊
path: Part 3 — Immigration clearance and collection of information
text:
(1) For subsection 261AA(1) of the Act, a circumstance is that the non ‑ citizen is in the company of, and restrained by:
(1) 對於該法第 261AA(1) 款，一種情況是該非公民與下列人員在一起並受到下列人員的限制：
(a) an officer; or
(a) 一名官員；或者
(b) in the case of a particular non ‑ citizen—another person directed by the Secretary to accompany and restrain the non ‑ citizen.
(b) 若是特定非公民－由部長指示陪同並約束該非公民的另一人。
(2) For subsection 261AA(1) of the Act, a circumstance is that each of the following applies:
(2) 對於該法案第 261AA(1) 款，以下情況均適用：
(a) immediately before being detained in immigration detention, the non ‑ citizen was detained under:
(a) 在被拘留在移民拘留所之前，該非公民是根據以下情況被拘留的：
(i) the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 ;
(i) 1999 年環境保護與生物多樣性保護法；
(ii) the Fisheries Management Act 1991 ;
(ii) 1991 年漁業管理法；
(iii) the Torres Strait Fisheries Act 1984 ;
(iii) 1984 年托雷斯海峽漁業法；
(b) the non ‑ citizen has provided a personal identifier or personal identifiers in accordance with the relevant Act in subparagraph (a)(i), (ii) or (iii).
(b) 非公民已根據第(a)(i)、(ii)或(iii)項中的相關法案提供了一個或多個個人識別碼。
(3) Subregulation (2) applies to the provision of a personal identifier only if:
(3) 第 (2) 款僅在下列情況下適用於提供個人識別碼：
(a) an authorised officer is satisfied that the personal identifier that has been provided is usable for a particular purpose set out in subsection 5A(3) of the Act; and
(a) 授權官員確信所提供的個人識別碼可用於該法案第 5A(3) 款規定的特定目的；和
(b) the authorised officer is satisfied about the integrity of the personal identifier; and
(b) 授權官員對個人識別碼的完整性感到滿意；和
(c) the authorised officer is satisfied that no further personal identifiers need to be collected from the non ‑ citizen to satisfy the purpose.
(c) 授權官員確信不需要從非公民收集更多的個人識別資訊來滿足該目的。
(4) For paragraph 261AA(1A)(e) of the Act, an iris scan is prescribed.
(4) 該法案第 261AA(1A)(e) 段規定了虹膜掃描。
Note: Under subsection 261AA(1) of the Act, a non ‑ citizen who is in immigration detention must (other than in the prescribed circumstances) provide to an authorised officer one or more personal identifiers. Personal identifiers are mentioned in subsection 261AA(1A) of the Act, and include any prescribed personal identifiers.
註：根據該法第 261AA(1) 款，被移民拘留的非公民必須（規定情況除外）向授權官員提供一個或多個個人識別資訊。該法案第 261AA(1A) 款提到了個人標識符，包括任何規定的個人識別符。

title: 4.02 Reviewable migration decisions and who may apply for review

path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1A) For paragraph 338(2)(d) of the Act, the following visas are prescribed:
(1A) 該法第 338(2)(d) 條規定了以下簽證：
(a) a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa;
(a) 401 子類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證；
(aa) a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa;
(aa) 402 子類（培訓和研究）簽證；
(b) a Subclass 407 (Training) visa;
(b) 407 類（培訓）簽證；
(c) a Subclass 416 (Special Program) visa;
(c) 416 子類（特殊項目）簽證；
(e) a Subclass 420 (Entertainment) visa;
(e) 420 子類（娛樂）簽證；
(k) a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa;
(k) 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；
(ka) a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa;
(ka) 482 子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；
(kb) a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa;
(kb) 482 子類別（需求技能）簽證；
(l) a Subclass 488 (Superyacht Crew) visa;
(l) 488 子類（超級遊艇船員）簽證；
(la) a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa;
(la) 494 子類（技術雇主擔保地區（臨時））簽證；
(m) a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa.
(m) 870 子類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證。
(4) For subsection 338(9) of the Act, each of the following decisions is a reviewable migration decision:
(4) 對於該法第 338(9) 款，以下每項決定都是可審查的移民決定：
(a) a decision under subsection 140E(1) or (1A) of the Act to refuse a person’s application for approval as a work sponsor or family sponsor in relation to a class of sponsor;
(a) 根據該法第 140E(1) 或 (1A) 款所做的決定，拒絕某人作為某類擔保人的工作擔保人或家庭擔保人的批准申請；
(d) a decision under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act to refuse to approve a nomination;
(d) 根據該法第 140GB(2) 條做出拒絕批准提名的決定；
(e) a decision under regulation 5.19 to refuse an application for approval of the nomination of a position;
(e) 依第 5.19 條作出拒絕核准職位提名申請的決定；
(f) a decision that:
(f) 一項決定：
(i) relates to requiring a security; and
(i) 涉及要求擔保；和
(ii) relates to the refusal to grant a visa, being a visa for which the Minister is to have regard to a criterion to the effect that if an authorised officer has required a security for compliance with any conditions that the officer has indicated to the applicant will be imposed on the visa if it is granted, the security has been lodged;
(ii) 與拒絕簽發簽證有關，對於該簽證，部長應考慮一項標準，即如果授權官員要求提供擔保，以符合該官員向申請人表明的任何條件，如果獲得批准，將對簽證施加擔保；
(h) a decision under section 140M of the Act to take one or more actions to cancel an approved sponsor’s approval or to bar an approved sponsor;
(h) 根據該法第 140M 條決定採取一項或多項行動取消已核准的保薦人的核准或禁止核准的保薦人；
(j) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 173 (Contributory Parent (Temporary)) visa to a contributory parent newborn child;
(j) 拒絕向繳費父母新生兒發放 173 類（繳費父母（臨時））簽證的決定；
(k) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 884 (Contributory Aged Parent (Temporary)) visa to a contributory parent newborn child;
(k) 拒絕向繳費父母新生兒發放 884 類（繳費老年父母（臨時））簽證的決定；
(l) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa, a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa to a non ‑ citizen who is outside Australia at the time of application if:
(l) 決定拒絕向申請時在澳洲境外的非公民發放 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（急需技能）簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 494 類（技術雇主擔保的地區（臨時））簽證，如果：
(i) the non ‑ citizen is, at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made, identified in an approved nomination that has not ceased under regulation 2.75 or 2.75B and the nominator was, at the time the nomination was approved, a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA); or
(i) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，該非公民是在根據第2.75或2.75B條尚未終止的批准提名中確定的，並且提名人在提名獲得批准時是第(4AA)款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(ii) a review of a decision under section 140E of the Act not to approve the proposed work sponsor of the non ‑ citizen is pending at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made and the proposed work sponsor was, at the time the decision under section 140E was made, a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA); or
(ii) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，對根據該法第140E條不批准該非公民的擬議工作擔保人的決定進行審查，並且在根據第140E條做出決定時，擬議的工作擔保人是第(4AA)款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(iii) a review of a decision under section 140GB of the Act not to approve the nomination of the non ‑ citizen is pending at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made and the nominator was, at the time the decision under section 140GB was made, a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA); or
(iii) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，對根據該法第 140GB 條不批准非公民提名的決定的審查仍在進行中，並且在根據第 140GB 條做出決定時，提名人是第 (4AA) 款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(iv) the non ‑ citizen did not seek to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of the visa, and the grant of the visa was refused because the non ‑ citizen did not satisfy the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa;
(iv) 該非公民沒有尋求滿足授予簽證的主要標準，並且由於該非公民沒有滿足授予簽證的次要標準而拒絕授予簽證；
(la) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 489 (Skilled—Regional (Provisional)) visa or a Subclass 491 (Skilled Work Regional (Provisional)) visa to a non ‑ citizen if:
(la) 決定拒絕向非公民發放 489 類（地區技術（臨時））簽證或 491 類（地區技術（臨時））簽證，如果：
(i) the non ‑ citizen is outside Australia at the time of application; and
(i) 非公民在申請時不在澳洲；和
(ii) the non ‑ citizen was sponsored or nominated, as required by a criterion for the grant of the visa, by a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA);
(ii) 該非公民是根據授予簽證標準的要求，由第(4AA)款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業擔保或提名的；
(m) a decision under subregulation 1.20AA(2) to refuse to approve a person or an organisation as a sponsor of a temporary visa applicant;
(m) 根據第 1.20AA(2) 款拒絕批准個人或組織作為臨時簽證申請人擔保人的決定；
(n) a decision under subsection 140GA(2) of the Act not to vary a term specified in an approval;
(n) 根據該法第 140GA(2) 款做出的不改變批准中指定條款的決定；
(o) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 407 (Training) visa to a non ‑ citizen who is outside Australia at the time of application if:
(o) 決定拒絕向申請時在澳洲境外的非公民發放 407 類（培訓）簽證，如果：
(i) the non ‑ citizen is, at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made, identified in an approved nomination that has not ceased under regulation 2.75A and the nominator was, at the time the nomination was approved, a person, body, company or partnership referred to subregulation (4AA); or
(i) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，該非公民是在根據第2.75A條尚未終止的已批准提名中確定的，並且提名人在提名獲得批准時是第(4AA)款所指的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(ii) a review of a decision under section 140E of the Act not to approve the proposed sponsor of the non ‑ citizen is pending at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made and the proposed sponsor was, at the time the decision under section 140E was made, a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA); or
(ii) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，對根據該法第140E條不批准該非公民的擬議擔保人的決定的審查仍在進行中，並且在根據第140E條做出決定時，擬議的擔保人是第(4AA)款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(iii) a review of a decision under section 140GB of the Act not to approve the nomination of the non ‑ citizen is pending at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made and the nominator was, at the time the decision under section 140GB was made, a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA); or
(iii) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，對根據該法第 140GB 條不批准非公民提名的決定的審查仍在進行中，並且在根據第 140GB 條做出決定時，提名人是第 (4AA) 款中提到的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業；或
(iv) the non ‑ citizen did not seek to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of the visa, and the grant of the visa was refused because the non ‑ citizen did not satisfy the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa; or
(iv) 該非公民沒有尋求滿足授予簽證的主要標準，並且由於該非公民沒有滿足授予簽證的次要標準而拒絕授予簽證；或
(v) except if it is a criterion for the grant of the visa that the non ‑ citizen is identified in an approved nomination that has not ceased under regulation 2.75A—the non ‑ citizen is, at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made, sponsored by an approved work sponsor and that sponsor is, at that time, a Commonwealth agency;
(v) 除非授予簽證的標準是在根據第2.75A條未停止的批准提名中確定非公民－在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時，非公民是由批准的工作擔保人擔保的，並且該擔保人當時是聯邦機構；
(p) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 408 (Temporary Activity) visa to a non ‑ citizen, if:
(p) 拒絕向非公民發放 408 類（臨時活動）簽證的決定，如果：
(i) the non ‑ citizen was outside Australia at the time of application; and
(i) 非公民在申請時不在澳洲；和
(ii) the non ‑ citizen was sponsored, as referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition of passes the sponsorship test in clause 408.111 of Schedule 2, by a person, body, company or partnership referred to in subregulation (4AA);
(ii) 如附表2第408.111條中通過擔保測試的定義(a)段所述，該非公民由第(4AA)款中提及的個人、團體、公司或合夥企業擔保；
(q) a decision to refuse to grant a visa prescribed under subregulation (1A) to a non ‑ citizen if:
(q) 拒絕向非公民發放第(1A)款規定的簽證的決定，如果：
(i) the non ‑ citizen did not seek to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of the visa, and the grant of the visa was refused because the non ‑ citizen did not satisfy the secondary criteria for the visa; and
(i) 該非公民沒有尋求滿足授予簽證的主要標準，並且由於該非公民沒有滿足簽證的次要標準而拒絕授予簽證；和
(ii) the requirements of paragraphs 338(2)(a) to (c) of the Act are met in relation to the non ‑ citizen and the visa;
(ii) 非公民和簽證符合該法第 338(2)(a) 至 (c) 段的要求；
(r) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 870 (Sponsored Parent (Temporary)) visa to a non ‑ citizen if the non ‑ citizen:
(r) 決定拒絕授予非公民 870 類（擔保父母（臨時））簽證，如果該非公民：
(i) is outside Australia at the time of application; and
(i) 申請時位於澳洲境外；和
(ii) is sponsored by a parent sponsor at the time the decision to refuse to grant the visa is made;
(ii) 在做出拒絕授予簽證的決定時由父母擔保人擔保；
(s) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 300 (Prospective Marriage) visa;
(s) 拒絕授予 300 類（未來婚姻）簽證的決定；
(saa) a decision to refuse to grant a Subclass 309 (Partner (Provisional)) visa;
(saa) 拒絕授予 309 類（伴侶（臨時））簽證的決定；
(sa) a decision made after the commencement of this paragraph to refuse to grant a Subclass 445 (Dependent Child) visa if the visa was applied for by an applicant who was outside Australia when the application was made;
(sa) 在本款生效後所做的決定，如果申請人在提出申請時不在澳洲境外申請 445 子類（受扶養子女）簽證，則拒絕授予該簽證；
(t) a decision made after 23 March 2021 to refuse to grant a Subclass 173 (Contributory Parent (Temporary)) visa to a non ‑ citizen (other than a contributory parent newborn child) if:
(t) 2021年3月23日後所做的決定，拒絕向非公民（繳費父母新生兒除外）發放173子類（繳費父母（臨時））簽證，如果：
(i) the application for the visa was made before 24 March 2021; and
(i) 簽證申請是在2021年3月24日之前提出的；和
(ii) the non ‑ citizen was in Australia on 24 March 2021; and
(ii) 該非公民於 2021 年 3 月 24 日在澳洲；和
(iii) the decision is made before the end of the concession period described in subregulation 1.15N(1); and
(iii) 該決定是在第 1.15N(1) 款所述的特許期結束之前做出的；和
(iv) the non ‑ citizen is in Australia when the decision is made;
(iv) 在做出決定時，非公民在澳洲；
(u) a decision not to approve for the purposes of condition 8208 a visa holder undertaking critical technology related study (within the meaning of that condition).
(u) 出於條件 8208 的目的，決定不批准簽證持有者進行關鍵技術相關研究（在該條件的含義內）。
(4AA) For the purposes of subparagraphs 4.02(4)(l), (la), (o) and (p), the nominator or sponsor must be:
(4AA) 就第 4.02(4)(l)、(la)、(o) 和 (p) 項而言，提名人或發起人必須是：
(a) an Australian citizen; or
(a) 澳洲公民；或
(b) a company that operates in the migration zone; or
(b) 在移民區經營的公司；或
(c) a partnership that operates in the migration zone; or
(c) 在移民區開展業務的合夥企業；或
(d) the holder of a permanent visa; or
(d) 永久簽證持有者；或
(e) a New Zealand citizen who holds a special category visa; or
(e) 持有特殊類別簽證的紐西蘭公民；或
(f) a Commonwealth agency; or
(f) 聯邦機構；或
(g) a State or Territory government agency.
(g) 州或領地政府機構。
(4A) For the purposes of paragraph (4)(a), the decision is not a reviewable migration decision if:
(4A) 就第 (4)(a) 款而言，如果符合以下條件，則該決定不是可審查的移民決定：
(a) the decision relates to a person whose application for approval as an approved work sponsor in relation to the standard business sponsor class has been refused; and
(a) 該決定涉及一個人，其申請批准為與標準業務贊助者類別相關的核准工作贊助者的申請已被拒絕；和
(b) in making the decision, the Minister did not consider the criterion at paragraph 2.59(f).
(b) 在做出決定時，部長沒有考慮第 2.59(f) 段的標準。
Note: The Minister is required to consider the criterion at paragraph 2.59(f) only if the applicant is lawfully operating a business in Australia.
註：只有當申請人在澳洲合法經營企業時，部長才需要考慮第 2.59(f) 段的標準。
(4B) For the purposes of paragraphs (4)(d) and (h), the decision is not a reviewable migration decision if:
(4B) 就第 (4)(d) 和 (h) 款而言，如果滿足以下條件，則該決定不是可審查的移民決定：
(a) the decision relates to a person who is:
(a) 該決定涉及下列人員：
(i) a standard business sponsor; or
(i) 標準商業贊助商；或
(ii) a former standard business sponsor; and
(ii) 前標準業務贊助商；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) in making the decision under subsection 140E(1) of the Act (whether to approve the person as a standard business sponsor), the Minister did not consider the criterion at paragraph 2.59(f); or
(i) 在根據該法第 140E(1) 款做出決定時（是否批准該人作為標準商業擔保人），部長沒有考慮第 2.59(f) 段中的標準；或
(ii) if a term of the approval of the person as a standard business sponsor has been varied—in making the decision under subsection 140GA(2) of the Act (whether to vary the terms of approval), the Minister did not consider the criterion at paragraph 2.68(g) (as in force before 18 March 2018).
(ii) 如果該人作為標準商業擔保人的批准條款已發生變化－在根據該法第 140GA(2) 款做出決定時（是否更改批准條款），部長沒有考慮第 2.68(g) 段中的標準（2018 年 3 月 18 日之前生效）。
Note: The Minister is required to consider the criterion at paragraph 2.59(f) or 2.68(g) only if the applicant is lawfully operating a business in Australia.
註：只有當申請人在澳洲合法經營企業時，部長才需要考慮第 2.59(f) 或 2.68(g) 段的標準。
(5) For the purposes of paragraph 347A(1)(d) of the Act, an application for review of a decision mentioned in subregulation (4) may only be made by the following:
(5) 就該法第 347A(1)(d) 款而言，對第 (4) 款所提及的決定進行複審的申請只能由下列人員提出：
(a) in the case of a decision mentioned in paragraph (4)(a)—a person to whose application the decision relates;
(a) 如果是第(4)(a)款所提及的決定－該決定所涉及的人；
(c) in the case of a decision mentioned in paragraph (4)(d)—the person who made the nomination;
(c) 如果是第(4)(d)款中提到的決定－提名人；
(d) in the case of a decision mentioned in paragraph (4)(e)—the person to whose nomination of a position the decision relates;
(d) 如果是第(4)(e)款中提到的決定－該決定所涉及的職位提名的人；
(e) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(f) applies—the non ‑ citizen in relation to whom the decision is made;
(e) 若是第(4)(f)款適用的決定－與該決定有關的非公民；
(g) in the case of a decision mentioned in paragraph (4)(h)—the person whose approval is cancelled or who has been barred;
(g) 如果是第(4)(h)款中提到的決定－被取消批准或被禁止的人；
(h) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(j) applies—the sponsor of the contributory parent newborn child;
(h) 若為第 (4)(j) 款適用的決定－繳費父母新生兒的擔保人；
(i) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(k) applies—the applicant;
(i) 若是第(4)(k)款適用的決定－申請人；
(k) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(l) relates—the person who applied to become the sponsor or who nominated the non ‑ citizen;
(k) 對於與第(4)(l)款相關的決定－申請成為擔保人或提名非公民的人；
(ka) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(la) relates—the sponsor or nominator;
(ka) 對於與第(4)(la)段相關的決定－發起人或提名人；
(l) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(m) applies—the person or organisation to whose approval the decision relates;
(l) 若是第(4)(m)款適用的決定－該決定與其批准相關的個人或組織；
(m) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(n) applies—the approved sponsor who applied for a variation of the term;
(m) 若是適用第 (4)(n) 款的決定－申請變更期限的核准擔保人；
(n) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(o) applies—the person who applied to become the sponsor or who nominated the non ‑ citizen;
(n) 若是第(4)(o)款適用的決定－申請成為擔保人或提名非公民的人；
(o) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(p) applies—the sponsor;
(o) 若是第 (4)(p) 款適用的決定－發起人；
(p) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(q) applies—a person to whose application the decision relates;
(p) 若是第(4)(q)款適用的決定－該決定所涉及的人；
(q) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(r) applies—the parent sponsor;
(q) 若是第 (4)(r) 款適用的決定－家長擔保人；
(r) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(s) applies—the sponsor;
(r) 若是第(4)(s)款適用的決定－保薦人；
(raa) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(saa) applies—the applicant;
(raa) 對於第(4)(saa)款適用的決定－申請人；
(ra) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(sa) applies—the sponsor;
(ra) 若是第(4)(sa)款適用的決定－發起人；
(s) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(t) applies—the sponsor;
(s) 若是第(4)(t)款適用的決定－保薦人；
(t) in the case of a decision to which paragraph (4)(u) applies—the visa holder.
(t) 若決定適用第 (4)(u) 款，則為簽證持有者。

title: 4.12 Combined applications for ART review
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) 2 or more applicants have combined their primary applications in Australia in a way permitted by Schedule 1 or regulation 2.08, 2.08A or 2.08B; and
(a) 2 名或更多申請人依照附表 1 或第 2.08、2.08A 或 2.08B 條允許的方式合併其在澳洲的主要申請；和
(b) the Minister’s decisions in respect of 2 or more of those applicants are that a visa not be granted; and
(b) 部長對於其中 2 名或以上申請人的決定是不授予簽證；和
(c) the Minister’s decisions are reviewable migration decisions;
(c) 部長的決定是可審查的移民決定；
the applicants referred to in paragraph (b) may combine their applications for review by the ART of the Minister’s decisions.
(b) 段中提到的申請人可以將其申請合併起來，供 ART 審查部長的決定。
(4) If:
(4) 如果：
(a) a person has nominated or sponsored 2 or more members of a family unit in respect of their primary applications for visas of a kind referred to in subsection 338(5) of the Act; and
(a) 某人已提名或擔保家庭單位中的 2 名或以上成員，以首次申請該法第 338(5) 款所述類型的簽證；和
(b) the Minister’s decisions in respect of 2 or more of the members of that family unit are that a visa not be granted; and
(b) 部長關於該家庭單位的 2 名或以上成員的決定是不授予簽證；和
(c) the Minister’s decisions are reviewable migration decisions;
(c) 部長的決定是可審查的移民決定；
the nominator or sponsor may combine his or her applications for review by the ART of the Minister’s decisions in respect of each of the members of the family unit to whom the Minister refused to grant a visa.
提名人或擔保人可以將他或她的申請合併起來，由 ART 審查部長針對部長拒絕發放簽證的家庭成員的決定。
(5) If a person applies for review by the ART of:
(5) 如果某人向 ART 申請審查：
(a) a decision to which paragraph 4.02(4)(f) applies; and
(a) 第 4.02(4)(f) 段適用的決定；和
(b) a decision to refuse to grant the visa mentioned in subparagraph 4.02(4)(f)(ii) that is a reviewable migration decision;
(b) 拒絕授予第 4.02(4)(f)(ii) 項中提到的簽證的決定，這是一項可審查的移民決定；
the applications for review by the ART of the decisions are taken to be combined.
ART 對決定進行審查的申請將合併。
(6) If:
(6) 如果：
(a) 2 or more visa applicants have combined their primary applications, in a way permitted by Schedule 1 or regulation 2.08, 2.08A or 2.08B, for visas of a kind referred to in subsection 338(6) or (7) of the Act; and
(a) 2 名或更多簽證申請人按照附表 1 或第 2.08、2.08A 或 2.08B 條允許的方式合併其主要申請，申請該法第 338(6) 或 (7) 款所述類型的簽證；和
(b) the Minister’s decisions in respect of 2 or more of those visa applicants are that visas not be granted; and
(b) 部長對其中 2 名或以上簽證申請人的決定是不授予簽證；和
(c) the Minister’s decisions are reviewable migration decisions;
(c) 部長的決定是可審查的移民決定；
the Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident who is a parent, spouse, de facto partner, child, brother or sister of the visa applicants may combine his or her applications for review by the ART of the Minister’s decisions in respect of each of those visa applicants to whom the Minister refused to grant a visa.
作為簽證申請人的父母、配偶、同居伴侶、子女、兄弟或姐妹的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民可以將其申請合併起來，供 ART 審查部長對部長拒絕授予簽證的每位簽證申請人的決定。

title: 4.12A Prescribed information and documents for review applications
zh: 4.12A 審查申請的規定資訊和文件
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1) This regulation is made for the purposes of subsection 347(2) of the Act.
(1) 本規定是為了該法第 347(2) 款的目的而製定的。
(2) If the person (the review applicant ) making an application for review of a reviewable migration decision has a copy of the notification of the decision, the prescribed document is a copy of that notification.
（二）可複審移民決定複審申請人（複審申請人）持有該決定通知書副本的，規定文件為該通知書副本。
(3) If the review applicant does not have a copy of that notification and the review applicant is an individual, the prescribed information is:
（三）複審申請人無該通知副本且複審申請人為個人的，規定資訊為：
(a) the review applicant’s full name; and
(a) 複審申請人的全名；和
(b) the review applicant’s address and contact details; and
(b) 複審申請人的地址和聯絡方式；和
(c) the date of the decision (if known to the review applicant) and a description of the decision; and
(c) 決定的日期（如果復審申請人知道的話）和決定的描述；和
(d) at least one of the following:
(d) 至少符合以下條件之一：
(i) the review applicant’s date of birth;
(i) 複審申請人的出生日期；
(ii) the review applicant’s country of birth;
(ii) 審查申請人的出生國；
(iii) the review applicant’s citizenship or nationality;
(iii) 審查申請人的公民身分或國籍；
(iv) the country of issue and number of the review applicant’s passport; and
（四）複核申請人護照的簽發國及號碼；和
(e) if the decision relates to an application for a visa made by a person (the visa applicant ) who is not the review applicant—the information specified in subregulation (5).
(e) 如果該決定涉及由非審查申請人的人（簽證申請人）提出的簽證申請－第（5）款中規定的資訊。
(4) If the review applicant does not have a copy of that notification and the review applicant is not an individual, the prescribed information is:
（四）複審申請人無該通知副本且複審申請人非個人的，規定資訊為：
(a) the review applicant’s name; and
(a) 複審申請人姓名；和
(b) the review applicant’s trading name (if any and if different from the review applicant’s name); and
(b) 複審申請人的商號（如有且與複審申請人的姓名不同）；和
(c) if the review applicant has an ABN (within the meaning of the A New Tax System (Australian Business Number) Act 1999 ) or ACN (within the meaning of the Corporations Act 2001 )—the ABN or ACN; and
(c) 如果復審申請人擁有 ABN（根據 1999 年新稅收制度（澳大利亞商業號碼）法案的含義）或 ACN（根據 2001 年公司法的含義）－ABN 或 ACN；和
(d) the review applicant’s business address; and
(d) 複審申請人的營業地址；和
(e) the name, position and contact details of a contact person for the review applicant; and
(e) 覆核申請人聯絡人的姓名、職位和聯絡方式；和
(f) the date of the decision (if known to the review applicant) and a description of the decision; and
(f) 決定的日期（如果復審申請人知道的話）和決定的描述；和
(g) if the decision relates to an application for a visa made by a person (the visa applicant ) who is not the review applicant—the information specified in subregulation (5).
(g) 如果該決定涉及由非審查申請人的人（簽證申請人）提出的簽證申請－第（5）款中規定的資訊。
(5) For the purposes of paragraphs (3)(e) and (4)(g), the following information is specified:
(5) 就第 (3)(e) 和 (4)(g) 款而言，規定了以下資訊：
(a) the visa applicant’s full name;
(a) 簽證申請人的全名；
(b) the visa applicant’s address and contact details;
(b) 簽證申請人的地址和聯絡方式；
(c) at least one of the following:
(c) 至少符合以下條件之一：
(i) the visa applicant’s date of birth;
(i) 簽證申請人的出生日期；
(ii) the visa applicant’s country of birth;
(ii) 簽證申請人的出生國；
(iii) the visa applicant’s citizenship or nationality;
(iii) 簽證申請人的公民身分或國籍；
(iv) the country of issue and number of the visa applicant’s passport.
(iv) 簽證申請人護照的核發國和號碼。

title: 4.13 ART review—fees and waiver
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1) Subject to this regulation, the prescribed fee for an application for review by the ART of a reviewable migration decision is $3,496 .
(1) 根據本規定，申請 ART 對可審查的移民決定進行審查的規定費用為 3,496 美元。
Note: The fee in this subregulation is subject to increase under regulation 4.13A.
註：本款中的費用可能會根據第 4.13A 條的規定增加。
(2) No fee is payable on the following:
（二）下列情形不需繳費：
(a) an application for review by the ART of a primary decision of a kind referred to in subsection 338(4) of the Act;
(a) 請求 ART 審查該法案第 338(4) 款所指類型的初步決定的申請；
(b) an application, made by a non ‑ citizen who is in immigration detention, for review by the ART of a decision to which paragraph 4.02(4)(f) applies.
(b) 被移民拘留的非公民提出的申請，要求 ART 審查適用第 4.02(4)(f) 段的決定。
(2A) No fee is payable on an application made by a person (the review applicant ) for review of a decision (the decision for review ) made by the Minister if:
(2A) 在下列情況下，個人（覆核申請人）提出複審部長決定（複審決定）的申請無需繳納費用：
(a) the decision for review is a refusal to grant the review applicant a visa because the review applicant did not satisfy at least one of the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(a) 複審決定是拒絕授予複審申請人簽證，因為複審申請人不符合至少一項授予簽證的次要標準；和
(b) that criterion was not satisfied because the Minister had refused to grant a visa to a person (the primary applicant ) who:
(b) 該標準不滿足，因為部長拒絕向以下人員（主申請人）發放簽證：
(i) is a former spouse or former de facto partner of the review applicant; and
(i) 是審查申請人的前配偶或前同居伴侶；和
(ii) was seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of that visa; and
(ii) 尋求滿足授予該簽證的主要標準；和
(c) in making the decision for review, the Minister was satisfied that the review applicant satisfied a criterion that the review applicant, or another person mentioned in the criterion, has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant.
(c) 在做出審查決定時，部長信納審查申請人符合審查申請人或標準中提到的其他人曾遭受主申請人所實施的家庭暴力的標準。
Note: For special provisions relating to family violence, see Division 1.5.
註：有關家庭暴力的特殊規定，請參閱1.5節。
(3) If a person combines 2 or more applications for review by the ART in accordance with regulation 4.12, an application fee is payable in respect of only 1 of those applications.
(3) 如果一個人根據第 4.12 條將 2 份或更多申請合併供 ART 審查，則只需為其中 1 份申請繳納申請費。
(4) If the ART Principal Registrar, having regard to the review applicant’s income, expenses, liabilities and assets, considers that the payment of the fee mentioned in subregulation (1) would cause, or has caused, financial hardship to the review applicant, the prescribed fee is 50% of the amount mentioned in subregulation (1).
(4) 如果 ART 主註冊官考慮到複審申請人的收入、開支、負債和資產，認為支付第 (1) 款所述費用將導致或已經導致複審申請人出現經濟困難，則規定費用為第 (1) 款所述金額的 50%。

title: 4.13A Annual increases in fees
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
The fee prescribed by subregulation 4.13(1) is increased, in accordance with regulation 4.13B, on each 1 July starting on 1 July 2025.
根據第 4.13B 條規定，自 2025 年 7 月 1 日起，每年 7 月 1 日增加第 4.13(1) 款規定的費用。

title: 4.13B Calculation of increase
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1) If, in a relevant period, the latest CPI number is greater than the earlier CPI number, a fee is taken to increase, on 1 July immediately following the end of the period, in accordance with the formula:
(1) 如果在相關期間內，最新的 CPI 數字大於先前的 CPI 數字，則在該期間結束後的 7 月 1 日起，請按照以下公式增加費用：
where:
其中：
earlier CPI number is the CPI number for the last March quarter before the beginning of the relevant period.
早期 CPI 資料是相關期間開始前最後一個三月季度的 CPI 資料。
latest CPI number is the CPI number for the last March quarter before the end of the relevant period.
最新 CPI 數據是相關期間結束前最後一個三月季度的 CPI 數據。
(2) If, apart from this subregulation, the amount of a fee increased under subregulation (1) would be an amount of dollars and cents, the amount is to be rounded to the nearest whole dollar and, if the amount to be rounded is 50 cents, rounded down.
(2) 除本款外，如果根據第 (1) 款增加的費用金額為美元和美分，則該金額應四捨五入至最接近的整數美元，如果四捨五入的金額為 50 美分，則向下捨去。
(3) Subject to subregulation (4), if at any time, whether before or after the commencement of this regulation, the Australian Statistician publishes for a particular March quarter a CPI number in substitution for an index number previously published by the Australian Statistician for that quarter, the publication of the later index number is to be disregarded for the purposes of this regulation.
(3) 根據第 (4) 款，如果在任何時候，無論是在本條例生效之前還是之後，澳大利亞統計局發布了特定 3 月季度的 CPI 數字，以替代澳大利亞統計局之前發布的該季度的指數，則就本條例而言，後一指數的發布將被忽略。
(4) If, at any time, whether before or after the commencement of this regulation, the Australian Statistician changes the reference base for the Consumer Price Index, then, for the purposes of the application of this regulation after the change is made, regard must be had only to numbers published in terms of the new reference base.
(4) 如果在任何時候，無論是在本法規生效之前還是之後，澳洲統計員更改了消費者物價指數的參考基準，那麼，為了在更改後應用本法規，必須僅考慮根據新的參考基準公佈的數字。
(5) In this regulation:
（五）本規定：
CPI number means the All Groups Consumer Price Index number (being the weighted average of the 8 Australian capital cities) published by the Australian Statistician.
CPI數字是指澳洲統計局公佈的所有群體消費者物價指數數字（澳洲8個首府城市的加權平均值）。
fee means:
費用的意思是：
(a) a fee prescribed by subregulation 4.13(1); or
(a) 第 4.13(1) 款規定的費用；或
(b) the fee in force at the end of the relevant period if regulation 4.13A applies.
(b) 若第 4.13A 條適用，則相關期間結束時有效的費用。
relevant period means a financial year starting on or after 1 July 2024.
相關期間是指2024年7月1日或之後開始的財政年度。

title: 4.14 Refund of fees by ART
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1) The table sets out:

(2) If an application for review by the ART is withdrawn, the fee paid on the application is to be refunded if the application is withdrawn because:
(2) 如果ART審查申請被撤回，則因以下原因而撤回申請所繳納的費用將退還：
(a) the death has occurred, since the visa application was made, of:
(a) 自從提出簽證申請以來，以下人員已死亡：
(i) the applicant for the visa that was the subject of the application; or
(i) 所申請簽證的申請人；或
(ii) a member of that applicant’s family unit; or
(ii) 申請人家屬；或
(iii) a review applicant; or
(iii) 覆核申請人；或
(b) the applicant for the visa that was the subject of the application has been granted a visa of the class applied for otherwise than because the Minister has reconsidered the primary application and the applicant’s score on the reconsideration is more than or equal to the applicable pass mark; or
(b) 所申請簽證的申請人已被授予所申請類別的簽證，除非部長重新考慮了主要申請並且申請人在重新考慮中的分數高於或等於適用的及格分數；或
(c) in relation to an application for a parent visa—the applicant:
(c) 父母簽證申請－申請人：
(i) applied for another parent visa after lodging the application for review; and
(i) 提交審核申請後，再次申請父母簽證；和
(ii) wants to have a decision made on the application for the other parent visa.
(ii) 希望就另一方父母簽證的申請做出決定。

title: 4.15 ART’s power to remit matters with orders
zh: 4.15 ART 透過命令移交事項的權力
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 349(2) of the Act (which deals with the ART’s power to remit):
(1) 就該法案第 349(2) 款（涉及 ART 的匯款權力）而言：
(a) an application for a visa is a prescribed matter; and
(a) 簽證申請是規定事項；和
(b) subject to subregulation (4), a permissible order is that the applicant must be taken to have satisfied a specified criterion for the visa.
(b) 根據第(4)款，允許的命令是必須認為申請人已符合簽證的特定標準。
(1A) For the purposes of subsection 349(2) of the Act:
(1A) 就該法案第 349(2) 款而言：
(a) the following are prescribed matters:
(a) 規定事項如下：
(i) a nomination under subsection 140GB(1) of the Act;
(i) 依該法第 140GB(1) 條提名；
(ii) a nomination referred to in subregulation 5.19(1) ; and
(ii) 第 5.19(1) 款所提及的提名；和
(b) a permissible order is that the nomination must be taken to have met a specified criterion or requirement for approval under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act or subregulation 5.19(3) (as the case may be).
(b) 允許的命令是提名必須被視為符合該法案第 140GB(2) 款或第 5.19(3) 款（視情況而定）規定的批准標準或要求。
(2) For the purposes of subsection 349(2) of the Act, the requiring of a security that is mentioned in paragraph 4.02(4)(f) is a prescribed matter.
(2) 就該法第 349(2) 條而言，第 4.02(4)(f) 段所提及的擔保要求是規定事項。
(3) If the ART remits a prescribed matter that is mentioned in subregulation (2) to the primary decision ‑ maker, the ART may order the primary decision ‑ maker:
(3) 如果ART將第(2)款中提到的規定事項轉交給主要決策者，ART可以命令主要決策者：
(a) to indicate to the applicant that a condition specified by the ART will be imposed on the visa if it is granted; and
(a) 向申請人表明，如果簽證獲得批准，將附加 ART 規定的條件；和
(b) to require a security for compliance with the condition (whether or not a security has already been required).
(b) 要求提供擔保以遵守條件（無論是否已經要求提供擔保）。
(4) If:
(4) 如果：
(a) a person applies for a Prospective Marriage (Temporary) (Class TO) visa; and
(a) 申請準婚姻（臨時）（TO 類）簽證的人；和
(b) in the period after the Minister’s decision on the application is made and before the application is finally determined, the applicant:
(b) 在部長對申請作出決定之後和最終確定申請之前的期間內，申請人：
(i) marries the person who was specified in the application as the applicant’s prospective spouse; and
(i) 與申請中指定為申請人未來配偶的人結婚；和
(ii) notifies the ART of the marriage; and
(ii) 將婚姻通知 ART；和
(c) the marriage is recognised as valid for the purposes of the Act; and
(c) 就該法而言，該婚姻被認為是有效的；和
(d) the ART decides to remit the application to the Minister for reconsideration;
(d) ART 決定將申請轉交部長複議；
then, for the purposes of paragraph 349(2)(b) of the Act, the permissible order is that the application must be taken to also be an application:
那麼，就該法案第 349(2)(b) 段而言，允許的命令是該申請也必須被視為申請：
(e) for a Partner (Migrant) (Class BC) visa and for a Partner (Provisional) (Class UF) visa; and
(e) 伴侶（移民）（BC 級）簽證和伴侶（臨時）（UF 級）簽證；和
(f) that is made on the day that the application is remitted to the Minister.
(f) 在向部長提交申請之日提出。

path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions

text:
For subsection 367(1) of the Act, the prescribed period starts when the application for review is received by the ART and ends at the end of 7 working days after the day on which the application is received.
對於該法第 367(1) 款，規定期限從 ART 收到審查申請時開始，到收到申請之日後 7 個工作天結束。
Note: Subsection 367(1) of the Act provides for the regulations to limit the time in which the ART must review certain decisions on bridging visas.
註：該法案第 367(1) 款規定了限制 ART 必須審查有關過橋簽證的某些決定的時間的規定。

title: 4.18 Applications to be reviewed on the papers
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
Kinds of applications that are an application to be reviewed on the papers
論文審查的申請類型
(1) For the purposes of paragraph 367C(2)(b) of the Act, an application made to the ART for review of a decision to refuse to grant a student visa is prescribed.
(1) 就該法第 367C(2)(b) 段而言，規定向 ART 提出申請，以審查拒絕授予學生簽證的決定。
Circumstances in which an application is not an application to be reviewed on the papers
申請不屬於論文審查申請的情況
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 367C(3)(b) of the Act, a prescribed circumstance is that the application relates to a decision to refuse to grant a student visa because the applicant did not satisfy one or more of the following criteria (whether or not that is the only reason the decision was made to refuse the visa):
(2) 就該法第 367C(3)(b) 條而言，規定的情況是申請涉及拒絕授予學生簽證的決定，因為申請人不符合以下一項或多項標準（無論這是否是拒絕簽證決定的唯一原因）：
(a) public interest criteria 4001, 4003B, 4007, 4010, 4013, 4014, 4017, 4018 or 4020;
(a) 公共利益準則 4001、4003B、4007、4010、4013、4014、4017、4018 或 4020；
(b) a special return criterion.
(b) 特殊退貨標準。
Issues on which the ART must invite written submissions and evidence
ART 必須邀請書面意見和證據的問題
(3) Subsection (4) applies in relation to an application to be reviewed on the papers of a decision to refuse to grant a student visa to an applicant who sought to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of the visa.
(3) 第(4)款適用於對拒絕向尋求滿足授予簽證的主要標準的申請人授予學生簽證的決定文件進行審查的申請。
(4) For the purposes of paragraph 367F(1)(b) of the Act, an issue is whether the applicant is enrolled in a course of study (within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2).
(4) 就該法案第 367F(1)(b) 段而言，問題是申請人是否註冊了學習課程（附表 2 第 500.111 條含義內）。

title: 4.19 Applications that cease to be applications to be reviewed on the papers
zh: 4.19 不再是論文審查申請的申請
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
For the purposes of subsection 367C(5) of the Act, for an application that ceases to be an application to be reviewed on the papers, any steps taken in relation to the application under subsection 367G(1) before the application so ceases are to be treated as steps taken under, and in accordance with, section 359A of the Act.
就該法案第 367C(5) 款而言，對於不再是文件審查申請的申請，在該申請停止之前根據第 367G(1) 款採取的與該申請相關的任何步驟均應被視為根據該法案第 359A 條採取的步驟。

title: 4.20 Response period for applications to be reviewed on the papers
zh: 4.20 論文審查申請的回覆期
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.1 — Review of reviewable migration decisions
text:
For the purposes of paragraph 367H(2)(a), the following periods are prescribed:
就第 367H(2)(a) 段而言，規定了以下期間：
(a) for an invitation given under subsection 367F(1)—within 28 days after the day the applicant is notified of the invitation;
(a) 依據第 367F(1) 款所發出的邀請－申請人收到邀請通知之日起 28 天內；
(b) for an invitation given under subsection 367G(1)—within 14 days after the day the applicant is notified of the invitation.
(b) 依據第 367G(1) 款所發出的邀請－申請人收到邀請通知之日起 14 天內。

title: Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
zh: 第 4.2 分部 — 可覆核保護決定的覆核
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions

title: 4.28 Application of this Division
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
text:
This Division applies in relation to the review of reviewable protection decisions.
本節適用於可審查保護決定的審查。
Note: The review of reviewable migration decisions is dealt with in Division 4.1.
注意：可審查遷移決定的審查在第 4.1 節中討論。

title: 4.31 Prescribed information and documents for review applications
zh: 4.31 審查申請的規定資訊和文件
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
text:
(1) This regulation is made for the purposes of subsection 347(2) of the Act.
(1) 本規定是為了該法第 347(2) 款的目的而製定的。
(2) If the person making an application for review of a reviewable protection decision has a copy of the notification of the decision, the prescribed document is a copy of that notification.
(2) 如果申請對可審查的保護決定進行審查的人持有該決定通知的副本，則規定的文件是該通知的副本。
(3) If the person does not have a copy of that notification, the prescribed information is:
(3) 如果該人沒有該通知的副本，則規定的資訊是：
(a) the person’s full name; and
(a) 該人的全名；和
(b) the person’s address and contact details; and
(b) 該人的地址和聯絡方式；和
(c) the date of the decision (if known to the person) and a description of the decision; and
(c) 決定的日期（如果該人知道的話）和決定的描述；和
(d) at least one of the following:
(d) 至少符合以下條件之一：
(i) the person’s date of birth;
(i) 該人的出生日期；
(ii) the person’s country of birth;
(ii) 該人的出生國；
(iii) the person’s citizenship or nationality or a statement that the person is stateless;
(iii) 該人的公民身分或國籍或該人無國籍的聲明；
(iv) the country of issue and number of the person’s passport.
(iv) 護照的簽發國和號碼。

title: 4.31A Combined applications for review by the ART
zh: 4.31A 供 ART 審查的合併申請
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
text:
If:
如果：
(a) 2 or more applicants have combined their primary applications for a protection visa in a way permitted by Schedule 1 or regulation 2.08, 2.08A, 2.08AAA or 2.08B; and
(a) 2名或更多申請人依附表1或第2.08、2.08A、2.08AAA或2.08B條允許的方式合併其保護簽證的主要申請；和
(b) the Minister’s decisions in respect of 2 or more of those applicants are that protection visas not be granted; and
(b) 部長對其中 2 名或以上申請人的決定是不授予保護簽證；和
(c) the Minister’s decisions are reviewable protection decisions;
(c) 部長的決定是可審查的保護決定；
the applicants referred to in paragraph (b) may combine their applications for review by the ART of the Minister’s decisions.
(b) 段中提到的申請人可以將其申請合併起來，供 ART 審查部長的決定。

title: 4.31B Review by the ART—fee, waivers and refunds
zh: 4.31B ART 審查－費用、豁免和退款
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
text:
Prescribed fee
訂明費用
(1) For the purposes of paragraph 347(2)(c) of the Act, the prescribed fee for an application for review by the ART of a reviewable protection decision is 50% of the amount of the prescribed fee mentioned in subregulation 4.13(1) (as indexed under regulation 4.13A).
(1) 就該法第 347(2)(c) 段而言，申請 ART 對可複審保護決定進行複審的規定費用為第 4.13(1) 款中提及的規定費用金額的 50%（依第 4.13A 條索引）。
Note: The application for review must be accompanied by the prescribed fee: see subsection 347(2) of the Act.
注意：審查申請必須附有規定的費用：請參閱該法案第 347(2) 款。
Waiver of prescribed fee
免訂費用
(2) The prescribed fee is not payable in relation to an application for review by the ART of a reviewable protection decision if:
(2) 若發生以下情況，則無需繳納與 ART 審查可審查保護決定的申請相關的規定費用：
(a) the application is made by a non ‑ citizen who is in immigration detention; or
(a) 申請由被移民拘留的非公民提出；或
(b) the application is combined, in accordance with regulation 4.31A, with another application in respect of which the prescribed fee is paid.
(b) 根據第 4.31A 條，該申請與另一項已繳納規定費用的申請合併。
Refund of prescribed fee
退還規定費用
(3) The whole of the prescribed fee that has been paid in relation to an application for review by the ART of a decision must be refunded if any of the following apply:
(3) 若有以下任何一種情況，則必須退還與 ART 決定複審申請相關的全部規定費用：
(a) the applicant is not entitled to apply for review by the ART;
(a) 申請人無權申請ART複審；
(b) the decision is not subject to review by the ART;
(b) 該決定不受 ART 審查；
(c) the ART decides under section 105 of the ART Act to vary the decision;
(c) ART 根據 ART 法第 105 條決定改變決定；
(d) the ART decides under subsection 349(2) of the Act to remit a matter in relation to the decision for reconsideration;
(d) ART 根據該法第 349(2) 款決定將與該決定相關的事項移交複議；
(e) the ART decides under section 105 of the ART Act to set the decision aside and substitute a new decision;
(e) ART 根據 ART 法第 105 條決定擱置該決定並以新決定替代；
(f) the Minister decides under section 339 of the Act to issue a conclusive certificate in relation to the decision;
(f) 部長根據該法第 339 條決定頒發與該決定有關的結論性證書；
(g) the Minister decides under subsection 351(1) of the Act to substitute for the decision of the ART a decision that is favourable to the applicant;
(g) 部長依該法第 351(1) 款決定以有利於申請人的決定取代 ART 的決定；
(h) the application is withdrawn because of the death of the applicant.
(h) 申請因申請人死亡而被撤回。

title: 4.33 Powers of ART
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
Division 4.2 — Review of reviewable protection decisions
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 349(2) of the Act, an application for a protection visa is prescribed.
(1) 就該法第 349(2) 條而言，規定了保護簽證的申請。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 349(2)(b) of the Act, it is a permissible order that the applicant must be taken to have satisfied the criteria for the visa that are specified in the order.
(2) 就該法第 349(2)(b) 段而言，申請人必須被視為已滿足該命令中指定的簽證標準，這是一項允許的命令。
(3) For the purposes of paragraph 349(2)(b) of the Act:
(3) 就該法第 349(2)(b) 段而言：
(a) it is a permissible order that the applicant is a refugee within the meaning of subsection 5H(1) of the Act; and
(a) 申請人是該法第 5H(1) 款含義內的難民是一項允許的命令；和
(aa) it is a permissible order that subsection 36(3) of the Act does not apply to the applicant; and
(aa) 該法令第 36(3) 款不適用於申請人，這是一項允許的命令；和
(b) it is not a permissible order that:
(b) 下列情況不屬於允許的命令：
(i) subsection 5H(1) of the Act applies to the applicant; or
(i) 該法第 5H(1) 條適用於申請人；或
(ii) subsection 5H(1) does not apply to the applicant because of subsection 5H(2); or
(ii) 由於第 5H(2) 款，第 5H(1) 款不適用於申請人；或
(iii) the applicant satisfies, or does not satisfy, the criterion in subsection 36(1C) of the Act.
(iii) 申請人符合或未符合該法案第 36(1C) 款的標準。
(4) For the purposes of paragraph 349(2)(b) of the Act:
(4) 就該法第 349(2)(b) 段而言：
(a) it is a permissible order that the applicant satisfies each matter, specified in the order, that relates to establishing whether the applicant is a person to whom Australia has protection obligations because there are substantial grounds for believing that, as a necessary and foreseeable consequence of the applicant being removed from Australia to a receiving country, there is a real risk that the applicant will suffer significant harm; and
(a) 這是一項允許的命令，要求申請人滿足該命令中規定的與確定申請人是否是澳大利亞負有保護義務的人有關的每項事項，因為有充分理由相信，作為申請人被從澳大利亞驅逐到接收國的必然和可預見的後果，申請人確實存在遭受重大傷害的風險；和
(b) it is not a permissible order that the applicant satisfies a matter that relates to establishing whether there are serious reasons for considering that:
(b) 申請人符合與確定是否有充分理由考慮下列事項有關的事項不屬於允許的命令：
(i) the applicant has committed a crime against peace, a war crime or a crime against humanity, as defined by an international instrument mentioned in regulation 2.03B; or
(i) 申請人犯有第 2.03B 條所提及的國際文書所定義的危害和平罪、戰爭罪或危害人類罪；或
(ii) the applicant committed a serious non ‑ political crime before entering Australia; or
(ii) 申請人在進入澳洲之前犯下嚴重的非政治犯罪；或
(iii) the applicant has been guilty of acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations; and
(iii) 申請人有違反聯合國宗旨和原則的行為；和
(c) it is not a permissible order that the applicant satisfies a matter that relates to establishing whether there are reasonable grounds that:
(c) 申請人符合與確定是否有合理理由有關的事項不屬於允許的命令：
(i) the applicant is a danger to Australia’s security; or
(i) 申請人對澳洲的安全構成威脅；或
(ii) the applicant, having been convicted by a final judgment of a particularly serious crime, including a crime that consists of the commission of a serious Australian offence or serious foreign offence, is a danger to the Australian community.
(ii) 申請人已被終審判決犯下特別嚴重的罪行，包括實施嚴重的澳洲犯罪或嚴重的外國犯罪，對澳洲社會構成危險。
(5) For the purposes of paragraph 349(2)(b) of the Act, it is a permissible order that the grant of the visa is not prevented by section 91W, 91WA or 91WB of the Act.
(5) 就該法案第 349(2)(b) 段而言，該法案第 91W、91WA 或 91WB 條不妨礙簽證的授予，這是一項允許的命令。

title: 4.34 Statement about decision under review—number of copies
zh: 4.34 關於正在審查的決定的說明－份數
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions

For the purposes of subsection 352(2) of the Act, the prescribed number of copies of a statement of the kind mentioned in that subsection is 1.
就該法案第 352(2) 款而言，該款中提到的此類聲明的規定份數為 1 份。

title: Division 4.3 — Service of documents
zh: 第 4.3 分部 — 文件送達
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions

title: 4.39 Address for service
path: Part 4 — Review of decisions—reviewable migration and protection decisions
text:
(1) In this regulation:
（一）本規定：
lodge an address for service , in relation to an applicant for review, means give the ART notice in writing of an address at which documents relating to a review may be sent to the applicant.
就審查申請人而言，提交送達地址是指以書面形式向 ART 發出通知，告知可以將與審查有關的文件發送給申請人的地址。
(2) An applicant for review of a reviewable migration decision or a reviewable protection decision may:
(2) 可審查移民決定或可審查保護決定的審查申請人可以：
(a) lodge an address for service in a review; and
(a) 提交審查送達地址；和
(b) at any time after lodging an address for service, lodge a new address for service in that review.
(b) 在提交送達地址後隨時在該審查中提交新的送達地址。
(3) If an applicant for review lodges with the ART a new address for service under paragraph (2)(b):
(3) 若復審申請人依第 (2)(b) 款向 ART 提交新的送達地址：
(a) that new address becomes the applicant for review’s address for service in the review; and
(a) 該新地址成為複審申請人在復核中送達的地址；和
(b) he or she must, immediately after doing so, serve on the Minister a notice of that new address for service.
(b) 他或她必須在這樣做後立即向部長送達新送達地址的通知。
(4) An address for service may be, but need not be, the applicant’s residential address.
(4) 送達地址可以是但不必是申請人的居住地址。

title: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
zh: 第 4A 部 — 決定的覆核—評估機構的核准
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals

title: Division 4A.1 — Preliminary
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals

title: 4.40 Definitions
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
text:
In this Part:
在本部分中：
revocation decision means a decision of the Skills Assessment Minister under subregulation 2.26B(1BG) to revoke an approval of a person or body as an assessing authority for an occupation and one or more countries.
撤銷決定是指技能評估部長根據第 2.26B(1BG) 款所做的決定，撤銷對個人或機構作為某一職業和一個或多個國家的評估機構的批准。

title: Division 4A.2 — Reconsideration and review of decisions revoking assessing authority approval
zh: 第 4A.2 分部 — 撤銷評估機構核准決定的重新考慮及覆核
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
Division 4A.2 — Reconsideration and review of decisions revoking assessing authority approval

title: 4.41 Reconsideration of revocation decision
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
Division 4A.2 — Reconsideration and review of decisions revoking assessing authority approval
text:
(1) A person or body (the aggrieved entity ) whose interests are affected by a revocation decision may request the Skills Assessment Minister to reconsider the decision.
(1) 其利益受到撤銷決定影響的個人或團體（受害實體）可以請求技能評估部長重新考慮該決定。
Form and timing of request
請求的形式和時間
(2) The request must:
(2) 請求必須：
(a) be in writing; and
(a) 採用書面形式；和
(b) set out the reasons for the request; and
(b) 說明提出請求的理由；和
(c) be made within:
(c) 在下列時間內作出：
(i) 30 days after the day the aggrieved entity is notified of the revocation decision; or
(i) 受害實體收到撤銷決定通知之日起 30 天；或
(ii) if the Skills Assessment Minister allows a longer period (whether before or after the end of the 30 ‑ day period referred to in subparagraph (i))—that longer period.
(ii) 如果技能評估部長允許更長的期限（無論是在第 (i) 項中提到的 30 天期限結束之前還是之後）—該更長的期限。
Reconsideration of decision
重新考慮決定
(3) On receiving a request made in accordance with subregulation (2), the Skills Assessment Minister:
(3) 在收到根據第 (2) 款提出的請求後，技能評估部長：
(a) must review the revocation decision; and
(a) 必須審查撤銷決定；和
(b) must affirm, vary or set aside the revocation decision; and
(b) 必須確認、變更或撤銷撤銷決定；和
(c) if the Skills Assessment Minister sets aside the revocation decision—may make such other decision as the Skills Assessment Minister thinks appropriate.
(c) 如果技能評估部長擱置撤銷決定－可以做出技能評估部長認為適當的其他決定。
(4) The Skills Assessment Minister must do so before the end of:
(4) 技能評估部長必須在以下時間結束前這樣做：
(a) the period of 30 days beginning on the day the Skills Assessment Minister receives the request, unless paragraph (b) applies; or
(a) 自技能評估部長收到請求之日起 30 天的期限，除非 (b) 段適用；或
(b) if the aggrieved entity and the Skills Assessment Minister agree on a longer period—that longer period.
(b) 如果受害實體和技能評估部長同意更長的期限－該更長的期限。
Notice of decision on reconsideration
複議決定通知書
(5) The Skills Assessment Minister must give the aggrieved entity written notice of the Skills Assessment Minister’s decision on reconsideration and of the reasons for that decision.
(5) 技能評估部長必須向受害實體書面通知技能評估部長的複議決定以及該決定的理由。
(6) The Skills Assessment Minister must give the Minister a copy of the notice.
(6) 技能評估部長必須提供部長一份通知副本。
When decision on reconsideration takes effect
複議決定何時生效
(7) The Skills Assessment Minister’s decision on reconsideration takes effect:
(7) 技能評估部長的複議決定生效：
(a) on the day specified in the notice; or
(a) 通知中指定的日期；或
(b) if a day is not specified—on the day on which that decision is made.
(b) 如果沒有指定日期－則為做出決定的日期。
Skills Assessment Minister may be taken to have affirmed decision
技能評估部長可能會做出確認決定
(8) The Skills Assessment Minister is taken to have made a decision affirming the revocation decision under reconsideration if the Skills Assessment Minister has not notified the aggrieved entity of the Skills Assessment Minister’s decision on reconsideration before the end of the period applicable under subregulation (4).
(8) 若技能評估部長在第 (4) 款規定的適用期限結束前未將技能評估部長的複議決定通知受害實體，則視為技能評估部長已做出確認複議撤銷決定的決定。

title: 4.42 Reconsideration of revocation decision on own initiative
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
Division 4A.2 — Reconsideration and review of decisions revoking assessing authority approval
text:
(1) The Skills Assessment Minister may reconsider a revocation decision if satisfied that there is sufficient reason to do so.
(1) 如果技能評估部長認為有充分理由，可以重新考慮撤銷決定。
(2) If the Skills Assessment Minister decides under subsection (1) to reconsider a revocation decision, the Skills Assessment Minister must, within 14 days after commencing reconsideration of the revocation decision, give the person or body (the interested entity ) whose interests are affected by the decision written notice that:
(2) 如果技能評估部長根據第 (1) 款決定重新考慮撤銷決定，則技能評估部長必須在開始重新考慮撤銷決定後 14 天內，向其利益受到該決定影響的個人或機構（利益實體）發出書面通知：
(a) states that the decision is being reconsidered; and
(a) 聲明正在重新考慮該決定；和
(b) specifies the day the reconsideration commenced.
(b) 指明複議開始的日期。
(3) After reconsidering the revocation decision, the Skills Assessment Minister:
(3) 重新考慮撤銷決定後，技能評估部長：
(a) must affirm, vary or set aside the revocation decision; and
(a) 必須確認、變更或撤銷撤銷決定；和
(b) if the Skills Assessment Minister sets aside the revocation decision—may make such other decision as the Skills Assessment Minister thinks appropriate.
(b) 如果技能評估部長擱置撤銷決定－可以做出技能評估部長認為適當的其他決定。
(4) The Skills Assessment Minister must, as soon as practicable after making the reconsideration decision:
(4) 技能評估部長必須在做出複議決定後儘快：
(a) give the interested entity written notice of the Skills Assessment Minister’s decision; and
(a) 將技能評估部長的決定書面通知感興趣的實體；和
(b) give the Minister a copy of the notice.
(b) 向部長提供一份通知副本。

title: 4.43 ART review of decisions
path: Part 4A — Review of decisions—assessing authority approvals
Division 4A.2 — Reconsideration and review of decisions revoking assessing authority approval
text:
Applications may be made to the ART for review of the following decisions:
可以向 ART 提出申請以審查以下決定：
(a) a decision under subregulation 4.41(3) that is made by the Skills Assessment Minister;
(a) 技能評估部長依據第 4.41(3) 條所做的決定；
(b) a decision under subregulation 4.41(8) that is taken to have been made by the Skills Assessment Minister;
(b) 根據第 4.41(8) 款所做的決定，被認為是由技能評估部長做出的；
(c) a decision under subregulation 4.42(3) that is made by the Skills Assessment Minister.
(c) 技能評估部長依據第 4.42(3) 條所做的決定。

title: Division 5.1 — Service of documents
zh: 第 5.1 分部 — 文件送達

title: 5.01 Definition for Division 5.1
text:
In this Division:
在本部門：
document includes:
文件包括：
(a) a letter; and
(a) 一封信；和
(b) an invitation, notice, notification, statement or summons, if it is in writing.
(b) 邀請、通知、通知、聲明或傳票，如果是書面形式。

title: 5.02 Service of document on person in immigration detention
zh: 5.02 向移民拘留人員送達文件
text:
For the purposes of the Act and these Regulations, a document to be served on a person in immigration detention may be served by giving it to the person himself or herself, or to another person authorised by him or her to receive documents on his or her behalf.
就該法和本條例而言，向移民拘留中的人送達的文件可以送達該人本人，或送達該人授權代表其接收文件的另一人。

title: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
zh: 第 5.2 分部 — 專員及指定機關的程序
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
Note: If a person is proposed to be deported because he or she was convicted of certain serious offences (set out in section 203 of the Act), he or she may ask the Minister to appoint a Commissioner to inquire into whether the grounds for the deportation have been made out.
注意：如果一個人因犯下某些嚴重罪行（該法第 203 條規定）而被提議驅逐出境，他或她可以要求部長任命一名專員來調查驅逐出境的理由是否已成立。
Section 253 of the Act provides that if a person arrested as a deportee asserts that he or she is not the person named in the deportation order, and makes a statutory declaration saying so, the person must be taken before a prescribed authority, who must inquire into whether there are reasonable grounds for supposing the person to be a deportee. The persons who may be prescribed authorities are set out in section 255 and include a judge or former judge, a legal practitioner of at least 5 years’ standing, and a magistrate.
該法第 253 條規定，如果作為被驅逐者被捕的人聲稱他或她不是驅逐令中指定的人，並做出法定聲明，則該人必須被帶到規定的當局面前，該當局必須調查是否有合理的理由認為該人是被驅逐者。第 255 條規定了可以擔任規定權力的人員，包括法官或前法官、具有至少 5 年資歷的法律執業者和治安法官。

title: 5.04 Power of Commissioner to send for witnesses and documents
zh: 5.04 專員傳喚證人和文件的權力
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
A Commissioner appointed under subsection 203(4) of the Act (which deals with the appointment of commissioners) may, by writing signed by the Commissioner, summon any person:
根據該法第 203(4) 款（涉及專員的任命）任命的專員可以透過專員簽署的書面文件傳喚任何人：
(a) to attend before the Commissioner at a time and place specified in the summons; and
(a) 依照傳票中指定的時間和地點出席專員的會議；和
(b) to give evidence; and
(b) 提供證據；和
(c) to produce any books or documents in the person’s custody or control which the person is required by the summons to produce.
(c) 出示傳票要求該人保管或控制的任何書籍或文件。

title: 5.05 Duty of witness to continue in attendance
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) A person who has been summoned to attend before a Commissioner as a witness must appear and report from day to day, unless excused by the Commissioner.
(1) 被傳喚作為證人出庭作證的人必須每天到場並報告，除非得到專員的許可。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(2) Strict liability applies to subregulation (1).
(2) 嚴格責任適用於第 (1) 款。

title: 5.06 Arrest of witness failing to appear
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) If a person who has been summoned to attend before a Commissioner fails:
(1) 若在專員之前被傳喚出席的人未能：
(a) to attend before the Commissioner as required by the summons; or
(a) 依傳票的要求出席專員的會議；或
(b) to appear and report in accordance with regulation 5.05;
(b) 依條例 5.05 出席並報告；
the Commissioner may, on being satisfied that the summons has been duly served and that reasonable expenses have been paid or tendered to the person, issue a warrant for the person’s arrest.
專員在信納傳票已妥為送達以及已向該人支付或交付合理開支後，可發出逮捕令以逮捕該人。
(2) A warrant authorises:
(2) 授權令授權：
(a) the arrest and bringing before the Commissioner of the person; and
(a) 逮捕該人並帶見專員；和
(b) the detention of the person in custody for the purposes specified in the warrant until the person is released by order of the Commissioner.
(b) 為逮捕令中指定的目的而拘留被拘留者，直至專員命令釋放該人。
(3) A warrant may be executed by a member of the police force of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory or by any person to whom it is addressed, and the person executing it has power to break and enter any place, building or vessel, using any force that is necessary and reasonable, for the purpose of executing the warrant.
(3) 逮捕令可以由聯邦、州或地區的警察部隊成員或任何其所針對的人執行，並且執行逮捕令的人有權為執行逮捕令使用任何必要且合理的武力闖入任何地方、建築物或船隻。
(4) The arrest of a person under this regulation does not relieve that person from any liability incurred by the person because of the failure of that person to attend before the Commissioner.
(4) 依本條逮捕某人並不免除該人因未出席專員的任何責任。

title: 5.07 Witnesses’ fees
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) A person who attends to give evidence before a Commissioner is, in respect of that attendance, to be paid such fees and travelling expenses as the Commissioner allows in accordance with the scale in Part 4 of the Public Works Committee Regulation 2016 .
(1) 出席在專員面前作證的人，應根據 2016 年公共工程委員會條例第 4 部分的標準，支付專員允許的費用和差旅費。
(2) The fees and travelling expenses are payable:
(2) 費用及差旅費的繳納：
(a) in the case of a witness summoned at the request of the person to whom the investigation relates—by that person; and
(a) 如果證人是應調查相關人員的請求傳喚的－由該人員傳喚；和
(b) in any other case—by the Commonwealth.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－由聯邦。

title: 5.08 Power to examine on oath or affirmation
zh: 5.08 審查宣誓或誓言的權力
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) A Commissioner may administer an oath to a person appearing as a witness before the Commissioner, whether the witness has been summoned or appears without being summoned, and may examine the witness on oath.
(1) 專員可以對在專員面前作為證人出庭的人進行宣誓，無論該證人是否已被傳喚或未經傳喚而出庭，並且可以對宣誓的證人進行詢問。
(2) If a witness conscientiously objects to swear an oath, the witness may make an affirmation that the witness conscientiously objects to swear an oath and that the witness will state the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth to all questions the witness is asked.
(2) 如果證人出於良心反對宣誓，則該證人可以聲明該證人出於良心反對宣誓，並且證人將陳述事實、全部事實，並且對證人提出的所有問題均陳述事實。
(3) An affirmation so made is of the same force and effect, and entails the same liabilities, as an oath.
(3) 如此所作的誓言與宣誓具有同等效力，並承擔同樣的責任。

title: 5.09 Offences by witnesses
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) A person summoned to attend before a Commissioner as a witness must not:
(1) 被傳喚出庭作證的人不得：
(a) fail to attend, after payment or tender to the person of a reasonable sum for expenses of attendance; or
(a) 在向當事人支付或支付合理的出席費用後未能出席；或
(b) refuse to be sworn or to make an affirmation as a witness; or
(b) 拒絕宣誓或確認為證人；或
(c) refuse to answer any question when required to do so by the Commissioner; or
(c) 在專員要求時拒絕回答任何問題；或
(d) refuse or fail to produce a book or document which the person was required by the summons to produce.
(d) 拒絕或未能出示傳票要求該人出示的書籍或文件。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。
(2) Paragraphs (1)(a) and (d) do not apply if the person has a reasonable excuse.
(2) 若該人有合理的理由，則第 (1)(a) 和 (d) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in subregulation (2) (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就第（2）款的事項負舉證責任（見《刑法》第 13.3（3）款）。
(3) Strict liability applies to paragraph (1)(a).
(3) 嚴格責任適用於第 (1)(a) 款。

title: 5.10 Statements of person not admissible in evidence against the person
zh: 5.10 人的陳述不可採納為針對該人的證據
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
A statement or disclosure made by a person in answer to a question put to the person during an investigation by a Commissioner is not admissible in evidence against the person in any civil or criminal proceedings other than:
一個人為回答專員在調查期間向該人提出的問題而做出的陳述或披露，不得在任何民事或刑事訴訟中被採納為對該人不利的證據，但以下情況除外：
(a) proceedings in respect of a false answer; or
(a) 針對虛假答覆的訴訟；或
(b) proceedings relating to the deportation of the person.
(b) 與驅逐該人有關的程序。

title: 5.11 Representation by counsel etc
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) In an investigation before a Commissioner, the person summoned to appear and the Minister are each entitled to be represented by a barrister or solicitor or by an agent approved by the Commissioner.
(1) 在專員進行調查時，被傳喚出庭的人和部長均有權由大律師或事務律師或經專員批准的代理人代表。
(2) A barrister, solicitor or agent appearing before a Commissioner may examine or cross ‑ examine witnesses and address the Commissioner.
(2) 出庭的大律師、事務律師或代理人可以詢問或交叉詢問證人並向專員講話。

title: 5.12 Offences in relation to Commissioners
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
A person must not:
一個人不得：
(a) intentionally insult or disturb a Commissioner when exercising powers and functions under the Act; or
(a) 在專員依該法行使權力和職能時故意侮辱或騷擾專員；或
(b) interrupt the proceedings of a Commissioner; or
(b) 中斷專員的程序；或
(c) use insulting language towards a Commissioner; or
(c) 對專員使用侮辱性語言；或
(d) by writing or speech use words calculated to influence dishonestly a Commissioner or a witness before a Commissioner.
(d) 透過書面或言語使用旨在不誠實地影響專員或專員面前的證人的言語。
Penalty: 10 penalty units.
處罰：10 個處罰單位。

title: 5.13 Protection of Commissioners, barristers and witnesses
zh: 5.13 保護專員、大律師和證人
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
(1) A Commissioner has, in the performance of the duties of a Commissioner, the same protection and immunity as a Justice of the High Court.
(1) 專員在執行專員職責時享有與高等法院法官相同的保護和豁免權。
(2) A barrister, solicitor or approved agent appearing before a Commissioner has the same protection and immunity as a barrister has in appearing for a party in proceedings in the High Court.
(2) 在專員面前出庭的大律師、事務律師或認可代理人享有與在高等法院訴訟中代表一方出庭的大律師相同的保護和豁免權。
(3) A witness summoned to attend, or appearing, before a Commissioner has the same protection as a witness in proceedings in the High Court.
(3) 被傳喚出席或出庭的證人與高等法院訴訟中的證人享有相同的保護。

title: 5.14 Procedure of prescribed authorities
path: Division 5.2 — Procedure of commissioners and prescribed authorities
text:
This Part applies to:
本部分適用於：
(a) prescribed authorities referred to in section 255 of the Act; and
(a) 該法第 255 條提及的規定權力機構；和
(b) proceedings before those prescribed authorities under section 253 of the Act;
(b) 依該法第 253 條向規定的機關提起訴訟；
in the same manner as it applies to Commissioners and proceedings before Commissioners and as if references in those provisions to a Commissioner were references to a prescribed authority.
以與適用於專員和專員訴訟程序相同的方式，並且這些條款中對專員的提及是對規定權力的提及。

title: Division 5.3 — General
zh: 第 5.3 分部 — 一般規定

title: 5.15 Behaviour concern non ‑ citizen
5.15A Special category visas—declared classes of New Zealand citizens
zh: 5.15A 特殊類別簽證－紐西蘭公民的聲明類別
text:
(1) For paragraph 32(2)(c) of the Act, a person is in a class of persons for whom a visa of a class other than a special category visa would be inappropriate if the person:
(1) 對於該法第 32(2)(c) 款，如果某人符合下列條件，則該人屬於不適合特殊類別簽證以外類別簽證的人員：
(a) is a New Zealand citizen who holds, and has presented to an officer, a New Zealand passport that is in force; and
(a) 是紐西蘭公民，持有並向官員出示有效的紐西蘭護照；和
(b) is not a health concern non ‑ citizen; and
(b) 不是有健康問題的非公民；和
(c) is covered by subregulation (2) or (3).
(c) 屬於第 (2) 或 (3) 款的範圍。
(2) A person is covered by this subregulation if the person is a behaviour concern non ‑ citizen only because of having been excluded from a country other than Australia in circumstances that, in the opinion of the Minister, do not warrant the exclusion of the person from Australia.
(2) 如果某人是非公民行為，僅因為在部長認為不值得將該人驅逐出澳洲的情況下被澳洲以外的國家驅逐出境，則該人受本款管轄。
(3) A person is covered by this subregulation if:
(3) 若符合下列條件，則受本款管轄：
(a) the Minister has, under subsection 501(3A) of the Act (person serving sentence of imprisonment), cancelled a visa held by the person; and
(a) 部長已根據該法第 501(3A) 款（服刑人員）取消了該人員持有的簽證；和
(b) the person has made representations to the Minister in accordance with the invitation given by the Minister under subsection 501CA(3) of the Act; and
(b) 該人已根據部長根據該法第 501CA(3) 款發出的邀請向部長作出陳述；和
(c) the decision to cancel the visa is revoked under subsection 501CA(4) of the Act; and
(c) 依該法第 501CA(4) 款撤銷取消簽證的決定；和
(d) the Minister has not, under subsection 501BA(2) of the Act, set aside the decision to revoke the cancellation of the visa; and
(d) 部長沒有根據該法第 501BA(2) 款撤銷撤銷取消簽證的決定；和
(e) since the person made the representations to the Minister mentioned in paragraph (b), no new grounds have arisen for the person to fall within the definition of behaviour concern non ‑ citizen in subsection 5(1) of the Act, unless the only new ground that has arisen is the person’s removal or deportation from Australia because of the decision to cancel the visa.
(e) 自該人向部長提出(b)段中提到的陳述以來，沒有出現任何新的理由使該人屬於該法第5(1)款中有關非公民的行為定義的範圍，除非出現的唯一新理由是該人因取消簽證的決定而被從澳大利亞驅逐或驅逐出境。
(4) For the purposes of paragraph 32(2)(c) of the Act, a declared class of persons for whom a visa of another class would be inappropriate is New Zealand citizens:
(4) 就該法第 32(2)(c) 條而言，不適合其他類別簽證的申報類別人員是紐西蘭公民：
(a) who hold a New Zealand passport that:
(a) 持有紐西蘭護照且：
(i) is in force; and
(i) 有效；和
(ii) is of a kind determined under section 175A of the Act to be an eligible passport for the purposes of Division 5 of Part 2 of the Act; and
(ii) 根據該法第 175A 條確定為符合該法第 2 部分第 5 節規定的合格護照；和
(b) who have presented an image of their face by presenting themselves to an authorised system and who, as a result, have been satisfactorily identified; and
(b) 透過向授權系統展示自己的臉部影像，並最終得到滿意的識別；和
(c) who are neither behaviour concern non ‑ citizens nor health concern non ‑ citizens.
(c) 行為既不涉及非公民，也不涉及健康的非公民。
(5) In this regulation:
（五）本規定：
authorised system means an automated system that is an authorised system for the purposes of section 32 of the Act.
授權系統是指就該法案第 32 條而言屬於授權系統的自動化系統。

title: 5.15C Excised offshore places
text:
(1) For paragraph (d) of the definition of excised offshore place in subsection 5(1) of the Act, the Coral Sea Islands Territory is prescribed.
(1) 對於該法第 5(1) 款中的離岸割據定義的第 (d) 款，規定了珊瑚海群島領土。
(2) For paragraph (e) of the definition of excised offshore place in subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following islands are prescribed:
(2) 對於該法第 5(1) 款中的離岸割據定義的第 (e) 款，規定了下列島嶼：
(a) all islands that:
(a) 所有島嶼：
(i) form part of Queensland; and
(i) 成為昆士蘭的一部分；和
(ii) are north of latitude 21  south;
(ii) 位於南緯 21° 以北；
(b) all islands that:
(b) 所有島嶼：
(i) form part of Western Australia; and
(i) 構成西澳大利亞州的一部分；和
(ii) are north of latitude 23  south;
(ii) 位於南緯 23° 以北；
(c) all islands that:
(c) 所有島嶼：
(i) form part of the Northern Territory; and
(i) 構成北領地的一部分；和
(ii) are north of latitude 16  south.
(ii) 位於南緯 16° 以北。

title: 5.16 Prescribed diseases—health concern non ‑ citizen (Act, s 5(1))
zh: 5.16 規定疾病－非公民健康問題（法案第 5(1) 條）
text:
For the purposes of the definition of health concern non ‑ citizen in subsection 5(1) of the Act, tuberculosis (being tuberculosis that is not being controlled with medication, and in respect of which the person suffering from it refuses to sign an undertaking to visit a Commonwealth Medical Officer within 7 days of entering Australia) is a prescribed disease.
就該法第 5(1) 小節中對健康問題非公民的定義而言，結核病（未通過藥物控制的結核病，並且患者拒絕簽署在進入澳大利亞後 7 天內拜訪聯邦醫療官員的承諾書）是一種規定疾病。

title: 5.17 Prescribed evidence of English language proficiency (Act, s 5(2)(b))
zh: 5.17 英語語言能力的規定證據（法案第 5(2)(b) 條）
text:
For the purposes of paragraph 5(2)(b) of the Act (dealing with whether a person has functional English), the evidence referred to in each of the following paragraphs is prescribed evidence of the English language proficiency of a person:
就該法案第 5(2)(b) 段（涉及一個人是否具有實用英語）而言，以下各段中提到的證據是一個人的英語語言能力的規定證據：
(a) evidence specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph;
(a) 部長在書面文件中為本款所規定的證據；
(c) evidence that:
(c) 證據顯示：
(i) the person holds an award (being a degree, a higher degree, a diploma or a trade certificate) that required at least 2 years of full ‑ time study or training; and
(i) 該人持有需要至少 2 年全日制學習或培訓的獎項（學位、高級學位、文憑或行業證書）；和
(ii) all instruction (including instruction received in other courses for which the person was allowed credit) for that award was conducted in English;
(ii) 該獎項的所有教學（包括該人獲得學分的其他課程中接受的教學）均以英語進行；
(d) if evidence referred to in paragraph (a) cannot be provided by the person—evidence that the person has been determined by the Minister, on the basis of an interview with the person, to have functional English.
(d) 如果該人無法提供(a)段中提到的證據－部長根據與該人的面談確定該人具有實用英語的證據。
