title: 5.19 Approval of nominated positions—Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa and Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa
zh: 5.19 提名職位的批准－186類（雇主提名計畫）簽證和187類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證
text:
Application
應用
(1) A person (the nominator ) (including a partnership or unincorporated association) may apply to the Minister for approval of the nomination of a position in Australia.
(1) 個人（提名人）（包括合夥或非法人團體）可以向部長申請批准澳洲職位的提名。
(2) The application must:
(2) 申請必須：
(aa) if the application identifies a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa—be made before 16 November 2019 (subject to subclause (2A)); and
(aa) 如果申請確定為 187 子類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證－應在 2019 年 11 月 16 日之前提出（根據第 (2A) 款）；和
(a) subject to subregulation (2AA), be made using the form specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this paragraph; and
(a) 根據第 (2AA) 款的規定，採用部長在為本段目的製定的立法文書中指定的格式；和
(b) identify the position; and
(b) 確定立場；和
(c) identify a person (the identified person ) in relation to the position; and
(c) 識別與該職位相關的人員（已識別人員）；和
(d) identify an occupation in relation to the position; and
(d) 確定與該職位相關的職業；和
(e) identify the subclass and stream to which the nomination relates, which must be one of the following:
(e) 確定提名所涉及的子類別和類別，必須是以下之一：
(i) a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream;
(i) 臨時居住過渡類別的 186 類（雇主提名計畫）簽證；
(ii) a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream;
(ii) 臨時居留過渡類別中的 187 子類別（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證；
(iii) a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Direct Entry stream;
(iii) 直接入境類別的 186 類（雇主提名計畫）簽證；
(iv) Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Direct Entry stream;
(iv) 直接入境類別中的 187 類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證；
(v) a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Labour Agreement stream; and
(v) 勞動協議類別中的 186 類（雇主提名計畫）簽證；和
(f) be accompanied by the fee mentioned in regulation 5.37; and
(f) 附有第 5.37 條所提及的費用；和
(fa) be accompanied by any nomination training contribution charge the nominator is liable to pay in relation to the nomination; and
(fa) 附有提名人應支付的與提名相關的任何提名培訓費用；和
(fb) identify the annual turnover (within the meaning of the Migration (Skilling Australians Fund) Charges Regulations 2018 ) for the nomination; and
(fb) 確定提名的年營業額（符合《2018 年移民（澳洲技能基金）收費條例》的涵義）；和
(g) include a written certification by the nominator stating whether or not the nominator has engaged in conduct, in relation to the nomination, that constitutes a contravention of subsection 245AR(1) of the Act.
(g) 包括提名人的書面證明，說明提名人是否從事與提名相關的行為，構成違反該法案第 245AR(1) 款的行為。
(2A) Paragraph (2)(aa) does not apply if:
(2A) 第 (2)(aa) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) the application identifies a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream; and
(a) 申請在臨時居留過渡類別中確定了 187 子類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證；和
(b) the identified person is a transitional 457 worker or transitional 482 worker at the time the application is made.
(b) 所確定的人員在提出申請時是過渡性 457 工人或過渡性 482 工人。
(2AA) For the purposes of paragraph (2)(a):
(2AA) 就第 (2)(a) 款而言：
(a) if the Minister specifies, in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this subregulation, a different way of making an application in circumstances specified in the instrument, the application may be made in that way; and
(a) 如果部長在為本款目的而製定的立法文書中規定了在文書中規定的情況下提出申請的不同方式，則可以以該方式提出申請；和
(b) if the Minister specifies in the instrument a form for the different way of making the application, the application must be made using that form.
(b) 如果部長在文書中指定了提出申請的不同方式的表格，則必須使用該表格提出申請。
Approval of nomination
批准提名
(3) The Minister must, in writing:
(3) 部長必須以書面：
(a) approve the nomination if the Minister is satisfied that the requirements set out in subregulation (4) are met; or
(a) 若部長認為符合第 (4) 款規定的要求，則批准提名；或
(b) otherwise—refuse to approve the nomination.
(b) 否則－拒絕批准提名。
Requirements for approval—general
批准要求－一般
(4) The requirements to be met for the nomination to be approved are as follows:
（四）提名獲得批准應具備的條件：
(a) the application is made in accordance with subregulation (2);
(a) 申請是根據第(2)款提出的；
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) there is no adverse information known to Immigration about the nominator or a person associated with the nominator; or
(i) 移民局不知道提名人或與提名人有關的人的不利資訊；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any adverse information known to Immigration about the nominator or a person associated with the nominator;
(ii) 可以合理地忽略移民局已知的有關提名人或與提名人有關的人員的任何不利資訊；
(c) if it is mandatory, in the State or Territory in which the position is located, for a person to:
(c) 如果是強制性的，則在該職位所在的州或地區，個人必須：
(i) hold a licence of a particular kind; or
(i) 持有特定種類的許可證；或
(ii) hold registration of a particular kind; or
(ii) 持有特定種類的註冊；或
(iii) be a member (or a member of a particular kind) of a particular professional body;
(iii) 是特定專業團體的成員（或特定類別的成員）；
to perform tasks of the kind to be performed in the occupation, the identified person is, or is eligible to become, the holder of the licence, the holder of the registration, or a member of the body, at the time of application;
為了執行該職業中要執行的任務，所確定的人在申請時是或有資格成為許可證持有者、註冊持有者或機構成員；
(d) the nominator has a satisfactory record of compliance with the laws of the Commonwealth, and of each State or Territory in which the nominator operates a business and employs employees in the business, relating to employment;
(d) 提名人在遵守澳洲聯邦以及提名人經營業務並在業務中僱用員工的每個州或地區的法律方面擁有令人滿意的記錄；
(da) any debt due by the nominator as mentioned in section 140ZO of the Act (recovery of nomination training contribution charge and late payment penalty) has been paid in full;
(da) 該法案第 140ZO 條中提到的提名人到期的任何債務（收回提名培訓費和滯納金）已全額支付；
(e) if the nomination relates to a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream—the requirements set out in subregulation (5) are met;
(e) 若提名涉及臨時居留過渡類別中的 186 子類（雇主提名計畫）簽證，則符合第 (5) 款規定的要求；
(ea) if the nomination relates to a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream—the requirements set out in subregulation (5A) are met;
(ea) 若提名涉及臨時居住過渡類別中的 187 子類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證，則符合第 (5A) 款所規定的要求；
(f) if the nomination relates to a visa in a Direct Entry stream—the requirements set out in subregulation (9) are met;
(f) 若提名涉及直接入境簽證－符合第 (9) 款規定的要求；
(g) if the nomination relates to a visa in a Labour Agreement stream—the requirements set out in subregulation (14) are met.
(g) 若提名涉及勞工協議流中的簽證－則符合第 (14) 款規定的要求。
Additional requirements for approval—nominations relating to the Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream .
與臨時居留過渡類別中的 186 類（雇主提名計劃）簽證相關的批准提名的附加要求。
(5) If the nomination relates to a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream, the following requirements must also be met:
(5) 如果提名涉及臨時居留過渡類別中的186子類（雇主提名計畫）簽證，也必須滿足以下要求：
(a) at the time the application is made, the identified person holds:
(a) 在提出申請時，所確定的人持有：
(i) a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa; or
(i) 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；或
(ii) a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; or
(ii) 482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；或
(iia) a Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa; or
(iia) 482 子類（需求技能）簽證；或
(iii) if the last substantive visa held by the identified person was a visa mentioned in subparagraph (i), (ii) or (iia)—a bridging visa granted on the basis that the person is an applicant for a visa mentioned in subparagraph (i), (ii) or (iia), a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa or a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa;
(iii) 如果所識別人員持有的最後一個實質性簽證是第 (i)、(ii) 或 (iia) 項中提到的簽證－根據該人是第 (i)、(ii) 或 (iia) 項中提到的簽證、186 類（雇主提名計劃）或 187 類簽證（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證申請人而授予的橋接過簽證申請人；
(b) the occupation:
(b) 職業：
(i) is listed in ANZSCO; and
(i) 在 ANZSCO 上市；和
(ii) is the same occupation in relation to which the identified person’s most recently held Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa, Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa or Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa was granted;
(ii) 與所識別人員最近持有的 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證、482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證或 482 類（需求技能）簽證所授予的職業相同；
(d) either:
(d) 任一：
(i) there is no information known to Immigration that indicates that the identified person is not genuinely performing the tasks of the occupation as specified in ANZSCO; or
(i) 移民局沒有掌握任何資訊表示所認定的人員沒有真正履行 ANZSCO 中規定的職業任務；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any such information;
(ii) 忽略任何此類資訊是合理的；
(h) the nominator:
(h) 提名人：
(i) was the standard business sponsor, or the party to a work agreement, who last identified the identified person in a nomination approved under section 140GB of the Act; and
(i) 是標準業務發起人或工作協議的一方，最後在根據該法案第 140GB 條批准的提名中確定了所確定的人員；和
(ii) is actively and lawfully operating a business in Australia;
(ii) 在澳洲積極合法地經營業務；
(j) the application identifies a need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(j) 申請顯示需要在提名人的直接控制下僱用所確定的人員擔任該職位；
(k) there is a genuine need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(k) 確實需要受僱於提名人直接控制的職位；
(l) the identified person will be employed on a full ‑ time basis in the position for at least 2 years;
(l) 所確定的人員將在該職位上全職工作至少 2 年；
(m) the terms and conditions of the identified person’s employment will not include an express exclusion of the possibility of extending the period of employment;
(m) 特定人員的僱用條款和條件不包括明確排除延長僱用期限的可能性；
(n) the nominator’s business has the capacity to employ the identified person for at least 2 years and to pay the person at least the annual market salary rate for the occupation each year;
(n) 提名人的企業有能力僱用指定人員至少兩年，並每年至少向該人員支付該職業的市場年薪；
(o) the requirements set out in subregulation 2.72(15) are met, applying subregulations 2.72(15) and (16) as if:
(o) 符合第 2.72(15) 款規定的要求，應用第 2.72(15) 和 (16) 款，假設：
(i) paragraph 2.72(15)(a) did not apply; and
(i) 第 2.72(15)(a) 段不適用；和
(ii) references to the nominee were references to the identified person; and
(ii) 提及被提名人即提及已確定的人；和
(iii) references to the person were references to the nominator; and
(iii) 提及該人即提及提名人；和
(iv) the words in paragraph 2.72(15)(d) were replaced with “the annual market salary rate, excluding any non ‑ monetary benefits, for the occupation (determined by the person in accordance with an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(17)) is not less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”; and
(iv) 將第2.72(15)(d)段的文字替換為「該職業的年市場工資率，不包括任何非貨幣福利（由該人根據第2.72(17)款制定的文書確定）不低於核心技能收入門檻的數額」；和
(v) the words in paragraph 2.72(15)(f) were replaced with “the identified person’s annual earnings, excluding any non ‑ monetary benefits, in relation to the occupation will not be less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”; and
(v) 將第2.72(15)(f)段的文字替換為「所確定的人員與職業相關的年收入，不包括任何非貨幣福利，將不低於核心技能收入門檻的數額」；和
(vi) the words in subparagraph 2.72(16)(a)(i) were replaced with “the annual market salary rate for the occupation (determined by the person in accordance with an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(17)) is not less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”;
(vi) 將第 2.72(16)(a)(i) 項中的文字替換為「該職業的年度市場工資率（由該人員根據第 2.72(17) 款制定的文書確定）不低於核心技能收入門檻金額」；
(p) either:
(p) 任一：
(i) there is no information known to Immigration that indicates that the employment conditions (other than in relation to earnings) that will apply to the identified person are less favourable than those that apply, or would apply, to an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident performing equivalent work at the same location; or
(i) 移民局未掌握任何資訊顯示適用於已確定人員的就業條件（與收入相關的除外）不如適用於或將適用於在同一地點從事同等工作的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民的就業條件；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any such information;
(ii) 忽略任何此類資訊是合理的；
(q) the nominator has provided the information required by the Minister for the purposes of paragraph (k) to (n).
(q) 提名人已提供部長為第 (k) 至 (n) 段之目的所需的資訊。
Additional requirements for approval—nominations relating to the Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream .
與臨時居留過渡類別中的 187 類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證相關的批准提名的附加要求。
(5A) If the nomination relates to a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream, the following requirements must also be met:
(5A) 如果提名涉及臨時居住過渡類別中的 187 子類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證，則必須滿足以下要求：
(a) at the time the application is made, the identified person holds:
(a) 在提出申請時，所確定的人持有：
(i) a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa; or
(i) 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；或
(ii) a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; or
(ii) 482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；或
(iii) if the last substantive visa held by the identified person was a visa mentioned in subparagraph (i) or (ii)—a bridging visa granted on the basis that the person is an applicant for a visa mentioned in subparagraph (i) or (ii), a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa or a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa;
(iii) 如果所識別人員持有的最後一個實質性簽證是第 (i) 或 (ii) 項中提到的簽證－基於該人是第 (i) 或 (ii) 項中提到的簽證申請人而授予的過橋簽證、186 類（雇主提名計劃）簽證或 187 類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證；
(b) the occupation:
(b) 職業：
(i) is listed in ANZSCO; and
(i) 在 ANZSCO 上市；和
(ii) has the same 4 ‑ digit ANZSCO occupation unit group code as the occupation in relation to which the identified person’s most recently held Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa or Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa was granted;
(ii) 具有與已識別人員最近持有的 457 類（臨時工作（技術））簽證或 482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證所涉及的職業相同的 4 位數 ANZSCO 職業單位組代碼；
(c) either:
(c) 任一：
(i) there is no information known to Immigration that indicates that the identified person is not genuinely performing the tasks of the occupation as specified in ANZSCO; or
(i) 移民局沒有掌握任何資訊表示所認定的人員沒有真正履行 ANZSCO 中規定的職業任務；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any such information;
(ii) 忽略任何此類資訊是合理的；
(d) during the period of 3 years immediately before the application is made, the identified person held one or more of the following for a total period of at least 2 years:
(d) 在提出申請之前的 3 年內，所確定的人員持有以下一項或多項的總期限至少為 2 年：
(i) a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa;
(i) 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；
(ii) a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa;
(ii) 482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；
(e) unless paragraph (f) applies—during the period of 3 years immediately before the application is made, the identified person was employed in the position in relation to which the visa, or visas, mentioned in paragraph (d) were granted:
(e) 除非(f)段適用－在提出申請之前的3年內，所確定的人員曾擔任與(d)段中提到的一個或多個簽證被授予相關的職位：
(i) for a total period of at least 2 years (not including any periods of unpaid leave); and
(i) 總期限至少為 2 年（不包括任何無薪假期）；和
(ii) on a full ‑ time basis, with the employment being undertaken in Australia;
(ii) 全職工作，並在澳洲從事工作；
(f) if the visa, or visas, mentioned in paragraph (d) were granted in relation to an occupation specified in an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(13)—during the period of 3 years immediately before the application is made, the identified person was employed in the occupation for a total period of at least 2 years (not including any periods of unpaid leave);
(f) 如果(d)段中所提及的一個或多個簽證是針對根據第2.72(13)款所訂定的文書中指定的職業而簽發的－在提出申請之前的3年內，所確定的人員在該職業中受僱的總時間至少為2年（不包括任何無薪休假的時間）；
(g) the nominator:
(g) 提名人：
(i) was the standard business sponsor, or the party to a work agreement, who last identified the identified person in a nomination approved under section 140GB of the Act; and
(i) 是標準業務發起人或工作協議的一方，最後在根據該法案第 140GB 條批准的提名中確定了所確定的人員；和
(ii) is actively and lawfully operating a business in Australia;
(ii) 在澳洲積極合法地經營業務；
(h) the application identifies a need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(h) 申請顯示需要在提名人的直接控制下僱用所確定的人員擔任該職位；
(i) there is a genuine need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(i) 確實需要受僱於提名人直接控制的職位；
(j) the identified person will be employed on a full ‑ time basis in the position for at least 2 years;
(j) 所確定的人員將在該職位上全職工作至少 2 年；
(k) the terms and conditions of the identified person’s employment will not include an express exclusion of the possibility of extending the period of employment;
(k) 所識別人員的僱用條款和條件不包括明確排除延長僱用期限的可能性；
(l) the nominator’s business has the capacity to employ the identified person for at least 2 years and to pay the person at least the annual market salary rate for the occupation each year;
(l) 提名人的企業有能力僱用指定人員至少兩年，並每年至少向該人員支付該職業的市場年薪；
(m) requirements set out in subregulation 2.72C(15) are met, applying subregulations 2.72C(15) and (16) as if:
(m) 符合第 2.72C(15) 款規定的要求，應用第 2.72C(15) 和 (16) 款，假設：
(i) paragraph 2.72C(15)(a) did not apply; and
(i) 第 2.72C(15)(a) 段不適用；和
(ii) references to the nominee were references to the identified person; and
(ii) 提及被提名人即提及已確定的人；和
(iii) references to the person were references to the nominator;
(iii) 提及該人即提及提名人；
(n) either:
(n) 任一：
(i) there is no information known to Immigration that indicates that the employment conditions (other than in relation to earnings) that will apply to the identified person are less favourable than those that apply, or would apply, to an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident performing equivalent work at the same location; or
(i) 移民局未掌握任何資訊顯示適用於已確定人員的就業條件（與收入相關的除外）不如適用於或將適用於在同一地點從事同等工作的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民的就業條件；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any such information;
(ii) 忽略任何此類資訊是合理的；
(o) the nominator has provided the information required by the Minister for the purposes of paragraphs (i) to (l) of this subregulation.
(o) 提名人已提供部長為本條第 (i) 至 (l) 款所要求的資訊。
Minister may vary certain Temporary Residence Transition stream requirements
部長可能會改變某些臨時居留過渡流的要求
(6) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine different periods of time for the purposes of paragraphs (5A)(d), (e) and (f) for persons specified in the instrument.
(6) 部長可以透過立法文書，為文書中指定的人員確定第 (5A)(d)、(e) 和 (f) 款的不同期限。
(7) Paragraphs (5)(j), (k) and (l) and (5A)(h), (i) and (j) do not apply in relation to occupations specified in an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(13).
(7) 第(5)(j)、(k)和(l)款以及(5A)(h)、(i)和(j)款不適用於根據第2.72(13)款制定的文書中規定的職業。
Direct Entry stream—additional requirements for approval
直接進入流－批准的附加要求
(9) If the nomination relates to a visa in a Direct Entry stream, the following requirements must also be met:
(9) 如果提名涉及直接入境簽證，則必須滿足以下要求：
(a) the nominator is actively and lawfully operating a business in Australia;
(a) 提名人在澳洲積極合法地經營業務；
(b) if the nominator’s business activities include activities related to the hiring of labour to other unrelated businesses—the position is within the business activities of the nominator and not for hire to other unrelated businesses;
(b) 若提名人的業務活動包括與向其他不相關企業聘用勞動力相關的活動，則該職位屬於提名人的業務活動範圍內，且不用於僱用其他不相關企業；
(c) the application identifies a need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(c) 申請顯示需要在提名人的直接控制下僱用所確定的人員擔任該職位；
(d) there is a genuine need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(d) 確實需要受僱於提名人直接控制的職位；
(e) the identified person will be employed on a full ‑ time basis in the position for at least 2 years;
(e) 所確定的人員將在該職位上全職工作至少 2 年；
(f) the terms and conditions of the identified person’s employment will not include an express exclusion of the possibility of extending the period of employment;
(f) 所認定人員的僱用條款和條件不包括明確排除延長僱用期限的可能性；
(g) the nominator’s business has the capacity to employ the identified person for at least 2 years and to pay the person at least the annual market salary rate for the occupation each year;
(g) 提名人的企業有能力僱用指定人員至少兩年，並每年至少向該人員支付該職業的市場年薪；
(h) the requirements set out in subregulation 2.72(15) are met, applying subregulations 2.72(15) and (16) as if:
(h) 符合第 2.72(15) 款規定的要求，應用第 2.72(15) 和 (16) 款，假設：
(i) paragraph 2.72(15)(a) did not apply; and
(i) 第 2.72(15)(a) 段不適用；和
(ii) references to the nominee were references to the identified person; and
(ii) 提及被提名人即提及已確定的人；和
(iii) references to the person were references to the nominator; and
(iii) 提及該人即提及提名人；和
(iv) the words in paragraph 2.72(15)(d) were replaced with “the annual market salary rate, excluding any non ‑ monetary benefits, for the occupation (determined by the person in accordance with an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(17)) is not less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”; and
(iv) 將第2.72(15)(d)段的文字替換為「該職業的年市場工資率，不包括任何非貨幣福利（由該人根據第2.72(17)款制定的文書確定）不低於核心技能收入門檻的數額」；和
(v) the words in paragraph 2.72(15)(f) were replaced with “the identified person’s annual earnings, excluding any non ‑ monetary benefits, in relation to the occupation will not be less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”; and
(v) 將第2.72(15)(f)段的文字替換為「所確定的人員與職業相關的年收入，不包括任何非貨幣福利，將不低於核心技能收入門檻的數額」；和
(vi) the words in subparagraph 2.72(16)(a)(i) were replaced with “the annual market salary rate for the occupation (determined by the person in accordance with an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(17)) is not less than the amount of the core skills income threshold”;
(vi) 將第 2.72(16)(a)(i) 項中的文字替換為「該職業的年度市場工資率（由該人員根據第 2.72(17) 款制定的文書確定）不低於核心技能收入門檻金額」；
(i) either:
(i) 任一：
(i) there is no information known to Immigration that indicates that the employment conditions (other than in relation to earnings) that will apply to the identified person are less favourable than those that apply, or would apply, to an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident performing equivalent work at the same location; or
(i) 移民局未掌握任何資訊顯示適用於已確定人員的就業條件（與收入相關的除外）不如適用於或將適用於在同一地點從事同等工作的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民的就業條件；或
(ii) it is reasonable to disregard any such information;
(ii) 忽略任何此類資訊是合理的；
(j) the requirements set out in subregulation (10) or (12) are met.
(j) 符合第 (10) 或 (12) 款規定的要求。
Occupations for the Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa in the Direct Entry stream
直接入境類別中186子類（雇主提名計畫）簽證的職業
(10) The requirements of this subregulation are as follows:
(10) 本款的要求如下：
(a) the tasks to be performed in the position will be performed in Australia and correspond to the tasks of an occupation specified in a legislative instrument:
(a) 該職位要執行的任務將在澳洲執行，並且與立法文件中規定的職業任務相對應：
(i) made under subregulation (11); and
(i) 根據第(11)款制定；和
(ii) in force at the time the application is made;
(ii) 提出申請時有效；
(b) the occupation applies to the identified person in accordance with that instrument.
(b) 該職業適用於根據該文書所確定的人員。
(11) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify occupations for the purposes of subregulation (10) and, for each occupation, specify any matters for the purposes of determining whether the occupation applies to an identified person, including matters relating to any of the following:
(11) 部長可以透過立法文書，為第 (10) 款的目的指定職業，並為每種職業指定任何事項，以確定該職業是否適用於特定人員，包括與以下任何一項有關的事項：
(a) the nominator;
(a) 提名人；
(b) the identified person;
(b) 已識別的人員；
(c) the occupation;
(c) 職業；
(d) the position in which the identified person is to work;
(d) 所識別人員的工作職位；
(e) the circumstances in which the occupation is undertaken;
(e) 進行佔領的情況；
(f) the circumstances in which the person is to be employed in the position.
(f) 僱用此人擔任該職位的情況。
Occupations for the Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Direct Entry stream
直接入境類別中 187 子類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證的職業
(12) The requirements of this subregulation are as follows:
(12) 本款的要求如下：
(a) the position is located at a place in regional Australia;
(a) 該職位位於澳洲偏遠地區；
(b) the business operated by the nominator is located at that place;
(b) 提名人經營的業務位於該地點；
(c) the position cannot be filled by an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident who is living in, or would move to, the local area concerned;
(c) 該職位不能由居住在或將搬到相關當地地區的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民擔任；
(d) the tasks to be performed in the position correspond to the tasks of an occupation specified in a legislative instrument:
(d) 該職位要執行的任務與立法文書中所規定的職業任務相對應：
(i) made under subregulation (13); and
(i) 根據第(13)款制定；和
(ii) as in force at the time the application is made;
(ii) 提出申請時有效；
(e) the occupation applies to the identified person in accordance with that instrument;
(e) 該職業適用於根據該文書所確定的人員；
(f) the Minister has been advised by a body that meets the requirements set out in paragraph (g) of this subregulation about matters relating to the following:
(f) 符合本條 (g) 款規定要求的機構已就下列事項向部長提供建議：
(i) whether the identified person would be paid at least the annual market salary rate for the occupation;
(i) 所確定的人員是否將至少獲得該職業的年度市場工資率；
(ii) whether there is a genuine need for the identified person to be employed in the position, under the direct control of the nominator;
(ii) 是否確實需要受僱於提名人直接控制的職位；
(iii) whether the position can be filled by an Australian citizen or an Australian permanent resident who is living in, or would move to, the local area concerned;
(iii) 該職位是否可以由居住在或將搬到有關當地地區的澳洲公民或澳洲永久居民擔任；
(g) the body must:
(g) 該機構必須：
(i) be specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for the purposes of this paragraph; and
(i) 在部長為本段目的而製定的立法文書中明確；和
(ii) be located in the State or Territory in which the position is located; and
(ii) 位於該職位所在的州或地區；和
(iii) have responsibility for the local area in which the position is located.
(iii) 對職位所在地區負責。
(13) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify occupations for the purposes of subregulation (12) and, for each occupation, specify any matters for the purposes of determining whether the occupation applies to an identified person, including matters relating to any of the following:
(13) 部长可以通过立法文书，为第 (12) 款的目的指定职业，并为每种职业指定任何事项，以确定该职业是否适用于特定人员，包括与以下任何一项有关的事项：
(a) the nominator;
(a) 提名人；
(b) the identified person;
(b) 已識別的人員；
(c) the occupation;
(c) 職業；
(d) the position in which the identified person is to work;
(d) 所識別人員的工作職位；
(e) the circumstances in which the occupation is undertaken;
(e) 進行佔領的情況；
(f) the circumstances in which the person is to be employed in the position.
(f) 僱用此人擔任該職位的情況。
Labour Agreement stream—additional requirements for approval
勞動協議流－批准的附加要求
(14) If the nomination relates to a visa in a Labour Agreement stream, the following requirements must also be met:
(14) 如果提名涉及勞工協議流中的簽證，也必須滿足以下要求：
(a) the nominator is a party to a labour agreement;
(a) 提名人是勞動協定的一方；
(b) the labour agreement:
(b) 勞動協定：
(i) is in effect; and
(i) 有效；和
(ii) specifies the occupation as one in relation to which a position may be nominated for the purposes of this regulation;
(ii) 為本條例之目的指定可提名職位的相關職業；
(c) if the labour agreement specifies requirements that must be met by a party to the labour agreement—the requirements of the labour agreement have been met;
(c) 如果勞動協議規定了勞動協議一方必須滿足的要求－勞動協議的要求已得到滿足；
(d) the number of nominations approved by the Minister under this regulation on application by the nominator is less than the number of approved nominations permitted under the labour agreement for the year.
(d) 部長根據本條例根據提名人的申請批准的提名數量少於當年勞工協議允許的批准提名數量。
Minister must give notice of approval or refusal
部長必須發出批准或拒絕通知
(15) As soon as practicable after deciding whether to approve, or refuse to approve, the nomination, the Minister must give the nominator:
(15) 在決定是否批准或拒絕批准提名後，部長必須盡快提供提名人：
(a) a copy of the written approval or refusal; and
(a) 書面批准或拒絕的副本；和
(b) if the Minister refuses to approve the nomination:
(b) 若部長拒絕批准提名：
(i) a written statement of the reasons why the nomination was refused; and
(i) 書面說明拒絕提名的原因；和
(ii) a written statement that the decision is a reviewable migration decision.
(ii) 書面聲明，表明該決定是可審查的移民決定。
Note: Division 4.1 deals with review of decisions. Paragraph 4.02(4)(e) provides that a decision under regulation 5.19 to refuse an application is a reviewable migration decision.
註：第 4.1 節涉及決策審查。第 4.02(4)(e) 款規定，根據第 5.19 條作出的拒絕申請的決定是可審查的移民決定。
Meaning of regional Australia
澳洲地區的含義
(16) In this regulation:
（十六）本規定：
regional Australia means a part of Australia specified in legislative instrument made by the Minister for the purposes of this definition.
澳洲地區是指部長為本定義目的而製定的立法文書中指定的澳洲的一部分。

title: 5.19A Designated investment
text:
(1) Subject to subregulation (2), the Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify a security issued by an Australian State or Territory government authority as a security in which an investment is a designated investment for the purposes of a Part of Schedule 2.
(1) 根据第 (2) 款，部长可通过立法文书，指定澳大利亚州或领地政府机构发行的证券为附表 2 部分所指的指定投资的证券。
(2) The Minister may so specify a security if and only if:
(2) 當且僅當下列情況時，部長才可指定擔保：
(a) an investment in the security matures in not less than 4 years from its date of issue; and
(a) 證券投資自發行日起不少於 4 年到期；和
(b) repayment of principal is guaranteed by the issuing authority; and
(b) 發行機構保證本金的償還；和
(c) an investment in the security cannot be transferred or redeemed before maturity except by operation of law or under other conditions acceptable to the Minister; and
(c) 證券投資不得在到期前轉讓或贖回，除非透過法律執行或部長可接受的其他條件；和
(d) investment in the security is open to the general public at commercially competitive rates of return; and
(d) 證券投資以具有商業競爭力的回報率向公眾開放；和
(e) the Minister is satisfied that the Commonwealth will not be exposed to any liability as a result of an investment in the security by a person.
(e) 部長信納聯邦不會因個人投資證券而承擔任何責任。

title: 5.19B Complying investment
text:
(1) An investment by a person (the investor ) is a complying investment if all of the requirements in this regulation are met.
(1) 若符合本條例中的所有要求，則個人（投資者）的投資即為合規投資。
Description
描述
(2) The investment must consist of one or more of the following:
(2) 投資必須包括以下一項或多項：
(a) an investment in a government bond (however described) of the Commonwealth, a State or Territory; or
(a) 對聯邦、州或領地政府債券（無論如何描述）的投資；或
(b) a direct investment in an Australian proprietary company that meets the following requirements:
(b) 對符合下列要求的澳洲專有公司的直接投資：
(i) the company is not listed on an Australian stock exchange;
(i) 該公司未在澳洲證券交易所上市；
(ii) the company has not been established wholly or substantially for the purpose of creating compliance with this paragraph;
(ii) 公司的全部或實質設立並非為了遵守本款規定；
(iii) the investment is an ownership interest in the company;
(iii) 該投資是本公司的所有者權益；
(c) an investment in a managed fund (directly or through an investor directed portfolio service) for a purpose specified by the Minister in an instrument, in writing, for this paragraph.
(c) 出于部长在本段书面文书中指定的目的，对管理基金进行投资（直接或通过投资者指导的投资组合服务）。
(3) The funds used to make the investment are:
（三）本次投資所用資金為：
(a) unencumbered; and
(a) 不受阻礙；和
(b) lawfully acquired.
(b) 合法取得。
Investor
投資者
(4) The investor must be an individual.
(4) 投資者必須是個人。
(5) The investor must make the investment:
(5) 投資者必須進行投資：
(a) personally; or
(a) 個人；或
(b) with the investor’s spouse or de facto partner; or
(b) 與投資者的配偶或同居伴侶；或
(c) by means of a company that has issued shares and in which:
(c) 透過已發行股票的公司，其中：
(i) the investor holds all of the issued shares; or
(i) 投資者持有全部已發行股份；或
(ii) the investor and the investor’s spouse or de facto partner hold all of the issued shares; or
(ii) 投資者及其配偶或同居伴侶持有全部已發行股份；或
(d) by means of a trust:
(d) 以信託方式：
(i) that is lawfully established; and
(i) 依法設立；和
(ii) of which:
(二) 其中：
(A) the investor is the sole trustee; or
(A) 投資者是唯一的受託人；或
(B) the investor and the investor’s spouse or de facto partner are the sole trustees; and
(B) 投資者及其配偶或同居伴侶是唯一的受託人；和
(iii) of which:
(三) 其中：
(A) the investor is the sole beneficiary; or
(A) 投資者為唯一受益人；或
(B) the investor and the investor’s spouse or de facto partner are the sole beneficiaries.
(B) 投資者及其配偶或同居伴侶為唯一受益人。
(6) If:
(6) 如果：
(a) an investor withdraws money from a complying investment, or cancels the investment; and
(a) 投資者從合規投資中撤資，或取消投資；和
(b) the investor makes an investment of at least the value of the withdrawn money or cancelled investment in one or more other investments mentioned in subregulation (2); and
(b) 投資者對第 (2) 款中提到的一項或多項其他投資進行至少相當於撤回資金或取消投資的價值的投資；和
(c) no more than 30 days passes between the events mentioned in paragraphs (a) and (b);
(c) (a) 和 (b) 段所述的事件相隔不超過 30 天；
the investment is taken not to have ceased to be a complying investment during the period between the events mentioned in paragraphs (a) and (b).
在(a)段和(b)段所提及的事件之間的期間，該投資被視為並未不再是合規投資。

title: 5.19C Complying significant investment
text:
Definition
定義
(1) An investment by a person (the investor ) is a complying significant investment if all of the requirements of this regulation are met.
(1) 如果滿足本法規的所有要求，則個人（投資者）的投資屬於合規重大投資。
(2) If an investment (the overall investment ) is based on one or more other investments, this regulation (and any instrument under subregulation (6)) applies equally to the overall investment and each investment on which the overall investment is based.
(2) 如果一项投资（整体投资）基于一项或多项其他投资，则本条例（以及第 (6) 款下的任何文书）同样适用于整体投资以及整体投资所基于的每项投资。
Investment requirements
投資要求
(3) All funds used to make the investment must be unencumbered and lawfully acquired.

(3) If a philanthropic contribution (the overall contribution ) is based on one or more other philanthropic contributions, this regulation applies equally to the overall contribution and each philanthropic contribution on which the overall contribution is based.
（三）如果一項慈善捐款（總捐款）是以一項或多項其他慈善捐款為基礎的，則本規定同樣適用於該總捐款以及該總捐款所依據的每一項慈善捐款。

title: 5.19E Complying entrepreneur activity
text:
(1) An activity that an applicant for a visa is undertaking, or proposing to undertake, is a complying entrepreneur activity if all the requirements set out in this regulation are met.
(1) 若符合本條例規定的所有要求，簽證申請人正在進行或擬進行的活動屬於合規企業家活動。
Note: For the grant of a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream, the applicant must be undertaking, or proposing to undertake, a complying entrepreneurial activity (see Subdivision 188.28 of Schedule 2).
注意：要取得企業家類別的 188 子類別（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證，申請人必須正在進行或擬進行符合規定的創業活動（請參閱附表 2 第 188.28 部分）。
(2) The activity:
（二）活動：
(a) relates to an innovative idea that is proposed to lead to:
(a) 涉及一個創新想法，旨在實現：
(i) the commercialisation of a product or service in Australia; or
(i) 澳洲的產品或服務商業化；或
(ii) the development of an enterprise or business in Australia; and
(ii) 在澳洲發展企業或業務；和
(b) does not relate to an activity specified, whether individually or by class, in an instrument under subregulation (6).
(b) 不涉及第(6)款下文書中單獨或依類別指定的活動。
(3) If the applicant is invited to apply for the visa before 1 July 2021, all of the following apply:
(3) 若申請人被邀請在2021年7月1日之前申請簽證，以下所有條件均適用：
(a) funding in relation to the activity is to be provided to any of the following (the entrepreneurial entity ):
(a) 與該活動相關的資金將提供給以下任何實體（企業實體）：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a body corporate;
(ii) 法人團體；
(iii) a partnership;
(iii) 合夥企業；
(b) the funding is to be provided under one or more legally enforceable agreements in effect between the entrepreneurial entity and one or more entities covered by subregulation (5);
(b) 資金將根據企業實體與第 (5) 款所涵蓋的一個或多個實體之間有效的一項或多項具有法律效力的協議提供；
(c) if the applicant is not the entrepreneurial entity—the applicant personally held, at the time the agreement or each agreement was entered into, at least a 30% share in the ownership of the entrepreneurial entity;
(c) 若申請人不是企業實體－在簽訂協議或每份協議時，申請人個人至少持有該企業實體所有權的 30% 股份；
(d) the total amount of the funding provided or to be provided under the agreement or agreements is at least $200,000;
(d) 根據一項或多項協議已提供或將提供的資金總額至少為 200,000 美元；
(e) under the agreement or each agreement, at least 10% of the funding is to be paid to the entrepreneurial entity within 12 months of the day the activity starts to be undertaken in Australia;
(e) 根據協議或每份協議，至少 10% 的資金應在澳洲開始開展活動之日起 12 個月內支付給創業實體；
(f) there is in place a business plan for the entrepreneurial entity that the Minister considers to be appropriately formulated to lead to a result mentioned in subparagraph (2)(a)(i) or (ii);
(f) 為企業實體制定了商業計劃，部長認為該商業計劃經過適當制定，可實現第 (2)(a)(i) 或 (ii) 項中提到的結果；
(g) all of the funding provided or to be provided to the entrepreneurial entity under the agreement or agreements is unencumbered and lawfully acquired.
(g) 根據一項或多項協議向企業實體提供或將提供的所有資金均不受阻礙且合法取得。
(5) An entity is covered by this subregulation if the entity is both:
(5) 若實體同時符合下列條件，則該實體受本款管轄：
(a) any of the following:
(a) 下列任何一項：
(i) an agency of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory, or a body established under a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory;
(i) 澳洲聯邦、州或地區的機構，或依澳洲聯邦、州或地區法律設立的機構；
(ii) a body corporate;
(ii) 法人團體；
(iii) a partnership;
(iii) 合夥企業；
(iv) an unincorporated body;
(iv) 非法人團體；
(v) an individual;
(v) 個人；
(vi) the trustee of a trust that has only 1 trustee;
(vi) 只有 1 位受託人的信託的受託人；
(vii) the trustees together of a trust that has more than 1 trustee; and
(vii) 擁有 1 名以上受託人的信託的受託人；和
(b) specified, whether by name or by class, in an instrument made under subregulation (6).
(b) 在依第(6)款制定的文書中以名稱或類別指明。
(6) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify:
(6) 部長可以透過立法文書規定：
(a) activities for the purposes of paragraph (2)(b); and
(a) 為第(2)(b)款目的而進行的活動；和
(b) entities for the purposes of paragraph (5)(b).
(b) 第 (5)(b) 款所指的實體。

text:
(1) For paragraph 245AB(2)(a) of the Act, the computer system operated by the Department, and known as “Visa Entitlement Verification Online”, or “VEVO”, is prescribed.
(1) 該法案第 245AB(2)(a) 款規定了由該部門運作的電腦系統，稱為「線上簽證權利驗證」或「VEVO」。
(2) For paragraph 245AB(2)(b) of the Act, each of the following is a prescribed thing:
(2) 對於該法第 245AB(2)(b) 段，以下各項均為規定事項：
(a) the entry into a contract under which a party to the contract performs either or both of the following functions:
(a) 簽訂合同，合約一方執行以下一項或兩項職能：
(i) verifying that a person has the required permission to work in Australia (however that is described in the contract);
(i) 核實某人是否擁有在澳洲工作所需的許可（但合約中有說明）；
(ii) supplying persons who have the required permission to work in Australia (however that is described in the contract);
(ii) 提供擁有在澳洲工作所需許可的人員（但合約中有說明）；
(b) the inspection of:
(b) 檢查：
(i) a document that appears to be the worker’s Australian passport; or
(i) 看似該工人的澳洲護照的文件；或
(ii) a document that appears to be the worker’s New Zealand passport; or
(ii) 看似該工人的紐西蘭護照的文件；或
(iii) a document that appears to be the worker’s Australian certificate of citizenship, accompanied by a form of identification featuring a photograph of the worker; or
(iii) 看似該工人的澳洲公民證書的文件，並附有帶有該工人照片的身份證明；或
(iv) a document that appears to be a certificate of evidence of the worker’s Australian citizenship, accompanied by a form of identification featuring a photograph of the worker; or
(iv) 看似是工人澳洲公民身分的證明文件，並附有帶有工人照片的身份證明；或

(vi) 看似該工人的居民身分證明書的文件，並附有附有該工人照片的身份證明；或
(vii) a document that appears to be a Certificate of Status for New Zealand Citizens in Australia for the worker, accompanied by a form of identification featuring a photograph of the worker.
(vii) 看起來像是工人在澳洲的紐西蘭公民身份證明的文件，並附有帶有工人照片的身份證明。
Example: An example of a form of identification is a driver’s licence.
例：駕駛執照就是一種身分證明形式的例子。
Note: Subsection 245AB(1) of the Act does not apply if reasonable steps are taken at reasonable times to verify that a worker is not an unlawful non ‑ citizen, including (but not limited to) either of the following steps:
註：如果在合理時間採取合理步驟來核實工人不是非法非公民，則該法第 245AB(1) 款不適用，包括（但不限於）以下任一步驟：
(a) using a computer system prescribed by the regulations to verify that matter;
(a) 使用條例規定的電腦系統核實該事項；
(b) doing any one or more things prescribed by the regulations.
(b) 進行法規規定的任何一項或多項行為。

title: Division 5.5 — Infringement notices
zh: 第 5.5 分部 — 違規通知

title: 5.21 Interpretation
5.22 When can an infringement notice be served?
zh: 5.22 侵權通知何時可以送達？
text:
(1) If an authorised officer has reason to believe that a person has committed an offence or has contravened a civil penalty provision, the officer may cause an infringement notice to be served on the person in accordance with this Division.
(1) 如果授權官員有理由相信某人犯罪或違反了民事處罰規定，該官員可以根據本節的規定向該人送達違法通知。
(2) An infringement notice must be served within 12 months of the date on which, or the last day of the period over which, an offence is alleged to have been committed or a civil penalty provision is alleged to have been contravened.
(2) 侵權通知必須在涉嫌犯罪或違反民事處罰規定之日或期限最後一天起 12 個月內送達。
(3) An infringement notice must not be served on a person in relation to:
(3) 不得送達侵權通知給下列人員：
(a) a failure to satisfy a sponsorship obligation prescribed in regulation 2.78; or
(a) 未履行第 2.78 條規定的贊助義務；或
(b) a failure to satisfy a sponsorship obligation prescribed in regulation 2.85.
(b) 未履行第 2.85 條規定的贊助義務。
Note: Regulation 2.78 prescribes an obligation to cooperate with inspectors. Regulation 2.85 prescribes an obligation to secure an offer of a reasonable standard of accommodation for a primary sponsored person or secondary sponsored person.
註：條例 2.78 規定了與檢查員合作的義務。第 2.85 條規定有義務為主要擔保人或次要擔保人提供合理標準的住宿。

title: 5.23 What must an infringement notice contain?
zh: 5.23 侵權通知必須包含什麼內容？
text:
(1) An infringement notice must:
(1) 侵權通知必須：
(a) state the name of the authorised officer who caused the notice to be served; and
(a) 註明送達通知的授權官員的姓名；和
(b) if the notice is for the alleged commission of an offence—set out:
(b) 如果通知是針對涉嫌犯罪的－則說明：
(i) the day on which the offence is alleged to have been committed; and
(i) 被指控犯罪的日期；和
(ii) if the offence is against section 229 or 230 of the Act, the place at which the offence is alleged to have been committed; or
(ii) 若犯罪行為違反該法第 229 或 230 條，則指稱犯罪發生的地點；或
(ba) if the notice is for an alleged contravention of a civil penalty provision—set out the day on which, or the period over which, the civil penalty provision is alleged to have been contravened; and
(ba) 如果通知是針對涉嫌違反民事處罰規定的－列出據稱違反民事處罰規定的日期或期限；和
(c) give brief particulars of the alleged offence or the alleged contravention of a civil penalty provision; and
(c) 簡要說明所指控的罪行或所指控的違反民事處罰規定的情況；和
(d) set out the infringement notice penalty; and
(d) 規定違規通知處罰；和
(e) state that, if the person on whom it is served does not wish the matter to be dealt with by a court, he or she may pay that penalty within 28 days after the date of service of the notice unless the notice is withdrawn before the end of that period; and
(e) 規定，如果受送達人不希望此事由法院處理，他或她可以在送達通知之日起 28 天內支付罰款，除非通知在該期限結束前撤回；和
(f) specify where and how that penalty may be paid; and
(f) 明確規定在何處以及如何支付罰款；和
(g) set out the procedures relating to the withdrawal of notices and the consequences of the withdrawal of a notice.
(g) 規定與撤回通知有關的程序以及撤回通知的後果。
(2) An infringement notice for a contravention of a sponsorship ‑ related civil penalty provision must also state that if the provision is contravened after the day on which, or the period over which, the contravention specified in the notice occurred:
(2) 針對違反贊助相關民事處罰規定的違規通知也必須說明，如果在通知中指定的違規行為發生之日或期間之後發生違反該規定的情況：
(a) the person will have contravened the provision again; and
(a) 該人將再次違反該規定；和
(b) further action may be taken as mentioned in section 140K of the Act.
(b) 可採取該法案第 140K 條所述的進一步行動。
(3) An infringement notice for a contravention of a work ‑ related civil penalty provision, or subsection 245AR(5) or 245AS(1) of the Act, must also state the grounds on which the infringement notice may be withdrawn.
(3) 針對違反與工作有關的民事處罰規定或該法第 245AR(5) 或 245AS(1) 款的侵權通知也必須說明可以撤回侵權通知的理由。
(4) An infringement notice for a contravention of a work ‑ related civil penalty provision, or subsection 245AR(5) or 245AS(1) of the Act, must also state that the grounds on which the infringement notice may be withdrawn are not exhaustive.
(4) 針對違反工作相關民事處罰規定或該法第 245AR(5) 或 245AS(1) 款的侵權通知也必須說明撤回侵權通知的理由並非詳盡無遺。
(5) An infringement notice may contain any other particulars that the authorised officer considers necessary.
(5) 侵權通知可以包含授權人員認為必要的任何其他細節。

title: 5.24 Can the time for payment be extended?
text:
If an infringement notice has been served on a person, an authorised officer may, if he or she is satisfied that in all the circumstances it is proper to do so, allow a further period for payment of the infringement notice penalty, whether or not the period of 28 days after the date of service of the notice has expired.
如果侵權通知已送達某人，授權官員如果確信在所有情況下這樣做是適當的，則可以允許延長支付侵權通知罰款的期限，無論通知送達之日後 28 天的期限是否已屆滿。

title: 5.25 What happens if the infringement notice penalty is paid?
zh: 5.25 如果支付了侵權通知罰款會怎樣？
text:
If the person on whom an infringement notice is served pays the infringement notice penalty in relation to the alleged offence or the alleged contravention of a civil penalty provision before:
如果收到侵權通知的人在以下時間之前支付了與涉嫌犯罪或涉嫌違反民事處罰條款相關的侵權通知罰款：
(a) the end of:
(a) 結束：
(i) the period of 28 days after the date of service of the notice; or
(i) 通知送達之日起 28 天的期限；或
(ii) if a further period has been allowed under regulation 5.24—that further period; or
(ii) 若第 5.24 條允許延長期限－該延長期限；或
(b) the notice is withdrawn;
(b) 通知被撤回；
whichever happens first, then:
以先發生者為準，然後：
(c) any liability of the person in respect of the alleged offence or the alleged contravention of the civil penalty provision is discharged; and
(c) 該人因所指控的罪行或所指控的違反民事處罰規定而承擔的任何責任已被解除；和
(d) no further proceedings may be taken in respect of the alleged offence or the alleged contravention of the civil penalty provision; and
(d) 不得就所指控的罪行或所指控的違反民事處罰規定的行為採取進一步的訴訟；和
(e) the person is not to be taken to have been convicted of the alleged offence.
(e) 該人不應被視為因所指控的罪行而被定罪。

title: 5.26 Can an infringement notice be withdrawn?
text:
(1) If an infringement notice has been served on a person, an authorised officer may withdraw it by notice in writing served on the person in accordance with these Regulations, at any time before:
(1) 如果侵權通知已送達某人，授權官員可以根據本條例，在以下時間之前的任何時間，透過向該人送達書面通知來撤回該通知：
(a) the end of 28 days after the date of service of the notice; or
(a) 通知送達後 28 天結束；或
(b) if a further period has been allowed under regulation 5.24—the end of that further period.
(b) 若依第 5.24 條允許延長期限－該延長期限結束。
(2) An infringement notice for:
(2) 侵權通知：
(a) an alleged offence against section 229 or 230 of the Act; or
(a) 涉嫌違反該法第 229 或 230 條的罪行；或
(b) an alleged contravention of a civil penalty provision;
(b) 涉嫌違反民事處罰規定；
must not be withdrawn under subregulation (1) after the expiry of 3 months commencing on the day on which the notice was served.
自通知送達之日起計3個月屆滿後，不得依第(1)款撤回。

title: 5.27 Refund of infringement notice penalty if notice withdrawn
zh: 5.27 如果撤回通知，則退還侵權通知罰款
text:
If:
如果：
(a) an infringement notice has been served on a person; and
(a) 侵權通知已送達某人；和
(b) the person has paid the infringement notice penalty in accordance with the notice; and
(b) 該人已依通知繳納了侵權通知罰款；和
(c) the notice is subsequently withdrawn;
(c) 該通知隨後被撤回；
an authorised officer must arrange for the refund to the person of an amount equal to the amount so paid.
授權官員必須安排向該人退還與所支付金額相同的金額。

title: 5.28 Evidence
text:
(1) In the hearing of proceedings for:
(1) 在審理下列案件的訴訟時：
(a) a prosecution for an offence specified in an infringement notice; or
(a) 起訴侵權通知中所指定的犯罪行為；或
(b) an application for a pecuniary penalty order in relation to a contravention of a civil penalty provision specified in an infringement notice;
(b) 就違反侵權通知中規定的民事處罰規定而提出的罰款令申請；
a certificate signed by an authorised officer and stating a matter mentioned in subregulation (2) is evidence of the matter.
由獲授權人員簽署並述明第(2)款所述事項的證明書，即為該事項的證據。
(2) The matter is that:
(2) 問題是：
(a) the authorised officer did not allow further time for payment of the infringement notice penalty and the penalty was not paid within 28 days after the date of service of the infringement notice; or
(a) 授權官員沒有留出更多時間支付侵權通知罰款，並且在侵權通知送達之日起 28 天內未支付罰款；或
(b) the authorised officer allowed a further period (as specified in the certificate) for payment of the infringement notice penalty and the penalty was not paid within the further period; or
(b) 授權官員允許延長一段期限（按照證書中的規定）支付侵權通知罰款，並且在延長的期限內未支付罰款；或
(c) the authorised officer withdrew the infringement notice on a day specified in the certificate.
(c) 授權官員在證書中指定的日期撤回侵權通知。
(3) A certificate that purports to have been signed by an authorised officer is taken to have been signed by that person unless the contrary is proved.
(3) 聲稱由授權官員簽署的證書應被視為由該人簽署，除非有相反證明。

title: 5.29 Can there be more than one infringement notice for the same offence or contravention of a civil penalty provision?
zh: 5.29 對於同一違法行為或違反民事處罰規定的行為，是否可以有多個違規通知？
text:
This Division does not prevent more than one infringement notice being served on a person for the same offence or the same contravention of a civil penalty provision, but regulation 5.25 applies to the person if the person pays the infringement notice penalty in accordance with one of the infringement notices.
本節並未阻止因同一罪行或同一違反民事處罰規定的行為而向某人送達多於一份侵權通知，但如果該人根據其中一份侵權通知繳納了侵權通知罰款，則第 5.25 條適用於該人。

title: 5.30 What if payment is made by cheque?
zh: 5.30 如果用支票付款怎麼辦？
text:
If a cheque is offered to Immigration as payment of all or part of the amount of a penalty specified in an infringement notice, payment is taken not to have been made unless the cheque is honoured upon presentation.
如果向移民局提供支票來支付違規通知中指定的全部或部分罰款，則除非在出示支票後兌現，否則視為未付款。

title: 5.31 Infringement notice not compulsory
text:
Nothing in this Division:
該部門沒有任何內容：
(a) requires an infringement notice to be served on a person in relation to an offence or a contravention of a civil penalty provision; or
(a) 要求向犯罪或違反民事處罰規定的人員送達侵權通知；或
(b) affects the liability of a person to be prosecuted for an offence or to be subject to proceedings in relation to a contravention of a civil penalty provision if the person does not comply with an infringement notice; or
(b) 影響因不遵守侵權通知而被起訴或因違反民事處罰規定而受到訴訟的人的責任；或
(c) affects the liability of a person to be prosecuted for an offence or to be subject to proceedings in relation to a contravention of a civil penalty provision if an infringement notice is not served on the person in relation to the offence or in relation to a contravention of a civil penalty provision; or
(c) 若未向某人送達與犯罪或違反民事處罰規定有關的侵權通知，則影響該人因犯罪而被起訴或因違反民事處罰規定而受到訴訟的責任；或
(d) affects the liability of a person to be prosecuted for an offence or to be subject to proceedings in relation to a contravention of a civil penalty provision if an infringement notice is served and withdrawn; or
(d) 若送達並撤回侵權通知，則影響因犯罪而被起訴或因違反民事處罰規定而受到訴訟的人的責任；或
(e) limits the amount of:
(e) 限制以下金額：
(i) the fine that may be imposed by a court on a person convicted of an offence; or
(i) 法院可能對被定罪的人處以的罰款；或
(ii) the pecuniary penalty that may be imposed by a court on a person for a contravention of a civil penalty provision.
(ii) 法院可能會對違反民事處罰規定的人處以罰款。

title: 5.32 Search warrants (Act, ss 223(14) and 251(4))
text:
(1) A search warrant for the purposes of subsection 223(14) of the Act (dealing with directions about, and seizure of, the valuables of non ‑ citizens in detention) is to be in accordance with prescribed form 1.
(1) 為該法第 223(14) 款（涉及有關被拘留的非公民的貴重物品的指示和扣押）目的而發出的搜索令應符合規定的表格 1。
(2) A search warrant for the purposes of subsection 251(4) of the Act (dealing with entry and search for unlawful non ‑ citizens) is to be in accordance with prescribed form 2.
(2) 為該法第 251(4) 款（處理非法非公民的入境和搜索）目的而發出的搜索令應符合規定的表格 2。

title: 5.32A Work performed by unlawful non ‑ citizen in detention centre
zh: 5.32A 非法非公民在拘留中心從事的工作
text:
For subsection 235(6) of the Act, the circumstance is that the work:
對於該法案第 235(6) 款，情況是該作品：
(a) is performed by an unlawful non ‑ citizen who is detained in a detention centre established under the Act; and
(a) 由被拘留在根據該法設立的拘留中心的非法非公民實施；和
(b) is allocated to the unlawful non ‑ citizen, at the non ‑ citizen’s request, by an officer at the detention centre.
(b) 應非公民的請求，由拘留中心的官員分配給非法非公民。

title: 5.34 Application of Chapter 2 of the Criminal Code
text:
Chapter 2 of the Criminal Code applies, on and after 1 November 2001, to offences against these Regulations.
《刑法》第二章自 2001 年 11 月 1 日起適用於違反本條例的犯罪行為。

title: 5.34D Disclosure of information to prescribed bodies
text:
For paragraph 336F(1)(d) of the Act (which deals with the authorised disclosure of identifying information to various bodies), a body of:
對於該法案第 336F(1)(d) 段（涉及授權向各個機構披露身分資訊），以下機構：
(a) a foreign country; or
(a) 外國；或
(b) the Commonwealth; or
(b) 英聯邦；或
(c) a State; or
(c) 國家；或
(d) a Territory;
(d) 一個領土；
that is specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for this regulation is a prescribed body.
部長依本條例制定的立法文書中指定的機構是規定機構。

title: 5.34E Disclosure of information to prescribed international organisations
zh: 5.34E 向規定的國際組織披露信息
text:
For paragraph 336F(1)(e) of the Act (which deals with the authorised disclosure of identifying information to international organisations), an organisation that is specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for this regulation is a prescribed international organisation.
對於該法第 336F(1)(e) 段（涉及授權向國際組織披露身分資訊），部長根據本條例制定的立法文書中指定的組織是規定的國際組織。

title: 5.34F Disclosure of information to police and Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission
zh: 5.34F 向警方和澳洲刑事情報委員會披露訊息
text:
(1) This regulation applies in relation to the following:
(1) 本規定適用於下列情況：
(a) a person who holds:
(a) 持有下列資料的人：
(i) a Subclass 050 (Bridging (General)) visa; or
(i) 050 類（過橋（普通））簽證；或
(ii) a Subclass 051 (Bridging (Protection Visa Applicant)) visa;
(ii) 051 類（過橋（保護簽證申請人））簽證；
(b) a person covered by a residence determination.
(b) 居住決定所涵蓋的人。
(2) The Minister may authorise the disclosure of any information mentioned in subregulation (4) about the person, or a class of such persons, to the following:
(2) 部長可授權向以下人員揭露第 (4) 款中提到的有關該人或此類人員的任何資訊：
(a) the Australian Federal Police;
(a) 澳洲聯邦警察；
(b) the police force or police service of a State or Territory;
(b) 州或地區的警察部隊或警察部門；
(c) the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission.
(c) 澳洲刑事情報委員會。
(3) The Minister may authorise the disclosure only if the Minister reasonably believes the disclosure is necessary or appropriate for the performance of functions or the exercise of powers under the Act.
(3) 只有當部長合理地認為披露對於履行該法案規定的職能或行使權力是必要或適當的時，部長才可以授權披露。
(4) For subregulation (2), the information is the following:
(4) 對於第(2)款，資料如下：
(a) the name of the person or the names of persons in the class;
(a) 該人的姓名或該類別中人員的姓名；
(b) the residential address of the person or the residential addresses of persons in the class;
(b) 該人的居住地址或該類別的人的居住地址；
(c) the sex of the person or of persons in the class;
(c) 該人或該類別的人的性別；
(d) the date of birth of the person or the dates of birth of persons in the class;
(d) 該人的出生日期或該類別的人的出生日期；
(e) the immigration status of the person or of persons in the class;
(e) 該人或該類別中的人的移民身分；
(f) the CNI number of the person or persons;
(f) 一個或多個人的 CNI 號碼；
(g) the client number of the person or persons.
(g) 一個或多個人的客戶編號。

title: 5.35 Medical treatment of persons in detention under the Act
zh: 5.35 根據該法對被拘留者的醫療
text:
(1) In this regulation:
（一）本規定：
detainee means a person held at a detention centre in detention under the Act.
被拘留者是指依該法被關押在拘留中心的人。
medical treatment includes:
醫療包括：
(a) the administration of nourishment and fluids; and
(a) 營養和液體的管理；和
(b) treatment in a hospital.
(b) 在醫院治療。
(2) The Secretary may authorise medical treatment to be given to a detainee if:
(2) 在下列情況下，部長可授權對被拘留者進行治療：
(a) the Secretary, acting in person and on the written advice of:
(a) 秘書親自並依照下列人員的書面建議行事：
(i) a Commonwealth Medical Officer; or
(i) 聯邦醫療官員；或
(ii) another registered medical practitioner;
(ii) 另一位註冊醫生；
forms the opinion that:
形成以下意見：
(iii) that detainee needs medical treatment; and
(iii) 被拘留者需要醫療照護；和
(iv) if medical treatment is not given to that detainee, there will be a serious risk to his or her life or health; and
(iv) 如果不對該被拘留者進行治療，其生命或健康將面臨嚴重風險；和
(b) that detainee fails to give, refuses to give, or is not reasonably capable of giving, consent to the medical treatment.
(b) 被拘留者沒有、拒絕或沒有合理能力同意接受醫療。
(3) An authorisation by the Secretary under subregulation (2) is authority for the use of reasonable force (including the reasonable use of restraint and sedatives) for the purpose of giving medical treatment to a detainee.
(3) 部長根據第 (2) 款的授權是為了對被拘留者進行醫療而使用合理武力（包括合理使用約束和鎮靜劑）的授權。
(4) A detainee to whom medical treatment is given under an authorisation under subregulation (2) is taken for all purposes to have consented to the treatment.
(4) 根據第 (2) 款的授權接受治療的被拘留者，無論出於何種目的，均被視為已同意該治療。
(5) Medical treatment that is given under an authorisation under subregulation (2) must be given by, or in the presence of, a registered medical practitioner.
(5) 根據第 (2) 款的授權提供的醫療必須由註冊醫生提供或在註冊醫生在場的情況下提供。
(6) Nothing in this regulation authorises the Secretary to require a registered medical practitioner to act in a way contrary to the ethical, moral or religious convictions of that medical practitioner.
(6) 本條例並未授權部長要求註冊醫生的行為有悖於該醫生的倫理、道德或宗教信仰。

title: 5.35AA Decisions that are not privative clause decisions
zh: 5.35AA 不屬於私有條款決定的決定
text:
For subsection 474(5) of the Act, a decision, or a decision included in a class of decisions, made under a provision of the Act set out in the following table is not a privative clause decision.
對於該法案第 474(5) 款，根據下表中列出的該法案條款所做的決定或一類決定中包含的決定不屬於私有條款決定。
Item | Provision | Subject matter of provision

2 | section 252A | Power to conduct a strip search
3 | section 252B | Rules for conducting a strip search
4 | section 252C | Possession and retention of certain things obtained during a screening procedure or strip search
5 | section 252D | Authorised officer may apply for a thing to be retained for a further period
6 | section 252E | Magistrate may order that thing be retained
7 | section 252G | Powers concerning entry to a detention centre
8 | Division 13A of Part 2 | Automatic forfeiture of things used in certain offences

3 |第 252B 條 |進行脫衣搜索的規則
