5 |第 252D 節 |授權人員可以申請將物品進一步保留一段時間
6 |第 252E 條 |地方法官可以命令保留該物品
7 |第252G條|進入拘留中心的權力
8 |第 2 部分第 13A 部分 |自動沒收用於某些犯罪行為的物品

title: 5.35AB Tax file numbers
Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
zh: 第 5.6A 分部 — 依與外國協議或安排而有的權力
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country

title: 5.35A Definitions
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
In this Division:
在本部門：
place means any place in or outside Australia.
地點是指澳洲境內或境外的任何地點。
weapon includes any thing capable of being used to inflict bodily injury or to help an individual escape from restraint.
武器包括任何能夠用於造成人身傷害或幫助個人逃脫束縛的物品。

title: 5.35B Exercise of power to restrain an individual
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
(1) In the exercise of a power under this Division to restrain an individual, the officer:
(1) 在行使本節規定的限制個人的權力時，官員：
(a) must not use more force, or subject the individual to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary to exercise the power; and
(a) 不得使用超過行使權力合理必要的武力或使個人遭受更大的侮辱；和
(b) must not do anything likely to cause the individual grievous bodily harm unless the officer believes on reasonable grounds that doing the thing is necessary to protect life or prevent serious injury to the individual or another individual (including the officer).
(b) 不得做任何可能導致個人嚴重身體傷害的事情，除非該官員有合理理由相信該行為對於保護生命或防止對該個人或其他個人（包括該官員）造成嚴重傷害是必要的。
(2) In this regulation:
（二）本規定：
officer includes an individual assisting the officer.
官員包括協助該官員的個人。

title: 5.35C Exercise of power to search an individual
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a search under this Division of an individual, clothing of an individual or property under the immediate control of an individual.
(1) 本條適用於依本節對個人、個人衣物或個人直接控制下的財產進行搜索。
(2) The purpose for which an individual, clothing of the individual or any property under the immediate control of the individual may be searched is to find out whether the individual is carrying a weapon, or a weapon is hidden on the individual, in the clothing or in the property.
(2) 搜索個人、個人的衣物或任何個人直接控制的財產的目的是查明該個人是否攜帶武器，或武器藏在個人、衣服或財產中。
(3) This regulation does not authorise an officer, or another individual conducting a search under subregulation (4), to remove any of the individual’s clothing, or to require an individual to remove any of his or her clothing, except the individual’s outer garments (including but not limited to the individual’s overcoat, coat, jacket, gloves, shoes and head covering).
(3) 本條例未授權官員或根據第 (4) 款進行搜索的其他個人脫掉個人的任何衣服，或要求個人脫掉任何衣服，但個人的外衣（包括但不限於個人的大衣、外套、夾克、手套、鞋子和頭巾）除外。
(4) A search of an individual, and the individual’s clothing, must be conducted by:
(4) 個人及其衣物的搜索必須由下列人員進行：
(a) an officer of the same sex as the individual; or
(a) 與該人性別相同的官員；或
(b) if an officer of the same sex as the individual is not available to conduct the search—any other individual who is of the same sex and:
(b) 若未與該人同性別的官員進行搜索－任何其他同性別的人，且：
(i) is requested by an officer; and
(i) 應官員要求；和
(ii) agrees;
(ii) 同意；
to conduct the search.
進行搜尋。
(5) An officer or other individual who conducts a search to which this regulation applies must not use more force, or subject the individual to greater indignity, than is reasonably necessary to conduct the search.
(5) 進行本條例適用的搜索的官員或其他個人不得使用比進行搜索合理必要的更多的武力，或使個人受到更大的侮辱。

title: 5.35D Protection of persons when acts done in good faith
zh: 5.35D 善意行事時對人員的保護
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
(1) An action or proceeding, whether civil or criminal, does not lie, in respect of anything done in the exercise of a power under this Division to restrain an individual, against the Commonwealth, an officer or an individual assisting an officer if the officer or individual who does the thing acts in good faith and does not contravene regulation 5.35B.
(1) 就根據本節行使限制個人的權力而對聯邦、官員或協助官員的個人採取的任何行動而言，無論是民事還是刑事訴訟或程序，只要該官員或個人善意行事且不違反第 5.35B 條，則該訴訟或訴訟程序不構成謊言。
(2) An action or proceeding, whether civil or criminal, does not lie against an individual who, at the request of an officer under subregulation 5.35C(4), conducts a search under that subregulation if the individual acts in good faith and does not contravene subregulation 5.35C(5).
(2) 若個人依照第 5.35C(4) 款的規定，依照官員的請求進行搜查，且該個人善意行事且不違反第 5.35C(5) 款，則該訴訟或程序，無論是民事或刑事，均不針對該個人。

title: 5.35E Powers when boarding certain foreign ships (Act s 245F(14))
zh: 5.35E 登上某些外國船舶時的權力（法案 245F(14)）
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
For subsection 245F(14) of the Act, the powers that the officer may exercise, consistently with the agreement or arrangement, are the powers to do the following:
對於該法案第 245F(14) 款，該官員根據協議或安排可以行使的權力是執行以下操作的權力：
(a) search, without warrant:
(a) 無證搜索：
(i) an individual on the ship; or
(i) 船上的個人；或
(ii) the clothing of the individual; or
(ii) 個人的服裝；或
(iii) any property under the immediate control of the individual;
(iii) 個人直接控制下的任何財產；
(b) take possession of any weapon for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(b) 為執行本條例之目的，在官員認為必要的時間內持有任何武器；
(c) restrain any individual on board the ship for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(c) 為本條的目的，在官員認為必要的時間內限制船上的任何個人；
(d) detain the ship for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(d) 扣留船舶的期限為官員認為為本條目的所必需的期限；
(e) bring the ship, or cause it to be brought, to a place that the officer considers appropriate.
(e) 將船舶或安排帶到官員認為適當的地點。

title: 5.35F Powers when boarding certain foreign ships on the high seas (Act s 245G(4))
zh: 5.35F 在公海上登上某些外國船舶時的權力（法案 245G(4)）
path: Division 5.6A — Powers under an agreement or arrangement with a foreign country
text:
(1) For subsection 245G(4) of the Act, the powers that the officer may exercise, consistently with the agreement or arrangement, are the powers to do the following:
(1) 對於該法第 245G(4) 款，該官員根據協議或安排可以行使的權力是執行下列操作的權力：
(a) search the ship;
(a) 搜查船舶；
(b) search, without warrant:
(b) 無搜索令的搜索：
(i) an individual on the ship; or
(i) 船上的個人；或
(ii) the clothing or the individual; or
(ii) 服裝或個人；或
(iii) any property under the immediate control of the individual;
(iii) 個人直接控制下的任何財產；
(c) take possession of any weapon for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(c) 根據本條例的目的，在官員認為必要的時間內持有任何武器；
(d) restrain any individual on board the ship for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(d) 在官員認為為本條規定所必需的時間內限制船上的任何個人；
(e) detain the ship for as long as the officer thinks necessary for the purposes of this regulation;
(e) 扣留船舶的期限為官員認為為本條規定所必需的期限；
(f) bring the ship, or cause it to be brought, to a port or other place that the officer considers appropriate;
(f) 將船舶帶到或促使將其帶到港口或官員認為適當的其他地方；
(g) return to the ship any individual who:
(g) 將符合下列情況的個人送回船上：
(i) was on the ship when it was initially detained under paragraph (e); and
(i) 最初根據(e)款被扣留時在船上；和
(ii) later leaves the ship.
(ii) 隨後離開船舶。
(2) Subject to this Division, an officer may use such force as is necessary and reasonable in the exercise of a power under this regulation.
(2) 依本節規定，官員在行使本條規定的權力時可以使用必要且合理的武力。
(3) In searching the ship, an officer must not damage the ship or any goods on the ship by forcing open a part of the ship or the goods unless:
(3) 在搜索船舶時，官員不得強行打開船舶或貨物的一部分來損壞船舶或船上的任何貨物，除非：
(a) the individual (if any) apparently in charge of the ship has been given a reasonable opportunity to open that part or the goods; or
(a) 明顯負責船舶的個人（如有）已獲得合理的機會打開該部分或貨物；或
(b) it is not reasonably practical to give that individual such an opportunity.
(b) 為該個人提供這樣的機會並不合理。
(4) An individual may be returned to a ship under paragraph (1)(g) only if the officer or individual assisting the officer is satisfied that it is safe to do so.
(4) 只有在高級船員或協助高級船員的個人確信這樣做是安全的情況下，才可以根據第 (1)(g) 款將個人送回船上。

title: Division 5.7 — Charges and fees
zh: 第 5.7 分部 — 收費及費用

title: 5.36 Payment of visa application charges, and fees, in foreign currencies
zh: 5.36 以外幣支付簽證申請費和費用
text:
(1) Payment of a fee, other than a visa application charge mentioned in subregulation (3A), must be made:
(1) 除第 (3A) 款所述的簽證申請費外，還必須支付以下費用：
(a) in a place, being Australia or a foreign country, that is specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for the purposes of this paragraph; and
(a) 部長為本段目的而製定的立法文書中指定的地點，無論是澳大利亞還是外國；和
(b) in a currency that is specified for the purposes of this paragraph in a legislative instrument made by the Minister as a currency in which a fee may be paid in that place.
(b) 為本款的目的，在部長制定的立法文書中指定為在該地點支付費用的貨幣。
Note: For foreign country , see section 2B of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
註：對於外國，請參閱《1901 年法案解釋法》第 2B 條。
(1A) The amount of the payment is to be worked out as follows:
(1A) 付款金額應按下式計算：
(a) if the currency in which the amount is to be paid is specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph, use the exchange rate for the currency specified in the notice;
(a) 若部長在本款的書面文件中指定了支付金額的貨幣，則使用通知中指定貨幣的匯率；
(b) if the currency in which the amount is to be paid is not specified in an instrument for paragraph (a), use the formula in subregulation (2).
(b) 若(a)款的文書中未規定支付金額的貨幣，則使用第(2)款的公式。
(2) The formula is:
(2) 計算公式為：
where:
其中：
AUD means the amount of the fee in Australian dollars.
AUD 指以澳幣為單位的費用金額。
CER means the highest exchange rate that is lawfully obtainable on a commercial basis for the purchase in the foreign country of Australian currency with the currency of the foreign country in a period that:
CER是指在一段時間內在外國用外國貨幣購買澳洲貨幣時在商業基礎上合法可獲得的最高匯率：
(a) begins:
(a) 開始：
(i) on the day when this regulation commences; or
(i) 本條例生效日；或
(ii) on any subsequent day when that rate increases or decreases by at least 5%; and
(ii) 在該匯率增加或減少至少 5% 的任何後續日期；和
(b) ends at the end of each day before another period begins.
(b) 在另一時段開始前的每天結束時結束。
(3) If the amount worked out by that formula cannot be paid wholly in banknotes of that country, the corresponding amount is that amount rounded up to the nearest larger amount that is payable wholly in banknotes of that country.
(3) 如果按該公式計算出的金額不能完全用該國紙幣支付，則相應金額為四捨五入到最接近的可完全用該國紙幣支付的金額。
(3A) A visa application charge payment made in accordance with regulation 2.12JA must be made in Australian dollars.
(3A) 依第 2.12JA 條規定支付的簽證申請費必須以澳幣支付。
(4) In this regulation:
（四）本規定：
fee means:
費用的意思是：
(a) an instalment of visa application charge; or
(a) 分期付款的簽證申請費；或
(b) an amount of visa evidence charge; or
(b) 一定金額的簽證證據費用；或
(ba) an amount of nomination training contribution charge; or
(ba) 提名培訓繳費金額；或
(c) a fee payable under these Regulations except regulation 5.41C.
(c) 除第 5.41C 條外，依本條例應付的費用。

title: 5.37 Employer nomination fee
text:
(1) This regulation sets out the fee for an application under subregulation 5.19(1) for the Minister’s approval of the nomination of a position.
(1) 本條例規定了根據第 5.19(1) 款申請部長批准職位提名的費用。
Note: Paragraph 5.19(2)(f) requires the fee to accompany the application.
注意：第 5.19(2)(f) 段要求申請時附帶費用。
(2) If the application relates to a visa in a Temporary Residence Transition stream:
(2) 如果申請涉及臨時居留過渡類別的簽證：
(a) if the position is located in regional Australia—no fee is payable; or
(a) 若該職位位於澳洲偏遠地區－則無需支付任何費用；或
(b) if the position is not located in regional Australia—the fee is $540.
(b) 如果該職位不在澳洲偏遠地區——費用為 540 美元。
(3) If the application relates to a visa in a Direct Entry stream:
(3) 如果申請涉及直接入境簽證：
(a) if the application seeks to meet the requirements set out in subregulation 5.19(10) (Employer Nomination Scheme)—the fee is $540; or
(a) 如果申請旨在滿足第 5.19(10) 款（雇主提名計畫）規定的要求－費用為 540 美元；或
(b) if the application seeks to meet the requirements set out in subregulation 5.19(12) (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme)—no fee is payable.
(b) 如果申請旨在滿足第 5.19(12) 款（地區擔保移民計畫）中規定的要求，則無需支付任何費用。
(4) If the application relates to a visa in a Labour Agreement stream:
(4) 如果申請涉及勞工協議類別中的簽證：
(a) if the position is located in regional Australia—no fee is payable; or
(a) 若該職位位於澳洲偏遠地區－則無需支付任何費用；或
(b) if the position is not located in regional Australia—the fee is $540.
(b) 如果該職位不在澳洲偏遠地區——費用為 540 美元。

title: 5.37A Refund of employer nomination fee and nomination training contribution charge
zh: 5.37A 雇主提名費及提名培訓繳款費的退還
text:
(1) The Minister may refund any fee mentioned in regulation 5.37, or any nomination training contribution charge mentioned in paragraph 5.19(2)(fa), paid in relation to a nomination if:
(1) 部長可退還第 5.37 條中提及的任何與提名相關的費用，或第 5.19(2)(fa) 段中提及的任何提名培訓繳費，如果：
(a) any of subregulations (2) to (9) apply; and
(a) 適用第 (2) 至 (9) 款的任何一條；和
(b) the Minister:
(b) 部長：
(i) receives a written request for a refund from the person who paid the amount; or
(i) 收到付款人的书面退款请求；或
(ii) considers it is reasonable in the circumstances to refund the amount to the person who paid the amount without receiving a written request for a refund.
(ii) 在没有收到书面退款请求的情况下，认为在这种情况下将款项退还给付款人是合理的。
(2) This subregulation applies if the application for approval of the nomination is made because of a mistake by Immigration.
(2) 如果提名批准申請是由於移民局的錯誤而提出的，則本款適用。
(3) This subregulation applies if:
(3) 本款適用於：
(a) the nomination relates to a visa in a Labour Agreement stream; and
(a) 提名與勞工協議流中的簽證相關；和
(b) the person is a party to a labour agreement; and
(b) 該人是勞動協議的一方；和
(c) the person withdraws the application for approval of the nomination before a decision is made under regulation 5.19 because:
(c) 該人在根據條例 5.19 作出決定之前撤回批准提名的申請，因為：
(i) the person has identified an occupation in the application that is not specified in the labour agreement as an occupation in relation to which a position may be nominated; or
(i) 該人已在申請中將勞動協議中未指定的職業確定為可以提名職位的相關職業；或者
(ii) the number of nominations approved by the Minister under regulation 5.19 on application by the person is equal to or greater than the number of approved nominations permitted under the labour agreement for the year.
(ii) 部長依第 5.19 條應個人申請核准的提名數量等於或大於當年勞工協議所允許的核准提名數量。
(4) This subregulation applies if:
(4) This subregulation applies if:
(a) the person withdraws the application for approval of the nomination before a decision is made under regulation 5.19; and
(a) 該人在根據第 5.19 條作出決定之前撤回批准提名的申請；和
(b) the reason for withdrawing the application is that the information in the application used to work out the amount of nomination training contribution charge in relation to the nomination was incorrect.
(b) 撤回申請的原因是申請中用於計算與提名相關的提名培訓繳費金額的資訊不正確。
(5) This subregulation applies if:
(5) This subregulation applies if:
(a) the nomination relates to a visa in a Labour Agreement stream; and
(a) 提名與勞工協議流中的簽證相關；和
(b) the person withdraws the application for approval of the nomination before a labour agreement is entered.
(b) 該人在簽訂勞動協議之前撤回提名批准申請。
(6) This subregulation applies if:
(6) This subregulation applies if:
(a) the nomination relates to a visa in a Temporary Residence Transition stream; and
(a) 提名與臨時居留過渡類別中的簽證有關；和
(b) the person withdraws the application for approval of the nomination before a decision is made under regulation 5.19; and
(b) 該人在根據條例 5.19 作出決定之前撤回批准提名的申請；和
(c) the reason for withdrawing the application is that the application, by mistake, identified the wrong occupation in relation to the position nominated.
(c) 撤回申請的原因是申請錯誤地確定了與提名職位相關的錯誤職業。
(7) This subregulation applies if:
(7) This subregulation applies if:
(a) the person withdraws the application for approval of the nomination before a decision is made under regulation 5.19; and
(a) 該人在根據第 5.19 條作出決定之前撤回批准提名的申請；和
(b) the reason for withdrawing the application is that the application, by mistake, identified the wrong stream.
(b) 撤回申請的原因是該申請錯誤地識別了錯誤的流。
(8) This subregulation applies if:
(8) This subregulation applies if:
(a) an application for a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa or a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa made on the basis of the nomination is finally determined; and
(a) 根據提名提出的186類（雇主提名計畫）簽證或187類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證申請最終確定；和
(b) the grant of the visa is refused:
(b) 簽證被拒絕：
(i) under section 501, 501A or 501B of the Act; or
(i) 依該法第 501、501A 或 501B 條；或
(ii) because the visa applicant did not satisfy public interest criterion 4001, 4002, 4003, 4003B, 4005, 4007 or 4020; or
(ii) 因為簽證申請人不符合公共利益準則 4001、4002、4003、4003B、4005、4007 或 4020；或
(iii) because a member of the family unit of the visa applicant did not satisfy public interest criterion 4001, 4002, 4003, 4003B, 4005, 4007 or 4020.
(iii) 因為簽證申請人的家庭成員不符合公共利益準則 4001、4002、4003、4003B、4005、4007 或 4020。
(9) This subregulation applies if:
(9) 本款適用於：
(a) a Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme) visa or a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa is granted on the basis of the nomination; and
(a) 根據提名授予 186 類（雇主提名計畫）簽證或 187 類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證；和
(b) the visa holder fails to commence employment in the position nominated.
(b) 簽證持有者未能開始在指定職位上工作。
(10) A refund under subregulation (1) must be paid to the person who paid the amount.
(10) 第 (1) 款規定的退款必須支付給付款人。
(11) A refund under subregulation (1) may be paid:
(11) 第 (1) 款規定的退款可以透過以下方式支付：
(a) in Australian currency; or
(a) 澳洲貨幣；或
(b) if the amount in respect of which the refund is being paid was paid in another currency, in that other currency.
(b) 如果退款金額是以另一種貨幣支付的，則以該另一種貨幣支付。

title: 5.38 Sponsorship fee
text:
(1) This regulation applies to sponsorship of an applicant if the applicant is applying for a temporary visa for which sponsorship is a requirement (other than a Subclass 600 (Visitor) visa).
(1) 若申請人正在申請需要擔保的臨時簽證（600 類（訪客）簽證除外），則本規定適用於申請人的擔保。
(2) Subject to subregulation (3), a fee is payable for seeking to be approved as a sponsor in respect of a sponsorship of an applicant to which this regulation applies, as follows:
(2) 除第 (3) 款規定外，申請核准成為本條適用的申請人的擔保人的擔保人應繳納費用，具體如下：
(a) if the person or organisation is seeking to sponsor more than 10 applicants together—$3 350;
(a) 若該個人或組織尋求共同擔保超過 10 位申請人－$3 350；
(b) in any other case—$335 for each applicant the person or organisation is seeking to sponsor.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－個人或組織尋求擔保的每位申請人 335 美元。
(3) If an application for a visa is not subject to a visa application charge, or a fee under these Regulations, no fee is payable for seeking to be approved as a sponsor in respect of that application.
(3) 如果簽證申請無需繳納簽證申請費或本條例規定的費用，則尋求獲得該申請批准的擔保人無需支付任何費用。

title: 5.40 Fees for assessment of a person’s work qualifications and experience etc
zh: 5.40 人員工作資格和經驗等評估費用
text:
(1) The fee payable to a non ‑ corporate Commonwealth entity within the meaning of the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Act 2013 for:
(1) 向 2013 年《公共治理、績效和問責法》所指的非公司英聯邦實體支付的費用，用於：
(a) an application for assessment, for the purposes of the Act, of a person’s occupational qualifications or experience (or both); and
(a) 出於該法案的目的，評估一個人的職業資格或經驗（或兩者）的申請；和
(b) an application for assessment, for the purposes of the Act, of a person’s educational qualifications; and
(b) 就該法而言，評估個人教育資格的申請；和
(c) an application for internal review of an assessment;
(c) 評估內部審查申請；
is the fee specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this regulation.
是部長在本條例的書面文件中規定的費用。
(2) Subject to subregulation (3), if, on an internal review of an assessment, a review authority decides in favour of the applicant, the fee paid for the internal review is to be refunded.
(2) 根據第(3)款的規定，如果審查機構在對評估進行內部審查時作出有利於申請人的決定，則應退還為內部審查支付的費用。
(3) A fee paid for an internal review is not to be refunded if the applicant provided evidence for the purposes of the review that was not provided for the purposes of the application for assessment.
（3）如果申請人為審查目的提供的證據並非為評估申請提供的，則內部審查費用將不予退還。

title: 5.41 Fee for further opinion of Medical Officer of the Commonwealth in merits review
zh: 5.41 聯邦醫療官員在案情審查中提出進一步意見的費用
text:
(1) This regulation applies to a review by the ART of a refusal to grant a visa to a person, if:
(1) 本規定適用於 ART 對拒絕向某人發放簽證的審查，如果：
(a) under regulation 2.25A, in determining whether the criteria for grant of the visa were satisfied, the Minister was required, to seek the opinion of a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth; and
(a) 根據第 2.25A 條，在確定是否符合授予簽證的標準時，部長必須徵求聯邦醫療官員的意見；和
(b) the refusal occurred wholly, or in part, because in the opinion of the Medical Officer of the Commonwealth, the person did not satisfy a requirement mentioned in subregulation 2.25A(1) or (2), as the case requires; and
(b) 被拒絕的全部或部分原因是聯邦醫療官員認為該人不符合第 2.25A(1) 或 (2) 款中提到的要求（視情況而定）；和
(c) for the review—a further opinion of a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth is required.
(c) 為了進行審查－需要聯邦醫療官員的進一步意見。
(2) There is payable, for the further opinion mentioned in paragraph (1)(c), a fee of $520.
(2) 對於第 (1)(c) 段所提及的進一步意見，需繳納 520 美元的費用。

title: 5.41C Fees for performing functions relating to certain international travellers using gateway airports
zh: 5.41C 使用門戶機場執行與某些國際旅客相關的職能的費用
text:
(1) If, at the request of a person, the Secretary arranges for a statutory function to be performed:
(1) 若部長應某人的請求安排履行法定職能：
(a) in a special processing area for the performance of the function at a gateway airport; and
(a) 在門戶機場履行職能的特殊處理區；和
(b) in relation to one or more international travellers using the gateway airport;
(b) 與使用門戶機場的一名或多名國際旅客有關；
the person must pay the Commonwealth an agreed fee in respect of the performance of the statutory function and any other statutory functions in relation to those international travellers.
該人必須就履行與這些國際旅行者有關的法定職能和任何其他法定職能向聯邦支付商定的費用。
Note: An agreed fee in respect of the performance of the statutory function and other statutory functions may be payable in anticipation of the performance of the function.
注意：在預期履行該職能時，可能需要支付與履行法定職能和其他法定職能有關的商定費用。
(2) On behalf of the Commonwealth, the Secretary may make, with a person making a request described in subregulation (1), an agreement relating to the amount and payment of a fee that is or will be payable under that subregulation.
(2) 部長可以代表聯邦與提出第 (1) 款所述請求的人就根據該款規定應付或將要支付的費用的金額和支付達成協議。
(3) In these Regulations:
（三）本條例中：
gateway airport means an aerodrome (whether a proclaimed airport or not) used by aircraft on overseas flights.
門戶機場是指飛機執行海外航班使用的機場（無論是否宣佈為機場）。
international traveller using a gateway airport means a person who:
使用門戶機場的國際旅客是指：
(a) arrives at the gateway airport aboard an aircraft on an overseas flight; or
(a) 搭乘海外航班的飛機抵達門戶機場；或
(b) is due to depart from the gateway airport aboard an aircraft on an overseas flight.
(b) 預計搭乘海外航班從門戶機場出發。
overseas flight means:
海外航班是指：
(a) a flight from a place outside Australia to a place in Australia; or
(a) 從澳洲境外某處飛往澳洲境內某處的航班；或
(b) a flight from a place in Australia to a place outside Australia (whether or not after calling at other places in Australia).
(b) 從澳洲境內飛往澳洲境外的航班（不論是否經過澳洲其他地點）。
special processing area of a gateway airport for the performance of a particular statutory function means:
為履行特定法定職能而設立的門戶機場的特殊處理區是指：
(a) if the gateway airport is commonly used for overseas flights—an area of the gateway airport other than an area in which that function is performed in relation to:
(a) 若門戶機場通常用於海外航班－門戶機場的一個區域，但執行此功能的區域除外：
(i) a majority of international travellers arriving at the gateway airport aboard aircraft on overseas flights; or
(i) 大多數國際旅客搭乘海外航班抵達門戶機場；或
(ii) a majority of international travellers due to depart from the gateway airport aboard aircraft on overseas flights; or
(ii) 大多數國際旅客將搭乘海外航班從門戶機場出發；或
(b) if the gateway airport is not commonly used for overseas flights—an area of the gateway airport in which that function is, or is to be, performed in relation to international travellers using the gateway airport.
(b) 如果門戶機場不常用於海外航班－門戶機場中正在執行或將執行與使用門戶機場的國際旅客相關的功能的區域。
statutory function means a function under:
法定職能是指以下職能：
(a) the Act; or
(a) 該法案；或
(b) regulations made under the Act.
(b) 根據該法制定的法規。

(ii) the country is specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this paragraph; and
(ii) 該國由部長在為本段目的而製定的立法文書中指定；和
(iii) if a period is specified in the instrument in relation to the country—the time referred to in subparagraph (i) is within that period.
(iii) 如果文書中規定了與該國有關的期限－第(i)項所提及的時間在該期限內。

(ii) must provide, at the same time and place as making the application, the approved form specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this subparagraph under subregulation 2.07(5) that has been completed and signed by an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or eligible New Zealand citizen who claims to be the spouse or de facto partner of the applicant (the partner ); and
(ii) 必須在提出申請的同時和地點提供部長在根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項製定的立法文書中指定的批准表格，該表格已由自稱是申請人的配偶或事實上的伴侶（伴侶）的澳大利亞公民、澳大利亞永久居民或符合資格的新西蘭公民填寫並簽署；和
(iii) must provide, at the same time and place as making the application, 2 statutory declarations each of which:
(iii) 必須在提出申請的同時和地點提供 2 份法定聲明，每份聲明：
(A) is made by an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or eligible New Zealand citizen who is not the partner; and
(A) 由澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合資格的紐西蘭公民（非合夥人）製作；和
(B) declares that the applicant and the partner are in a married relationship or de facto relationship; and
(B) 聲明申請人與伴侶有婚姻關係或同居關係；和
(C) was declared no more than 6 weeks before the day on which the application for the Partner (Residence) (Class BS) visa was made.
(C) 在申請伴侶（居留）（BS 級）簽證之日前 6 週內宣布。
(3A) For paragraph (3)(e):
(3A) 對於第 (3)(e) 段：
(a) the applicant is taken to have met the requirements of the paragraph if the applicant:
(a) 若申請人符合下列條件，則視為申請人符合本款的要求：
(i) is a person to whom section 48 of the Act applies; and
(i) 是該法第 48 條適用的人；和
(ii) claims to be a dependent child of a person who has met the requirements of paragraph (3)(e); and
(ii) 自稱是符合第 (3)(e) 款要求的人的受扶養子女；和
(b) if the applicant leaves and re ‑ enters the migration zone while holding a bridging visa, the applicant is taken to have been continuously in the migration zone despite the travel.
(b) 如果申請人在持有過橋簽證的情況下離開並重新進入移民區，儘管旅行，申請人仍被視為持續留在移民區。

(d) 若有以下情況，個人的申請不是有效的申請：

(ii) the person has not been notified of a decision not to proceed with the cancellation; and
(ii) 該人尚未收到不繼續取消的決定的通知；和
(iii) the visa was not the subject of a decision to cancel the visa under section 134 of the Act.
(iii) 該簽證並非依據該法第 134 條取消簽證決定的對象。
(e) Application by a person is not a valid application if:
(e) 若有以下情況，個人的申請不是有效的申請：

(ii) the decision to cancel the visa has not been set aside by the ART.
(ii) ART 尚未撤銷取消簽證的決定。

(a) on 8 May 2018:

(ab) 持有臨時簽證（特殊目的簽證除外）的申請人必須是：

(i) 在澳洲境外辦理出入境檢查，搭乘預先清關的航班前往澳洲；或

(d) 如果申請人尋求符合授予 500 子類（學生）簽證的主要標準，並且在澳洲期間任何時候都未滿 18 歲，則申請必須附有申請人住宿、贍養和一般福利的預期安排的證據。

(iv) 副申請人在澳大利亞，在本項生效之時或之後在澳大利亞出生，是主申請人的子女，並且在生效時，主申請人在滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準的基礎上持有500子類（學生）簽證（早期簽證）；或
(v) the secondary applicant is in Australia, was born in Australia on or after the commencement of this subparagraph, is a child of the primary applicant and, before that commencement, the primary applicant applied for a Subclass 500 (Student) visa (the earlier visa ) which was granted, on or after that commencement, on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for the grant of the earlier visa; or
(v) 副申請人在澳大利亞，在本項生效之日或之後在澳大利亞出生，是主申請人的子女，並且在該生效之前，主申請人申請了 500 類（學生）簽證（早期簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是在該生效之日或之後根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證），該簽證是根據滿足授予早期簽證的主要標準而獲得批准的；或簽證）之後；
(vi) the secondary applicant is included in a class of persons specified in an instrument under paragraph (5)(c).
(vi) 第二申請人屬於第(5)(c)款文書中指定的人員類別。
(e) An application by a person claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who is an applicant for a Subclass 500 (Student) visa must be made at the same time and place as, and combined with, the application by that person.
(e) 自稱是 500 類（學生）簽證申請人的家庭成員的個人提出的申請必須與該人的申請同時和地點同時提出。
(f) An application by a person claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who is seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 590 (Student Guardian) visa must be made at the same time as, and combined with, the application by that person.
(f) 自稱是尋求符合授予 590 類（學生監護人）簽證主要標準的人的家庭成員的申請必須與該人的申請同時提出並結合在一起。
(3A) For the purposes of subparagraph (3)(aa)(iii), the classes of persons are the following:
(3A) 就第 (3)(aa)(iii) 項而言，人員類別如下：
(a) Defence students;
(a) 國防生；
(b) Foreign Affairs students;
(b) 外交學生；
(c) school students (within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2);
(c) 學校學生（附表 2 第 500.111 條意義內）；
(d) classes of persons specified in an instrument under paragraph (5)(d).
(d) 依第(5)(d)款在文書中指定的人員類別。
(4) If the applicant is in Australia:
（4）如果申請人在澳洲：
(a) the applicant must:
(a) 申請人必須：
(i) hold a substantive visa; and
(i) 持有實質簽證；和
(ii) not be included in a class of persons specified in an instrument under paragraph (5)(e); or
(ii) 不屬於第(5)(e)款文書中指定的人員類別；或
(b) either subitem (4A) or (4B) must apply to the applicant.
(b) 分項 (4A) 或 (4B) 必須適用於申請人。
(4A) This subitem applies to an applicant if the applicant satisfies each of the following paragraphs:
(4A) 若申請人符合以下各段，則本項適用於申請人：
(a) the applicant is not the holder of a substantive visa;
(a) 申請人並非實質簽證持有者；
(b) the last substantive visa held by the applicant was:
(b) 申請人最後持有的實質簽證是：
(ii) a special purpose visa; or
(ii) 特殊目的簽證；或
(iii) a Diplomatic (Temporary) (Class TF) visa granted to the holder as the spouse or de facto partner, or a dependent relative, of a diplomatic or consular representative of a foreign country;
(iii) 外交（臨時）（TF 等級）簽證，授予作為外國外交或領事代表的配偶或同居伴侶或受扶養親屬的持有人；
(c) the application is made within 28 days after:
(c) 申請在以下日期後 28 天內提出：
(i) the day when that last substantive visa ceased to be in effect; or
(i) 最後一個實質簽證不再有效的日期；或
(ii) if that last substantive visa was cancelled, and the ART has made a decision to set aside and substitute the cancellation decision or the Minister’s decision not to revoke the cancellation—the later of the day when that last substantive visa ceased to be in effect and the day when:
(ii) 如果最後一個實質簽證被取消，並且 ART 已做出擱置並替代取消決定的決定，或者部長決定不撤銷取消——以最後一個實質性簽證不再有效之日和以下日期中較晚者為準：
(A) if the ART’s decision is given to the applicant orally—the applicant is taken, under subsection 368(7) of the Act, to have been notified of the decision; or
(A) 如果 ART 的決定以口頭方式給予申請人－根據該法第 368(7) 款，申請人被視為已被告知該決定；或
(B) otherwise—the applicant is taken, under section 379C of the Act, to have received the notification of the ART’s decision;
(B) 否則－根據該法第 379C 條，申請人被視為已收到 ART 決定的通知；
(d) the applicant has not previously been granted a visa based on an application made when the applicant did not hold a substantive visa.
(d) 申請人先前未曾依其未持有實質簽證時提出的申請取得簽證。
(4B) This subitem applies to an applicant if the applicant satisfies each of the following paragraphs:
(4B) 若申請人符合以下各段，則本項適用於申請人：
(a) the applicant is not the holder of a substantive visa;
(a) 申請人並非實質簽證持有者；
(b) the last substantive visa held by the applicant was a student visa (the earlier visa );
(b) 申請人最後持有的實質簽證是學生簽證（較早的簽證）；
(c) the following circumstances exist in relation to the earlier visa:
(c) 先前的簽證有以下情況：
(i) the earlier visa was cancelled;
(i) 先前的簽證被取消；
(ii) the ART made the decision to set aside and substitute the cancellation decision or the Minister’s decision not to revoke the cancellation;
(ii) ART 做出撤銷並取代取消決定的決定或部長不撤銷取消的決定；
(iii) the ART’s decision was made after the day when the earlier visa ceased to be in effect;
(iii) ART 的決定是在之前的簽證失效之日之後做出的；
(d) the application is made within 28 days after:
(d) 申請在以下日期後 28 天內提出：
(i) if the ART’s decision is given to the applicant orally—the applicant is taken, under subsection 368(7) of the Act, to have been notified of the decision; or
(i) 若 ART 的決定以口頭方式給予申請人－根據該法第 368(7) 款，申請人被視為已被告知該決定；或
(ii) otherwise—the applicant is taken, under section 379C of the Act, to have received the notification of the ART’s decision;
(ii) 否則－根據該法第 379C 條，申請人被視為已收到 ART 決定的通知；
(e) the applicant has not previously been granted a visa based on an application made when the applicant did not hold a substantive visa.
(e) 申請人之前未曾根據其未持有實質簽證時提出的申請獲得簽證。
(5) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify all or any of the following:
(5) 部長可以透過立法文書規定以下全部或任何內容：
(a) classes of persons to whom subparagraph (2)(a)(i) applies;
(a) 第(2)(a)(i)項適用的人員類別；
(b) the requirements that evidence required by paragraph (3)(c) must satisfy;
(b) 第 (3)(c) 款所要求的證據必須滿足的要求；
(c) classes of persons for the purposes of subparagraph (3)(da)(vi);
(c) 就第(3)(da)(vi)項而言的人員類別；
(d) classes of persons for the purposes of paragraph (3A)(d);
(d) 就第 (3A)(d) 款而言的人員類別；
(e) classes of persons for the purposes of subparagraph (4)(a)(ii).
(e) 就第(4)(a)(ii)項而言的人員類別。
(5A) For the purposes of subparagraphs (2)(a)(ib) and (ic) and (3)(da)(i), the following countries are specified:
(5A) 就第 (2)(a)(ib)、(ic) 和 (3)(da)(i) 項而言，指定下列國家：
(a) Brunei;
(a) 汶萊；
(b) Cambodia;
(b) 柬埔寨；
(c) Indonesia;
(c) 印尼；
(d) Laos;
(d) 寮國；
(e) Malaysia;
(e) 馬來西亞；
(f) Myanmar;
(f) 緬甸；
(g) Philippines;
(g) 菲律賓；
(h) Singapore;
(h) 新加坡；
(i) Thailand;
(一) 泰國；
(j) Vietnam.
(j) 越南。
(6) Subclasses:
(6) 小類：
500 (Student)
500（學生）
590 (Student Guardian)
590（學生監護人）
(7) In this item:
(7) 本項中：
course of study has the same meaning as in clause 500.111.
學習課程與第 500.111 條的意思相同。

title: 1224A Work and Holiday (Temporary) (Class US)
zh: 1224A 工作與假期（臨時）（美國級）
path: Part 2 — Temporary visas (other than bridging visas)
text:
(1) Form: The approved form specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(1) 形式：部長在根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的立法文書中指定的批准形式。
(2) Visa application charge:
（二）簽證申請費：
(a) the base application charge (payable at the time the application is made) is:
(a) 基本申請費（提出申請時支付）為：
(i) for an applicant in a class of persons specified in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this subparagraph under subregulation 2.07(5)—nil; or
(i) 根據第 2.07(5) 款為本項目的而製定的立法文書中指定的一類人員的申請人－無；或
(ii) for an applicant who is not in such a class of persons and who holds a valid passport issued by a Pacific ‑ regional country—$690; or
(ii) 對於不屬於此類人員且持有太平洋地區國家簽發的有效護照的申請人－690美元；或
(iii) for an applicant who is not in such a class of persons, who does not hold a valid passport issued by a Pacific ‑ regional country and is not, and has not previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa—$840; or
(iii) 對於不屬於此類人員、不持有太平洋地區國家簽發的有效護照、現在和以前都沒有以 462 類（工作和度假）簽證（受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的離岸簽證除外）持有者身份在澳大利亞的申請人，840 美元；或
(iv) for any other applicant—$1 000; and
(iv) 對於任何其他申請人－$1 000；和
(b) the second instalment (payable before grant of visa) is nil.
(b) 第二期付款（在授予簽證之前支付）為零。
Note: Regulation 2.12C explains the components of the first instalment of visa application charge and specifies the amounts of subsequent temporary application charge and non ‑ Internet application charge. Not all of the components may apply to a particular application.
註：第2.12C條解釋了第一期簽證申請費的組成部分，並規定了後續臨時申請費和非互聯網申請費的金額。並非所有元件都適用於特定應用程式。
Additional applicant charge is paid by an applicant who claims to be a member of the family unit of another applicant and seeks to combine the application with that applicant’s application.
額外的申請人費用由聲稱是另一申請人家庭成員並尋求將申請與該申請人的申請合併的申請人支付。
(3) Other:
（三）其他：
(a) Applicant must hold a valid passport issued by a foreign country specified in an instrument in writing made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(a) 申請人必須持有根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的書面文書中指定的外國簽發的有效護照。
Note: For foreign country , see section 2B of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 .
註：對於外國，請參閱《1901 年法案解釋法》第 2B 條。
(aaa) Paragraph (a) does not apply if:
(aaa) (a) 款不適用於下列情況：
(i) the applicant is in Australia; and
(i) 申請人在澳洲；和
(ii) when entering Australia, the applicant held a valid passport issued by a foreign country specified in an instrument in writing mentioned in paragraph (a); and
(ii) 申請人在進入澳洲時持有(a)段所述書面文書中指定的外國簽發的有效護照；和
(iii) the passport expired after the applicant entered Australia.
(iii) 申請人進入澳洲後護照過期。
(aab) The applicant must be aged at least 18 and no more than:
(aab) 申請人必須年滿 18 歲且不超過：
(i) unless subparagraph (ii) applies—35; or
(i) 除非第 (ii) 項適用－35；或
(ii) if the instrument mentioned in paragraph (a) specifies a younger age for the foreign country that issued the passport the applicant holds (or, if paragraph (aaa) applies, held)—that age.
(ii) 如果(a)段中提到的文書規定了簽發申請人持有的護照的外國的較低年齡（或者，如果(aaa)段適用，則為持有護照）－該年齡。
(aa) An application must be made at the place, and in the manner, (if any) specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(aa) 申請必須在部長根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的立法文書中指定的地點和方式（如果有）提出。
(b) If the applicant is not, and has not previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant must:
(b) 如果申請人現在和之前都沒有以 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證（受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的離岸簽證除外）持有者身份在澳大利亞，則申請人必須：
(i) be outside Australia; and
(i) 位於澳洲境外；和
(ii) not have previously been in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa; and
(ii) 之前未曾以 417 類（工作假期）簽證持有者身份進入澳洲；和
(iii) unless the applicant is a member of a class of persons specified by the Minister, by an instrument in writing, for this subparagraph—provide evidence that the applicant has the support for the grant of the visa from the government of the foreign country mentioned in paragraph (a).
(iii) 除非申請人是部長透過書面文書針對本項指定的一類人員的成員，否則應提供證據證明申請人得到(a)款中提到的外國政府授予簽證的支持。
(c) If the applicant is, or has previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa:
(c) 如果申請人現在或曾經作為 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證（受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的離岸簽證以外的簽證持有者）身在澳洲：
(i) the applicant may be in or outside Australia, but not in immigration clearance; and
(i) 申請人可在澳洲境內或境外，但尚未辦理出入境手續；和
(ii) if, disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has held only one Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa in Australia—the application must be accompanied by a declaration by the applicant that he or she has carried out specified Subclass 462 work for a total period of at least 3 months as the holder of that visa; and
(ii) 如果不考慮任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證，申請人在澳洲僅持有一份 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證－該申請必須附有申請人的聲明，表明他或她作為該簽證持有者已從事指定的 462 子類工作總計至少 3 個月；和
(iia) if, disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has held 2 Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visas in Australia—the application must be accompanied by a declaration by the applicant that:
(iia) 如果申請人在澳洲持有 2 個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證（無論是否有任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證），則該申請必須附有申請人的聲明，表明：
(A) the applicant has carried out specified Subclass 462 work for a total period of at least 6 months; and
(A) 申請人已完成指定的462子類工作總計至少6個月；和
(B) all of that work was carried out while the applicant held the second Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa or while the applicant held a bridging visa that was in effect and was granted on the basis of the application for the second Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa (made at a time when the applicant held the first Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa); and
(B) 所有這些工作都是在申請人持有第二個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時或在申請人持有有效的過橋簽證並根據第二個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證申請（在申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和申請人持有第一個 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和人。
(C) all of that work was carried out on or after 1 July 2019; and
(C) 所有這些工作均在 2019 年 7 月 1 日或之後進行；和
(iii) disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has not held more than 2 Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visas in Australia (including any Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa held by the applicant at the time of application); and
(iii) 無論任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證，申請人在澳洲持有的 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證不超過 2 個（包括申請人在申請時持有的任何 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證）；和
(iv) if the applicant is in Australia, the applicant must hold a substantive visa or have held a substantive visa at any time in the period of 28 days immediately before making the application.
(iv) 如果申請人在澳大利亞，申請人必須持有實質簽證或在提出申請前28天內的任何時間持有實質簽證。
(d) Subparagraphs (c)(ii) and (iia) do not apply if the applicant holds a passport of a kind specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this paragraph.
(d) 若申請人持有部長為本段目的而製定的立法文書中指定的護照類型，則 (c)(ii) 和 (iia) 項不適用。
(e) Subparagraphs (c)(ii) and (iia) do not apply if:
(e) 在下列情況下，(c)(ii) 和 (iia) 項不適用：
(i) the application is made between 5 March 2022 and 31 December 2022; and
(i) 申請於2022年3月5日至2022年12月31日期間提出；和
(ii) the applicant holds or held an onshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa; and
(ii) 申請人持有或持有受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的境內簽證；和
(iii) the applicant has not been granted a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa on the basis of another application made on or after 5 March 2022.
(iii) 申請人尚未根據 2022 年 3 月 5 日或之後提出的另一項申請獲得 462 子類（工作和度假）簽證。
(f) Subparagraph (c)(iv) does not apply if:
(f) 在下列情況下，(c)(iv) 項不適用：
(i) the application is made between 5 March 2022 and 31 December 2022; and
(i) 申請於2022年3月5日至2022年12月31日期間提出；和
(ii) the applicant holds a bridging visa.
(ii) 申請人持有過橋簽證。
(3A) If:
(3A) 如果：
(a) the applicant is not, and has not previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa; and
(a) 申請人現在和之前都沒有以 462 類（工作和度假）簽證持有者身份在澳大利亞；和
(b) the applicant holds a valid passport issued by a foreign country specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this paragraph;
(b) 申請人持有由部長在為本段目的製定的立法文書中指定的外國簽發的有效護照；
the requirements of the following table must be met.
必須滿足下表的要求。
Requirements for certain applicants
Item | Requirements
1 | The applicant is a selected participant for a visa pre ‑ application process (the relevant process ) conducted under subsection 46C(1) of the Act in relation to: (a) a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa; and (b) the foreign country that issued the valid passport held by the applicant
2 | At the time the applicant became a registered participant for the relevant process, the applicant held a valid passport issued by the foreign country to which the relevant process relates
3 | The application is made on or before the date specified in the notice given to the applicant after becoming a selected participant for the relevant process as the date by which the applicant must make a valid visa application for a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa
對某些申請人的要求
項目 |要求

2 |申請人成為相關程序的註冊參與者時，申請人持有相關程序所涉及的國家簽發的有效護照

It also provides for the giving of the notice referred to in item 3 of the table.

title: 1225 Working Holiday (Temporary) (Class TZ)
path: Part 2 — Temporary visas (other than bridging visas)
text:
(1) Form: The approved form specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(1) 形式：部長在根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的立法文書中指定的批准形式。
(2) Visa application charge:
（二）簽證申請費：
(a) the base application charge (payable at the time the application is made) is:
(a) 基本申請費（提出申請時支付）為：
(i) for an applicant in a class of persons specified in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this subparagraph under subregulation 2.07(5)—nil; or
(i) 根據第 2.07(5) 款為本項目的而製定的立法文書中指定的一類人員的申請人－無；或
(ii) for an applicant who is not in such a class of persons, and is not, and has not previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa—$840; or
(ii) 對於不屬於此類人員，並且現在和以前都沒有作為 417 類（工作度假）簽證（受海外 COVID-19 影響的海外簽證除外）持有者身份在澳大利亞的申請人，840 美元；或
(iii) for any other applicant—$1 000; and
(iii) 對於任何其他申請人－$1 000；和
(b) the second instalment (payable before grant of visa) is nil.
(b) 第二期付款（在授予簽證之前支付）為零。
Note: Regulation 2.12C explains the components of the first instalment of visa application charge and specifies the amounts of subsequent temporary application charge and non ‑ Internet application charge. Not all of the components may apply to a particular application.
註：第2.12C條解釋了第一期簽證申請費的組成部分，並規定了後續臨時申請費和非互聯網申請費的金額。並非所有元件都適用於特定應用程式。
Additional applicant charge is paid by an applicant who claims to be a member of the family unit of another applicant and seeks to combine the application with that applicant’s application.
額外的申請人費用由聲稱是另一申請人家庭成員並尋求將申請與該申請人的申請合併的申請人支付。
(3) An application must be made at the place, and in the manner, (if any) specified in relation to a class of persons that includes the applicant by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(3) 申請必須在部長根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的立法文書中針對包括申請人在內的一類人指定的地點和方式（如果有）提出。
(3AA) The applicant is aged at least 18 and no more than:
(3AA) 申請人年滿 18 歲且不超過：
(a) unless paragraph (b) applies—35; or
(a) 除非(b)段適用－35；或
(b) if the instrument mentioned in subitem (3) specifies a younger age for the foreign country that issued the passport the applicant holds (or, if paragraph (3BC)(b) applies, held)—that younger age.
(b) 如果第 (3) 項中提到的文書規定了簽發申請人所持護照（或者，如果第 (3BC)(b) 段適用，則持有護照）的外國的較低年齡——該較低年齡。
(3A) If the applicant is not, and has not previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant:
(3A) 如果申請人現在和之前都沒有以 417 類（工作假期）簽證（受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的離岸簽證除外）持有者身份在澳大利亞，則申請人：
(a) is outside Australia; and
(a) 在澳洲境外；和
(b) holds a working holiday eligible passport.
(b) 持有符合打工度假資格的護照。
(3B) If the applicant is, or has previously been, in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa other than an offshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa:
(3B) 如果申請人現在或曾經作為 417 子類（工作度假）簽證（受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的離岸簽證以外的簽證持有者）身在澳洲：
(a) the applicant may be in or outside Australia, but not in immigration clearance; and
(a) 申請人可在澳洲境內或境外，但尚未辦理出入境手續；和
(c) if, disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has held only one Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa in Australia—the application must be accompanied by a declaration by the applicant that he or she has carried out specified Subclass 417 work for a total period of at least 3 months as the holder of that visa; and
(c) 如果不考慮任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證，申請人在澳洲僅持有一份 417 子類（工作度假）簽證－該申請必須附有申請人的聲明，表明他或她作為該簽證持有者已從事指定的 417 子類工作總計至少 3 個月；和
(ca) if, disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has held 2 Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visas in Australia—the application must be accompanied by a declaration by the applicant that:
(ca) 如果申請人在澳洲持有 2 個 417 子類（工作度假）簽證（無論是否有任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證），則該申請必須附有申請人的聲明：
(i) the applicant has carried out specified Subclass 417 work for a total period of at least 6 months; and
(i) 申請人已完成指定的 417 子類工作總計至少 6 個月；和
(ii) all of that work was carried out while the applicant held the second Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa or while the applicant held a bridging visa that was in effect and was granted on the basis of the application for the second Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa (made at a time when the applicant held the first Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa); and
(ii) 所有這些工作都是在申請人持有第二個 417 子類（工作假期）簽證期間或申請人持有有效的過橋簽證並根據第二個 417 子類（工作假期）簽證申請（在申請人持有第一個 417 子類（工作假期）簽證時申請的）期間進行的；和
(iii) all of that work was carried out on or after 1 July 2019; and
(iii) 所有這些工作均在 2019 年 7 月 1 日或之後進行；和
(d) disregarding any COVID ‑ 19 affected visa, the applicant has not held more than 2 Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visas in Australia (including any Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa held by the applicant at the time of application); and
(d) 無論任何受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證，申請人在澳洲持有的 417 類（工作假期）簽證不超過 2 個（包括申請人在申請時持有的任何 417 類（工作假期）簽證）；和
(e) the applicant holds a working holiday eligible passport; and
(e) 申請人持有符合打工度假資格的護照；和
(f) if the applicant is in Australia, the applicant must:
(f) 若申請人在澳大利亞，申請人必須：
(i) hold a substantive visa; or
(i) 持有實質簽證；或
(ii) have held a substantive visa at any time in the period of 28 days immediately before making the application.
(ii) 在提出申請前 28 天內的任何時間持有實質簽證。
(3BA) Paragraphs (3B)(c) and (ca) do not apply if the applicant holds a passport of a kind specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for the purposes of this subitem.
(3BA) 如果申請人持有部長在為本項目的製定的立法文書中指定的護照類型，則第 (3B)(c) 和 (ca) 款不適用。
(3BB) Paragraphs (3B)(c) and (ca) do not apply if:
(3BB) 第 (3B)(c) 及 (ca) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) the application is made between 5 March 2022 and 31 December 2022; and
(a) 申請於2022年3月5日至2022年12月31日期間提出；和
(b) the applicant holds or held an onshore COVID ‑ 19 affected visa; and
(b) 申請人持有或持有境內受新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 影響的簽證；和
(c) the applicant has not been granted a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa on the basis of another application made on or after 5 March 2022.
(c) 申請人尚未根據 2022 年 3 月 5 日或之後提出的另一項申請獲得 417 類（工作假期）簽證。
(3BC) Paragraph (3B)(e) does not apply if:
(3BC) 第 (3B)(e) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) the applicant is in Australia; and
(a) 申請人在澳洲；和
(b) when entering Australia, the applicant held a working holiday eligible passport; and
(b) 申請人進入澳洲時持有打工度假資格護照；和
(c) the passport expired after the applicant entered Australia.
(c) 申請人進入澳洲後護照過期。
(3BD) Paragraph (3B)(f) does not apply if.
(3BD) 第 (3B)(f) 款不適用於下列情況。
(a) the application is made between 5 March 2022 and 31 December 2022; and
(a) 申請於2022年3月5日至2022年12月31日期間提出；和
(b) the applicant holds a bridging visa.
(b) 申請人持有過橋簽證。
(3C) The applicant must not have previously been in Australia as the holder of a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa.
(3C) 申請人之前不得以 462 類（工作和度假）簽證持有者身份進入澳洲。
(4) Subclasses:
(4) 子類別：
417 (Working Holiday)
417（工作假期）
(5) In this item:
(5) 本項中：
working holiday eligible passport means a valid passport held by a person who is a member of a class of persons specified in an instrument mentioned in subitem (3).
打工度假資格護照是指屬於第(3)項所述文書中指定的一類人員的成員所持有的有效護照。

(b) 第二期付款（在授予簽證之前支付）為零。

（三）其他：
(c) An application must be made at the place, and in the manner, (if any) specified by the Minister in a legislative instrument made for this item under subregulation 2.07(5).
(c) 申請必須在部長根據第 2.07(5) 款為此項目制定的立法文書中指定的地點和方式（如果有）提出。
(f) The following applicants may be in or outside Australia when making their applications, but not in immigration clearance:
(f) 以下申請人在提出申請時可以在澳洲境內或境外，但不能辦理出入境檢查：
(i) an applicant claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who, having satisfied the primary criteria, holds a Skilled (Provisional) (Class VC) visa;
(i) 申請人聲稱自己是符合主要標準並持有技術（臨時）（VC 級）簽證的人員的家庭成員；
(iii) an applicant who is applying for a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream or a Subclass 485 visa as a member of the family unit of an applicant for a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream.
(iii) 正在申請替換流中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證的申請人，或作為替換流中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證申請人的家庭成員申請 485 子類簽證。
(g) An applicant to whom paragraph (f) does not apply must be in Australia, but not in immigration clearance, when making his or her application.
(g) (f) 款不適用的申請人在提出申請時必須在澳大利亞，但尚未辦理出入境手續。
(h) An application by a person claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who seeks to satisfy the primary criteria may be made at the same time and place as, and combined with, an application by that person.
(h) 自稱是尋求滿足主要標準的人的家庭成員的申請可以與該人的申請同時和地點提出，並與其一起提出。
(j) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa must nominate only one stream to which the application relates.
(j) 尋求符合授予 485 類（臨時畢業生）簽證主要標準的申請人必須僅提名與申請相關的一個類別。
(k) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Vocational Education Work stream must nominate a skilled occupation for the applicant that is specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph.
(k) 尋求滿足在職業教育工作類別中授予 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證的主要標準的申請人必須為申請人提名由部長在本段書面文書中指定的技術職業。
(l) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream must hold, or have held, a Student Temporary (Class TU) visa.
(l) 尋求滿足在高等教育工作類別中授予 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證的主要標準的申請人必須持有或曾經持有學生臨時（TU 類）簽證。
(la) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a subsequent Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream must:
(la) 尋求符合授予高等教育後工作類別中的後續 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證的主要標準的申請人必須：
(i) hold a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream or the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream; or
(i) 持有學習後工作類別或高等教育工作類別的 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證；或
(ii) hold a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream and have held a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream.
(ii) 在替換類別中持有 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證，並且在學習後工作類別中持有 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證。
(lb) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream must meet the requirements of subitem (5).
(lb) 尋求滿足替換類別 485（臨時畢業生）簽證授予主要標準的申請人必須滿足第 (5) 款的要求。
(m) An applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa must meet the requirements of subitem (4).
(m) 尋求符合授予 485 類（臨時畢業生）簽證主要標準的申請人必須符合第 (4) 項的要求。
(4) The following requirements must be met:
（四）必須符合下列要求：
(a) one of the following subparagraphs must be satisfied by the applicant:
(a) 申請人必須符合以下一項：
(i) the applicant holds an eligible student visa;
(i) 申請人持有合格的學生簽證；
(ia) the applicant is outside Australia when the application is made and the applicant has held an eligible student visa;
(ia) 提出申請時申請人在澳洲境外並且持有合格的學生簽證；
(ii) the applicant must:
(ii) 申請人必須：
(A) hold a Bridging A (Class WA) visa or Bridging B (Class WB) visa that was granted on the basis of a valid application for a visa; and
(A) 持有根據有效簽證申請授予的過橋 A（WA 級）簽證或過橋 B（WB 級）簽證；和
(B) have held an eligible student visa at any time during the period of 6 months ending immediately before the day on which the application for the Skilled (Provisional) (Class VC) visa is made;
(B) 在申請技術（臨時）（VC 類）簽證之日之前的 6 個月內的任何時間持有合格的學生簽證；
(iii) the applicant must:
(iii) 申請人必須：
(A) hold a substantive visa; and
(A) 持有實質簽證；和
(B) have held an eligible student visa at any time during the period of 6 months ending immediately before the day on which the application for the Skilled (Provisional) (Class VC) visa is made;
(B) 在申請技術（臨時）（VC 類）簽證之日之前的 6 個月內的任何時間持有合格的學生簽證；
(iv) if the ART made a decision to set aside and substitute the Minister’s decision not to revoke the cancellation of the applicant’s eligible student visa—the applicant must:
(iv) 如果 ART 決定擱置並替代部長不撤銷取消申請人合格學生簽證的決定－申請人必須：
(A) if the ART’s decision is given to the applicant orally—have been taken, under subsection 368(7) of the Act, to have been notified of the decision not more than 28 days before the day on which the application is made;
(A) 如果 ART 的決定是口頭給予申請人的，則根據該法第 368(7) 款，已被認為在提出申請之日前 28 天以內已收到該決定的通知；
(B) otherwise—have been taken, under section 379C of the Act, to have received the notification of the ART’s decision not more than 28 days before the day on which the application is made;
(B) 否則－根據該法第 379C 條，已被視為在提出申請之日前 28 天內收到 ART 決定的通知；
(v) the applicant holds a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream or the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream and is applying for a subsequent Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream;
(v) 申請人持有學習後工作類別或高等教育工作類別的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，並正在申請高等教育後工作類別的後續 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(vi) the applicant holds a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream and is applying for a subsequent Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream;
(vi) 申請人持有 485 子類別的替代類別（臨時畢業生）簽證，並正在申請高等教育後工作類別的後續 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(vii) the applicant holds a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa that was granted on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for that visa and is applying for a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream;
(vii) 申請人持有485子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，該簽證是在滿足該簽證的主要標準的基礎上獲得的，並且正在替換類別中申請485子類（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(viii) the applicant:
(八) 申請人：
(A) held a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa that was granted on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for that visa; and
(A) 持有 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，該簽證是在滿足該簽證主要標準的基礎上獲得的；和
(B) either holds a substantive visa or holds a Bridging A (Class WA) visa or Bridging B (Class WB) visa that was granted on the basis of a valid application for a visa; and
(B) 持有實質簽證或持有根據有效簽證申請而獲得的過橋 A（WA 級）簽證或過橋 B（WB 級）簽證；和
(C) is applying for a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream;
(C) 正在申請替換類別的 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(aa) if the visa applied for were granted, the total number of Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visas held by the applicant, including that visa:
(aa) 如果申請的簽證獲得批准，申請人持有的 485 類（臨時畢業生）簽證總數，包括該簽證：
(i) must not be more than 4; and
(i) 不得超過 4 個；和
(ii) must not include more than one Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream, or the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream, granted on the basis of meeting the requirements in clause 485.232, 485.233, 485.234 or 485.235 of Schedule 2;
(ii) 在符合附表 2 第 485.232、485.233、485.234 或 485.235 條要求的基礎上授予的學習後工作類別或高等教育後工作類別中不得包含多於一份 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(b) the applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa must be:
(b) 尋求符合授予 485 類（臨時畢業生）簽證主要標準的申請人必須是：
(i) if the applicant holds a Hong Kong passport or a British National (Overseas) passport, or has completed a masters degree (research) or a doctoral degree—less than 50 years old; or
(i) 如申請人持有香港護照或英國國民（海外）護照，或已完成碩士（研究）學位或博士學位－年齡不超過50歲；或
(ii) otherwise—35 years old or younger.
(ii) 否則－35 歲或以下。
(5) The following requirements must be met by an applicant seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream:
(5) 尋求符合替換類別 485（臨時畢業生）簽證授予主要標準的申請人必須符合以下要求：
(a) the applicant must make the application before 1 July 2024;
(a) 申請人必須在2024年7月1日之前提出申請；
(b) the applicant must hold or have held a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa (the first visa ) that:
(b) 申請人必須持有或曾經持有485子類（臨時畢業生）簽證（第一個簽證）：
(i) was granted on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for the first visa; and
(i) 在滿足首次簽證的主要標準的基礎上獲得批准；和
(ii) was granted before 15 December 2021; and
(ii) 在 2021 年 12 月 15 日之前授予；和
(iii) was in effect on or after 1 February 2020;
(iii) 於 2020 年 2 月 1 日或以後生效；
(c) if the applicant was outside Australia when the first visa was granted:
(c) 如果申請人在獲得第一個簽證時在澳洲境外：
(i) the applicant must have entered Australia on a day on which the first visa was in effect and that occurred before 15 December 2021; and
(i) 申請人必須在第一個簽證生效之日進入澳大利亞，且該日期發生在 2021 年 12 月 15 日之前；和
(ii) the applicant must have later departed Australia on a day on which the first visa was in effect and that occurred before 15 December 2021;
(ii) 申請人必須在第一份簽證生效的當天離開澳大利亞，且該日期發生在 2021 年 12 月 15 日之前；
(d) if the applicant was in Australia when the first visa was granted—the applicant must have been outside Australia on a day on which the first visa was in effect and that occurred between 1 February 2020 and 14 December 2021;
(d) 如果申請人在獲得第一個簽證時在澳洲－申請人必須在第一個簽證生效的當天在澳洲境外，且該日期發生在2020年2月1日至2021年12月14日之間；
(e) if any of the following visas held by the applicant have been cancelled:
(e) 申請人持有的下列簽證已被取消：
(i) a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa;
(i) 485 類（臨時畢業生）簽證；
(ii) a visa granted after the applicant held a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa;
(ii) 申請人持有485類（臨時畢業生）簽證後所獲得的簽證；
then, either of the following must apply to each cancelled visa:
那麼，以下任一情況必須適用於每個被取消的簽證：
(iii) the cancelled visa must have been cancelled on the ground specified in paragraph 2.43(1)(g);
(iii) 被取消的簽證必須是根據第2.43(1)(g)條規定的理由被取消的；
(iv) the decision to cancel the cancelled visa must have been set aside by the ART.
(iv) 取消已取消簽證的決定必須已被 ART 擱置。
(10) Subclasses:
(10) 小類：
Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate)
子類 485（臨時畢業生）
(11) In this item:
(11) 本項中：
completed , in relation to a masters degree (research) or a doctoral degree, means having met the academic requirements for its award.
就碩士學位（研究）或博士學位而言，完成意味著已滿足其授予的學術要求。
Note: The academic requirements for the award of a masters degree (research) or a doctoral degree do not include the formal conferral of the degree. Therefore, a person can complete such a degree, for the purposes of this definition, before the award is formally conferred.
註：授予碩士學位（研究型）或博士學位的學術要求不包括正式授予學位。因此，就本定義而言，一個人可以在正式授予獎項之前完成這樣的學位。
eligible student visa means a student visa, other than:
合格的學生簽證是指學生簽證，但以下情況除外：
(a) a visa granted to a Foreign Affairs student or Defence student; or
(a) 授予外交學生或國防學生的簽證；或
(b) a visa granted on the basis of the applicant being a member of the family unit of the holder of a student visa.
(b) 基於申請人是學生簽證持有人的家庭成員而授予的簽證。
PHE visa means either:
PHE 簽證意味著：
(a) a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream or the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream; or
(a) 學習後工作類別或高等教育工作類別的 485 子類別（臨時畢業生）簽證；或
(b) a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Replacement stream held by a person who previously held a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Study Work stream.
(b) 替換流中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，由先前持有學習後工作流程中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證的人持有。

title: 1230 Skilled—Regional Sponsored (Provisional) (Class SP)

text:

(a) first instalment (payable at the time the application is made):
(a) 第一期付款（在提出申請時支付）：
(i) for an applicant:
(i) 對於申請人：

(A) 持有太平洋地區國家簽發的有效護照並持有特定技能簽證；或
(B) whose application is combined, or sought to be combined, with an application made by that person; or

(C) who claims to be a member of the family unit of a person (the primary person ) who both holds a Regional Sponsored (Provisional) (Class SP) visa and holds a valid passport issued by a Pacific ‑ regional country, and the primary person held a specified skills visa at the time of applying for the Regional Sponsored (Provisional) (Class SP) visa:
(C) 自稱持有地區擔保（臨時）（SP類）簽證並持有太平洋地區國家簽發的有效護照的人（主要人士）的家庭成員，且主要人士在申請地區擔保（臨時）（SP類）簽證時持有特定技能簽證：
First instalment
Item | Component | Amount
1 | Base application charge | $450
2 | Additional applicant charge for an applicant who is at least 18 | $225
3 | Additional applicant charge for an applicant who is less than 18 | $110
第一期
項目 |組件|金額
1 |基礎申請費 | 450 美元
2 |年滿 18 歲的申請人需繳交額外費用 | 225 美元
3 | 18 歲以下申請人需繳交額外費用 | 110 美元
(ii) for an applicant:
(ii) 對於申請人：
(A) who does not hold a valid passport issued by a Pacific ‑ regional country and who holds a specified skills visa; or
(A) 不持有太平洋地區國家簽發的有效護照並持有特定技能簽證的；或
(B) whose application is combined, or sought to be combined, with an application made by that person; or

the applicant must be outside Australia.

(cag) If an applicant is seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for a Subclass 403 (Temporary Work (International Relations)) visa in the Mobility Arrangement for Talented Early ‑ professionals Scheme stream, the applicant:

(i) must be outside Australia when the application is made; and
(i) 提出申請時必須在澳洲境外；和
(ii) must meet the requirements in subitem (3F).
(ii) 必須符合第 (3F) 項的要求。
(cb) An applicant must not hold a permanent visa.
(cb) 申請人不得持有永久簽證。
(cc) If the applicant (the secondary applicant ) claims to be a member of the family unit of a person who:
(cc) 若申請人（副申請人）聲稱自己是下列人員的家庭成員：
(i) is an applicant for the grant of, or holds, a Subclass 403 (Temporary Work (International Relations)) visa in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility stream; or
(i) 是獲得或持有太平洋澳大利亞勞動力流動類別 403 子類（臨時工作（國際關係））簽證的申請人；或
(ii) holds a Subclass 403 (Temporary Work (International Relations)) visa in the Pacific Labour Scheme stream;
(ii) 持有太平洋勞工計畫類別的 403 子類別（臨時工作（國際關係））簽證；
the application by the secondary applicant is supported, in writing, by a Department responsible for administering the scheme known as the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme.
第二申請人的申請得到負責管理太平洋澳大利亞勞動力流動計畫的部門的書面支持。
(d) An application by a person claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who is an applicant for an Temporary Work (International Relations) (Class GD) visa may be made at the same time and place as, and combined with, an application by that person or any other member of the family unit who claims to be a member of the family unit of the primary applicant.
(d) 自稱是臨時工作（國際關係）（GD 類）簽證申請人家庭成員的人提出的申請，可以與該人或自稱是主申請人家庭成員的任何其他家庭成員在同一時間和地點提出申請，並與其一起提出申請。
Note: An applicant for a Temporary Work (International Relations) (Class GD) visa cannot meet the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa if the primary applicant holds a Subclass 403 (Temporary Work (International Relations)) visa in the Domestic Worker (Diplomatic or Consular) stream (see clause 403.311 of Schedule 2).
注意：如果主申請人持有家庭工人（外交或領事）類別的 403 子類（臨時工作（國際關係））簽證，則臨時工作（國際關係）（GD 類）簽證的申請人不能滿足授予簽證的次要標準（參見附表 2 第 403.311 條）。

(i) 臨時活動贊助人或已申請批准為臨時活動贊助人但其申請尚未決定的人；和
(ii) participating, as an employer, in the scheme known as the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme.
(ii) 以雇主身分參與太平洋澳大利亞勞動力流動計畫。

notice of selection , in relation to a particular visa pre ‑ application process, means the notice of selection given to a selected participant in that process in accordance with the visa pre ‑ application process determination for that process.

(baa) Either:

(i) 申請人已提出有效的實質簽證（保護（XA類）簽證除外）申請，但尚未最終確定；或

(ii) 已在法定期限內申請對申請人實質簽證申請（保護類（XA）簽證申請除外）的決定進行司法審查，且司法審查程序（包括上訴程序，如有）尚未完成。

(ii) the applicant has made a valid application for a Protection (Class XA) visa and application has been made for judicial review of a decision in relation to the applicant’s valid application for a Protection (Class XA) visa, and the judicial review proceedings (including proceedings on appeal, if any) have not been completed.
(ii) 申請人已提出有效的保護（XA級）簽證申請，並已申請對與申請人有效保護（XA級）簽證申請相關的決定進行司法審查，且司法審查程序（包括上訴程序，如有）尚未完成。
(bb) Applicant must not be:
(bb) 申請人不得：
(i) the holder of a Subclass 785 (Temporary Protection) visa, including a Subclass 785 (Temporary Protection) visa granted before 2 December 2013; or
(i) 785類（臨時保護）簽證持有者，包括2013年12月2日之前簽發的785類（臨時保護）簽證；或
(ii) a person whose last substantive visa was a Subclass 785 (Temporary Protection) visa, including a Subclass 785 (Temporary Protection) visa granted before 2 December 2013; or
(ii) 最後一次實質簽證為 785 子類（臨時保護）簽證的人，包括 2013 年 12 月 2 日之前授予的 785 子類（臨時保護）簽證；或
(iii) the holder of a Subclass 790 (Safe Haven Enterprise) visa; or
(iii) 790 類（避風港企業）簽證持有者；或
(iv) a person whose last substantive visa was a Subclass 790 (Safe Haven Enterprise) visa.
(iv) 最後的實質簽證是 790 類（避風港企業）簽證的人。
(c) Applicant is not in immigration detention or criminal detention.
(c) 申請人沒有被移民拘留或刑事拘留。
(ca) Either:
(ca) 任一：
(i) the applicant is not a person in respect of whom a weapons of mass destruction determination has been made; or
(i) 申請人不是已被認定為大規模毀滅性武器的人；或
(ii) if the applicant is a person in respect of whom a weapons of mass destruction determination has been made—the Foreign Minister, or a person authorised by the Foreign Minister, has subsequently determined that the applicant is no longer a person whose presence in Australia may be directly or indirectly associated with the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.
(ii) 如果申請人已被確定為大規模殺傷性武器－外交部長或外交部長授權的人隨後確定申請人不再是其在澳洲的存在可能與大規模殺傷性武器擴散直接或間接相關的人。
(d) Application by a person claiming to be a member of the family unit of a person who is an applicant for a Bridging B (Class WB) visa may be made at the same time and place as, and combined with, the application by that person.
(d) 自稱是過橋 B（WB 類）簽證申請人的家庭成員的人的申請可以與該人的申請同時和地點同時提出。

(4) 子類別：

(ia) holds, or has ever held, a Safe Haven Enterprise (Class XE) visa; or

(ii) holds, or has ever held, a Temporary Safe Haven (Class UJ) visa; or
(ii) 持有或曾經持有臨時避風港（UJ 類）簽證；或
(iii) holds, or has ever held, a Temporary (Humanitarian Concern) (Class UO) visa; or
(iii) 持有或曾經持有臨時（人道關注）（UO 類）簽證；或
(iv) did not hold a visa that was in effect on the person’s last entry into Australia; or
(iv) 未持有上次進入澳洲時有效的簽證；或
(v) is an unauthorised maritime arrival; or
(v) 未經授權的海上抵達；或
(vi) was not immigration cleared on the person’s last entry into Australia.
(vi) 該人最後一次進入澳洲時未獲得移民許可。
(e) Either:
(e) 要嘛：

(iii) a SHEV has been granted to the applicant.
(iii) SHEV 已授予申請人。
Note: A person to whom subparagraph (ii) applies, whose SHEV application has been refused, is prevented by section 48A of the Act from making the Temporary Protection visa application unless the Minister has made a determination in relation to the person under section 48B of the Act.

(f) The application for the visa was not made at the same time as an application for a SHEV.
(f) 簽證申請未與 SHEV 申請同時提出。
Note: TPV/SHEV transition day is defined in regulation 1.03.

(vii) 該人最後一次進入澳洲時未獲得移民許可。

(4) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, specify a regional area for the purposes of these regulations.

(3) An applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(3) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：

(b) the Minister is satisfied that the applicant has a compelling need to work.

(5) An applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(5) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) the applicant has made, in Australia, a valid application for a substantive visa of a kind that can be granted if the applicant is in Australia; and
(a) 申請人已在澳洲提出有效的實質簽證申請，如果申請人在澳洲境內，則可以獲得此類簽證；和
(aa) that application was refused; and
(aa) 該申請被拒絕；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the applicant, or the Minister, has applied, within statutory time limits, for judicial review of a decision in relation to the applicant’s substantive visa application; or
(i) 申請人或部長已在法定期限內申請對與申請人的實質簽證申請有關的決定進行司法審查；或

(二) 申請人：
(A) is a member of the family unit of a person whose substantive visa application is the subject of the judicial review proceedings mentioned in subparagraph (i); and
(A) 是其實質簽證申請屬於第(i)項所述司法審查程序對象的人員的家庭成員；和
(B) made a substantive visa application that was combined with the substantive visa application mentioned in subparagraph (i); and
(B) 提出與第(i)項所述的實質簽證申請合併的實質簽證申請；和
(c) at the time of that application, he or she held a Bridging C (Class WC) visa; and
(c) 在提出申請時，他或她持有過橋 C（WC 類）簽證；和
(d) the judicial review proceedings (including proceedings on appeal, if any) are not completed.
(d) 司法覆核程序（包括上訴程序，如有）尚未完成。

(b) 允許持有人留在澳洲直至：

(i) 若部長關於實質簽證申請的決定是授予簽證－授予簽證；或

(iiaa) if the Minister’s decision in respect of that application is to refuse to grant a visa and subclause (1A) applies in relation to the decision—the time the Minister makes the decision; or
(iiaa) 如果部長就該申請做出的決定是拒絕授予簽證並且第 (1A) 款適用於該決定－部長做出決定的時間；或
(iia) if the substantive visa application is refused and the ART decides that the holder’s application for merits review of that refusal was not made in accordance with the law governing the making of applications to the ART—35 days after the ART makes the decision; or
(iia) 如果實質簽證申請被拒絕，且 ART 決定持有人對該拒絕的案情審查申請未按照管轄向 ART 提出申請的法律提出－ART 做出決定後 35 天；或者
(iii) if the substantive visa application is refused and the ART makes a decision on the holder’s application for merits review of that refusal (other than a decision to remit the application to the Minister for reconsideration)—35 days after the ART makes the decision; or
(iii) 如果實質簽證申請被拒絕，且 ART 對持有人的拒絕案情審查申請做出決定（而非決定將申請轉交給部長重新考慮）－ART 做出決定後 35 天；或
(iv) the grant of another bridging visa to the holder in respect of the same application for a substantive visa; or
(iv) 就同一實質簽證申請授予持有人另一份過橋簽證；或

(1A) This subclause applies in relation to a decision to refuse to grant the non ‑ citizen a substantive visa if:

(a) despite any failure to comply with the requirements of the Act or these Regulations in relation to the decision mentioned in the subparagraph; and
