(b) 主申請人提出申請時已年滿 18 歲；
satisfies public interest criterion 4019.
滿足公共利益準則 4019。
(6) Each person:
(6) 每人：
(a) who is a member of the family unit of the primary applicant; and
(a) 主申請人的家庭成員；和
(b) who is not an applicant for a Subclass 858 visa;
(b) 不是 858 類簽證的申請人；
satisfies public interest criteria 4001, 4002, 4003, 4003B and 4004, and satisfies public interest criterion 4007 unless the Minister is satisfied that it would be unreasonable to require the person to undergo assessment in relation to that criterion.
滿足公共利益準則 4001、4002、4003、4003B 和 4004，並滿足公共利益準則 4007，除非部長認為要求該人接受與該標準相關的評估是不合理的。
(7) Each person:
(7) 每人：
(a) who was, at the time of the primary applicant’s application, a member of the family unit of the primary applicant but is no longer a member of the family unit of the primary applicant; and
(a) 在主申請人提出申請時是主申請人家庭成員，但不再是主申請人家庭成員；和
(b) who is a member of the family unit of a person who is covered by subclause (3); and
(b) 屬於第 (3) 款所涵蓋人員的家庭成員；和
(c) who is not an applicant for a Subclass 858 visa;
(c) 不是 858 類簽證的申請人；
satisfies public interest criteria 4001, 4002, 4003, 4003B and 4004, and satisfies public interest criterion 4007 unless the Minister is satisfied that it would be unreasonable to require the person to undergo assessment in relation to that criterion.
滿足公共利益準則 4001、4002、4003、4003B 和 4004，並滿足公共利益準則 4007，除非部長認為要求該人接受與該標準相關的評估是不合理的。

858.32—Criteria to be satisfied at time of decision
text:
(1) The applicant meets the requirements of subclause (2), (3), (3A) or (4).
(1) 申請人符合第 (2)、(3)、(3A) 或 (4) 款的要求。
(2) The applicant meets the requirement of this subclause if the applicant is a member of the family unit of a person (the primary applicant ) who holds a Subclass 858 visa granted on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for the grant of the visa .
(2) 如果申請人是持有基於滿足授予簽證的主要標準而授予的 858 類簽證的人（主申請人）的家庭成員，則申請人符合本款的要求。
(3) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(3) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) at the time of the application, the applicant was the spouse or de facto partner of a person (the primary applicant ) seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 858 visa, and the primary applicant has since been granted that visa; and
(a) 在申請時，申請人是尋求滿足授予 858 類簽證主要標準的人（主申請人）的配偶或同居伴侶，並且主申請人此後已獲得該簽證；和
(b) the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant has ceased; and
(b) 主申請人與申請人之間的關係已終止；和
(c) one or more of the following:
(c) 以下一項或多項：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a member of the family unit of the applicant who has made a combined application with the applicant or with the primary applicant;
(ii) 與申請人或主申請人合併申請的申請人家庭成員；
(iii) a dependent child of the applicant or of the primary applicant;
(iii) 申請人或主申請人的受扶養子女；
has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant; and
曾遭受主申請人的家庭暴力；和
(d) the applicant:
(d) 申請人：
(i) was in Australia at the time the applicant’s visa application was made; or
(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或
(ii) entered Australia after the applicant’s visa application was made.
(ii) 申請人提出簽證申請後進入澳洲。
(3A) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(3A) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) at the time of the application, the applicant was the spouse or de facto partner of a person (the primary applicant ) seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 858 visa; and
(a) 在申請時，申請人是尋求符合授予 858 類簽證主要標準的人（主申請人）的配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant has ceased; and
(b) 主申請人與申請人之間的關係已終止；和
(c) one or more of the following:
(c) 以下一項或多項：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a member of the family unit of the applicant who has made a combined application with the applicant or with the primary applicant;
(ii) 與申請人或主申請人合併申請的申請人家庭成員；
(iii) a dependent child of the applicant or of the primary applicant;
(iii) 申請人或主申請人的受扶養子女；
has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant; and
曾遭受主申請人的家庭暴力；和
(d) the applicant:
(d) 申請人：
(i) was in Australia at the time the applicant’s visa application was made; or
(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或
(ii) entered Australia after the applicant’s visa application was made; and
(ii) 申請人提出簽證申請後進入澳洲；和
(e) the Minister has decided to refuse to grant the primary applicant the visa for reasons including that the primary applicant had engaged in conduct involving family violence (whether or not the family violence was against a person mentioned in paragraph (c)).
(e) 部長決定拒絕向主申請人發放簽證，原因包括主申請人曾從事涉及家庭暴力的行為（無論家庭暴力是否針對（c）段中提到的人）。
(4) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(4) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) the applicant is a member of the family unit of a person (the secondary applicant ) who meets the requirements of subclause (3) or (3A); and
(a) 申請人是符合第(3)或(3A)款要求的人（副申請人）的家庭成員；和
(b) the applicant has made a combined application with either the secondary applicant or the primary applicant mentioned in subclause (3) or (3A) (whichever applies to the secondary applicant); and
(b) 申請人與第(3)或(3A)款中提到的副申請人或主申請人（以適用於副申請人的為準）提出了合併申請；和
(c) a Subclass 858 visa has since been granted to the secondary applicant.
(c) 858 子類簽證已授予第二申請人。
Note: For special provisions relating to family violence, see Division 1.5.
註：有關家庭暴力的特殊規定，請參閱1.5節。

text:
(1) This clause applies if the applicant (the secondary applicant ) meets the requirements of subclause 858.321(3A).
(1) 若申請人（副申請人）符合第 858.321(3A) 款的要求，則本條款適用。

(3) 858簽證副申請人的每位家庭成員均符合：

(6) 副申請人非858類簽證申請人的每位家庭成員：

zh: 簽證子類別 864 — 付費類年長父母
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas

title: 864.1—Interpretation
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
In this Part, a reference to an applicant who is the holder of a Subclass 884 (Contributory Aged Parent (Temporary)) visa means a person:
在本部分中，所提及的持有 884 類（繳費型老年父母（臨時））簽證的申請人是指：
(a) who, at the time of application, holds a Subclass 884 (Contributory Aged Parent (Temporary)) visa; or
(a) 申請時持有 884 類（繳費型老年父母（臨時））簽證；或
(b) who has held a Subclass 884 (Contributory Aged Parent (Temporary)) visa at any time in the 28 days immediately before making the application; or
(b) 在提出申請前 28 天內的任何時間持有 884 類（繳費型老年父母（臨時））簽證的人；或
(c) in relation to whom the Minister is satisfied that compassionate and compelling circumstances exist for the person to be considered to have been the holder of a Subclass 884 (Contributory Aged Parent (Temporary)) visa at the time of the application.
(c) 部長信納該人在申請時存在令人同情和令人信服的情況，被視為 884 類（繳費型老年父母（臨時））簽證的持有者。
Note: Australian permanent resident , aged parent , eligible New Zealand citizen , close relative , guardian , outstanding , parent visa and settled are defined in regulation 1.03, balance of family test is defined in regulation 1.05, parent is defined in subsection 5(1) of the Act (also see regulation 1.14A), de facto partner is defined in section 5CB of the Act (also see regulation 1.09A), and spouse is defined in section 5F of the Act (also see regulation 1.15A).
附註：澳洲永久居民、老年父母、符合資格的紐西蘭公民、近親、監護人、未償還債務、父母簽證和定居者的定義請參閱第 1.03 條，家庭平衡測試的定義見第 1.05 條，父母的定義見該法案第 5(1) 款（另見第 1.14A 所），父母的定義見該法案第 5(1) 款（另見第 1.14A 配偶），事實見伴侶的定義見第 55A.條該法的規定（另見第 1.15A 條）。

has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant; and

(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或

(4) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：

(i) 申請人；

has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant; and

(a) 40乘以申請人在重大投資者類別中持有188類簽證期間的完整年數；和

(b) 40乘以申請人在重大投資者延期類別中持有188子類簽證期間的年數（如有）（將一年的一部分視為1年）。
(2A) For the purposes of working out, under subclause (2), the number of days the applicant has been in Australia, the applicant is taken to have been in Australia during a period if:
(2A) 為了根據第 (2) 款計算申請人在澳洲的天數，申請人在一段時間內被視為在澳大利亞，如果：
(a) the applicant was outside Australia during a concession period; and
(a) 申請人在優惠期間身處澳洲境外；和
(b) during the concession period the applicant held a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream or a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor Extension stream; and
(b) 在優惠期間內，申請人持有重大投資者類別的 188 子類簽證或重大投資者延期類別的 188 子類簽證；和
(c) the Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream was granted to the applicant before 1 July 2019.
(c) 重大投資者類別的 188 子類簽證於 2019 年 7 月 1 日之前授予申請人。
(3) The applicant’s spouse or de facto partner has been in Australia on a Subclass 188 visa, granted on the basis that the applicant held a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream or the Significant Investor Extension stream, for at least the number of days worked out by adding the results of paragraphs (a) and (b):
(3) 申請人的配偶或同居伴侶已持 188 子類簽證在澳洲居留，該簽證是根據申請人在重大投資者流或重大投資者延期流中持有 188 子類簽證而獲得的，且居留天數至少為 (a) 和 (b) 段結果相加得出的天數：
(a) 180 multiplied by the number of complete years in the period in which the applicant held a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream; and
(a) 180 乘以申請人在重大投資者類別中持有 188 類簽證期間的完整年數；和
(b) 180 multiplied by the number of years (if any) (treating a part of a year as 1 year) in which the applicant held a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor Extension stream.
(b) 180乘以申請人在重大投資者延期類別中持有188子類簽證的年數（如果有）（將一年的一部分視為1年）。
(4) For the purposes of working out, under subclause (3), the number of days the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner has been in Australia, the spouse or partner is taken to have been in Australia during a period if:
(4) 為了根據第(3)款計算申請人的配偶或同居伴侶在澳洲的天數，如果符合以下條件，則該配偶或同居伴侶在一段時間內被視為在澳洲：
(a) the spouse or partner was outside Australia during a concession period; and
(a) 配偶或伴侶在減讓期內身處澳洲境外；和
(b) during the concession period the spouse or partner held a Subclass 188 visa, granted on the basis that the applicant held a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream or a Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor Extension stream; and
(b) 在優惠期間內，配偶或伴侶持有 188 子類簽證，該簽證是在申請人持有重大投資者類別 188 子類簽證或重大投資者延期類別 188 子類簽證的基礎上授予的；和
(c) the Subclass 188 visa in the Significant Investor stream was granted to the applicant before 1 July 2019.
(c) 重大投資者類別的 188 子類簽證於 2019 年 7 月 1 日之前授予申請人。
Note: It is not necessary for the applicant to have been in Australia for 40 days in each year in the period or the applicant’s spouse or de facto partner to have been in Australia for 180 days in each year in the period.
註：申請人無需在此期間每年在澳洲居住滿40天，或申請人的配偶或同居伴侶無需在此期間每年在澳洲居住滿180天。

title: 888.25—Criteria for Premium Investor stream
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
Note: These criteria are only for applicants seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for a Subclass 888 visa in the Premium Investor stream.
注意：這些標準僅適用於尋求符合高級投資者類別 888 簽證主要標準的申請人。

path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
(1) At the time of application the applicant has held a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Premium Investor stream for a continuous period of at least 12 months.
(1) 申請時，申請人已連續持有高級投資者類別188（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證至少連續12個月。
(2) For the whole of the period during which the applicant has held the visa mentioned in subclause (1), the applicant has held a complying premium investment (within the meaning of regulation 5.19D as in force at the time the application for that visa was made) except any part of the investment that is a philanthropic contribution.
(2) 在申請人持有第 (1) 款中提到的簽證的整個期間內，申請人持有符合要求的優質投資（按照申請該簽證時有效的第 5.19D 條的含義），但投資中屬於慈善捐款的任何部分除外。
(3) For any part of the complying premium investment (except any part of the investment that is a philanthropic contribution) that is, or was, a direct investment in an Australian proprietary company:
(3) 對於合規溢價投資的任何部分（屬於慈善捐贈的投資的任何部分除外）現在或曾經是對澳洲專有公司的直接投資：
(a) the company was a qualifying business for the whole period; or
(a) 該公司在整個期間內都是合格企業；或
(b) if the company has been unable to operate as a qualifying business, the Minister is satisfied that the applicant made a genuine attempt to operate the business as a qualifying business.
(b) 如果該公司無法作為合格企業運營，部長信納申請人確實嘗試以合格企業經營該企業。
(4) The applicant has given the Minister evidence that the investment complies with the requirements set out in regulation 5.19D as in force at the time of application.
(4) 申請人已向部長提供證據證明投資符合申請時有效的第 5.19D 條規定的要求。

title: 888.26—Criteria for Entrepreneur stream
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
Note: These criteria are only for applicants seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for a Subclass 888 visa in the Entrepreneur stream.
注意：這些標準僅適用於尋求滿足企業家類別 888 簽證主要標準的申請人。

path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
(1) At the time of application the applicant:
(1) 申請人在提出申請時：
(a) holds a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream and has done so for a continuous period of at least:
(a) 持有 188 個企業家類別的子類別（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證，並且連續持有該簽證的時間至少為：
(i) if the applicant was invited to apply for that visa before 1 July 2021—4 years; or
(i) 若申請人在 2021 年 7 月 1 日之前被邀請申請簽證－4 年；或
(ii) otherwise—3 years; and
(ii) 否則－3 年；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) if the applicant was invited to apply for that visa before 1 July 2021—has resided in Australia for at least 2 years of the 4 years mentioned in subparagraph (a)(i); or
(i) 如果申請人在 2021 年 7 月 1 日之前被邀請申請簽證－在 (a)(i) 項提及的 4 年中已在澳洲居住至少 2 年；或
(ii) otherwise—has resided in Australia for at least 2 years while holding a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream.
(ii) 否則－已在澳洲居住至少 2 年，同時持有 188 子類別的企業家類別（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證。
(1A) If:
(1A) 如果：
(a) the applicant was outside Australia during a concession period; and
(a) 申請人在優惠期間身處澳洲境外；和
(b) during the concession period the applicant held a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream (the qualifying visa ); and
(b) 在優惠期間內，申請人持有企業家類別的188子類（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證（合格簽證）；和
(c) the qualifying visa was granted before 1 July 2019; and
(c) 合格簽證是在 2019 年 7 月 1 日之前簽發的；和
(d) the qualifying visa expired during the concession period while the applicant was outside Australia and before the application was made;
(d) 當申請人在澳洲境外且在提出申請之前，合格簽證在優惠期間內過期；
then the applicant is taken to satisfy paragraph (1)(a) at the time of application.
那麼申請人在提出申請時就被視為符合第(1)(a)款的要求。
(1B) If:
(1B) 如果：
(a) the applicant was outside Australia during a concession period; and
(a) 申請人在優惠期間身處澳洲境外；和
(b) during the concession period the applicant held a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream; and
(b) 在優惠期間內，申請人持有企業家類別的188子類（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證；和
(c) the visa was granted before 1 July 2019;
(c) 簽證是在2019年7月1日之前簽發的；
then, for the purposes of working out under paragraph (1)(b) the length of time the applicant has resided in Australia, the applicant is taken to have resided in Australia during any period the applicant held the visa outside Australia during the concession period.
那麼，為了根據第(1)(b)款計算申請人在澳洲居住的時間長度，申請人在減讓期內在澳洲境外持有簽證的任何期間均被視為在澳洲居住。
(2) The applicant has demonstrated overall a successful record of undertaking, whether alone or by participating in a business, activities of an entrepreneurial nature (disregarding activities specified in an instrument made under subregulation 5.19E(6) for the purposes of paragraph 5.19E(2)(b)):
(2) 申請人整體表現出成功從事創業性質活動的記錄，無論是單獨或參與企業活動（為了第 5.19E(2)(b) 段的目的，不考慮根據第 5.19E(6) 款制定的文書中指定的活動）：
(a) in Australia; and
(a) 在澳洲；和
(b) while holding a Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa in the Entrepreneur stream.
(b) 持有 188 個企業家類別的子類別（商業創新和投資（臨時））簽證。
(3) In determining the success of the applicant’s record for the purposes of subclause (2), the Minister must have regard to the following (without limitation):
(3) 在決定申請人的記錄是否符合第 (2) 款的目的時，部長必須考慮以下因素（但不限於）：
(a) the number of Australian citizens and Australian permanent residents that are employed in Australia in relation to the activities;
(a) 在澳洲受僱從事與活動相關的澳洲公民和澳洲永久居民的人數；
(b) the level and nature of ongoing funding of, or investment in, the activities;
(b) 活動持續供資或投資的水平和性質；
(c) the annual turnover of businesses related to the activities;
(c) 與活動有關的業務的年營業額；
(d) any endorsement of the applicant’s record by a body recognised by the nominating State or Territory government agency as a start ‑ up incubator, start ‑ up accelerator or other body that assists start ‑ up businesses.
(d) 提名州或領地政府機構認可的新創企業孵化器、新創公司加速器或其他協助新創企業的機構對申請人記錄的認可。

title: 888.3—Secondary criteria
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas

title: 888.31—Criteria
path: Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
Schedule 2 — Provisions with respect to the grant of Subclasses of visas
text:
(1) The applicant meets the requirements of subclause (2), (3), (4), (5) or (6).
(一)申請人符合第(2)、(3)、(4)、(5)或(6)款的要求。
(2) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if the applicant:
(2) 若申請人符合以下條件，則申請人符合本款的要求：
(a) is the member of the family unit of a person (the primary applicant ) who holds a Subclass 888 visa granted on the basis of satisfying the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(a) 是持有888子類簽證的人（主申請人）的家庭成員，該簽證是在滿足授予簽證的主要標準的基礎上獲得的；和
(b) made a combined application with the primary applicant.
(b) 與主申請人合併申請。
(3) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(3) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) at the time of the application, the applicant was the spouse or de facto partner of a person (the primary applicant ) seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 888 visa, and the primary applicant has since been granted that visa; and
(a) 在申請時，申請人是尋求滿足授予 888 類簽證主要標準的人（主申請人）的配偶或同居伴侶，並且主申請人此後已獲得該簽證；和
(b) the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant has ceased; and
(b) 主申請人與申請人之間的關係已終止；和
(c) one or more of the following has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant:
(c) 下列一項或多項曾經歷主申請人所實施的家庭暴力：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a member of the family unit of the applicant who has made a combined application with the applicant or with the primary applicant;
(ii) 與申請人或主申請人合併申請的申請人家庭成員；
(iii) a dependent child of the applicant or of the primary applicant; and
(iii) 申請人或主申請人的受扶養子女；和
(d) the applicant:
(d) 申請人：
(i) was in Australia at the time the applicant’s visa application was made; or
(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或
(ii) entered Australia after the applicant’s visa application was made.
(ii) 申請人提出簽證申請後進入澳洲。
(4) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(4) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) at the time of the application, the applicant was the spouse or de facto partner of a person (the primary applicant ) seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 888 visa; and
(a) 在申請時，申請人是尋求符合授予 888 類簽證主要標準的人（主申請人）的配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant has ceased; and
(b) 主申請人與申請人之間的關係已終止；和
(c) one or more of the following has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant:
(c) 下列一項或多項曾經歷主申請人所實施的家庭暴力：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a member of the family unit of the applicant who has made a combined application with the applicant or with the primary applicant;
(ii) 與申請人或主申請人合併申請的申請人家庭成員；
(iii) a dependent child of the applicant or of the primary applicant; and
(iii) 申請人或主申請人的受扶養子女；和
(d) the applicant:
(d) 申請人：
(i) was in Australia at the time the applicant’s visa application was made; or
(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或
(ii) entered Australia after the applicant’s visa application was made; and
(ii) 申請人提出簽證申請後進入澳洲；和
(e) the Minister has decided to refuse to grant the primary applicant the visa for reasons including that the primary applicant had engaged in conduct involving family violence (whether or not the family violence was against a person mentioned in paragraph (c)).
(e) 部長決定拒絕向主申請人發放簽證，原因包括主申請人曾從事涉及家庭暴力的行為（無論家庭暴力是否針對（c）段中提到的人）。
(5) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(5) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) at the time of the application, the applicant was the spouse or de facto partner of a person (the primary applicant ) seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 888 visa; and
(a) 在申請時，申請人是尋求符合授予 888 類簽證主要標準的人（主申請人）的配偶或同居伴侶；和
(b) the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant has ceased; and
(b) 主申請人與申請人之間的關係已終止；和
(c) one or more of the following has experienced family violence committed by the primary applicant:
(c) 下列一項或多項曾經歷主申請人所實施的家庭暴力：
(i) the applicant;
(i) 申請人；
(ii) a member of the family unit of the applicant who has made a combined application with the applicant or with the primary applicant;
(ii) 與申請人或主申請人合併申請的申請人家庭成員；
(iii) a dependent child of the applicant or of the primary applicant; and
(iii) 申請人或主申請人的受扶養子女；和
(d) the applicant:
(d) 申請人：
(i) was in Australia at the time the applicant’s visa application was made; or
(i) 申請人提出簽證申請時在澳洲；或
(ii) entered Australia after the applicant’s visa application was made; and
(ii) 申請人提出簽證申請後進入澳洲；和
(e) the Minister has decided to refuse to grant the primary applicant the visa for reasons that the primary applicant does not meet the requirements of clause 888.225, 888.232 or 888.242; and
(e) 因主申請人不符合第 888.225、888.232 或 888.242 條的要求，部長決定拒絕向主申請人發放簽證；和
(f) the primary applicant would have met the requirements of the clause had the relationship between the primary applicant and the applicant not ceased.

(6) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(6) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) the applicant is a member of the family unit of a person (the secondary applicant ) who meets the requirements of subclause (3), (4) or (5); and

(c) a Subclass 888 visa has since been granted to the secondary applicant.
(c) 888 子類簽證已授予第二申請人。
Note: For special provisions relating to family violence, see Division 1.5.

Note 1: Member of the crew and non ‑ military ship are defined in regulation 1.03.
註1：船員與非軍用船舶的定義見第1.03條。
Note 2: For this Part, a person will sign on to a ship in Australia after:
註 2：對於本部分，人員將在以下時間後在澳洲登船：
(a) travelling to Australia on another visa in order to join a ship as a member of the crew; or
(a) 持另一簽證前往澳洲以作為船員上船；或
(b) joining the ship in Australia after signing off another ship in Australia; or
(b) 在澳洲簽收另一艘船後在澳洲上船；或
(c) joining another ship after the ship on which the person travelled to Australia is imported under section 49A or 71A of the Customs Act 1901 .
(c) 根據《1901 年海關法》第 49A 或 71A 條，在該人前往澳洲的船舶進口後，登上另一艘船舶。

path: Schedule 3 — Additional criteria applicable to unlawful non ‑ citizens and certain bridging visa holders
text:
3001 (1) The application is validly made within 28 days after the relevant day (within the meaning of subclause (2)).
3001 (1) 申請在相關日期後 28 天內有效提出（在第 (2) 款的含義內）。
(2) For the purposes of subclause (1) and of clause 3002, the relevant day, in relation to an applicant, is:
(2) 就第 (1) 款及第 3002 條而言，對申請人而言，相關日期為：
(a) if the applicant held an entry permit that was valid up to and including 31 August 1994 but has not subsequently been the holder of a substantive visa—1 September 1994; or
(a) 若申請人持有有效期至1994年8月31日（含）的入境許可證，但隨後並未持有實質簽證－1994年9月1日；或
(b) if the applicant became an illegal entrant before 1 September 1994 (whether or not clause 6002 in Schedule 6 of the Migration (1993) Regulations applied or section 195 of the Act applies) and has not, at any time on or after 1 September 1994, been the holder of a substantive visa—the day when the applicant last became an illegal entrant; or
(b) 如果申請人在 1994 年 9 月 1 日之前成為非法入境者（無論《移民（1993）條例》附表 6 中的第 6002 條是否適用，或該法第 195 條是否適用），並且在 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後的任何時間都沒有實際入境日期；
(c) if the applicant:
(c) 如果申請人：
(i) ceased to hold a substantive or criminal justice visa on or after 1 September 1994; or
(i) 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後不再持有實質或刑事司法簽證；或
(ii) entered Australia unlawfully on or after 1 September 1994;
(ii) 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後非法進入澳洲；
whichever is the later of:
以較晚者為準：
(iii) the last day when the applicant held a substantive or criminal justice visa; or
(iii) 申請人持有實質或刑事司法簽證的最後一天；或
(iv) the day when the applicant last entered Australia unlawfully; or
(iv) 申請人最後一次非法進入澳洲的日期；或
(d) if the last substantive visa held by the applicant was cancelled, and the ART has made a decision to set aside and substitute the cancellation decision or the Minister’s decision not to revoke the cancellation—the later of the day when that last substantive visa ceased to be in effect and the day when:
(d) 如果申請人持有的最後一個實質性簽證被取消，並且 ART 已做出擱置並替代取消決定的決定，或者部長決定不撤銷取消，則以最後一個實質性簽證不再有效之日和以下日期中較晚者為準：
(i) if the ART’s decision is given to the applicant orally—the applicant is taken, under subsection 368(7) of the Act, to have been notified of the decision; or
(i) 若 ART 的決定以口頭方式給予申請人－根據該法第 368(7) 款，申請人被視為已被告知該決定；或
(ii) otherwise—the applicant is taken, under section 379C of the Act, to have received the notification of the ART’s decision.
(ii) 否則－根據該法案第 379C 條，申請人被視為已收到 ART 決定的通知。

path: Schedule 3 — Additional criteria applicable to unlawful non ‑ citizens and certain bridging visa holders

3002 The application is validly made within 12 months after the relevant day (within the meaning of subclause 3001(2)).

path: Schedule 3 — Additional criteria applicable to unlawful non ‑ citizens and certain bridging visa holders
text:
3003 If:
第3003章
(a) the applicant has not, on or after 1 September 1994, been the holder of a substantive visa; and
(a) 申請人在 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後尚未持有實質簽證；和
(b) on 31 August 1994, the applicant was either:
(b) 1994年8月31日，申請人是：
(i) an illegal entrant; or
(i) 非法入境者；或
(ii) the holder of an entry permit that was not valid beyond 31 August 1994;
(ii) 入境許可證的持有者在 1994 年 8 月 31 日之後無效；
the Minister is satisfied that:
部長信納的是：
(c) the applicant last became an illegal entrant, or, in the case of a person referred to in subparagraph (b)(ii), last became a person in Australia without a substantive visa, because of factors beyond the applicant’s control; and
(c) 由於申請人無法控制的因素，申請人最後成為非法入境者，或對於(b)(ii)項中提到的人，最後成為沒有實質簽證的澳洲人；和
(d) there are compelling reasons for granting the visa; and
(d) 授予簽證有令人信服的理由；和
(e) the applicant has complied substantially with the conditions that apply or applied to:
(e) 申請人已基本遵守適用於或已應用於下列事項的條件：
(i) the last of any entry permits held by the applicant (other than a condition of which the applicant was in breach solely because of the expiry of the entry permit); and
(i) 申請人持有的最後一份入境許可證（申請人僅因入境許可證過期而違反的條件除外）；和
(ii) any subsequent bridging visa; and
(ii) 任何隨後的過橋簽證；和
(f) the applicant would have been entitled to be granted an entry permit equivalent to a visa of the class applied for if the applicant had applied for the entry permit immediately before last becoming an illegal entrant or, in the case of a person referred to in subparagraph (b)(ii), if the applicant had applied for the entry permit on 31 August 1994; and
(f) 如果申請人在最後一次成為非法入境者之前申請了入境許可證，或者對於(b)(ii)項所述的人來說，如果申請人於1994年8月31日申請了入境許可證，那麼該申請人將有權獲得相當於所申請類別簽證的入境許可證；和
(g) the applicant intends to comply with any conditions subject to which the visa is granted; and
(g) 申請人打算遵守授予簽證的任何條件；和
(h) the last entry permit (if any) held by the applicant was not granted subject to a condition that the holder would not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted an entry permit, or a further entry permit, while the holder remained in Australia.
(h) 申請人持有的最後一次入境許可證（如果有）沒有被授予，但條件是持有人在進入澳洲後，在其留在澳洲期間無權獲得入境許可證或進一步的入境許可證。

path: Schedule 3 — Additional criteria applicable to unlawful non ‑ citizens and certain bridging visa holders
text:
3004 If the applicant:
第3004章 如果申請人：
(a) ceased to hold a substantive or criminal justice visa on or after 1 September 1994; or
(a) 在 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後不再持有實質或刑事司法簽證；或
(b) entered Australia unlawfully on or after 1 September 1994 and has not subsequently been granted a substantive visa;
(b) 1994 年 9 月 1 日或之後非法進入澳大利亞，且隨後未獲得實質簽證；
the Minister is satisfied that:
部長信納的是：
(c) the applicant is not the holder of a substantive visa because of factors beyond the applicant’s control; and
(c) 因申請人無法控制的因素，導致申請人無法持有實質簽證；和
(d) there are compelling reasons for granting the visa; and
(d) 授予簽證有令人信服的理由；和
(e) the applicant has complied substantially with:
(e) 申請人已基本遵守：
(i) the conditions that apply or applied to:
(i) 適用或適用的條件：
(A) the last of any entry permits held by the applicant (other than a condition of which the applicant was in breach solely because of the expiry of the entry permit); and
(A) 申請人持有的最後一份入境許可證（申請人僅因入境許可證過期而違反的條件除外）；和
(B) any subsequent bridging visa; or
(B) 任何後續過橋簽證；或
(ii) the conditions that apply or applied to:
(ii) 適用或適用於的條件：
(A) the last of any substantive visas held by the applicant (other than a condition of which the applicant was in breach solely because the visa ceased to be in effect); and
(A) 申請人持有的最後一個實質簽證（申請人僅因為簽證不再有效而違反的條件除外）；和
(B) any subsequent bridging visa; and
(B) 任何後續過橋簽證；和
(f) either:
(f) 任一：
(i) in the case of an applicant referred to in paragraph (a)—the applicant would have been entitled to be granted a visa of the class applied for if the applicant had applied for the visa on the day when the applicant last held a substantive or criminal justice visa; or
(i) 對於(a)款中所提及的申請人－如果申請人在最後一次持有實質或刑事司法簽證之日申請簽證，則該申請人將有權獲得所申請類別的簽證；或
(ii) in the case of an applicant referred to in paragraph (b)—the applicant would have satisfied the criteria (other than any Schedule 3 criteria) for the grant of a visa of the class applied for on the day when the applicant last entered Australia unlawfully; and
(ii) 如果是(b)段中提到的申請人－申請人將符合在申請人最後一次非法進入澳洲之日所申請類別簽證的授予標準（附表3中的任何標準除外）；和
(g) the applicant intends to comply with any conditions subject to which the visa is granted; and
(g) 申請人打算遵守授予簽證的任何條件；和
(h) if the last visa (if any) held by the applicant was a transitional (temporary) visa, that visa was not subject to a condition that the holder would not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted an entry permit, or a further entry permit, while the holder remained in Australia.
(h) 如果申請人持有的最後一個簽證（如果有）是過渡（臨時）簽證，則該簽證不受以下條件的限制：持有人在進入澳洲後，在其留在澳洲期間無權獲得入境許可證或進一步的入境許可證。

path: Schedule 3 — Additional criteria applicable to unlawful non ‑ citizens and certain bridging visa holders
text:
3005 A visa or entry permit has not previously been granted to the applicant on the basis of the satisfaction of any of the criteria set out in:
3005 簽證或入境許可之前未曾根據滿足以下規定的任何標準而授予申請人：
(a) this Schedule; or
(a) 本附表；或
(b) Schedule 6 of the Migration (1993) Regulations; or
(b) 《移民（1993）條例》附表 6；或
(c) regulation 35AA or subregulation 42(1A) or (1C) of the Migration (1989) Regulations.
(c) 《移民（1989）條例》第 35AA 條或第 42(1A) 或 (1C) 款。
Note: Section 10 of the Act provides that a child who was born in the migration zone and was a non ‑ citizen when he or she was born shall be taken to have entered Australia when he or she was born.
註：該法第10條規定，在移民區出生且出生時為非公民的兒童在出生時應被視為已進入澳洲。

Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions
text:
4001 Either:
第4001章 要嘛：
(a) the person satisfies the Minister that the person passes the character test; or
(a) 此人使部長信納此人通過了品格測試；或
(b) the Minister is satisfied, after appropriate inquiries, that there is nothing to indicate that the person would fail to satisfy the Minister that the person passes the character test; or
(b) 經過適當詢問後，部長信納沒有任何跡象顯示該人無法使部長信納該人通過品格測試；或
(c) the Minister has decided not to refuse to grant a visa to the person despite reasonably suspecting that the person does not pass the character test; or
(c) 儘管有合理理由懷疑該人未通過性格測試，但部長仍決定不拒絕向該人發放簽證；或
(d) the Minister has decided not to refuse to grant a visa to the person despite not being satisfied that the person passes the character test.
(d) 儘管對該人通過性格測驗不滿意，但部長仍決定不拒絕向該人發放簽證。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions
text:
4002 The applicant is not assessed by the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation to be directly or indirectly a risk to security, within the meaning of section 4 of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation Act 1979 .
4002 根據《1979 年澳洲安全情報組織法》第 4 條的涵義，澳洲安全情報組織未評估申請人對安全構成直接或間接風險。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions
text:
4003 The applicant:
4003 申請人：
(a) is not determined by the Foreign Minister, or a person authorised by the Foreign Minister, to be a person whose presence in Australia is, or would be, contrary to Australia’s foreign policy interests; and
(a) 不被外交部長或外交部長授權的人認定為在澳洲存在違反或將會違反澳洲外交政策利益的人；和
(b) is not determined by the Foreign Minister, or a person authorised by the Foreign Minister, to be a person whose presence in Australia may be directly or indirectly associated with the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction; and
(b) 不被外交部長或外交部長授權的人確定為在澳洲的存在可能與大規模毀滅性武器的擴散直接或間接相關的人；和
(c) either:
(c) 任一：
(i) is not declared under paragraph 6(b) or 6A(1)(b), (2)(b), (4)(b), (5)(b), (8)(b) or (9)(b) of the Autonomous Sanctions Regulations 2011 for the purpose of preventing the person from travelling to, entering or remaining in Australia; or
(i) 未依據《2011 年自主制裁條例》第 6(b) 或 6A(1)(b)、(2)(b)、(4)(b)、(5)(b)、(8)(b) 或 (9)(b) 段宣告為阻止該人前往、進入或留在澳洲；或
(ii) if the applicant is declared—is a person for whom the Foreign Minister has waived the operation of the declaration in accordance with regulation 19 of the Autonomous Sanctions Regulations 2011 .
(ii) 如果申請人被宣布－是外交部長根據 2011 年《自主制裁條例》第 19 條放棄執行聲明的人。

title: 4003A
path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions

4003A The applicant is not determined by the Foreign Minister, or a person authorised by the Foreign Minister, to be a person whose presence in Australia may be directly or indirectly associated with the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.
4003A 外交部長或外交部長授權的人員未確定申請人在澳洲的存在可能與大規模殺傷性武器的擴散直接或間接相關。

title: 4003B

4003B 部长尚未确定申请人转让关键技术存在不合理的风险。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions

4004 The applicant does not have outstanding debts to the Commonwealth unless the Minister is satisfied that appropriate arrangements have been made for payment.
4004 除非部長信納已做出適當的付款安排，否則申請人對聯邦沒有未償債務。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions
text:
4005 (1) The applicant:
4005 (1) 申請人：
(aa) if the applicant is in a class of persons specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this paragraph:
(aa) 若申請人屬於部長在本段書面文書中指定的一類人員：
(i) must undertake any medical assessment specified in the instrument; and
(i) 必須進行文書中規定的任何醫療評估；和
(ii) must be assessed by the person specified in the instrument;
(ii) 必須由文書中指定的人員進行評估；
unless a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth decides otherwise; and
除非聯邦醫療官員另有決定；和
(ab) must comply with any request by a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth to undertake a medical assessment; and
(ab) 必須遵守聯邦醫療官員提出的任何進行醫療評估的要求；和
(a) is free from tuberculosis; and
(a) 沒有結核病；和
(b) is free from a disease or condition that is, or may result in the applicant being, a threat to public health in Australia or a danger to the Australian community; and
(b) 沒有患有或可能導致申請人對澳洲公共衛生構成威脅或對澳洲社區構成危險的疾病或病症；和
(c) is, unless the applicant is a minor born in Australia and is ordinarily resident in Australia, free from a disease or condition in relation to which:
(c) 除非申请人是在澳大利亚出生并通常居住在澳大利亚的未成年人，否则不患有与以下相关的疾病或病症：
(i) a person who has it would be likely to:
(i) 擁有它的人可能會：
(A) require health care or community services; or
(A) 需要醫療保健或社區服務；或
(B) meet the medical criteria for the provision of a community service;
(B) 符合提供社區服務的醫療標準；
during the period described in subclause (2); and
在第(2)款所述期間；和
(ii) the provision of the health care or community services would be likely to:
(ii) 提供醫療保健或社區服務可能會：
(A) result in a significant cost to the Australian community in the areas of health care and community services; or
(A) 在醫療保健和社區服務領域為澳洲社區帶來巨大成本；或
(B) prejudice the access of an Australian citizen or permanent resident to health care or community services;
(B) 妨礙澳洲公民或永久居民獲得醫療保健或社區服務；
regardless of whether the health care or community services will actually be used in connection with the applicant; and
無論醫療保健或社區服務是否實際與申請人一起使用；和
(d) if the applicant is a person from whom a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth has requested a signed undertaking to present himself or herself to a health authority in the State or Territory of intended residence in Australia for a follow ‑ up medical assessment—has provided the undertaking.
(d) 如果申請人是聯邦醫療官員要求其簽署的承諾書，以將其本人帶到澳洲預期居住的州或地區的衛生當局進行後續醫療評估，則申請人已提供該承諾。
(2) For subparagraph (1)(c)(i), the period is:
(2) 對於第 (1)(c)(i) 項，期限為：
(a) for an application for a permanent visa—the period commencing when the application is made; or
(a) 對於永久簽證申請－從提出申請時開始的期限；或
(b) for an application for a temporary visa:
(b) 申請臨時簽證：

(a) 申請人所在國的法律允許驅逐申請人；
(b) each person who can lawfully determine where the applicant is to live consents to the grant of the visa;
(b) 每個能夠合法確定申請人居住地點的人均同意簽發簽證；
(c) the grant of the visa would be consistent with any Australian child order in force in relation to the applicant.
(c) 簽證的授予將符合對申請人有效的任何澳洲兒童令。

4018 The Minister is satisfied that there is no compelling reason to believe that the grant of the visa would not be in the best interests of the applicant.
4018 部長信納沒有令人信服的理由相信簽證的授予不符合申請人的最佳利益。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions

4019 (1) The applicant has signed a statement (a values statement ) in accordance with Part 3.
4019 (1) 申請人已根據第3部分簽署了一份聲明（價值觀聲明）。
Note: Part 3 sets out further provisions relating to values statements and the requirements for this criterion.
註：第 3 部分列出了與價值陳述和本標準要求相關的進一步規定。
(2) However, if compelling circumstances exist, the Minister may decide that the applicant is not required to satisfy subclause (1).
(2) 然而，如果有令人信服的情況，部長可以決定申請人無需滿足第 (1) 款。

path: Schedule 4 — Public interest criteria and related provisions
text:
4020 (1) There is no evidence before the Minister that the applicant has given, or caused to be given, to the Minister, an officer, the ART during the review of a reviewable migration decision, a relevant assessing authority or a Medical Officer of the Commonwealth, a bogus document or information that is false or misleading in a material particular in relation to:
4020 (1) 沒有證據表明，在審查可審查的移民決定期間，申請人已向部長、官員、ART、相關評估機構或聯邦醫療官員提供或促使向部長、官員、聯邦醫療官員提供以下方面虛假或誤導性的虛假文件或資訊：
(a) the application for the visa; or
(a) 簽證申請；或
(b) a visa that the applicant held in the period of 12 months before the application was made.
(b) 申請人在提出申請前12個月內持有的簽證。
(2) The Minister is satisfied that during the period:
(2) 部長信納在此期間：
(a) starting 3 years before the application was made; and
(a) 從提出申請前3年開始；和
(b) ending when the Minister makes a decision to grant or refuse to grant the visa;
(b) 當部長決定授予或拒絕授予簽證時結束；
the applicant and each member of the family unit of the applicant has not been refused a visa because of a failure to satisfy the criteria in subclause (1).
申請人及其家庭成員並未因未符合第(1)款中的標準而被拒絕簽證。
(2AA) However, subclause (2) does not apply to the applicant if, at the time the application for the refused visa was made, the applicant was under 18.
(2AA) 但是，如果在申請被拒絕簽證時申請人未滿 18 歲，則第 (2) 款不適用於申請人。
(2A) The applicant satisfies the Minister as to the applicant’s identity.
(2A) 申請人使部長對申請人的身分感到滿意。
(2B) The Minister is satisfied that during the period:
(2B) 部長信納在此期間：
(a) starting 10 years before the application was made; and
(a) 從提出申請前 10 年開始；和
(b) ending when the Minister makes a decision to grant or refuse to grant the visa;
(b) 當部長決定授予或拒絕授予簽證時結束；
neither the applicant, nor any member of the family unit of the applicant, has been refused a visa because of a failure to satisfy the criteria in subclause (2A).
申請人或申請人的任何家庭成員均未因未符合第 (2A) 款中的標準而被拒絕簽證。
(2BA) However, subclause (2B) does not apply to the applicant if, at the time the application for the refused visa was made, the applicant was under 18.
(2BA) 但是，如果在申請被拒絕簽證時申請人未滿 18 歲，則第 (2B) 款不適用於申請人。
(3) To avoid doubt, subclauses (1) and (2) apply whether or not the Minister became aware of the bogus document or information that is false or misleading in a material particular because of information given by the applicant.
(3) 為避免疑問，無論部長是否因申請人提供的信息而意識到在重要細節上存在虛假或誤導性的虛假文件或信息，第 (1) 和 (2) 款均適用。
(4) The Minister may waive the requirements of any or all of paragraphs (1)(a) or (b) and subclause (2) if satisfied that:
(4) 若部長信納下列情況，可免除第 (1)(a) 或 (b) 款及第 (2) 款的任何或所有要求：
(a) compelling circumstances that affect the interests of Australia; or
(a) 影響澳洲利益的令人信服的情況；或
(b) compassionate or compelling circumstances that affect the interests of an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or an eligible New Zealand citizen;
(b) 影響澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合條件的紐西蘭公民利益的令人同情或令人信服的情況；
justify the granting of the visa.
證明授予簽證的合理性。
(5) In this clause:
(5) 本條：
information that is false or misleading in a material particular means information that is:
重大資訊中存在虛假或誤導性的資訊是指以下資訊：
(a) false or misleading at the time it is given; and
(a) 在提供時存在虛假或誤導性；和
(b) relevant to any of the criteria the Minister may consider when making a decision on an application, whether or not the decision is made because of that information.
(b) 與部長在對申請做出決定時可能考慮的任何標準相關，無論該決定是否是根據該資訊做出的。
Note: For the definition of bogus document , see subsection 5(1) of the Act.
註：有關虛假文件的定義，請參閱該法案第 5(1) 款。

Statement
聲明
(1) For public interest criterion 4019, the Minister must, by instrument in writing, approve one or more values statements for the subclasses of visas specified in the instrument.
(1) 對於公共利益準則 4019，部長必須透過書面文書批准文書中指定的簽證子類的一項或多項價值觀聲明。
(2) A values statement must include provisions relating to:
(2) 價值觀聲明必須包括以下相關條款：
(a) values that are important to Australian society; and
(a) 對澳洲社會重要的價值觀；和
(b) matters concerning Australian citizenship (if relevant); and
(b) 有關澳洲公民身分的事宜（如果相關）；和
(c) compliance with the laws of Australia.
(c) 遵守澳洲法律。
(3) A values statement may include other provisions.
(3) 價值觀聲明可以包括其他規定。
Signing values statement—Internet application
簽署價值觀聲明—網路應用
(4) For public interest criterion 4019, a values statement is taken to have been signed by an applicant who makes an Internet application if the instructions for signing the values statement are followed.
(4) 對於公共利益準則 4019，如果遵循簽署價值觀聲明的說明，則提出互聯網申請的申請人已簽署價值觀聲明。

title: Schedule 5 — Special return criteria
zh: 附表 5 — 特別返澳準則
text:
(regulation 1.03)
（規則1.03）

5001 The applicant is not:
5001　申請人不得是以下人士：
(a) a person who left Australia while the subject of a deportation order under:
(a) 在受依以下規定所作的驅逐令約束期間離開澳洲的人士：
(i) section 200 of the Act; or
(i) 本法第 200 條；或
(ii) section 55, 56 or 57 of the Act as in force on and after 19 December 1989 but before 1 September 1994; or
(ii) 於 1989 年 12 月 19 日或之後、但在 1994 年 9 月 1 日之前有效的本法第 55、56 或 57 條；或
(iii) section 12, 13 or 14 of the Act as in force before 19 December 1989; or
(iii) 於 1989 年 12 月 19 日之前有效的本法第 12、13 或 14 條；或
(b) a person whose visa has been cancelled under section 501 of the Act, as in force before 1 June 1999, wholly or partly because the Minister, having regard to the person’s past criminal conduct, was satisfied that the person is not of good character; or
(b) 簽證依 1999 年 6 月 1 日之前有效的本法第 501 條被取消的人士，而取消簽證全部或部分是因部長考慮該人士過去的犯罪行為後，信納該人士並非品格良好；或
(c) a person whose visa has been cancelled under section 501, 501A or 501B of the Act, if:
(c) 簽證依本法第 501、501A 或 501B 條被取消的人士，如：
(i) the cancellation has not been revoked under subsection 501C(4) or 501CA(4) of the Act; or
(i) 該取消決定未依本法第 501C(4) 或 501CA(4) 款被撤銷；或
(ii) after cancelling the visa, the Minister has not, acting personally, granted a permanent visa to the person; or
(ii) 部長在取消該簽證後，未親自行使權力向該人士批准永久簽證；或
(ca) a person who left Australia, and whose visa has been refused under section 501, 501A or 501B of the Act, if:
(ca) 已離開澳洲，且簽證依本法第 501、501A 或 501B 條被拒絕的人士，如：
(i) the refusal has not been revoked under subsection 501C(4) of the Act; or
(i) 該拒簽決定未依本法第 501C(4) 款被撤銷；或
(ii) after refusing the visa, the Minister has not, acting personally, granted a permanent visa to the person;
(ii) 部長在拒絕該簽證後，未親自行使權力向該人士批准永久簽證；
whether or not the person was in Australia when the visa was refused; or
不論該人士在簽證被拒絕時是否身處澳洲；或
(d) a person whose visa has been cancelled under section 501BA of the Act if the Minister has not, acting personally, granted a permanent visa to the person after that cancellation.
(d) 簽證依本法第 501BA 條被取消的人士，而部長在該取消決定後，未親自行使權力向該人士批准永久簽證。

5002 If the applicant is a person who has been removed from Australia under section 198, 199 or 205 of the Act:
5002 如果申請人是根據該法第 198、199 或 205 條被驅逐出澳洲的人：
(a) the application is made more than 12 months after the removal; or
(a) 申請是在被驅逐後超過 12 個月提出的；或
(b) the Minister is satisfied that, in the particular case:
(b) 部長信納，在特定情況下：
(i) compelling circumstances that affect the interests of Australia; or
(i) 影響澳洲利益的令人信服的情況；或者
(ii) compassionate or compelling circumstances that affect the interests of an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or an eligible New Zealand citizen;
(ii) 影響澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合條件的紐西蘭公民利益的令人同情或令人信服的情況；
justify the granting of the visa within 12 months after the removal.
在被驅逐後 12 個月內證明授予簽證的合理性。

5010 (1) If:
5010 (1) 如果：
(a) the applicant is the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa; or
(a) 申請人持有外交學生簽證；或
(b) the applicant is the holder of a student visa granted to the applicant who is provided financial support by the government of a foreign country;
(b) 申請人持有由外國政府提供經濟支持的學生簽證；
the applicant meets the requirements of subclause (3), (4) or (5).
申請人符合第(3)、(4)或(5)款的要求。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) the applicant is not the holder of a Foreign Affairs student visa and has in the past held a Foreign Affairs student visa; or
(a) 申請人不是外交學生簽證持有者，且過去曾持有外交學生簽證；或
(b) both:
(b) 兩者：
(i) paragraph (a) does not apply to the applicant, and the applicant is not the holder of a substantive visa; and
(i) (a) 款不適用於申請人，且申請人不是實質簽證的持有者；和
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the applicant was a student visa granted to the applicant who was provided financial support by the government of a foreign country;
(ii) 申請人最後持有的實質簽證是由外國政府向申請人核發的學生簽證；
the applicant meets the requirements of subclause (3), (4) or (5).
申請人符合第(3)、(4)或(5)款的要求。
(3) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if the course of study or training to which:
(3) 若學習或訓練課程符合下列條件，則申請人符合本款的要求：
(a) the visa mentioned in paragraph (1)(a) or (b) relates; or
(a) 第(1)(a)或(b)款所提及的簽證；或
(b) if paragraph (2)(a) applies—the Foreign Affairs student visa most recently held by the applicant related; or
(b) 若第(2)(a)條適用－申請人最近持有的相關外交學生簽證；或
(c) if paragraph (2)(b) applies—the last substantive visa held by the applicant related;
(c) 若第 (2)(b) 款適用－申請人持有的最後一個相關實質簽證；
(whether or not the applicant has ceased the course) is one designed to be undertaken over a period of less than 12 months.
（無論申請人是否已停止課程）是一門設計時間少於 12 個月的課程。
(4) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if the applicant:
(4) 若申請人符合以下條件，則申請人符合本款的要求：
(a) has ceased:
(a) 已停止：
(i) the course of study or training to which:
(i) 學習或訓練課程：
(A) the visa mentioned in paragraph (1)(a) or (b) relates; or
(A) 第 (1)(a) 或 (b) 款所提及的簽證；或
(B) if paragraph (2)(a) applies—the Foreign Affairs student visa most recently held by the applicant related; or
(B) 若第 (2)(a) 段適用－申請人最近持有的相關外交學生簽證；或
(C) if paragraph (2)(b) applies—the last substantive visa held by the applicant related; or
(C) 若第 (2)(b) 款適用－申請人持有的最後一個相關實質簽證；或
(ii) another course approved by the AusAID Minister, the Foreign Minister or the government of the foreign country that provided financial support to the applicant, as the case requires, in substitution for that course; and
(ii) 經澳洲國際開發署部長、外交部長或根據情況需要向申請人提供財政支持的外國政府批准的另一門課程，以取代該課程；和
(b) has spent at least 2 years outside Australia since ceasing the course.
(b) 自停止課程後已在澳洲境外居住至少 2 年。
(5) The applicant meets the requirements of this subclause if:
(5) 申請人符合本款的要求，如果：
(a) the applicant has the support of the Foreign Minister or the government of the foreign country that provided financial support to the applicant, as the case requires, for the grant of the visa; or
(a) 申請人獲得外交部長或根據情況需要向申請人提供財政支持的外國政府的支持，以授予簽證；或
(b) the Minister is satisfied that, in the particular case, waiving the requirement of paragraph (a) is justified by:
(b) 部長信納，在特定情況下，放棄(a)款的要求是合理的：
(i) compelling circumstances that affect the interests of Australia; or
(i) 影響澳洲利益的令人信服的情況；或者
(ii) compassionate or compelling circumstances that affect the interests of an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or an eligible New Zealand citizen.
(ii) 影響澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民或符合條件的紐西蘭公民利益的令人同情或令人信服的情況。
(6) In this clause:
(6) 本條：
cease has the same meaning as in regulation 1.04A.
停止的意思與第 1.04A 條的意思相同。
Foreign Affairs student visa has the same meaning as in regulation 1.04A.
外交學生簽證與第1.04A條意義相同。

title: Part 6D.5 — Aggregating points for employment experience qualifications
zh: 第 6D.5 部 — 就業經驗資格的積分
path: Schedule 6D — General points test for General Skilled Migration visas mentioned in subregulation 2.26AC(1)
Part 6D.5 — Aggregating points for employment experience qualifications
text:
6D51 (1) If an applicant has a qualification mentioned in Part 6D.3 and a qualification mentioned in Part 6D.4, and the combined number of points that would be awarded under those Parts for the qualifications is more than 20 points:
6D51 (1) 如果申請人具有第 6D.3 部分提到的資格和第 6D.4 部分提到的資格，並且根據這些資格獲得的總分超過 20 分：
(a) the Minister must give the applicant 20 points under this Part for the qualifications; and
(a) 部長必須根據本部分的資格給予申請人 20 分；和
(b) no points are given under Part 6D.3 or 6D.4.
(b) 第 6D.3 或 6D.4 部分未給出任何分數。
(2) The prescribed number of points for the combination of qualifications is 20.
（二）資格組合規定積分為20分。

title: Schedule 8 — Visa conditions
zh: 附表 8 — 簽證附加條件
text:
(subregulations 2.05(1) and (2))
(第2.05(1)及(2)款)
Note 1: Whether a visa of a particular class may be made subject to any of these conditions depends on the relevant provision in Schedule 2.
註1：特定類別的簽證是否可以滿足這些條件取決於附表2的相關規定。
Note 2: As to cancellation for breaches of conditions, see the Act, ss. 41 and 116 to 119.
註 2：關於因違反條件而取消的規定，請參閱該法案第 1 條。 41和116至119。

8101 The holder must not engage in work in Australia.
8101 持有者不得在澳洲從事工作。

8102 The holder must not engage in work in Australia (other than in relation to the holder’s course of study or training).
8102 持有人不得在澳洲從事工作（與持有人的學習或培訓課程相關的工作除外）。

8103 The holder must not undertake work in Australia without the permission in writing of the Minister, which may be:
8103 未經部長書面許可，持有人不得在澳洲從事工作，可能是：
(a) in relation to specified work; or
(a) 與特定工作有關；或
(b) for a specified time.
(b) 在指定時間內。

8104 (1) The holder must not engage in work for more than 40 hours a fortnight while the holder is in Australia.
8104 (1) 持有者在澳洲期間每兩週從事的工作時間不得超過 40 小時。
(2) Subject to subclauses (2A) and (2B), if the holder is a member of the family unit of a person who satisfies the primary criteria for the grant of a student visa, the holder must not engage in work in Australia until the person who satisfies the primary criteria has commenced a course of study.
(2) 根據第(2A)和(2B)款，如果持有人是符合授予學生簽證的主要標準的人的家庭成員，則在滿足主要標準的人開始學習之前，持有人不得在澳洲從事工作。
(2A) Subclause (2) does not apply to the holder if:
(2A) 第 (2) 款不適用於持有人，如果：
(a) at the time of applying for the visa, the holder held a substantive visa or a bridging visa (the previous visa ); and
(a) 申請簽證時，持有者持有實質簽證或過橋簽證（原簽證）；和
(b) the holder was permitted to work in Australia during the period that the previous visa was in effect.
(b) 持有人在先前的簽證有效期內被允許在澳洲工作。
(2B) Subclause (2) does not apply to the holder if the person who satisfies the primary criteria for the grant of the student visa:
(2B) 若符合授予學生簽證的主要標準的人，則第 (2) 款不適用於持有人：
(a) held a substantive visa or a bridging visa (the previous visa ) at the time of applying for the student visa; and
(a) 申請學生簽證時持有實質簽證或過橋簽證（之前的簽證）；和
(b) was permitted to work in Australia during the period that the previous visa was in effect.
(b) 在先前的簽證有效期內被允許在澳洲工作。
(2C) If subclause (2) does not apply to the holder because of subclause (2A) or (2B), then despite subclause (1), the holder may engage in work for more than 40 hours a fortnight:
(2C) 若因第 (2A) 或 (2B) 款而第 (2) 款不適用於持有人，則儘管有第 (1) 款，持有人仍可每兩週從事超過 40 小時的工作：
(a) while the holder is in Australia; and
(a) 持有人在澳洲時；和
(b) before the course of study mentioned in subclause (2) commences.
(b) 在第(2)款所提及的學習課程開始之前。
(3) If the course of study mentioned in subclause (2) is for the award of a masters or doctoral degree, then despite subclause (1), the holder may engage in work for more than 40 hours a fortnight while the holder is in Australia.
（3）如果第（2）款中提到的學習課程是為了授予碩士或博士學位，那麼儘管有第（1）款的規定，持有人在澳洲期間每兩周可以從事超過40小時的工作。
(3A) If the visa held is a Subclass 500 (Student) visa, or a bridging visa granted on the basis of a valid application for a Subclass 500 (Student) visa, this clause applies as if the reference in subclauses (1), (2C) and (3) to 40 hours were instead a reference to 48 hours.
(3A) 如果持有的簽證是 500 類（學生）簽證，或根據 500 類（學生）簽證的有效申請而授予的過橋簽證，則本條款適用，如同第 (1)、(2C) 和 (3) 款中提到的 40 小時改為 48 小時一樣。
(4) In this clause:
(4) 本條中：
fortnight means the period of 14 days commencing on a Monday.
兩週是指從星期一開始的 14 天期間。

8105 (1A) Subject to subclause (1B), the holder must not engage in any work in Australia before the holder’s course of study commences.
8105 (1A) 根據第 (1B) 款，持有者在學習課程開始之前不得在澳洲從事任何工作。
(1B) Subclause (1A) does not apply to the holder if:
(1B) 第 (1A) 款不適用於持有人，如果：
(a) at the time of applying for the visa, the holder held a substantive visa or a bridging visa (the previous visa ); and
(a) 申請簽證時，持有者持有實質簽證或過橋簽證（原簽證）；和
(b) the holder was permitted to work in Australia during the period that the previous visa was in effect.
(b) 持有人在先前的簽證有效期內被允許在澳洲工作。
(1) Subject to subclause (2), the holder must not engage in work in Australia for more than 40 hours a fortnight during any fortnight when the holder’s course of study or training is in session.
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，持有者在學習或培訓課程期間的任何兩週內，每兩週不得在澳洲從事超過 40 小時的工作。
(2) Subclause (1) does not apply:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用：
(a) to work that was specified as a requirement of the course when the course particulars were entered in the Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students; and
(a) 當課程詳情輸入英聯邦海外學生機構和課程登記冊時，指定為課程要求的工作；和
(b) in relation to a student visa granted in relation to a masters degree by research or doctoral degree if the holder has commenced the masters degree by research or doctoral degree.
(b) 就研究型碩士學位或博士學位授予的學生簽證而言，如果持有者已開始攻讀研究型碩士學位或博士學位。
(2A) If the visa held is a Subclass 500 (Student) visa, or a bridging visa granted on the basis of a valid application for a Subclass 500 (Student) visa, this clause applies as if the reference in subclause (1) to 40 hours were instead a reference to 48 hours.
(2A) 如果持有的簽證是 500 類（學生）簽證，或根據 500 類（學生）簽證的有效申請而授予的過橋簽證，則本條款適用，如同第 (1) 款中提到的 40 小時改為 48 小時一樣。
(3) In this clause:
(3) 本條：
fortnight means the period of 14 days commencing on a Monday.
兩週是指從星期一開始的 14 天期間。

8106 The holder must engage in work in Australia only if the work is relevant to the conduct of the business, or performance of the tasks, specified in the visa application.
8106 只有在工作與簽證申請中指定的業務進行或任務執行相關時，持有人才必須在澳洲從事工作。

8107 (1) If the visa is not a visa mentioned in subclause (3) or (4), and was granted to enable the holder to be employed in Australia, the holder must not:
8107 (1) 如果簽證不是第 (3) 或 (4) 款中提到的簽證，並且是為了使持有人能夠在澳大利亞就業而授予的，則持有人不得：
(a) cease to be employed by the employer in relation to which the visa was granted; or
(a) 不再受僱於與簽證相關的雇主；或
(b) work in a position or occupation inconsistent with the position or occupation in relation to which the visa was granted; or
(b) 從事與簽證所涉職位或職業不一致的職位或職業；或
(c) engage in work for another person or on the holder’s own account while undertaking the employment in relation to which the visa was granted.
(c) 在從事與簽證相關的工作時為他人或為自己工作。
(2) If the visa is not a visa mentioned in subclause (3) or (4), and subclause (1) does not apply, the holder must not:
（2）如果簽證不是第（3）或（4）款中提到的簽證，且第（1）款不適用，則持有人不得：
(a) cease to undertake the activity in relation to which the visa was granted; or
(a) 停止從事與簽證相關的活動；或
(b) engage in an activity inconsistent with the activity in relation to which the visa was granted; or
(b) 從事與簽證所涉活動不符的活動；或
(c) engage in work for another person or on the holder’s own account inconsistent with the activity in relation to which the visa was granted.
(c) 為他人或為持有人自己從事與簽證所涉活動不符的工作。
(3) If the visa is, or the last substantive visa held by the applicant was, a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of subclause 457.223(2) or (4) (as in force before 18 March 2018):
(3) 如果該簽證或申請人持有的最後一個實質簽證是 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證，且該簽證是在持有人滿足第 457.223(2) 或 (4) 款（2018 年 3 月 18 日之前生效）的要求的基礎上授予的：
(a) the holder:
(a) 持有人：
(i) must work only in the occupation listed in the most recently approved nomination for the holder; and
(i) 必須僅在最近批准的持有人提名中列出的職業中工作；和
(ii) unless the circumstances in subclause (3A) apply:
(ii) 除非第 (3A) 款的情況適用：
(A) must work only for the party to a labour agreement or former party to a labour agreement who nominated the holder in the most recently approved nomination; or
(A) 必須僅為在最近批准的提名中提名持有人的勞動協議方或前勞動協議方工作；或
(B) if the sponsor is, or was, a standard business sponsor who was lawfully operating a business in Australia at the time of the sponsor’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the sponsor’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor—must work only in a position in the business of the sponsor or an associated entity of the sponsor; or
(B) 如果擔保人是或曾經是標準業務擔保人，並且在擔保人被批准為標準業務擔保人時，或在最後一次批准擔保人作為標準業務擔保人的批准期限變更時，該擔保人在澳大利亞合法經營業務，則必須僅在擔保人或其關聯實體的業務中工作；或
(C) if the sponsor is or was a standard business sponsor who was not lawfully operating a business in Australia, and was lawfully operating a business outside Australia, at the time of the sponsor’s approval as a standard business sponsor, or at the time of the last approval of a variation to the sponsor’s term of approval as a standard business sponsor—must work only in a position in the business of the sponsor; and
(C) 如果擔保人是或曾經是標準商業擔保人，但未在澳洲合法經營業務，而在澳洲境外合法經營業務，則在擔保人被批准為標準業務擔保人時，或在最後一次批准擔保人作為標準業務擔保人的批准期限變更時，必須僅在擔保人的業務中工作；和
(aa) subject to paragraph (c), the holder must:
(aa) 根據(c)段，持有人必須：
(i) if the holder was outside Australia when the visa was granted—commence work within 90 days after the holder’s arrival in Australia; and
(i) 若簽證核准時持有人在澳洲境外－則在持有人抵達澳洲後 90 天內開始工作；和
(ii) if the holder was in Australia when the visa was granted—commence work within 90 days after the holder’s visa was granted; and
(ii) 如果簽證核准時持有人在澳洲－在簽證核准後 90 天內開始工作；和
(b) the holder may cease to work in accordance with paragraph (a) for a period, but:
(b) 持有人可以根據(a)款停止工作一段時間，但是：
(i) any such period must not exceed 180 consecutive days; and
(i) 任何此類期限不得超過連續 180 天；和
(ii) the total number of days on which the holder does not work in accordance with paragraph (a) must not exceed 365 during the visa period for the holder’s visa; and
(ii) 在持有人簽證有效期限內，持有人不依(a)款規定工作的總天數不得超過365天；和
(c) if the holder is required to hold a licence, registration or membership that is mandatory to perform the occupation nominated in relation to the holder, in the location where the holder’s position is situated—the holder:

the holder must not:

8110 The holder:

(a) must not engage in work in Australia except in the household of the employer in relation to whom the visa was granted; and

8116 The holder must not work in Australia other than by engaging in an activity specified in a legislative instrument made by the Minister for this clause.
8116 持有人不得在澳洲工作，除非從事部長為此條款制定的立法文書中指定的活動。

(a) 持有人離開澳洲的航班；

(b) 在某一地點或以某種方式；
specified, orally or in writing, by the Minister from time to time.
由部長不時以口頭或書面指定。

the costs (within the meaning of Division 10 of Part 2 of the Act) of the holder’s detention.
持有人的拘留費用（根據該法第 2 部分第 10 節的含義）。

8511 Within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose, the holder must, show an officer a ticket for travel to a country other than Australia that the Minister is satisfied will allow the holder to enter on his or her arrival.

(b) has satisfied the secondary criteria; and
(b) 已符合次要標準；和
(c) holds a student visa because of paragraphs (a) and (b);
(c) 因(a)和(b)段而持有學生簽證；
must leave Australia not later than the time of departure of the holder.
必須在持有者離開澳洲的時間之前離開澳洲。

8525 持有人必須在指定日期或指定期限內搭乘指定交通工具離開澳洲。

8528 持有人在前往澳洲或進入澳洲時不得有一項或多項刑事定罪，且刑期（無論是否服刑）總計 12 個月或以上。

8529 The holder must, after entering Australia:
8529 持有者在進入澳洲後必須：
(a) undergo a medical examination carried out by:
(a) 接受由下列人員進行的體檢：
(i) a Commonwealth Medical Officer; or
(i) 聯邦醫療官員；或
(ii) a medical practitioner approved by the Minister; or
(ii) 經部長批准的醫生；或
(iii) a medical practitioner employed by an organisation approved by the Minister; and
(iii) 由部長批准的組織僱用的醫生；和

(i) 未滿 11 歲，且不是聯邦醫療官員要求進行此類檢查的人；或

(ii) 是一個人：

(A) 經聯邦醫療官員確認懷孕；和
(B) who has been examined for tuberculosis by a chest clinic officer employed by a health authority of a State or Territory; and
(B) 已接受州或地區衛生當局僱用的胸腔科診所官員的結核病檢查；和
(C) who has signed an undertaking to place herself under the professional supervision of a health authority in a State or Territory and to undergo any necessary treatment; and
(C) 已簽署承諾書，接受州或地區衛生當局的專業監督並接受任何必要的治療；和

8532 If the holder has not turned 18:
8532 若持有人未年滿 18 歲：
(a) the holder must stay in Australia with a person who is:

(i) 持有人的父母或擁有持有人監護權的人；或

(ii) 持有人的親屬：
(A) is nominated by a parent of the holder or a person who has custody of the holder; and
(A) 由持有人的父母或擁有持有人監護權的人提名；和
(B) has turned 21; and
(B) 已年滿 21 歲；和
(C) is of good character; or
（三）品行良好；或

(i) 持有人的住宿、支持和一般福利的安排必須得到外交部長的批准；和
(ii) the holder must not enter Australia before the day those arrangements are to commence.

while the holder remains in Australia.
而持有者仍在澳洲。

8543 持有者必須在部長以口頭或書面指定的地點、日期和時間出席，以便於安排和實現將其驅逐出澳洲。

(b) 航空或海運業的職業；

8552 持有人必須在變更發生前至少 2 個工作天通知部長其就業細節的任何變更。

8553 The holder must not become involved in activities that are prejudicial to security (within the meaning of section 4 of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation Act 1979 ).
8553 持有者不得參與有損安全的活動（《1979 年澳洲安全情報組織法》第 4 條涵義內）。

8554 (1) 持有人不得獲得以下任何商品：

weapon means a thing made or adapted for use for inflicting bodily injury.

8555 持有人在進行以下活動或類似活動之前必須獲得部長的批准：

(a) 飛行訓練；
(b) flying aircraft.
(b) 飛行的飛機。

8556 持有人不得與下列人員交流或交往：

(i) if the holder was outside Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s arrival in Australia; or
(i) 若簽證簽發時持有人在澳洲境外－持有人抵達澳洲後 90 天；或
(ii) if the holder was in Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s visa was granted; and
(ii) 若簽證被授予時持有人在澳洲－簽證被授予後 90 天；和
(b) continue to hold the authorisation while the holder is performing the occupation; and
(b) 在持有人從事職業期間繼續持有授權；和
(c) notify Immigration, in writing, as soon as practicable if an application for the authorisation is refused; and
(c) 如果授權申請被拒絕，請盡快以書面通知移民局；和
(d) comply with each condition or requirement to which the authorisation is subject; and
(d) 遵守授權所須遵守的每項條件或要求；和
(e) not engage in work that is inconsistent with the authorisation, including any conditions or requirements to which the authorisation is subject; and
(e) 不從事與授權不符的工作，包括授權所受的任何條件或要求；和
(f) notify Immigration, in writing, as soon as practicable if the authorisation ceases to be in force or is revoked or cancelled.
(f) 若授權不再有效或被撤銷或取消，請盡快以書面通知移民局。

8610 (1) If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.232 or 485.234 of Schedule 2 , the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.
8610 (1) 如果簽證是高等教育後工作流程中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，並且是在持有人滿足附表 2 第 485.232 或 485.234 條的要求的基礎上授予的，則持有人在澳大利亞期間，必須僅在簽證授予時屬於澳大利亞區域中心或其他地區的地區生活、工作和其他地區學習。
(2) If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (1), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(2) 如果簽證是在滿足第 (1) 款中提到的與主申請人相關的次要標準的基礎上授予的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，則持有人在澳大利亞期間必須僅在簽證授予時屬於澳大利亞區域中心或其他區域的地區生活、工作和學習。
(3) If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the Post ‑ Higher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.233 or 485.235 of Schedule 2, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(3) 如果簽證是高等教育後工作流程中的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，並且是在持有人滿足附表 2 第 485.233 或 485.235 條要求的基礎上授予的，則持有人在澳大利亞期間必須僅在簽證授予時屬於指定地區的澳大利亞部分地區生活、工作和學習。
(4) If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (3), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(4) 如果簽證是在滿足第 (3) 款中提到的與主申請人相關的次要標準的基礎上授予的 485 子類（臨時畢業生）簽證，則持有人在澳大利亞期間必須僅在簽證授予時屬於澳大利亞指定偏遠地區的部分地區生活、工作和學習。

8611 If the visa is a Subclass 403 visa in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility stream, the holder:
8611 如果簽證是太平洋澳大利亞勞動力流動類別的 403 子類簽證，則持有者：
(a) must not work other than:
(a) 不得從事以下以外的工作：
(i) for the holder’s sponsor in relation to the visa; or
(i) 與簽證有關的持有人擔保人；或
(ii) for another person in accordance with an arrangement endorsed by a Department responsible for administering the scheme known as the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme; and
(ii) 根據負責管理太平洋澳大利亞勞動力流動計劃的部門批准的安排為另一個人；和
(b) must not engage in work on the holder’s own account.
(b) 不得為持有人自己從事工作。

8612 The holder:
8612持有人：
(a) must, within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the full name, and date of birth, of each person who ordinarily resides with the holder at the holder’s residential address; and
(a) 必須在授予後 5 個工作天內，將通常與持有人居住在持有人居住地址的每個人的全名和出生日期通知移民局；和
(b) must notify Immigration of any change in the persons who ordinarily reside with the holder at the holder’s residential address within 2 working days after the change occurs.
(b) 必須在變更發生後 2 個工作天內將通常與持有人居住在持有人居住地址的人員發生變更的情況通知移民局。

8614 The holder must notify Immigration of any travel interstate or overseas by the holder at least 7 working days before undertaking the travel.
8614 持有者必須在旅行前至少 7 個工作天通知移民局其任何州際或海外旅行。

8615 (1) The holder must:
8615 (1) 持有人必須：
(a) within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the details of the holder’s association with, or membership of, any organisation that engages in activities involving more than incidental contact with minors or vulnerable persons (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2); and
(a) 在授予後 5 個工作天內，將持有人與任何組織的關聯或成員資格的詳細資訊通知移民局，該組織從事的活動不僅僅涉及與未成年人或弱勢群體的偶然接觸（見附表 2 第 070 部分的含義）；和
(b) notify Immigration of any change in those details (including the beginning or end of any association or membership) within 2 working days after the change occurs.
(b) 在這些細節發生任何變化（包括任何協會或會員資格的開始或結束）後 2 個工作天內通知移民局。
(2) Subclause (1) does not apply in relation to the following:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) an organisation formed for a purpose of engaging in communications on governmental or political matters;
(a) 為就政府或政治事務進行交流而成立的組織；
(b) an organisation whose regular functions or activities involve communications on governmental or political matters.
(b) 其日常職能或活動涉及政府或政治事務溝通的組織。

8616 (1) The holder must notify Immigration of the details of any contact with any individual who is known by the holder to have been charged with, or convicted of, a criminal offence.
8616 (1) 持有人必須向移民局通報與持有人所知被指控或被判犯有刑事犯罪的任何個人的任何聯繫詳情。
(2) Subclause (1) does not apply to:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於：
(a) contact in the course of attending a therapeutic or rehabilitative service; or
(a) 在參與治療或復健服務過程中接觸；或
(b) contact in connection with legal proceedings or legal advice; or
(b) 與法律訴訟或法律諮詢有關的聯繫；或
(c) incidental contact.
(c) 偶然接觸。

8617 The holder must notify Immigration of each of the following matters within 5 working days after the matter occurs:
8617 持有人必須在事項發生後5個工作天內將以下各項事項通知移民局：
(a) the holder receives, within any period of 30 days, an amount or amounts totalling AUD10 000 or more from one or more other persons;
(a) 持有人在 30 天內從一個或多個其他人收到總計 10,000 澳元或以上的金額；
(b) the holder transfers, within any period of 30 days, an amount or amounts totalling AUD10 000 or more to one or more other persons.
(b) 持有人在任意 30 天內將一筆或多筆金額總計 10,000 澳元或以上轉讓給一名或多名其他人。

8618 (1) If the holder incurs a debt or debts totalling AUD10 000 or more, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder incurs the debt or debts.
8618 (1) 若持有人產生的債務總額為 AUD10,000 或以上，則持有人必須在產生債務後 5 個工作天內通知移民局。
(2) If the holder is declared bankrupt, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder is so declared.
(2) 若持有人被宣告破產，持有人必須在宣告持有人破產後的5個工作天內通知移民局。
(3) The holder must notify Immigration of any significant change in relation to the holder’s debts or bankruptcy within 5 working days after the change occurs.
(3) 持有人必須在發生變更後5個工作天內將與持有人債務或破產有關的任何重大變更通知移民局。

8620 (1) The holder must, between 10 pm on one day and 6 am the next day or between such other times as are specified in writing by the Minister, remain at a notified address for the holder for those days.
8620 (1) 持有人必須在當天晚上 10 點至隔天上午 6 點之間或部長書面指定的其他時間期間，留在該日持有人指定的地址。
(2) If the Minister specifies other times for the purposes of subclause (1), the times must not be more than 8 hours apart.
(2) 若部長為第 (1) 款的目的而指定其他時間，則這些時間的間隔不得超過 8 小時。
(3) In this clause:
(3) 本條：
notified address for a holder for a particular day or days means any of the following:
特定日期或日期的持有人的通知地址是指以下任何一項：
(a) either:
(a) 任一：
(i) the address notified by the holder under condition 8513; or
(i) 持有人依條件 8513 通知的地址；或
(ii) if the holder has notified another address under condition 8625—the last address so notified by the holder;
(ii) 如果持有人已根據條件 8625 通知了另一個地址－持有人如此通知的最後一個地址；
(b) an address at which the holder stays regularly because of a close personal relationship with a person at that address, and which the holder has notified to Immigration for the purposes of this paragraph;
(b) 持有人因與該地址的人有密切的個人關係而經常居住的地址，並且持有人已為本段目的通知移民局；
(c) if, for the purposes of this paragraph, the holder notifies Immigration of an address for that day or those days no later than 12 pm on the day before that day or the earliest day of those days (as the case may be)—that address.
(c) 如果就本段而言，持有人在該日的前一天或這些天中最早的一天（視情況而定）的中午 12 點之前通知移民局當天或這些天的地址——該地址。
Note: Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
注意：根據第 2.25AF 條規定，簽證持有人在以下任何期間均不受此條件約束：
(a) under arrest or detained in custody; or
(a) 被逮捕或拘留；或
(b) admitted as an in ‑ patient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.
(b) 在公立或私立醫院、註冊精神衛生機構或其他註冊醫療機構接受治療。

8621 (1) The holder must wear a monitoring device at all times.
8621 (1) 持有者必須隨時配戴監控裝置。
(2) The holder must allow an authorised officer to fit, install, repair or remove the following:
(2) 持有者必須允許授權人員安裝、安裝、修理或拆除以下物品：
(a) the holder’s monitoring device;
(a) 持有人的監視裝置；
(b) any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device.
(b) 持有人監控裝置的任何相關監控設備。
(3) The holder must take any steps specified in writing by the Minister, and any other reasonable steps, to ensure that the following remain in good working order:
(3) 持有者必須採取部長書面指定的任何步驟以及任何其他合理步驟，以確保以下各項保持良好的工作狀態：
(a) the holder’s monitoring device;
(a) 持有人的監視裝置；
(b) any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device.
(b) 持有人監控裝置的任何相關監控設備。
(4) If the holder becomes aware that either of the following is not in good working order:
(4) 若持有人意識到以下任何一項工作狀態不佳：
(a) the holder’s monitoring device;
(a) 持有人的監視裝置；
(b) any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device;
(b) 持有人監控裝置的任何相關監控設備；
the holder must notify an authorised officer of that as soon as practicable.
持有人必須盡快將此情況通知授權官員。
(5) In this clause:
(5) 本條：
monitoring device means any electronic device capable of being used to determine or monitor the location of a person or an object or the status of an object.
監控設備是指任何能夠用於確定或監控人或物體的位置或物體的狀態的電子設備。
related monitoring equipment , for a monitoring device, means any electronic equipment necessary for operating the monitoring device.
相關監控設備，對於監控裝置而言，是指操作監控裝置所需的任何電子設備。
Note: Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
注意：根據第 2.25AF 條規定，簽證持有人在以下任何期間均不受此條件約束：
(a) under arrest or detained in custody; or
(a) 被逮捕或拘留；或
(b) admitted as an in ‑ patient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.
(b) 在公立或私立醫院、註冊精神衛生機構或其他註冊醫療機構接受治療。

8622 (1) The holder must not perform any work, or participate in any regular organised activity, involving more than incidental contact with a minor or vulnerable person (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2).
8622 (1) 持有者不得从事任何涉及未成年人或弱势群体（附表 2 第 070 部分含义内）的工作或参加任何定期组织的活动。
(2) Subclause (1) applies:
(2) 第 (1) 款適用：
(a) whether the work or activity is for reward or otherwise; and
(a) 工作或活動是否是為了報酬或其他；和
(b) whether or not a working with children or vulnerable people check (however described) is required in relation to the work.
(b) 是否需要進行與兒童或弱勢群體相關的工作檢查（無論如何描述）。

8623 The holder must not go within 50 metres of a school, childcare centre or day care centre.
8623 持有者不得前往學校、托兒中心或日託中心 50 公尺範圍內。

8624 (1) The holder must not contact, or attempt to contact, the victim of the offence or a member of the victim’s family.
8624 (1) 持有人不得聯繫或試圖聯繫犯罪行為的受害者或受害者的家庭成員。
(2) In this clause:
(2) 本條中：
member of the victim’s family includes, without limitation, each of the following:
受害者家庭成員包括但不限於以下各項：
(a) a spouse or de facto partner of the victim;
(a) 受害人的配偶或同居伴侶；
(b) a parent or guardian of the victim;
(b) 受害人的父母或監護人；
(c) a child of the victim;
(c) 受害人的子女；
(d) a sibling of the victim.
(d) 受害人的兄弟姊妹。

8626 The holder must notify the Minister of any change in the following:
8626 持有人必須將以下內容的任何變更通知部長：
(a) an online profile used by the holder;
(a) 持有人使用的線上個人資料；
(b) a user name of the holder;
(b) 持有人的使用者名稱；
within 2 working days after the change occurs.
變更發生後2個工作天內。

title: Form 1 — Search Warrant—Valuables
zh: 表格 1 — 搜索令 — 貴重物品
text:

COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA
澳洲聯邦
Migration Act 1958
1958 年移民法
Search Warrant—Valuables
搜索令－貴重物品
To ( insert name of officer and capacity by virtue of which he or she is an officer within the meaning of the Act ).
致（插入官員姓名及其作為該法案含義內的官員的身份）。
I, ( name ), the Secretary [ or a delegate of the Secretary] of the Department of Home Affairs, authorise you, ( insert name of officer ), under subsection 223(14) of the Migration Act 1958 (the Act), at any time of the day or night, with such assistance, and using such reasonable force, as you think necessary:
我，（姓名），內政部秘書[或秘書的代表]，授權您（插入官員姓名），根據《1958 年移民法》（以下簡稱《法案》）第 223(14) 款，在白天或晚上的任何時間，在您認為必要時提供此類協助，並使用您認為必要的合理武力：
(a) to enter and search any building, premises, vehicle, vessel or place in which you have reasonable cause to believe there may be found any valuables to which a notice in force under section 223 of the Act relates; and
(a) 進入並搜索您有合理理由相信可能發現根據該法第 223 條生效的通知所涉及的任何貴重物品的任何建築物、場所、車輛、船隻或場所；和
(b) to seize any such valuables found in the course of such a search;
(b) 沒收在搜索過程中發現的任何貴重物品；
and for the purposes of the exercise of the foregoing powers, to stop any vehicle.
並為了行使上述權力而攔截任何車輛。
And for doing so this shall be your sufficient warrant.
為此，這將是您充分的理由。
This warrant remains in force for the period commencing on 20
該搜索令自 20 日起持續有效
and ending on 20 .
並於20日結束。
Dated 20 .
日期 20 。
Secretary [ or Delegate]
秘書[或代表]

title: Form 2 — Search warrant
text:
(subregulation 5.32(2))
（第 5.32(2) 款）
COMMONWEALTH OF AUSTRALIA

Migration Act 1958
1958 年移民法
Search Warrant
搜索令
To (insert name of officer and capacity by virtue of which he or she is an officer within the meaning of the Act) .
致（插入官員姓名以及該人作為該法案含義內的官員的身份）。
I, ( name ), the Secretary [ or a delegate of the Secretary] of the Department of Home Affairs or the Australian Border Force Commissioner [ or a delegate of the Australian Border Force Commissioner], authorise you, under subsection 251(4) of the Migration Act 1958 (the Act), at any time of the day or night, with such assistance as you think necessary, to enter and search any building, premises, vehicle, vessel or place in which you have reasonable cause to believe there may be found:
我，（姓名），內政部秘書[或秘書的代表]或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員[或澳大利亞邊境部隊專員的代表]，根據《1958年移民法》（以下簡稱《法案》）第251(4)款，授權您在白天或晚上的任何時間，在您認為必要的協助下，進入並搜查您有合理理由可能發現的任何建築物場所：
(a) an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee, within the meaning of the Act; or
(a) 該法所指的非法非公民、被驅逐者或被驅逐者；或
(b) a person to whom a temporary visa under the Act has been issued subject to a condition with respect to the work to be performed by that person; or
(b) 根據該法獲得臨時簽證的人，但須遵守與該人將要從事的工作有關的條件；或
(c) any document, book or paper relating to the entry or proposed entry into Australia of a person in circumstances in which that person:
(c) 與某人入境或擬入境澳洲有關的任何文件、書籍或文件，且該人：
(i) would have become a prohibited immigrant within the meaning of the Act as in force from time to time before the commencement of the Migration Amendment Act 1983 ; or
(i) 將成為 1983 年《移民修正案》生效之前不時生效的法案含義內的禁止移民；或
(ii) would have become a prohibited non ‑ citizen within the meaning of the Act as in force from time to time after the commencement of the Migration Amendment Act 1983 but before the commencement of section 4 of the Migration Legislation Amendment Act 1989 ; or
(ii) 在《1983年移民修正法》生效之後但在《1989年移民立法修正法》第4節生效之前，將成為該法所指的禁止非公民；或
(iii) would have become an illegal entrant within the meaning of the Act as in force from time to time after the commencement of section 4 of the Migration Legislation Amendment Act 1989 but before commencement of section 7 of the Migration Reform Act 1992 ; or
(iii) 在 1989 年《移民立法修正案》第 4 條生效之後、1992 年《移民改革法》第 7 條生效之前，將成為該法所指的非法入境者；或
(iv) would have become, or would become, an unlawful non ‑ citizen; or
(iv) 本來會成為或將成為非法非公民；或
(d) any passport or document of identity of, or any ticket for the conveyance from a place within Australia to a place outside Australia of, an unlawful non ‑ citizen, a removee or a deportee, within the meaning of the Act;
(d) 該法所指的非法非公民、被遣返者或被驅逐者的任何護照或身分文件，或從澳洲境內前往澳洲境外的任何機票；
and to seize any such document, book, paper, passport, document of identity or ticket, as the case may be, and to impound and detain it for such time as you think necessary, and for the purposes of the exercise of the foregoing powers to stop any vessel or vehicle and to use such reasonable force as is necessary.
扣押任何此類文件、書籍、紙張、護照、身分證文件或機票（視情況而定），並在您認為必要的時間內扣押和扣押，並為了行使上述權力攔截任何船隻或車輛並使用必要的合理武力。
And for doing so this shall be your sufficient warrant.
為此，這將是您充分的理由。
This warrant remains in force for the period commencing on 20
該搜索令自 20 日起持續有效
and ending on 20 .
並於20日結束。
Dated 20 .
日期 20 。

title: 101 Operation of Schedule 1
path: Part 1 — Amendments made by Migration Amendment Regulation 2012 (No. 2)
text:
(1) The amendments of these Regulations made by Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment Regulation 2012 (No. 2) apply in relation to:
(1) 2012 年移民修訂條例（第 2 號）附表 1 對本條例的修訂適用於：
(a) an application for a visa made on or after 1 July 2012; and
(a) 2012年7月1日或之後提出的簽證申請；和
(b) an application for approval of a nomination made on or after 1 July 2012.
(b) 2012 年 7 月 1 日或之後提出的提名核准申請。
(2) However, the repeal of a provision of these Regulations by Schedule 1 to that regulation does not apply in relation to an application for a visa that is taken to have been made by a person before, on or after 1 July 2012 in accordance with regulation 2.08, 2.08A or 2.08B of these Regulations.
(2) 然而，附表 1 對該條例的一項規定的廢除不適用於被視為由 2012 年 7 月 1 日之前、當日或之後根據本條例第 2.08、2.08A 或 2.08B 條提出的簽證申請。
(3) Despite subregulations 5.19(1) to (7), an application to the Minister for approval of a nominated position as an approved appointment made before 1 July 2012 is to be dealt with in accordance with these Regulations as in force immediately before that day.
(3) 儘管有第 5.19(1) 至 (7) 款的規定，2012 年 7 月 1 日之前向部長申請批准提名職位作為批准任命的申請應根據該日之前生效的本條例進行處理。
