(2) Despite the repeal of provisions of these Regulations by Part 1, 3, 4, 5 or 7 of the amending regulation, those provisions, as in force immediately before those repeals, continue to apply in relation to an application for a visa if:
(2) 儘管修訂條例第 1、3、4、5 或 7 部分廢除了本條例的規定，但在廢除之前有效的這些規定繼續適用於簽證申請，如果：
(a) the visa application is taken to have been made by a person before, on or after 22 March 2014 in accordance with regulation 2.08, 2.08A or 2.08B; and
(a) 簽證申請被視為由個人在 2014 年 3 月 22 日或之後根據第 2.08、2.08A 或 2.08B 條提出；和
(b) for an application taken to have been made in accordance with regulation 2.08—the non ‑ citizen mentioned in paragraph 2.08(1)(a) applied for his or her visa before 22 March 2014; and
(b) 對於被視為根據第2.08條提出的申請－第2.08(1)(a)段中提到的非公民在2014年3月22日之前申請了簽證；和
(c) for an application taken to have been made in accordance with regulation 2.08A or 2.08B—the original applicant mentioned in paragraph 2.08A(1)(a) or 2.08B(1)(a), as the case requires, applied for his or her visa before 22 March 2014.
(c) 對於被視為根據第2.08A或2.08B條提出的申請－第2.08A(1)(a)或2.08B(1)(a)段中提到的原始申請人（視情況需要）在2014年3月22日之前申請了簽證。
(3) Despite the repeal of Division 2.7 of these Regulations by Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the amending regulation, that Division, as in force immediately before that repeal, continues to apply after 22 March 2014 to an assurance of support accepted by the Minister before 1 July 2004.
(3) 儘管修訂條例附表 1 第 1 部分廢除了本條例第 2.7 條，但該條例在廢除之前有效，在 2014 年 3 月 22 日之後繼續適用於部長在 2004 年 7 月 1 日之前接受的支持保證。
(4) The amendments of these Regulations made by Part 6 of Schedule 1 to the amending regulation apply in relation the following applications for a visa:
(4) 附表 1 第 6 部分對本條例的修訂適用於下列簽證申請：
(a) an application made, but not finally determined, before 22 March 2014;
(a) 2014年3月22日之前提出申請但尚未最終確定；
(b) an application made on or after 22 March 2014.
(b) 2014 年 3 月 22 日或之後提出的申請。
(5) If:
(5) 如果：
(a) an instrument is in force immediately before the commencement of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the amending regulation; and
(a) 文書在修訂條例附表 1 第 2 部分生效之前立即生效；和
(b) the instrument was made (whether wholly or partly) under a provision amended by that Part;
(b) 該文書是根據該部分修訂的條款制定的（無論全部或部分）；
then, the instrument has effect after that commencement as if it had been made under that provision as amended.
那麼，該文書在該生效後生效，如同它是根據經修訂的該條款制定的一樣。

path: Part 57 — Amendments made by the Migration Legislation Amendment (2016 Measures No. 4) Regulation 2016
text:

(b) 因此類申請而獲得的簽證。
(2) To avoid doubt, despite the amendment of subparagraph 3.01(2)(e)(ii), regulation 3.01 (as amended) does not apply to a person who:
(2) 為避免疑問，儘管對第 3.01(2)(e)(ii) 項進行了修訂，但第 3.01 條（經修訂）不適用於以下人員：

(a) 乘坐非軍艦進入澳洲；和
(b) holds a Subclass 988 (Maritime Crew) visa that was granted (before, on or after 19 November 2016):
(b) 持有（2016 年 11 月 19 日之前、當天或之後）簽發的 988 子類（海事船員）簽證：
(i) as a result of an application made before 19 November 2016; and

(3) Despite subclause (1), the amendment of subparagraph 457.511(d)(iv) of Schedule 2 applies to a visa granted to a person on or after 19 November 2016, whether it was granted:
(3) 儘管有第 (1) 款的規定，附表 2 第 457.511(d)(iv) 項的修正案適用於 2016 年 11 月 19 日或之後授予個人的簽證，無論該簽證是：

(a) 基於其是第 1.12(10) 款（2016 年 11 月 19 日之前生效）所述情況下簽證持有人的家庭成員；或
(b) as a result of an application made on or after 19 November 2016.

title: 6002 Operation of Parts 5 and 6 of Schedule 1
zh: 6002 附表 1 第 5 及 6 部的運作
path: Part 60 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Temporary Activity Visas) Regulation 2016
text:
(1) The amendments of these Regulations made by Parts 5 and 6 of Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment (Temporary Activity Visas) Regulation 2016 apply in relation to the following:
(1) 《2016 年移民修訂（臨時活動簽證）條例》附表 1 第 5 和第 6 部分對本條例的修訂適用於以下內容：
(a) an application for a visa made on or after 19 November 2016;
(a) 2016年11月19日或之後提出的簽證申請；
(b) an application for approval as a sponsor made on or after 19 November 2016;
(b) 2016 年 11 月 19 日或之後提出的批准成為保薦人的申請；
(c) an application for a variation of a term of an approval as a sponsor made on or after 19 November 2016;
(c) 2016年11月19日或之後提出的變更保薦人核准期限的申請；
(d) a nomination made under subsection 140GB(1) of the Act on or after 19 November 2016, including such a nomination made:
(d) 2016 年 11 月 19 日或之後依該法第 140GB(1) 條所作的提名，包括所作的提名：
(i) by an approved sponsor that was approved as a sponsor as a result of an application for approval made before, on or after 19 November 2016; or
(i) 在 2016 年 11 月 19 日或之後提出批准申請而被批准為保薦人的批准保薦人；或
(ii) in relation to an application for a visa made before, on or after 19 November 2016.
(ii) 與 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前、當天或之後提出的簽證申請有關。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) before 19 November 2016, a person applies for approval in relation to any of the following classes of sponsor:
(a) 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前，任何人申請批准以下任何類別的擔保人：
(i) a long stay activity sponsor;
(i) 長期住宿活動贊助商；
(ii) a training and research sponsor;
(ii) 培訓及研究贊助商；
(iii) a special program sponsor;
(iii) 特別計劃贊助商；
(iv) an entertainment sponsor;
(iv) 娛樂贊助商；
(v) a superyacht crew sponsor;
(v) 超級遊艇船員贊助商；
(vi) a professional development sponsor; and
(vi) 專業發展贊助商；和
(b) the Minister has not approved, or refused to approve, the person as a sponsor in relation to that class of sponsor; and
(b) 部長尚未批准或拒絕批准該人作為該類別擔保人的擔保人；和
(c) after 18 May 2017, the person gives the Minister a written notice withdrawing the application;
(c) 2017 年 5 月 18 日之後，該人向部長發出撤回申請的書面通知；
the application is taken to be withdrawn, and the Minister may refund the fee paid in accordance with regulation 2.61 in relation to the application.
該申請被視為撤回，部長可以退還根據第 2.61 條與該申請相關的已繳納費用。
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) before 19 November 2016, an approved sponsor makes a nomination under subsection 140GB(1) of the Act identifying a proposed applicant for:
(a) 2016 年 11 月 19 日之前，經批准的擔保人根據該法案第 140GB(1) 款進行提名，確定擬議申請人：
(i) a Subclass 401 (Temporary Work (Long Stay Activity)) visa; or
(i) 401 子類（臨時工作（長期停留活動））簽證；或
(ii) a Subclass 402 (Training and Research) visa; or
(ii) 402 子類（培訓和研究）簽證；或
(iii) a Subclass 420 (Temporary Work (Entertainment)) visa; and
(iii) 420 子類（臨時工作（娛樂））簽證；和
(b) the proposed applicant does not apply for the visa before 19 November 2016; and
(b) 擬申請人未在2016年11月19日之前申請簽證；和
(c) the Minister has not approved, or refused to approve, the nomination; and
(c) 部長尚未批准或拒絕批准提名；和
(d) the approved sponsor gives the Minister a written notice withdrawing the nomination;
(d) 核准的擔保人向部長發出撤回提名的書面通知；
the nomination is taken to be withdrawn, and the Minister may refund the fee paid in accordance with regulation 2.73A in relation to the nomination.
提名將被視為撤回，部長可退還根據第 2.73A 條與提名相關的費用。

title: 8101 Transitional provisions in relation to Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa
zh: 8101 與 187 類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證相關的過渡性規定
path: Part 81 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (New Skilled Regional Visas) Regulations 2019
text:
(1) This clause applies in relation to a nomination under regulation 5.19 if:
(1) 本條款適用於根據第 5.19 條進行的提名，如果：
(a) the nomination relates to a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa; and
(a) 提名與 187 類（地區擔保移民計畫）簽證相關；和
(b) the person identified in the nomination:
(b) 提名中確定的人員：
(i) did not apply for a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa on the basis of the nomination on or before 16 November 2019; and
(i) 未在 2019 年 11 月 16 日或之前根據提名申請 187 類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證；和
(ii) if the nomination relates to a Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa in the Temporary Residence Transition stream—is not a transitional 457 worker, or transitional 482 worker, on 16 November 2019.
(ii) 如果提名與臨時居住過渡類別中的 187 子類（地區擔保移民計劃）簽證相關，則在 2019 年 11 月 16 日不是過渡 457 工人或過渡 482 工人。
Applications for approval of nominations that are not decided before 16 November 2019
2019 年 11 月 16 日之前尚未決定的提名批准申請
(2) An application for approval of the nomination is taken to be withdrawn on 16 November 2019 if:
(2) 若發生以下情況，提名核准申請將於 2019 年 11 月 16 日被視為撤回：
(a) the Minister did not approve, and did not refuse to approve, the nomination under subregulation 5.19(3) on or before 15 November 2019; and
(a) 部長在 2019 年 11 月 15 日或之前沒有批准也沒有拒絕批准第 5.19(3) 款規定的提名；和
(b) the application was not withdrawn on or before 15 November 2019.
(b) 申請未於 2019 年 11 月 15 日或之前撤回。
Refund of nomination training contribution charge
退還提名培訓繳費
(3) The Minister must refund any nomination training contribution charge mentioned in paragraph 5.19(2)(fa) paid in relation to the nomination if:
(3) 部長必須退還第 5.19(2)(fa) 段中提到的任何與提名相關的提名培訓繳費，如果：
(a) either:
(a) 任一：
(i) the application for approval of the nomination is taken to be withdrawn under subclause (2) of this clause; or
(i) 根據本條第 (2) 款，提名批准申請被視為撤回；或
(ii) the Minister refused to approve the nomination under subregulation 5.19(3)(b), and on 16 November 2019 the application for approval is not finally determined; and
(ii) 部長拒絕批准第 5.19(3)(b) 款規定的提名，且 2019 年 11 月 16 日批准申請尚未最終確定；和
(b) the Minister:
(b) 部長：
(i) receives a written request for a refund from the person who paid the charge; or
(i) 收到付款人的書面退款要求；或
(ii) considers it is reasonable in the circumstances to refund the charge to the person who paid the charge without receiving a written request for a refund.
(ii) 在沒有收到書面退款請求的情況下，認為在這種情況下將費用退還給支付費用的人是合理的。
(4) The Minister may refund any nomination training contribution charge mentioned in paragraph 5.19(2)(fa) paid in relation to the nomination if:
(4) 在下列情況下，部長可退還第 5.19(2)(fa) 段中提到的任何與提名相關的提名培訓繳費：
(a) the Minister approved the nomination under paragraph 5.19(3)(a) on or before 15 November 2019; and
(a) 部長於 2019 年 11 月 15 日或之前根據第 5.19(3)(a) 段批准了提名；和
(b) the Minister:
(b) 部長：
(i) receives a written request for a refund from the person who paid the charge; or
(i) 收到付款人的書面退款要求；或
(ii) considers it is reasonable in the circumstances to refund the charge to the person who paid the amount without receiving a written request for a refund.
(ii) 在沒有收到書面退款請求的情況下，認為在這種情況下將費用退還給付款人是合理的。
(5) A refund under subclause (3) or (4) must be paid to the person who paid the charge.
(5) 第 (3) 或 (4) 款規定的退款必須支付給支付費用的人。

In this Part:

title: 8502 Operation of Schedule 3
path: Part 85 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Temporary Sponsored Parent Visa and Other Measures) Regulations 2019
text:
(1) Subject to subclauses (2) and (3), the amendments of these Regulations made by Schedule 3 to the amending regulations apply in relation to the following:
(1) 除第 (2) 及 (3) 款外，附表 3 對修訂條例所作的本條例修訂適用於下列內容：
(a) a visa application made on or after the commencement day;
(a) 在生效日期或之後提出的簽證申請；
(b) a visa granted on or after the commencement day if the application for the visa was made on or after the commencement day.
(b) 如果簽證申請是在生效日期或之後提出的，則在生效日期或之後獲得簽證。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) an application for a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa is made before, on or after the commencement day; and
(a) 405 類（投資者退休）簽證的申請是在生效日期之前、當天或之後提出的；和
(b) the applicant is seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(b) 申請人尋求滿足授予簽證的主要標準；和
(c) either:
(c) 任一：
(i) the applicant is the holder of a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa that was applied for before the commencement day; or
(i) 申請人是在生效日期之前申請的 405 類（投資者退休）簽證的持有者；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the applicant since last entering Australia was a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa that was applied for before the commencement day;
(ii) 申請人自上次進入澳洲以來持有的最後一個實質簽證是在生效日期之前申請的 405 子類（投資者退休）簽證；
then, despite the amendment of paragraph 405.228(5)(a) of Schedule 2 to these Regulations made by item 5 of Schedule 3 to the amending regulations, that paragraph, as in force immediately before the commencement day, continues to apply in relation to the application.
那麼，儘管修訂規例附表3第5項對本規例附表2第405.228(5)(a)段作出修訂，該款在緊接生效日期之前有效的繼續適用於該申請。
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) an application for a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa is made before, on or after the commencement day; and
(a) 405 類（投資者退休）簽證的申請是在生效日期之前、當天或之後提出的；和
(b) the applicant is seeking to satisfy the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(b) 申請人尋求滿足授予簽證的次要標準；和
(c) either:
(c) 任一：
(i) the applicant is the holder of a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa that was applied for before the commencement day; or
(i) 申請人是在生效日期之前申請的 405 類（投資者退休）簽證的持有者；或
(ii) the last substantive visa held by the applicant since last entering Australia was a Subclass 405 (Investor Retirement) visa that was applied for before the commencement day;
(ii) 申請人自上次進入澳洲以來持有的最後一個實質簽證是在生效日期之前申請的 405 子類（投資者退休）簽證；
then, despite the amendment of subclause 405.330(2) of Schedule 2 to these Regulations made by item 6 of Schedule 3 to the amending regulations, that subclause, as in force immediately before the commencement day, continues to apply in relation to the application.
那麼，儘管修訂規例附表 3 第 6 項對本規例附表 2 第 405.330(2) 款進行了修訂，但該款在緊接生效日期之前有效，繼續適用於該申請。

title: 9001 Subclass 457 visas
path: Part 90 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Hong Kong Passport Holders) Regulations 2020
text:
(1) This clause applies to a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa if:
(1) 本條款適用於 457 子類別（臨時工作（技術））簽證，如果：
(a) the visa is in effect on or after 9 July 2020 (whether the visa was granted before, on or after 9 July 2020); and
(a) 簽證於2020年7月9日或之後生效（不論簽證是在2020年7月9日之前、當天或之後簽發的）；和
(b) the visa is granted on the basis that the holder satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(b) 簽證的授予是基於持有人滿足授予簽證的主要標準；和
(c) on the date of grant of the visa, the holder holds a Hong Kong passport.
(c) 在簽證核准之日，持有人持有香港護照。
(2) This clause also applies to a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa if:
(2) 本條款也適用於 457 子類別（臨時工作（技術））簽證，如果：
(a) the visa is in effect on or after 9 July 2020 (whether the visa was granted before, on or after 9 July 2020); and
(a) 簽證於2020年7月9日或之後生效（不論簽證是在2020年7月9日之前、當天或之後簽發的）；和
(b) the visa is granted on the basis that the holder satisfied the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa as a member of the family unit of a person (the primary applicant ) who satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa (the primary visa ); and
(b) 簽證的授予是基於申請人作為家庭成員滿足授予簽證的次要標準（主申請人），而該人滿足授予 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證（主簽證）的主要標準；和
(c) on the date of grant of the primary visa, the primary applicant holds a Hong Kong passport.
(c) 在主要簽證核准之日，主要申請人持有香港護照。
(3) Despite former clause 457.511 of Schedule 2 to these Regulations, a visa to which this clause applies is a temporary visa permitting the holder to:
(3) 儘管有本條例附表 2 的原條款 457.511，本條款適用的簽證是臨時簽證，允許持有人：
(a) travel to, and enter, Australia on multiple occasions; and
(a) 多次前往並進入澳洲；和
(b) remain in Australia;
(b) 留在澳洲；
during the period that:
期間：
(c) starts when the visa comes into effect; and
(c) 從簽證生效時開始；和
(d) ends on 8 July 2025.
(d) 於 2025 年 7 月 8 日結束。

(1) This clause applies to a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa if:

(a) the visa was granted before 9 July 2020; and

(b) the visa was granted on the basis that the holder satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; and
(b) 簽證的授予是基於持有人滿足授予簽證的主要標準；和
(c) on the date of grant of the visa, the holder held a Hong Kong passport; and
(c) 在簽證簽發之日，持有人持有香港護照；和
(d) the visa did not cease to be in effect before 9 July 2020.
(d) 簽證在2020年7月9日之前並未失效。
(2) This clause also applies to a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa (the secondary visa ) if:
(2) 本條款也適用於 482 子類（臨時技能短缺）簽證（二級簽證），如果：
(a) the secondary visa was granted before 9 July 2020; and
(a) 二次簽證是在2020年7月9日之前簽發的；和
(b) the secondary visa was granted on the basis that the holder satisfied the secondary criteria for the grant of the visa as a member of the family unit of a person (the primary applicant ) who satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of one of the following visas (the primary visa ):
(b) 次要簽證的授予是基於以下條件：持有人作為個人（主申請人）的家庭成員，滿足授予簽證的次要標準，而該人滿足授予以下簽證之一（主要簽證）的主要標準：
(i) a Subclass 457 (Temporary Work (Skilled)) visa;
(i) 457 子類（臨時工作（技術））簽證；
(ii) a Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa; and
(ii) 482 類（臨時技能短缺）簽證；和
(c) on the date of grant of the primary visa, the primary applicant held a Hong Kong passport; and

text:
Scope of this clause
本條款的範圍
(1) This clause applies in relation to an application (the second 417 application ) for a Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa made on or after 14 November 2020, if:
(1) 本條款適用於 2020 年 11 月 14 日或之後提出的 417 類（工作假期）簽證申請（第二次 417 申請），如果：
(a) the applicant has held only one Subclass 417 (Working Holiday) visa (the first 417 visa ) in Australia; and
(a) 申請人在澳洲僅持有一個417子類（打工度假）簽證（第一個417簽證）；和
(b) before the day (the second 417 application day ) the second 417 application is made, the applicant carried out specified Subclass 417 work as the holder of:
(b) 在提出第二次 417 申請之日（第二個 417 申請日）之前，申請人作為以下人員進行了指定的 417 子類工作：
(i) an eligible 408 visa; or
(i) 符合資格的408簽證；或
(ii) a bridging visa that was in effect and granted on the basis of an application for an eligible 408 visa; and
(ii) 有效的過橋簽證，並根據符合資格的 408 簽證申請而授予；和

(a) 自 2022 年 7 月 1 日開始；和

(2) Paragraph 1402(2)(b) of Schedule 1, as in force immediately before the commencement of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment (Subclass 202 Visas) Regulations 2022 , applies in relation to the application as if:
(2) 附表 1 第 1402(2)(b) 段在《2022 年移民修正案（202 類簽證）條例》附表 1 第 1 部分生效之前立即生效，適用於該申請，如同：
(a) the reference to $16 444 were instead a reference to $4 755; and
(a) 所提及的 16 444 美元改為 4 755 美元；和
(b) the reference to $2 680 were instead a reference to Nil.

(2) The amendment made by item 3 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment (Subclass 189 Visas—New Zealand Stream) Regulations 2022 applies in relation to an application for a Subclass 189 (Skilled—Independent) visa, whether made (or taken to be made) before, on or after 10 December 2022, if:
(2) 2022 年移民修正案（189 類簽證－紐西蘭流）條例附表 1 第 1 部分第 3 項所做的修訂適用於 189 類（獨立技術）簽證的申請，無論是在 2022 年 12 月 10 日之前、當日或之後提出（或視為提出），如果：

title: 12101 Definitions
path: Part 121 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Resolution of Status Visa) Regulations 2023
text:
In this Part:
在本部分中：
amending regulations means the Migration Amendment (Resolution of Status Visa) Regulations 2023 .
修訂法規是指 2023 年移民修訂（身分簽證解決）法規。
identity information criterion means subclause 851.228(2) of Schedule 2, as inserted by Schedule 2 to the amending regulations.
身分資訊標準係指附表 2 第 851.228(2) 款，由修訂條例附表 2 插入。

title: 12102 Operation of amendments
path: Part 121 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Resolution of Status Visa) Regulations 2023
text:
(1) The amendments made by Schedule 2 to the amending regulations apply in relation to an application for a visa:
(1) 修訂條例附表2所做的修訂適用於簽證申請：
(a) made, but not finally determined, before the commencement of that Schedule; or
(a) 在該附表生效之前製定但尚未最終確定；或
(b) made on or after that commencement.
(b) 在該生效日期或之後作出。
(2) For an application made on the basis of meeting the requirements of item 4, 4A or 5 of the table in subitem 1127AA(3) of Schedule 1, the identity information criterion applies in relation to an invitation under section 56 of the Act whether given before, on or after the commencement of that criterion.
(2) 對於基於符合附表 1 第 1127AA(3) 子項表中第 4、4A 或 5 項要求而提出的申請，身分資訊標準適用於根據該法第 56 條發出的邀請，無論是在該標準生效之前、之時或之後發出。
(3) For an application taken to be a valid application for a Resolution of Status (Class CD) visa under regulation 2.08G, the identity information criterion applies in relation to an invitation under section 56 of the Act whether given before, on or after the commencement of that criterion, provided that the invitation was given after regulation 2.08G started to apply in relation to the application.
(3) 對於根據第 2.08G 條被視為有效身份解決（CD 類）簽證申請的申請，身份資訊標準適用於該法第 56 條下的邀請，無論是在該標準生效之前、之時還是之後發出，前提是該邀請是在第 2.08G 條開始適用於該申請之後發出的。

(a) 於 2018 年 3 月 18 日或之後作出，且在該生效日期之前尚未最終確定；或
(b) is made on or after that commencement.

(2) The amendments of regulation 5.19 of these Regulations made by Schedule 1 to the amending regulations apply in relation to an application under that regulation:

(b) made on or after the commencement of those amendments.

(3) The amendments of clause 1240 of Schedule 1 to these Regulations made by Schedule 1 to the amending regulations apply in relation to visa applications made on or after the commencement of those amendments.

text:
(1) This clause applies if:
(1) 本條款適用於：
(a) an invitation was given under section 56 or 57 of the Act before the commencement of the amending Part; and
(a) 在修訂部分生效之前根據該法第 56 或 57 條發出了邀請；和
(b) the prescribed period for the invitation was the period prescribed by sub ‑ subparagraph 2.15(1)(b)(ii)(B) or subparagraph 2.15(3)(b)(ii) of these Regulations (as the case may be); and
(b) 邀請的規定期限是本條例第 2.15(1)(b)(ii)(B) 款或第 2.15(3)(b)(ii) 款規定的期限（視情況而定）；和
(c) immediately before that commencement, that period has not ended.
(c) 在該生效日期之前，該期間尚未結束。
(2) The prescribed period for the invitation is taken, on and after the commencement of the amending Part, to be the period prescribed by sub ‑ subparagraph 2.15(1)(b)(ii)(C) or subparagraph 2.15(3)(b)(iii) of these Regulations (as the case may be).
(2) 在修訂部分生效之日及之後，邀請的規定期限視為本條例第 2.15(1)(b)(ii)(C) 款或第 2.15(3)(b)(iii) 款（視情況而定）規定的期限。

title: 14601 Operation of amendments
path: Part 146 — Amendments made by the Migration Amendment (Skills Assessing Authorities) Regulations 2024
text:
(1) Despite the repeal of subregulation 2.26B(1B) by Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Migration Amendment (Skills Assessing Authorities) Regulations 2024 (the amending Part ), an approval given under that subregulation that is in force immediately before the commencement of the amending Part continues to be in force, after that commencement, as if the repeal had not happened.
(1) 儘管《2024 年移民修正案（技能評估機構）條例》（修訂部分）附表 1 第 1 部分廢除了第 2.26B(1B) 款，但根據該款在修訂部分生效之前有效的批准在該修訂部分生效後繼續有效，就像廢除沒有發生一樣。
(2) Subregulation 2.26B(1BC), as inserted by the amending Part, applies in relation to an approval given under subregulation 2.26B(1B) before, on or after the commencement of the amending Part.
(2) 修訂部分插入的第 2.26B(1BC) 款適用於修訂部分生效之前、生效之時或之後根據第 2.26B(1B) 款作出的批准。
(3) Subregulation 2.26B(1BG), as inserted by the amending Part, applies in relation to the following:
(3) 修訂部分插入的第 2.26B(1BG) 款適用於下列各項：
(a) an approval given under subregulation 2.26B(1B) on or after the commencement of the amending Part;
(a) 在修訂部分生效之日或之後根據第 2.26B(1B) 款給予批准；
(b) an approval given under subregulation 2.26B(1B) before that commencement if the ground for the revocation of the approval relates to:
(b) 在該生效前根據第 2.26B(1B) 款所做的批准，如果撤銷批准的理由涉及：
(i) if the ground for the revocation is the ground mentioned in paragraph 2.26B(1BG)(a) or (c)—a thing done, or not done, on or after that commencement; and
(i) 如果撤銷的理由是第 2.26B(1BG)(a) 或 (c) 段中提到的理由－在該生效之日或之後所做或未做的事情；和
(ii) otherwise—a thing done, or not done, after the time mentioned in subregulation 2.26B(1BD).
(ii) 否則－在第 2.26B(1BD) 款所提及的時間之後完成或未完成的某件事。
(4) The amendments of these Regulations made by items 18, 20, 23, 31 and 32 of the amending Part apply in relation to an application for a visa made on or after the commencement of that Part.
(4) 修訂部分第 18、20、23、31 和 32 項對本條例的修訂適用於在該部分生效之日或之後提出的簽證申請。
(5) The amendments of these Regulations made by items 25 and 26 of the amending Part apply in relation to an application made in response to an invitation given by the Minister on or after the commencement of that Part.
(5) 修訂部分第 25 和 26 項對本條例的修訂適用於響應部長在該部分生效之日或生效後發出的邀請而提出的申請。

(a) condition 8612;
(a) 條件 8612；
(b) condition 8615;
(b) 條件 8615；
(c) condition 8622;
(c) 條件 8622；

(d) 條件 8623；

(e) 條件 8624；

(2) 該法第 76E 條適用於生效日或之後頒發的簽證，且須遵守一項或多項附加規定條件。
Visas granted before commencement day

(3) If:

text:
For the purposes of subsection 314(1) of the Act, the Code of Conduct constituted by this instrument (other than this section) is prescribed.
為了該法案第 314(1) 款的目的，規定了由本文書（本節除外）構成的行為準則。
Note 1: Registered migration agents must conduct themselves in accordance with the Code of Conduct: see subsection 314(2) of the Act.
註 1：註冊移民代理人必須依照行為準則行事：請參閱該法案第 314(2) 款。
Note 2: The Authority may cancel or suspend the registration of a migration agent, or caution an agent, if the Authority becomes satisfied that the agent has not complied with the Code of Conduct: see section 303 of the Act.
註 2：如果管理局認為移民代理人未遵守《行為準則》，管理局可以取消或暫停移民代理的註冊，或警告代理：請參閱該法案第 303 條。

title: Division 2 — Purpose of this instrument
zh: 第 2 分部 — 本法律文書的目的

title: 5 Purpose of this instrument
text:
The purpose of this instrument is to:
這份文書的目的是：
(a) protect clients of migration agents; and
(a) 保護移民代理的客戶；和
(b) strengthen the integrity of the immigration advice industry and Australia’s immigration system.
(b) 加強移民諮詢業和澳洲移民制度的誠信。

title: 6 Other duties of migration agents
text:
(1) This instrument is not an exhaustive statement of the duties of migration agents under Commonwealth law.
(1) 本文件並未詳盡闡述英聯邦法律下移民代理的職責。
(2) This instrument is not intended to apply to the exclusion of a law of a State or a Territory that imposes duties on a migration agent (whether in the migration agent’s capacity as a migration agent or in any other capacity) to the extent to which that law is capable of operating concurrently with this instrument.
(2) 本文書無意適用於排除對移民代理施加義務的州或地區的法律（無論是移民代理作為移民代理的身份還是任何其他身份），只要該法律能夠與本文書同時實施。

title: 7 Definitions
text:
Note: See also section 8 (expressions have same meaning as in Part 3 of the Act).
註：另請參閱第 8 節（措詞與該法案第 3 部分的含義相同）。
In this instrument:
在本儀器中：
Act means the Migration Act 1958 .
該法案是指 1958 年移民法案。
Authority means the Migration Agents Registration Authority.
當局是指移民代理登記當局。
business : a migration agent’s business consists of the following members :
業務：移民代理的業務由以下成員組成：
(a) the agent;
(a) 代理人；
(b) any individual who is related by employment to the migration agent.
(b) 與移民代理有僱傭關係的任何個人。
client money : see section 10.
客戶資金：請參閱第 10 節。
consumer guide means the guide, as existing from time to time, produced under subsection 43(1) of the Migration Agents Regulations 2026 .
消費者指南是指根據《2026 年移民代理條例》第 43(1) 款制定的不時存在的指南。
Note: The consumer guide could in 2026 be viewed on the Authority’s website (http://www.mara.gov.au).
注意：2026 年消費者指南可在管理局網站 (http://www.mara.gov.au) 上查看。
covers : a service agreement covers :
涵蓋：服務協議涵蓋：
(a) each client to whom immigration assistance is to be given under the agreement; and
(a) 每位根據協議將向其提供移民援助的客戶；和
(b) the immigration assistance that is to be given under the agreement.
(b) 根據協議提供的移民援助。
employee includes:
員工包括：
(a) a person engaged as a consultant or as an independent contractor; and
(a) 擔任顧問或獨立承包商的人員；和
(b) a person engaged as a volunteer.
(b) 擔任志工的人。
engage in conduct means:
從事行為是指：
(a) do an act; or
(a) 採取行動；或
(b) omit to perform an act.
(b) 省略執行某項行為。
financial institution means a body corporate that, as part of its normal activities:
金融機構是指作為其正常活動的一部分的法人團體：
(a) takes money on deposit and makes advances of money; and
(a) 接受存款並預支款項；和
(b) does so under a regulatory regime, governed by the central bank (or its equivalent) of the country in which it operates, that the Minister is satisfied provides effective prudential assurance.
(b) 在由其經營所在國家的中央銀行（或同等機構）管轄的監管制度下這樣做，並且部長信納提供了有效的審慎保證。
fixed fee : see subsection 46(2).
固定費用：請參閱第 46(2) 款。
futile : see subsection 19(3).
徒勞的：參閱第 19(3) 款。
government official includes the following:
政府官員包括以下：
(a) the Minister;
(a) 部長；
(b) a member of the Minister’s staff;
(b) 部長的工作人員；
(c) the Department (including the Authority);
(c) 該部門（包括管理局）；
(d) an officer of the Department;
(d) 該部門的一名官員；
(e) a review authority;
(e) 審查機構；
(f) a member of a review authority’s staff;
(f) 審查機構的工作人員；
(g) any other person performing functions or exercising powers under the migration law.
(g) 任何其他根據移民法履行職能或行使權力的人。
immigration assistance : see section 9.
移民援助：請參閱第 9 節。
initial consultation : see subsection 43(4).
初步諮詢：請參閱第 43(4) 款。
MARN is short for migration agent registration number.
MARN 是移民代理註冊號碼的縮寫。
members : see the definition of business .
委員：參閱業務的定義。
migration law means any of the following:
移民法是指以下任何一項：
(a) the Act;
(a) 該法案；
(b) regulations made under the Act (including this instrument);
(b) 根據該法案（包括本文書）制定的法規；
(c) any other instrument made under the Act or those regulations.
(c) 根據該法案或這些條例制定的任何其他文書。
related by employment : see section 11.
與就業相關：請參閱第 11 節。
responsible migration agent : see section 12.
負責的移民代理：請參閱第 12 節。
service agreement means an agreement for the giving of immigration assistance by a migration agent to a client.
服務協議是指移民代理向客戶提供移民協助的協議。
Note: A service agreement must provide for the giving of immigration assistance, but may also provide for the performance of other work or services.
注意：服務協議必須規定提供移民援助，但也可以規定提供其他工作或服務。
terminated : to avoid doubt, a reference to a service agreement being terminated does not include a reference to the agreement being brought to an end by the fulfilment of the obligations under the agreement.
已終止：為避免疑義，所提及的服務協議被終止並不包括因履行協議規定的義務而終止該協議。
work or services includes immigration assistance.
工作或服務包括移民援助。

title: 8 Expressions have same meaning as in Part 3 of the Act
zh: 8 表述與該法案第 3 部分的含義相同
text:
(1) Subject to this Division, an expression used in this instrument and in Part 3 of the Act has the same meaning in this instrument as it has in that Part.
(1) 根據本節規定，本文書和法案第 3 部分所使用的表述在本文書中具有與該部分相同的含義。
Note: Relevant expressions include the following:
註：相關表述包括：
(a) client;
(a) 客戶；
(b) registered migration agent;
(b) 註冊移民代理；
(c) review authority.
(c) 審查權限。
(2) Subsection (1) does not limit paragraph 13(1)(b) of the Legislation Act 2003 .
(2) 第 (1) 款不限制《2003 年立法法》第 13(1)(b) 款。

title: 9 Immigration assistance
text:
A reference in this instrument to giving immigration assistance includes a reference to making immigration representations (within the meaning of section 282 of the Act).
本文提及提供移民援助包括提及進行移民代理（在該法第 282 條的涵義內）。
Note: See also section 276 of the Act.
註：另請參閱該法案第 276 條。

title: 10 Meaning of client money
text:
(1) Client money , in relation to a service agreement, is an amount (including a fee or an amount for disbursements) that:
(1) 就服務協議而言，客戶資金是指下列金額（包括費用或支出金額）：
(a) a responsible migration agent in relation to the agreement; or
(a) 與協議相關的負責任的移民代理；或
(b) a member of the business of a responsible migration agent in relation to the agreement;
(b) 與協議相關的負責移民代理的業務成員；
receives from a client covered by the agreement for work or services performed, or to be performed, under the agreement.
從協議所涵蓋的客戶收到的根據協議執行或將執行的工作或服務。
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) either:
(a) 任一：
(i) a registered migration agent (the original agent ); or
(i) 註冊移民代理（原代理）；或
(ii) a member of the business of a registered migration agent (the original agent );
(ii) 註冊移民代理業務的成員（原代理）；
receives client money in relation to a service agreement; and
接收與服務協議相關的客戶資金；和
(b) the original agent, or a member of the original agent’s business, refunds some or all of that client money at the instruction of a client or former client of the original agent by transferring an amount to:
(b) 原始代理人或原始代理人業務的成員依照原始代理人的客戶或前客戶的指示，透過將金額轉入以下方式退還部分或全部客戶資金：
(i) another migration agent (the receiving agent ); or
(i) 另一家移民代理（接收代理）；或
(ii) a member of the business of another migration agent (the receiving agent ); and
(ii) 另一家移民代理（接收代理）的業務成員；和
(c) the receiving agent is or becomes a responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement that covers the client;
(c) 接收代理是或成為與涵蓋客戶的服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理；
the amount is taken to have been received by the receiving agent, or the member of the receiving agent’s business mentioned in subparagraph (b)(ii), from the client for work or services performed, or to be performed, under the service agreement mentioned in paragraph (c).
該款項被視為接收代理人或(b)(ii)項所述的接收代理人業務成員根據(c)款所述的服務協議已完成或將要完成的工作或服務而從客戶處收到的款項。
Note: An effect of subsection (2) is that the amount is taken to be client money in relation to the service agreement mentioned in paragraph (c).
註：第 (2) 款的效果是，該金額被視為與 (c) 段提到的服務協議相關的客戶資金。

title: 11 Meaning of related by employment
text:
For the purposes of this instrument, an individual is related by employment to another individual if the first individual:
就本文書而言，如果一個人符合以下條件，則該個人與另一個人有僱傭關係：
(a) is related by employment to the other individual for the purposes of Part 3 of the Act; or
(a) 就該法第 3 部分而言，與其他人有僱傭關係；或
(b) would be related by employment to the other individual for the purposes of that Part if, in section 278 of the Act, employee included a person engaged as a volunteer.
(b) 若在該法第 278 條中，僱員包括作為志願者參與的人員，則就該部分而言，將透過僱傭關係與其他個人相關。

title: 12 Meaning of responsible migration agent
zh: 12 負責任的移民代理的意義
text:
Each of the following is a responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement:
以下各人是與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理：
(a) each migration agent who gives, or has given, immigration assistance under the agreement;
(a) 根據協議提供或已經提供移民援助的每個移民代理；
(b) if no immigration assistance has yet been given under the agreement—each migration agent who signs the agreement.
(b) 如果尚未根據協議提供任何移民援助－簽署該協議的每位移民代理。

title: Part 2 — General duties
zh: 第 2 部 — 一般義務

title: Division 1 — General duties
zh: 第 1 分部 — 一般義務

title: 13 General duty to act professionally, ethically etc.
zh: 13 以專業、道德等方式行事的一般義務
text:
(1) A migration agent must act:
(1) 移民代理必須採取以下行動：
(a) professionally; and
(a) 專業上；和
(b) competently; and
(b) 勝任；和
(c) diligently; and
(c) 勤奮；和
(d) ethically, honestly and with integrity.
(d) 道德、誠實和正直。
Note: The other provisions of this instrument supplement, but do not limit, the general duties in this subsection.
註：本文書的其他條款補充但不限製本節中的一般職責。
(2) A migration agent must not engage in conduct (whether in the agent’s capacity as a migration agent or in any other capacity) that is reasonably likely to damage the reputation of migration agents or the immigration advice industry.
(2) 移民代理不得從事可能損害移民代理或移民諮詢行業聲譽的行為（無論是以移民代理身份還是以任何其他身份）。

title: 14 Duty to treat all persons with appropriate respect
zh: 14 有義務適當尊重所有人
text:
(1) A migration agent must treat all persons with appropriate respect.
(1) 移民代理必須適當尊重所有人。
(2) In particular, a migration agent must not:
(2) 特別是，移民代理不得：
(a) harass or coerce any person; or
(a) 騷擾或脅迫任何人；或
(b) engage in unconscionable conduct targeted at another person; or
(b) 針對他人實施不合情理的行為；或
(c) without limiting paragraph (b), victimise a person on the basis of the person’s status under the migration law.
(c) 在不限制(b)款的情況下，依移民法規定的身份使某人受害。
(3) For the purposes of paragraph (2)(b), it does not matter whether conduct is targeted at another person directly or indirectly.
(3) 就第 (2)(b) 款而言，行為是否直接或間接針對他人並不重要。

title: 15 Duty not to make false or misleading statements
zh: 15 不作出虛假或誤導性陳述的責任
text:
A migration agent must not make a false or misleading statement.
移民代理不得做出虛假或誤導性陳述。
Note: See also sections 20 and 26.
註：另請參閱第 20 節和第 26 節。

title: 16 Duty not to threaten to contravene this instrument
zh: 16 不威脅違反本文書的義務
text:
A migration agent must not threaten to engage in conduct that would contravene this instrument.
移民代理不得威脅要從事違反本文書的行為。

title: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
zh: 第 2 分部 — 與澳洲移民制度相關的職責
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system

title: 17 Duty to comply with migration law
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
text:
A migration agent must comply with the migration law.
移民代理必須遵守移民法。

title: 18 Duty not to undermine the migration law
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
text:
(1) A migration agent must not act in a way that is intended to:
(1) 移民代理不得以下列方式行事：
(a) defeat the purpose of the migration law; or
(a) 違背移民法的目的；或
(b) evade a requirement of the migration law;
(b) 規避移民法的要求；
for the purpose of obtaining a benefit or advantage for the agent, a client of the agent or any other person.
為代理人、代理人的客戶或任何其他人獲取利益或利益的目的。
(2) A migration agent must not, in making an application or giving other immigration assistance, withhold relevant information or documents from a government official for the purpose of causing delay.
(2) 移民代理不得在提出申請或提供其他移民協助時向政府官員隱瞞相關資訊或文件以造成延誤。
(3) A migration agent must not:
(3) 移民代理不得：
(a) act in a way that is intended to frustrate the proper disposition of any review or appeal process in relation to decisions made under the migration law; or
(a) 其行為方式旨在阻礙與根據移民法作出的決定有關的任何審查或上訴程序的適當處理；或
(b) delay such a review or appeal process for any purpose other than ensuring the proper disposition of the process; or
(b) 為了確保程序得到適當處理以外的任何目的而延遲此類審查或上訴程序；或
(c) abuse such a review or appeal process.
(c) 濫用此類審查或上訴程序。

title: 19 Duty not to give futile immigration assistance
zh: 19 不提供無用的移民援助的義務
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
text:
(1) A migration agent must not give immigration assistance to a client if the agent reasonably believes that giving the immigration assistance would be futile.
(1) 若移民代理人合理地認為提供移民援助是徒勞無功的，則不得向客戶提供移民援助。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) the migration agent is satisfied that giving the immigration assistance would not be in breach of the agent’s duties under sections 13, 17, 18 and 33; and
(a) 移民代理確信提供移民援助不會違反第 13、17、18 和 33 條規定的代理義務；和
(b) a migration agent (whether or not the migration agent mentioned in subsection (1) of this section) has advised the client that giving the immigration assistance would be futile; and
(b) 移民代理（無論是否是本條第（1）款中提到的移民代理）已告知客戶提供移民援助將是徒勞的；和
(c) the client has given to a migration agent (whether or not the migration agent mentioned in subsection (1) of this section or paragraph (b) of this subsection) a written statement that the client:
(c) 客戶已向移民代理（無論是否是本節第 (1) 款或本節 (b) 款中提到的移民代理）提供一份書面聲明，表明客戶：
(i) has been advised of the matter mentioned in paragraph (b); and
(i) 已獲悉(b)段所述事項；和
(ii) still wishes to be given the immigration assistance.
(ii) 仍希望獲得移民援助。
(3) Without limiting when giving immigration assistance is taken to be futile, for the purposes of this instrument it is futile for a migration agent to give immigration assistance if:
(3) 在不限制何時提供移民援助被視為徒勞的情況下，就本文書而言，在以下情況下，移民代理提供移民援助是徒勞的：
(a) the purpose of the immigration assistance is to achieve, or to assist with the achieving of, a particular result; and
(a) 移民援助的目的在於實現或協助實現特定結果；和
(b) there is little or no prospect of that result being achieved.
(b) 實現這一結果的希望很小或根本沒有。
Example: Preparing a visa application if there is little or no prospect of the visa being granted.
例如：如果獲得簽證的可能性很小或根本沒有機會，則準備簽證申請。

title: 20 Duty to avoid making false or misleading statements etc. to government officials
zh: 20 避免向政府官員作出虛假或誤導性陳述等的責任
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
text:
Documents migration agent knows are false or misleading
移民代理知道的文件是虛假或誤導的
(1) A migration agent must not give to a government official a document that the agent knows is false or misleading, unless the agent discloses to the government official that the document is false or misleading.
(1) 移民代理不得向政府官員提供其明知是虛假或誤導性的文件，除非代理人向政府官員披露該文件是虛假或誤導性的。
Note: See also section 15 (duty not to make false or misleading statements).
註：另請參閱第 15 節（不做出虛假或誤導性陳述的義務）。
Statements and documents migration agent suspects are false or misleading
移民代理懷疑的陳述和文件存在虛假或誤導性
(2) A migration agent must not make to a government official a statement that the agent suspects, or reasonably ought to suspect, (but does not know) is false or misleading, unless the agent has taken all reasonable steps to determine whether the statement is false or misleading.
(2) 移民代理不得向政府官員做出其懷疑或合理應該懷疑（但不知道）虛假或誤導性的聲明，除非該代理已採取一切合理步驟來確定該聲明是否虛假或誤導性。
(3) A migration agent must not give to a government official a document that the migration agent suspects, or reasonably ought to suspect, (but does not know) is false or misleading, unless the agent:
(3) 移民代理不得向政府官員提供其懷疑或合理應該懷疑（但不知道）虛假或誤導性的文件，除非該代理：
(a) discloses to the government official that the agent suspects that the document is false or misleading; or
(a) 向政府官員透露代理人懷疑該文件是虛假或誤導性的；或
(b) has taken all reasonable steps to determine whether the document is false or misleading.
(b) 已採取一切合理步驟來確定該文件是否為虛假或具有誤導性。
Statements and documents about endorsement etc.
有關背書等的聲明及文件
(4) A migration agent must not make to a government official a statement that a person is endorsed, nominated or sponsored by another person under or for the purposes of the migration law, unless the agent has taken all reasonable steps to verify the statement.
(4) 移民代理不得向政府官員聲明某人根據移民法或為了移民法的目的而得到另一人的認可、提名或擔保，除非該代理已採取一切合理步驟來核實該聲明。
(5) A migration agent must not give to a government official a document that states that a person is endorsed, nominated or sponsored by another person under or for the purposes of the migration law, unless the agent has taken all reasonable steps to verify the statement.
(5) 移民代理不得向政府官員提供文件，表明某人根據移民法或為了移民法的目的而得到另一人的認可、提名或擔保，除非移民代理已採取一切合理措施來核實該聲明。
Third party documents
第三方文件
(6) A migration agent must not state to a government official that a particular document originated from a specified person other than the agent or a client of the agent, unless the agent has taken all reasonable steps to verify the origin of the document.
(6) 移民代理人不得向政府官員聲明特定文件源自代理或其客戶以外的特定人員，除非代理人已採取一切合理步驟來核實文件的來源。
(7) A migration agent must not give to a government official a document that purports to have originated from a particular person other than the agent or a client of the agent, unless the agent has taken all reasonable steps to verify the origin of the document.
(7) 移民代理不得向政府官員提供聲稱來自代理或其客戶以外的特定人員的文件，除非代理已採取一切合理措施來核實文件的來源。

title: 21 Duty relating to correcting false or misleading statements etc.
zh: 21 與糾正虛假或誤導性陳述等有關的義務
path: Division 2 — Duties relating to Australia’s immigration system
text:
If a migration agent becomes aware that:
如果移民代理意識到：
(a) a statement that:
(a) 聲明：
(i) a client of the agent made to a government official; or
(i) 代理人向政府官員提出的客戶；或
(ii) the migration agent made to a government official on behalf of a client of the agent; or
(ii) 移民代理代表其客戶向政府官員提出要求；或
(iii) a third person (including another migration agent) made to a government official on behalf of a person who is now a client of the agent (whether or not the client was a client of the agent at the time the statement was made);
(iii) 第三人（包括另一名移民代理）代表現在是該代理客戶的人向政府官員所做的聲明（無論該客戶在作出聲明時是否是該代理的客戶）；
in relation to an immigration matter (including a statement described in subsection 20(4) or (6)) was false or misleading; or
與移民事務有關的內容（包括第 20(4) 或 (6) 款所述的陳述）是虛假的或具有誤導性的；或
(b) a document that:
(b) 一份文件：
(i) a client of the agent gave to a government official; or
(i) 代理人的客戶向政府官員提供的款項；或
(ii) the agent gave to a government official on behalf of a client of the agent; or
(ii) 代理人代表其客戶向政府官員提供資金；或
(iii) a third person (including another migration agent) gave to a government official on behalf of a person who is now a client of the agent (whether or not the client was a client of the agent at the time the document was given);
(iii) 第三人（包括另一名移民代理）代表現在是代理客戶的人向政府官員提供文件（無論該客戶在提供文件時是否是代理的客戶）；
in relation to an immigration matter (including a document described in subsection 20(5) or (7)) was false or misleading; or
與移民事務有關的內容（包括第 20(5) 或 (7) 款所述的文件）是虛假的或具有誤導性的；或者
(c) a client of the agent has concealed from a government official relevant information in relation to an immigration matter;
(c) 代理人的客戶向政府官員隱瞞了有關移民事務的相關資訊；
the migration agent must not give immigration assistance to the client unless:
移民代理不得向客戶提供移民援助，除非：
(d) a migration agent has:
(d) 移民代理具有：
(i) informed the client about the potential consequences of the matter mentioned in paragraph (a), (b) or (c) of this section; and
(i) 告知客戶本節(a)、(b)或(c)段所提及的事項的潛在後果；和
(ii) discussed with the client how the matter may be corrected; and
(ii) 與客戶討論如何修正該問題；和
(e) the client agrees to the matter being corrected; and
(e) 客戶同意糾正該事項；和
(f) the client takes all reasonable steps to correct the matter.
(f) 客戶採取一切合理措施糾正問題。

title: Division 3 — Duty to maintain skills and knowledge
zh: 第 3 分部 — 維持技能和知識的責任
path: Division 3 — Duty to maintain skills and knowledge

title: 22 Duty to maintain skills and knowledge
zh: 22 保持技能和知識的責任
path: Division 3 — Duty to maintain skills and knowledge
text:
A migration agent must:
移民代理必須：
(a) maintain sufficient knowledge and skills to give immigration assistance professionally and competently; and
(a) 保持足夠的知識和技能，以專業、有能力地提供移民援助；和
(b) maintain, or have access to, a professional library that includes up ‑ to ‑ date material relevant to giving immigration assistance.
(b) 維持或有權使用專業圖書館，其中包含與提供移民援助相關的最新資料。
Example: Material relevant to giving immigration assistance includes copies of the Act and regulations made under the Act.
例如：與提供移民援助相關的資料包括該法案和根據該法案製定的法規的副本。
Note: See also section 290A of the Act (continuing professional development requirements).
註：另請參閱該法案第 290A 條（持續專業發展要求）。

title: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
zh: 第 4 分部 — 與實務管理相關的職責
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management

title: 23 Duty to ensure that immigration assistance is given only by registered migration agents
zh: 23 確保僅由註冊移民代理提供移民援助的責任
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
text:
A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that no member of the agent’s business contravenes Division 2 of Part 3 of the Act.
移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保代理業務中的任何成員均不違反該法案第 3 部分第 2 節的規定。
Note: Division 2 of Part 3 of the Act provides that generally only registered migration agents may give immigration assistance.
注意：該法案第 3 部分第 2 部分規定，一般只有註冊移民代理才能提供移民援助。

title: 24 Duties relating to work or services performed by persons other than registered migration agents
zh: 24 與註冊移民代理以外的人員所履行的工作或服務有關的職責
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
text:
(1) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure the quality, accuracy and timeliness of any work or services performed by another person (including a person in the migration agent’s business):
(1) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保他人（包括移民代理業務中的人員）所執行的任何工作或服務的品質、準確性和及時性：
(a) for the purpose of assisting the agent to give immigration assistance; or
(a) 為了協助代理人提供移民協助；或
(b) under a service agreement in relation to which the agent is a responsible migration agent.
(b) 根據代理作為負責任的移民代理的服務協議。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply to work or services performed by another registered migration agent.
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於其他註冊移民代理所從事的工作或服務。

title: 25 Duties relating to MARN
zh: 25 與 MARN 相關的職責
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
text:
(1) A migration agent must ensure that the agent’s MARN appears on the agent’s:
(1) 移民代理必須確保代理的 MARN 出現在代理的：
(a) correspondence; and
(a) 信件；和
(b) business cards.
(b) 名片。
(2) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the MARN of at least one member of the agent’s business who is a registered migration agent appears:
(2) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保代理企業中至少一名註冊移民代理成員的 MARN 出現：
(a) on the business’s:
(a) 關於企業：
(i) website; and
(i) 網站；和
(ii) social media; and
(ii) 社群媒體；和
(b) in any advertisement relating to the giving of immigration assistance by the members of the business who are registered migration agents.
(b) 與作為註冊移民代理的企業成員提供移民援助有關的任何廣告。
(3) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the agent’s MARN is not used in a way that suggests that immigration assistance given by another person is given by the agent.
(3) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保代理的 MARN 的使用方式不會暗示他人提供的移民援助是由代理人提供的。
(4) A migration agent must give written notice to the Authority within 14 days after becoming aware that the agent’s MARN is being, or has been, used:
(4) 移民代理人必須在意識到其 MARN 正在或已經被使用後 14 天內向管理局發出書面通知：
(a) by another person (whether or not a registered migration agent) as if the MARN were the MARN of that person or of a third person; or
(a) 由另一個人（不論是否已註冊移民代理）將 MARN 視為該人或第三人的 MARN；或
(b) by another person in a way that is reasonably likely to have been intended to represent that conduct of that person or of a third person was conduct of the migration agent.
(b) 由另一人以合理可能的方式表示該人或第三人的行為是移民代理的行為。

title: 26 Duties not to make false or misleading statements in promoting business etc.
zh: 26 在推銷業務等時不作出虛假或誤導性陳述的義務。
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
text:
(1) A migration agent must not:
(1) 移民代理不得：
(a) make a false or misleading statement about:
(a) 作出虛假或誤導性陳述：
(i) the agent’s qualifications; or
（一）代理人的資格；或
(ii) immigration opportunities or risks; or
(ii) 移民機會或風險；或
(iii) migration procedure; or
(iii) 遷移程序；或
(b) state that the agent’s status as a registered migration agent involves a special or privileged relationship with any government official; or
(b) 說明該代理人作為註冊移民代理人的身份涉及與任何政府官員的特殊或特權關係；或
(c) state that the agent can procure a particular decision for a client under the migration law.
(c) 說明代理人可以根據移民法為客戶做出特定決定。
(2) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that no member of the agent’s business makes statements of the type mentioned in subsection (1) in relation to:
(2) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保代理業務中的任何成員均不會就以下方面發表第 (1) 款中提到的類型的聲明：
(a) the migration agent; or
(a) 移民代理；或
(b) a class of migration agents in the migration agent’s business that includes the migration agent; or
(b) 移民代理業務中的一類移民代理，包括移民代理；或
(c) the migration agents in the migration agent’s business generally.
(c) 移民代理業務中的移民代理。
(3) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that no person publishes or broadcasts an advertisement that makes statements of the type mentioned in subsection (1) in relation to:
(3) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保沒有人發布或廣播含有第 (1) 款所述類型聲明的廣告：
(a) the migration agent; or
(a) 移民代理；或
(b) a class of migration agents in the migration agent’s business that includes the migration agent; or
(b) 移民代理業務中的一類移民代理，包括移民代理；或
(c) the migration agents in the migration agent’s business generally.
(c) 移民代理業務中的移民代理。

title: 27 Duty to hold professional indemnity insurance
zh: 27 持有職業賠償保險的義務
path: Division 4 — Duties relating to practice management
text:
A migration agent must:
移民代理必須：
(a) hold professional indemnity insurance of a kind prescribed by section 33 of the Migration Agents Regulations 2026 ; or
(a) 持有《2026 年移民代理條例》第 33 條規定的專業賠償保險；或
(b) be a director, employee or member of an organisation that holds professional indemnity insurance of such a kind.
(b) 是持有此類職業賠償保險的組織的董事、員工或成員。

title: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent
zh: 第 5 分部 — 向管理局、客戶、部門和審查機構通報與移民代理有關的事宜的職責
path: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent

title: 28 Duty to notify Authority and clients of material changes in matters shown in Register
zh: 28 有義務將登記冊中所示事項的重大變更通知管理局和客戶
path: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent
text:
A migration agent must give written notice to:
移民代理必須向以下人員發出書面通知：
(a) the Authority; and
(a) 管理局；和
(b) all current clients of the agent;
(b) 該代理人所有現有的客戶；
within 14 days after becoming aware of a material change in a matter that is shown in the Register of Migration Agents in respect of the agent.
在得知移民代理登記冊中有關該代理人的事項發生重大變更後 14 天內。

title: 29 Duty to notify Authority of changes in circumstances relevant to agent’s continued registration
zh: 29 有義務將與代理人繼續註冊有關的情況變更通知管理局
path: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent
text:
A migration agent must give written notice to the Authority within 14 days after becoming aware of any change to the agent’s personal circumstances that it is reasonably likely will have a negative impact on the Authority’s satisfaction that the agent:
移民代理必須在意識到其個人情況發生任何變化後 14 天內向移民局發出書面通知，表明該變化很可能會對移民局的滿意度產生負面影響，即移民代理：
(a) is a person of integrity; and
(a) 是個正直的人；和
(b) is otherwise a fit and proper person to give immigration assistance.
(b) 在其他方面是提供移民援助的適當人選。
Note 1: Subsection 290(2) of the Act sets out the matters the Authority must take into account in considering whether an agent is fit and proper or a person of integrity. Those matters include:
註 1：該法第 290(2) 條規定了管理局在考慮代理人是否適當或正直時必須考慮的事項。這些事項包括：
(a) any relevant criminal proceedings that the agent is the subject of; and
(a) 代理人所涉及的任何相關刑事訴訟；和
(b) any relevant inquiry or investigation that the agent is or has been the subject of; and
(b) 該代理人現在或曾經受到的任何相關質詢或調查；和
(c) any relevant disciplinary action that is being taken, or has been taken, against the applicant.
(c) 正在或已對申請人採取的任何相關紀律處分。
Note 2: The Authority may cancel or suspend the registration of a migration agent, or caution an agent, if the Authority becomes satisfied that the agent is not a person of integrity or is otherwise not a fit and proper person to give immigration assistance: see subsection 303(1) of the Act.
註 2：如果管理局認為移民代理人不誠信或不適合提供移民援助，管理局可以取消或暫停該移民代理人的註冊，或警告該代理人：請參閱該法第 303(1) 款。

title: 30 Duty to notify clients, Department and review authority if registration suspended
zh: 30 如果註冊被暫停，則有義務通知客戶、部門和審查機構
path: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent
text:
(1) If the Authority suspends a migration agent’s registration, the agent must give written notice of the suspension in accordance with subsections (2) to (6) within 14 days after the Authority gives notice of the suspension to the agent.
(1) 若管理局暫停移民代理的註冊，代理人必須在管理局向代理人發出暫停通知後 14 天內，根據第 (2) 至 (6) 款發出書面暫停通知。
(2) Notice must be given to:
(2) 必須通知：
(a) all current clients of the migration agent; and
(a) 移民代理的所有現有客戶；和
(b) the Department, if an immigration matter in relation to which the agent has given immigration assistance to a current client is pending before the Department; and
(b) 若與該代理人向現有客戶提供移民援助有關的移民事宜正在該部門待決，則該部門；和
(c) a review authority, if an immigration matter in respect of which the agent has given immigration assistance to a current client is pending before the review authority.
(c) 審查機構，如果代理人已向現有客戶提供移民援助的移民事務正在等待審查機構審理。
(3) A notice must state the period of the suspension.
(3) 通知必須註明暫停的期限。
(4) A notice given to a client must include the following if an immigration matter in respect of the client is pending:
(4) 若客戶的移民事宜懸而未決，則向客戶發出的通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) the status of the client’s immigration matter;
(a) 客戶移民事務的狀況；
(b) if the matter is to be allocated to another registered migration agent:
(b) 若該事項將分配給另一名註冊移民代理：
(i) the name and contact details of the other registered migration agent; and
(i) 其他註冊移民代理的姓名和聯絡方式；和
(ii) a statement to the effect that the client may choose not to have the matter allocated to another registered migration agent and may cease receiving the agent’s services at any time before the end of the period of suspension if the client wishes to do so;
(ii) 一份聲明，表明客戶可以選擇不將事務分配給其他註冊移民代理，並且如果客戶願意，可以在暫停期結束之前隨時停止接受該代理的服務；
(c) if the matter is not to be allocated to another registered migration agent—details of how the client may obtain further immigration assistance.
(c) 如果不將案件分配給其他註冊移民代理－客戶如何獲得進一步移民援助的詳細資訊。
(5) A notice given to a client must include the following if the migration agent, or a member of the migration agent’s business, has received client money in relation to a service agreement that covers the client and in relation to which the agent is a responsible migration agent:
(5) 如果移民代理或移民代理業務的成員已收到與涵蓋客戶的服務協議相關的客戶資金，並且該代理是負責的移民代理，則向客戶發出的通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) a statement setting out:
(a) 一份聲明，載明：
(i) each amount of client money received; and
(i) 收到的每筆客戶資金；和
(ii) each amount paid as mentioned in paragraph 50(1)(d); and
(ii) 第 50(1)(d) 段所述支付的每筆金額；和
(iii) the amount remaining;
(iii) 剩餘金額；
(b) a statement that, in the absence of instructions from the client, the amount remaining will be refunded to the client.
(b) 聲明，表明在沒有客戶指示的情況下，剩餘金額將退還給客戶。
(6) A notice given to a client must include a statement setting out the effect of section 54.
(6) 向客戶發出的通知必須包括闡明第 54 條效力的聲明。
Note 1: Section 54 requires a migration agent to return documents to which a client is entitled if requested to do so by the client or by a new registered migration agent representing the client.
註 1：第 54 條要求移民代理在客戶或代表客戶的新註冊移民代理提出要求時，歸還客戶有權取得的文件。
Note 2: See also section 57 (termination notices).
註 2：另請參閱第 57 條（終止通知）。

title: 31 Duty to notify clients, Department and review authority if registration expected to lapse
zh: 31 如果註冊預計將失效，則有義務通知客戶、部門和審查機構
path: Division 5 — Duties relating to keeping Authority, clients, Department and review authority informed of matters relating to migration agent
text:
(1) A migration agent who becomes aware that it is reasonably likely that the agent will cease to be a registered migration agent on a particular day (other than because of the agent’s registration being cancelled) must give written notice of the expected cessation in accordance with subsections (2) to (6):
(1) 移民代理若意識到該代理人很可能在某一天不再是註冊移民代理（除非代理的註冊被取消），則必鬚根據第 (2) 至 (6) 款發出預期終止的書面通知：
(a) if the agent becomes aware of the expected cessation less than 14 days before that day—as soon as practicable; or
(a) 若代理人在該日期之前 14 天內意識到預期停止－盡快；或
(b) otherwise—no later than 14 days before that day.
(b) 否則－不遲於該日之前 14 天。
Note: The registration of a migration agent ends 12 months after the day of registration unless the registration is suspended, cancelled or the agent applies to be registered for another 12 months: see section 299 of the Act.
注意：移民代理的註冊在註冊之日起 12 個月後結束，除非註冊被暫停、取消或代理申請再註冊 12 個月：請參閱該法第 299 條。
(2) Notice must be given to:
(2) 必須通知：
(a) all current clients of the migration agent; and
(a) 移民代理的所有現有客戶；和
(b) the Department, if an immigration matter in relation to which the agent has given immigration assistance to a current client is pending before the Department; and
(b) 若與該代理人向現有客戶提供移民援助有關的移民事宜正在該部門待決，則該部門；和
(c) a review authority, if an immigration matter in respect of which the agent has given immigration assistance to a current client is pending before the review authority.
(c) 審查機構，如果代理人已向現有客戶提供移民援助的移民事務正在等待審查機構審理。
(3) A notice must state the day on which it is reasonably likely that the agent will cease to be a registered migration agent.
(3) 通知必須說明代理人很可能不再是註冊移民代理人的日期。
(4) A notice given to a client must include the following if it is reasonably likely that an immigration matter in respect of the client will be pending on the day stated under subsection (3) (the end date ):
(4) 若客戶的移民事務很可能在第 (3) 款規定的日期（結束日期）懸而未決，則向客戶發出的通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) the status of the client’s immigration matter;
(a) 客戶移民事務的狀況；
(b) if the matter is to be allocated to another registered migration agent:
(b) 若該事項將分配給另一名註冊移民代理：
(i) the name and contact details of the other registered migration agent; and
(i) 其他註冊移民代理的姓名和聯絡方式；和
(ii) a statement to the effect that the client may choose not to have the matter allocated to another registered migration agent and may cease receiving the agent’s services at any time before the end date if the client wishes to do so;
(ii) 一份聲明，表明客戶可以選擇不將事務分配給其他註冊移民代理，並且如果客戶願意，可以在結束日期之前隨時停止接受該代理的服務；
(c) if the matter is not to be allocated to another registered migration agent—details of how the client may obtain further immigration assistance.
(c) 如果不將案件分配給其他註冊移民代理－客戶如何獲得進一步移民援助的詳細資訊。
(5) A notice given to a client must include the following if, when the notice is given, the migration agent, or a member of the migration agent’s business, has received client money in relation to a service agreement that covers the client and in relation to which the agent is a responsible migration agent:
(5) 如果在發出通知時，移民代理或移民代理業務的成員已收到與涵蓋客戶的服務協議相關的客戶資金，並且該代理是負責的移民代理，則向客戶發出的通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) a statement setting out:
(a) 一份聲明，載明：
(i) each amount of client money received; and
(i) 收到的每筆客戶資金；和
(ii) each amount paid as mentioned in paragraph 50(1)(d); and
(ii) 第 50(1)(d) 段所述支付的每筆金額；和
(iii) the amount remaining;
(iii) 剩餘金額；
(b) a statement that, in the absence of instructions from the client, the amount remaining will be refunded to the client.
(b) 聲明，表明在沒有客戶指示的情況下，剩餘金額將退還給客戶。
(6) A notice given to a client must include a statement setting out the effect of section 54.
(6) 向客戶發出的通知必須包括闡明第 54 條效力的聲明。
Note 1: Section 54 requires a migration agent to return documents to which a client is entitled if requested to do so by the client or by a new registered migration agent representing the client.
註 1：第 54 條要求移民代理在客戶或代表客戶的新註冊移民代理提出要求時，歸還客戶有權取得的文件。
Note 2: See also section 57 (termination notices).
註 2：另請參閱第 57 條（終止通知）。

title: Division 6 — Duty to respond to requests from Authority for information or documents
zh: 第 6 分部 — 回應當局索取資訊或文件的請求的責任
path: Division 6 — Duty to respond to requests from Authority for information or documents

title: 32 Duty to respond to requests from Authority for information or documents
zh: 32 回應當局索取資訊或文件的要求的責任
path: Division 6 — Duty to respond to requests from Authority for information or documents
text:
(1) This section applies if the Authority requests information or a document from a migration agent for the purposes of the Authority carrying out its functions under paragraphs 316(1)(a) to (d) of the Act.
(1) 若管理局為了履行該法第 316(1)(a) 至 (d) 款規定的職能而要求移民代理人提供資訊或文件，則本節適用。
(2) The migration agent must respond to the request:
(2) 移民代理人必須回應請求：
(a) promptly; and
(a) 立即；和
(b) without limiting paragraph (a), if the Authority specifies a reasonable time by which the migration agent must respond to the request—by the specified time; and
(b) 在不限制(a)段的情況下，如果移民局規定了移民代理必須對請求做出回應的合理時間－在規定的時間內；和
(c) in accordance with subsection (3).
(c) 根據第(3)款。
(3) The response must:
(3) 回應必須：
(a) deal with each matter raised by the request; and
(a) 處理請求提出的每一事項；和
(b) answer any questions in the request; and
(b) 回答請求中的任何問題；和
(c) include all requested information or documents.
(c) 包括所有要求的資訊或文件。
Note: Other provisions of the migration law under which a migration agent can be required to provide documents to the Authority include:
注意：移民法中要求移民代理向管理局提供文件的其他規定包括：
(a) subsection 56(9) of this instrument (access to client files); and
(a) 本文書第 56(9) 款（查閱客戶檔案）；和
(b) sections 305C, 306D and 308 of the Act.
(b) 該法第 305C、306D 和 308 條。

title: Part 3 — The agent ‑ client relationship
zh: 第 3 部 — 代理人與客戶的關係

title: Division 1 — General duties
zh: 第 1 分部 — 一般義務

title: Subdivision A — General duties
zh: 第 A 次分部 — 一般義務

title: 33 General duties
text:
A migration agent must, in giving immigration assistance to a client or in performing other work or services for a client under a service agreement:
移民代理在向客戶提供移民援助或根據服務協議為客戶提供其他工作或服務時必須：
(a) subject to this instrument and any other law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory, act:
(a) 根據本文書和澳洲聯邦、州或領地的任何其他法律，採取以下行動：
(i) in the legitimate interests of the client; and
(i) 符合客戶的合法利益；和
(ii) in accordance with the client’s instructions; and
(ii) 依照客戶的指示；和
(iii) in accordance with the relevant service agreement (if any—see section 43); and
(iii) 依據相關服務協議（如有－請參閱第 43 條）；和
(b) have regard to the client’s dependence on the agent’s knowledge and experience; and
(b) 考慮客戶對代理人知識和經驗的依賴；和
(c) respond to the client in a timely manner; and
(c) 及時回覆客戶；和
(d) be aware of the times by which, under law, any relevant application must be made, any relevant response must be given or any other relevant thing must be done; and
(d) 了解根據法律必須提出任何相關申請、必須給予任何相關答覆或必須完成任何其他相關事項的時間；和
(e) have regard to the consequences of an application not being made, a response not being given, or any other thing not being done by the relevant time.
(e) 考慮未在相關時間內提出申請、未給予答覆或任何其他未採取行動的後果。

title: 34 Duty to inform clients of conflicts of interest
zh: 34 告知客戶利益衝突的義務
text:
(1) Subject to subsection (4), if a migration agent has an interest, pecuniary or otherwise, that conflicts, or could conflict, with the proper performance of the agent’s duties in relation to a client, the agent must not give immigration assistance to the client unless:
(1) 根據第 (4) 款，如果移民代理的利益（無論是金錢利益或其他利益）與代理人正確履行與客戶相關的職責相衝突或可能相衝突，則該代理人不得向客戶提供移民協助，除非：
(a) the agent gives written notice of the interest to the client in accordance with subsection (2); and
(a) 代理人依第 (2) 款向客戶發出書面利益通知；和
(b) the client gives to the agent a written statement that the client:
(b) 客戶向代理人提供一份書面聲明，表明客戶：
(i) has been given notice of the conflict; and
(i) 已收到衝突通知；和
(ii) still wishes the agent to give immigration assistance to the client.
(ii) 仍希望代理人向客戶提供移民協助。
Note: The proper performance of the agent’s duties in relation to the client includes complying with the agent’s duty to act in the legitimate interests of the client and in accordance with the client’s instructions: see section 33.
註：代理人正確履行與客戶相關的職責包括遵守代理人的職責，以客戶的合法利益行事並按照客戶的指示行事：請參閱第 33 節。
(2) A notice under paragraph (1)(a) must include the following:
(2) 第 (1)(a) 款規定的通知必須包括以下：
(a) details of:
(a) 詳情：
(i) the nature of the interest; and
(i) 權益的性質；和
(ii) how the interest conflicts, or could conflict, with the proper performance of the agent’s duties in relation to the client;
(ii) 利益如何與代理人正確履行與客戶相關的職責發生衝突或可能發生衝突；
(b) if relevant:
(b) 如相關：
(i) the name of the person or body providing the interest; and
(i) 提供權益的個人或機構的名稱；和
(ii) the reason the interest is being, or has been, provided;
(ii) 正在或已提供利息的原因；
(c) if the interest is pecuniary—the amount or a reasonable estimate of the amount of the pecuniary interest.
(c) 如果利息是金錢利息－金錢利息的金額或金額的合理估計。
(3) A notice under paragraph (1)(a), and a statement under paragraph (1)(b), may be included in a service agreement that covers the immigration assistance.
(3) 第 (1)(a) 款規定的通知和第 (1)(b) 款規定的聲明可以包含在涵蓋移民援助的服務協議中。
Actual conflicts
實際衝突
(4) A migration agent must not give immigration assistance to a client (even with the client’s consent) if:
(4) 在下列情況下，移民代理不得提供移民協助給客戶（即使得到客戶同意）：
(a) the agent has an actual conflict of interest, pecuniary or otherwise, with the client’s interests; and
(a) 代理人與客戶的利益有實際的利益衝突，無論是金錢上的或其他方面的；和
(b) as a result of the conflict of interest:
(b) 由於利益衝突：
(i) the agent’s objectivity, or the relationship of confidence and trust between the agent and the client, could be compromised; or
(i) 代理人的客觀性或代理人與客戶之間的信心和信任關係可能受到損害；或
(ii) the agent is reasonably likely to breach the confidentiality of the client.
(ii) 代理人很可能違反客戶的保密規定。
Interests of family members
家庭成員的利益
(5) To avoid doubt, for the purposes of this instrument, a conflict of interest may arise in relation to a migration agent or a client because of an interest of a relative of the migration agent or client.
(5) 為避免疑問，就本文書而言，由於移民代理或客戶的親屬的利益，可能會導致與移民代理或客戶相關的利益衝突。

title: 35 Duty of confidentiality
text:
Except as required by a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory, a migration agent must not disclose, or allow to be disclosed, to a third person any personal information relating to:
除澳洲聯邦、州或領地法律要求外，移民代理不得向第三方披露或允許向第三方披露與以下相關的任何個人資訊：
(a) a client or former client; or
(a) 客戶或前客戶；或
(b) a client’s or former client’s affairs;
(b) 客戶或前客戶的事務；
without the client’s written consent.
未經客戶書面同意。

title: Subdivision B — Preliminary requirements for giving immigration assistance
zh: B 部分 — 提供移民援助的初步要求
path: Subdivision B — Preliminary requirements for giving immigration assistance

title: 36 Duty to know clients etc.
path: Subdivision B — Preliminary requirements for giving immigration assistance
text:
(1) A migration agent must not give immigration assistance to a client unless the agent:
(1) 移民代理不得提供客戶移民協助，除非該代理：
(a) has taken all reasonable steps to verify the identity of the client; and
(a) 已採取一切合理步驟來驗證客戶的身份；和
(b) is reasonably satisfied of the identity of the client.
(b) 對客戶的身份相當滿意。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply to giving immigration assistance mentioned in paragraph 276(1)(b), (2)(b) or (2A)(b) of the Act (advice) during an initial consultation.
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於在初步諮詢期間提供該法案第 276(1)(b)、(2)(b) 或 (2A)(b) 段（建議）中提到的移民援助。
(3) A migration agent must not deal with a client through an agent or other intermediary representing the client unless the migration agent:
(3) 移民代理不得透過代理人或其他代表客戶的中介與客戶進行交易，除非移民代理：
(a) has taken all reasonable steps to verify the identity of the agent or other intermediary; and
(a) 已採取一切合理步驟核實代理人或其他中間人的身分；和
(b) is reasonably satisfied:
(b) 合理滿意：
(i) of the identity of the agent or other intermediary; and
(i) 代理人或其他中間人的身分；和
(ii) that the client has agreed in writing to the agent or other intermediary dealing with the migration agent on the client’s behalf.
(ii) 客戶已書面同意代表客戶與移民代理人打交道的代理人或其他中介。
Duties relating to third persons who have endorsed, nominated or sponsored client
與認可、提名或贊助客戶的第三方相關的責任
(4) Subsections (5) and (6) apply to a migration agent giving immigration assistance to a client on the basis that a third person has endorsed, nominated or sponsored the client under or for the purposes of the migration law or intends to do so.
(4) 第 (5) 和 (6) 款適用於移民代理在第三方已根據移民法或為了移民法之目的認可、提名或擔保客戶或打算這樣做的情況下向客戶提供移民協助。
(5) The migration agent must not give the immigration assistance unless the agent:
(5) 移民代理不得提供移民協助，除非代理：
(a) has taken all reasonable steps to verify the identity of the third person; and
(a) 已採取一切合理步驟核實第三人的身分；和
(b) is reasonably satisfied:
(b) 合理滿意：
(i) of the identity of the third person; and
(i) 第三人的身分；和
(ii) that the third person has actually endorsed, nominated or sponsored the client or intends to do so.
(ii) 第三人實際上已認可、提名或贊助客戶或打算這樣做。
(6) Furthermore, if the migration agent deals with the third person through an agent or other intermediary who represents the third person, the migration agent must not give the immigration assistance unless the agent:
(6) 此外，如果移民代理人透過代理人或其他代表第三人的中間人與第三人打交道，則移民代理不得提供移民協助，除非該代理人：
(a) has taken all reasonable steps to verify the identity of the agent or other intermediary; and
(a) 已採取一切合理步驟核實代理人或其他中間人的身分；和
(b) is reasonably satisfied:
(b) 合理滿意：
(i) of the identity of the agent or other intermediary; and
(i) 代理人或其他中間人的身分；和
(ii) that the third person has agreed in writing to the agent or other intermediary dealing with the migration agent on the third person’s behalf.
(ii) 第三人已書面同意代表第三人與移民代理人打交道的代理人或其他中介。

title: 37 Duty to arrange access to interpreters
path: Subdivision B — Preliminary requirements for giving immigration assistance
text:
(1) A migration agent must arrange for an appropriately qualified interpreter to assist a client in the client’s dealings with the agent if the client requests such assistance.
(1) 如果客戶要求協助，移民代理必須安排一名具有適當資格的口譯員協助客戶與代理打交道。
(2) To avoid doubt, subsection (1) does not prevent the client from being required to pay for the assistance.
(2) 為避免疑問，第 (1) 款並不妨礙客戶被要求支付援助費用。

title: 38 Duty to give consumer guide to clients
zh: 38 向客戶提供消費指南的責任
path: Subdivision B — Preliminary requirements for giving immigration assistance
text:
A migration agent must not give immigration assistance to a client unless a copy of the consumer guide has been given to the client.
除非已向客戶提供消費者指南副本，否則移民代理不得向客戶提供移民協助。
Note 1: The Authority arranges for the production of the consumer guide: see subsection 43(1) of the Migration Agents Regulations 2026 .
註 1：管理局安排消費者指南的製作：請參閱《2026 年移民代理條例》第 43(1) 款。
Note 2: The consumer guide could in 2026 be viewed on the Authority’s website (http://www.mara.gov.au).
註 2：2026 年消費者指南可在管理局網站 (http://www.mara.gov.au) 上查看。

title: Subdivision C — Other duties
zh: C 分部 — 其他職責

title: 39 Duty to keep clients informed about progress of immigration matters
zh: 39 有責任讓客戶了解移民事務的進展
text:
A migration agent must:
移民代理必須：
(a) advise a client in writing when any application, submission or representation that the agent makes for the client is lodged with a government official; and
(a) 當代理人向政府官員提出代理人為客戶提出的任何申請、提交或陳述時，以書面通知客戶；和
(b) give a copy of the application, submission or representation to the client; and
(b) 向客戶提供申請、提交或陳述的副本；和
(c) promptly advise the client of any material developments that occur in relation to the application, submission or representation.
(c) 及時告知客戶與申請、提交或陳述相關的任何重大進展。

title: 40 Duty not to act in a way that causes unnecessary expense or delay
zh: 40 有責任不以造成不必要費用或延誤的方式行事
text:
A migration agent must not, when dealing with an application, submission or representation for a client (including when lodging the application, submission or representation with the Department or a review authority), act in a way that causes, or is reasonably likely to cause, unnecessary expense or delay.
移民代理在處理客戶的申請、提交或陳述時（包括向移民部或審查機構提交申請、提交或陳述時），不得以導致或合理可能導致不必要的費用或延誤的方式行事。

title: 41 Duty not to give false or misleading documents to clients
zh: 41 不提供客戶虛假或誤導性文件的責任
text:
(1) A migration agent must not give to a client a document that the agent knows is false or misleading, unless the agent discloses to the client that the document is false or misleading.
(1) 移民代理不得向客戶提供其明知是虛假或誤導性的文件，除非代理向客戶披露該文件是虛假或誤導性的。
(2) A migration agent must not give to a client a document that the migration agent suspects, or reasonably ought to suspect, (but does not know) is false or misleading, unless the agent:
(2) 移民代理不得向客戶提供其懷疑或合理應該懷疑（但不知道）虛假或誤導性的文件，除非該代理：
(a) discloses to the client that the agent suspects that the document is false or misleading; or
(a) 向客戶透露代理人懷疑該文件是虛假或誤導性的；或
(b) has taken all reasonable steps to determine whether the document is false or misleading.
(b) 已採取一切合理步驟來確定該文件是否為虛假或具有誤導性。
Note: See also section 15 (duty not to make false or misleading statements).
註：另請參閱第 15 節（不做出虛假或誤導性陳述的義務）。

title: Division 2 — Service agreements
zh: 第 2 分部 — 服務協議

title: 42 Service agreements
text:
(1) Subject to section 43, a migration agent must not give immigration assistance to a client unless:
(1) 根據第 43 條，移民代理不得向客戶提供移民援助，除非：
(a) a service agreement that:
(a) 服務協議：
(i) covers the immigration assistance; and
(i) 涵蓋移民援助；和
(ii) authorises the agent to act on the client’s behalf; and
(ii) 授權代理人代表客戶行事；和
(iii) complies with the requirements of this Division;
(iii) 符合本部分的要求；
is in force; and
已生效；和
(b) if the service agreement has been varied—that variation met the requirements of section 44.
(b) 若服務協議已變更－該變更符合第 44 條的要求。
(2) The service agreement must be:
(2) 服務協議必須是：
(a) in writing; and
(a) 以書面形式；和
(b) signed by the client; and
(b) 由客戶簽署；和
(c) signed by the migration agent or by another migration agent in the agent’s business.
(c) 由移民代理或該代理業務中的其他移民代理簽署。
(3) The service agreement must include the following:
(3) 服務協議必須包括以下內容：
(a) the following details of each client to whom immigration assistance is to be given under the agreement:
(a) 根據協議將向其提供移民援助的每位客戶的以下詳細資訊：
(i) name;
(i) 姓名；
(ii) date of birth;
(ii) 出生日期；
(iii) email address (if any);
(iii) 電子郵件地址（如有）；
(iv) residential address;
(iv) 居住地址；
(b) the name, MARN and contact details of:
(b) 以下人員的姓名、MARN 和聯絡方式：
(i) the migration agent who signs the agreement, as mentioned in paragraph (2)(c); and
(i) 簽署第(2)(c)段所述協議的移民代理；和
(ii) each migration agent who, at the time the agreement is signed, is expected to give immigration assistance under the agreement;
(ii) 在簽署協議時預計將根據協議提供移民援助的每個移民代理；
(c) details of the work or services to be performed under the agreement;
(c) 根據協議執行的工作或服務的詳細資訊；
(d) a statement that a copy of the consumer guide has been given to the client (see section 38);
(d) 已向客戶提供消費者指南副本的聲明（請參閱第 38 條）；
(e) an explanation of what will happen to the client’s file:
(e) 解釋客戶的文件會發生什麼情況：
(i) if the service agreement is terminated by any party to the agreement; or
(i) 如服務協議被協議任何一方終止；或
(ii) on completion of the work or services covered by the agreement;
(ii) 協議涵蓋的工作或服務完成時；
(f) the matters required by Division 3 (about fees and disbursements).
(f) 第 3 部分要求的事項（關於費用和支出）。
(4) A service agreement may be expressed to cover more than one client.
(4) 一份服務協議可以涵蓋多個客戶。
(5) The authority mentioned in subparagraph (1)(a)(ii) may be expressed to cover:
(5) 第 (1)(a)(ii) 項所述的權力可表述為包括：
(a) a particular migration agent; or
(a) 特定的移民代理；或
(b) a class of migration agents in the agent’s business; or
(b) 代理業務中的一類移民代理；或
(c) all migration agents in the agent’s business.
(c) 代理業務中的所有移民代理。

title: 43 Service agreements not required for initial consultations
zh: 43 初次諮詢不需要服務協議
text:
(1) Despite section 42, a migration agent may give immigration assistance of a kind mentioned in paragraph 276(1)(b), (2)(b) or (2A)(b) of the Act (advice) at an initial consultation with a client or potential client without a service agreement that covers the immigration assistance being in force.
(1) 儘管有第 42 條規定，移民代理可以在與客戶或潛在客戶初步協商時提供該法第 276(1)(b)、(2)(b) 或 (2A)(b) 段（建議）中提到的移民援助，而無需簽訂涵蓋有效移民援助的服務協議。
(2) A migration agent must ensure that any fee charged for an initial consultation the migration agent conducts other than under a service agreement is reasonable.
(2) 移民代理必須確保移民代理在服務協議之外進行的初次諮詢所收取的任何費用都是合理的。
(3) If a migration agent conducts an initial consultation with a client or potential client other than under a service agreement:
(3) 若移民代理在服務協議之外與客戶或潛在客戶進行初步諮詢：
(a) the migration agent must notify the client or potential client of the agent’s MARN; and
(a) 移民代理必須將代理的 MARN 通知客戶或潛在客戶；和
(b) section 49 (invoices and receipts) applies in relation to:
(b) 第 49 條（發票和收據）適用於：
(i) immigration assistance given as part of that initial consultation; or
(i) 作為初步諮詢的一部分提供的移民援助；或
(ii) other work or services performed as part of that initial consultation;
(ii) 作為初步諮詢的一部分進行的其他工作或服務；
as if the immigration assistance were given, or the other work or services were performed, under a service agreement; and
如同根據服務協議提供移民援助或執行其他工作或服務；和
(c) if the migration agent, or a member of the migration agent’s business, receives amounts (including fees or amounts for disbursements) from a client for:
(c) 若移民代理或移民代理企業的成員從客戶收到以下款項（包括費用或支出金額）：
(i) immigration assistance given as part of that initial consultation; or
(i) 作為初步諮詢的一部分提供的移民援助；或
(ii) other work or services performed as part of that initial consultation;
(ii) 作為初步諮詢的一部分進行的其他工作或服務；
then:
那麼：
(iii) this instrument (other than section 51) applies to those amounts in the same way as it applies to client money in relation to a service agreement in relation to which the migration agent is a responsible migration agent; and
(iii) 本文件（第 51 條除外）適用於這些金額，其適用方式與適用於與移民代理作為負責移民代理的服務協議有關的客戶資金的方式相同；和
(iv) the migration agent must ensure that sufficient funds are available to cover any refunds of those amounts that become payable; and
(iv) 移民代理必須確保有足夠的資金來支付應付金額的任何退款；和
(v) the migration agent must ensure that any such refunds are paid promptly and, in any case, no later than 14 days after they become payable.
(v) 移民代理必須確保及時支付任何此類退款，並且在任何情況下不得晚於應支付的 14 天內。
(4) To avoid doubt:
(4) 為避免疑問：
(a) only the first consultation between a migration agent and a client or a potential client in relation to a particular immigration matter is an initial consultation ; and
(a) 只有移民代理與客戶或潛在客戶之間就特定移民事務進行的首次諮詢才是初步諮詢；和
(b) if a consultation consists of a series of sessions conducted on more than one day, sessions conducted on a day other than the first day are taken not to be part of an initial consultation .
(b) 若諮詢包括在一天以上進行的一系列會議，則在第一天以外的一天舉行的會議不被視為初步諮詢的一部分。

title: 44 Written notice of variations to service agreements
zh: 44 服務協議變更的書面通知
text:
For the purposes of paragraph 42(1)(b):
就第 42(1)(b) 段而言：
(a) before a service agreement is varied, each client covered by the agreement must be given written notice of:
(a) 在變更服務協議之前，必須向該協議所涵蓋的每位客戶發出以下書面通知：
(i) the proposed variation; and
(i) 擬議的變更；和
(ii) the reasons for the proposed variation; and
(ii) 擬議變更的原因；和
(iii) the matters required by subsection 46(5), if relevant; and
(iii) 第 46(5) 條要求的事項（如果相關）；和
(b) a variation of a service agreement must not take effect unless:
(b) 服務協議的變更不得生效，除非：
(i) each client covered by the agreement agrees in writing to the variation; or
(i) 協議涵蓋的每位客戶均以書面同意變更；或
(ii) if the agreement provides that the agreement of each client is not required for the variation—at least one client covered by the agreement agrees in writing to the variation, and any other conditions specified in the agreement are satisfied.
(ii) 如果協議規定變更不需要每位客戶的同意－協議所涵蓋的至少一名客戶以書面同意變更，並且協議中規定的任何其他條件均已滿足。

title: 45 Duty to ensure work or services specified in service agreements are completed
zh: 45 確保完成服務協議中規定的工作或服務的責任
text:
(1) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the work or services specified in the agreement are completed.
(1) 負責服務協議的移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保協議中指定的工作或服務得以完成。
(2) This section ceases to apply if the agreement is terminated.
(2) 若協議終止，本條不再適用。

title: Division 3 — Fees and disbursements
zh: 第 3 分部 — 費用和支出

title: 46 Fees
text:
(1) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must not charge fees, and must ensure that fees are not charged, for work or services performed under the agreement other than as provided for by the agreement in accordance with this section and section 48.
(1) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理不得收取費用，並且必須確保不對根據本節和第 48 節規定的協議規定之外的根據協議執行的工作或服務收取費用。
(2) If fees are to be charged for work or services performed under the service agreement, the agreement must include:
(2) 如果要對根據服務協議執行的工作或服務收取費用，協議必須包括：
(a) details of the fees, specified as either:
(a) 費用詳情，指定為：
(i) an hourly rate; or
(i) 小時費率；或
(ii) a fixed total amount (a fixed fee );
(ii) 固定總額（固定費用）；
including any relevant amount of GST or other tax; and
包括任何相關金額的商品及服務稅或其他稅費；和
