(b) if the agreement specifies fees as an hourly rate—a reasonable estimate of the time that will be spent performing the work or services.
(b) 如果協議規定費用為小時費率－執行工作或服務所需時間的合理估計。
(3) An hourly rate or fixed fee specified as mentioned in paragraph (2)(a) must be fair and reasonable.
(3) 第 (2)(a) 款所規定的小時費率或固定費用必須公平合理。
(4) If the service agreement specifies an hourly rate and an estimate of time, the agreement must provide that the clients covered by the agreement will not be charged for time spent performing work or services under the agreement in excess of that estimate (or the latest updated estimate given under this subsection, if any) unless:
(4) 如果服務協議規定了每小時費率和預計時間，則協議必須規定，協議所涵蓋的客戶將不會因超出該預計（或根據本款給出的最新更新的預計，如果有）執行協議下的工作或服務的時間而被收取費用，除非：
(a) exceptional circumstances arise after the agreement is signed; and
(a) 協議簽訂後出現特殊情況；和
(b) those circumstances make it impracticable to perform some or all of the work or services under the agreement at the hourly rate within the estimated time; and
(b) 這些情況使得在預計時間內以小時費率完成協議項下的部分或全部工作或服務不切實際；和
(c) each client covered by the agreement is given, in writing, an updated reasonable estimate of the time that will be spent performing the work or services; and
(c) 以書面形式向協議涵蓋的每位客戶提供關於執行工作或服務所需時間的最新合理估計；和
(d) either:
(d) 任一：
(i) each client covered by the agreement agrees in writing for work or services to continue to be performed under the agreement; or
(i) 協議涵蓋的每位客戶均書面同意繼續根據協議執行工作或服務；或
(ii) if the agreement provides that the agreement of each client is not required for work or services to continue to be performed under the agreement—at least one client covered by the agreement agrees in writing for work or services to continue to be performed under the agreement, and any other conditions specified in the agreement are satisfied.
(ii) 如果協議規定繼續根據協議執行工作或服務不需要每位客戶的同意－至少一名協議涵蓋的客戶以書面形式同意根據協議繼續執行工作或服務，並且滿足協議中規定的任何其他條件。
(5) The agreement must provide that an hourly rate or a fixed fee specified in the agreement must not be varied unless:
(5) 協議必須規定不得更改協議中指定的小時費率或固定費用，除非：
(a) exceptional circumstances arise after the agreement is signed; and
(a) 協議簽訂後出現特殊情況；和
(b) those circumstances make it impracticable to perform some or all of the work or services under the agreement at the hourly rate within the estimated time, or at the fixed fee, specified in the agreement.
(b) 這些情況使得無法在預計時間內以小時費率或依協議中規定的固定費用執行協議項下的部分或全部工作或服務。

title: 47 Disbursements
text:
(1) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement:
(1) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理：
(a) must not unreasonably incur disbursements in relation to work or services performed under the agreement; and
(a) 不得不合理地支付與根據協議執行的工作或服務相關的費用；和
(b) must not require a client to pay, and ensure that a client is not required to pay, for a disbursement that will be incurred, in relation to such work or services, other than in accordance with:
(b) 不得要求客戶支付，並確保客戶無需支付與此類工作或服務相關的費用，除非符合以下規定：
(i) subsections (3) and (6); and
(i) 第(3)和(6)款；和
(ii) provisions included in the agreement in accordance with section 48.
(ii) 依第 48 條納入協議的條款。
Clients must agree to disbursements
客戶必須同意付款
(2) The service agreement must include details of the likely disbursements that will be incurred in relation to work or services performed under the agreement and for which the client will be required to pay, including, for each disbursement:
(2) 服務協議必須包括與根據協議執行的工作或服務相關而可能產生的費用以及客戶需要支付的費用的詳細信息，包括每項費用：
(a) either:
(a) 任一：
(i) the amount of the disbursement; or
(i) 支付金額；或
(ii) a reasonable estimate of the amount of the disbursement;
(ii) 對支付金額的合理估計；
including any relevant amount of GST or other tax; and
包括任何相關金額的商品及服務稅或其他稅費；和
(b) whether the disbursement is to be paid:
(b) 是否支付款項：
(i) directly by the client; or
(i) 直接由客戶進行；或
(ii) on the client’s behalf.
(ii) 代表客戶。
(3) For the purposes of subparagraph (1)(b)(i), a client must not be charged for a disbursement unless:
(3) 就第 (1)(b)(i) 項而言，不得向客戶收取費用，除非：
(a) all of the following requirements are met:
(a) 滿足以下所有要求：
(i) details of the disbursement are included in the service agreement as mentioned in subsection (2);
(i) 付款詳情包含在第 (2) 款所述的服務協議中；
(ii) those provisions of the service agreement are complied with;
(ii) 遵守服務協議的這些條款；
(iii) subsection (4) is complied with (if applicable); or
(iii) 遵守第(4)款（如適用）；或
(b) all of the following requirements are met:
(b) 滿足以下所有要求：
(i) when the agreement was signed, the disbursement was not reasonably likely;
(i) 當協議簽署時，付款的可能性不大；
(ii) each client covered by the agreement is given, in writing, details of the disbursement, including the amount of the disbursement or a reasonable estimate of the amount of the disbursement;
(ii) 以書面形式向協議涵蓋的每位客戶提供付款詳情，包括付款金額或付款金額的合理估計；
(iii) subsection (5) is complied with.
(iii) 第(5)款已遵守。
(4) For the purposes of subparagraph (3)(a)(iii), if the service agreement specifies an amount of a disbursement, or includes a reasonable estimate of the amount of a disbursement, a client must not be required to pay an amount for the disbursement that is greater than the specified amount or the estimated amount unless:
(4) 就第 (3)(a)(iii) 項而言，如果服務協議規定了支付金額，或包含對支付金額的合理估計，則不得要求客戶支付高於指定金額或估計金額的支付金額，除非：
(a) each client covered by the agreement is given written notice of:
(a) 向協議涵蓋的每位客戶發出以下書面通知：
(i) the actual amount of the disbursement; and
(i) 實際支付金額；和
(ii) the reason that the actual amount of the disbursement is greater than the specified amount or the estimated amount; and
(ii) 實際支付金額高於指定金額或預計金額的原因；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) each client covered by the agreement agrees in writing to incurring the increased cost; or
(i) 協議涵蓋的每位客戶均書面同意承擔增加的費用；或
(ii) if the agreement provides that the agreement of each client is not required for the increased cost to be incurred—at least one client covered by the agreement agrees in writing to incurring the increased cost, and any other conditions specified in the agreement are satisfied.
(ii) 如果協議規定增加的費用不需要每位客戶的同意－協議所涵蓋的至少一名客戶以書面形式同意承擔增加的費用，並且滿足協議中規定的任何其他條件。
(5) For the purposes of subparagraph (3)(b)(iii), this subsection is complied with if:
(5) 就第 (3)(b)(iii) 項而言，如果符合下列條件，則符合本款規定：
(a) each client covered by the service agreement agrees in writing to the disbursement; or
(a) 服務協議涵蓋的每位客戶均以書面同意付款；或
(b) both:
(b) 兩者：
(i) the agreement provides that the agreement of each client is not required for the disbursement; and
(i) 協議規定付款無須徵得每位客戶的同意；和
(ii) at least one client covered by the agreement agrees in writing to the disbursement and any other conditions specified in the agreement are satisfied.
(ii) 協議涵蓋的至少一名客戶以書面形式同意付款，並且滿足協議中規定的任何其他條件。
(6) For the purposes of subparagraph (1)(b)(i), and despite anything in the service agreement, a client must not be charged, for a disbursement in relation to work or services provided under the agreement, more than:
(6) 就第 (1)(b)(i) 項而言，無論服務協議有何規定，客戶就協議下提供的工作或服務支付的費用不得超過：
(a) if the amount of the disbursement is known at the time the client is charged—the actual amount of the disbursement; or
(a) 若在向客戶收費時已知支付金額－實際支付金額；或
(b) otherwise—a reasonable estimate of the amount of the disbursement.
(b) 否則－對支付金額的合理估計。
Refund of excess charged
退還超額費用
(7) If:
(7) 如果：
(a) a client is charged for a disbursement in relation to work or services performed under a service agreement; and
(a) 客戶需要支付與根據服務協議執行的工作或服務相關的費用；和
(b) a responsible migration agent in relation to the agreement becomes aware that the amount charged was greater than the actual amount of the disbursement (including because of any refunds);
(b) 與協議相關的負責移民代理意識到收取的金額高於實際支付金額（包括任何退款）；
the responsible migration agent must ensure that the excess is refunded to the client in accordance with section 52.
負責的移民代理必須確保根據第 52 條將超額部分退還給客戶。

title: 48 Payment of fees and disbursements etc.
text:
A service agreement must include:
服務協議必須包括：
(a) the terms and conditions for the payment of fees for, and disbursements in relation to, work or services performed under the agreement; and
(a) 根據協議執行的工作或服務的費用支付和支出的條款和條件；和
(b) the interest, if any, to be charged on unpaid fees and disbursements.
(b) 對未付費用和支出收取的利息（如有）。

title: 49 Invoices and receipts
text:
A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement:
與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理：
(a) must not charge a client, and must ensure that a client is not charged:
(a) 不得向客戶收費，且必須確保不會向客戶收取下列費用：
(i) a fee for work or services performed under the agreement; or
(i) 依協議執行的工作或服務的費用；或
(ii) an amount for a disbursement in relation to work or services performed under the agreement;
(ii) 與依協議執行的工作或服務有關的支出金額；
unless the client is given an itemised invoice containing details of the work or services to which the fee or disbursement relates; and
除非向客戶提供包含與費用或支出相關的工作或服務詳細資訊的明細發票；和
(b) must ensure that, after the client pays such a fee or amount, the client is given a receipt that identifies:
(b) 必須確保在客戶支付此類費用或金額後，向客戶提供收據，其中註明：
(i) the work or services to which the payment relates; and
(i) 與付款相關的工作或服務；和
(ii) the invoice, if any, to which the payment relates.
(ii) 與付款相關的發票（如有）。
Note: Under section 313 of the Act, a registered migration agent is not entitled to be paid a fee or other reward for giving immigration assistance unless the agent gives the assisted person a statement of services that sets out particulars of each service performed and the charge made in respect of each service.
注意：根據該法第 313 條，註冊移民代理無權因提供移民援助而獲得費用或其他獎勵，除非代理向受援助人提供服務說明，其中列出了所提供的每項服務的詳情以及每項服務的收費。

title: 50 Duty in relation to client’s money
zh: 50 與客戶資金相關的責任
text:
(1) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must ensure that the following requirements are complied with in relation to client money in relation to the agreement that is received by the agent or by a member of the agent’s business:
(1) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理必須確保遵守以下與代理或代理業務成員收到的協議相關的客戶資金相關的要求：
(a) client money must be paid into an account with a financial institution;
(a) 客戶資金必須存入金融機構的帳戶；
(b) amounts other than client money must not be paid into that account;
(b) 不得將客戶資金以外的金額存入該帳戶；
(c) without limiting paragraph (b), interest on the account must not be paid into the account;
(c) 在不限制(b)段的情況下，帳戶利息不得存入帳戶；
(d) an amount must not be paid out of the account other than:
(d) 不得向帳戶支付下列款項：
(i) to pay the agent or the agent’s business (but not if, under section 313 of the Act, a migration agent is not entitled to be paid the amount); or
(i) 支付代理人或代理人的業務費用（但如果根據該法第 313 條，移民代理人無權獲得該金額，則不支付）；或
(ii) to pay amounts required to be paid to the Department or a review authority; or
(ii) 支付需要支付給部門或審查機構的金額；或
(iii) to pay disbursements in accordance with the agreement; or
（三）依協議支付費用；或
(iv) to refund client money to a client; or
(iv) 將客戶資金退還給客戶；或
(v) to refund client money by transferring amounts to other registered migration agents, or to members of the businesses of other registered migration agents, at the instruction of a client;
(v) 根據客戶的指示，透過將金額轉移給其他註冊移民代理或其他註冊移民代理的企業成員來退還客戶資金；
Note: Under section 313 of the Act, a registered migration agent is not entitled to be paid a fee or other reward for giving immigration assistance unless the agent gives the assisted person a statement of services that sets out particulars of each service performed and the charge made in respect of each service.
注意：根據該法第 313 條，註冊移民代理無權因提供移民援助而獲得費用或其他獎勵，除非代理向受援助人提供服務說明，其中列出了所提供的每項服務的詳情以及每項服務的收費。
(e) without limiting paragraph (d), an amount must not be paid out of the account to pay fees or costs associated with opening or maintaining the account;
(e) 在不限制(d)段的情況下，不得從帳戶中支付金額來支付與開立或維持帳戶相關的費用或成本；
(f) the total amount paid out of the account for a particular purpose must not exceed the total amount paid into the account for that purpose.
(f) 為特定目的從帳戶支付的總金額不得超過為此目的存入帳戶的總金額。
(2) A migration agent must, if requested by the Authority, demonstrate to the Authority that this section is being complied with.
(2) 如管理局要求，移民代理必須向管理局證明本條已遵守。

title: 51 Duty not to receive amounts from clients before entering into service agreements
zh: 51 在簽訂服務協議之前不收取客戶款項的義務
text:
(1) A migration agent must not receive amounts (including fees or amounts for disbursements) from a client if:
(1) 在下列情況下，移民代理不得向客戶收取款項（包括費用或支出金額）：
(a) the amounts relate to the agent, or another registered migration agent in the agent’s business, giving immigration assistance to the client; and
(a) 該金額與代理人或代理人業務中的其他註冊移民代理人向客戶提供移民援助有關；和
(b) a service agreement that covers the immigration assistance is not in force.
(b) 涵蓋移民援助的服務協議尚未生效。
(2) A migration agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that a member of the agent’s business, other than another registered migration agent, does not receive amounts (including fees or amounts for disbursements) from a client if:
(2) 移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保除其他註冊移民代理之外的代理業務成員不會向客戶收取款項（包括費用或支出金額），如果：
(a) the amounts relate to the agent, or another registered migration agent in the agent’s business, giving immigration assistance to the client; and
(a) 該金額與代理人或代理人業務中的其他註冊移民代理人向客戶提供移民援助有關；和
(b) a service agreement that covers the immigration assistance is not in force.
(b) 涵蓋移民援助的服務協議尚未生效。
(3) This section does not apply to a fee charged for an initial consultation conducted other than under a service agreement in accordance with section 43.
(3) 本條不適用於依第 43 條的服務協議以外的方式進行的初次諮詢所收取的費用。
Note: See also paragraph 43(3)(c).
註：另請參閱第 43(3)(c) 段。

title: 52 Refunds
text:
(1) A service agreement must include a refund policy in relation to fees and disbursements.
(1) 服務協議必須包括與費用和支出相關的退款政策。
(2) The refund policy must be fair and reasonable.
（2）退款政策必須公平合理。
(3) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must ensure that:
(3) 負責服務協議的移民代理必須確保：
(a) sufficient funds are available to cover any refunds that become payable under the agreement; and
(a) 有足夠的資金來支付根據協議應付的任何退款；和
(b) any refunds payable under the agreement are paid:
(b) 根據協議應付的任何退款均按以下方式支付：
(i) in accordance with the agreement; and
(i) 依照協議；和
(ii) promptly and, in any case, no later than 14 days after they become payable.
(ii) 及時且在任何情況下均不得晚於應付款項後 14 天內。

title: Division 4 — Client documents
zh: 第 4 分部 — 客戶文件

title: 53 Duty to keep documents securely
text:
A migration agent must ensure that any documents belonging, or relating, to a client or former client of the agent that are in the possession of the agent, or a member of the agent’s business, are kept securely.
移民代理必須確保代理或代理企業成員擁有的屬於代理客戶或前客戶或與代理客戶或前客戶相關的任何文件均得到安全保存。

title: 54 Duty to return client documents
text:
(1) A migration agent must, if requested in writing by:
(1) 如有書面要求，移民代理必須：
(a) a client; or
(a) 客戶；或
(b) a former client, or a new registered migration agent representing a former client;
(b) 前客戶或代表前客戶的新註冊移民代理；
return to the client or new agent all documents to which the client is entitled within 14 days of receiving the request.
在收到請求後 14 天內，將客戶有權獲得的所有文件回饋給客戶或新代理人。
(2) A migration agent is not entitled to claim a lien on documents to which a client or former client is entitled unless the agent is a restricted legal practitioner who is eligible.
(2) 移民代理無權對客戶或前客戶有權獲得的文件要求留置權，除非該代理是符合資格的受限法律執業者。
Note: A person cannot be registered as a migration agent if the person is an unrestricted legal practitioner or a restricted legal practitioner who is not eligible: see section 302A of the Act.
注意：如果某人是非限制性法律執業者或不符合資格的限制性法律執業者，則不能註冊為移民代理：請參閱該法案第 302A 條。
(3) For the purposes of this section, and without limiting it, a client or former client of a migration agent is taken to be entitled to documents that are:
(3) 就本節而言，且不限於此，移民代理的客戶或前客戶被認為有權獲得以下文件：
(a) given to the agent, or a member of the agent’s business, by, or on behalf of, the client; or
(a) 由客戶或代表客戶提供給代理人或代理人業務的成員；或
(b) paid for by, or on behalf of, the client.
(b) 由客戶或代表客戶支付。
Note: Documents that are commonly given to migration agents by, or on behalf of, clients include passports, birth certificates, qualifications, photographs and business financial statements.
注意：通常由客戶或代表客戶提供給移民代理的文件包括護照、出生證明、資格證書、照片和商業財務報表。

title: Division 5 — Record keeping
zh: 第 5 分部 — 記錄保存

title: 55 Duty to make records of oral communications with clients
zh: 55 與客戶進行口頭溝通記錄的責任
text:
A migration agent must make a contemporaneous written record of oral communications between the agent and a client in relation to immigration assistance, including:
移民代理必須對代理與客戶之間有關移民援助的口頭交流進行同步書面記錄，包括：
(a) oral instructions the client gives the agent; and
(a) 客戶向代理人發出的口頭指示；和
(b) oral advice the agent gives the client.
(b) 代理人向客戶提供的口頭建議。

title: 56 Duty to maintain client files
text:
Duty to create and maintain client files
建立和維護客戶文件的職責
(1) A migration agent for a client must ensure that a client file is created and maintained for the client.
(1) 客戶端的遷移代理必須確保為客戶端建立和維護客戶端檔案。
(2) The client file must include the following:
(2) 客戶檔案必須包括以下內容：
(a) a copy of the client’s application or other immigration matter;
(a) 客戶申請或其他移民事宜的副本；
(b) copies of all service agreements between the agent and the client and any variations to the agreements;
(b) 代理人與客戶之間的所有服務協議的副本以及協議的任何變更；
(c) copies of all written communications (including electronic communications) between:
(c) 以下人員之間的所有書面通訊（包括電子通訊）的副本：
(i) the agent and the client; and
(i) 代理人和客戶；和
(ii) the agent and any other person or organisation, to the extent that the communications relate to the client;
(ii) 代理人和任何其他個人或組織，只要通信與客戶有關；
(d) all records made under section 55 in relation to the client;
(d) 依第 55 條所作出的所有與客戶有關的紀錄；
(e) records of material oral communications between the agent and any person or organisation other than the client, to the extent that the communications relate to the client;
(e) 代理人與客戶以外的任何個人或組織之間的重要口頭交流記錄，只要該等交流與客戶有關；
(f) copies of all invoices and receipts given by the agent relating to the client;
(f) 代理人提供的所有與客戶有關的發票和收據的副本；
(g) copies of all personal documents relating to the client given to the agent by, or on behalf of, the client;
(g) 由客戶或代表客戶向代理人提供的所有與客戶有關的個人文件的副本；
(h) evidence of the safe return of any original documents belonging to the client and given to the agent.
(h) 安全返還屬於客戶並交給代理人的任何原始文件的證據。
(3) A migration agent may create and maintain a single file under subsection (1) for 2 or more clients who are members of the same family unit, other than a client who requests the agent to create and maintain a separate client file for the client.
(3) 移民代理可以根據第 (1) 款為屬於同一家庭單位的 2 個或更多客戶建立和維護單一文件，但要求代理為該客戶創建和維護單獨的客戶文件的客戶除外。
(4) A client file may be kept in written or electronic form, or partly written and partly electronic form.
（四）客戶檔案可以以書面或電子形式，或部分書面部分電子形式保存。
Duty to keep client files for 7 years
保存客戶檔案7年的責任
(5) A migration agent who has a duty under subsection (1) in relation to a client file must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the client file is kept for a period of 7 years after the last action on the file for the relevant client.
(5) 根據第 (1) 款對客戶檔案負有責任的移民代理必須採取一切合理措施，確保客戶檔案在相關客戶最後一次對檔案採取行動後保存 7 年。
(6) Subsection (5) does not prohibit a migration agent from transferring possession of a client file to another migration agent.
(6) 第 (5) 款不禁止移民代理將客戶文件的所有權轉讓給另一移民代理。
(7) If a migration agent (the original agent ) transfers possession of a client file for a client to another migration agent (the receiving agent ):
(7) 若移民代理（原代理）將客戶的客戶文件的所有權轉讓給另一移民代理（接收代理）：
(a) the receiving agent must take all reasonable steps to ensure that the client file is kept for a period of 7 years after the date of the last action on the file for the client; and
(a) 接收代理人必須採取一切合理措施，確保客戶檔案自最後一次對客戶檔案採取行動之日起保存 7 年；和
(b) except as required or authorised by law, the receiving agent must not disclose, or allow to be disclosed, to a third person any personal information contained in the client file relating to:
(b) 除非法律要求或授權，接收代理不得向第三方披露或允許向第三方披露客戶檔案中包含的與以下相關的任何個人資訊：
(i) the client; or
(i) 客戶；或
(ii) the client’s affairs;
(ii) 客戶的事務；
without the written consent of the client.
未經客戶書面同意。
(8) The receiving agent’s duties under subsection (7) are in addition to the original agent’s duties under section 35 (confidentiality) and subsection (5) of this section.
(8) 第 (7) 款規定的接收代理人的職責是對本條第 35 條（保密）和第 (5) 款規定的原代理人職責的補充。
Duty to give Authority access to client files on request
有責任根據要求允許當局存取客戶文件
(9) A migration agent must give the Authority access to a client file that is in the possession of the agent, or a member of the agent’s business, if the Authority, in writing, requests access to the client file for the purposes of the Authority carrying out its functions under paragraphs 316(1)(a) to (d) of the Act.
(9) 若移民局為了履行該法第 316(1)(a) 至 (d) 條規定的職能而以書面形式請求查閱客戶檔案，則移民代理必須允許移民局查閱該代理人或其業務成員所擁有的客戶檔案。

title: Division 6 — Ending agent ‑ client relationship
zh: 第 6 分部 — 終止代理與客戶關係

title: 57 Termination notices
text:
Notices to clients
致客戶的通知
(1) Subject to subsection (2), a responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must ensure that each client covered by the agreement is given a written notice in accordance with subsection (3) before any termination of the agreement takes effect.
(1) 根據第 (2) 款，負責服務協議的移民代理必須確保在協議終止生效之前，按照第 (3) 款向協議所涵蓋的每位客戶發出書面通知。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於下列情況：
(a) because of exceptional circumstances, it is reasonable for the agreement to be terminated without a client having been given such a notice before the termination takes effect; or
(a) 由於特殊情況，在終止生效之前未向客戶發出通知的情況下終止協議是合理的；或
(b) the agreement is terminated unilaterally by a client.
(b) 客戶單方面終止協議。
Instead, the responsible migration agent must ensure that each client covered by the agreement is given a written notice in accordance with subsection (3) no later than 14 days after the termination takes effect.
相反，負責的移民代理必須確保在終止生效後 14 天內根據第 (3) 款向協議所涵蓋的每位客戶發出書面通知。
(3) The notice must include the following:
(3) 通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) the date from which the agreement is terminated;
(a) 協議終止的日期；
(b) the matters required by subsection (4) (if applicable);
(b) 第(4)款要求的事項（如適用）；
(c) the matters required by subsection (5) (if applicable);
(c) 第(5)款要求的事項（如適用）；
(d) a statement setting out the effect of section 54.
(d) 闡述第 54 條效力的聲明。
Note: Section 54 requires a migration agent to return documents to which a client is entitled if requested to do so by the client or by a new registered migration agent representing the client.
注意：第 54 節要求移民代理在客戶或代表客戶的新註冊移民代理提出要求時，歸還客戶有權獲得的文件。
(4) If an immigration matter in respect of the client is pending, the notice must include the following:
(4) 若客戶的移民事宜懸而未決，則通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) the status of the client’s immigration matter;
(a) 客戶移民事務的狀況；
(b) if the matter is to be allocated to another registered migration agent:
(b) 若該事項將分配給另一名註冊移民代理：
(i) the name and contact details of that other registered migration agent; and
(i) 該其他註冊移民代理的姓名和聯絡方式；和
(ii) a statement to the effect that the client may choose not to have the matter allocated to another registered migration agent and may cease receiving the responsible migration agent’s services at any time before the agent terminates the agreement if the client wishes to do so;
(ii) 一份聲明，表明客戶可以選擇不將事務分配給其他註冊移民代理，並且如果客戶願意，可以在代理終止協議之前隨時停止接受負責的移民代理的服務；
(c) if the matter is not to be allocated to another registered migration agent—details of how the client may obtain further immigration assistance.
(c) 如果不將案件分配給其他註冊移民代理－客戶如何獲得進一步移民援助的詳細資訊。
(5) If the responsible migration agent, or a member of the responsible migration agent’s business, holds any client money in relation to the service agreement, the notice must include the following:
(5) 如果負責的移民代理或負責的移民代理業務的成員持有與服務協議相關的任何客戶資金，則通知必須包括以下內容：
(a) a statement setting out:
(a) 一份聲明，載明：
(i) each amount of client money received; and
(i) 收到的每筆客戶資金；和
(ii) each amount paid as mentioned in paragraph 50(1)(d); and
(ii) 第 50(1)(d) 段所述支付的每筆金額；和
(iii) the amount remaining;
(iii) 剩餘金額；
(b) a statement that, in the absence of instructions from the client, the amount remaining will be refunded to the client.
(b) 聲明，表明在沒有客戶指示的情況下，剩餘金額將退還給客戶。
Notices to Department and review authorities
給部門和審查機構的通知
(6) A responsible migration agent in relation to a service agreement must ensure that the Department or a review authority is given written notice no later than 14 days after a termination of the service agreement takes effect if, at that time, an immigration matter in relation to which immigration assistance has been provided under the agreement is pending before the Department or review authority.
(6) 負責服務協議的移民代理必須確保在服務協議終止生效後 14 天內向部門或審查機構發出書面通知，如果當時與根據協議提供移民援助有關的移民事宜正在部門或審查機構待決。

title: 58 Duty to forward correspondence relating to former clients
zh: 58 轉寄與前客戶有關的信件的義務
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a migration agent ceases to be a migration agent of a client; and
(a) 移民代理不再是客戶的移民代理；和
(b) the agent later receives correspondence from a government official that:
(b) 代理人隨後收到政府官員的來信，內容如下：
(i) is addressed to the client; or
(i) 致客戶；或
(ii) it is reasonable to assume was addressed to the agent because it was believed that the agent was, at the time the correspondence was sent, a current migration agent of the client;
(ii) 可以合理地假設是寫給代理人的，因為在發送信件時相信該代理人是客戶的現任移民代理人；
the agent must take all reasonable steps to forward the correspondence to the former client or to a current migration agent of the former client.
代理必須採取一切合理步驟將信件轉發給前客戶或前客戶的現任移民代理。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply to correspondence the migration agent receives more than 28 days after the agent gives written notice to:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於移民代理在向下列人員發出書面通知後超過 28 天收到的信件：
(a) the Department; or
(a) 該部門；或
(b) a review authority at a time when an immigration matter in respect of the client is pending before the review authority;
(b) 當與客戶相關的移民事務正在審查機構待決時，審查機構；
that the agent has ceased to be a migration agent of the client.
該代理人已不再是客戶的移民代理人。
(3) For the purposes of subsection (2), if:
(3) 就第 (2) 款而言，如果：
(a) the client gave the Minister notice under subsection 494D(1) of the Act that the agent was authorised by the client to receive documents under the Act; and
(a) 客戶根據該法案第 494D(1) 款向部長發出通知，表明該代理人已獲客戶授權接收該法案規定的文件；和
(b) the client varies or withdraws the notice so that the agent is no longer the client’s authorised recipient;
(b) 客戶改變或撤回通知，使代理人不再是客戶的授權接收者；
the agent is taken to have given written notice in accordance with that subsection at the later of:
代理人被視為已根據該款在以下時間（以較晚者為準）發出書面通知：
(c) the time the client varies or withdraws the notice; and
(c) 客戶更改或撤回通知的時間；和
(d) the time the client ceases to be a client of the agent.
(d) 客戶不再是代理人的客戶的時間。

title: 59 Legal professional privilege
text:
Nothing in this instrument affects the right of a person to refuse to answer a question, give information, or produce a document, on the ground that:
本文書的任何內容均不影響任何人基於以下理由拒絕回答問題、提供資訊或出示文件的權利：
(a) the answer to the question or the information would be privileged from being given on the ground of legal professional privilege; or
(a) 基於法律專業特權的原因，將有權給予問題或資訊的答案；或
(b) the document would be privileged from being produced on the ground of legal professional privilege.
(b) 該文件將因法律專業特權而享有特權。

title: Part 5 — Application and transitional provisions
zh: 第 5 部 — 適用及過渡條文

title: Division 1 — Application of this instrument
zh: 第 1 分部 — 本文書的應用

title: 60 Application of this instrument—general duties
zh: 60 本文書的應用－一般職責
text:
Duty not to give futile immigration assistance
有責任不提供無用的移民援助
(1) For the purposes of paragraph 19(2)(b), it does not matter whether advice given to a client was given before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(1) 就第 19(2)(b) 段而言，提供給客戶的建議是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當天或之後提供並不重要。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 19(2)(c), it does not matter whether a written statement given to a migration agent was given before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(2) 就第 19(2)(c) 段而言，向移民代理人提供的書面聲明是否是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當日或之後提供並不重要。
Duty relating to correcting false or misleading statements etc.
與糾正虛假或誤導性陳述等有關的職責
(3) For the purposes of section 21, it does not matter whether:
(3) 就第 21 條而言，下列情況並不重要：
(a) a statement made to a government official was made before, on or after 1 March 2022; or
(a) 向政府官員所做的聲明是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當天或之後做出的；或
(b) a document given to a government official was given before, on or after 1 March 2022; or
(b) 向政府官員提供的文件是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當天或之後提供的；或
(c) information concealed from a government official was concealed before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(c) 向政府官員隱瞞的資訊是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當天或之後隱瞞的。
Duty to notify Authority of misuse of MARN
通知當局濫用 MARN 的義務
(4) Subsection 25(4) applies to a migration agent becoming aware, on or after 1 March 2022, of a use of the agent’s MARN, whether the use occurred before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(4) 第 25(4) 款適用於移民代理在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後意識到其 MARN 的使用，無論該使用發生在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當日或之後。
Duties to notify Authority and clients of certain matters
向管理局和客戶通知某些事項的義務
(5) Section 28 applies to a change that occurs on or after 1 March 2022.
(5) 第 28 條適用於 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後發生的變更。
(6) If:
(6) 如果：
(a) on 1 March 2022, a migration agent is aware of a matter mentioned in paragraph 29(a) or (b); and
(a) 2022 年 3 月 1 日，移民代理人獲知第 29(a) 或 (b) 段所提及的事項；和
(b) the agent did not give written notice of the matter to the Authority before 1 March 2022;
(b) 代理人並未在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前向管理局發出有關此事的書面通知；
for the purposes of section 29, the migration agent is taken to become aware of the matter on 1 March 2022.
就第 29 條而言，移民代理應於 2022 年 3 月 1 日獲悉此事。
(7) Subsection 30(5) does not apply in relation to client money received by a migration agent, or a member of a migration agent’s business, before 1 March 2022 under a service agreement that requires the client money to be refunded or transferred if the agent’s registration is suspended.
(7) 第 30(5) 款不適用於移民代理或移民代理業務成員在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前根據服務協議收到的客戶資金，該服務協議要求在代理註冊被暫停的情況下退還或轉移客戶資金。
Duty to notify clients, Department and review authority if registration expected to lapse
如果註冊預計失效，有義務通知客戶、部門和審查機構
(8) If:
(8) 如果：
(a) on 1 March 2022, a migration agent is aware that it is reasonably likely that the agent will cease to be a registered migration agent on a day (the end day ) occurring after 1 March 2022; and
(a) 2022 年 3 月 1 日，移民代理意識到該代理人很可能會在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之後的某一天（結束日）不再擔任註冊移民代理；和
(b) the agent did not, before 1 March 2022, give written notice to:
(b) 代理人未在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前向下列人員發出書面通知：
(i) a client; or
(i) 客戶；或
(ii) the Department; or
(ii) 該部門；或
(iii) a review authority;
(iii) 審查機構；
that it was reasonably likely that the agent would cease to be a registered migration agent on the end day;
該代理人很可能在結束日不再是註冊移民代理人；
then, for the purposes of section 31, as it applies in relation to the client, the Department or the review authority, the migration agent is taken to become aware on 1 March 2022 that it is reasonably likely that the agent will cease to be a registered migration agent on the end day.
那麼，就第 31 條而言，當該條適用於客戶、移民部或審查機構時，移民代理被認為在 2022 年 3 月 1 日意識到該代理人很可能在結束日不再是註冊移民代理。
(9) Subsection 31(5) does not apply in relation to client money received by a migration agent, or a member of a migration agent’s business, before 1 March 2022 under a service agreement that requires the client money to be refunded or transferred if the agent ceases to be a registered migration agent.
(9) 第 31(5) 條不適用於移民代理或移民代理業務成員在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前根據服務協議收到的客戶資金，該服務協議要求如果代理不再是註冊移民代理，則需要退還或轉移客戶資金。
Duty to respond to requests from Authority
回應當局要求的責任
(10) Section 32 applies to requests made by the Authority on or after 1 March 2022.
(10) 第 32 條適用於管理局在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後提出的請求。

title: 61 Application of this instrument—the agent ‑ client relationship
zh: 61 本文書的應用－代理與客戶關係
text:
Duty to inform clients of conflicts of interest
告知客戶利益衝突的義務
(1) For the purposes of subsection 34(1), a written notice that:
(1) 就第 34(1) 款而言，書面通知：
(a) was given to a client before 1 March 2022; and
(a) 在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前提供給客戶；和
(b) meets the requirements of subsection 34(2);
(b) 符合第 34(2) 款的要求；
is taken to have been given under paragraph 34(1)(a).
被視為已根據第 34(1)(a) 段給出。
(2) For the purposes of subsection 34(1), a written statement that:
(2) 就第 34(1) 條而言，一份書面聲明：
(a) was given to a migration agent before 1 March 2022; and
(a) 在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前提供給移民代理；和
(b) meets the requirements of subparagraphs 34(1)(b)(i) and (ii);
(b) 符合第 34(1)(b)(i) 和 (ii) 項的要求；
is taken to have been given under paragraph 34(1)(b).
被視為已根據第 34(1)(b) 段給出。
Duty of confidentiality
保密義務
(3) Section 35 applies to disclosing information on or after 1 March 2022, whether the information was obtained before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(3) 第 35 條適用於 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後披露信息，無論該信息是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當日還是之後獲得。
Duty to give consumer guide to clients
向客戶提供消費指南的責任
(4) For the purposes of section 38, if a copy of the consumer guide has been given to a client it does not matter whether the copy was given before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(4) 就第 38 條而言，如果已向客戶提供消費者指南的副本，則該副本是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當日還是之後提供並不重要。
Service agreements
服務協定
(5) If a service agreement:
(5) 如果有服務協議：
(a) was in force immediately before 1 March 2022; and
(a) 於 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前生效；和
(b) met all applicable requirements of Schedule 2 to the Migration Agents Regulations 1998 , as in force immediately before 1 March 2022;
(b) 符合 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前生效的《1998 年移民代理條例》附表 2 的所有適用要求；
then:
那麼：
(c) for the purposes of subparagraph 42(1)(a)(iii) of this instrument, the service agreement is taken to comply with the requirements of Division 2 of Part 3; and
(c) 就本文書第 42(1)(a)(iii) 項而言，服務協議被視為符合第 3 部分第 2 節的要求；和
(d) paragraph 42(1)(b) does not apply in relation to a variation of the service agreement that occurred before 1 March 2022; and
(d) 第 42(1)(b) 段不適用於 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前發生的服務協議變更；和
(e) sections 46, 47 and 48 are taken to require only the following in relation to the service agreement:
(e) 第 46、47 和 48 條被認為僅要求與服務協議相關的以下內容：
(i) a responsible migration agent in relation to the service agreement must not charge fees, and must ensure that fees are not charged, for work or services performed under the agreement other than as provided for by the agreement;
(i) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理不得收取費用，並且必須確保不對根據協議執行的工作或服務收取費用，除非協議另有規定；
(ii) a responsible migration agent in relation to the service agreement must not unreasonably incur disbursements in relation to work or services performed under the agreement;
(ii) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理必須合理地支付與根據協議執行的工作或服務有關的費用；
(iii) a responsible migration agent in relation to the service agreement must not require a client to pay, and must ensure that a client is not required to pay, for a disbursement that will be incurred in relation to such work or services, other than in accordance with the agreement; and
(iii) 與服務協議相關的負責任的移民代理不得要求客戶支付，並且必須確保客戶不需要支付與此類工作或服務相關的費用，除非按照協議規定；和
(f) subsections 52(1) and (2) do not apply to the service agreement.
(f) 第 52(1) 及 (2) 款不適用於服務協議。
(6) Subsection (5) ceases to apply to the service agreement at the first time (if any) that the service agreement is varied on or after 1 March 2022.
(6) 在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後服務協議首次變更（如有）時，第 (5) 款不再適用於服務協議。
Invoices and receipts
發票和收據
(7) For the purposes of paragraph 49(a), it does not matter whether an itemised invoice given to a client was given before, on or after 1 March 2022.
(7) 就第 49(a) 段而言，提供給客戶的明細發票是在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前、當天或之後提供並不重要。
Duty in relation to client’s money
與客戶資金相關的責任
(8) Section 50 applies to client money received by a migration agent, or by a migration agent’s business, on or after 1 March 2022.
(8) 第 50 條適用於移民代理或移民代理業務在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後收到的客戶資金。
Duty to maintain client files
維護客戶檔案的責任
(9) Subsections 56(1) to (4), to the extent they relate to maintaining a client file, apply in relation to the following:
(9) 第 56(1) 至 (4) 款，在涉及維護客戶檔案的範圍內，適用於以下情況：
(a) a client file created before 1 March 2022 if action on the file occurs on or after 1 March 2022;
(a) 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前建立的客戶文件，如果對該文件採取的行動發生在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後；
(b) a client file created on or after 1 March 2022.
(b) 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後建立的客戶文件。
Termination notices
終止通知
(10) Subsection 57(5) does not apply in relation to client money received by a migration agent, or a member of a migration agent’s business, before 1 March 2022.
(10) 第 57(5) 條不適用於移民代理或移民代理業務成員在 2022 年 3 月 1 日之前收到的客戶資金。
Duty to forward correspondence relating to former client
轉發與前客戶有關的信件的義務
(11) Section 58 applies in relation to a migration agent ceasing to be a migration agent of a client on or after 1 March 2022.
(11) 第 58 條適用於在 2022 年 3 月 1 日或之後不再擔任客戶移民代理的移民代理。

title: Endnote 1—About the endnotes
text:
The endnotes provide information about this compilation and the compiled law.
尾註提供了有關本彙編和已彙編法律的資訊。
The following endnotes are included in every compilation:
每個彙編中都包含以下尾註：
Endnote 1—About the endnotes
尾註 1——關於尾註
Endnote 2—Abbreviation key
尾註 2——縮寫鍵
Endnote 3—Legislation history
尾註 3——立法歷史
Endnote 4—Amendment history
尾註 4——修改歷史
Abbreviation key—Endnote 2
縮寫鍵－尾註 2
The abbreviation key sets out abbreviations that may be used in the endnotes.
縮寫鍵列出了尾註中可能使用的縮寫。
Legislation history and amendment history—Endnotes 3 and 4
立法歷史和修訂歷史—尾註3和4
Amending laws are annotated in the legislation history and amendment history.
修改法律在立法史和修改史都有註釋。
The legislation history in endnote 3 provides information about each law that has amended (or will amend) the compiled law. The information includes commencement details for amending laws and details of any application, saving or transitional provisions that are not included in this compilation.
尾註 3 中的立法歷史提供了已修訂（或將修訂）法律彙編的每項法律的資訊。這些資訊包括修訂法律的開始細節以及本彙編中未包含的任何應用、保存或過渡條款的詳細資訊。
The amendment history in endnote 4 provides information about amendments at the provision (generally section or equivalent) level. It also includes information about any provision of the compiled law that has been repealed in accordance with a provision of the law.
尾註 4 中的修訂歷史記錄提供了有關條款（通常是章節或同等級別）級別修訂的資訊。它還包括有關已根據法律條款廢除的已編纂法律的任何條款的資訊。
Editorial changes
編輯修改
The Legislation Act 2003 authorises First Parliamentary Counsel to make editorial and presentational changes to a compiled law in preparing a compilation of the law for registration. The changes must not change the effect of the law. Editorial changes take effect from the compilation registration date.
《2003 年立法法》授權第一議會律師在準備登記法律彙編時對已彙編的法律進行編輯和表述上的修改。變更不得改變法律的效力。編輯修改自編譯註冊之日起生效。
If the compilation includes editorial changes, the endnotes include a brief outline of the changes in general terms. Full details of any changes can be obtained from the Office of Parliamentary Counsel.
如果彙編包含編輯性更改，則尾註包括通用術語更改的簡要概述。任何變更的完整細節可以從議會法律顧問辦公室獲得。
Misdescribed amendments
錯誤描述的修正案
A misdescribed amendment is an amendment that does not accurately describe how an amendment is to be made. If, despite the misdescription, the amendment can be given effect as intended, then the misdescribed amendment can be incorporated through an editorial change made under section 15V of the Legislation Act 2003 .
錯誤描述的修正案是指沒有準確描述如何進行修正案的修正案。儘管有錯誤描述，如果修正案能夠如預期生效，那麼可以根據《2003 年立法法》第 15V 條進行編輯修改，將錯誤描述的修正案納入其中。
If a misdescribed amendment cannot be given effect as intended, the amendment is not incorporated and “(md not incorp)” is added to the amendment history.
如果錯誤描述的修正案無法如預期生效，則該修正案不會被納入，並且「（md not incorp）」將添加到修正案歷史中。

zh: 附註 4 — 條文修訂沿革

title: 1 Name
text:
This instrument is the Migration Agents Regulations 2026 .
該文書就是《2026 年移民代理條例》。

title: 2 Commencement
text:
(1) Each provision of this instrument specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.
(1) 表中第 1 欄規定的本文書每項規定均依照表第 2 欄開始或被視為已開始。第 2 欄的任何其他聲明均按其條款有效。
