(2) A constable or Commonwealth officer who, under subsection 3ZQU(1) of the Crimes Act 1914 , may use or make available warrant material, is authorised to make available warrant material or warrant information:
(2) 根據《1914 年犯罪法》第 3ZQU(1) 款，警察或聯邦官員可以使用或提供逮捕令資料，並被授權提供逮捕令資料或逮捕令資訊：
(a) to a person covered by subsection (4); and
(a) 第(4)款所涵蓋的人；和
(b) for a purpose mentioned in subsection (3).
(b) 用於第(3)款所提及的目的。
(3) A person covered by subsection (4) is authorised to receive and use warrant material and warrant information, or make it available to another person covered by subsection (4), for the following purposes:
(3) 第 (4) 款所涵蓋的人員被授權接收和使用權證材料和權證訊息，或將其提供給第 (4) 款所涵蓋的其他人，用於以下目的：
(a) making a decision, or assisting in making a decision, to approve or refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen;
(a) 做出決定或協助做出決定，批准或拒絕批准某人成為澳洲公民；
(b) making a decision, or assisting in making a decision, to revoke a person’s Australian citizenship;
(b) 做出決定或協助做出決定，撤銷某人的澳洲公民身分；
(c) making a decision, or assisting in making a decision, to cancel an approval given to a person under section 24.
(c) 做出決定或協助做出決定，取消根據第 24 條給予某人的批准。
Note: Subsection 3ZQU(4) of the Crimes Act 1914 contemplates that another law of the Commonwealth may require or authorise the use or making available of a document or other thing to persons, or for purposes, in addition to those listed in subsection 3ZQU(1) of that Act.
註：《1914 年犯罪法》第 3ZQU(4) 小節考慮到，除了該法第 3ZQU(1) 小節中列出的目的之外，澳洲聯邦的另一項法律可能要求或授權向個人或出於其他目的使用或提供文件或其他物品。
(4) The following persons are covered by this subsection:
(4) 本款涵蓋以下人士：
(a) the Minister;
(a) 部長；
(b) the Secretary;
(b) 秘書；
(c) an APS employee in the Department whose duties include making decisions, or assisting in making decisions, in relation to Australian citizenship.
(c) 該部門的 APS 員工，其職責包括做出或協助做出與澳洲公民身分相關的決定。

title: 51B Reports to Parliament
text:
(1) As soon as practicable after a reporting period ends, the Minister must table a report in each House of the Parliament that sets out the number of applications made under section 36D to which both of the following apply:
(1) 報告期結束後，部長必須盡快向議會各院提交一份報告，列出根據第 36D 條提出的且適用以下兩項的申請數量：
(a) the applications were made during the reporting period to which the report relates or during an earlier reporting period;
(a) 申請是在與報告有關的報告期間內或在較早的報告期間內提出的；
(b) the applications relate to persons who, during the reporting period to which the report relates, were convicted and sentenced for one or more serious offences.
(b) 申請涉及在報告所涉報告期間因一項或多項嚴重罪行被定罪和判刑的人。
(2) The report must not contain information, or content of a document, if:
(2) 報告不得包含資訊或文件內容，如果：
(a) the information or content includes any operationally sensitive information (within the meaning of the Independent National Security Legislation Monitor Act 2010 ); or
(a) 資訊或內容包括任何操作敏感資訊（2010 年《獨立國家安全立法監測法》含義內）；或
(b) the disclosure of the information or content would or might prejudice:
(b) 資訊或內容的揭露將會或可能損害：
(i) the security, defence or international relations of Australia; or
(i) 澳洲的安全、國防或國際關係；或
(ii) the performance by a law enforcement or security agency (within the meaning of the Independent National Security Legislation Monitor Act 2010 ) of its functions; or
(ii) 執法或安全機構（根據《2010 年獨立國家安全立法監測法》）履行其職能；或
(c) the disclosure of the information or content would or might endanger a person’s safety; or
(c) 資訊或內容的揭露將或可能危及個人安全；或
(d) the disclosure of the information or content would be likely to be contrary to the public interest for any other reason.
(d) 資訊或內容的揭露可能因任何其他原因而違反公共利益。
(3) In this section:
(3) 本節：
reporting period means:
報告期間是指：
(a) the period of 12 months beginning on the day the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Citizenship Repudiation) Act 2023 commences; or
(a) 自《2023 年澳洲公民身份修正案（公民身份否認）法》生效之日起的 12 個月期間；或
(b) each subsequent 12 ‑ month period.
(b) 隨後的每個 12 個月期間。

title: 52 Review of decisions
text:
(1) An application may be made to the Administrative Review Tribunal for review of the following decisions:
(1)可以向行政復議庭申請複審下列決定：
(a) a decision under section 17 to refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen;
(a) 根據第 17 條拒絕批准某人成為澳洲公民的決定；
(aa) a decision under section 19D to refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen;
(aa) 根據第 19D 條拒絕批准某人成為澳洲公民的決定；
(b) a decision under section 24 to refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen;
(b) 根據第 24 條拒絕批准某人成為澳洲公民的決定；
(c) a decision under section 25 to cancel an approval given to a person under section 24;
(c) 根據第 25 條所做的取消根據第 24 條給予某人的批准的決定；
(d) a decision under section 30 to refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen again;
(d) 根據第 30 條拒絕批准某人再次成為澳洲公民的決定；
(e) a decision under section 33 to refuse to approve a person renouncing his or her Australian citizenship, except a refusal because of the operation of subsection 33(5) (about war);
(e) 根據第 33 條拒絕批准某人放棄澳洲公民身分的決定，但由於第 33(5) 條（關於戰爭）的實施而拒絕的除外；
(f) a decision under section 34 or subsection 36(1) to revoke a person’s Australian citizenship;
(f) 依第 34 條或第 36(1) 款作出撤銷某人澳洲公民身分的決定；
(g) a decision under section 37 to refuse to give a person a notice stating that the person is an Australian citizen at a particular time.
(g) 根據第 37 條決定拒絕在特定時間向某人發出表明該人是澳洲公民的通知。
Citizenship by conferral decision
透過授予決定獲得公民身份
(2) However, if:
(2) 但是，如果：
(a) the Minister makes a decision under section 24 to refuse to approve a person becoming an Australian citizen; and
(a) 部長根據第 24 條做出決定，拒絕批准某人成為澳洲公民；和
(b) the Minister’s reasons for the decision did not refer to the eligibility ground in subsection 21(8) (about statelessness); and
(b) 部長的決定理由並未提及第 21(8) 條（關於無國籍）中的資格理由；和
(c) the person was aged 18 or over at the time the person made the application to become an Australian citizen;
(c) 該人在申請成為澳洲公民時已年滿 18 歲；
a person (the applicant ) cannot apply for review of that decision unless the applicant is a permanent resident.
除非申請人是永久居民，否則個人（申請人）不能申請對該決定進行複審。
(3) For the purposes of the Administrative Review Tribunal reviewing a decision of a kind referred to in paragraph (1)(b):
(3) 就行政複審法庭複審第 (1)(b) 款所述的判決而言：
(a) the Tribunal must not exercise the power under subsection 22A(1A) or 22B(1A); and
(a) 仲裁庭不得行使第 22A(1A) 或 22B(1A) 款所規定的權力；和
(b) the Tribunal must not review any exercise of the power or any failure to exercise the power.
(b) 仲裁庭不得審查任何權力的行使或不行使權力的情況。

title: 53 Delegation
text:
(1) The Minister may, by writing, delegate to any person all or any of the Minister’s functions or powers under this Act or the regulations.
(1) 部長可以書面形式將本法或條例規定的部長的全部或任何職能或權力委託給任何人。
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply in relation to the function under subsection 23A(1) (about approval of citizenship test) or the power under section 36D (about application for citizenship cessation order).
(2) 但是，第 (1) 款不適用於第 23A(1) 款（關於批准公民身份測試）下的職能或第 36D 款（關於申請終止公民身份令）下的權力。

title: 54 Regulations
text:
The Governor ‑ General may make regulations prescribing matters:
總督可訂定規定以下事項的條例：
(a) required or permitted by this Act to be prescribed; or
(a) 本法要求或允許規定的；或
(b) necessary or convenient to be prescribed for carrying out or giving effect to this Act.
(b) 為執行或實施本法所必需或方便的規定。

title: Endnote 1—About the endnotes
text:
The endnotes provide information about this compilation and the compiled law.
尾註提供了有關本彙編和已彙編法律的資訊。
The following endnotes are included in every compilation:
每個彙編中都包含以下尾註：
Endnote 1—About the endnotes
尾註 1——關於尾註
Endnote 2—Abbreviation key
尾註 2——縮寫鍵
Endnote 3—Legislation history
尾註 3——立法歷史
Endnote 4—Amendment history
尾註 4——修改歷史
Abbreviation key—Endnote 2
縮寫鍵－尾註 2
The abbreviation key sets out abbreviations that may be used in the endnotes.
縮寫鍵列出了尾註中可能使用的縮寫。
Legislation history and amendment history—Endnotes 3 and 4
立法歷史和修訂歷史—尾註3和4
Amending laws are annotated in the legislation history and amendment history.
修改法律在立法史和修改史都有註釋。
The legislation history in endnote 3 provides information about each law that has amended (or will amend) the compiled law. The information includes commencement details for amending laws and details of any application, saving or transitional provisions that are not included in this compilation.
尾註 3 中的立法歷史提供了已修訂（或將修訂）法律彙編的每項法律的資訊。這些資訊包括修訂法律的開始細節以及本彙編中未包含的任何應用、保存或過渡條款的詳細資訊。
The amendment history in endnote 4 provides information about amendments at the provision (generally section or equivalent) level. It also includes information about any provision of the compiled law that has been repealed in accordance with a provision of the law.
尾註 4 中的修訂歷史記錄提供了有關條款（通常是章節或同等級別）級別修訂的資訊。它還包括有關已根據法律條款廢除的已編纂法律的任何條款的資訊。
Editorial changes
編輯修改
The Legislation Act 2003 authorises First Parliamentary Counsel to make editorial and presentational changes to a compiled law in preparing a compilation of the law for registration. The changes must not change the effect of the law. Editorial changes take effect from the compilation registration date.
《2003 年立法法》授權第一議會律師在準備登記法律彙編時對已彙編的法律進行編輯和表述上的修改。變更不得改變法律的效力。編輯修改自編譯註冊之日起生效。
If the compilation includes editorial changes, the endnotes include a brief outline of the changes in general terms. Full details of any changes can be obtained from the Office of Parliamentary Counsel.
如果彙編包含編輯性更改，則尾註包括通用術語更改的簡要概述。任何變更的完整細節可以從議會法律顧問辦公室獲得。
Misdescribed amendments
錯誤描述的修正案
A misdescribed amendment is an amendment that does not accurately describe how an amendment is to be made. If, despite the misdescription, the amendment can be given effect as intended, then the misdescribed amendment can be incorporated through an editorial change made under section 15V of the Legislation Act 2003 .
錯誤描述的修正案是指沒有準確描述如何進行修正案的修正案。儘管有錯誤描述，如果修正案能夠如預期生效，那麼可以根據《2003 年立法法》第 15V 條進行編輯修改，將錯誤描述的修正案納入其中。
If a misdescribed amendment cannot be given effect as intended, the amendment is not incorporated and “(md not incorp)” is added to the amendment history.
如果錯誤描述的修正案無法如預期生效，則該修正案不會被納入，並且「（md not incorp）」將添加到修正案歷史中。

title: Endnote 4—Amendment history
zh: 附註 4 — 條文修訂沿革

title: 1 Name
text:
This is the Australian Citizenship Regulation 2016 .
這是《2016 年澳洲公民身份條例》。

title: 3 Authority
text:
This instrument is made under the Australian Citizenship Act 2007 .
該文書是根據《2007 年澳大利亞公民法》制定的。

title: 5 Definitions
text:
In this instrument:
在本儀器中：
Act means the Australian Citizenship Act 2007 .
該法案是指《2007 年澳洲公民法案》。
Australian mission overseas means a diplomatic, consular or migration office maintained by or on behalf of the Commonwealth outside Australia.
澳洲海外使團是指由聯邦或代表聯邦在澳洲境外設立的外交、領事或移民辦事處。
Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption means the Convention on Protection of Children and Co ‑ operation in Respect of Intercountry Adoption , done at The Hague on 29 May 1993.
《跨國收養海牙公約》指 1993 年 5 月 29 日在海牙簽署的《跨國收養方面保護兒童及合作公約》。
Note: The Convention is in Australian Treaty Series 1998 No. 21 ([1998] ATS 21) and could in 2016 be viewed in the Australian Treaties Library on the AustLII website (http://www.austlii.edu.au).
註：該公約載於《澳洲條約彙編 1998 年第 21 號》([1998] ATS 21)，2016 年可在 AustLII 網站 (http://www.austlii.edu.au) 的澳洲條約圖書館中查看。
presiding officer means any of the following persons before whom a pledge of commitment may be made:
主持人是指可以在其面前做出承諾的任何以下人員：
(a) a person authorised under subsection 27(4) of the Act;
(a) 依該法第 27(4) 款授權的人；
(b) a person included in a class of persons authorised under subsection 27(5) of the Act.
(b) 屬於依該法第 27(5) 款授權的人員類別中的人員。

title: Part 2 — Australian citizenship
zh: 第 2 部 — 澳洲公民身分

title: 6 Registration under section 18 of the Act
zh: 6 依該法第 18 條進行登記
text:
For the purposes of section 18 of the Act, a person is registered by the Minister:
就該法第 18 條而言，一個人由部長登記：
(a) making a record of the fact that the person is an Australian citizen by descent; and
(a) 記錄該人是澳洲血統公民的事實；和
(b) including the record on a data storage system kept by the Department.
(b) 包括該部門保存的資料儲存系統上的記錄。

title: 6A Citizenship for persons adopted in accordance with the Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption or a bilateral arrangement
zh: 6A 根據《跨國收養海牙公約》或雙邊安排收養的人的公民身份
text:
(1) For the purposes of the definition of Bilateral Arrangements regulations in subsection 19C(4) of the Act, the Family Law (Bilateral Arrangements—Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 2023 are prescribed.
(1) 為了定義該法第 19C(4) 款中的雙邊安排條例，規定了 2023 年《家庭法（雙邊安排－跨國收養）條例》。
(2) For the purposes of the definition of Intercountry Adoption regulations in subsection 19C(4) of the Act, the Family Law (Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption) Regulations 1998 are prescribed.
(2) 為了該法第 19C(4) 款中跨國收養法規的定義，規定了 1998 年《家庭法（跨國收養海牙公約）條例》。

title: 7 Registration under section 19E of the Act
zh: 7 根據該法第 19E 條進行註冊
text:
For the purposes of section 19E of the Act, a person is registered by the Minister:
就該法第 19E 條而言，一個人由部長登記：
(a) making a record of the fact that the person is an Australian citizen by adoption in accordance with the Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption or a bilateral arrangement; and
(a) 根據《跨國收養海牙公約》或雙邊安排，記錄該人透過收養成為澳洲公民的事實；和
(b) including the record on a data storage system kept by the Department.
(b) 包括該部門保存的資料儲存系統上的記錄。

title: 8 Defence service requirement—prescribed visas
zh: 8 國防服役要求－規定簽證

title: 9 Prescribed reasons for failing to make pledge of commitment
zh: 9 未作出承諾的規定原因
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 25(3) of the Act, this section prescribes reasons for failing to make a pledge of commitment.
(1) 就該法第 25(3) 條而言，本節規定了未能做出承諾的原因。
(2) A person has a prescribed reason for failing to make a pledge of commitment if :
(2) 在下列情況下，一個人有規定的理由未能做出承諾：
(a) the person was prevented from making a pledge because the Minister has determined under subsection 26(3) of the Act that the person cannot make the pledge until the end of a specified period; and
(a) 由於部長根據該法第 26(3) 條確定此人在指定期限結束之前不能做出承諾，因此該人無法做出承諾；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the determination is in force, and the specified period has not yet ended; or
(i) 該決定已生效，且規定期限尚未結束；或
(ii) the determination has ceased to be in force or the specified period has ended, but the person has not yet had a reasonable period in which to make a pledge.
(ii) 該決定已不再有效或規定的期限已結束，但該人尚未有合理的期限作出承諾。
(3) Subject to subsection (5), a person has a prescribed reason for failing to make a pledge of commitment if:
(3) 根據第 (5) 款的規定，在下列情況下，一個人有未做出承諾保證的規定原因：
(a) the person could not make a pledge, either in Australia or at an Australian mission overseas, because during the period referred to in paragraph 25(3)(a) of the Act the person was overseas:
(a) 該人無法在澳洲或在澳洲海外使團做出承諾，因為在該法第 25(3)(a) 段所述期間，該人在海外：
(i) for medical treatment that was not available in Australia; or
(i) 澳洲無法提供的醫療；或
(ii) for any purpose, and was unexpectedly hospitalised; or
(ii) 為任何目的，意外住院；或
(iii) to care for a person who was critically ill; or
(iii) 照顧病重的人；或
(iv) for a funeral and other associated arrangements; and
(iv) 葬禮及其他相關安排；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the person still cannot make a pledge for the reason mentioned in paragraph (a); or
(i) 由於(a)段所述的原因，該人仍不能作出承諾；或
(ii) the person is now able to make a pledge, but the person has not yet had a reasonable period in which to do so.
(ii) 該人現在能夠做出承諾，但尚未有合理的期限做出承諾。
(4) Subject to subsection (5), a person has a prescribed reason for failing to make a pledge of commitment if:
(4) 根據第 (5) 款的規定，在下列情況下，一個人有未作出承諾保證的規定原因：
(a) the person could not make a pledge because of an administrative error or omission made by:
(a) 該人因下列人員的行政錯誤或遺漏而無法做出承諾：
(i) the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory; or
(i) 聯邦、州或地區；或
(ii) an authority of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory; or
(ii) 聯邦、州或地區的當局；或
(iii) a local government authority; and
(iii) 地方政府機構；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the person still cannot make a pledge for the reason mentioned in paragraph (a); or
(i) 由於(a)段所述的原因，該人仍不能作出承諾；或
(ii) the person is now able to make a pledge, but the person has not yet had a reasonable period in which to do so.
(ii) 該人現在能夠做出承諾，但尚未有合理的期限做出承諾。
(5) For the purposes of subsection (3) or (4), a person has a prescribed reason only if the person gives the Minister:
(5) 就第 (3) 或 (4) 款而言，只有當某人向部長提供以下資訊時，該人才有規定的理由：
(a) a signed statement to support the claim, including a description of any effort that the person made to make a pledge of commitment within the relevant period; and
(a) 支持該主張的簽署聲明，包括該人在相關期限內為做出承諾承諾所做的任何努力的描述；和
(b) written evidence that supports the statement.
(b) 支持該陳述的書面證據。

title: 10 Arrangements for making pledge of commitment
text:
For the purposes of subsection 27(2) of the Act, the arrangements are:
就該法案第 27(2) 款而言，安排是：
(a) the pledge of commitment must be made in public if it is reasonably practicable to do so; and
(a) 在合理可行的情況下，必須公開承諾；和
(b) the person before whom the pledge is made must read aloud the address specified in Schedule 1 to the person making the pledge.
(b) 承諾人必須向承諾人朗讀附表 1 所指定的地址。
Note: In addition to the arrangements that are required for the purposes of subsection 27(2) of the Act, the Department may notify arrangements for making a pledge of commitment, or conducting a ceremony, that are designed to impress upon applicants the responsibilities and privileges of Australian citizenship.
注意：除了該法第 27(2) 款所要求的安排外，該部門還可以通知做出承諾或舉行儀式的安排，旨在讓申請人牢記澳洲公民的責任和特權。

title: 11 Registration under section 31 of the Act
text:
For the purposes of section 31 of the Act, a person is registered by the Minister:
就該法第 31 條而言，一個人由部長登記：
(a) making a record of the fact that the person is an Australian citizen by resumption of citizenship; and
(a) 記錄該人透過恢復公民身份成為澳洲公民的事實；和
(b) including the record on a data storage system kept by the Department.
(b) 包括該部門保存的資料儲存系統上的記錄。

title: 12 Form of notice under subsection 37(3) of the Act
zh: 12 該法第 37(3) 款規定的通知形式
text:
(1) For the purposes of subsection 37(3) of the Act, a notice must be in accordance with the form in Schedule 2.
(1) 就該法第 37(3) 款而言，通知必須依照附表 2 的形式發出。
(2) The signature of the Minister on the notice may be a facsimile that is printed or stamped.
(2) 部長在通知上的簽名可以是列印或蓋章的傳真件。
(3) The signature of one or more presiding officers may be included on the notice.
(3) 通知中可以包含一名或多名主持人的簽名。
(3A) The signature of a presiding officer, if included on the notice, may be a facsimile that is printed or stamped.
(3A) 若通知包含主持人的簽名，則可以是列印或蓋章的傳真件。
(3B) A presiding officer whose signature appears on the notice need not be the presiding officer before whom the pledge of commitment was made by the person who is the subject of the notice.
(3B) 通知上簽名的主持官員不必是通知對象向其做出承諾保證的主持官員。
(4) The following information in relation to the person to whom the notice is given may be set out on the back of the notice:
(4) 通知背面可載明與通知接收人有關的以下資訊：
(a) the person’s name at the time of acquisition of Australian citizenship, if different from the person’s current name;
(a) 該人取得澳洲公民身分時的姓名（如果與該人目前的姓名不同）；
(b) the date of any notice of evidence of Australian citizenship previously given to the person;
(b) 先前向該人發出任何澳洲公民身分證明通知的日期；
(c) any other name in which a notice of evidence of Australian citizenship has previously been given to the person;
(c) 先前已向該人發出澳洲公民身分證明通知的任何其他姓名；
(d) any other date of birth in a notice of evidence of Australian citizenship previously given to the person.
(d) 先前向該人提供的澳洲公民身分證明通知中的任何其他出生日期。
Note: A notice given under section 37 of the Act is prima facie evidence of the matters in the notice (see subsection 37(5) of the Act).
註：根據該法第 37 條發出的通知是通知中事項的表面證據（參見該法第 37(5) 款）。
(5) If the back of the notice sets out any of the information referred to in subsection (4), the signature of the Minister (which may be a facsimile that is printed or stamped) must also be included on the back of the notice.
（5）如果通知的背面載有第（4）款中提到的任何信息，則部長的簽名（可以是打印或蓋章的傳真）也必須包含在通知的背面。

title: 13 Personal identifiers
Part 3 — Other matters
zh: 第 3 部 — 其他事項

title: 15 Application for replacement of evidence of Australian citizenship lost, destroyed or damaged due to a natural disaster
zh: 15 申請更換因天災遺失、毀損或損壞的澳洲公民身分證明
text:
(1) This section applies to an application under section 37 of the Act for evidence of Australian citizenship if:
(1) 本節適用於根據該法第 37 條提出的澳洲公民身分證據申請，如果：
(a) the application relates to the replacement of evidence of Australian citizenship that was lost, destroyed or damaged due to a natural disaster that is included on a list of natural disasters published by the Department on its website; and
(a) 該申請涉及更換因自然災害而丟失、毀壞或損壞的澳洲公民身份證據，該自然災害包含在該部門在其網站上公佈的自然災害清單中；和
(b) the application is made within 18 months of the date specified for the natural disaster on the list.
(b) 申請是在清單上指定的自然災害日期後 18 個月內提出的。
(2) For the purposes of paragraph 46(1)(c) of the Act, the application must be accompanied by the following:
(2) 就該法第 46(1)(c) 條而言，申請書必須附上以下內容：
(a) a statutory declaration stating that the evidence of Australian citizenship has been lost, destroyed or damaged due to the natural disaster;
(a) 一份法定聲明，說明澳洲公民身分的證據因自然災害而遺失、毀損或損壞；
(b) if the evidence of Australian citizenship is damaged—the damaged evidence of Australian citizenship.
(b) 如果澳洲公民身分的證據被損壞－被損壞的澳洲公民身分的證據。
Note: No fee is payable for an application to which this section applies (see Schedule 3).
註：適用本節的申請無需繳納任何費用（請參閱附表 3）。

title: 16 Fees to accompany applications
text:
For the purposes of paragraph 46(1)(d) of the Act, the fee to accompany an application under a provision of the Act is the amount set out in Schedule 3 to this instrument for the application.
就該法案第 46(1)(d) 段而言，根據該法案規定提出申請的費用為本文件附表 3 中規定的申請金額。

title: 17 Refund of fees under subsection 46(3) of the Act
zh: 17 依該法第 46(3) 款退還費用
text:
(1) The Minister may refund the whole or part of a fee that has been paid under section 46 of the Act in relation to an application made under section 16, 19C, 21 or 29 of the Act in any of the following circumstances:
(1) 在下列任何情況下，部長可退還根據該法第 46 條就根據該法第 16、19C、21 或 29 條提出的申請已支付的全部或部分費用：
(a) a person has previously made an application under the same section and a decision on that application has not been made;
(a) 某人曾根據同一節提出申請，但尚未就該申請作出決定；
(b) a person has made an application as a result of incorrect advice given by the Department;
(b) 某人因該部門提供的建議不正確而提出申請；
(c) a person is an Australian citizen;
(c) 某人是澳洲公民；
(d) a person has paid an incorrect fee.
(d) 某人支付了錯誤的費用。
(2) The Minister may refund the whole or part of a fee that has been paid under section 46 of the Act in relation to an application made under section 33 of the Act in either of the following circumstances:
(2) 在下列情況之一的情況下，部長可以退還根據該法第 46 條就根據該法第 33 條提出的申請已支付的全部或部分費用：
(a) a person has previously made an application under the same section and a decision on that application has not been made;
(a) 某人曾根據同一節提出申請，但尚未就該申請作出決定；
(b) a person has made an application as a result of incorrect advice given by the Department.
(b) 某人因該部門給予不正確的建議而提出申請。
(3) The Minister may refund the whole or part of a fee that has been paid under section 46 of the Act in relation to an application made under section 37 of the Act in any of the following circumstances:
(3) 在下列任何情況下，部長可退還根據該法第 46 條就根據該法第 37 條提出的申請已支付的全部或部分費用：
(a) a person has previously made an application under the same section and a decision on that application has not been made;
(a) 某人曾根據同一節提出申請，但尚未就該申請作出決定；
(b) a person has made an application as a result of incorrect advice given by the Department;
(b) 某人因該部門提供的建議不正確而提出申請；
(c) a person has already been given evidence of his or her Australian citizenship, but a Departmental error was made which resulted in an error in the information provided in the evidence.
(c) 某人已獲得其澳洲公民身分的證據，但由於部門錯誤而導致證據中提供的資訊出現錯誤。
(4) If a person:
(4) 如果一個人：
(a) made an application under section 21 of the Act; and
(a) 根據該法第 21 條提出申請；和
(b) claimed eligibility in that application on the basis of the criteria in subsection 21(2) of the Act; and
(b) 根據該法第 21(2) 款中的標準在該申請中聲稱符合資格；和
(c) paid the amount specified in item 13 of Schedule 3; and
(c) 支付附表 3 第 13 項規定的金額；和
(d) does not satisfy the criteria in subsection 21(2) of the Act because he or she did not sit a test as described in paragraph 21(2A)(a) of the Act;
(d) 不符合該法第 21(2) 款的標準，因為他或她沒有參加該法第 21(2A)(a) 款所述的考試；
the Minister may refund an amount equal to the difference between:
部長可以退還相當於以下兩者之間差額的金額：
(e) the amount specified in that item; and
(e) 該項目中指定的金額；和
(f) the amount specified in item 10 or 17 of Schedule 3, whichever is applicable.
(f) 附表 3 第 10 項或第 17 項規定的金額（以適用者為準）。
(6) If a person:
(6) 如果一個人：
(a) made an application under section 21 of the Act; and
(a) 根據該法第 21 條提出申請；和
(b) claimed eligibility in that application on the basis of the criteria in subsection 21(2) of the Act; and
(b) 根據該法第 21(2) 款中的標準在該申請中聲稱符合資格；和
(c) paid the amount specified in item 14 of Schedule 3; and
(c) 支付附表 3 第 14 項規定的金額；和
(d) does not satisfy the criteria in subsection 21(2) of the Act because he or she did not sit a test as described in paragraph 21(2A)(a) of the Act;
(d) 不符合該法第 21(2) 款的標準，因為他或她沒有參加該法第 21(2A)(a) 款所述的考試；
the Minister may refund an amount equal to the difference between:
部長可以退還相當於以下兩者之間差額的金額：
(e) the amount specified in that item; and
(e) 該項目中指定的金額；和
(f) the amount specified in item 16 or 18 of Schedule 3, whichever is applicable.
(f) 附表 3 第 16 項或第 18 項（以適用者為準）所規定的金額。

title: 18 Form of notice under section 47 of the Act
zh: 18 該法第 47 條規定的通知形式
text:
For the purposes of subsection 47(4) of the Act, the Minister must give notice of a decision under the Act by:
就該法案第 47(4) 款而言，部長必須透過以下方式發出該法案規定的決定通知：
(a) personal delivery; or
(a) 專人交付；或
(b) prepaid post to the last address given to the Department; or
(b) 預付郵資至該部門最後提供的地址；或
(c) electronic means.
(c) 電子方式。

title: Part 4 — Transitional arrangements
zh: 第 4 部 — 過渡安排

title: 19 Transitional provisions relating to the commencement of this instrument—applications made before commencement
zh: 19 本文生效相關的過渡性條款－生效前提出的申請
text:
(1) This section applies in relation to an application made under the Act and in accordance with the Australian Citizenship Regulations 2007 (the old regulations ) before 1 January 2017.
(1) 本條適用於 2017 年 1 月 1 日之前根據該法和《2007 年澳洲公民身份條例》（舊條例）提出的申請。
(2) The application is taken, on and after 1 January 2017, to have been made in accordance with this instrument.
(2) 2017 年 1 月 1 日及之後的申請被視為是根據本文書提出的。
(3) However, the following amounts are to be worked out in accordance with the old regulations as in force immediately before the start of 1 January 2017 (subject to any provisions of a transitional nature in those regulations):
(3) 但是，以下金額應按照 2017 年 1 月 1 日開始前有效的舊規定計算（須遵守這些規定中任何過渡性規定）：
(a) the amount of any fee payable in accordance with the old regulations in relation to the application;
(a) 根據舊條例與申請有關的任何費用的金額；
(b) the amount of any refund of such a fee.
(b) 此類費用的退款金額。

The amendment of section 16 made by Schedule 1 to the Home Affairs Legislation Amendment (2020 Measures No. 1) Regulations 2020 applies in relation to an application made on or after 1 July 2020.
《2020 年民政法例修訂（2020 年第 1 號措施）規例》附表 1 對第 16 條的修訂適用於 2020 年 7 月 1 日或之後提出的申請。

《2020 年民政法例修訂（2020 年第 2 號措施）規例》附表 3 對第 16 條的修訂適用於 2021 年 1 月 1 日或之後提出的申請。

text:
The amendments of sections 16 and 17 and Schedule 3 made by Schedules 5 and 6 to the Home Affairs Legislation Amendment (2021 Measures No. 1) Regulations 2021 apply in relation to an application under a provision of the Act made on or after 1 July 2021.
《2021 年民政立法修正案（2021 年第 1 號措施）條例》附表 5 和 6 對第 16 條和第 17 條以及附表 3 的修訂適用於 2021 年 7 月 1 日或之後根據該法條款提出的申請。

title: 29 Fee for applications for evidence of citizenship where certain applications for citizenship approved after 1 July 2021
zh: 29 某些公民身份申請在 2021 年 7 月 1 日之後獲得批准的公民身份證明申請費用
text:
(1) For the purposes of paragraph 46(1)(d) of the Act, the fee to accompany an application (the evidence application ) under section 37 of the Act is nil if:
(1) 就該法案第 46(1)(d) 段而言，在以下情況下，根據該法案第 37 條提出申請（證據申請）的費用為零：
(a) the applicant made an application under section 16 or 19C of the Act before 1 July 2021; and
(a) 申請人在 2021 年 7 月 1 日之前根據該法第 16 或 19C 條提出申請；和
(b) the Minister approves the applicant becoming an Australian citizen on or after 1 July 2021; and
(b) 部長批准申請人在 2021 年 7 月 1 日或之後成為澳洲公民；和
(c) the evidence application is made within the period:
(c) 證據申請是在以下期限內提出的：
(i) starting on 1 July 2021; and
(i) 自 2021 年 7 月 1 日起；和
(ii) ending 6 months after the day on which the Minister approves the applicant becoming an Australian citizen.
(ii) 在部長批准申請人成為澳洲公民之日後 6 個月結束。
(2) Section 16 does not apply to the evidence application.
(2) 第 16 條不適用於證據申請。

title: 30 Application of amendment made by Schedule 2 to the Home Affairs Legislation Amendment (2021 Measures No. 2) Regulations 2021
zh: 30 《2021 年民政法例修正案（2021 年第 2 號措施）條例》附表 2 修正案的適用

《2022 年民政法例修訂（2022 年第 1 號措施）規例》附表 1 對第 16 條和第 17 條的修訂適用於 2022 年 7 月 1 日或之後提出的申請。

title: 32 Application of amendment made by Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Translation Requirements for Applications) Regulations 2022
zh: 32 附表 1 第 1 部分對《2022 年澳洲公民權修正案（申請的翻譯要求）條例》的適用
text:
(1) The repeal of section 14 by Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Translation Requirements for Applications) Regulations 2022 applies in relation to an application made before the commencement of that Part if:
(1) 《2022 年澳洲公民身分修正案（申請的翻譯要求）條例》附表 1 第 1 部分第 14 條的廢除適用於該部分生效之前提出的申請，如果：
(a) a decision on the application had not been made before that commencement; or
(a) 在該生效日期之前尚未就該申請作出決定；或
(b) a decision on the application had been made before that commencement and one of the following applies:
(b) 在該生效日期之前已就該申請做出決定，且以下情況之一適用：
(i) as at that commencement, the time for making an application for review of the decision under section 52 of the Act has not ended;
(i) 截至該生效日期，依該法第 52 條提出複審決定申請的時間尚未結束；
(ii) as at that commencement, the decision is subject to a review under section 52 of the Act that has not been completed;
(ii) 自該生效之日起，該決定需根據該法第 52 條進行審查，但尚未完成；
(iii) before that commencement, the decision was remitted to the Minister following a review under section 52 of the Act, and the Minister has not, as at that commencement, reconsidered the decision.
(iii) 在該生效之前，根據該法第 52 條進行審查後，該決定已轉交給部長，並且截至該生效時，部長尚未重新考慮該決定。
(2) The repeal of section 14 by Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Australian Citizenship Amendment (Translation Requirements for Applications) Regulations 2022 also applies in relation to an application made on or after the commencement of that Part.
(2) 《2022 年澳洲公民身分修正案（申請的翻譯要求）條例》附表 1 第 1 部分對第 14 條的廢除也適用於該部分生效之日或之後提出的申請。

title: Schedule 1 — Preamble for citizenship ceremony
zh: 附表 1 — 公民入籍儀式的序言
text:
Note: See section 10.
註：請參閱第 10 節。
Australian citizenship represents full and formal membership of the community of the Commonwealth of Australia, and Australian citizenship is a common bond, involving reciprocal rights and obligations, uniting all Australians, while respecting their diversity.
澳洲公民身份代表了澳洲聯邦社區的正式和正式成員資格，澳洲公民身份是一種共同的紐帶，涉及互惠的權利和義務，將所有澳洲人團結在一起，同時尊重他們的多樣性。
Persons on whom Australian citizenship is conferred enjoy these rights and undertake to accept these obligations:
被授予澳洲公民身份的人享有這些權利並承諾接受這些義務：
(a) by pledging loyalty to Australia and its people;
(a) 宣誓效忠澳洲及其人民；
(b) by sharing their democratic beliefs;
(b) 分享他們的民主信仰；
(c) by respecting their rights and liberties; and
(c) 尊重他們的權利和自由；和
(d) by upholding and obeying the laws of Australia.
(d) 維護並遵守澳洲法律。

title: Endnote 1—About the endnotes
text:
The endnotes provide information about this compilation and the compiled law.
尾註提供了有關本彙編和已彙編法律的資訊。
The following endnotes are included in every compilation:
每個彙編中都包含以下尾註：
Endnote 1—About the endnotes
尾註 1——關於尾註
Endnote 2—Abbreviation key
尾註 2——縮寫鍵
Endnote 3—Legislation history
尾註 3——立法歷史
Endnote 4—Amendment history
尾註 4——修改歷史
Abbreviation key—Endnote 2
縮寫鍵－尾註 2
The abbreviation key sets out abbreviations that may be used in the endnotes.
縮寫鍵列出了尾註中可能使用的縮寫。
Legislation history and amendment history—Endnotes 3 and 4
立法歷史和修訂歷史—尾註3和4
Amending laws are annotated in the legislation history and amendment history.
修改法律在立法史和修改史都有註釋。
The legislation history in endnote 3 provides information about each law that has amended (or will amend) the compiled law. The information includes commencement details for amending laws and details of any application, saving or transitional provisions that are not included in this compilation.
尾註 3 中的立法歷史提供了已修訂（或將修訂）法律彙編的每項法律的資訊。這些資訊包括修訂法律的開始細節以及本彙編中未包含的任何應用、保存或過渡條款的詳細資訊。
The amendment history in endnote 4 provides information about amendments at the provision (generally section or equivalent) level. It also includes information about any provision of the compiled law that has been repealed in accordance with a provision of the law.
尾註 4 中的修訂歷史記錄提供了有關條款（通常是章節或同等級別）級別修訂的資訊。它還包括有關已根據法律條款廢除的已編纂法律的任何條款的資訊。
Editorial changes
編輯修改
The Legislation Act 2003 authorises First Parliamentary Counsel to make editorial and presentational changes to a compiled law in preparing a compilation of the law for registration. The changes must not change the effect of the law. Editorial changes take effect from the compilation registration date.
《2003 年立法法》授權第一議會律師在準備登記法律彙編時對已彙編的法律進行編輯和表述上的修改。變更不得改變法律的效力。編輯修改自編譯註冊之日起生效。
If the compilation includes editorial changes, the endnotes include a brief outline of the changes in general terms. Full details of any changes can be obtained from the Office of Parliamentary Counsel.
如果彙編包含編輯性更改，則尾註包括通用術語更改的簡要概述。任何變更的完整細節可以從議會法律顧問辦公室獲得。
Misdescribed amendments
錯誤描述的修正案
A misdescribed amendment is an amendment that does not accurately describe how an amendment is to be made. If, despite the misdescription, the amendment can be given effect as intended, then the misdescribed amendment can be incorporated through an editorial change made under section 15V of the Legislation Act 2003 .
錯誤描述的修正案是指沒有準確描述如何進行修正案的修正案。儘管有錯誤描述，如果修正案能夠如預期生效，那麼可以根據《2003 年立法法》第 15V 條進行編輯修改，將錯誤描述的修正案納入其中。
If a misdescribed amendment cannot be given effect as intended, the amendment is not incorporated and “(md not incorp)” is added to the amendment history.
如果錯誤描述的修正案無法如預期生效，則該修正案不會被納入，並且「（md not incorp）」將添加到修正案歷史中。

title: 3 Simplified outline of this Act
text:
A large number of Acts and legislative instruments allow people to apply to the Administrative Review Tribunal for review of decisions made under them. The Tribunal is established to review these decisions (known as reviewable decisions).
許多法案和立法文件允許人們向行政複審法庭申請複審根據其所做的決定。設立仲裁庭是為了審查這些決定（稱為可審查決定）。
The Tribunal has a President, Deputy Presidents, senior members and general members. There is also a Principal Registrar and staff. This Act deals with their appointment, functions and terms and conditions.
法庭有庭長、副庭長、高級成員和普通成員。還有一名首席書記官和工作人員。該法涉及他們的任命、職能以及條款和條件。
This Act contains the standard provisions applying to Tribunal processes. Other legislation can include provisions that apply in addition to, or instead of, these standard provisions.
本法包含適用於法庭程序的標準條款。其他立法可以包括除這些標準條款之外或替代這些標準條款而適用的條款。
Broadly, a Tribunal process for review of a reviewable decision includes the following stages:
概括地說，仲裁庭審查可審查決定的程序包括以下階段：
(a) a person whose interests are affected by a reviewable decision applies to the Tribunal for review;
(a) 利益受到可覆核決定影響的人向仲裁庭申請覆核；
(b) the applicant, the decision ‑ maker and potentially other persons become parties to the proceeding for the review;
(b) 申請人、決策者和可能的其他人成為審查程序的當事人；
(c) the President constitutes the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding by deciding which member or members will exercise the Tribunal’s powers for the proceeding;
(c) 庭長為了程序的目的而組成仲裁庭，決定由哪位或哪些成員行使仲裁庭的訴訟權；
(d) the Tribunal conducts the proceeding, including obtaining evidence and holding hearings, directions hearings and dispute resolution processes;
(d) 仲裁庭進行訴訟程序，包括取得證據並舉行聽證會、指示聽證會及爭議解決程序；
(e) the Tribunal makes its decision.
(e) 仲裁庭作出裁決。
Tribunal powers in relation to the proceeding are exercised by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of the proceeding or, in some circumstances by the President or by members, the Principal Registrar, registrars and staff members authorised by the President.
與訴訟程序相關的法庭權力由為訴訟目的而組建的法庭行使，或者在某些情況下由庭長或庭長、首席書記官長、書記官長和庭長授權的工作人員行使。
The Tribunal reviews decisions on their merits. It may affirm, vary or set aside a decision ‑ maker’s decision. If the Tribunal sets aside a decision, it may make a substitute decision or remit the matter to the decision ‑ maker to reconsider as ordered or recommended by the Tribunal.
法庭根據案情審查裁決。它可以肯定、改變或擱置決策者的決定。如果仲裁庭擱置某項決定，則可以根據仲裁庭的命令或建議做出替代決定或將事項移交決策者重新考慮。
After the Tribunal makes its decision:
仲裁庭作出裁決後：
(a) in some circumstances, a party may apply to refer the matter to the guidance and appeals panel for another review; and
(a) 在某些情況下，一方可申請將此事提交指導和上訴小組再次審查；和
(b) a party may appeal to the Federal Court, on a question of law, from the Tribunal’s decision.
(b) 一方當事人可以就法庭的裁決向聯邦法院提出法律問題上訴。
Special rules apply when the Tribunal’s powers in relation to a proceeding are exercised in the Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area. This occurs if the proceeding relates to an intelligence and security decision or the President otherwise directs (for example where the President is satisfied national security information would be involved).
當法庭在情報和安全管轄範圍內行使與訴訟有關的權力時，適用特殊規則。如果訴訟涉及情報和安全決定或總統另有指示（例如，總統確信將涉及國家安全資訊），就會發生這種情況。
There are requirements for decision ‑ makers in relation to giving notice of decisions and review rights and providing statements of reasons. These apply whether or not an application has been made to the Tribunal for review of the decision.
對決策者提出了有關發出決定通知和審查權利以及提供理由說明的要求。無論是否已向仲裁庭提出複審決定的申請，這些規定均適用。
This Act also establishes the Administrative Review Council, with functions relating to the Commonwealth administrative law system. The Council consists of the President, the Commonwealth Ombudsman, the Australian Information Commissioner and other members appointed by the Governor ‑ General. This Act deals with the appointed members’ appointment, functions and terms and conditions.
該法也設立了行政審查委員會，其職能與聯邦行政法律體係有關。該委員會由總統、聯邦監察員、澳洲資訊專員和總督任命的其他成員組成。本法涉及指定成員的任命、職能以及條款和條件。

title: 4 Definitions
text:
In this Act:
在本法案中：
accessible , in relation to the Tribunal, means enables persons to apply to the Tribunal and to participate effectively in proceedings in the Tribunal.
就法庭而言，「無障礙」是指使人們能夠向法庭提出申請並有效參與法庭訴訟程序。
Note: Examples of areas where arrangements may be made in relation to accessibility include the following:
註：可做出與無障礙相關的安排的領域範例包括：
(a) premises, facilities and technology;
(a) 場地、設施和技術；
(b) ease of locating and understanding information about the Tribunal and documents relating to proceedings;
(b) 易於找到和理解有關法庭的資訊以及與訴訟程序有關的文件；
(c) adjustments that can reasonably be made to accommodate a person’s needs, such as interpreter services for hearings.
(c) 可以合理地進行調整以滿足個人的需要，例如聽證會的口譯服務。

(b) 依第 239 條向法庭提供服務的人。
statement of reasons , for a decision, means a written statement in relation to the decision that:
對於決定而言，理由陳述是指與該決定相關的書面陳述：
(a) sets out the findings on material questions of fact; and
(a) 列出關於重大事實問題的調查結果；和
(b) refers to the evidence or other material on which the findings are based; and
(b) 指調查結果所依據的證據或其他資料；和
(c) explains the reasons for the decision.
(c) 解釋該決定的理由。
State or Territory government entity means:
州或領地政府實體是指：
(a) a Department of a State or Territory; or
(a) 州或地區的一個部門；或
(b) a body (whether incorporated or not) established for a public purpose by or under a law of a State or Territory.
(b) 由州或領地法律或根據州或領地法律為公共目的設立的機構（無論是否成立）。
Tribunal means the Administrative Review Tribunal established by section 8.
法庭是指依第 8 條設立的行政復議法庭。
Tribunal Advisory Committee means the Tribunal Advisory Committee established by section 236.
仲裁庭諮詢委員會是指依第 236 條設立的仲裁庭諮詢委員會。
Tribunal case event , in relation to a proceeding in the Tribunal, means:
與法庭訴訟相關的法庭案件事件是指：
(a) the hearing, or part of the hearing, of the proceeding; or
(a) 訴訟的聽證會或聽證會的一部分；或
(b) a directions hearing, or part of a directions hearing, in relation to the proceeding; or
(b) 與訴訟相關的指示聽證會或指示聽證會的一部分；或
(c) a dispute resolution process, or part of a dispute resolution process, under Subdivision C of Division 6 of Part 4 in relation to the proceeding.
(c) 爭議解決程序或爭議解決程序的一部分，根據第 4 部分第 6 部分 C 分節與此程序相關。
Tribunal guidance decision : see subsection 109(1).
仲裁庭指導決定：參閱第 109(1) 款。

title: 5 Other Acts can change how some provisions in this Act apply
zh: 5 其他法案可能會改變本法案中某些條款的適用方式
text:
General rules
一般規則
(1) The application of a provision of this Act is subject to a contrary intention in another Act.
(1) 本法某條款的適用受到另一法相反意圖的約束。
Note: For example, the Act under which a reviewable decision is made may contain provisions that apply to review of the decision in addition to, or instead of, provisions in this Act.
註：例如，作出可審查決定所依據的法案可能包含適用於對決定進行審查的規定，以補充或代替本法中的規定。
(2) If an Act provides that an instrument made under that Act can contain provisions that apply:
(2) 如果一項法案規定根據該法案製定的文書可以包含適用的條款：
(a) in addition to; or
(a) 另外；或
(b) instead of; or
(b) 代替；或
(c) contrary to;
(c) 違背；
this Act, the application of a provision of this Act is subject to a contrary intention in the instrument.
在本法中，本法某條款的適用受到文書中相反意圖的約束。
Note: Instruments may contain provisions that apply to review of a reviewable decision in addition to, or instead of, provisions in this Act if that is permitted by the Act under which the instrument is made.
註：如果制定文書所依據的法案允許，文書可以包含適用於審查可審查決定的條款，以補充或代替本法中的規定。
Exceptions
例外情況
(3) However, subsections (1) and (2) do not apply in relation to:
(3) 但是，第 (1) 及 (2) 款不適用於：
(a) Part 2 (establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal); or
(a) 第 2 部分（設立行政複審法庭）；或
(b) Part 8 (members and staff of Tribunal); or
(b) 第 8 部分（法庭成員和工作人員）；或
(c) Part 9 (Administrative Review Council).
(c) 第 9 部分（行政審查委員會）。

title: 6 Extension to external Territories
text:
This Act extends to the external Territories.
該法適用於外部領土。

title: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal
zh: 第 2 部 — 行政覆核審裁處的設立
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal

title: Division 1 — Preliminary
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal

title: 7 Simplified outline of this Part
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal
text:
The Administrative Review Tribunal is established with the objective of providing an independent mechanism of review.
設立行政複審法庭的目的是提供獨立的複審機制。
The Tribunal consists of the President, Deputy Presidents, senior members and general members. The President and Judicial Deputy Presidents are Judges. For detail relating to appointments and roles, see Divisions 2 and 3 of Part 8.
法庭由庭長、副庭長、高級成員和一般成員組成。院長和司法副院長由法官擔任。有關任命和角色的詳細信息，請參閱第 8 部分的第 2 節和第 3 節。
The Tribunal also has a Principal Registrar and staff. For detail regarding management of the Tribunal, see Part 8.
法庭還設有首席書記官長和工作人員。有關仲裁庭管理的詳細信息，請參閱第 8 部分。

title: Division 2 — Establishment of Tribunal
zh: 第 2 分部 — 仲裁庭的設立
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal

title: 8 Establishment
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal
text:
The Administrative Review Tribunal is established by this section.
依本條設立行政復議庭。

title: 9 Objective
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal
text:
The Tribunal must pursue the objective of providing an independent mechanism of review that:
法庭必須追求提供獨立審查機制的目標：
(a) is fair and just; and
(a) 公平、公正；和
(b) ensures that applications to the Tribunal are resolved as quickly, and with as little formality and expense, as a proper consideration of the matters before the Tribunal permits; and
(b) 確保向法庭提出的申請在法庭允許的情況下，以盡可能少的手續和費用盡快得到解決；和
(c) is accessible and responsive to the diverse needs of parties to proceedings; and
(c) 易於取得並滿足訴訟當事人的不同需求；和
(d) improves the transparency and quality of government decision ‑ making; and
(d) 提高政府決策的透明度和品質；和
(e) promotes public trust and confidence in the Tribunal.
(e) 增進公眾對法庭的信任與信心。

title: 10 Members of Tribunal
path: Part 2 — Establishment of Administrative Review Tribunal
text:
(1) The Tribunal consists of the following members:
(1) 仲裁庭由下列成員組成：
(a) the President;
(a) 主席；
(b) Deputy Presidents;
(b) 副主席；
(c) senior members;
(c) 資深成員；
(d) general members.
(d) 一般成員。
(2) A Judge who is to be appointed as a member must be appointed as the President or as a Judicial Deputy President.
(2) 被任命為成員的法官必須被任命為院長或司法副院長。

title: Part 3 — Starting a review
zh: 第 3 部 — 啟動覆核

title: 11 Simplified outline of this Part
text:
A large number of Acts and legislative instruments allow people to apply to the Tribunal for review of decisions made under them.
許多法案和立法文件允許人們向法庭申請審查根據其做出的決定。
A person whose interests are affected by a reviewable decision may apply to the Tribunal for review of the decision. Timeframes apply to applications, but may be extended in some circumstances.
利益受到可審查決定影響的人可以向法庭申請對該決定進行審查。期限適用於申請，但在某些情況下可能會延長。
If a person applies for review of a decision, the person and the decision ‑ maker are parties to the proceeding for the review. Other people whose interests are affected by the decision may apply to the Tribunal to become a party.
如果某人申請對某項決定進行複審，則該人和決策者都是複審程序的當事人。利益受到該決定影響的其他人可以向仲裁庭申請成為當事人。
For the purposes of the review of a decision, the decision ‑ maker must generally give copies of a statement of reasons for the decision and relevant documents to the Tribunal and the other parties to the proceeding for the review.
為了審查決定，決策者通常必須向仲裁庭和訴訟程序的其他當事人提供決定理由說明和相關文件的副本，以供審查。
An application for review of a decision does not affect the operation of the decision unless the Tribunal orders otherwise.
除非仲裁庭另有命令，否則申請複審決定並不影響該決定的實施。
This Part contains the standard provisions for these matters. Other legislation can include provisions that apply in addition to, or instead of, these standard provisions.
本部分包含這些事項的標準規定。其他立法可以包括除這些標準條款之外或替代這些標準條款而適用的條款。
Part 10 contains other provisions assisting persons affected by decisions. These deal with when decision ‑ makers are required to give notice of decisions and review rights and provide statements of reasons.
第 10 部分包含為受決策影響的人提供協助的其他條款。這些涉及何時要求決策者發出決定通知和審查權利並提供理由說明。

title: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
zh: 第 2 分部 — 決策審查的關鍵概念
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions

title: 12 Reviewable decisions
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
text:
(1) A decision is a reviewable decision if an Act or a legislative instrument provides for an application to be made to the Tribunal for review of the decision.
(1) 如果一項法案或立法文書規定向法庭提出申請以審查該決定，則該決定是可審查的決定。
Note: To find out whether a decision is a reviewable decision, start by looking at the Act or legislative instrument under which the decision is made.
注意：要了解某項決定是否為可審查的決定，請先查看做出該決定所依據的法案或立法文件。
(2) In addition, if an Act or a legislative instrument provides for an application to be made to the Tribunal for review of a decision of a person under a power, a decision under the power is a reviewable decision , whether or not it is made by the person.
(2) 此外，如果一項法案或立法文書規定向法庭提出申請，以審查有權人的決定，則該權力人的決定是可審查的決定，無論該決定是否由該人做出。
Note: Under subsection (2), the decision is a reviewable decision even if made by a person who is not authorised to make the decision.
註：根據第 (2) 款，即使該決定是由無權做出決定的人做出的，也是可審查的決定。

title: 13 Instruments may provide for application to Tribunal for review
zh: 13 文件可規定向仲裁庭申請審查
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
text:
(1) A legislative instrument may provide for an application to be made to the Tribunal for review of a decision made under the instrument.
(1) 立法文書可規定向法庭提出申請，要求審查依該文書所做的決定。
(2) Subsection (1) does not limit any other Act or instrument made under an Act.
(2) 第 (1) 款不限制任何其他法案或依法案製定的文書。

title: 14 Decision ‑ maker
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The decision ‑ maker for a decision is the person who makes the decision.
(1) 決策的決策者是做出決策的人。
Note: For when Tribunal decisions are taken to be made by the decision ‑ maker, see subsection 108(2).
註：有關仲裁庭決定何時由決策者做出的信息，請參閱第 108(2) 款。
Exception—person ceases to hold office, appointment or position
例外－人員不再擔任職務、任命或職位
(2) Despite subsection (1), if:
(2) 儘管有第(1)款的規定，如果：
(a) a person makes a decision as the holder or occupier of an office, appointment or position; and
(a) 一個人作為職位、任命或職位的持有者或占有者做出決定；和
(b) the person ceases to hold or occupy the office, appointment or position;
(b) 該人不再擔任或擔任職務、任命或職位；
the decision ‑ maker for the decision is:
該決定的決策者是：
(c) the person who holds or occupies the office, appointment or position; or
(c) 擔任或擔任職務、任命或職位的人；或
(d) if there is no person who holds or occupies the office, appointment or position—the person specified by the President.
(d) 如果沒有人擔任或佔據該職位、任命或職位－總統指定的人。
Exception—any other circumstance
例外——任何其他情況
(3) If subsections (1) and (2) do not apply in relation to a decision, the decision ‑ maker for the decision is the person specified by the President.
(3) 如果第(1)和(2)款不適用於某項決定，則該決定的決策者是總統指定的人。
Specifying a decision ‑ maker
指定決策者
(4) The President must not specify a person under paragraph (2)(d) or subsection (3) unless the President considers that the person is the person most able to satisfy the requirements imposed by this Act on decision ‑ makers of reviewable decisions.
(4) 總統不得根據第(2)(d)款或第(3)款指定某人，除非總統認為該人是最有能力滿足本法對可審查決定的決策者提出的要求的人。
(5) If the President specifies the person in writing, the specification is not a legislative instrument.
(5) 若總統以書面指定該人，則該指定不屬於立法文書。
Extension—unincorporated decision ‑ maker is treated as if it were a person
擴展－非法人決策者被視為一個人
(6) If a board, committee or other unincorporated body constituted by 2 or more persons is empowered by an Act or an instrument made under an Act to make a decision, this Act applies as if that board, committee or other body were a person empowered to make the decision.
(6) 如果由 2 人或 2 人以上組成的董事會、委員會或其他非法人機構被一項法案或根據一項法案製定的文書授權做出決定，則本法適用，如同該董事會、委員會或其他機構是被授權做出決定的人一樣。
Clarification—decisions made by delegates
澄清——代表們所做的決定
(7) Subject to this Act, if an Act or an instrument made under an Act confers power on a person or body (the authority ) to delegate a function or power in relation to a decision, a function or power so delegated, when performed or exercised by the delegate, is, for the purposes of this Act, taken to have been performed or exercised by the authority.
(7) 根據本法，如果一項法案或根據該法案製定的文書授予個人或機構（當局）委託與決定有關的職能或權力的權力，則就本法而言，當由代表執行或行使時，被委託的職能或權力應被視為已由當局履行或行使。

title: 15 Organisation or association whose interests are affected by a decision
zh: 15 其利益受到決策影響的組織或協會
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
text:
An organisation or association of persons, whether incorporated or not, is taken to be a person whose interests are affected by a decision if:
組織或團體，無論是否成立，如果滿足以下條件，則被視為其利益受到決定影響的人：
(a) the decision relates to a matter included in the objects or purposes of the organisation or association at the time the decision is made; and
(a) 決定涉及做出決定時組織或協會的目標或宗旨中包含的事項；和
(b) the matter has not been removed from the objects or purposes of the organisation or association.
(b) 該事項並未脫離該組織或協會的目標或宗旨。

title: 16 Decision is taken to be made if timeframe expires
path: Division 2 — Key concepts for review of decisions
text:
If:
如果：
(a) a decision of a person not to do a thing is a reviewable decision; and
(a) 一個人不做某件事的決定是可審查的決定；和
(b) an Act or an instrument made under an Act provides for a quantified period within which the person is required or permitted to do the thing; and
(b) 一項法案或根據該法案製定的文書規定了要求或允許該人做某事的量化期限；和
(c) the person does not do the thing within the period;
(c) 該人沒有在期限內做該事；
the person is taken, for the purposes of this Act and the Act or instrument that provides for an application to be made to the Tribunal for review of the decision, to have made a decision at the end of the period not to do the thing.
就本法以及規定向法庭提出申請以審查該決定的法案或文書而言，該人被視為在期限結束時做出了不做某事的決定。
Note: If there is no quantified period within which the person is required or permitted to do the thing, see section 10 of the Ombudsman Act 1976 .
注意：如果沒有要求或允許該人做某事的量化期限，請參閱《1976 年監察員法》第 10 條。

title: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision
zh: 第 3 分部 — 申請覆核決定
path: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision

title: 17 Who can apply
path: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision
text:
(1) A person whose interests are affected by a reviewable decision may apply to the Tribunal for review of the decision.
(1) 其利益受到可覆核決定影響的人可以向仲裁庭申請覆核該決定。
Note 1: For which decisions are reviewable decisions, see section 12.
註 1：對於哪些決定是可審查的決定，請參閱第 12 節。
Note 2: For when an organisation’s or association’s interests are taken to be affected, see section 15.
註 2：當組織或協會的利益被視為受到影響時，請參閱第 15 節。
Note 3: Section 173 provides a right of appeal to the Federal Court if the Tribunal decides that a person’s interests are not affected by a reviewable decision.
註 3：第 173 條規定，如果法院裁定某人的利益不受可重複決定的影響，則有權向聯邦法院提出上訴。
(2) To avoid doubt, a person may apply even if the person is the Commonwealth or an authority, tribunal or other body (whether incorporated or not) that is established by an Act or an instrument made under an Act.
(2) 為避免疑義，即使該人是聯邦或根據法案或根據法案製定的文書設立的當局、法庭或其他機構（無論是否成立），也可以提出申請。

title: 18 When to apply—general rule
path: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision
text:
(1) An application to the Tribunal for review of a decision must be made within the period prescribed by the rules.
(1) 向仲裁庭申請覆核決定必須在規則規定的期限內提出。
Note: The legislation under which a reviewable decision is made may specify a different period for applying for review of that type of decision.
註：作出可複審決定所依據的立法可能規定申請對該類型決定進行複審的不同期限。
(2) Subsection (1) is subject to section 19 (exception—Tribunal may extend period).
(2) 第 (1) 款受第 19 條的約束（例外情況－仲裁庭可以延長期限）。
(3) Rules made for the purposes of subsection (1) must not prescribe a period ending before the day that is 28 days after the day the decision is made.
(3) 為第 (1) 款目的而製定的規則不得規定在決定作出之日後 28 天之前結束的期限。
(4) Rules made for the purposes of subsection (1) may prescribe different periods for different classes of application.
(4) 為第(1)款目的而製定的規則可以對不同類別的申請規定不同的期限。

title: 19 Exception—Tribunal may extend period
zh: 19 例外－仲裁庭可以延長期限
path: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision
text:
Application to extend period
申請延長期限
(1) A person (the applicant ) may apply to the Tribunal to extend the period during which the applicant may apply to the Tribunal for review of a decision.
(1) 個人（申請人）可以向仲裁庭申請延長申請人向仲裁庭申請複審決定的期限。
(2) The Tribunal may, by order, extend the period if the Tribunal considers that it is reasonable in all the circumstances to do so.
(2) 如果仲裁庭認為在所有情況下都這樣做都是合理的，仲裁庭可以透過命令延長期限。
(3) The Tribunal may extend the period even if it has expired.
(3) 即使期限已屆滿，仲裁庭也可以延長此期限。
Exception—where reinstatement is available or has been refused
例外情況－可以恢復或已被拒絕
(4) The Tribunal must not extend the period if:
(4) 在下列情況下，仲裁庭不得延長期限：
(a) section 102 permits the applicant to apply to the Tribunal to reinstate an application by the applicant for review of the decision; or
(a) 第 102 條允許申請人向仲裁庭申請恢復申請人對決定進行複審的申請；或
(b) the Tribunal refuses an application by the applicant under section 102 to reinstate an application for review of the decision.
(b) 仲裁庭拒絕申請人依第 102 條提出的恢復複審決定申請的申請。
Notice to affected persons may be required
可能需要通知受影響的人
(5) The Tribunal may:
(5) 仲裁庭可以：
(a) give notice of the application to extend the period (the extension application ); or
(a) 發出延長期限申請的通知（延期申請）；或
(b) require the applicant to give notice of the extension application;
(b) 要求申請人發出延期申請通知；
to any other person the Tribunal considers is affected by the extension application.
仲裁庭認為受到延期申請影響的任何其他人。
Affected persons may oppose extension application
受影響人可以反對延期申請
(6) A person notified under subsection (5) may notify the Tribunal within 14 days that the person wishes to oppose the extension application.
(6) 依第 (5) 款通知的人可以在 14 天內通知仲裁庭其希望反對延期申請。
(7) If a person notifies the Tribunal under subsection (6), the Tribunal must not extend the period unless the Tribunal has given the applicant and any person who notified the Tribunal under subsection (6) a reasonable opportunity to adduce evidence and make submissions to the Tribunal in relation to the extension.
(7) 若某人依據第 (6) 款通知仲裁庭，仲裁庭不得延長期限，除非仲裁庭已給予申請人及依第 (6) 款通知仲裁庭的任何人合理的機會舉證並向仲裁庭就延期提出意見。

title: 20 Exception—no prescribed period applies
zh: 20 例外情況－無規定期限適用
path: Division 3 — Applying for review of decision
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) an application for review of a decision is made to the Tribunal; and
(a) 向仲裁庭提出複審決定的申請；和
(b) the application is not required by law to be made within any particular period; and
(b) 法律不要求在任何特定期限內提出申請；和
(c) the Tribunal considers that the application was not made within a reasonable time after the making of the decision;
(c) 仲裁庭認為申請不是在作出決定後的合理時間內提出的；
the Tribunal must dismiss the application.
仲裁庭必須駁回該申請。
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply if the Tribunal considers that there are special circumstances that justify the Tribunal reviewing the decision.
(2) 但是，如果仲裁庭認為有特殊情況，證明仲裁庭有理由複審該決定，則第 (1) 款不適用。
(3) In considering the matter in paragraph (1)(c):
(3) 在考慮第 (1)(c) 款的問題時：
(a) the Tribunal must have regard to the following:
(a) 仲裁庭必須考慮下列事項：
(i) the time at which the applicant became aware of the making of the decision;
(i) 申請人得知作出決定的時間；
(ii) if the application would have been required by law to be made within a particular period if the application had been made by someone other than the applicant—that period; and
(ii) 如果申請是由申請人以外的其他人提出的，則法律要求該申請必須在特定期限內提出－該期限；和
(b) the Tribunal may have regard to any other matters that it considers relevant.
(b) 仲裁庭可考慮其認為相關的任何其他事項。

title: Division 4 — After an application is made
zh: 第 4 分部 — 提出申請後
path: Division 4 — After an application is made

title: Subdivision A — Parties to proceeding
path: Division 4 — After an application is made

title: 21 Parties and potential parties to be notified of application
zh: 21 締約方和潛在締約方將收到申請通知
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
text:
(1) This section applies if an application is made to the Tribunal for review of a decision.
(1) 若向仲裁庭提出複審決定的申請，則本節適用。
(2) The Tribunal must give written notice of the application to:
(2) 仲裁庭必須將申請書書面通知至：
(a) the applicant; and
(a) 申請人；和
(b) the decision ‑ maker; and
(b) 決策者；和
(c) any other person who is made a party to the proceeding for the review by an Act or an instrument made under an Act.
(c) 根據法案或根據法案製定的文書而成為審查程序當事人的任何其他人。
(3) If the Tribunal considers that another person’s interests may be affected by the decision, the Tribunal may:
(3) 如果仲裁庭認為該決定可能影響他人的利益，仲裁庭可以：
(a) give to the person; or
(a) 給予該人；或
(b) require the applicant to give to the person;
(b) 要求申請人提供給該人；
written notice of the application and the person’s right to apply to become a party to the proceeding for the review.
申請的書面通知以及該人申請成為審查程序一方的權利。

title: 22 Parties to proceeding for review
zh: 22 參與審查程序的締約方
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
text:
Parties to proceeding
訴訟當事人
(1) Each of the following are parties to a proceeding for review by the Tribunal of a decision:
(1) 下列各方均為仲裁庭複審裁決的程序的當事人：
(a) the applicant for the review;
（一）複審申請人；
(b) the decision ‑ maker;
(b) 決策者；
(c) any other person, if:
(c) 任何其他人，如果：
(i) the person applies to the Tribunal to become a party to the proceeding; and
(i) 該人向仲裁庭申請成為訴訟的一方；和
(ii) the Tribunal is satisfied that the person’s interests are affected by the decision; and
(ii) 仲裁庭確信該人的利益受到該決定的影響；和
(iii) the Tribunal considers it appropriate that the person become a party to the proceeding.
(iii) 仲裁庭認為該人成為訴訟當事人是適當的。
Note: In addition, the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory is a party to a proceeding in certain circumstances (see sections 59 and 93).
註：此外，聯邦或州或領地的總檢察長在某些情況下是訴訟的一方（請參閱第 59 和 93 條）。
(2) This section is subject to sections 65 (certain parties may seek to withdraw from being a party) and 83 (Tribunal may remove party from proceeding if party fails to appear or does not comply).
(2) 本節受第 65 條（某些當事人可以尋求退出當事人身分）和第 83 條（如果當事人未出庭或不遵守規定，仲裁庭可以將當事人從訴訟程序中剔除）的約束。
Notice to other parties
給其他方的通知
(3) If a person becomes a party to a proceeding under paragraph (1)(c), the Tribunal must give written notice to the other parties to the proceeding.
(3) 若某人成為第 (1)(c) 款規定的訴訟當事人，仲裁庭必須向訴訟的其他當事人發出書面通知。

title: Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
zh: B 部分 — 提供理由和文件
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents

title: 23 Decision ‑ maker must give Tribunal reasons and documents—general rule
zh: 23 決策者必須向仲裁庭提供理由和文件－一般規則
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
Within 28 days after the Tribunal notifies the decision ‑ maker for a decision of an application for review of the decision, the decision ‑ maker must give the Tribunal:
在仲裁庭通知決定複審決定申請的決定者後 28 天內，決定者必須向仲裁庭提供：
(a) a statement of reasons for the decision; and
(a) 作出該決定的理由說明；和
(b) a copy of every other document that is:
(b) 以下所有其他文件的副本：
(i) in the possession or under the control of the decision ‑ maker; and
(i) 決策者擁有或控制；和
(ii) relevant to the Tribunal’s review of the decision.
(ii) 與仲裁庭對裁決的審查有關。
Note: A decision ‑ maker may, but is not required to, give the Tribunal the same statement of reasons given to an applicant (whether under section 269 or 270 or otherwise).
註：決策者可以但不要求向仲裁庭提供與申請人相同的理由說明（無論是根據第 269 條、第 270 條或其他規定）。

title: 24 Decision ‑ maker must give Tribunal additional statement if Tribunal requires—general rule
zh: 24 如果仲裁庭要求，決策者必須向仲裁庭提供補充說明－一般規則
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
(1) This section applies if a decision ‑ maker for a decision has given the Tribunal a statement of reasons for the decision under section 23.
(1) 若某項決定的決策者已依第 23 條向仲裁庭提供了該決定的理由說明，則本條適用。
(2) The Tribunal may order the decision ‑ maker to give the Tribunal, within the period specified in the order, a statement containing further information in relation to any one or more of the following:
(2) 仲裁庭可命令決策者在命令規定的期限內向仲裁庭提供一份包含與以下一項或多項有關的進一步資訊的聲明：
(a) findings on material questions of fact in relation to the decision;
(a) 與決定有關的重大事實問題的調查結果；
(b) evidence or other material on which the findings were based;
(b) 調查結果所依據的證據或其他資料；
(c) reasons for the decision.
(c) 決定的理由。

title: 25 Decision ‑ maker must give Tribunal additional documents within 28 days—general rule
zh: 25 決策者必須在 28 天內向仲裁庭提供額外文件－一般規則
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
If:
如果：
(a) at any time during the Tribunal’s review of a decision, a document that is relevant to the review comes into the possession or under the control of the decision ‑ maker; and
(a) 在仲裁庭審查裁決期間的任何時間，決策者擁有或控制與審查相關的文件；和
(b) the document has not been given to the Tribunal for the purposes of the review;
(b) 該文件尚未提交仲裁庭進行審查；
the decision ‑ maker must give a copy of the document to the Tribunal within 28 days after the day on which the document came into the possession or under the control of the decision ‑ maker, or within a longer period specified in the practice directions.
決策者必須在決策者擁有或控制該文件之日起28天內，或在實務指示中規定的較長期限內，向仲裁庭提供該文件的副本。

title: 26 Decision ‑ maker must give Tribunal additional documents on request—general rule
zh: 26 決策者必須根據要求向仲裁庭提供額外文件－一般規則
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
(1) If, at any time during the Tribunal’s review of a decision, the Tribunal is satisfied that a document that may be relevant to the review is in the possession or under the control of the decision ‑ maker, the Tribunal may request the decision ‑ maker to give a copy of the document to the Tribunal within a specified period.
(1) 如果在仲裁庭審查裁決期間的任何時間，仲裁庭確信決策者擁有或控制可能與審查相關的文件，則仲裁庭可以要求決策者在指定期限內向仲裁庭提供該文件的副本。
(2) The request may relate to a particular document or documents in a class of documents.
(2) 請求可能涉及特定文件或一類文件中的文件。
(3) If the document is in the possession or under the control of the decision ‑ maker, the decision ‑ maker must give the Tribunal a copy of the document within the specified period.
(3) 如果該文件由決策者佔有或控制，則決策者必須在規定期限內向仲裁庭提供該文件的副本。

title: 27 Decision ‑ maker must give copies of reasons and documents to other parties—general rule
zh: 27 決策者必須向其他各方提供理由和文件的副本－一般規則
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
(1) If a decision ‑ maker for a decision is required to give the Tribunal a statement or copy of a document under this Subdivision within a period, the decision ‑ maker must give a copy of the statement or document to each other party to the proceeding for review of the decision within the same period.
(1) 如果一項決定的決策者需要在一段時間內向仲裁庭提供本款規定的聲明或文件副本，則決策者必須在同一期間內向訴訟各方提供該聲明或文件的副本，以供審查該決定。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if there is a certificate under section 91 (disclosure of information—public interest certificate) that relates to the disclosure of the statement or document in the proceeding.
(2) 若依據第 91 條（資訊揭露－公共利益證明）存在與程序中的聲明或文件揭露相關的證明，則第 (1) 款不適用。

title: 28 Exceptions—Tribunal may adjust requirements
zh: 28 例外情況－仲裁庭可以調整要求
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the decision ‑ maker for a decision is required to give the Tribunal or a party to a proceeding a statement or copy of a document under this Subdivision within a period.
(1) 若決策的決策者需要在一段時間內向仲裁庭或訴訟當事人提供本款規定的聲明或文件副本，則本節適用。
(2) This section applies despite any other provision in this Subdivision (other than section 29).
(2) 儘管本款中有任何其他規定（第 29 條除外），本條仍適用。
Shorten period to comply
縮短遵守期限
(3) A party to the proceeding for review of the decision may apply to the Tribunal to shorten the period within which the decision ‑ maker must give the statement or copy.
(3) 決定覆核程序的一方可以向仲裁庭申請縮短決定者必須提供陳述或副本的期限。
(4) On application under subsection (3) or on the Tribunal’s own initiative, the Tribunal may, by order, shorten the period within which the decision ‑ maker must give the statement or copy if it appears to the Tribunal that a party to the proceeding for review of the decision could suffer hardship if the period is not shortened.
(4) 根據第(3)款提出的申請或仲裁庭主動提出的申請，如果仲裁庭認為，如果不縮短期限，決定複核程序的一方可能會遭受困難，仲裁庭可以命令縮短決策者必須提供陳述或副本的期限。
Extend period to comply
延長遵守期限
(5) The decision ‑ maker may apply to the Tribunal to extend the period within which the decision ‑ maker must give the statement or copy.
(5) 決策者可以向仲裁庭申請延長決策者必須提供陳述或副本的期限。
(6) On application under subsection (5) or on the Tribunal’s own initiative, the Tribunal may, by order, extend the period within which the decision ‑ maker must give the statement or copy.
(6) 根據第(5)款提出的申請或仲裁庭主動提出的申請，仲裁庭可以透過命令延長決策者必須提供陳述或副本的期限。
(7) The Tribunal may extend the period even if it has expired.
(7) 即使期限已屆滿，仲裁庭也可以延長此期限。
Tribunal orders otherwise
仲裁庭另有命令
(8) The decision ‑ maker does not need to give the statement or copy if the Tribunal orders the decision ‑ maker not to give the statement or copy.
(8) 如果仲裁庭命令決策者不提供陳述或副本，則決策者無需提供陳述或副本。
Practice directions provide otherwise
實務指導另有規定
(9) The decision ‑ maker does not need to give the statement or copy in the circumstances specified in the practice directions.
(9) 實務指引中規定的情況，決策者無需提供陳述或副本。
Number of copies
份數
(10) The Tribunal may, by order, require the decision ‑ maker to give a specified number of copies of the statement or document.
(10) 仲裁庭可透過命令要求決策者提供指定數量的聲明或文件副本。

title: 29 Exception—while resolving whether to restrict publication or disclosure of information
zh: 29 例外－在決定是否限制資訊發布或揭露時
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
(1) This section applies if the decision ‑ maker for a decision is required to give the Tribunal or a party to a proceeding a statement or copy of a document under this Subdivision.
(1) 若決策的決策者需要向仲裁庭或訴訟當事人提供本款規定的聲明或文件副本，則本節適用。
(2) This section applies despite subsection 27(1) and section 28.
(2) 儘管有第 27 條第(1)款和第 28 條的規定，本條仍然適用。
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) a person applies to the Tribunal for an order under section 70 prohibiting or restricting the publication or other disclosure of information in the statement or copy; and
(a) 某人根據第 70 條向法庭申請命令，禁止或限制在聲明或副本中公佈或以其他方式披露資訊；和
(b) the person gives the Tribunal the statement or copy; and
(b) 該人向仲裁庭提供陳述或副本；和
(c) the person gives a copy of the application for the order to each party to the proceeding for review of the decision (other than the person);
(c) 該人向訴訟的每一方（本人除外）提供該命令的申請副本，以供複核該決定；
the decision ‑ maker does not need to give the statement or copy unless the Tribunal, after making its decision on the application for the order, orders the decision ‑ maker to do so.
決策者無需提供聲明或副本，除非仲裁庭在對命令申請作出決定後命令決策者這樣做。

title: 30 Privilege and public interest
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision B — Provision of reasons and documents
text:
This Subdivision (other than section 25) has effect despite any rule of law relating to legal professional privilege, without prejudice privilege or the public interest in relation to the production of documents.
儘管有任何與法律專業特權相關的法律規則，本細則（第 25 條除外）仍然有效，且不損害與製作文件相關的特權或公共利益。

title: Subdivision C — Effect of application for review on decision
zh: C 部分－複審申請對決定的影響
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision C — Effect of application for review on decision

title: 31 Decision cannot be altered outside Tribunal process
zh: 31 決定不能在仲裁程序之外改變
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision C — Effect of application for review on decision
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) After an application is made to the Tribunal for review of a reviewable decision, the decision may not be altered otherwise than by the Tribunal.
(1) 在向仲裁庭提出複審可覆核決定的申請後，除仲裁庭外，不得變更該決定。
Exceptions
例外情況
(2) However, the decision may be altered if:
(2) 但是，如果出現以下情況，則可以更改決定：
(a) both of the following apply:
(a) 下列兩項均適用：
(i) the parties to the proceeding for the review consent to the alteration;
(i) 審查程序當事人同意變更；
(ii) the Tribunal, by order, consents to the alteration; or
(ii) 仲裁庭以命令同意變更；或
(b) the decision is remitted to the decision ‑ maker under section 85.
(b) 依第85條將決定轉交給決策者。
Definitions
定義
(3) In this section:
(3) 本節：
alter a decision means:
改變決定意味著：
(a) vary the decision; or
(a) 改變決定；或
(b) set the decision aside; or
(b) 擱置該決定；或者
(c) set the decision aside and make a decision in substitution for the decision.
(c) 擱置該決定並作出替代該決定的決定。

title: 32 Reviewable decision continues to operate unless Tribunal orders otherwise
zh: 32 可審查的決定繼續有效，除非仲裁庭另有命令
path: Division 4 — After an application is made
Subdivision C — Effect of application for review on decision
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The making of an application to the Tribunal for review of a reviewable decision does not affect the operation of the decision or prevent the taking of action to implement the decision.
(1) 向仲裁庭申請覆核可覆核決定並不影響該決定的實施或妨礙採取行動執行該決定。
Exception—Tribunal may stay operation or implementation
例外－仲裁庭可以中止運作或實施
(2) However, on application by a party to a proceeding for review of a reviewable decision, the Tribunal may make an order staying or otherwise affecting the operation or implementation of the decision if the Tribunal considers that it is desirable to do so for the purpose of ensuring the effectiveness of the review.
(2) 然而，當訴訟一方申請複審可複核決定時，如果仲裁庭認為為了確保複核的有效性而有必要這樣做，則仲裁庭可以下令中止或以其他方式影響該決定的實施或實施。
(3) The order is subject to any conditions specified in the order.
(3) 該訂單須遵守訂單中指定的任何條件。
(4) The order has effect until the decision of the Tribunal on the application for review comes into operation.
(4) 該命令在仲裁庭對複審申請所做的決定生效前有效。
(5) Despite subsection (4), if:
(5) 儘管有第(4)款的規定，如果：
(a) the order states that it applies for a period; and
(a) 該命令聲明其適用期限；和
(b) the period ends before the decision of the Tribunal on the application for review comes into operation;
(b) 該期限在仲裁庭關於複審申請的決定生效前結束；
the order has effect until the end of the period.
該命令的有效期限至該期限結束為止。
(6) On application by a party to the proceeding, the Tribunal may, by order, vary or revoke the order.
(6) 根據訴訟一方的申請，仲裁庭可以透過命令更改或撤銷該命令。
Preconditions to making, varying or revoking an order
制定、更改或撤銷訂單的先決條件
(7) The Tribunal must not make, vary or revoke an order staying or otherwise affecting the operation or implementation of a reviewable decision unless:
(7) 仲裁庭不得作出、更改或撤銷暫緩執行或以其他方式影響可審查決定的實施或實施的命令，除非：
(a) the Tribunal has given the parties to the proceeding for review of the decision a reasonable opportunity to make submissions to the Tribunal in relation to the making, variation or revocation of the order; and
(a) 仲裁庭已給予決定複核程序的各方合理的機會，就該命令的製定、變更或撤銷向仲裁庭提出意見；和
(b) the Tribunal has taken into account the interests of any person who may be affected by the review of the decision.
(b) 仲裁庭已考慮到可能因裁決審查而受到影響的任何人的利益。
(8) However, paragraph (7)(a) does not prevent the Tribunal making, varying or revoking an order without giving a party an opportunity to make a submission to the Tribunal if the Tribunal is satisfied that it is not practicable to give the party the opportunity.
(8) 然而，如果仲裁庭認為給予當事人機會向仲裁庭提交意見不切實際，則第 (7)(a) 款並不妨礙仲裁庭在不給予當事人向仲裁庭提交意見的機會的情況下作出、更改或撤銷命令。
(9) If the Tribunal makes, varies or revokes an order without giving a party an opportunity to make a submission as mentioned in subsection (8), the order, variation or revocation does not take effect until a notice setting out the terms of the order, variation or revocation is given to the party.
(9) 若仲裁庭在未給予當事人第(8)款所述提交意見的機會的情況下作出、變更或撤銷命令，則在向當事人發出載有命令、變更或撤銷條款的通知之前，該命令、變更或撤銷不會生效。

title: Part 4 — Proceedings
zh: 第 4 部 — 審理程序

title: 33 Simplified outline of this Part
text:
This Part deals with the process the Tribunal follows when an application is made. It contains the standard provisions for Tribunal proceedings. Other legislation can include provisions that apply in addition to, or instead of, these standard provisions. For example, standard requirements apply to applications to the Tribunal, but other legislation may specify additional or alternative requirements.
本部分涉及仲裁庭提出申請時所遵循的程序。它包含法庭程序的標準條款。其他立法可以包括除這些標準條款之外或替代這些標準條款而適用的條款。例如，標準要求適用於向法庭提出的申請，但其他立法可能會規定附加或替代要求。
Practice directions made by the President also deal with various matters relating to Tribunal proceedings and operations. Practice directions must be published.
庭長制定的實務指示也涉及與法庭程序和運作有關的各種事項。實踐指導必須公開。
The President decides which member or members will exercise the Tribunal’s powers for a specific proceeding. This is referred to as constituting the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding. There are different requirements for constituting the Tribunal for different kinds of proceedings. For other ways the Tribunal’s powers can be exercised, see Division 4 of Part 11.
庭長決定哪位或哪些成員將在特定程序中行使法庭的權力。這被稱為為訴訟目的組成仲裁庭。針對不同類型的訴訟程序，組成仲裁庭有不同的要求。有關仲裁庭行使權力的其他方式，請參閱第 11 部分第 4 節。
General principles (for example in relation to accessibility and informality) apply to how the Tribunal runs proceedings. Specific requirements also apply to the Tribunal, applicants, decision ‑ makers and other parties to proceedings. There are provisions dealing with the following:
一般原則（例如與無障礙性和非正式性有關）適用於仲裁庭如何進行訴訟程序。具體要求也適用於仲裁庭、申請人、決策者和訴訟的其他各方。有涉及以下內容的規定：
(a) participating in proceedings, including representation;
(a) 參與訴訟程序，包括代表；
(b) ways for parties to stop participating;
(b) 各方停止參與的方式；
(c) hearings, directions hearings and dispute resolution processes (together known as Tribunal case events);
(c) 聽證會、指示聽證會及爭議解決程序（統稱為仲裁庭案件事件）；
(d) obtaining and managing evidence and information, including public interest certificates;
(d) 取得和管理證據和訊息，包括公共利益證書；
(e) orders the Tribunal may make in relation to proceedings.
(e) 仲裁庭可能就訴訟程序所作出的命令。
The Tribunal may dismiss an application without making a decision in some circumstances. Otherwise, in a review of a reviewable decision, the Tribunal must affirm, vary or set aside the decision. If the Tribunal sets aside the decision, it may make a substitute decision or remit the matter to the decision ‑ maker to reconsider as ordered or recommended by the Tribunal.
在某些情況下，仲裁庭可能會駁回申請而不做出決定。否則，在可複審決定進行複審時，仲裁庭必須確認、變更或撤銷該決定。如果仲裁庭擱置該決定，則可以根據仲裁庭的命令或建議做出替代決定或將事項移交決策者重新考慮。
The timing and effect of some Tribunal decisions is set out. Once decisions are made, requirements apply to the Tribunal in relation to giving notice, giving statements of reasons and publishing decisions.
規定了一些仲裁庭裁決的時間和效果。一旦做出決定，仲裁庭就適用發出通知、說明理由和公佈決定的要求。
Some guidance and appeals panel decisions are specified to be Tribunal guidance decisions. The Tribunal must have regard to these decisions in some future proceedings.
一些指導和上訴小組的決定被指定為仲裁庭指導決定。仲裁庭必須在未來的一些訴訟中考慮這些決定。
There are a number of offences applying to giving evidence, non ‑ publication and non ‑ disclosure orders and contempt.
有許多罪行適用於提供證據、不公開和不披露命令以及藐視法庭罪。

title: Division 2 — Applications to Tribunal
zh: 第 2 分部 — 向仲裁庭提出申請

title: 34 How to apply
text:
Manner of applying
申請方式
(1) An application to the Tribunal may be made in writing or in any other manner specified for the application in the practice directions.
(1) 向仲裁庭提出的申請可以書面或實務指南中為申請指定的任何其他方式提出。
Information to include
要包含的訊息
(2) An application to the Tribunal must include the information specified for the application in the practice directions.
(2) 向仲裁庭提出的申請必須包括實務指示中為申請指定的資訊。
Note 1: A fee may be payable in respect of the application (see rules made for the purposes of section 296). An application may be dismissed if the fee is not paid within the time prescribed by the rules (see section 98).
註 1：申請可能需要繳交費用（請參閱第 296 條所訂定的規則）。如果未在規則規定的時間內繳納費用，申請可能會被駁回（請參閱第 98 條）。
Note 2: The legislation under which a reviewable decision is made may contain other requirements for applications for review of that type of decision.
註 2：作出可複審決定所依據的法令可能包含對該類型決定複審申請的其他要求。
(3) A failure to comply with subsection (2) does not affect the validity of the application.
(3) 不遵守第(2)款並不影響申請的有效性。

title: 35 Applications may be made on behalf of a person
zh: 35 可以代表個人提出申請
text:
To avoid doubt, if this Act, another Act or an instrument made under this Act or another Act allows a person to make an application to the Tribunal, the application may be made on the person’s behalf by someone else.
為避免疑問，如果本法、其他法或根據本法或其他法制定的文書允許某人向法庭提出申請，則該申請可由其他人代表該人提出。

title: Division 3 — Practice directions
zh: 第 3 分部 — 實踐指導

title: 36 President may make practice directions
zh: 36 總統可以製定實務指示
text:
President may make practice directions
總統可以製定實踐指示
(1) The President may make practice directions in relation to any or all of the following:
(1) 主席可就以下任何或所有事項作出實務指示：
(a) the operations of the Tribunal;
(a) 法庭的運作；
(b) the procedure of the Tribunal;
(b) 仲裁庭的程序；
(c) the conduct of proceedings by the Tribunal;
(c) 法庭進行訴訟程序；
(d) the arrangement of the business of the Tribunal;
(d) 法庭的業務安排；
(e) the places at which the Tribunal may sit;
(e) 仲裁庭可以開庭的地點；
(f) the use of technology that allows a person to participate in a proceeding, or part of a proceeding, in the Tribunal without being physically present;
(f) 使用科技使個人無需親自到場即可參與法庭的訴訟或部分訴訟；
(g) giving information or producing or giving documents or things to the Tribunal for any purpose, including:
(g) 為任何目的向仲裁庭提供資訊或出示或提供文件或物品，包括：
(i) the form and manner in which information, documents or things may be produced or given; and
(i) 製作或提供資訊、文件或物品的形式和方式；和
(ii) producing or giving additional copies of documents;
(ii) 出示或提供額外的文件副本；
(h) giving information or producing or giving documents or things to persons for the purposes of a proceeding in the Tribunal, including:
(h) 為法院訴訟的目的向他人提供資訊或出示或提供文件或物品，包括：
(i) the form and manner in which information, documents or things may be produced or given; and
(i) 製作或提供資訊、文件或物品的形式和方式；和
(ii) producing or giving additional copies of documents;
(ii) 出示或提供額外的文件副本；
(i) dispute resolution processes under Subdivision C of Division 6;
(i) 第 6 分部 C 分部下的爭議解決程序；
(j) the sorting, prioritisation, allocation and treatment of applications for review and related matters;
(j) 審查申請及相關事項的排序、優先順序、分配和處理；
(k) the accessibility of the Tribunal and the responsiveness of the Tribunal to the diverse needs of parties to proceedings;
(k) 法庭的便利性以及法庭對訴訟當事人不同需求的回應能力；
(l) any other matter that is required or permitted by this Act to be specified in the practice directions.
(l) 本法要求或允許在執業指導中規定的任何其他事項。
(2) Practice directions must be made in writing.
(2) 實踐指示必須以書面形式作出。
Consultation before practice directions are made
在製定實務指導前進行諮詢
(3) Before making a practice direction, the President must consult the Tribunal Advisory Committee.
(3) 在作出實務指示之前，庭長必須諮詢仲裁庭諮詢委員會。
Regulations and rules prevail over practice directions
法規和規則優先於實踐指示
(4) Practice directions that are inconsistent with the regulations or rules have no effect to the extent of the inconsistency, but practice directions are taken to be consistent with the regulations and rules to the extent that the practice directions are capable of operating concurrently with the regulations and rules.
（四）執業指導與法規、規章不一致的，不產生任何效力，但在執業指導能與規章、規章同時實施的範圍內，視為與規章、規章一致。
Failure to comply does not invalidate
不遵守並不意味著無效
(5) A failure by the Tribunal to comply with the practice directions does not affect the validity of anything done by the Tribunal.
