(5) 仲裁庭未能遵守實務指示並不影響仲裁庭所做任何事情的有效性。
Compliance is sufficient
合規性就足夠了
(6) If the Tribunal deals with a proceeding in a way that complies with the practice directions, the Tribunal is not required to take any other action in dealing with the proceeding.
(6) 如果仲裁庭以符合慣例指示的方式處理訴訟，則仲裁庭無需在處理該訴訟時採取任何其他行動。
Publishing
出版
(7) The Tribunal must publish practice directions.
(7) 仲裁庭必須公佈實務指示。
Practice directions not legislative instruments
實踐指導而非立法文書
(8) A practice direction made under subsection (1) is not a legislative instrument.
(8) 依第 (1) 款所製定的實務指示並非立法文書。

title: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
zh: 第 4 分部 — 訴訟程序的法庭組成
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding

title: Subdivision A — Constituting the Tribunal
zh: A 分部 — 仲裁庭的組成
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding

title: 37 President may constitute Tribunal for purposes of a proceeding
zh: 37 主席可以為訴訟目的組成法庭
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
President directs how Tribunal is constituted
主席指示法庭如何組成
(1) The President may direct that a member or members constitute the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding in the Tribunal.
(1) 庭長可指示一名或多名成員組成法庭以進行法庭訴訟。
President directs which member presides
主席指示由哪位成員主持
(2) If the Tribunal is constituted by more than one member for the purposes of a proceeding, the President must direct which member is to preside for the purposes of the proceeding.
(2) 若法庭由多名成員組成以進行訴訟，庭長必須指示由哪位成員主持訴訟。
Requirements for directions
路線要求
(3) In making a direction under subsection (1) or (2), the President must comply with:
(3) 在根據第 (1) 或 (2) 款作出指示時，總統必須遵守：
(a) the requirements specified in this Act; and
(a) 本法規定的要求；和
(b) any other requirements specified in the practice directions.
(b) 實踐指南中規定的任何其他要求。
(4) If a direction under subsection (1) or (2) is made in writing, the direction is not a legislative instrument.
(4) 若第 (1) 或 (2) 款規定的指示以書面形式作出，則該指示並非立法文書。
President must notify parties to proceeding
總統必須通知各方進行訴訟
(5) If the President makes a direction under subsection (1) or (2) in relation to a proceeding, the President must give written notice to each party to the proceeding (other than a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding).
(5) 若總統依據第 (1) 或 (2) 款就某一訴訟作出指示，則總統必須向該訴訟的每一方（不包括該訴訟的非參與者）發出書面通知。
(6) The notice does not need to specify:
(6) 通知無須載明：
(a) the member or members constituting the Tribunal; or
(a) 組成仲裁庭的成員；或
(b) the member who is to preside.
(b) 主持會議的成員。
(7) If the Tribunal is constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by the guidance and appeals panel, the notice must state this.
(7) 如果仲裁庭是為了訴訟目的而由指導和上訴小組組成的，則通知必須說明這一點。

title: 38 President must consult before including Judicial Deputy President
zh: 38 總統納入司法副院長前必須先諮詢
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
Before the President directs that a Judicial Deputy President constitutes, or members at least one of whom is a Judicial Deputy President constitute, the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding, the President must consult the Chief Justice of the court of which the Judicial Deputy President is a Judge.
在院長指示司法副院長或其中至少一名司法副院長組成法庭以進行訴訟之前，院長必須諮詢司法副院長擔任法官的法院的首席法官。

title: Subdivision B — Proceedings generally
zh: B 分部 — 一般訴訟程序
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding

title: 39 General rules for constitution of Tribunal
zh: 39 仲裁庭組成的一般規則
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
General rules
一般規則
(1) The Tribunal must be constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by a single member, 2 members or 3 members.
(1) 為了訴訟目的，仲裁庭必須由一名成員、兩名成員或三名成員組成。
(2) The Tribunal may be constituted by 2 or 3 members only if the President considers that it is appropriate to do so:
(2) 只有在主席認為適當的情況下，法庭才可以由 2 名或 3 名成員組成：
(a) because the proceeding raises a complex issue; or
(a) 因為程序提出了一個複雜的問題；或
(b) because one or more of the members have particular expertise relevant to the proceeding; or
(b) 因為一名或多名成員具有與程序相關的特定專業知識；或
(c) in the interests of justice.
(c) 為了正義。
(3) The Tribunal constituted must have no more than one member who is a Judge.
(3) 所組成的法庭不得超過一名法官。
Exceptions
例外情況
(4) This section is subject to Subdivision C (guidance and appeals panel).
(4) 本節受 C 部分（指導和上訴小組）管轄。

title: Subdivision C — Guidance and appeals panel
zh: 第 C 次分部 — 指導與上訴小組
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
Subdivision C — Guidance and appeals panel

title: 40 Exception—President refers application for review that raises issue of significance
zh: 40 例外－總統提交的審查申請提出了重大問題
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
Subdivision C — Guidance and appeals panel
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies instead of section 39 in relation to a proceeding in the Tribunal in relation to an application referred to the guidance and appeals panel by the President under section 122.
(1) 本條代替第 39 條適用於仲裁庭就總統依第 122 條提交給指導和上訴小組的申請進行的訴訟。
Note: The President may refer an application for review of a decision to the guidance and appeals panel if the President is satisfied that the application raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making (see section 122).
註：如果總統確信申請提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題，總統可以將決定複審申請提交給指導和上訴小組（見第122節）。
General rules
一般規則
(2) The Tribunal must be constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by 2 or 3 members.
(2) 為訴訟目的，仲裁庭必須由 2 名或 3 名成員組成。
(3) One of the members must be the President or a Deputy President.
(3) 其中一名成員必須是主席或副主席。

title: 41 Exception—President, on appeal, refers Tribunal decision that raises issue of significance
zh: 41 例外－庭長在上訴時提及仲裁庭的裁決，該裁決提出了重大問題
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
Subdivision C — Guidance and appeals panel
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a proceeding relates to a guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because the President refers a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel; and
(a) 因庭長將法庭裁決（法庭裁決）提交給指導和上訴小組而提出的與指導和上訴小組申請相關的訴訟程序；和
(b) the President is satisfied that the Tribunal decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making;
(b) 庭長確信法庭的裁決提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；
the President must constitute the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding in accordance with this section instead of section 39.
庭長必須根據本節而不是第 39 節的規定組成仲裁庭以進行訴訟。
Note: Under section 128, the President may refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel if the President is satisfied of either or both of the following:
註：根據第 128 條，如果庭長對以下其中一項或兩項感到滿意，可以將法庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組：
(a) the decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making;
(a) 該決定提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；
(b) the decision may contain an error of fact or law materially affecting the decision.
(b) 該決定可能包含對決定有重大影響的事實或法律錯誤。
General rules
一般規則
(2) The Tribunal must be constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by 2 or 3 members.
(2) 為訴訟目的，仲裁庭必須由 2 名或 3 名成員組成。
(3) One of the members must be the President or a Deputy President.
(3) 其中一名成員必須是主席或副主席。
(4) Unless the parties to the proceeding agree otherwise, none of the members can be a person who constituted, or was one of the persons who constituted, the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision was made.
(4) 除非訴訟各方另有協議，否則任何成員均不能是為仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟目的組成仲裁庭的人，也不能是組成仲裁庭的人之一。

title: 42 Exception—President, on appeal, refers Tribunal decision for material error
zh: 42 例外－庭長在上訴中提及仲裁庭的裁決有重大錯誤
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
Subdivision C — Guidance and appeals panel
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a proceeding relates to a guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because the President refers a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel; and
(a) 因庭長將法庭裁決（法庭裁決）提交給指導和上訴小組而提出的與指導和上訴小組申請相關的訴訟程序；和
(b) the President is not satisfied that the Tribunal decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making;
(b) 庭長不滿意法庭的裁決提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；
the President must constitute the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding in accordance with this section instead of section 39.
庭長必須根據本節而不是第 39 節的規定組成仲裁庭以進行訴訟。
Note: Under section 128, the President may refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel if the President is satisfied of either or both of the following:
註：根據第 128 條，如果庭長對以下其中一項或兩項感到滿意，可以將法庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組：
(a) the decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making;
(a) 該決定提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；
(b) the decision may contain an error of fact or law materially affecting the decision.
(b) 該決定可能包含對決定有重大影響的事實或法律錯誤。
General rules
一般規則
(2) The Tribunal must be constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by a single member, 2 members or 3 members.
(2) 為了訴訟目的，仲裁庭必須由一名成員、兩名成員或三名成員組成。
(3) Unless the parties to the proceeding agree otherwise, none of the members can be a person who constituted, or was one of the persons who constituted, the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision was made.
(3) 除非訴訟各方另有協議，否則任何成員均不能是為仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟目的組成仲裁庭的人，也不能是組成仲裁庭的人之一。
(4) If the Tribunal is constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by a single member, the member must be more senior than the most senior person involved in making the Tribunal decision (see subsections (6) and (7)).
(4) 如果仲裁庭是為了訴訟目的而由一名成員組成，則該成員的級別必須高於參與仲裁庭裁決的最高級別人員（請參閱第 (6) 和 (7) 款）。
(5) If the Tribunal is constituted for the purposes of the proceeding by 2 or 3 members, the presiding member must be:
(5) 如果仲裁庭由 2 名或 3 名成員組成，則首席成員必須是：
(a) if a Non ‑ Judicial Deputy President constituted, or was one of the persons who constituted, the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision was made—equal in seniority to, or more senior than, the most senior person involved in making the Tribunal decision (see subsections (6) and (7)); or
(a) 若非司法副庭長為仲裁庭作出裁決的程序而組成仲裁庭，或是組成仲裁庭的人員之一，其資歷與參與仲裁庭裁決的最高級別人員相同或更高（見第 (6) 和 (7) 款）；或
(b) in any other case—more senior than the most senior person involved in making the Tribunal decision (see subsections (6) and (7)).
(b) 在任何其他情況下－比參與仲裁庭裁決的最高級人員的等級更高（請參閱第 (6) 和 (7) 款）。
(6) For the purposes of subsections (4) and (5), the most senior person involved in making the Tribunal decision is:
(6) 就第 (4) 及 (5) 款而言，參與仲裁庭裁決的最高級人員是：
(a) if the Tribunal decision was made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by a single member—that member; or
(a) 如果仲裁庭的裁決是由一名成員為訴訟目的而組成的仲裁庭做出的－該成員；或
(b) if the Tribunal decision was made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by 2 or more members—the most senior of those members.
(b) 如果仲裁庭的裁決是由 2 名或 2 名以上成員（其中資歷最高的成員）為訴訟目的而組成的仲裁庭做出的。
(7) For the purposes of subsections (4), (5) and (6), the order of seniority of members is as follows:
(7) 就第(4)、(5)和(6)款而言，成員的資歷順序如下：
(a) the President;
(a) 主席；
(b) Judicial Deputy Presidents;
(b) 司法副院長；
(c) Non ‑ Judicial Deputy Presidents;
(c) 非司法副院長；
(d) senior members;
(d) 資深成員；
(e) general members.
(e) 一般成員。

title: Subdivision D — Reconstitution
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding

title: 43 Reconstitution—before hearing starts
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
At any time before the start of the hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal, the President may reconstitute the Tribunal.
在法庭審理程序開始之前的任何時間，庭長均可重組法庭。

title: 44 Reconstitution—after hearing starts if member unavailable etc.
zh: 44 重組－聽證會開始後，如果成員無法出席等情況。
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
President may reconstitute Tribunal
總統可以重組法庭
(1) At any time after the start of the hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal, the President may reconstitute the Tribunal if:
(1) 在法庭審理程序開始後的任何時間，庭長可在下列情況下重組法庭：
(a) the member, or one of the members, who constitutes the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding:
(a) 為訴訟目的而組成仲裁庭的成員或成員之一：
(i) stops being a member; or
(i) 不再是會員；或
(ii) is for any reason unavailable; or
(ii) 因任何原因無法使用；或
(iii) is directed by the President not to take part in the proceeding; or
(iii) 總統指示不參與訴訟程序；或
(b) the President considers that reconstituting the Tribunal is in the interests of achieving the quick and efficient conduct of the proceeding.
(b) 庭長認為重組法庭有利於訴訟程序的快速有效進行。
(2) However, the President must not reconstitute the Tribunal under this section unless the President:
(2) 但是，庭長不得依本條重組法庭，除非庭長：
(a) considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so; and
(a) 認為這樣做符合正義；和
(b) consults each member who would cease to be a member of the Tribunal as constituted for the purposes of the proceeding if it is reasonably practicable to do so.
(b) 在合理可行的情況下，與每位將不再擔任為訴訟目的而組成的法庭成員的成員進行協商。
President may direct member not to take part
主席可指示會員不參加
(3) The President may direct that a member not take part in a proceeding in the Tribunal if:
(3) 在下列情況下，主席可以指示成員不參與仲裁庭的訴訟：
(a) the President considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so; and
(a) 總統認為這樣做符合正義；和
(b) the President has consulted the member if it is reasonably practicable to do so.
(b) 在合理可行的情況下，主席已與該成員協商。

title: 45 Reconstitution—involvement in dispute resolution process
zh: 45 重構－參與爭議解決過程
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
At any time after the start of the hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal, the President may reconstitute the Tribunal if section 89 (eligibility of person conducting dispute resolution process to sit as a member) applies in relation to the member, or one of the members, who constitutes the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding.
在法庭審理程序開始後的任何時間，如果第 89 條（進行爭議解決程序的人員擔任成員的資格）適用於為程序目的組成法庭的成員或其中一名成員，則庭長可隨時重組法庭。

title: 46 Reconstitution—after hearing starts for conflict of interest or bias
zh: 46 重組－利益衝突或偏見聽證會開始後
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
At any time after the start of the hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal, the President may reconstitute the Tribunal if the President is satisfied that the member, or one of the members, who constitutes the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding:
在法庭訴訟開始後的任何時間，如果庭長確信為訴訟目的組成法庭的成員或其中一名成員：
(a) has a conflict of interest in relation to the proceeding; or
(a) 與訴訟有利益衝突；或
(b) has an actual or apprehended bias in relation to the proceeding.
(b) 對訴訟程序有實際或擔憂的偏見。

title: 47 Reconstitution—as guidance and appeals panel after hearing starts
zh: 47 重組－聽證會開始後作為指導和上訴小組
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
The President must reconstitute the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding if, at any time after the start of the hearing of the proceeding, the application to which the proceeding relates is referred to the guidance and appeals panel by the President under section 122.
如果在訴訟聽證開始後的任何時間，院長根據第 122 條將與訴訟相關的申請提交給指導和上訴小組，則院長必須為訴訟目的重組法庭。
Note: The President may refer an application for review of a decision to the guidance and appeals panel if the President is satisfied that the application raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making (see section 122).
註：如果總統確信申請提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題，總統可以將決定複審申請提交給指導和上訴小組（見第122節）。

title: 48 After Tribunal is reconstituted
path: Division 4 — Constitution of Tribunal for a proceeding
text:
If the President reconstitutes the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding, the Tribunal as reconstituted:
如果庭長為了訴訟目的重組法庭，則重組後的法庭：
(a) must continue the proceeding; and
(a) 必須繼續程序；和
(b) may have regard to:
(b) 可考慮：
(i) any record of the proceeding before the Tribunal as previously constituted (including a record of any evidence taken in the proceeding); and
(i) 仲裁庭先前組成的訴訟程序的任何記錄（包括訴訟程序中取得的任何證據的記錄）；和
(ii) any document or thing relating to the proceeding given to the Tribunal as previously constituted.
(ii) 與先前組成的仲裁庭進行的訴訟有關的任何文件或物品。

title: Division 5 — Tribunal procedure
zh: 第 5 分部 — 仲裁程序

title: 49 Tribunal has discretion in relation to procedure
zh: 49 仲裁庭對程序有自由裁量權
text:
(1) The procedure of the Tribunal in a proceeding is within the discretion of the Tribunal.
(1) 仲裁庭在訴訟中的程序由仲裁庭自行決定。
(2) In exercising its discretion, the Tribunal must have regard to the circumstances of the proceeding.
(2) 在行使其自由裁量權時，仲裁庭必須考慮訴訟的具體情況。
(3) Subsections (1) and (2) are subject to this Act and the rules.
(3) 第 (1) 和 (2) 款適用本法和規則。

title: 50 Tribunal is to act informally etc.
zh: 50 仲裁庭應以非正式方式行事等。
text:
(1) In a proceeding, the Tribunal must act with as little formality and technicality as a proper consideration of the matters before the Tribunal permits.
(1) 在訴訟程序中，仲裁庭在行事時必須盡可能減少形式和技術性，並在仲裁庭允許的情況下對事項進行適當考慮。
(2) Subsection (1) is subject to this Act and the rules.
(2) 第 (1) 款適用本法及規則。

title: 51 Tribunal to be accessible
text:
(1) As far as practicable, the Tribunal must conduct each proceeding in the Tribunal in a way that is accessible for the parties to the proceeding, taking into account the needs of the parties.
(1) 在可行的情況下，仲裁庭必須以訴訟當事人可以接受的方式進行仲裁庭的每項訴訟，並考慮到當事人的需要。
(2) Subsection (1) is subject to this Act and the rules.
(2) 第 (1) 款適用本法及規則。

title: 52 Tribunal is not bound by rules of evidence
zh: 52 仲裁庭不受證據規則的約束
text:
The Tribunal is not bound by the rules of evidence, but may inform itself on any matter in such manner as it considers appropriate.
仲裁庭不受證據規則的約束，但可以以其認為適當的方式就任何事項自行通報。

title: 53 Tribunal controls scope of review of decision
zh: 53 仲裁庭控制決定審查的範圍
text:
In a proceeding for review of a decision, the Tribunal may determine the scope of the review by limiting the questions of fact, the evidence and the issues that it considers.
在覆核裁決的程序中，仲裁庭可以透過限制事實問題、證據和其考慮的問題來確定複核的範圍。

title: 54 Tribunal can exercise powers of decision ‑ maker
zh: 54 仲裁庭可以行使決策者的權力
text:
For the purposes of reviewing a reviewable decision, the Tribunal may exercise all the powers and discretions that are conferred on the decision ‑ maker by an Act or an instrument made under an Act.
為了審查可審查的決定，法庭可以行使法案或根據法案製定的文書賦予決策者的所有權力和自由裁量權。

title: 55 Right to present case
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The Tribunal must ensure that each party to a proceeding in the Tribunal is given a reasonable opportunity to:
(1) 仲裁庭必須確保仲裁庭訴訟的各方都有合理的機會：
(a) present the party’s case; and
(a) 陳述當事人的案情；和
(b) access any information or documents to which the Tribunal proposes to have regard in reaching a decision in the proceeding; and
(b) 取得仲裁庭在程序中做出決定時建議考慮的任何資訊或文件；和
(c) make submissions and adduce evidence.
(c) 提出意見並提出證據。
Exceptions
例外情況
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding.
(2) 第(1)款不適用於訴訟的非參與方。
(2A) If a party to the proceeding is a non ‑ participating party to a Tribunal case event in relation to the proceeding, subsection (1) does not apply in relation to that party in relation to that Tribunal case event.
(2A) 若訴訟一方是與該訴訟有關的法庭案件事件的非參與方，則第(1)款不適用於與該法庭案件事件有關的該方。
(3) Subsection (1) is subject to:
(3) 第 (1) 款須遵守：
(a) section 69 (hearings to be in public unless practice directions or Tribunal order requires otherwise); and
(a) 第 69 條（聽證會應公開進行，除非實踐指示或法庭命令另有要求）；和
(b) section 70 (Tribunal may restrict publication or disclosure of information); and
(b) 第 70 條（仲裁庭可以限制資訊的發布或揭露）；和
(c) section 78 (inspection of documents produced under summons); and
(c) 第 78 條（檢查根據傳票出示的文件）；和
(d) section 91 (disclosure of information—public interest certificate); and
(d) 第 91 條（資訊揭露－公共利益證明）；和
(e) Part 6 (proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area).
(e) 第 6 部分（情報和安全管轄範圍內的訴訟程序）。
(4) This section does not limit section 53 (Tribunal controls scope of review of decision).
(4) 本節不限制第 53 條（仲裁庭控制決定審查的範圍）。

title: 56 Parties and their representatives to assist Tribunal
zh: 56 當事人及其代表協助仲裁庭
text:
Decision ‑ makers and their representatives
決策者及其代表
(1) In a proceeding for review of a decision, the decision ‑ maker and any person representing the decision ‑ maker must use their best endeavours to assist the Tribunal to:
(1) 在覆核決定的程序中，決策者和代表決策者的任何人必須盡最大努力協助仲裁庭：
(a) make the correct or preferable decision in relation to the proceeding; and
(a) 就訴訟作出正確或更好的決定；和
(b) achieve the objective in section 9.
(b) 實現第 9 節的目標。
Other parties and their representatives
其他當事人及其代表
(2) A party to a proceeding in the Tribunal (other than the decision ‑ maker in a proceeding for review of a decision) and any person representing the party must use their best endeavours to assist the Tribunal to achieve the objective in section 9.
(2) 仲裁庭訴訟的一方（複審決定的程序中的決策者除外）和代表該方的任何人必須盡最大努力協助仲裁庭實現第9條中的目標。
Obligation is limited for non ‑ participating party
非參與方的義務有限
(3) The obligation of a non ‑ participating party to a proceeding or a Tribunal case event in relation to a proceeding, and any person representing the party, to use best endeavours to assist the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding only applies in relation to action the party is required to take by this Act or the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding.
(3) 訴訟或與訴訟有關的法庭案件事件的非參與方以及代表該方的任何人有義務盡最大努力就該程序協助法庭，該義務僅適用於本法或法庭要求該方就該程序採取的行動。

title: 57 Sittings of Tribunal
text:
Sittings of the Tribunal are to be held from time to time as required, in such places in Australia or an external Territory as are convenient or in the interests of justice.
法庭開庭應根據需要不時在澳洲或外部領土方便或為了正義的地方舉行。

title: 58 Resolving disagreements between Tribunal members
zh: 58 解決仲裁庭成員之間的分歧
text:
2 members
2 名成員
(1) If 2 members constitute the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding and they do not agree about any matter, the view of the presiding member prevails.
(1) 如果 2 名成員組成仲裁庭以進行訴訟，且他們對任何事項沒有達成一致，則以主持成員的觀點為準。
3 members
3名成員
(2) If 3 members constitute the Tribunal for the purposes of a proceeding and they do not agree about any matter:
(2) 如果 3 名成員組成仲裁庭以進行訴訟，且他們對任何事項沒有達成協議：
(a) if the majority agree—the view of the majority prevails; or
(a) 若多數人同意－多數人的觀點佔上風；或
(b) in any other case—the view of the presiding member prevails.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－以主持成員的觀點為準。

title: Subdivision B — Parties and representation
zh: B 部分 — 當事人與代表

title: 59 Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth may become a party
zh: 59 聯邦總檢察長可以成為一方
text:
Becoming a party
成為一方
(1) If the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth gives written notice to the Tribunal that the Attorney ‑ General wishes to be a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal, the Attorney ‑ General is a party to the proceeding.
(1) 如果聯邦總檢察長向法庭發出書面通知，表示總檢察長希望成為法庭訴訟的一方，則總檢察長就是該訴訟的一方。
Ceasing to be a party
不再是政黨
(2) If:
(2) 如果：
(a) the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth is a party to a proceeding because of a notice under subsection (1); and
(a) 聯邦總檢察長因根據第 (1) 款發出的通知而成為訴訟的一方；和
(b) the Attorney ‑ General gives written notice to the Tribunal that the Attorney ‑ General wishes to cease being a party to the proceeding;
(b) 總檢察長向法庭發出書面通知，表示總檢察長希望不再作為訴訟當事人；
the Attorney ‑ General ceases being a party to the proceeding.
總檢察長不再是訴訟的當事人。
Costs
成本
(3) If the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth is a party to a proceeding because of a notice under subsection (1), the Attorney ‑ General may authorise the Commonwealth to pay another party to the proceeding any costs that the Attorney ‑ General considers the party reasonably incurred as a result of the Attorney ‑ General being a party to the proceeding.
(3) 如果聯邦總檢察長因根據第 (1) 款發出通知而成為訴訟當事方，則總檢察長可授權聯邦向訴訟另一方支付總檢察長認為該方因總檢察長作為訴訟當事方而合理產生的任何費用。

title: 60 Decision ‑ makers may elect not to participate in kind of proceeding or Tribunal case event
zh: 60 決策者可以選擇不參與某種訴訟或法庭案件活動
text:
(1) A person who is the decision ‑ maker for a reviewable decision may give the Tribunal written notice (an election notice ) that the person does not wish to participate in:
(1) 作為可審查決定的決策者的人可以向仲裁庭發出書面通知（選舉通知），表明該人不希望參與：
(a) a kind of proceeding in the Tribunal; or
(a) 法庭的一種訴訟程序；或
(b) a kind of Tribunal case event (other than a directions hearing or part of a directions hearing) in relation to a kind of proceeding in the Tribunal.
(b) 與法庭某類訴訟相關的某類法庭案件事件（指示聽證會或指示聽證會的一部分除外）。
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a kind of proceeding or Tribunal case event prescribed by the rules.
(2) 但是，第 (1) 款不適用於規則規定的某類訴訟或仲裁庭案件事件。
(3) An election notice is not a legislative instrument.
(3) 選舉通知並非立法文書。

title: 61 Decision ‑ maker who elects not to participate may be a non ‑ participating party to proceeding or Tribunal case event
zh: 61 選擇不參與的決策者可能是訴訟程序或法庭案件活動的非參與者
text:
Person who has given election notice
發出選舉通知的人
(1) A person is a non ‑ participating party to a proceeding if:
(1) 若符合下列條件，則該人屬於訴訟的非參與方：
(a) the person is a party to the proceeding (other than the applicant); and
(a) 該人是訴訟的一方（申請人除外）；和
(b) the proceeding relates to a decision for which the person is the decision ‑ maker; and
(b) 該程序涉及該人作為決策者的決定；和
(c) the proceeding is of a kind for which the person has given an election notice under paragraph 60(1)(a); and
(c) 該程序屬於該人已根據第 60(1)(a) 段發出選擇通知的類型；和
(d) the proceeding is not a guidance and appeals panel proceeding; and
(d) 該程序不是指導和上訴小組程序；和
(e) any conditions prescribed by the rules for the purposes of this paragraph are satisfied; and
(e) 滿足本款規定的任何條件；和
(f) the Tribunal has not decided under section 62 that the person is to participate in the proceeding; and
(f) 仲裁庭尚未根據第 62 條決定該人參加訴訟；和
(g) the Tribunal has not ordered the person to participate in the proceeding under section 63.
(g) 仲裁庭沒有命令該人參加第 63 條規定的訴訟程序。
(1A) A person is a non ‑ participating party to a Tribunal case event in relation to a proceeding if:
(1A) 在下列情況下，某人是與訴訟相關的法庭案件事件的非參與者：
(a) the person is a party to the proceeding (other than the applicant); and
(a) 該人是訴訟的一方（申請人除外）；和
(b) the proceeding relates to a decision for which the person is the decision ‑ maker; and
(b) 該程序涉及該人作為決策者的決定；和
(c) the Tribunal case event and proceeding are of a kind for which the person has given an election notice under paragraph 60(1)(b); and
(c) 仲裁庭案件事件和程序屬於該人已根據第 60(1)(b) 段發出選舉通知的類型；和
(d) the proceeding is not a guidance and appeals panel proceeding; and
(d) 該程序不是指導和上訴小組程序；和
(e) any conditions prescribed by the rules for the purposes of this paragraph are satisfied; and
(e) 滿足本款規定的任何條件；和
(f) the Tribunal has not decided under section 62 that the person is to participate in the Tribunal case event; and
(f) 仲裁庭尚未根據第 62 條決定該人參加仲裁庭案件活動；和
(g) the Tribunal has not ordered the person to participate in the Tribunal case event under section 63.
(g) 仲裁庭沒有根據第 63 條命令該人參加仲裁庭案件活動。
Note: A non ‑ participating party remains a party to the proceeding and still needs to comply with this Act and orders of the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding. However, certain requirements do not apply to the party (see, for example, section 83 which deals with removal of a party for failure to appear or non ‑ compliance).
註：非參與方仍然是訴訟的一方，並且仍然需要遵守本法和法庭與訴訟有關的命令。然而，某些要求不適用於該當事人（例如，請參閱第 83 條，其中涉及因未出庭或不遵守而將當事人除名的情況）。
(2) To avoid doubt, once the Tribunal decides under section 62 that a person is to participate in a proceeding or Tribunal case event, or orders the person to participate in a proceeding or Tribunal case event under section 63, the person is no longer a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or Tribunal case event and a new election notice does not affect this.
(2) 為避免疑義，一旦仲裁庭根據第 62 條決定某人參加訴訟或仲裁庭案件活動，或根據第 63 條命令該人參加訴訟或仲裁庭案件活動，則該人不再是訴訟或仲裁庭案件活動的非參與方，並且新的選舉通知不會影響這一點。
Prescribed circumstances
規定的情況
(3) A person is also a non ‑ participating party to a proceeding or Tribunal case event in the circumstances prescribed by the rules.
(3) 在規則規定的情況下，一個人也是訴訟程序或法庭案件事件的非參與者。

title: 62 Tribunal may allow non ‑ participating party to participate
zh: 62 仲裁庭可允許非參與方參與
text:
(1) If a non ‑ participating party to a proceeding gives the Tribunal written notice (a participation notice ) that the party wishes to participate in the proceeding, the Tribunal must decide whether or not the party is to participate in the proceeding.
(1) 如果未參與訴訟的一方向仲裁庭發出書面通知（參與通知）表明該方希望參加該程序，則仲裁庭必須決定該方是否參與該程序。
Note: An election notice relates to a kind of proceeding. A participation notice relates to a particular proceeding of that kind. The election notice continues to apply to other proceedings of that kind.
註：選舉通知涉及一種程序。參與通知涉及此類特定程序。選舉通知繼續適用於此類其他程序。
(1A) If a non ‑ participating party to a Tribunal case event gives the Tribunal written notice (a participation notice ) that the party wishes to participate in the Tribunal case event, the Tribunal must decide whether or not the party is to participate in the Tribunal case event.
(1A) 若仲裁庭案件活動的非參與方向仲裁庭發出書面通知（參與通知），表示該方希望參與仲裁庭案件活動，則仲裁庭必須決定該方是否參與仲裁庭案件活動。
Note: An election notice relates to a kind of Tribunal case event in relation to a kind of proceeding. A participation notice relates to a particular Tribunal case event of that kind. The election notice continues to apply to other Tribunal case events of that kind in relation to proceedings of that kind.
註：選舉通知涉及與某種程序有關的某種法庭案件事件。參與通知涉及特定的仲裁庭案件事件。此選舉通知繼續適用於與此類程序相關的其他法庭案件事件。
(2) A participation notice is not a legislative instrument.
(2) 參與通知並非立法文書。

title: 63 Non ‑ participating party may give submissions or be required to participate
zh: 63 非參與方可以提交意見或被要求參與
text:
Written submissions may be provided
可以提供書面意見
(1) A non ‑ participating party to a proceeding may give the Tribunal written submissions in relation to the proceeding.
(1) 訴訟的非參與者可以向仲裁庭提交與訴訟相關的書面意見。
(1A) A non ‑ participating party to a Tribunal case event may give the Tribunal written submissions in relation to the Tribunal case event.
(1A) 仲裁庭案件活動的非參與者可以向仲裁庭提供與仲裁庭案件活動相關的書面意見。
Tribunal may order non ‑ participating party to participate, appear or provide written submissions
仲裁庭可命令非參與方參與、出庭或提供書面陳述
(2) The Tribunal may order a non ‑ participating party to a proceeding or Tribunal case event in relation to a proceeding to do any one or more of the following, if the Tribunal considers it would assist in progressing the proceeding or in making the correct or preferable decision:
(2) 如果仲裁庭認為這有助於推進訴訟或做出正確或更好的決定，則仲裁庭可以命令未參與訴訟或與訴訟有關的仲裁庭案件事件的當事人採取以下一項或多項行動：
(a) appear before the Tribunal at a Tribunal case event in relation to the proceeding;
(a) 在與訴訟程序相關的法庭案件事件中出庭；
(b) give the Tribunal written submissions in relation to the proceeding or a Tribunal case event in relation to the proceeding;
(b) 向仲裁庭提供與訴訟程序相關的書面意見或與訴訟程序相關的仲裁庭案件事件；
(c) participate in the proceeding.
(c) 參與訴訟程序。

title: 64 Rules may deal with elections in relation to participation
zh: 64 規則可涉及與參與有關的選舉
text:
(1) The rules may provide for or in relation to:
(1) 規則可規定或涉及下列事項：
(a) the operation of sections 60 to 63; and
(a) 第 60 至 63 條的實施；和
(b) the operation of this Part in relation to parties who are or who have been non ‑ participating parties to proceedings or Tribunal case events.
(b) 本部分對於現在或曾經不參與訴訟程序或法庭案件事件的當事人的適用。
(2) Without limiting the scope of rules that may be made for the purposes of subsection (1), the rules may provide for the following:
(2) 在不限制為第 (1) 款目的而製定的規則範圍的情況下，規則可規定以下內容：
(a) requirements for giving election notices or participation notices;
(a) 發出選舉通知或參與通知的要求；
(b) publication of election notices or participation notices;
(b) 發布選舉通知或參與通知；
(c) matters relating to steps in a proceeding taken while a person is a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or a Tribunal case event in relation to the proceeding.
(c) 與某人作為程序的非參與方或與程序有關的法庭案件事件時所採取的程序步驟有關的事項。

title: 65 Certain parties may seek to withdraw from being a party
zh: 65 某些當事人可能會尋求退出當事人身份
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The Tribunal may order that a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal ceases to be a party to the proceeding if the party gives written notice to the Tribunal that the party wishes to cease being a party to the proceeding.
(1) 如果仲裁庭程序的一方向仲裁庭發出書面通知，表示其希望不再是訴訟的一方，仲裁庭可以命令該方不再是該程序的一方。
Exceptions—applicant and decision ‑ maker
例外情況－申請人和決策者
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply in relation to the following parties:
(2) 但是，第 (1) 款不適用於下列各方：
(a) in any case—the applicant;
(a) 在任何情況下－申請人；
(b) if the proceeding relates to a decision—the decision ‑ maker.
(b) 如果訴訟涉及一項決定－決策者。
Note: The applicant may withdraw the application (see section 95).
註：申請人可以撤回申請（參見第 95 條）。

title: 66 Representation before Tribunal
text:
General rules
一般規則
(1) A party to a proceeding in the Tribunal may choose another person to represent the party in the proceeding.
(1) 仲裁庭訴訟的一方可以選擇另一人代表該方參與訴訟。
(2) A person who is required or permitted to appear before the Tribunal may, with the permission of the Tribunal, choose another person to represent the person before the Tribunal.
(2) 被要求或允許出庭的人，經仲裁庭許可，可以選擇另一人代表該人出庭。
Exception
例外
(3) However, the Tribunal may order that a person is not to be represented by the person’s representative if the Tribunal considers that:
(3) 然而，如果仲裁庭認為以下情況，仲裁庭可以命令某人不得由該人的代表代理：
(a) the representative has a conflict of interest in representing the person; or
(a) 代表在代表該人時有利益衝突；或
(b) the representative is not acting in the best interests of the person; or
(b) 該代表的行為不符合該人的最大利益；或
(c) representation of the person by the representative presents a safety risk to any person; or
(c) 由代表代表該人對任何人構成安全風險；或
(d) representation of the person by the representative presents an unacceptable privacy risk to any person; or
(d) 由代表代表該人會給任何人帶來不可接受的隱私風險；或
(e) the representative is otherwise impeding the Tribunal.
(e) 該代表以其他方式妨礙仲裁庭審理。
Note: A party to the proceeding can choose another representative. A person required or permitted to appear before the Tribunal can seek the Tribunal’s permission to choose another representative.
註：訴訟一方可以選擇另一位代表。被要求或允許出庭的人可以尋求仲裁庭的許可來選擇另一位代表。

title: 67 Tribunal may appoint litigation supporter
zh: 67 仲裁庭可指定訴訟支援人
text:
Appointment of litigation supporter
指定訴訟支援人
(1) The Tribunal may, by order, appoint a person to be a litigation supporter for a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal if the Tribunal considers that:
(1) 如果仲裁庭認為：
(a) the party does not have decision ‑ making ability; and
(a) 當事人不具備決策能力；和
(b) the appointment is necessary, taking into account the availability and suitability of other measures that would allow the party to participate in the proceeding.
(b) 考慮到允許當事人參與訴訟的其他措施的可用性和適當性，指定是必要的。
(1A) In considering whether to make an order under subsection (1), it is to be presumed that a party to a proceeding has decision ‑ making ability.
(1A) 在考慮是否依據第(1)款下達命令時，應假定訴訟當事人具有決策能力。
(1B) The presumption is not rebutted solely on the basis that a party has a disability.
(1B) 該推定不能僅因為一方有殘疾而被反駁。
(2) In appointing a person to be a litigation supporter for a party to a proceeding, the Tribunal must take into account:
(2) 在指定某人為訴訟一方的訴訟支援人時，仲裁庭必須考慮：
(a) the party’s will and preferences, or likely will and preferences, in relation to:
(a) 當事人的意願和偏好，或可能的意願和偏好，涉及：
(i) whether the Tribunal should appoint a person to be a litigation supporter; and
(i) 審裁處是否應指定一人為訴訟支援人；和
(ii) who the Tribunal should appoint to be a litigation supporter; or
(ii) 仲裁庭應指定誰為訴訟支援人；或
(b) if the party’s will and preferences, or likely will and preferences, cannot be ascertained—the personal and social wellbeing of the party.
(b) 若無法確定該方的意願和偏好，或可能的意願和偏好－該方的個人和社會福祉。
(3) The Tribunal may appoint a person to be a litigation supporter for a party to a proceeding only if:
(3) 只有在下列情況下，仲裁庭才可以指定某人為訴訟一方的訴訟支持者：
(a) the person is at least 18 years old; and
(a) 該人已年滿 18 歲；和
(b) the person has no conflict of interest in representing the party; and
(b) 該人在代表當事人時不存在利益衝突；和
(c) the person consents to the appointment; and
(c) 該人同意該任命；和
(d) the Tribunal considers that the person is able to meet the requirements in subsections (6) to (8); and
(d) 仲裁庭認為該人能夠滿足第(6)至(8)款的要求；和
(e) any conditions prescribed by the rules for the purposes of this paragraph are satisfied.
(e) 符合本款規定的規則規定的任何條件。
(4) The Tribunal may appoint a person to be a litigation supporter for a party whether or not the party has a guardian or representative appointed under another law.
(4) 仲裁庭可以指定一人為當事人的訴訟支援人，不論該當事人是否有依其他法律指定的監護人或代表。
Role of litigation supporter
訴訟支持者的角色
(5) If a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal has a litigation supporter:
(5) 如果仲裁庭訴訟的當事人有訴訟支持者：
(a) the party may participate in the proceeding:
(a) 當事人可以參與訴訟：
(i) wherever possible—with the support of the litigation supporter; or
(i) 只要有可能－在訴訟支持者的支持下；或
(ii) otherwise—by the litigation supporter; and
(ii) 否則－由訴訟支持者提出；和
(b) the litigation supporter must do anything required to be done by the party in relation to the proceeding by an Act or an instrument under an Act; and
(b) 訴訟支持者必須依照法案或法案下的文書要求當事人完成與訴訟程序相關的任何事情；和
(c) the litigation supporter may do anything permitted to be done by the party in relation to the proceeding by an Act or an instrument under an Act.
(c) 訴訟支持者可以根據法案或法案下的文書進行與訴訟相關的當事人允許做的任何事情。
Duty of litigation supporter
訴訟支持人的義務
(6) If a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal has a litigation supporter, the litigation supporter must give effect to the party’s will and preferences, or likely will and preferences, in relation to the proceeding.
(6) 如果仲裁庭訴訟的當事人有訴訟支持人，則訴訟支持人必須落實該方與訴訟相關的意願和偏好，或可能的意願和偏好。
(7) However, if to do so would pose a serious risk to the party’s personal and social wellbeing, the litigation supporter must instead act in a manner that promotes the personal and social wellbeing of the party.
(7) 但是，如果這樣做會對當事人的個人和社會福祉帶來嚴重風險，訴訟支援人必須以有利於當事人的個人和社會福祉的方式行事。
(8) If the party’s will and preferences, or likely will and preferences, cannot be ascertained, the litigation supporter must act in a manner that promotes the personal and social wellbeing of the party.
(8) 如果無法確定當事人的意願和偏好，或可能的意願和偏好，訴訟支持者的行為方式必須有利於當事人的個人和社會福祉。
Resignation and removal of litigation supporter
訴訟支持者的辭職和撤職
(9) A litigation supporter may resign by giving the Tribunal a written resignation.
（九）訴訟支援人可以向仲裁庭提出書面辭職。
(10) The Tribunal may, by order, remove a party’s litigation supporter if:
(10) 在下列情況下，仲裁庭可以命令取消當事人的訴訟支援人：
(a) the party requests a different person be appointed to be a litigation supporter for the party; or
(a) 當事人請求指定其他人為當事人的訴訟支援人；或
(b) the Tribunal considers that the party has decision ‑ making ability; or
(b) 仲裁庭認為當事人具有決策能力；或
(c) the Tribunal considers that:
(c) 仲裁庭認為：
(i) the litigation supporter has a conflict of interest in representing the party; or
(i) 訴訟支援人在代理當事人時有利益衝突；或
(ii) the litigation supporter has not complied with subsections (6) to (8); or
（二）訴訟支援人未遵守第（六）款至第（八）款規定的；或
(iii) representation of the party by the litigation supporter presents a safety risk to any person; or
(iii) 訴訟支持者代表當事人對任何人構成安全風險；或
(iv) representation of the party by the litigation supporter presents an unacceptable privacy risk to any person; or
(iv) 訴訟支持者代表當事人會給任何人帶來不可接受的隱私風險；或
(v) the litigation supporter is otherwise impeding the Tribunal.
(v) 訴訟支持者有其他妨礙仲裁庭審理的行為。
Rules
規則
(11) The rules may provide for matters relating to litigation supporters.
（十一）本規則可以對訴訟支持人的相關事項作出規定。
(12) Without limiting the scope of rules that may be made for the purposes of subsection (11), the rules may provide for or in relation to the following:
（12）在不限制為第（11）款目的而製定的規則範圍的情況下，規則可以規定以下內容或與以下內容相關：
(a) costs relating to litigation supporters;
(a) 與訴訟支持者有關的費用；
(b) giving documents to a litigation supporter or a party who has a litigation supporter.
(b) 向訴訟支援人或有訴訟支援人的當事人提供文件。

title: 68 Tribunal may appoint interpreter
text:
Tribunal may appoint interpreter on request
仲裁庭可應要求指定口譯員
(1) A person appearing at a Tribunal case event may request the Tribunal to appoint an interpreter for the person.
(1) 出席法庭案件活動的人員可以請法庭為其指派口譯員。
(2) The Tribunal must comply with the request unless the Tribunal considers that the person does not require an interpreter for the purposes of:
(2) 仲裁庭必須遵守該請求，除非仲裁庭認為該人出於以下目的不需要口譯員：
(a) communication with the Tribunal; or
(a) 與法庭的溝通；或
(b) understanding evidence and submissions given to the Tribunal.
(b) 了解向法庭提交的證據和陳詞。
Tribunal must appoint interpreter in certain circumstances
在某些情況下，仲裁庭必須指定口譯員
(3) If:
(3) 如果：
(a) the Tribunal considers that a person appearing at a Tribunal case event requires an interpreter for the purposes of:
(a) 仲裁庭認為出席仲裁庭案件活動的人員為下列目的而需要口譯員：
(i) communication with the Tribunal; or
(i) 與仲裁庭的溝通；或
(ii) understanding evidence and submissions given to the Tribunal; and
(ii) 了解向仲裁庭提交的證據和陳詞；和
(b) the person does not request the Tribunal to appoint an interpreter;
(b) 該人沒有請求仲裁庭指定口譯員；
the Tribunal must, on its own initiative, appoint an interpreter for the purposes of communication between the person and the Tribunal.
仲裁庭必須主動指定一名口譯員，以便該人與仲裁庭之間進行溝通。
Conflict of interest
利益衝突
(4) The Tribunal may appoint a person to be an interpreter for another person only if the person has no conflict of interest in acting as an interpreter for the other person.
(4) 只有當該人在擔任另一人的口譯員時不存在利益衝突時，仲裁庭才可以指定該人擔任另一人的口譯員。
Tribunal may appoint interpreters in other situations
仲裁庭可以在其他情況下指定口譯員
(5) Subsections (2) and (3) do not limit the power of the Tribunal to appoint an interpreter.
(5) 第 (2) 和 (3) 款不限制仲裁庭指定口譯員的權力。
Oath or affirmation for interpreter
口譯員宣誓或誓詞
(6) The Tribunal may require an interpreter appointed by the Tribunal to take an oath or make an affirmation. A member or a staff member may administer an oath or affirmation to the interpreter.
(6) 仲裁庭可要求仲裁庭指定的口譯員宣誓或作出聲明。成員或工作人員可以向口譯員宣誓或宣誓。
(7) The oath or affirmation is an oath or affirmation that the interpretation the interpreter will give will be true.
(7) 宣誓或聲明是指口譯員所提供的解釋是真實的宣誓或聲明。

title: Division 6 — Tribunal powers
zh: 第 6 分部 — 仲裁庭的權力

title: Subdivision A — Hearings and evidence
zh: A 部分－聽證會和證據

title: 69 Hearings to be in public unless practice directions or Tribunal order requires otherwise
zh: 69 聽證會應公開進行，除非實務指示或法庭命令另有要求
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal must be in public.
(1) 法庭審理訴訟必須公開。
Note: The hearing of a proceeding is the substantive hearing of the matter before the Tribunal. Directions hearings do not need to be in public (see the definition of hearing of a proceeding in section 4).
註：訴訟聽證會是法庭對事項的實質聽證會。指示聽證會無需公開（請參閱第 4 節中訴訟聽證會的定義）。
Exception—practice directions may require private hearing
例外－實踐指導可能需要私人聽證會
(2) Despite subsection (1), in the circumstances specified in the practice directions:
(2) 儘管有第(1)款的規定，在實務指引中規定的情況下：
(a) the hearing or part of the hearing is to take place in private; and
(a) 聽證會或部分聽證會非公開進行；和
(b) only the persons specified in the practice directions may be present.
(b) 只有實務指示中指定的人員可以在場。
Exception—Tribunal may require private hearing
例外－仲裁庭可能要求舉行私人聽證會
(3) Despite subsection (1), the Tribunal may, by order:
(3) 儘管有第(1)款的規定，仲裁庭可以通過命令：
(a) direct that the hearing or part of the hearing is to take place in private; and
(a) 指示聽證會或部分聽證會非公開進行；和
(b) give directions in relation to the persons who may be present.
(b) 就可能在場的人員發出指示。
Note: The power must be exercised in accordance with section 71.
註：該權力必須依照第 71 條的規定行使。

title: 70 Tribunal may restrict publication or disclosure of information
zh: 70 仲裁庭可以限制資訊的發布或揭露
text:
Information about parties, witnesses and others
有關當事人、證人和其他人的信息
(1) The Tribunal may, by order, give directions prohibiting or restricting the publication or other disclosure of:
(1) 仲裁庭可以透過命令發出指示，禁止或限制公佈或以其他方式揭露：
(a) information tending to reveal the identity of:
(a) 可能揭示下列身分的資訊：
(i) a party to or witness in a proceeding in the Tribunal; or
(i) 法庭訴訟的當事人或證人；或
(ii) any person related to or otherwise associated with any party to or witness in a proceeding in the Tribunal; or
(ii) 與仲裁庭訴訟的任何一方或證人有關或以其他方式關聯的任何人；或
(b) information otherwise concerning a party, witness or other person mentioned in paragraph (a).
(b) 有關(a)段所述的當事人、證人或其他人的其他資訊。
Note 1: The power must be exercised in accordance with section 71.
註1：該權力必須依照第71條的規定行使。
Note 2: Breach of a non ‑ publication or non ‑ disclosure order is an offence (see section 119).
註 2：違反不公開或不揭露命令屬於犯罪行為（參閱第 119 條）。
Information relating to proceeding
與訴訟有關的信息
(2) The Tribunal may, by order, give directions prohibiting or restricting the publication or other disclosure of information that:
(2) 仲裁庭可以透過命令發出指示，禁止或限制發布或以其他方式揭露以下資訊：
(a) relates to a proceeding in the Tribunal; and
(a) 與法庭的訴訟程序有關；和
(b) is any of the following:
(b) 是以下任何一項：
(i) information that comprises evidence or information about evidence;
(i) 包含證據或有關證據的資訊的資訊；
(ii) information given to the Tribunal.
(ii) 向仲裁庭提供的資訊。
Note 1: The power must be exercised in accordance with section 71.
註1：該權力必須依照第71條的規定行使。
Note 2: Breach of a non ‑ publication or non ‑ disclosure order is an offence (see section 119).
註 2：違反不公開或不揭露命令屬於犯罪行為（參閱第 119 條）。
(3) Without limiting subsection (2), the order may prohibit or restrict the publication or other disclosure to some or all of the parties to the proceeding.
(3) 在不限制第 (2) 款的情況下，該命令可以禁止或限制向訴訟的部分或全部當事人公佈或以其他方式披露。
Order can be made on application or on Tribunal’s initiative
可以根據申請或仲裁庭的倡議下達命令
(4) The Tribunal may make an order under this section on application by a person or on its own initiative.
(4) 仲裁庭可應個人申請或自行依本條作出命令。

title: 71 Requirements for Tribunal orders about hearings, publication and disclosure
zh: 71 法庭關於聽證會、公佈和披露的命令的要求
text:
Practice directions
練習方向
(1) In making an order under subsection 69(3) or section 70, the Tribunal must comply with the requirements (if any) specified in the practice directions.
(1) 在依據第 69(3) 款或第 70 條作出命令時，仲裁庭必須遵守實務指示中規定的要求（如果有）。
Considerations
注意事項
(2) In considering whether to make an order under subsection 69(3) or section 70 in relation to a proceeding, the Tribunal must have regard to the following:
(2) 在考慮是否依據第 69 條第(3)款或第 70 條就訴訟程序作出命令時，仲裁庭必須考慮下列因素：
(a) the principle that it is desirable that hearings of proceedings in the Tribunal are held in public;
(a) 法庭審理程序最好公開舉行的原則；
(b) the principle that it is desirable that evidence given before the Tribunal is made available to the public;
(b) 向法庭提供的證據最好向公眾公開的原則；
(c) the principle that it is desirable that evidence given before the Tribunal and the contents of documents given to the Tribunal are made available to all the parties to the proceeding;
(c) 向仲裁庭提供的證據和向仲裁庭提供的文件的內容最好向訴訟的所有當事方提供的原則；
(d) any reasons in favour of making an order, including the following:
(d) 有利於下達命令的任何理由，包括以下內容：
(i) in any case—the circumstances of the parties to the proceeding and other persons connected to the proceeding;
(i) 在任何情況下－訴訟當事人以及與訴訟有關的其他人員的情況；
(ii) in any case—the harm (if any) that is likely to occur to a person if the order is not made;
(ii) 在任何情況下－如果不下達命令，人員可能遭受的傷害（如有）；
(iii) in relation to an order under section 70—the confidential nature (if any) of the information;
(iii) 就第 70 條的命令而言－資訊的保密性質（如有）；
(e) any other matters that the Tribunal considers relevant.
(e) 仲裁庭認為相關的任何其他事項。

title: 72 Tribunal must notify parties of Tribunal case event
zh: 72 仲裁庭必須將仲裁庭案件事件通知當事人
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) Before a Tribunal case event in relation to a proceeding, the Tribunal must give written notice to the parties to the proceeding of the date, time and place of the Tribunal case event.
(1) 在與訴訟相關的仲裁庭案件事件發生之前，仲裁庭必須向訴訟各方發出書面通知，告知仲裁庭案件事件的日期、時間和地點。
Exception—non ‑ participating party
例外－非參與方
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or Tribunal case event.
(2) 第(1)款不適用於訴訟或仲裁庭案件事件的非參與方。

title: 73 How a party may appear at a Tribunal case event
zh: 73 一方如何出席仲裁庭案件活動
text:
(1) Parties to proceedings may appear at Tribunal case events:
(1) 訴訟各方可出席仲裁庭案件活動：
(a) themselves; or
(a) 他們自己；或
(b) unless subsection (2) applies—through a representative.
(b) 除非第(2)款適用－透過代表。
(2) The Tribunal may order a party to a proceeding to appear at a Tribunal case event in relation to the proceeding personally, whether or not the party’s representative also appears.
(2) 仲裁庭可以命令訴訟當事人親自出席與訴訟相關的仲裁庭案件活動，無論該當事人的代表是否也出席。
(3) Subsection (2) does not apply in relation to the decision ‑ maker in a proceeding that relates to a decision.
(3) 第(2)款不適用於與決定有關的訴訟中的決定者。

title: 74 Tribunal may summon person to give evidence or produce documents
zh: 74 仲裁庭可傳喚某人提供證據或出示文件
text:
Power to issue summons
發出傳票的權力
(1) If the Tribunal has reasonable grounds to believe that a person has information, or a document or thing, relevant to a proceeding in the Tribunal, the Tribunal may, in writing, summon the person to do either or both of the following, on the day, and at the time and place, specified in the summons:
(1) 如果仲裁庭有合理的理由相信某人擁有與仲裁庭訴訟相關的資訊、文件或物品，仲裁庭可以書面傳喚該人在傳票中指定的日期、時間和地點執行以下一項或兩項操作：
(a) appear before the Tribunal to give evidence;
(a) 出庭作證；
(b) produce any document or thing specified in the summons.
(b) 出示傳票中指定的任何文件或物品。
(2) Except with the consent of the person being summoned, the day specified in the summons must be at least 14 days after the day the summons is given to the person.
(2) 除非經傳喚人同意，傳票中指定的日期必須至少為傳票給該人之日起 14 天。
(3) The Tribunal may summon the person:
(3) 仲裁庭可以傳喚該人：
(a) at the request of a party to the proceeding; or
(a) 應訴訟一方的請求；或
(b) on its own initiative.
(b) 自行主動。
(4) The Tribunal may refuse a request for a person to be summoned.
(4) 仲裁庭可以拒絕傳喚某人的請求。
Early compliance with summons
及早遵守傳票
(5) A person may comply with a summons to produce a document or thing by producing the document or thing to the Tribunal before the day specified in the summons.
(5) 任何人可以在傳票指定的日期之前向仲裁庭出示文件或物品，以遵守出示文件或物品的傳票。
(6) If the person does so, the person is not required to appear before the Tribunal unless:
(6) 如果該人這樣做，則該人無需出庭，除非：
(a) the summons or another summons requires the person to appear before the Tribunal; or
(a) 傳票或另一傳票要求該人出庭；或
(b) the Tribunal orders the person to appear before the Tribunal.
(b) 仲裁庭命令該人出庭。
Note 1: A person might commit an offence by failing to comply with a summons (see section 116).
註 1：任何人可能因不遵守傳票而構成犯罪（見第 116 條）。
Note 2: A person summoned under this section may be entitled to be paid fees or allowances under section 77. However, the person is not excused from complying with a summons only because the person thinks that an amount paid to the person under that section is not sufficient.
註 2：依本條被傳喚的人可能有資格依第 77 條獲得費用或津貼。但是，該人不能僅因為該人認為根據該條支付給該人的金額不足而免除遵守傳票。

title: 75 Tribunal may take evidence
text:
The Tribunal may take evidence, including on oath or by affirmation, inside or outside Australia.
法庭可以在澳洲境內或境外取得證據，包括宣誓或確認的證據。

title: 76 Taking evidence on oath or affirmation
text:
(1) At the hearing of a proceeding or a directions hearing in relation to a proceeding:
(1) 在訴訟聽證會或與訴訟有關的指示聽證會上：
(a) the Tribunal may require a person appearing before the Tribunal to give evidence to take an oath or make an affirmation; and
(a) 仲裁庭可要求出庭人員作證宣誓或作出確認；和
(b) a member or a staff member may administer an oath or affirmation to the person.
(b) 成員或工作人員可以向該人宣誓或宣誓。
Note 1: Failure to take an oath or make an affirmation is an offence (see section 117).
註 1：未宣誓或作出確認即屬違法（參閱第 117 條）。
Note 2: The hearing is a judicial proceeding for the purposes of Part III of the Crimes Act 1914 , which creates various offences in relation to such proceedings.
註 2：聽證會是一項司法程序，符合 1914 年《犯罪法》第三部分的規定，該法規定了與此類程序相關的各種犯罪行為。
(2) The oath or affirmation is an oath or affirmation that the evidence the person will give will be true.
(2) 宣誓或誓言是指該人所提供的證據是真實的。
(3) The Tribunal may allow a person appearing before the Tribunal at the hearing of a proceeding, or a directions hearing in relation to a proceeding, who has taken an oath or made an affirmation, to give evidence by tendering a written statement and verifying it by oath or affirmation.
(3) 仲裁庭可以允許出庭出席訴訟聽證會或與訴訟有關的指示聽證會的、已宣誓或作出確認的人透過提交書面陳述並透過宣誓或確認進行核實的方式提供證據。
Note: A person might commit an offence if the person provides false or misleading evidence (see section 118).
注意：如果提供虛假或誤導性證據，則可能構成犯罪（參見第 118 條）。

title: 77 Payment of witness fees and allowances
text:
Entitlement to fees and allowances
享受費用和津貼的權利
(1) A person required by this Act, another Act or an instrument made under an Act to give information or produce or give a document or thing to the Tribunal is to be paid, in accordance with the rules, any fees, and any allowances for expenses, prescribed by the rules for compliance with the requirement.
(1) 本法、其他法案或根據某項法案製定的文書要求向法庭提供資訊或出示或提供文件或物品的人，應按照規則規定支付任何費用和任何費用補貼，以符合要求。
Rules concerning fees and allowances
有關費用和津貼的規則
(2) Without limiting the scope of rules that may be made for the purposes of subsection (1), those rules may prescribe, or prescribe matters relating to, any or all of the following:
（2）在不限制為第（1）款目的而製定的規則範圍的情況下，這些規則可以規定以下任何或全部內容，或規定與以下任何或所有內容有關的事項：
(a) the circumstances in which a person is to be paid;
(a) 支付某人報酬的情況；
(b) the circumstances in which a person is not to be paid;
(b) 不應向某人支付報酬的情況；
(c) who must pay;
(c) 誰必須付款；
(d) the time when payment is required.
(d) 要求付款的時間。
(3) Rules made for the purposes of subsection (1) may do any or all of the following:
(3) 為第 (1) 款目的而製定的規則可以執行以下任何或全部操作：
(a) prescribe the amount of, or a method for working out the amount of, a fee or allowance;
(a) 規定費用或津貼的金額或計算金額的方法；
(b) make provision in relation to the whole or a part of a fee or allowance;
(b) 就全部或部分費用或津貼作出規定；
(c) provide for the Tribunal to make orders relating to the payment of a fee or allowance in relation to a proceeding.
(c) 規定仲裁庭可以作出有關支付訴訟費用或津貼的命令。

title: 78 Inspection of documents produced under summons
zh: 78 檢驗傳票下出示的文件
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) A party to a proceeding may inspect or take a copy of a document or thing produced under a summons under section 74 in relation to the proceeding:
(1) 訴訟當事人可以檢查或取得根據第 74 條傳票出示的與訴訟有關的文件或物品的副本：
(a) in the circumstances specified in the practice directions; or
(a) 在執業指示中指定的情況下；或
(b) if the Tribunal permits.
(b) 若仲裁庭允許。
Exception—public interest certificate applies
例外－公共利益證明適用
(2) This section does not apply if there is a certificate under section 91 that relates to disclosure of the document or thing in the proceeding.
(2) 若依第 91 條有與程序中的文件或事物的揭露相關的證書，則本條不適用。
Exception—disclosure prohibited by law
例外－法律禁止披露
(3) Subsection (1) does not apply if the inspection or copying of the document or thing would result in a disclosure of information which is prohibited or restricted by or under this Act, another Act or an instrument made under an Act.
(3) 若檢查或複製文件或物品會導致本法、其他法或依某法制定的文書所禁止或限制的資訊的揭露，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: The disclosure of information may be prohibited or restricted by Tribunal order under section 70.
註：仲裁庭根據第 70 條發出的命令可能會禁止或限制資訊揭露。
Exception—person objects
例外－人對象
(4) The person required to produce the document or thing, or any party to the proceeding, may give the Tribunal notice that the person or party objects to the document or thing being inspected or copied.
(4) 被要求出示文件或物品的人或訴訟的任何一方可以向仲裁庭發出通知，表明該人或當事人反對檢查或複製文件或物品。
(5) A notice under subsection (4):
(5) 第(4)款規定的通知：
(a) may be made in writing or in any other manner specified in the practice directions; and
(a) 可以書面或實踐指示中規定的任何其他方式作出；和
(b) must contain reasons for the objection.
(b) 必須包含反對的理由。
(6) If a notice is given under subsection (4), the Tribunal must decide whether the document or thing may be inspected or copied by a party to the proceeding.
(6) 若依第 (4) 款發出通知，仲裁庭必須決定訴訟一方是否可以檢查或複製該文件或物品。

title: Subdivision B — Management of proceedings
zh: B 部分 — 訴訟程序管理

title: 79 Tribunal may give directions in relation to procedure for proceeding
zh: 79 仲裁庭可就訴訟程序發出指示

title: 80 Tribunal may hold directions hearing
zh: 80 法庭可舉行指示聽證會
text:
The Tribunal may hold a directions hearing in relation to a proceeding in the Tribunal.
仲裁庭可就仲裁庭的訴訟程序舉行指示聽證會。

title: 81 Tribunal may proceed without absent party
zh: 81 仲裁庭可在當事人缺席的情況下繼續進行
text:
The Tribunal may proceed with a Tribunal case event that relates to a proceeding in the absence of a party to the proceeding if the Tribunal is satisfied that the party received appropriate notice of the date, time and place of the Tribunal case event.
如果仲裁庭確信當事人收到了有關仲裁庭案件事件的日期、時間和地點的適當通知，則仲裁庭可以在訴訟當事人缺席的情況下繼續審理與訴訟程序相關的仲裁庭案件事件。

title: 82 Tribunal may adjourn Tribunal case event
zh: 82 法庭可押後法庭案件事件
text:
The Tribunal may adjourn a Tribunal case event that relates to a proceeding in the Tribunal from time to time.
仲裁庭可能會不時延遲與仲裁庭訴訟程序相關的仲裁庭案件事件。

title: 83 Tribunal may remove party from proceeding if party fails to appear or does not comply
zh: 83 若當事人未出庭或不遵守規定，仲裁庭可以將當事人從訴訟程序中剔除
text:
Tribunal may remove party who fails to appear
仲裁庭可將未出庭的一方驅逐出境
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal fails to appear at a Tribunal case event that relates to the proceeding; and
(a) 仲裁庭訴訟的一方未出席與該訴訟相關的仲裁庭案件活動；和
(b) the Tribunal is satisfied that the party received appropriate notice of the date, time and place of the Tribunal case event;
(b) 仲裁庭確信當事人已收到有關仲裁庭案件事件的日期、時間和地點的適當通知；
the Tribunal may order that the party ceases to be a party to the proceeding.
仲裁庭可以命令該方不再是訴訟的一方。
Note 1: Tribunal case events include hearings, directions hearings and dispute resolution processes (see the definition of Tribunal case event in section 4).
註1：仲裁庭案件事件包括聽證會、指示聽證會及爭議解決程序（請參閱第4節仲裁庭案件事件的定義）。
Note 2: For how to appear at a Tribunal case event, see section 73.
註 2：有關如何出席仲裁庭案件活動，請參閱第 73 條。
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply if the party is:
(2) 但是，若當事人屬於下列情況，則第 (1) 款不適用：
(a) the applicant; or
(a) 申請人；或
(b) a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or Tribunal case event.
(b) 訴訟或法庭案件活動的非參與者。
Tribunal may remove party who fails to comply with Act or order
仲裁庭可以驅逐不遵守法案或命令的一方
(3) If a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal fails to comply with this Act or an order of the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding within a reasonable time, the Tribunal may order that the party ceases to be a party to the proceeding.
(3) 若仲裁庭訴訟的一方未能在合理時間內遵守本法或仲裁庭有關該訴訟的命令，仲裁庭可以命令該方不再是該訴訟的一方。
(4) However, subsection (3) does not apply if the party is the applicant.
（4）但是，如果當事人是申請人，則第（3）款不適用。
Reinstatement
復職
(5) If a person ceases to be a party to a proceeding under subsection (1) or (3), the person is a party to the proceeding again if the Tribunal, on application by the person or on its own initiative, orders that the person is a party to the proceeding.
(5) 如果某人不再是第 (1) 或 (3) 款規定的訴訟當事人，且仲裁庭根據該人的申請或主動命令該人成為該訴訟的當事人，則該人再次成為該訴訟的當事人。

title: 84 If applicant dies or is bankrupt, wound up or in liquidation or administration
zh: 84 如果申請人死亡或破產、清盤、清算或管理
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies in relation to a proceeding in the Tribunal in relation to an application (the substantive application ) for review of a decision if:
(1) 本條適用於仲裁庭中有關複審決定的申請（實質申請）的程序，如果：
(a) the applicant:
(a) 申請人：
(i) dies; or
(i) 死亡；或
(ii) becomes bankrupt; or
(ii) 破產；或
(iii) is wound up or otherwise ceases to exist; or
(iii) 清盤或以其他方式不復存在；或
(iv) becomes subject to any form of liquidation or administration (however described); and
(iv) 接受任何形式的清算或管理（無論如何描述）；和
(b) the Tribunal considers that the applicant cannot continue with the substantive application because of the event mentioned in paragraph (a).
(b) 仲裁庭認為，由於(a)段所述的事件，申請人無法繼續進行實質申請。
Another person may apply to continue with substantive application
他人可申請繼續實質申請
(2) The following persons may apply to the Tribunal to continue with the substantive application:
(2)下列人員可以向仲裁庭申請繼續進行實質申請：
(a) a legal personal representative, executor, administrator, liquidator or trustee of the applicant for the substantive application;
(a) 實質申請申請人的法定個人代表、遺囑執行人、管理人、清算人或受託人；
(b) a person who would have been entitled to apply for review of the decision at the time the substantive application was made.
(b) 在提出實質申請時有權申請複審該決定的人。
(3) If a person applies to continue with the substantive application, the Tribunal may, on request or on its own initiative, give such orders as appear to the Tribunal to be appropriate in the circumstances.
(3) 如果某人申請繼續進行實質申請，仲裁庭可以根據請求或主動發出仲裁庭認為適合具體情況的命令。
Tribunal may dismiss substantive application
仲裁庭可駁回實質申請
(4) The Tribunal may dismiss the substantive application if:
(4) 在下列情況下，仲裁庭可以駁回實質申請：
(a) the Tribunal considers that there is no person mentioned in subsection (2) who can continue with the substantive application; or
(a) 仲裁庭認為第(2)款所提及的任何人均無法繼續進行實質申請；或
(b) no application to continue with the substantive application is made within 3 months after the Tribunal becomes aware of the event mentioned in paragraph (1)(a).
(b) 仲裁庭獲知第 (1)(a) 款所述事件後 3 個月內未提出繼續進行實質申請的申請。

title: 85 Tribunal may remit decision to decision ‑ maker for reconsideration
zh: 85 仲裁庭可將決定發回決策者重新考慮
text:
Tribunal may remit decision to decision ‑ maker
仲裁庭可將決定移交決策者
(1) At any time during a proceeding for review of a reviewable decision, the Tribunal may remit the decision to the decision ‑ maker and ask the decision ‑ maker to reconsider the decision.
(1) 在可覆核決定的任何時候，仲裁庭可將決定轉交決策者並要求決策者重新考慮該決定。
Decision ‑ maker must reconsider decision
決策者必須重新考慮決定
(2) If the Tribunal remits the decision to the decision ‑ maker, the decision ‑ maker must reconsider the decision and do one of the following:
(2) 如果仲裁庭將決定發回決策者，則決策者必須重新考慮該決定並執行以下操作之一：
(a) affirm the decision;
(a) 確認決定；
(b) vary the decision;
(b) 改變決定；
(c) set aside the decision and make a new decision in substitution for the decision set aside.
(c) 撤銷該決定並作出新的決定來代替被撤銷的決定。
After reconsideration
複議後
(3) After the decision ‑ maker complies with subsection (2), the proceeding resumes.
(3) 決策者遵守第(2)款後，程序恢復。
(4) The applicant may:
(4) 申請人可以：
(a) proceed with the application; or
(a) 繼續申請；或者
(b) withdraw the application under section 95.
(b) 依第 95 條撤回申請。
Review continues in relation to decision as updated by decision ‑ maker
繼續對決策者更新的決定進行審查
(5) If the decision ‑ maker varies the decision, the application for review of the decision is taken to be an application for review of the decision as varied instead.
（五）決策者改變決定的，該決定複審申請視為變更後的決定複審申請。
(6) If the decision ‑ maker sets aside the decision and makes a new decision in substitution for the decision set aside, the application for review of the decision is taken to be an application for review of the new decision instead.
（六）決策者撤銷該決定並作出新的決定代替撤銷的決定的，該決定的複審申請視為新決定的複審申請。
Timeframes for reconsideration
複議期限
(7) The decision ‑ maker must comply with subsection (2) within the period specified by the Tribunal when remitting the decision to the decision ‑ maker.
(7) 決策者必須在仲裁庭規定的期限內將決定轉交給決策者時遵守第(2)款的規定。
(8) However, the Tribunal may, on the application of the decision ‑ maker, extend the period within which the decision ‑ maker must comply with subsection (2).
(8) 然而，仲裁庭可以根據決策者的申請，延長決策者必須遵守第(2)款的期限。
(9) The decision ‑ maker is taken to have affirmed the decision if the decision ‑ maker does not comply with subsection (2) within the period specified by the Tribunal.
(9) 若決策者未在仲裁庭指定的期限內遵守第(2)款的規定，則視為決策者已確認該決定。
(10) For the purposes of subsection (9), take into account any extension under subsection (8) of the period that occurs before the period would otherwise expire.
(10) 就第 (9) 款而言，應考慮在期限屆滿之前根據第 (8) 款對期限進行的任何延長。

title: 86 Tribunal may vary or revoke Tribunal order
zh: 86 仲裁庭可以更改或撤銷仲裁庭命令
text:
Subject to this Act, a power of the Tribunal to make an order includes the power to revoke or vary the order.
根據本法，法庭作出命令的權力包括撤銷或更改命令的權力。

title: Subdivision C — Dispute resolution processes
zh: 細分 C — 爭議解決流程

title: 87 Tribunal may refer to dispute resolution process
zh: 87 仲裁庭可參考爭議解決程序
text:
General rules
一般規則
(1) At any time during a proceeding, the Tribunal may, by order:
(1) 在訴訟期間的任何時間，仲裁庭可以透過命令：
(a) direct that the proceeding, or any part of or matter arising out of the proceeding, be referred to a dispute resolution process; and
(a) 指示將訴訟或訴訟的任何部分或由訴訟引起的事項提交爭議解決程序；和
(b) direct any of the following persons to conduct the dispute resolution process:
(b) 指示以下任何人進行爭議解決程序：
(i) a member;
(i) 會員；
(ii) a registrar;
(ii) 登記官；
(iii) a person engaged under subsection 90(1).
(iii) 依第 90(1) 款受聘的人員。
Note: A non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or a Tribunal case event of that kind is not required to appear at the dispute resolution process unless the Tribunal orders the party to do so under section 63.
註：未參與訴訟或仲裁庭此類案件事件的一方無需出席爭議解決程序，除非仲裁庭根據第 63 條命令該方這樣做。
(2) The parties to the proceeding appearing at the dispute resolution process must act in good faith in relation to the conduct of the dispute resolution process.
(2) 出席爭議解決程序的訴訟各方必須真誠地處理爭議解決程序的進行。
Exception—guidance and appeals panel proceedings
例外－指導和上訴小組程序
(3) Despite subsection (1), the Tribunal must not direct that a guidance and appeals panel proceeding, or any part of or matter arising out of a guidance and appeals panel proceeding, be referred to a dispute resolution process other than conferencing.
(3) 儘管有第 (1) 款的規定，仲裁庭不得指示將指導和上訴小組程序或指導和上訴小組程序的任何部分或由指導和上訴小組程序引起的事項提交給會議以外的爭議解決程序。

title: 88 Evidence in dispute resolution process not admissible elsewhere
zh: 88 爭議解決過程中的證據在其他地方不可接受
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) Evidence of anything said, any act done or any information disclosed at or for the sole purpose of a dispute resolution process is not admissible:
(1) 在爭議解決過程中或僅出於爭議解決過程的目的而提出的任何言論、所做的任何行為或披露的任何資訊的證據均不予採信：
(a) in a proceeding in the Tribunal; or
(a) 在法庭的訴訟中；或
(b) in any court; or
(b) 在任何法庭；或
(c) in any proceedings before a person authorised by a law of the Commonwealth or of a State or Territory to hear evidence; or
(c) 在由澳洲聯邦或州或地區法律授權的人聽取證據的任何訴訟中；或
(d) in any proceedings before a person authorised by the consent of the parties to hear evidence.
(d) 在任何訴訟程序中，當事人同意授權的人聽取證據。
Exception—agreement of parties
例外情況－雙方協議
(2) Subsection (1) does not prevent the admission, at a proceeding in the Tribunal, of particular evidence if each party to the proceeding to which the dispute resolution process relates (other than a non ‑ participating party to that dispute resolution process or that proceeding) agrees to the evidence being admitted.
(2) 若與爭議解決程序相關的程序的每一方（該爭議解決程序或該程序的非參與方除外）都同意接受特定證據，則第（1）款並不阻止在仲裁庭的程序中接受特定證據。
Exception—certain reports admissible
例外－某些報告可以接受
(3) Subsection (1) does not prevent the admission, at a proceeding in the Tribunal, of a report prepared by a person conducting a dispute resolution process in the form of a neutral evaluation.
(3) 第 (1) 款並不妨礙在仲裁庭的訴訟中接受由進行爭議解決程序的人員以中立評估的形式編寫的報告。
(4) However, subsection (3) does not apply if, before the start of the hearing of the proceeding, a party to the proceeding to which the dispute resolution process relates notifies the Tribunal that the party objects to the report being admitted.
(4) 但是，如果在訴訟審理開始之前，與爭議解決程序相關的訴訟一方通知仲裁庭該方反對接受報告，則第 (3) 款不適用。

title: 89 Eligibility of person conducting dispute resolution process to sit as a member
zh: 89 執行爭議解決程序的人員擔任會員的資格
text:
A member of the Tribunal as constituted for the purposes of a proceeding must no longer take part in the proceeding if:
為訴訟目的而組成的法庭成員不得再參與訴訟，如果：
(a) the member conducts a dispute resolution process in relation to the proceeding; and
(a) 成員進行與訴訟相關的爭議解決程序；和
(b) a party to the proceeding notifies the Tribunal as soon as practicable after the dispute resolution process that the party objects to the member participating in the proceeding.
(b) 程序的一方在爭議解決程序後儘快通知仲裁庭該方反對成員參與程序。
Note: The President may reconstitute the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding (see sections 43 and 45).
註：庭長可為訴訟目的重組法庭（請參閱第 43 和 45 條）。

title: 90 Engagement of persons to conduct dispute resolution processes
zh: 90 人員參與爭議解決程序
text:
(1) The Principal Registrar may, on behalf of the Commonwealth, engage a person to conduct a kind of dispute resolution process.
(1) 首席書記官長可以代表聯邦聘請某人進行某種爭議解決程序。
(2) The Principal Registrar must not engage a person under subsection (1) unless the Principal Registrar is satisfied, having regard to the person’s qualifications and experience, that the person is a suitable person to conduct the relevant kind of dispute resolution process.
(2) 首席登記官不得聘用第 (1) 款規定的人員，除非首席登記官在考慮該人的資格和經驗後確信該人是執行相關爭議解決程序的合適人選。

title: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions
zh: 第 7 分部 — 公共利益證明與介入措施
path: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions

title: 91 Disclosure of information—public interest certificate
zh: 91 資訊揭露－公共利益證明
path: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions
text:
Public interest certificate—Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth
公共利益證明書—英聯邦總檢察長
(1) The Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth may certify, in writing, that the disclosure of specified information, or the content of a specified document, in a proceeding in the Tribunal would be contrary to the public interest for one or more of the following reasons:
(1) 聯邦總檢察長可以書面證明，由於以下一個或多個原因，在法庭訴訟中披露特定資訊或特定文件的內容將違背公共利益：
(a) the disclosure would prejudice the security, defence or international relations of the Commonwealth;
(a) 揭露會損害英聯邦的安全、國防或國際關係；
(b) the disclosure would involve the disclosure of deliberations or decisions of the Cabinet or of a Committee of the Cabinet;
(b) 揭露涉及內閣或內閣委員會的審議或決定的揭露；
(c) any other reason that could form the basis for a claim by the Crown in right of the Commonwealth in a judicial proceeding that the information or the matter contained in the document should not be disclosed.
(c) 任何其他可能構成英國政府在司法程序中主張不應披露文件中包含的資訊或事項的依據的理由。
Public interest certificate—Attorney ‑ General of State, Australian Capital Territory or Northern Territory
公共利益證明－澳洲首都領地或北領地總檢察長
(2) The Attorney ‑ General of a State, the Australian Capital Territory or the Northern Territory may certify, in writing, that the disclosure of specified information, or of the content of a specified document, in a proceeding in the Tribunal would be contrary to the public interest for one or more of the following reasons:
(2) 州、澳洲首都領地或北領地總檢察長可以書面證明，由於以下一個或多個原因，在法庭訴訟中披露特定資訊或特定文件的內容將違背公共利益：
(a) the disclosure would involve the disclosure of deliberations or decisions of the Cabinet, or of a Committee of the Cabinet, of the State or Territory;
(a) 披露將涉及披露州或地區內閣或內閣委員會的審議或決定；
(b) any other reason that could form the basis for a claim by the Crown in right of the State or Territory in a judicial proceeding that the information or the matter contained in the document should not be disclosed.
(b) 任何其他可能構成國家或地區政府在司法程序中主張不應披露文件中所含資訊或事項的依據的理由。
Effect of certificate
證書效力
(3) If a certificate is given under this section in relation to information or a document in relation to a proceeding, a person is not excused from disclosing the information, or giving the document, to the Tribunal for the purposes of the proceeding if the person is required by or under this Act to do so.
(3) 如果根據本條提供了與訴訟有關的資訊或文件有關的證書，則不得免除該人為訴訟目的向法庭披露該資訊或向法庭提供該文件，如果該人根據本法要求這樣做。
(4) However, the Tribunal must do all things necessary to ensure that:
(4) 然而，仲裁庭必須採取一切必要措施以確保：
(a) subject to subsection (6), the information or document is not disclosed or given to any person other than:
(a) 依第 (6) 款，資訊或文件不得揭露或提供給下列任何人：
(i) a member in the course of the performance of the member’s duties; or
(i) 會員在執行會員職務的過程中；或
(ii) the Principal Registrar in the course of the performance of the Principal Registrar’s duties; or
(ii) 首席書記官長在履行首席書記官長職責期間；或
(iii) a staff member in the course of the performance of the staff member’s duties; and
(iii) 工作人員在履行其職責過程中；和
(b) in the case of a document given to the Tribunal—the document is returned, to the person who gave it to the Tribunal, as soon as practicable after the Tribunal has finished considering the document.
(b) 對於向仲裁庭提交的文件－在仲裁庭完成審議該文件後，在切實可行的情況下盡快將該文件退還給向仲裁庭提供該文件的人。
(5) A certificate under subsection (1) or (2) is not a legislative instrument.
(5) 第 (1) 或 (2) 款規定的證書不是立法文書。
Tribunal may allow disclosure in limited cases
仲裁庭可以在有限的情況下允許披露
(6) The Tribunal may decide to make the information or document available to any or all of the parties to the proceeding if either of the following applies:
(6) 若下列任一情況適用，仲裁庭可以決定向訴訟的任何或所有當事人提供資訊或文件：
(a) the certificate was given by the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth other than for the reason set out in paragraph (1)(a) or (b);
(a) 該證書由英聯邦總檢察長簽發，但出於第 (1)(a) 或 (b) 款規定的原因；
(b) the certificate was given by the Attorney ‑ General of a State or Territory other than for the reason set out in paragraph (2)(a).
(b) 該證書是由州或領地總檢察長簽發的，但出於第 (2)(a) 款規定的原因除外。
(7) In deciding whether to make the information or document available, the Tribunal must:
(7) 在決定是否提供資訊或文件時，仲裁庭必須：
(a) take into account as a primary consideration the principle that it is desirable, in the interest of ensuring the effective performance of the Tribunal’s functions, for the parties to the proceeding to be made aware of all relevant matters; and
(a) 作為首要考慮因素，為了確保法庭有效履行職能，程序各方最好了解所有相關事項；和
(b) have regard to any reason specified in the certificate.
(b) 考慮證書中所指的任何原因。
(8) For the purposes of making a decision under subsection (6), the Tribunal must be constituted:
(8) 為了依第 (6) 款做出決定，仲裁庭的組成必須是：
(a) as if the making of the decision were a separate proceeding; and
(a) 如同該決定的製定是單獨的程序；和
(b) by a member who is, or by members at least one of whom is, a Judge or a Deputy President.
(b) 由一位擔任法官或副院長的成員或至少其中一位成員擔任。
Exclusion of other laws
其他法律的排除
(9) This section excludes the operation of any law that relates to the public interest and would otherwise apply in relation to the disclosure of information, or of the content of documents, in a proceeding in the Tribunal.
(9) 本節排除與公共利益有關的任何法律的實施，以及在法庭訴訟中適用於資訊揭露或文件內容的任何法律。

title: 92 Attorney ‑ General may intervene for public interest reasons
zh: 92 總檢察長可以出於公共利益原因進行幹預
path: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions
text:
Attorney ‑ General may intervene
總檢察長可能會介入
(1) If a person is asked a question in the course of giving evidence at the hearing of a proceeding in the Tribunal:
(1) 若某人在法庭訴訟聽證會上作證過程中被問到問題：
(a) the Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth may inform the Tribunal that, in the opinion of the Attorney ‑ General, the answering of the question would be contrary to the public interest for a reason mentioned in subsection 91(1); or
(a) 聯邦總檢察長可告知法庭，總檢察長認為，由於第 91(1) 條中提到的原因，回答該問題將違反公共利益；或
(b) the Attorney ‑ General of a State, the Australian Capital Territory or the Northern Territory may inform the Tribunal that, in the opinion of the Attorney ‑ General, the answering of the question would be contrary to the public interest for a reason mentioned in subsection 91(2).
(b) 州、澳洲首都領地或北領地的總檢察長可以通知仲裁庭，總檢察長認為，由於第 91(2) 款中提到的原因，對問題的回答將違背公共利益。
General rule
一般規則
(2) If an Attorney ‑ General so informs the Tribunal, the person is excused from answering the question.
(2) 若總檢察長如此通知法庭，則該人可免於回答問題。
Exceptions
例外情況
(3) However, the person must answer the question if:
(3) 但是，如果出現以下情況，則該人必須回答問題：
(a) for a reason covered by paragraph 91(1)(c) or (2)(b)—the Tribunal decides that the answering of the question would not be contrary to the public interest; or
(a) 為第 91(1)(c) 或 (2)(b) 段所涵蓋的理由－仲裁庭判定該問題的答案不會違反公共利益；或
(b) in any case—the Federal Court, on an appeal under section 172 or a reference under section 185, decides that answering the question would not be contrary to the public interest.
(b) 在任何情況下－聯邦法院根據第 172 條提出的上訴或根據第 185 條提出的上訴，裁定回答該問題不會違背公共利益。
(4) For the purposes of making a decision under paragraph (3)(a), the Tribunal must be constituted:
(4) 為了根據第 (3)(a) 款作出決定，仲裁庭的組成必須是：
(a) as if the making of the decision were a separate proceeding; and
(a) 如同該決定的製定是單獨的程序；和
(b) by a member who is, or by members at least one of whom is, a Judge or a Deputy President.
(b) 由一位擔任法官或副院長的成員或至少其中一位成員擔任。

title: 93 Attorney ‑ General is party to proceeding
zh: 93 總檢察長是訴訟當事人
path: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions
text:
Public interest certificates
公益證書
(1) The Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth or of a State, the Australian Capital Territory or the Northern Territory is a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal if:
(1) 聯邦或州、澳洲首都領地或北領地的總檢察長是法庭訴訟的一方，如果：
(a) that Attorney ‑ General gives a certificate under section 91 in relation to the proceeding; and
(a) 總檢察長依第 91 條提供與訴訟有關的證明；和
(b) the certificate does not specify a reason set out in paragraph 91(1)(a) or (b) or (2)(a); and
(b) 證書未說明第 91(1)(a) 或 (b) 或 (2)(a) 段所規定的原因；和
(c) that Attorney ‑ General would not otherwise be a party to the proceeding.
(c) 總檢察長否則不會成為訴訟的一方。
Attorney ‑ General intervening
總檢察長介入
(2) The Attorney ‑ General of the Commonwealth or of a State, the Australian Capital Territory or the Northern Territory is taken to be a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal if that Attorney ‑ General:
(2) 聯邦或州、澳洲首都領地或北領地的總檢察長如果符合以下條件，則被視為法庭訴訟的一方：
(a) informs the Tribunal under subsection 92(1) that the answering of a question at the hearing of the proceeding would be contrary to the public interest; and
(a) 根據第 92(1) 款通知仲裁庭，在訴訟聽證會上回答問題將違反公共利益；和
(b) would not otherwise be a party to the proceeding.
(b) 否則不會成為訴訟的一方。

title: 94 Public interest decisions made by Tribunal
zh: 94 仲裁庭所做的公共利益決定
path: Division 7 — Public interest certificates and interventions
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if, in relation to a proceeding (the primary proceeding ):
(1) 本條適用於與訴訟（主要訴訟）有關的情況：
(a) an Attorney ‑ General certifies under section 91 that the disclosure of specified information, or the content of a specified document, would be contrary to the public interest; and
(a) 總檢察長根據第 91 條證明，披露特定資訊或特定文件的內容將違反公共利益；和
(b) the Tribunal makes a decision (the public interest decision ) under subsection 91(6) in relation to the information, or the content of the document.
(b) 仲裁庭依據第 91(6) 條就該資訊或文件內容作出決定（公共利益決定）。
(2) This section also applies if, in relation to a proceeding (the primary proceeding ):
(2) 本節也適用於與訴訟（主要訴訟）有關的情況：
(a) an Attorney ‑ General informs the Tribunal under section 92 that the answering of a question would be contrary to the public interest; and
(a) 總檢察長根據第 92 條通知法庭，回答問題將違反公共利益；和
(b) the Tribunal makes a decision (the public interest decision ) under paragraph 92(3)(a) in relation to the answering of the question.
(b) 仲裁庭依據第 92(3)(a) 段就問題的回答作出決定（公共利益決定）。
Tribunal must give reasons for decision
仲裁庭必須給出決定的理由
(3) The Tribunal must, as soon as practicable after making the public interest decision, give each party to the primary proceeding a statement of reasons for the decision.
(3) 仲裁庭必須在做出公共利益決定後儘快向主要程序的各方提供該決定的理由說明。
Question of law
法律問題
(3A) For the purposes of this Act, each of the following is a question of law:
(3A) 就本法而言，以下各項均屬於法律問題：
(a) the question whether information, or a document, should be made available to a party to a proceeding under subsection 91(6);
(a) 是否應向第 91(6) 款規定的訴訟當事人提供資訊或文件的問題；
(b) the question whether the answering of a question would be contrary to the public interest.
(b) 問題的回答是否會違反公共利益。
Appeals to Federal Court
向聯邦法院上訴
(4) For the purposes of section 172 (party may appeal), the public interest decision is to be treated as:
(4) 就第 172 條（當事人可以上訴）而言，公共利益決定應視為：
(a) the decision of the Tribunal in a separate proceeding; and
(a) 仲裁庭在單獨訴訟中所作出的裁決；和
(b) made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of the public interest decision.
(b) 為公共利益目的而組成的法庭所做的決定。
Referral to Federal Court
移交聯邦法院
(5) For the purposes of section 185 (referring questions of law), a question of law in relation to the public interest decision that is referred to the Federal Court is to be treated as:
(5) 就第 185 條（涉及法律問題）而言，與提交聯邦法院的公共利益決定相關的法律問題應被視為：
(a) a question arising in the primary proceeding; but
(a) 在主要程序中出現的問題；但是
(b) referred by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of the public interest decision.
(b) 由為公共利益決定而組成的法庭移交。

title: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
zh: A 部分 — 撤回和駁回申請
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications

title: 95 Applicant may withdraw application
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
(1) The applicant may, at any time, by:
(1) 申請人可以隨時透過以下方式：
(a) giving written notice to the Tribunal; or
(a) 向仲裁庭發出書面通知；或
(b) notifying the Tribunal in any other manner specified for the application in the practice directions;
(b) 以實務指示中為申請指定的任何其他方式通知仲裁庭；
withdraw an application made to the Tribunal.
撤迴向仲裁庭提出的申請。
(2) If the applicant withdraws the application, the Tribunal is taken to have dismissed the application.
(2)申請人撤回申請的，仲裁庭視為駁回其申請。

title: 96 Tribunal may dismiss application if parties consent
zh: 96 如果當事人同意，仲裁庭可以駁回申請
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
The Tribunal may, at any time, dismiss an application made to the Tribunal if the Tribunal has the consent of the parties to the proceeding in relation to the application (other than any non ‑ participating party to the proceeding).
如果仲裁庭已獲得與申請相關的訴訟各方（不包括訴訟的任何非參與者）的同意，則仲裁庭可以隨時駁迴向仲裁庭提出的申請。

title: 97 Tribunal must dismiss application if decision is not reviewable decision
zh: 97 如果決定不是可審查的決定，仲裁庭必須駁回申請
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
The Tribunal must dismiss an application if:
若有以下情況，仲裁庭必須駁回申請：
(a) the application is made for review of a decision; and
(a) 申請覆核決定；和
(b) the Tribunal is satisfied that the decision is not reviewable by the Tribunal.
(b) 仲裁庭確信該決定不可由仲裁庭複審。

title: 98 Tribunal may dismiss application if fee is not paid
zh: 98 若未繳費，仲裁庭可駁回申請
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
The Tribunal may dismiss an application if a fee payable by the applicant to the Tribunal in respect of the application is not paid by the time prescribed by the rules.
