如果申請人未在規則規定的時間內向仲裁庭繳納有關申請的費用，仲裁庭可以駁回申請。

title: 99 Tribunal may dismiss application if applicant does not appear
zh: 99 如果申請人不出庭，仲裁庭可以駁回申請
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
If:
如果：
(a) the applicant fails to appear at a Tribunal case event that relates to a proceeding in relation to an application; and
(a) 申請人未能出席與申請相關的訴訟程序的仲裁庭案件活動；和
(b) the Tribunal is satisfied that the applicant received appropriate notice of the date, time and place of the Tribunal case event;
(b) 仲裁庭確信申請人已收到有關仲裁庭案件事件的日期、時間和地點的適當通知；
the Tribunal may dismiss the application.
仲裁庭可以駁回該申請。
Note 1: Tribunal case events include hearings, directions hearings and dispute resolution processes (see the definition of Tribunal case event in section 4).
註1：仲裁庭案件事件包括聽證會、指示聽證會及爭議解決程序（請參閱第4節仲裁庭案件事件的定義）。
Note 2: For how to appear at a Tribunal case event, see section 73.
註 2：有關如何出席仲裁庭案件活動，請參閱第 73 條。

title: 100 Tribunal may dismiss application if applicant fails to comply with order etc.
zh: 100 如果申請人不遵守命令等，仲裁庭可以駁回申請。
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
The Tribunal may dismiss an application made to the Tribunal if the applicant fails to do either of the following within a reasonable time:
如果申請人未能在合理時間內做到以下任一行為，仲裁庭可以駁迴向仲裁庭提出的申請：
(a) proceed with the application;
(a) 繼續申請；
(b) comply with this Act or an order of the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding in relation to the application.
(b) 遵守本法或法庭關於申請程序的命令。

title: 101 Tribunal may dismiss application if frivolous, vexatious etc.
zh: 101 如果申請是輕率、無理取鬧等，仲裁庭可以駁回申請。
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
(1) The Tribunal may, at any time, dismiss an application made to the Tribunal if the Tribunal is satisfied that the application:
(1) 如果仲裁庭確信該申請符合下列條件，仲裁庭可以隨時駁迴向仲裁庭提出的申請：
(a) is frivolous, vexatious, misconceived or lacking in substance; or
(a) 輕率、無理取鬧、誤解或缺乏實質內容；或
(b) has no reasonable prospects of success; or
(b) 沒有合理的成功前景；或
(c) is otherwise an abuse of the process of the Tribunal.
(c) 在其他方面濫用仲裁庭程序。
(2) If the Tribunal dismisses an application (the substantive application ) under subsection (1), the Tribunal may, on application by a party to the proceeding in relation to the substantive application or on its own initiative, order that the applicant for the substantive application must not, without leave of the Tribunal, make a subsequent application to the Tribunal of a specified kind or kinds.
(2) 若仲裁庭依據第 (1) 款駁回申請（實質申請），仲裁庭可以應與實質申請有關的訴訟一方的申請或自行決定，命令實質申請的申請人未經仲裁庭許可不得向仲裁庭提出特定種類的後續申請。
(3) The order has effect despite any other provision of this Act or any other Act.
(3) 儘管本法或任何其他法有任何其他規定，該命令仍然有效。

title: 102 Reinstatement of application
path: Subdivision A — Withdrawing and dismissing applications
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the Tribunal dismisses an application.
(1) 若仲裁庭駁回申請，則本條適用。
Note: An application may be dismissed in specified circumstances (see sections 20, 84 and 96 to 101). In addition, an application is taken to have been dismissed if the applicant withdraws it (see section 95).
註：在特定情況下，申請可能會被駁回（請參閱第 20、84 和 96 至 101 條）。此外，如果申請人撤回申請，則該申請將被視為被駁回（見第 95 條）。
Tribunal may reinstate on own initiative
仲裁庭可主動恢復原狀
(2) If the Tribunal considers that the application was dismissed in error, the Tribunal may on its own initiative reinstate the application and make such orders as appear to the Tribunal to be appropriate in the circumstances.
(2) 如果仲裁庭認為申請被錯誤駁回，仲裁庭可以主動恢復申請，並作出仲裁庭認為適合當時情況的命令。
(3) Despite subsection (2), the Tribunal must not reinstate an application under subsection (2) if the application was dismissed under section 96 (Tribunal may dismiss application if parties consent).
(3) 儘管有第 (2) 款的規定，如果申請根據第 96 條被駁回，仲裁庭不得恢復根據第 (2) 款提出的申請（如果當事人同意，仲裁庭可以駁回申請）。
(4) Despite subsection (2), if more than 28 days have passed since an application was dismissed, the Tribunal must not reinstate the application under subsection (2) unless the Tribunal is satisfied that special circumstances justify reinstating the application.
(4) 儘管有第 (2) 款的規定，如果自申請被駁回以來已過去超過 28 天，仲裁庭不得根據第 (2) 款恢復該申請，除非仲裁庭確信特殊情況證明有理由恢復該申請。
Party may apply for reinstatement if application dismissed in error
如果申請被錯誤駁回，當事人可以申請恢復
(5) A party to the proceeding in relation to the application may apply to the Tribunal for reinstatement of the application on the grounds of error within 28 days after the party receives notice that the application is dismissed (or such longer period as the Tribunal, in special circumstances, allows).
(5) 與申請有關的訴訟的一方可以在收到申請被駁回的通知後 28 天內（或在特殊情況下仲裁庭允許的更長期限）內，以錯誤為由向仲裁庭申請恢復該申請。
(6) If a party applies under subsection (5) and the Tribunal considers that the application was dismissed in error, the Tribunal may reinstate the application and make such orders as appear to the Tribunal to be appropriate in the circumstances.
(6) 如果一方當事人根據第 (5) 款提出申請，並且仲裁庭認為該申請被錯誤地駁回，則仲裁庭可以恢復該申請，並作出仲裁庭認為適合當時情況的命令。
Parties can apply for reinstatement in other specified circumstances
當事人在其他特定情況下可以申請恢復
(7) If the application is dismissed under:
(7) 若申請因下列原因被駁回：
(a) section 95 (applicant may withdraw application); or
(a) 第 95 條（申請人可以撤回申請）；或
(b) section 99 (Tribunal may dismiss application if applicant does not appear); or
(b) 第 99 條（如果申請人不出庭，仲裁庭可以駁回申請）；或
(c) section 100 (Tribunal may dismiss application if applicant fails to comply with order etc.);
(c) 第 100 條（如果申請人不遵守命令等，仲裁庭可以駁回申請）；
a party to the proceeding in relation to the application may apply to the Tribunal for reinstatement of the application within 28 days after the party receives notice that the application is dismissed (or such longer period as the Tribunal, in special circumstances, allows).
與申請相關的訴訟的一方可以在收到申請被駁回的通知後 28 天內（或在特殊情況下法庭允許的更長期限）內向仲裁庭申請恢復該申請。
(8) However, the applicant cannot apply if the application is dismissed under section 95 (applicant may withdraw application).
(8) 但是，如果申請根據第 95 條被駁回，則申請人不能提出申請（申請人可以撤回申請）。
(9) If a party applies under subsection (7) and the Tribunal considers it appropriate to reinstate the application, the Tribunal may reinstate the application and make such orders as appear to the Tribunal to be appropriate in the circumstances.
(9) 如果一方當事人根據第 (7) 款提出申請，並且仲裁庭認為恢復該申請是適當的，則仲裁庭可以恢復該申請，並作出仲裁庭認為適合當時情況的命令。

title: Subdivision B — Decisions agreed by parties
zh: B 部分 — 各方商定的決定
path: Subdivision B — Decisions agreed by parties

title: 103 If parties reach agreement—review of decisions only
zh: 103 如果各方達成協議－僅對決定進行審查
path: Subdivision B — Decisions agreed by parties
text:
Tribunal may make decision agreed by parties
仲裁庭可以做出各方同意的決定
(1) If, at any time:
(1) 如果在任何時候：
(a) the parties to a proceeding for review of a decision agree on the terms of a decision of the Tribunal:
(a) 裁決複審程序的各方就仲裁庭裁決的條款達成一致：
(i) in the proceeding; or
(i) 在訴訟中；或
(ii) in relation to a part of the proceeding; or
(ii) 與程序的一部分有關；或
(iii) in relation to a matter arising out of the proceeding;
(iii) 與訴訟中產生的事項有關；
that would be acceptable to the parties; and
當事人可以接受的；和
(b) the terms of the agreement are reduced to writing, signed by or on behalf of the parties and given to the Tribunal; and
(b) 協議條款簡化為書面形式，由雙方或其代表簽署並提交給仲裁庭；和
(c) if the terms of the agreement are signed in a dispute resolution process under Subdivision C of Division 6—7 days pass after the terms of the agreement are given to the Tribunal and none of the parties has notified the Tribunal in writing that the party wishes to withdraw from the agreement; and
(c) 如果協議條款是在第 6 節 C 分項下的爭議解決程序中簽署的－協議條款提交給仲裁庭後 7 天后，且任何一方均未書面通知仲裁庭該方希望退出協議；和
(d) the Tribunal is satisfied that a decision in the terms of the agreement or consistent with those terms would be within the powers of the Tribunal;
(d) 仲裁庭確信依協議條款或與本條款一致的決定屬於仲裁庭的權力範圍；
the Tribunal may act in accordance with subsection (2) or (3).
審裁處可依第(2)或(3)款行事。
Decision agreed by parties
各方同意的決定
(2) If the agreement reached is an agreement on the terms of a decision of the Tribunal in the proceeding, the Tribunal may, without holding or completing the hearing of the proceeding, make a decision in accordance with those terms.
(2) 如果達成的協議是就仲裁庭在訴訟中的裁決條款達成的協議，仲裁庭可以在不舉行或完成訴訟聽證會的情況下，根據這些條款作出裁決。
Tribunal does not need to deal with agreed part or matter
仲裁庭不需要處理商定的部分或事項
(3) If the agreement relates to:
(3) 如果協議涉及：
(a) a part of the proceeding; or
(a) 程序的一部分；或
(b) a matter arising out of the proceeding;
(b) 訴訟中產生的事項；
the Tribunal may, in its decision in the proceeding, give effect to the terms of the agreement without dealing (or further dealing) with that part or that matter at the hearing of the proceeding.
仲裁庭可以在其訴訟裁決中使協議條款生效，而無需在訴訟聽證會上處理（或進一步處理）該部分或該事項。
Variation or revocation of decision
變更或撤銷決定
(4) The Tribunal may vary or revoke a decision in relation to a proceeding, to the extent the decision is made in accordance with subsection (2) or (3), if:
(4) 在符合第 (2) 或 (3) 款規定的情況下，仲裁庭可以變更或撤銷與訴訟有關的決定：
(a) the parties to the proceeding reach agreement on the variation or revocation; and
(a) 程序各方就變更或撤銷達成協議；和
(b) the terms of the agreement are reduced to writing, signed by or on behalf of the parties and given to the Tribunal; and
(b) 協議條款簡化為書面形式，由雙方或其代表簽署並提交給仲裁庭；和
(c) in the case of a variation—the Tribunal is satisfied that it would have been within the powers of the Tribunal to have made the decision as varied.
(c) 在變更的情況下－仲裁庭確信其有權做出變更決定。

title: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
zh: 分部 C — 對可審查決定進行審查的決定
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision

title: 104 When this Subdivision applies
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
text:
This Subdivision applies in relation to an application for review of a reviewable decision.
本款適用於可審查決定的審查申請。

title: 105 Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision
zh: 105 仲裁庭關於審查可覆核決定的決定
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
text:
In relation to the reviewable decision, the Tribunal must make a decision:
對於可審查的決定，仲裁庭必須做出以下決定：
(a) affirming the reviewable decision; or
(a) 確認可審查的決定；或
(b) varying the reviewable decision; or
(b) 改變可審查的決定；或
(c) setting aside the reviewable decision and:
(c) 擱置可審查的決定並且：
(i) making a decision in substitution for the reviewable decision; or
(i) 作出替代可複審決定的決定；或
(ii) remitting the matter to the decision ‑ maker for reconsideration in accordance with any orders or recommendations of the Tribunal.
(ii) 根據仲裁庭的任何命令或建議，將事項轉交決策者重新考慮。

title: 106 Circumstances in which Tribunal may reach decision without hearing—review of decisions only
zh: 106 仲裁庭無需聽證即可作出決定的情況－僅對決定進行複核
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
text:
Tribunal may make decision without hearing in certain circumstances
在某些情況下，仲裁庭可以不經聽證就做出決定
(1) The Tribunal may make its decision in the proceeding in relation to the application after considering the documents and things given to the Tribunal and without holding the hearing of the proceeding if any of subsections (2) to (6) applies.
(1) 如果第 (2) 至 (6) 款適用，仲裁庭可以在考慮向仲裁庭提交的文件和事項後，在不舉行訴訟聽證會的情況下就與申請有關的訴訟作出決定。
Note: The Tribunal must make its decision in relation to an application for review of certain decisions under the Migration Act 1958 without holding the hearing of the proceeding (see section 367N of that Act). This section does not apply in relation to such applications (see paragraph 367D(g) of that Act).
注意：法庭必須就根據《1958 年移民法》審查某些決定的申請做出決定，而無需舉行訴訟聽證會（參見該法第 367N 條）。本節不適用於此類申請（請參閱該法案第 367D(g) 段）。
Parties consent
雙方同意
(2) This subsection applies if:
(2) 本款適用於下列情況：
(a) all of the parties to the proceeding consent to the proceeding being determined without the hearing of the proceeding; and
(a) 程序的所有當事人同意在不舉行程序聽證的情況下確定程序；和
(b) it appears to the Tribunal that the issues for determination in the proceeding can be adequately determined in the absence of the parties to the proceeding.
(b) 仲裁庭認為，在程序當事人缺席的情況下，可以充分確定程序中需要確定的問題。
Where only parties are applicant and non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or hearing
如果訴訟或聽證會的當事人只有申請人和非參與方
(3) This subsection applies if:
(3) 本款適用於下列情況：
(a) the only parties to the proceeding are the applicant and a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or the hearing of the proceeding; and
(a) 訴訟的唯一當事人是申請人和未參加訴訟或訴訟聽證會的當事人；和
(b) either:
(b) 任一：
(i) the decision is wholly in favour of the applicant; or
(i) 該決定完全有利於申請人；或
(ii) the applicant requests the Tribunal to make its decision without holding the hearing of the proceeding; and
(ii) 申請人請求仲裁庭在不舉行訴訟聽證會的情況下做出決定；和
(c) it appears to the Tribunal that the issues for determination in the proceeding can be adequately determined in the absence of the parties to the proceeding.
(c) 仲裁庭認為，在程序當事人缺席的情況下，可以充分確定程序中需要確定的問題。
Party fails to comply
當事人不遵守規定
(4) This subsection applies if:
(4) 本款適用於：
(a) a party to the proceeding fails to comply with this Act or an order of the Tribunal in relation to the proceeding within a reasonable time; and
(a) 訴訟一方未能在合理時間內遵守本法或法庭關於訴訟的命令；和
(b) it appears to the Tribunal that the issues for determination in the proceeding can be adequately determined in the absence of the parties to the proceeding.
(b) 仲裁庭認為，在程序當事人缺席的情況下，可以充分確定程序中需要確定的問題。
Party fails to appear
當事人未能出現
(5) This subsection applies if:
(5) 本款適用於下列情況：
(a) a party to the proceeding fails to appear at a Tribunal case event that relates to the proceeding; and
(a) 訴訟一方未能出席與訴訟相關的仲裁庭案件活動；和
(b) the party is not a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding or Tribunal case event; and
(b) 該當事人不是訴訟程序或仲裁庭案件活動的非參與者；和
(c) the Tribunal is satisfied that the party received appropriate notice of the date, time and place of the Tribunal case event; and
(c) 仲裁庭確信當事人已收到有關仲裁庭案件事件的日期、時間和地點的適當通知；和
(d) it appears to the Tribunal that the issues for determination in the proceeding can be adequately determined in the absence of the parties to the proceeding.
(d) 仲裁庭認為，在程序當事人缺席的情況下，可以充分確定程序中需要確定的問題。
Note 1: Tribunal case events include hearings, directions hearings and dispute resolution processes (see the definition of Tribunal case event in section 4).
註1：仲裁庭案件事件包括聽證會、指示聽證會及爭議解決程序（請參閱第4節仲裁庭案件事件的定義）。
Note 2: For how to appear at a Tribunal case event, see section 73.
註 2：有關如何出席仲裁庭案件活動，請參閱第 73 條。
Otherwise reasonable
否則合理
(6) This subsection applies if it appears to the Tribunal that:
(6) 若仲裁庭認為以下情況，本款適用：
(a) the issues for determination in the proceeding can be adequately determined in the absence of the parties to the proceeding; and
(a) 程序中需要確定的問題可以在程序當事人缺席的情況下得到充分確定；和
(b) it is reasonable in the circumstances to make its decision in the proceeding without holding the hearing of the proceeding.
(b) 在這種情況下，在不舉行訴訟聽證會的情況下做出訴訟決定是合理的。
(7) However, subsection (6) does not apply unless:
(7) 但是，第 (6) 款不適用，除非：
(a) the Tribunal has given the parties to the proceeding (other than a non ‑ participating party to the proceeding) a reasonable opportunity to make submissions to the Tribunal in relation to the Tribunal making its decision without holding the hearing of the proceeding; and
(a) 仲裁庭給予訴訟各方（不參與訴訟的一方除外）合理的機會，就仲裁庭在不舉行訴訟聽證會的情況下作出的決定向仲裁庭提出意見；和
(b) the Tribunal has taken into account any submissions received.
(b) 仲裁庭已考慮收到的所有意見。

title: 107 When Tribunal’s decision on review comes into operation
zh: 107 仲裁庭的複審決定何時生效
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) A decision of the Tribunal in the proceeding in relation to the application comes into operation when it is given to the parties to the proceeding.
(1) 仲裁庭在訴訟中就申請所做的裁決在提交給訴訟各方時生效。
Exception—Tribunal specifies a later date
例外－仲裁庭指定較晚的日期
(2) Despite subsection (1), if the Tribunal specifies in a decision that the decision comes into operation at a time after the decision is given to the parties, the decision comes into operation at the specified time.
(2) 儘管有第 (1) 款的規定，如果仲裁庭在裁決中明確規定該裁決在向當事人發出裁決後的某個時間生效，則該裁決將在指定時間生效。
Exception—Tribunal ordered stay of reviewable decision
例外－仲裁庭下令暫緩執行可審查的決定
(3) Despite subsections (1) and (2), if an order under section 32 staying or otherwise affecting the operation of:
(3) 儘管有第 (1) 和 (2) 款的規定，如果第 32 條下的命令中止或以其他方式影響以下機構的運作：
(a) in any case—the reviewable decision; or
(a) 在任何情況下－可審查的決定；或
(b) if the application is a guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because of the referral of a decision of the Tribunal—the decision affirmed, varied or set aside by the decision of the Tribunal;
(b) 如果申請是因提交仲裁庭裁決而提出的指導和上訴小組申請－該裁決被仲裁庭的裁決確認、變更或撤銷；
is in force immediately before the Tribunal makes a decision under section 105 (Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision) on the application, the operation of the Tribunal’s decision is stayed until:
在仲裁庭根據第 105 條（仲裁庭關於審查可複核決定的決定）對申請作出決定之前立即生效，仲裁庭決定的執行將暫停直至：
(c) if a relevant appeal is made—the later of the following:
(c) 若提出相關上訴－以下以較晚者為準：
(i) the end of the appeal period;
(i) 上訴期結束；
(ii) the completion of the relevant appeal; or
(ii) 相關上訴完成；或
(d) in any other case—the end of the appeal period.
(d) 在任何其他情況下－上訴期結束。
(4) For the purposes of paragraph (3)(c), do not take into account any relevant appeal that is made after the end of the period within which the relevant appeal may be made.
(4) 就第 (3)(c) 款而言，不考慮在相關上訴期限結束後提出的任何相關上訴。
(5) Subsection (3) does not apply if the Tribunal’s decision is made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties).
(5) 如果仲裁庭的決定是根據第 103(2) 款（雙方同意的決定）做出的，則第 (3) 款不適用。
Exception—Tribunal or court order
例外－法庭或法院命令
(6) Despite subsection (3):
(6) 儘管有第(3)款的規定：
(a) the Tribunal may order that a decision of the Tribunal comes into operation at a different time; and
(a) 仲裁庭可命令仲裁庭的裁決在不同時間生效；和
(b) the Federal Court or the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2) may order that a decision of the Tribunal comes into operation at a different time.
(b) 聯邦法院或澳洲聯邦巡迴法院和家庭法院（第 2 庭）可以命令法庭的裁決在不同時間生效。
Definitions
定義
(7) In this section:
(7) 本節：
completion :
完成：
(a) the completion of a court appeal occurs when:
(a) 在下列情況下法院上訴完成：
(i) in any case—the court appeal is determined, discontinued, dismissed or disposed of; or
(i) 在任何情況下－法院上訴被裁定、中止、駁回或處置；或
(ii) if a panel appeal is also made and the President refers the Tribunal’s decision to the guidance and appeals panel—the decision of the Tribunal on the guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because of the referral comes into operation; and
(ii) 如果也提出了專家小組上訴，並且庭長將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組－仲裁庭就指導和上訴小組申請因移交而做出的決定開始生效；和
(b) the completion of a panel appeal occurs when:
(b) 在下列情況下，專家小組上訴完成：
(i) if the President refers the Tribunal’s decision to the guidance and appeals panel—the decision of the Tribunal on the guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because of the referral comes into operation; or
(i) 如果庭長將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組－仲裁庭因提交而針對指導和上訴小組申請作出的決定開始生效；或
(ii) in any other case—the panel appeal is refused.
(ii) 在任何其他情況下－專家小組上訴被駁回。
court appeal means an appeal from the Tribunal’s decision to the Federal Court under Division 2 of Part 7 (appeals on questions of law).
法院上訴是指根據第 7 部分第 2 分部（關於法律問題的上訴）對法庭裁決向聯邦法院提出的上訴。
end of the appeal period means:
上訴期結束意味著：
(a) if a panel appeal may be made—the later of the following:
(a) 如果可以提出專家小組上訴－以下兩者中的較晚者：
(i) the end of the period within which court appeals may be made;
(i) 可以向法院提出上訴的期限結束時；
(ii) the end of the period within which panel appeals may be made; or
(ii) 專家小組可以提出上訴的期限結束；或
(b) in any other case—the end of the period within which court appeals may be made.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－可以向法院提出上訴的期限結束。
panel appeal means an application to refer the Tribunal’s decision to the guidance and appeals panel under section 123.
小組上訴是指根據第 123 條將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組的申請。
relevant appeal means:
相關申訴是指：
(a) if a panel appeal may be made—a court appeal or a panel appeal; or
(a) 如可提出專家小組上訴－法院上訴或專家小組上訴；或
(b) in any other case—a court appeal.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－法院上訴。
(8) For the purposes of subsection (4) and the definition of end of the appeal period in subsection (7), take into account:
(8) 就第 (4) 款和第 (7) 款中上訴期結束的定義而言，考慮：
(a) any extension under section 125 of the period within which panel appeals may be made that occurs before the period would otherwise expire; and
(a) 根據第 125 條對專家小組上訴期限的任何延長，如果該期限在該期限到期之前發生；和
(b) any extension under subsection 174(2) of the period within which court appeals may be made that occurs before the period would otherwise expire.
(b) 根據第 174(2) 款，在該期限到期之前對法院上訴期限進行任何延長。

title: 108 Effect of Tribunal decision to vary or substitute a reviewable decision
zh: 108 仲裁庭改變或取代可審查決定的決定的效力
path: Subdivision C — Decision on review of reviewable decision
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the Tribunal:
(1) 本條適用於仲裁庭：
(a) varies the reviewable decision; or
(a) 改變可審查的決定；或
(b) sets aside the reviewable decision and makes a decision in substitution for the reviewable decision.
(b) 擱置可覆核決定並作出替代可覆核決定的決定。
Decision is taken to be decision of decision ‑ maker
決定被視為決策者的決定
(2) The reviewable decision as varied, or the decision made in substitution for the reviewable decision, is taken be a decision of the decision ‑ maker for all purposes other than:
(2) 變更後的可複核決定或替代可複核決定的決定被視為決策者的決定，其目的除以下以外的所有目的：
(a) section 16 (decision is taken to be made if timeframe expires); or
(a) 第 16 條（若期限屆滿，則應作出決定）；或
(b) Division 3 of Part 3 (applying for review of decision); or
(b) 第 3 部分第 3 部分（申請覆核決定）；或
(c) Divisions 2 and 4 of Part 7 (appeals and references of questions of law to Federal Court); or
(c) 第 7 部分第 2 和第 4 部分（向聯邦法院上訴和提交法律問題）；或
(d) Part 10 (notice and information about administrative decision).
(d) 第 10 部分（有關行政決定的通知和資訊）。
No application for review of varied or substituted decision
不申請審查變更或替代決定
(3) A pplication may not be made to the Tribunal for review of the reviewable decision as varied or the decision made in substitution for the reviewable decision.
(3) 不得向仲裁庭申請就變更後的可覆核決定或替代可覆核決定所作的決定進行複核。
Note 1: In some circumstances, application may be made to refer to the guidance and appeals panel a decision of the Tribunal to affirm, vary or set aside a decision (see section 123).
註 1：在某些情況下，可以申請將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組，以確認、變更或撤銷決定（請參閱第 123 條）。
Note 2: This subsection does not apply in relation to ART social services decisions (see Part 5A).
註 2：本小節不適用於 ART 社會服務決策（請參閱第 5A 部分）。
Timing
時機
(4) When the decision of the Tribunal to vary or set aside the reviewable decision comes into operation, the reviewable decision as varied, or the decision made in substitution for the reviewable decision, has effect, or is taken to have had effect, from the time at which the reviewable decision has or had effect.
(4) 當仲裁庭變更或撤銷可覆核決定的決定生效時，變更後的可覆核決定或替代可覆核決定的決定自可複核決定已生效或已生效之時起生效或被視為已生效。
(5) Subsection (4) does not apply if the Tribunal orders otherwise.
(5) 若仲裁庭另有命令，則第 (4) 款不適用。

title: Division 9 — Tribunal guidance decisions
zh: 第 9 分部 — －仲裁庭指導決定

title: 109 Tribunal guidance decisions
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) A decision of the Tribunal is a Tribunal guidance decision if:
(1) 仲裁庭的決定是仲裁庭指導決定，如果：
(a) the decision is made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding in accordance with:
(a) 該決定由為訴訟目的而組成的法庭根據以下規定作出：
(i) section 40 (exception—President refers application for review that raises issue of significance); or
(i) 第 40 條（例外－總統提交提出重大問題的複審申請）；或
(ii) section 41 (exception—President, on appeal, refers Tribunal decision that raises issue of significance); and
(ii) 第 41 條（例外情況－庭長在上訴時提及仲裁庭的裁決，該裁決提出了重大問題）；和
(b) the decision is:
(b) 決定是：
(i) made under section 105 (Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision); and
(i) 根據第 105 條（法庭關於審查可審查決定的決定）作出；和
(ii) not made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties); and
(ii) 未依第 103(2) 款作出（雙方同意的決定）；和
(c) the decision is not declared under subsection (2) of this section to be an excluded decision.
(c) 未依本條第 (2) 款宣布該決定為排除決定。
Exception—declared by President
例外——總統宣布
(2) The President may, in writing, declare that a decision made under section 105 by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding in accordance with section 40 or 41 is an excluded decision.
(2) 庭長可以書面宣布，為根據第 40 條或第 41 條提起訴訟而組成的法庭根據第 105 條作出的決定是排除決定。
(3) A declaration made under subsection (2) is not a legislative instrument.
(3) 依第 (2) 款所作的聲明並非立法文書。
(4) The President must publish declarations made under subsection (2).
(4) 總統必須公佈根據第 (2) 款所作的聲明。

title: 110 Tribunal must have regard to Tribunal guidance decisions
zh: 110 仲裁庭必須考慮仲裁庭的指導決定
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) When making a decision in a proceeding in the Tribunal, the Tribunal must have regard to Tribunal guidance decisions that the Tribunal considers raise:
(1) 在仲裁庭的訴訟程序中做出決定時，仲裁庭必須考慮仲裁庭認為引起以下問題的仲裁庭指導決定：
(a) facts similar to the facts raised by the proceeding; or
(a) 與訴訟中提出的事實類似的事實；或
(b) issues similar to the issues raised by the proceeding.
(b) 與訴訟中提出的問題類似的問題。
Exception—member who is a Judge
例外－擔任法官的成員
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply to:
(2) 第 (1) 款不適用於：
(a) a member who is a Judge; or
(a) 一名擔任法官的成員；或
(b) the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by a member who is, or members at least one of whom is, a Judge.
(b) 為訴訟目的而由一名法官或至少一名法官組成的法庭。
Effect of failure to comply
不遵守規定的影響
(3) A failure by the Tribunal to comply with subsection (1) does not affect the validity of the decision.
(3) 仲裁庭不遵守第 (1) 款並不影響裁決的效力。

title: Division 10 — After proceeding ends
zh: 第 10 分部 — 程序結束後

title: 111 Notice of decision and statement of reasons—review of reviewable decision
zh: 111 決定通知和理由說明－可審查決定的審查
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the Tribunal makes a decision under section 105 in a proceeding for review of a reviewable decision, other than a decision made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties).
(1) 若仲裁庭在可複審決定的複審程序中依第 105 條作出決定，則本條適用，但依第 103(2) 款所作的決定（當事人同意的決定）除外。
General rules—Tribunal must give decision and statement of reasons
一般規則－仲裁庭必須作出決定並說明理由
(2) The Tribunal must give each party to the proceeding the following things in writing:
(2) 仲裁庭必須以書面向訴訟各方提供以下資料：
(a) the Tribunal’s decision;
(a) 仲裁庭的決定；
(b) a statement of reasons for the Tribunal’s decision;
(b) 仲裁庭作出決定的理由說明；
(c) if the party has a right to apply to refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel under Division 3 of Part 5—notice of that right;
(c) 若當事人有權根據第 5 部分第 3 部分申請將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組－該權利的通知；
(ca) if the party has a right to apply for second review of the Tribunal’s decision under Part 5A—notice of that right;
(ca) 若當事人有權根據第 5A 部分申請對仲裁庭的決定進行第二次複審－該權利的通知；
(d) notice of the right of the party to appeal to the Federal Court under Division 2 of Part 7.
(d) 當事人有權根據第 7 部分第 2 分部向聯邦法院上訴的權利的通知。
(3) Each thing must be given by the time specified in the practice directions. If the practice directions do not specify a time, the thing must be given within 28 days after the day the Tribunal’s decision is made.
(3)每件事必須在練習指示規定的時間內完成。如果實務指示沒有指定時間，則必須在仲裁庭做出決定之日後 28 天內提供。
(4) The Tribunal may give a decision and the reasons for the decision orally before giving them in writing.
(4) 仲裁庭可以在書面作出決定之前以口頭方式作出決定並說明決定的理由。
(4A) A failure by the Tribunal to provide the things mentioned in paragraphs (2)(c) to (d) by the time required by subsection (3) does not affect the validity of the Tribunal’s decision.
(4A) 仲裁庭未能在第 (3) 款要求的時間內提供第 (2)(c) 至 (d) 款所提及的事項，並不影響仲裁庭裁決的效力。
Exceptions
例外情況
(5) This section is subject to sections 70 (Tribunal may restrict publication or disclosure of information) and 91 (disclosure of information—public interest certificate).
(5) 本節受第 70 條（仲裁庭可以限制資訊的公佈或揭露）和第 91 條（資訊揭露－公共利益證明）的約束。

title: 112 Notice of decision and statement of reasons—other proceedings
zh: 112 決定通知和理由說明－其他程序
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the Tribunal makes a decision finalising a proceeding in the Tribunal, other than:
(1) 若仲裁庭作出結束仲裁庭程序的決定，則本節適用，但下列情況除外：
(a) a public interest decision mentioned in subsection 94(1) or (2) (public interest decisions made by Tribunal); or
(a) 第 94(1) 或 (2) 款所提及的公共利益決定（法庭所做的公共利益決定）；或
(b) a decision under section 96 (Tribunal may dismiss application if parties consent); or
(b) 根據第 96 條所做的決定（如果當事人同意，仲裁庭可以駁回申請）；或
(c) a decision under subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties); or
(c) 依第 103(2) 款所做的決定（各方同意的決定）；或
(d) a decision under section 105 (Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision).
(d) 根據第 105 條（仲裁庭關於審查可審查決定的決定）所做的決定。
(2) To avoid doubt, this section does not apply in relation to a decision under section 128 (President decides whether to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel).
(2) 為避免疑問，本節不適用於第 128 條的決定（庭長決定是否將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組）。
Notice of decision
決定通知
(3) The Tribunal must give each party to the proceeding notice of the Tribunal’s decision orally or in writing.
(3) 仲裁庭必須以口頭或書面向訴訟各方發出仲裁庭裁決的通知。
General rule—Tribunal must give statement of reasons on request
一般規則－仲裁庭必須依照要求提供理由說明
(4) The Tribunal may give reasons for the Tribunal’s decision to the parties to the proceeding orally or by giving a statement of reasons for the decision.
(4) 仲裁庭可以口頭或透過作出決定的理由陳述向訴訟各方說明仲裁庭決定的理由。
(5) If the Tribunal has not given a party to the proceeding a statement of reasons for the Tribunal’s decision, the party may, within 28 days after the day the Tribunal’s decision is made, request the Tribunal to give the party a statement of reasons for the Tribunal’s decision.
(5) 若仲裁庭未向訴訟當事人提供仲裁庭決定的理由說明，該方可以在仲裁庭作出決定之日起 28 天內，請求仲裁庭向當事人提供仲裁庭決定的理由說明。
(6) The request must be given to the Tribunal in writing.
(6) 請求必須以書面向仲裁庭提出。
(7) Within 28 days after receiving the request, the Tribunal must give the party a statement of reasons for the Tribunal’s decision.
(7) 在收到請求後 28 天內，仲裁庭必須向當事人提供仲裁庭決定的理由說明。
Exception
例外
(8) This section is subject to sections 70 (Tribunal may restrict publication or disclosure of information) and 91 (disclosure of information—public interest certificate).
(8) 本節受第 70 條（仲裁庭可以限制資訊的發布或揭露）和第 91 條（資訊揭露－公共利益證明）的約束。

title: 113 Tribunal may publish decisions
text:
General rules
一般規則
(1) The Tribunal may publish its decisions and the reasons for them.
(1) 仲裁庭可公佈其裁決及其理由。
(2) The Tribunal must publish a decision (and the reasons for it) if:
(2) 在下列情況下，仲裁庭必須公佈裁決（及其理由）：
(a) the President considers that the decision:
(a) 主席認為該決定：
(i) involves a significant conclusion of law; or
(i) 涉及重要的法律結論；或
(ii) has significant implications for Commonwealth policy or administration; or
(ii) 對聯邦政策或管理有重大影響；或
(b) the decision is:
(b) 決定是：
(i) made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by the guidance and appeals panel; and
(i) 由指導和上訴小組為訴訟目的而組成的法庭所作出的；和
(ii) made under section 105 (Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision); and
(ii) 根據第 105 條（法庭關於審查可審查決定的決定）作出；和
(iii) not made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties).
(iii) 未依第 103(2) 款作出（雙方同意的決定）。
(3) Publication of Tribunal decisions, and the reasons for them, must be in accordance with any requirements specified in the practice directions.
(3) 仲裁庭裁決及其理由的公佈必須符合實務指南中規定的任何要求。
Exception—where disclosure prohibited or restricted by law
例外情況－法律禁止或限制揭露的情況
(4) However, this section does not authorise the Tribunal to publish information the disclosure of which is prohibited or restricted by or under this Act, another Act or an instrument made under an Act.
(4) 然而，本節並未授權仲裁庭公佈本法、另一項法案或根據某項法案製定的文書所禁止或限制披露的資訊。
Note: The disclosure of information may be prohibited or restricted by Tribunal order under section 70. For example, while the Tribunal can publish reasons for a decision in a proceeding that was not heard in public, the reasons cannot include information covered by a Tribunal order under section 70.
註：第 70 條規定的仲裁庭命令可能會禁止或限制資訊揭露。例如，雖然仲裁庭可以公佈未公開審理的訴訟中作出決定的理由，但該理由不能包括第 70 條規定的仲裁庭命令所涵蓋的資訊。

title: 114 Tribunal may correct error in decision or statement of reasons
zh: 114 仲裁庭可以糾正決定或理由陳述中的錯誤
text:
(1) If, after the Tribunal makes a decision, the Tribunal considers that there is an obvious error in the text of:
(1) 仲裁庭做出裁決後，如果仲裁庭認為以下內容有明顯錯誤：
(a) the decision; or
(a) 決定；或
(b) the statement of reasons for the decision;
(b) 作出決定的理由說明；
the Tribunal may alter the text of the decision or statement.
仲裁庭可以更改決定或聲明的文字。
Note: The following are examples of obvious errors in the text of a decision or statement:
注意：以下是決定或聲明文字中明顯錯誤的範例：
(a) an obvious clerical or typographical error in the text of the decision or statement;
(a) 決定或聲明文本中存在明顯的書寫或印刷錯誤；
(b) an inconsistency between the decision and the statement of reasons for the decision.
(b) 決定與決定理由的陳述不一致。
(2) If the text of a decision is altered under subsection (1), the altered text is taken to be the decision. If the text of a statement is altered under subsection (1), the altered text is taken to be the statement.
(2) 如果根據第 (1) 款對決定的文本進行了修改，則修改後的文本將被視為決定。如果根據第(1)款更改了聲明的文本，則更改後的文本視為該聲明。

title: 115 Taxing costs
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the Tribunal orders a party to a proceeding in the Tribunal to pay costs incurred by another party to the proceeding.
(1) 若仲裁庭命令仲裁庭訴訟的一方支付訴訟另一方所產生的費用，則本節適用。
Note: The Tribunal’s power to order a party to a proceeding to pay costs is set out in other legislation.
註：其他立法中規定了法庭命令訴訟一方支付費用的權力。
Party may apply for costs to be taxed
當事人可以申請對費用徵稅
(2) If the parties cannot agree on the amount of the costs, the Tribunal may, on application by either party, tax the costs.
(2) 如果雙方無法就費用金額達成一致，仲裁庭可以根據任何一方的申請，對費用徵稅。
Amounts are recoverable as debts
金額可作為債務收回
(3) An amount that a party (the first party ) is ordered by the Tribunal to pay to another party (the second party ) is recoverable by the second party as a debt due to the second party by the first party.
(3) 仲裁庭命令一方（甲方）向另一方（乙方）支付的金額可由乙方作為甲方欠乙方的債務予以追償。

title: 116 Offence—failure to comply with summons
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person is given a summons under section 74; and
(a) 依第 74 條向該人發出傳票；和
(b) the person fails to comply with the summons.
(b) 該人不遵守傳票。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months or 30 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 6 個月監禁或 30 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if it is not reasonably practicable for the person to comply with the summons by the time specified in the summons or within such further period as the Tribunal allows.
(2) 若該人在傳票中指定的時間或在法庭允許的更長時間內遵守傳票是不合理可行的，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。

title: 117 Offence—failure to take oath, make affirmation or answer question
zh: 117 罪行－未宣誓、作出確認或回答問題
text:
A person appearing before the Tribunal to give evidence at the hearing of a proceeding or a directions hearing in relation to a proceeding commits an offence if the person:
出庭在訴訟聽證會或與訴訟有關的指示聽證會上出庭作證的人，如果出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) fails to take an oath or make an affirmation when required to do so (see section 76); or
(a) 在需要時未宣誓或作出保證（參閱第 76 條）；或
(b) fails to answer a question that the Tribunal requires the person to answer.
(b) 未能回答仲裁庭要求該人回答的問題。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months or 30 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 6 個月監禁或 30 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 118 Offence—giving false or misleading evidence
zh: 118 犯罪－提供虛假或誤導性證據
text:
(1) A person appearing before the Tribunal to give evidence commits an offence if the person:
(1) 出庭作證的人如果有以下情況，即構成犯罪：
(a) gives evidence; and
(a) 提供證據；和
(b) does so knowing that the evidence:
(b) 這樣做時知道證據：
(i) is false or misleading; or
(i) 虛假或具誤導性；或
(ii) omits any matter or thing without which the evidence is misleading.
(ii) 遺漏任何事項或事物，否則證據就會產生誤導。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months or 60 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 12 個月監禁或 60 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
Note: Giving false testimony is also subject to the offence under section 35 of the Crimes Act 1914 .
註：根據《1914 年犯罪法》第 35 條，提供虛假證言也屬於犯罪行為。
(2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the evidence is not false or misleading in a material particular.
(2) 若證據在重要細節上不存在虛假或誤導性，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Note: A defendant bears an evidential burden in relation to the matter in this subsection (see subsection 13.3(3) of the Criminal Code ).
註：被告就本款的事項負舉證責任（參見《刑法典》第 13.3（3）款）。

title: 119 Offence—breach of non ‑ publication or non ‑ disclosure order
zh: 119 犯罪－違反不公佈或不披露命令
text:
A person commits an offence if:
若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person engages in conduct; and
(a) 該人從事某種行為；和
(b) the conduct contravenes an order under section 70 (Tribunal may restrict publication or disclosure of information) or subsection 157(3) (orders restricting publication or disclosure of findings).
(b) 該行為違反了第 70 條（仲裁庭可以限制公佈或披露資訊）或第 157(3) 款（限制公佈或披露調查結果的命令）下的命令。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months or 60 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 12 個月監禁或 60 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: 120 Offence—contempt of Tribunal
text:
(1) A person commits an offence if:
(1) 若出現以下情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person engages in conduct; and
(a) 該人從事某種行為；和
(b) the conduct obstructs or hinders the Tribunal or an authorised person in the performance of the functions of the Tribunal.
(b) 該行為妨礙或妨礙仲裁庭或授權人員履行仲裁庭的職能。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months or 60 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 12 個月監禁或 60 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。
(2) A person commits an offence if:
(2) 若出現下列情況，則構成犯罪：
(a) the person engages in conduct; and
(a) 該人從事某種行為；和
(b) the conduct would, if the Tribunal were a court of record, constitute a contempt of that court.
(b) 如果仲裁庭是記錄法院，則該行為將構成對該法院的蔑視。
Penalty: Imprisonment for 12 months or 60 penalty units, or both.
處罰： 12 個月監禁或 60 個處罰單位，或兩者併罰。

title: Part 5 — Guidance and appeals panel
zh: 第 5 部 — 指導與上訴小組

title: 121 Simplified outline of this Part
text:
The guidance and appeals panel is a way of constituting the Tribunal at a more senior level to:
指導和上訴小組是在更高層級組建法庭的一種方式，目的是：
(a) review some decisions made by decision ‑ makers; or
(a) 檢視決策者所做的一些決定；或
(b) re ‑ review some decisions that have been reviewed by the Tribunal.
(b) 重新審查法庭已經審查過的一些決定。
Broadly, the circumstances in which the Tribunal may be constituted as a guidance and appeals panel are as follows:
概括地說，法庭可以組成指導和上訴小組的情況如下：
(a) there is an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making;
(a) 存在對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；
(b) a Tribunal decision may contain an error of fact or law materially affecting the Tribunal decision.
(b) 仲裁庭的裁決可能包含對仲裁庭裁決產生重大影響的事實或法律錯誤。
The first way a guidance and appeals panel proceeding can start is that an application to the Tribunal may be referred to the guidance and appeals panel by the President.
指導和上訴小組程序啟動的第一種方式是，總統可以將向法庭提出的申請轉交給指導和上訴小組。
The second way is that, after the Tribunal has affirmed, varied or set aside a decision made by a decision ‑ maker, a party to the Tribunal proceeding may apply to the President to refer the matter to the guidance and appeals panel. Timeframes apply to applications, but may be extended in some circumstances. The application to refer the matter does not affect the operation of the Tribunal decision unless the Tribunal orders otherwise.
第二種方式是，在法庭確認、改變或撤銷決策者所做的決定後，法庭程序的一方可以向庭長申請將此事提交給指導和上訴小組。期限適用於申請，但在某些情況下可能會延長。除非仲裁庭另有命令，否則申請移交該事項並不影響仲裁庭裁決的實施。
If the President decides to refer the matter to the guidance and appeals panel, the Tribunal constituted as the guidance and appeals panel reviews the decision of the decision ‑ maker, as affected by the earlier Tribunal review. Some different Tribunal powers and procedures apply in relation to guidance and appeals panel proceedings.
如果總統決定將此事提交給指導和上訴小組，則作為指導和上訴小組組成的法庭將審查決策者的決定，並受到法庭先前審查的影響。一些不同的法庭權力和程序適用於指導和上訴小組程序。
Only some kinds of Tribunal decisions can be referred to the guidance and appeals panel. For these decisions, a party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made can choose to apply to refer the matter to the guidance and appeals or to appeal on a question of law to the Federal Court under Part 7.
只有某些類型的仲裁庭裁決可以提交給指導和上訴小組。對於這些決定，仲裁庭作出決定的訴訟當事方可以選擇申請將此事提交指南和上訴，或根據第 7 部分就法律問題向聯邦法院提出上訴。
This Part contains the standard provisions for guidance and appeals panel proceedings. Other legislation can include provisions that apply in addition to, or instead of, these standard provisions.
本部分包含指導和上訴小組程序的標準規定。其他立法可以包括除這些標準條款之外或替代這些標準條款而適用的條款。

title: Division 2 — President may refer application on own initiative
zh: 第 2 分部 — 主席可以主動提交申請
path: Division 2 — President may refer application on own initiative

title: 122 President may refer application for review of decision to guidance and appeals panel
zh: 122 總統可以將決定審查申請案提交給指導和上訴小組
path: Division 2 — President may refer application on own initiative
text:
(1) If:
(1) 如果：
(a) an application for review of a decision is made to the Tribunal (other than a guidance and appeals panel application); and
(a) 向仲裁庭提出複審決定的申請（指導和上訴小組申請除外）；和
(b) the President is satisfied that:
(b) 主席確信：
(i) the application raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making; and
(i) 該申請提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；和
(ii) it is appropriate in the interests of justice that the Tribunal be constituted by the guidance and appeals panel for the purposes of the proceeding in relation to the application;
(ii) 為了正義的利益，法庭由指導和上訴小組組成以進行與申請有關的訴訟是適當的；
the President may refer the application to the guidance and appeals panel.
總統可以將申請提交給指導和上訴小組。
Note 1: The Tribunal will be constituted by the guidance and appeals panel for the purposes of the proceeding (see section 40).
註 1：出於訴訟目的，仲裁庭將由指導和上訴小組組成（見第 40 條）。
Note 2: If the Tribunal is already constituted for the purposes of the proceeding, it may be reconstituted (see sections 43 and 47).
註 2：如果仲裁庭已經為訴訟目的而組成，則可以重新組成（請參閱第 43 和 47 條）。
(2) For the purposes of subparagraph (1)(b)(ii), the President must have regard to the circumstances of the parties to the proceeding.
(2) 就第 (1)(b)(ii) 項而言，院長必須考慮訴訟各方的情況。

title: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
zh: 第 3 分部 — 當事人可以申請將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel

title: Subdivision A — Application for referral to guidance and appeals panel
zh: A 部分 — 轉介給指導和上訴小組的申請
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision A — Application for referral to guidance and appeals panel

title: 123 Application may be made to refer certain Tribunal decisions to guidance and appeals panel
zh: 123 可以申請將仲裁庭的某些決定提交給指導和上訴小組
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision A — Application for referral to guidance and appeals panel
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) Application may be made to the President to refer a decision of the Tribunal under section 105 (Tribunal decision on review of reviewable decision) to the guidance and appeals panel.
(1) 可向庭長申請將仲裁庭根據第 105 條（仲裁庭關於審查可複審決定的決定）所做的決定提交給指導和上訴小組。
Note: If the President refers a Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel, the Tribunal will be constituted by the guidance and appeals panel for the purposes of the proceeding (see sections 41 and 42).
註：如果庭長將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組，則仲裁庭將由指導和上訴小組出於訴訟目的組成（見第 41 和 42 節）。
(2) An application may be made under subsection (1) by a person who was at any time a party to the proceeding in which the decision of the Tribunal is made.
(2) 任何時間以仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟當事人的人均可依第 (1) 款提出申請。
(3) To avoid doubt, the decision of the Tribunal is not a reviewable decision.
(3) 為避免疑義，仲裁庭的決定並非可覆核的決定。
Note: If the President refers a Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel, the review relates to the decision affirmed, varied or set aside by the Tribunal decision (see subsection 130(2)).
註：如果庭長將法庭裁決提交給指導和上訴小組，則審查涉及法庭裁決所確認、變更或撤銷的裁決（見第 130(2) 款）。
Exception—Tribunal decision made by guidance and appeals panel or Judge
例外－由指導和上訴小組或法官所做的仲裁庭決定
(4) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a decision made by the Tribunal constituted for the purposes of a proceeding by:
(4) 第 (1) 款不適用於仲裁庭為訴訟目的而由下列人員組成的裁決：
(a) the guidance and appeals panel; or
(a) 指導和上訴小組；或
(b) a member who is, or members at least one of whom is, a Judge.
(b) 一名或至少一名法官的成員。
Exception—decision by agreement of parties
例外－經各方同意的決定
(5) Subsection (1) does not apply if the decision is made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties).
(5) 如果決定是根據第 103(2) 款（當事人同意的決定）作出的，則第 (1) 款不適用。
Exception—decision of a kind prescribed by the rules
例外－規則規定的某種決定
(6) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a decision of a kind prescribed by the rules.
(6) 第 (1) 款不適用於規則規定的此類決定。

title: 124 How to apply
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision A — Application for referral to guidance and appeals panel
text:
Manner of applying
申請方式
(1) An application to refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel may be made in writing or in any other manner specified for the application in the practice directions.
(1) 將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組的申請可以書面形式或以實踐指南中為申請指定的任何其他方式提出。
Information to include
要包含的訊息
(2) An application by a person to refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel must:
(2) 個人將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組的申請必須：
(a) include the information specified for the application in the practice directions; and
(a) 在實踐指導中包括為申請指定的資訊；和
(b) explain why the person considers that:
(b) 解釋該人為何認為：
(i) the decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making; or
(i) 該決定提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；或
(ii) the decision may contain an error of fact or law materially affecting the decision.
(ii) 該決定可能包含對決定有重大影響的事實或法律錯誤。
(3) A failure to comply with subsection (2) does not affect the validity of the application.
(3) 不遵守第(2)款並不影響申請的有效性。
(4) Without limiting section 128, the President may refuse the application if the application does not comply with subsection (2) of this section.
(4) 在不限制第 128 條的情況下，如果申請不符合本條第 (2) 款的規定，總統可以拒絕該申請。

title: 125 When to apply to refer Tribunal decision
zh: 125 何時申請提交仲裁庭裁決
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision A — Application for referral to guidance and appeals panel
text:
An application to refer a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel must be made within the period of 28 days after the Tribunal gives a statement of reasons for the decision to the parties to the proceeding in which the decision is made (or such longer period as the President, in special circumstances, allows).
將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組的申請必須在仲裁庭向做出該裁決的訴訟各方提供裁決理由後的 28 天內提出（或在特殊情況下院長允許的更長期限）。

title: Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made
zh: 細分 B — 申請提交決定後
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made

title: 126 Parties to be notified of application
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made
text:
(1) This section applies if an application is made to refer a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel.
(1) 如果申請將仲裁庭的裁決（仲裁庭裁決）提交給指導和上訴小組，則本節適用。
(2) The Tribunal must give written notice of the application to the following:
(2) 仲裁庭必須將申請書書面通知以下人員：
(a) the applicant;
(a) 申請人；
(b) the decision ‑ maker for the decision affirmed, varied or set aside by the Tribunal decision;
(b) 法庭決定所確認、變更或撤銷的決定的決策者；
(c) any other party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made.
(c) 仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟的任何其他當事方。

title: 127 Tribunal decision continues to operate unless Tribunal orders otherwise
zh: 127 除非仲裁庭另有命令，否則仲裁庭的裁決繼續有效
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The making of an application (the referral application ) to refer a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel does not affect the operation of the Tribunal decision or prevent the taking of action to implement the Tribunal decision.
(1) 將仲裁庭的裁決（仲裁庭裁決）提交給指導和上訴小組的申請（移交申請）不會影響仲裁庭裁決的實施，也不會妨礙採取行動執行仲裁庭裁決。
Exception—Tribunal may stay operation or implementation
例外－仲裁庭可以中止運作或實施
(2) However, on application by a party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made, the Tribunal may make an order staying or otherwise affecting the operation or implementation of the Tribunal decision if the Tribunal considers that it is desirable to do so for the purpose of ensuring the effectiveness of the referral application.
(2) 然而，根據作出仲裁庭決定的訴訟一方的申請，如果仲裁庭認為為了確保移交申請的有效性而有必要這樣做，則仲裁庭可以下令中止或以其他方式影響仲裁庭決定的實施或實施。
(3) The order is subject to any conditions specified in the order.
(3) 該訂單須遵守訂單中指定的任何條件。
(4) The order has effect until:
(4) 該命令的有效期限至：
(a) if the President refers the Tribunal decision—14 days after the President refers the Tribunal decision; or
(a) 若庭長提交仲裁庭決定－在庭長提交仲裁庭決定 14 天後；或
(b) in any other case—the Tribunal refuses the referral application.
(b) 在任何其他情況下－仲裁庭拒絕移交申請。
Note: If the President refers the Tribunal decision, an application is taken to be made for review of a reviewable decision (see subsection 130(2)). The Tribunal may stay the operation or implementation of the reviewable decision for the purpose of ensuring the effectiveness of the review (see section 32).
註：如果庭長提交仲裁庭的決定，則會申請對可審查的決定進行審查（請參閱第 130(2) 款）。為了確保覆核的有效性，仲裁庭可以中止可覆核決定的運作或執行（見第 32 條）。
(5) Despite subsection (4), if:
(5) 儘管有第(4)款的規定，如果：
(a) the order states that it applies for a period; and
(a) 該命令聲明其適用期限；和
(b) the period ends before the time the order would cease to have effect under subsection (4) if the period were not stated;
(b) 若未說明該期限，則該期限在該命令依第(4)款停止效力的時間之前結束；
the order has effect until the end of the period.
該命令的有效期限至該期限結束為止。
(6) The Tribunal may, by order, vary or revoke the order on application by a party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made.
(6) 仲裁庭可以根據仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟一方的申請，透過命令更改或撤銷該命令。
Preconditions to making, varying or revoking an order
制定、更改或撤銷訂單的先決條件
(7) The Tribunal must not make, vary or revoke an order staying or otherwise affecting the operation or implementation of the Tribunal decision unless:
(7) 仲裁庭不得作出、更改或撤銷暫緩執行或以其他方式影響仲裁庭決定的實施或實施的命令，除非：
(a) the Tribunal has given the parties to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made a reasonable opportunity to make submissions to the Tribunal in relation to the making, variation or revocation of the order; and
(a) 仲裁庭已向作出仲裁庭決定的訴訟各方提供合理的機會，就該命令的製定、變更或撤銷向仲裁庭提出意見；和
(b) the Tribunal has taken into account the interests of any person who may be affected by the decision affirmed, varied or set aside by the Tribunal decision.
(b) 仲裁庭已考慮到任何可能受到仲裁庭裁決所確認、變更或撤銷的決定影響的人的利益。
(8) However, paragraph (7)(a) does not prevent the Tribunal making, varying or revoking an order without giving a party an opportunity to make a submission to the Tribunal if the Tribunal is satisfied that it is not practicable to give the party the opportunity.
(8) 然而，如果仲裁庭認為給予當事人機會向仲裁庭提交意見不切實際，則第 (7)(a) 款並不妨礙仲裁庭在不給予當事人向仲裁庭提交意見的機會的情況下作出、更改或撤銷命令。
(9) If the Tribunal makes, varies or revokes an order without giving a party an opportunity to make a submission as mentioned in subsection (8), the order, variation or revocation does not take effect until a notice setting out the terms of the order, variation or revocation is given to the party.
(9) 若仲裁庭在未給予當事人第(8)款所述提交意見的機會的情況下作出、變更或撤銷命令，則在向當事人發出載有命令、變更或撤銷條款的通知之前，該命令、變更或撤銷不會生效。

title: 128 President decides whether to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
zh: 128 主席決定是否將法庭裁決提交給指導和上訴小組
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made
text:
President’s decision
總統的決定
(1) If a person applies to refer a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel, the President may refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel or refuse the application.
(1) 如果有人申請將法庭的決定（法庭決定）提交給指導和上訴小組，主席可以將法庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組或拒絕該申請。
Requirements for decision
決策要求
(2) The President may refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel if the President is satisfied that:
(2) 若主席確信：
(a) the Tribunal decision raises an issue of significance to administrative decision ‑ making; or
(a) 仲裁庭的裁決提出了對行政決策具有重要意義的問題；或
(b) the Tribunal decision may contain an error of fact or law materially affecting the Tribunal decision.
(b) 仲裁庭的裁決可能包含對仲裁庭裁決產生重大影響的事實或法律錯誤。
(3) However, the President must not refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel in any of the following circumstances:
(3) 但是，有下列情形之一的，院長不得將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組：
(a) a fee payable in relation to the application is not paid by the time prescribed by the rules;
(a) 未在規則規定的時間內繳納與申請相關的費用；
(b) a circumstance prescribed by the rules.
（二）規則規定的情形。
(4) In deciding whether to refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel or refuse the application under this section, the President must have regard to:
(4) 在決定是否將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組或拒絕本條規定的申請時，庭長必須考慮：
(a) the circumstances of the parties to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made; and
(a) 仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟各方的情況；和
(b) any other matters that the President considers relevant.
(b) 主席認為相關的任何其他事項。
(5) To avoid doubt, the President is not required to refer any decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel.
(5) 為避免疑問，主席無需將法庭的任何決定提交給指導和上訴小組。

title: 129 Notice of President’s decision
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision B — After application to refer decision is made
text:
(1) This section applies if:
(1) 本節適用於：
(a) a person applies to refer a decision of the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to the guidance and appeals panel; and
(a) 某人申請將仲裁庭的裁決（仲裁庭裁決）提交給指導和上訴小組；和
(b) the President decides to refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel or refuse the application.
(b) 庭長決定將仲裁庭的裁決提交給指導和上訴小組或拒絕該申請。
(2) The President must give notice of the President’s decision orally or in writing to the following:
(2) 主席必須將主席的決定以口頭或書面通知下列人員：
(a) the person;
(a) 該人；
(b) the decision ‑ maker for the decision affirmed, varied or set aside by the Tribunal decision;
(b) 法庭決定所確認、變更或撤銷的決定的決策者；
(c) any other party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made.
(c) 仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟的任何其他當事方。

title: Subdivision C — Review after Tribunal decision is referred to guidance and appeals panel
zh: C 分部 — 仲裁庭裁決提交指導和上訴小組後進行審查
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision C — Review after Tribunal decision is referred to guidance and appeals panel

title: 130 Application for review proceeds if President refers Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision C — Review after Tribunal decision is referred to guidance and appeals panel
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies if the President refers to the guidance and appeals panel under section 128 a decision made by the Tribunal (the Tribunal decision ) to affirm, vary or set aside a decision (the original decision ).
(1) 若庭長依第 128 條向指導和上訴小組提交仲裁庭所做的決定（仲裁庭決定）以確認、變更或撤銷決定（原始決定），則本節適用。
Applicant is taken to have applied for review of decision
申請人被視為已申請覆核決定
(2) The person who applied to refer the Tribunal decision to the guidance and appeals panel is taken to have applied to the Tribunal for review of the following decision:
(2) 申請將仲裁庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組的人被視為已向仲裁庭申請複審以下決定：
(a) if the Tribunal decision is to affirm the original decision—the original decision;
(a) 若仲裁庭決定維持原決定－原決定；
(b) if the Tribunal decision is to vary the original decision—the original decision as varied (an updated decision );
(b) 如果仲裁庭決定改變原始決定－改變後的原始決定（更新後的決定）；
(c) if the Tribunal decision is to set aside the original decision and make a new decision in substitution for it—the new decision (also an updated decision );
(c) 如果仲裁庭決定撤銷原來的決定並作出新的決定來代替－新的決定（也是更新的決定）；
(d) if the Tribunal decision is to set aside the original decision and remit the matter to the decision ‑ maker for reconsideration—the original decision.
(d) 若仲裁庭決定撤銷原決定並將該事項提交決策者重新考慮－原決定。
Note 1: The decision ‑ maker for the original decision is the decision ‑ maker for the purposes of the review (see section 108).
註1：原決定的決策者是審查目的的決策者（見第108節）。
Note 2: The Tribunal will be constituted by the guidance and appeals panel for the purposes of the proceeding for the review (see sections 41 and 42).
註 2：法庭將由指導和上訴小組組成，負責審查程序（見第 41 和 42 節）。
Parties to Tribunal decision proceeding are parties to review proceeding
仲裁庭裁決程序的當事人即是覆核程序的當事人
(3) In addition to the persons who are parties to the proceeding for the review under section 22, any other party to the proceeding in which the Tribunal decision is made is a party to the proceeding for the review.
(3) 除了屬於第 22 條規定的複審程序當事人之外，作出仲裁庭裁決的程序的任何其他當事人也是複核程序的當事人。
(4) Subsection (3) is subject to section 65 (certain parties may seek to withdraw from being a party) and 83 (Tribunal may remove party from proceeding if party fails to appear or does not comply).
(4) 第 (3) 款受第 65 條（某些當事人可以尋求退出當事人身分）和第 83 條（如果當事人未出庭或不遵守規定，仲裁庭可以將當事人從訴訟程序中剔除）的約束。
This Act applies differently in relation to the review
本法對於審查的適用有所不同
(5) The following provisions do not apply in relation to an updated decision:
(5) 下列規定不適用於更新後的決定：
(b) section 24 (decision ‑ maker must give Tribunal additional statement if Tribunal requires—general rule);
(b) 第24條（如果仲裁庭要求，決策者必須向仲裁庭提供補充說明－一般規則）；
(c) Part 10 (notice and information about administrative decision).
(c) 第 10 部分（有關行政決定的通知和資訊）。
(6) The following provisions do not apply in relation to a guidance and appeals panel application:
(6) 以下規定不適用於指導和上訴小組申請：
(aa) Division 3 of Part 3 (applying for review of decision);
(aa) 第 3 部分第 3 部分（申請覆核決定）；
(a) section 21 (parties and potential parties to be notified of application);
(a) 第 21 條（申請通知的當事人和潛在當事人）；
(b) section 23 (decision ‑ maker must give reasons and documents to Tribunal—general rule).
(b) 第23條（決策者必須向仲裁庭提供理由和文件－一般規則）。
(7) This Act applies in relation to an updated decision or a guidance and appeals panel application subject to any modifications prescribed by the regulations.
(7) 本法適用於更新的決定或指導和上訴小組申請，但須遵守法規規定的任何修改。

title: 131 Tribunal may have regard to records and documents from earlier proceeding
zh: 131 仲裁庭可考慮先前程序中的記錄和文件
path: Division 3 — Party may apply to refer Tribunal decision to guidance and appeals panel
Subdivision C — Review after Tribunal decision is referred to guidance and appeals panel
text:
In a proceeding in relation to a guidance and appeals panel application taken to be made because the President refers a decision of the Tribunal to the guidance and appeals panel, the Tribunal may have regard to:
在因庭長將法庭的決定提交給指導和上訴小組而提出的與指導和上訴小組申請有關的訴訟中，法庭可能會考慮：
(a) any record of the proceeding (the earlier proceeding ) in which the decision of the Tribunal is made (including a record of any evidence taken in the earlier proceeding); and
(a) 仲裁庭作出裁決的訴訟程序（較早的程序）的任何記錄（包括在較早的程序中取得的任何證據的記錄）；和
(b) any document or thing relating to the earlier proceeding given to the Tribunal; and
(b) 與提交給仲裁庭的先前程序有關的任何文件或物品；和
(c) any order or recommendation of the Tribunal in the earlier proceeding.
(c) 仲裁庭在先前程序中的任何命令或建議。

title: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
zh: 第 5A 部 — 某些社會服務決定的第二次覆核
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions

title: Division 1 — Preliminary
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions

title: 131A Simplified outline of this Part
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
A person may apply to the Tribunal for review of an ART social services decision.
個人可以向法庭申請審查 ART 社會服務決定。
Most ART social services decisions are decisions made by the Tribunal on review of social services decisions. However, some ART social services decisions are made originally by the Tribunal.
大多數 ART 社會服務決定是法庭在審查社會服務決定時所做的決定。然而，一些 ART 社會服務決定最初是由法庭做出的。
In general, the Tribunal must deal with an application for review of an ART social services decision in the same way as it would deal with a reviewable decision of that kind.
一般來說，仲裁庭必須以與處理此類可審查決定相同的方式處理 ART 社會服務決定的審查申請。
However, this general rule is modified by Division 3 of this Part, and may also be modified by regulations made under this Part.
然而，本一般規則由本部分第 3 部分修改，也可能由根據本部分制定的法規修改。
An application cannot be made under section 123 to refer a decision of the Tribunal on review of a social services decision, or a decision of the Tribunal on second review, to the guidance and appeals panel.
不得根據第 123 條申請將法庭關於社會服務決定複審的決定或法庭關於第二次複審的決定提交給指導和上訴小組。

title: 131B How this Part applies
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
This Part applies despite subsection 108(3) (no application for review of varied or substituted decision).
儘管有第 108(3) 款的規定，本部分仍然適用（不申請審查變更或替代的決定）。

title: 131C Meaning of eligible social services decision
zh: 131C 合格社會服務決定的涵義
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions

title: Division 2 — General rules for second review
zh: 第 2 分部 — －複審一般規則
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
Division 2 — General rules for second review

title: 131D Who can apply
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
Division 2 — General rules for second review
text:
(1) A person whose interests are affected by an ART social services decision may apply to the Tribunal for review (the second review ) of the decision.
(1) 其利益受到 ART 社會服務決定影響的人可以向法庭申請對該決定進行複審（第二次復審）。
(2) However, an application cannot be made for second review if the ART social services decision was made in accordance with subsection 103(2) (decision agreed by parties).
(2) 但是，如果 ART 社會服務決定是根據第 103(2) 款（當事人同意的決定）作出的，則不能申請複審。
(3) An ART social services decision is:
(3) ART 社會服務決策是：
(a) for an eligible social services decision that has been affirmed by the Tribunal—the decision as affirmed; or
(a) 對於法庭已確認的合格社會服務決定－已確認的決定；或
(b) for an eligible social services decision that has been varied by the Tribunal—the decision as varied; or
(b) 對於法庭已改變的合格社會服務決定－改變後的決定；或
(c) for an eligible social services decision that has been set aside and remade by the Tribunal—the decision as remade; or
(c) 對於已被法庭撤銷並重新做出的合格社會服務決定－重新作出的決定；或
(d) for an eligible social services decision that has been set aside and remitted to the decision ‑ maker by the Tribunal—the decision as set aside; or
(d) 對於已被法庭擱置並轉交給決策者的合格社會服務決定－被擱置的決定；或
(e) for an eligible social services decision made under section 92 or subsection 95N(2) of the Child Support (Registration and Collection) Act 1988 —the decision as made.
(e) 根據 1988 年《兒童扶養費（登記及領取）法》第 92 條或第 95N(2) 款所做出的合格社會服務決定－所做出的決定。

title: 131E Operation of this Act and other laws
zh: 131E 本法和其他法律的實施
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
Division 2 — General rules for second review
text:
(1) This Act applies in relation to an ART social services decision as if the decision were a reviewable decision.
(1) 本法適用於 ART 社會服務決定，如同該決定是可審查的決定一樣。
(2) If the review of an eligible social services decision under this Act was subject to provisions with a contrary intention in another Act, any second review relating to the decision is subject to those provisions in the same way.
(2) 如果根據本法對符合條件的社會服務決定的審查受到另一項法律中具有相反意圖的規定的約束，則與該決定相關的任何第二次審查也應以同樣的方式受到這些規定的約束。
(3) This section has effect subject to:
(3) 本條的效力取決於：
(a) the modifications set out in Division 3; and
(a) 第 3 部分所規定的修改；和
(b) any modifications of this Act prescribed by the regulations for the purposes of second review.
(b) 為進行第二次審查而規定的對本法的任何修改。

title: Division 3 — Modifications for second review
zh: 第 3 分部 — －二次審查的修改
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions

title: 131F References to the decision ‑ maker
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
A reference in this Act, as it would apply for the purposes of second review, to the decision ‑ maker for an ART social services decision is taken to be a reference to the decision ‑ maker for the related eligible social services decision.
本法中提及的 ART 社會服務決策的決策者（因為它將適用於第二次審查的目的）被視為提及相關合格社會服務決策的決策者。

title: 131G Giving reasons and documents to Tribunal
zh: 131G 向審裁處提供理由和文件
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
Section 23 (decision ‑ maker must give reasons and documents to Tribunal—general rule) does not apply in relation to an application for second review.
第 23 條（決策者必須向仲裁庭提供理由和文件－一般規則）不適用於第二次複審申請。

title: 131H Who can apply—claimant decisions
zh: 131H 誰可以申請－申請人的決定
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
Despite section 17 (who can apply), an application for second review in relation to a claimant decision (within the meaning of the Paid Parental Leave Act 2010 ) may not be made by a person in the person’s capacity as an employer.
儘管有第 17 條（誰可以申請），但個人不得以雇主身份提出與索賠人決定相關的第二次審查申請（根據 2010 年《帶薪育嬰假法》的含義）。

title: 131J When to apply
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
(1) Despite a contrary intention in any other law, an application for second review must be made within the time prescribed under section 18 (when to apply—general rule).
(1) 儘管任何其他法律有相反的意圖，複審申請必須在第 18 條規定的時間內提出（何時申請－一般規則）。
(2) However, an application for second review of a child care decision (within the meaning of the A New Tax System (Family Assistance) (Administration) Act 1999 ) about an individual’s entitlement to be paid CCS for a week may also be made after the time prescribed under section 18 (when to apply—general rule) if the application is made:
(2) 但是，如果提出申請，則也可以在第 18 條（何時申請－一般規則）規定的時間之後，對有關個人領取一周 CCS 的權利的兒童保育決定（按照 1999 年新稅收制度（家庭援助）（管理）法的含義）提出申請：
(a) because of a review, by the Commissioner of Taxation, of a previous decision by the Commissioner about the taxable income of the individual or another person in relation to whom the individual has met the CCS reconciliation conditions for the income year in which the CCS fortnight that includes the week starts; and
(a) 由於稅務專員對稅務專員先前做出的關於個人或與該個人相關的其他人的應稅收入的審查而做出的決定，該個人或其他人已滿足包含該週的 CCS 兩週開始的收入年度的 CCS 調節條件；和
(b) within the time prescribed under that section after the individual or other person was notified by the Commissioner of the outcome of the review.
(b) 在專員通知該個人或其他人審查結果後，在該條規定的時間內。

title: 131K Parties to proceeding
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
(1) The parties to a proceeding for second review include the persons who were parties to the proceeding for review of the related eligible social services decision.
(1) 第二次複審程序的當事人包括相關合格社會服務決定複審程序的當事人。
(2) However, subsection (1) has effect subject to:
(2) 但是，第 (1) 款的效力取決於：
(a) section 65 (certain parties may seek to withdraw from being a party); and
(a) 第 65 條（某些當事人可以尋求退出當事人身分）；和
(b) section 83 (Tribunal may remove party from proceeding if party fails to appear or does not comply).
(b) 第 83 條（若當事人未出庭或不遵守規定，仲裁庭可將當事人從訴訟程序中剔除）。

title: 131L Limits on applying to become a party to proceeding—claimant decisions
zh: 131L 申請成為訴訟一方的限制－原告的決定
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
(1) This section applies to a proceeding for a second review that relates to a claimant decision (within the meaning of the Paid Parental Leave Act 2010 ).
(1) 本節適用於與原告決定相關的第二次審查程序（根據 2010 年《帶薪育嬰假法》）。
(2) Despite paragraph 22(1)(c), a person may not apply to be a party to the proceeding in the person’s capacity as an employer.
(2) 儘管有第 22(1)(c) 條的規定，個人不得以雇主身分申請成為訴訟當事人。

title: 131M Decision cannot be altered outside Tribunal process
zh: 131M 裁決不能在仲裁庭程序之外更改
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
Despite a contrary intention in any other law, section 31 (decision cannot be altered outside Tribunal process) has effect in relation to a second review.
儘管任何其他法律有相反的意圖，第 31 條（決定不能在法庭程序之外改變）對於第二次審查仍然有效。

title: 131N No automatic election notice for decision ‑ maker
zh: 131N 沒有自動選舉決策者的通知
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
Despite a contrary intention in any other law, a decision ‑ maker is not taken to have given the Tribunal an election notice in relation to a second review.
儘管任何其他法律有相反的意圖，決策者並不被視為已向法庭發出有關第二次審查的選舉通知。

title: 131P Tribunal may have regard to records and documents from earlier proceeding
zh: 131P 仲裁庭可考慮先前程序中的記錄和文件
path: Part 5A — Second review for certain social services decisions
text:
In a proceeding for second review, the Tribunal may have regard to:
在第二次審查程序中，仲裁庭可能會考慮：
(a) any record of the proceeding (the earlier proceeding ) in which the ART social services decision was made (including a record of any evidence taken in the earlier proceeding); and
(a) 作出 ART 社會服務決定的訴訟程序（較早的訴訟程序）的任何記錄（包括在較早的訴訟程序中採取的任何證據的記錄）；和
(b) any document or thing relating to the earlier proceeding given to the Tribunal; and
(b) 與提交給仲裁庭的先前程序有關的任何文件或物品；和

title: 132 Simplified outline of this Part
path: Part 6 — Proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area
text:
Special rules apply when the Tribunal’s powers in relation to a proceeding are exercised in the Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area. This occurs if the proceeding relates to an intelligence and security decision or the President otherwise directs (for example where the President is satisfied national security information would be involved).
當法庭在情報和安全管轄範圍內行使與訴訟有關的權力時，適用特殊規則。如果訴訟涉及情報和安全決定或總統另有指示（例如，總統確信將涉及國家安全資訊），就會發生這種情況。
The standard Tribunal process is adjusted, including in relation to applicants, decision ‑ makers, parties, constitution of the Tribunal, dispute resolution processes and Tribunal decisions. Some adjustments apply to all intelligence and security decisions, others only apply to some kinds of decisions.
調整了標準仲裁庭程序，包括與申請人、決策者、當事人、仲裁庭組成、爭議解決程序和仲裁庭裁決有關的內容。有些調整適用於所有情報和安全決策，有些調整僅適用於某些類型的決策。
Referral to the guidance and appeals panel is not available in relation to intelligence and security decisions. However, for some kinds of intelligence and security decisions reviewed by the Tribunal, the applicant may apply to the Tribunal for the decision to be reviewed again.
與情報和安全決策相關的事宜無法轉介給指導和上訴小組。然而，對於仲裁庭審查的某些情報和安全決定，申請人可以向仲裁庭申請再次審查該決定。
Special rules are also in place to protect information. These deal with:
也制定了特殊規則來保護資訊。這些涉及：
(a) whether statements of reasons can be given; and
(a) 能否說明理由；和
(b) what information is to be provided to the Tribunal and parties to proceedings; and
(b) 應向仲裁庭和訴訟各方提供哪些資訊；和
(c) how the information is to be provided; and
(c) 如何提供資訊；和
(d) how the information is to be used and protected.
(d) 如何使用和保護資訊。
For example, different requirements apply to information covered by certificates issued on public interest grounds.
例如，不同的要求適用於以公共利益為由頒發的證書所涵蓋的資訊。

Subdivision A — Applications and notice of applications
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies in relation to an intelligence and security decision, other than an exempt security record decision.
(1) 本節適用於情報和安全決定，但豁免安全記錄決定除外。
Application for decision to be reviewed again
申請再次覆核決定
(2) If the Tribunal has reviewed the decision, the person who applied for the review may apply to the Tribunal for the decision to be reviewed again.
（二）仲裁庭已經覆核決定的，申請覆核人可以向仲裁庭申請再次覆核該決定。
(3) The Tribunal must dismiss the application unless the Tribunal is satisfied that:
(3) 仲裁庭必須駁回申請，除非仲裁庭確信：
(a) further evidence of material significance has become available; and
(a) 已獲得具有重大意義的進一步證據；和
(b) the further evidence was not available at the time of the initial review.
(b) 初步審查時尚未提供進一步證據。

title: 141 Information to be provided by agency head
zh: 141 機構負責人應提供的訊息
path: Part 6 — Proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area
Subdivision B — Information to be provided by agency head
text:
When this section applies
本節適用時
(1) This section applies:
(1) 本條適用：
(a) in relation to an intelligence and security decision, other than an exempt security record decision; and
(a) 與情報和安全決定有關，但豁免安全記錄決定除外；和
(b) instead of Subdivision B of Division 4 of Part 3 (provision of reasons and documents).
(b) 代替第 3 部分第 4 部分的 B 部分（提供理由和文件）。
Information to be provided by agency head
機構負責人需提供的信息
(2) If the agency head is given notice of an application for review of the decision, the agency head must give the Tribunal:
(2) 若機構負責人收到複審決定申請的通知，機構負責人必須向仲裁庭提供：
(a) in any case—all the relevant information that:
(a) 在任何情況下－所有相關資訊：
(i) was used to make the decision; and
(i) 用來做決定；和
(ii) is available to the agency head; and
(ii) 可供機構負責人使用；和
(b) if the decision is a security clearance decision—a copy of the statement of grounds prepared for the decision under section 83C of the ASIO Act; and
(b) 如果該決定是安全審查決定－根據 ASIO 法案第 83C 條為該決定準備的理由說明副本；和
(c) if the decision is a foreign acquisitions and takeovers decision:
(c) 如果該決定是一項外國收購和併購決定：
(i) a copy of the notice given to the person concerned under subsection 79B(1) of the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975 ; and
(i) 根據《1975 年外國收購和接管法》第 79B(1) 款向有關人員發出的通知副本；和
(ii) a copy of the whole of the notice (without redactions).
(ii) 整個通知的副本（未經修改）。
Non ‑ disclosure certificates
保密證書
(3) If the application is for review of a decision mentioned in column 1 of an item in the following table, and a certificate mentioned in column 2 of the item has been made in relation to the decision, the agency head must also give the Tribunal the documents mentioned in column 3 of the item.
(3) 如果申請複審下表第 1 欄所述的決定，並且已就該決定提供該項目第 2 欄所述的證明，機構負責人還必須向仲裁庭提供該項目第 3 欄所述的文件。
Non ‑ disclosure certificates—documents to be given to Tribunal
Item | Column 1 Decision | Column 2 Certificate | Column 3 Documents to be given
1 | Criminal intelligence assessment | Certificate under subsection 54D(7) of the Australian Crime Commission Act 2002 | The following: (a) a copy of the certificate; (b) a copy of the whole assessment (without redactions)
2 | Security assessment | Certificate under paragraph 38(2)(b) of the ASIO Act | The following: (a) a copy of the certificate; (b) a copy of the whole assessment (without redactions)
3 | Security clearance decision | Certificate under subsection 83C(6) of the ASIO Act | A copy of the certificate
4 | Security clearance suitability assessment | Certificate under paragraph 83A(4)(b) of the ASIO Act | The following: (a) a copy of the certificate; (b) a copy of the whole assessment (without redactions), including a copy of the statement of grounds prepared for the assessment under section 82G of the ASIO Act
保密證明－向仲裁庭提供的文件
項目 |第 1 欄決定 |第2欄 證書|第 3 欄 需提供的文件
1 |犯罪情報評估|根據《2002 年澳洲犯罪委員會法》第 54D(7) 款提供的證書 |以下： (a) 證書副本； (b) 整個評估的副本（未經修改）
2 |安全評估|根據 ASIO 法案第 38(2)(b) 段提供的證書 |以下： (a) 證書副本； (b) 整個評估的副本（未經修改）
3 |安全許可決定| ASIO 法案第 83C(6) 款下的證書 |證書複印件
4 |安全許可適宜性評估 |根據 ASIO 法案第 83A(4)(b) 段提供的證書 |以下： (a) 證書副本； (b) 整個評估的副本（未經編輯），包括根據 ASIO 法案第 82G 條為評估準備的理由聲明的副本
Prohibition on disclosure of subsection 79B(1) notices
禁止揭露第 79B(1) 款通知
(4) The Tribunal must not, at any time, permit an applicant to have access to:
(4) 仲裁庭在任何時間都不得允許申請人存取：
(a) any copy or particulars of a notice (without redaction) given under subsection 79B(1) of the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975 ; or
(a) 根據《1975 年外國收購和接管法》第 79B(1) 款發出的通知的任何副本或詳情（未經編輯）；或
(b) any matter to which the notice (without redaction) relates.
(b) 與通知（未經編輯）相關的任何事項。
General rules
一般規則
(5) Information or a document required under this section must be given to the Tribunal within 28 days after the agency head is given notice of the application, or within such further period as the Tribunal allows.
(5) 本節要求的資訊或文件必須在機構負責人收到申請通知後 28 天內或在仲裁庭允許的更長時間內提供給仲裁庭。
(6) To avoid doubt, this section applies whether or not the information or documents are favourable or unfavourable to the applicant.
(6) 為避免疑義，不論資訊或文件對申請人有利或不利，本條均適用。

title: Subdivision C — Provision of security clearance standards

title: 142 When this Subdivision applies
path: Part 6 — Proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area
Subdivision C — Provision of security clearance standards
text:
This Subdivision applies in relation to the review of:
本款適用於以下方面的審查：
(a) a security clearance decision; or
(a) 安全審查決定；或
(b) a security clearance suitability assessment.
(b) 安全許可適宜性評估。

title: 143 Director ‑ General of Security may provide standards
path: Part 6 — Proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area
Subdivision C — Provision of security clearance standards
text:
Providing standards
提供標準
(1) The Director ‑ General of Security may give the Tribunal either or both of the following:
(1) 安全局長可向仲裁庭提供以下一項或兩項：
(a) a copy of any standard (or a part of a standard) certified in writing by the Director ‑ General as a standard relating to the Commonwealth’s highest level of security clearance that was used to make the security clearance decision or the security clearance suitability assessment;
(a) 經總幹事書面認證為與英聯邦最高級別安全審查有關的標準（或標準的一部分）的副本，該標準用於做出安全審查決定或安全審查適宜性評估；
(b) a copy of any standard (or a part of a standard) certified in writing by the Director ‑ General as a current standard relating to the Commonwealth’s highest level of security clearance.
(b) 經總幹事書面認證為與英聯邦最高安全等級相關的現行標準的任何標準（或標準的一部分）的副本。
Note: A standard relating to the Commonwealth’s highest level of security clearance is part of the Australian Government’s framework of protective security policy.
註：與聯邦最高安全許可證等級相關的標準是澳洲政府保護性安全政策框架的一部分。
Applying standards
應用標準
(2) If a copy of only one standard (or part) is given, the Tribunal must apply the standard (or part) in its review of the decision.
(2) 如果僅提供一份標準（或部分）的副本，仲裁庭必須在審查裁決時應用該標準（或部分）。
(3) If copies of more than one standard (or part) are given, the Tribunal must, in its review of the decision, apply the standard (or part) certified by the Director ‑ General as being a current standard.
(3) 如果提供了一份以上標準（或部分）的副本，仲裁庭在審查決定時必須採用經總幹事認證為現行標準的標準（或部分）。

title: 144 Disclosure of standards
path: Part 6 — Proceedings in Intelligence and Security jurisdictional area
Subdivision C — Provision of security clearance standards
text:
General rule
一般規則
(1) The Tribunal must do all things necessary to ensure that a copy of a standard (or a part of a standard) given to the Tribunal under section 143, or any information contained in the copy, is not disclosed to the applicant or any person other than:
(1) 仲裁庭必須採取一切必要措施，確保根據第 143 條向仲裁庭提供的標準（或標準的一部分）副本或副本中包含的任何資訊不會向申請人或除以下人員以外的任何人披露：
(a) the Director ‑ General of Security or the Director ‑ General’s representative; or
(a) 安全局長或局長代表；或
(b) a member in the course of the performance of the member’s duties; or
(b) 會員在履行其職責過程中；或
(c) the Principal Registrar in the course of the performance of the Principal Registrar’s duties; or
(c) 首席書記官在履行首席書記官職責期間；或
(d) a staff member in the course of the performance of the staff member’s duties.
(d) 工作人員在履行其職責過程中。
Exception
例外
(2) However, subsection (1) does not apply in relation to disclosure to the applicant or a person representing the applicant to the extent that the information:
(2) 但是，第 (1) 款不適用於向申請人或代表申請人的人員揭露以下資訊：
(a) has already been lawfully disclosed to the applicant; or
(a) 已合法地向申請人揭露；或
(b) is disclosed to the applicant with the consent of the Director ‑ General of Security.
(b) 經安全總監同意後向申請人揭露。
