title: 5. Preamble
text:
5. Preamble
5. 序言

title: 5.1. Objectives
text:
5.1. Objectives
                     (1)  The objective of the Act is to regulate, in the national interest, the coming into, and presence in,
                     Australia of non-citizens. Relevantly, a non-citizen who does not pass the character test (see Annex A
                     for explanation) is liable for refusal of a visa or cancellation of their visa.
                     (2)  Specifically, under subsection 501(1) of the Act, non-citizens may be refused a visa if they do not
                     satisfy the decision-maker that they pass the character test. Under subsection 501(2), non-citizens
                     may have their visa cancelled if the decision-maker reasonably suspects that they do not pass the
                     character test, and the non-citizens do not satisfy the decision-maker that they do pass the character
                     test. Where the discretion to refuse to grant or to cancel a visa is enlivened, the decision-maker must
                     consider the specific circumstances of the case in deciding whether to exercise that discretion.
                     (3)  Under subsection 501(3A) of the Act, the decision-maker must cancel a visa that has been granted
                     to a person if the decision-maker is satisfied that the person does not pass the character test because
                     of the operation of paragraph (6)(a) (on the basis of paragraph (7)(a), (b) or (c) or paragraph (6)(e))) and
                     the non-citizen is serving a sentence of imprisonment, on a full-time basis in a custodial institution, for
                     an offence against a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory. A non-citizen who has had their
                     visa cancelled under section 501(3A) may request revocation of that decision under section 501CA of
                     the Act. Where the decision-maker considering the request is not satisfied that the non-citizen passes
                     the character test, the decision-maker must consider whether there is another reason to revoke the
                     cancellation given the specific circumstances of the case.
                     (4)  The purpose of this Direction is to guide decision-makers in performing functions or
                     exercising powers under section 501 and 501CA of the Act. Under section 499(2A) of the Act,
                     such decision-makers must comply with a direction made under section 499.
5.1.目標
                     (1) 該法案的目標是為了國家利益，規範進入和存在以下行為：
                     非公民的澳洲。相應地，未通過品格測試的非公民（見附件 A）
                     解釋）將承擔拒絕簽證或取消簽證的責任。
                     (2) 具體來說，根據該法第 501(1) 款，非公民如果不這樣做，可能會被拒絕簽證。
                     讓決策者相信他們通過了性格測驗。根據第 501(2) 款，非公民
                     如果決策者有理由懷疑他們沒有通過簽證，他們的簽證可能會被取消
                     品格測試，非公民不符合決策者的要求，認為他們通過了品格測試
                     測試。如果拒絕授予或取消簽證的自由裁量權被激活，決策者必須
                     在決定是否行使該自由裁量權時考慮案件的具體情況。
                     (3) 根據該法第 501(3A) 款，決策者必須取消已授予的簽證

                     第(6)(a)款的實施情形(以第(7)(a)、(b)或(c)款或第(6)(e)款為基礎）；及

title: 5.2. Principles
text:
5.2. Principles
               The principles below provide the framework within which decision-makers should approach their task of
               deciding whether to refuse or cancel a non-citizen's visa under section 501, or whether to revoke a
               mandatory cancellation under section 501CA. The factors (to the extent relevant in the particular case) that
               must be considered in making a decision under section 501 or section 501CA of the Act are identified in
               Part 2.
                     (1)  Australia has a sovereign right to determine whether non-citizens who are of character concern
                     are allowed to enter and/or remain in Australia. Being able to come to or remain in Australia is a
                     privilege Australia confers on non-citizens in the expectation that they are, and have been, law-
                     abiding, will respect important institutions, such as Australia's law enforcement framework, and will not
                     cause or threaten harm to individuals or the Australian community.
                     (2)  The safety of the Australian Community is the highest priority of the Australian Government.
                     (3)  Non-citizens who engage, have engaged in, advocated for, or encouraged criminal or other
                     serious conduct should expect to be denied the privilege of coming to, or to forfeit the privilege of
                     staying in, Australia.
                     (4)  The Australian community expects that the Australian Government can and should refuse entry to
                     non-citizens, or cancel their visas, if they engaged in conduct, in Australia or elsewhere, that raises
                     serious character concerns. This expectation of the Australian community applies regardless of
                     whether the non-citizen poses a measurable risk of causing physical harm to the Australian
                     community. The Australian community recognises the simple presence of such non                           -citizens causes
                     harm to the social fabric of our nation.
5.2.原則
               以下原則提供了決策者應在其中完成其任務的框架：
               決定是否根據第 501 條拒絕或取消非公民簽證，或是否撤銷
               根據第 501CA 條強制取消。因素（在特定情況下相關的範圍內）
               根據該法案第 501 條或第 501CA 條做出決定時必須考慮的因素在
               第 2 部分。
                     (1) 澳洲擁有決定品格問題的非公民是否屬於澳洲的主權權利
                     被允許進入和/或留在澳大利亞。能夠來到或留在澳洲是一個
                     澳洲賦予非公民特權，期望他們現在和過去都是合法的——
                     遵守，將尊重重要機構，例如澳洲的執法框架，並且不會
                     對個人或澳洲社區造成或威脅傷害。
                     （2）澳洲社會的安全是澳洲政府的首要任務。
                     (3) 參與、曾經參與、鼓吹或鼓勵犯罪或其他犯罪行為的非公民
                     嚴重行為應該被剝奪來到這裡的特權，或是喪失來到這裡的特權。
                     留在澳洲。
                     （4）澳洲社會期望澳洲政府能夠而且應該拒絕入境
                     非公民，如果他們在澳洲或其他地方從事引起爭議的行為，則取消其簽證
                     嚴重的品格問題。澳洲社會的這項期望無論在什麼情況下都適用
                     非公民是否對澳洲人造成身體傷害的可衡量風險

                     危害我們國家的社會結構。
(5)  Australia has a low tolerance of any criminal or other serious conduct by visa applicants or those

                     (7) 決策者必須考慮與決策相關的主要因素和其他因素
                     個別情況。在某些情況下，非公民行為的性質或可能造成的傷害
                     如果這種行為再次發生，可能會造成嚴重的後果，甚至強烈反補貼
                     考慮因素可能不足以證明不取消或拒絕簽證或撤銷簽證的理由
                     強制取消。
                     (8) 家庭暴力或影響家庭暴力等某些行為的固有性質
                      未成年子女問題如此嚴重，即使是強有力的反補貼考量也可能不足以證明其合理性
                      不取消或拒絕簽證，或撤銷強制取消，即使訊息
                      在考慮時可用表示非公民不會構成可衡量的風險
                      对澳大利亚社区造成人身伤害。
                     (9) 澳洲社會期望非公民遵守澳洲制定的規則和標準
                      移民框架，包括當留在澳大利亞的特權終止時離開澳大利亞
                      或被沒收。澳洲社會承認絕大多數非公民這樣做
                      遵守這些規則。

title: Part 2. Making a decision
text:
Part 2. Making a decision
第 2 部分：做決定

title: 6. Making a decision
text:
6. Making a decision
               Informed by the principles in paragraph 5.2, a decision-maker must take into account the considerations
               identified in sections 8 and 9, where relevant to the decision.
6. 做出決定
               根據第 5.2 段中的原則，決策者必須考慮以下因素
               第 8 節和第 9 節中與決定相關的內容。

title: 7. Taking the relevant considerations into account
text:
7. Taking the relevant considerations into account
                     (1)  In applying the considerations (both primary and other), information and evidence from
                      independent and authoritative sources should be given appropriate weight.
                     (2)  The primary consideration at 8.1 below (protection of the Australian community) is generally to
                      be given greater weight than other primary considerations. Otherwise, primary considerations
                      should generally be given greater weight than the other considerations.
                     (3)  One or more primary considerations may outweigh other primary considerations.
7. 考慮相關因素
                     (1) 在應用考慮因素（主要的和其他的）時，資訊和證據來自
                      應適當重視獨立和權威的來源。
                     (2) 以下 8.1 中的主要考慮因素（保護澳洲社區）通常是
                      比其他主要考慮因素給予更大的重視。否則，主要考慮
                      通常應比其他考慮因素給予更大的重視。
                     (3) 一個或多個主要考慮因素可能超過其他主要考慮因素。

title: 8. Primary considerations
text:
8. Primary considerations
               In making a decision under section 501(1), 501(2) or 501CA(4), the following are primary considerations:
                     (1)  protection of the Australian community from criminal or other serious conduct;
                     (2)  whether the conduct engaged in constituted domestic or family violence;
                     (3)  expectations of the Australian community;
                     (4)  the best interests of minor children in Australia, including the interests of child victims
8. 主要考慮因素
               在根據第 501(1)、501(2) 或 501CA(4) 條做出決定時，主要考慮以下因素：
                     (1) 保護澳洲社區免受犯罪或其他嚴重行為的侵害；
                     （二）實施的行為是否構成家庭暴力；
                     （3）澳洲社會的期望；
                     （4）澳洲未成年兒童的最大利益，包括受害兒童的利益

title: 8.1. Protection of the Australian community
text:
8.1. Protection of the Australian community
                     (1) When considering protection of the Australian community, decision-makers should keep in mind that
                     the safety of the Australian community is the highest priority of the Australian Government. To that end,
                     the Government is committed to protecting the Australian community from harm as a result of criminal
                     activity or other serious conduct by non-citizens. In this respect, decision-makers should have particular
                     regard to the principle that entering or remaining in Australia is a privilege that Australia confers on non-
                     citizens in the expectation that they are, have been, and will continue to be law abiding, will respect
                     important institutions, and will not cause or threaten harm to individuals or the Australian community;
8.1.保護澳洲社區
                     (1) 在考慮保護澳洲社區時，決策者應牢記：
                     澳洲社區的安全是澳洲政府的首要任務。為此，
                     政府致力於保護澳洲社區免受犯罪行為的傷害
                     非公民的活動或其他嚴重行為。在這方面，決策者應該有特別的
                     考慮到進入或留在澳大利亞是澳大利亞賦予非
                     公民期望他們現在、過去並將繼續守法，並尊重
                     重要機構，不會對個人或澳洲社區造成或威脅傷害；
(2) Decision-makers should also give consideration to:
                         a)    the nature and seriousness of the non-citizen's conduct to date; and
(2) 決策者也應考慮：
                         a) 非公民迄今行為的性質和嚴重性；和
b)   the risk to the Australian community, should the non-citizen commit further offences or engage
                          in other serious conduct, in the event they were granted the visa, the visa is not cancelled, or the
                          mandatory cancellation revoked, as the case may be.
b) 若非公民進一步犯罪或從事其他活動，澳洲社會將面臨風險
                          有其他嚴重行為的，在獲得簽證的情況下，簽證未被取消，或者
                          強制取消視具體情況而撤銷。

title: 8.1.1. The nature and seriousness of the conduct
zh: 8.1.1　行為的性質與嚴重程度
text:
8.1.1. The nature and seriousness of the conduct
                     (1) In considering the nature and seriousness of the non-citizen's criminal offending or other conduct to
                     date, decision-makers must have regard to the following:
                          a) without limiting the range of conduct that may be considered very serious, the types of crimes or
                          conduct described below are viewed very seriously by the Australian Government and the Australian
                          community:
                                     i.  violent and/or sexual crimes;
                                     ii. crimes against women or children, particularly but not limited to crimes of a violent and/or
                                     sexual nature, regardless of the sentence imposed;
                                     iii. acts of domestic or family violence, regardless of whether there is a conviction for an
                                     offence or a sentence imposed, particularly acts of domestic or family violence against
                                     children or exposing children as witnesses;
                          b) without limiting the range of conduct that may be considered serious, the types of crimes or
                          conduct described below are considered by the Australian Government and the Australian
                          community to be serious:
                                     i.  causing a person to enter into or being party to a forced marriage (other than being a
                                     victim), regardless of whether there is a conviction for an offence or a sentence imposed;
                                     ii. crimes committed against vulnerable members of the community (such as the elderly and
                                     the disabled), or government representatives or officials due to the position they hold, or in
                                     the performance of their duties;
                                     iii. any conduct that forms the basis for a finding that a non             -citizen does not pass an aspect
                                     of the character test that is dependent upon the decision                -maker's opinion (for example,
                                     section 501(6)(c));
                                     iv. where the non     -citizen is in Australia, a crime committed or other serious conduct
                                     engaged in while the non         -citizen was in immigration detention, during an escape from
                                     immigration detention, or after the non           -citizen escaped from immigration detention, but
                                     before the non     -citizen was taken into immigration detention again, or an offence against
                                     section 197A of the Act, which prohibits escape from immigration detention;
                                     v. engaging in conduct constituting a hate crime, or advocacy or conduct that might have
                                     the effect of leading another person to engage in conduct constituting a hate crime;
                                     vi. any crime that involves a drug offence or damage to property where the non                        -citizen was
                                     sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than five years.
                          c) the sentence imposed by the courts for a crime or crimes;
                          d) the impact of the offending on any victims of offending or other conduct and their family, where
                          information in this regard is available and the non            -citizen whose visa is being considered for refusal
                          or cancellation, or who has sought revocation of the               mandatory cancellation of their visa, has been
                          afforded procedural fairness;
                          e) the frequency of the non        -citizen's offending and/or whether there is any trend of increasing
                          seriousness;
                          f) the cumulative effect of repeated offending;
                          g) whether the non-citizen has provided false or misleading information to the Department, including
                          by not disclosing prior criminal offending;

title: 8.1.2. The risk to the Australian community should the non-citizen commit further offences or engage in other serious conduct
zh: 8.1.2　非公民再次犯罪或從事其他嚴重行為對澳洲社會造成的風險
text:
8.1.2. The risk to the Australian community should the non                      -citizen commit further offences or
                engage in other serious conduct
                    (1) In considering the need to protect the Australian community (including individuals, groups or
                    institutions) from harm, decision        -makers should have regard to the Government's view that the Australian
                    community's tolerance for any risk of future harm becomes                   lower as the seriousness of the potential
                    harm increases. Some conduct and the harm that would be caused, if it were to be repeated, is so
                    serious that any risk that it may be repeated may be unacceptable.
                    (2) In assessing the risk that may be posed by the non               -citizen to the Australian community if the visa
                    were not refused, not cancelled, or the mandatory cancellation were revoked, as the case may be,
                    decision-makers must have regard to, cumulatively:
                          a)   the nature of the harm to individuals or the Australian community should the non                      -citizen
                               engage in further criminal or other serious conduct; and
                          b)   the likelihood of the non-citizen engaging in further criminal or other serious conduct, taking
                               into account:
                                     i. information and evidence on the risk of the non             -citizen re-offending; and
                                     ii. evidence of rehabilitation achieved by the time of the decision, giving weight to time spent
                                     in the community since their most recent offence (noting that decisions should not be
                                     delayed in order for rehabilitative courses to be undertaken).
                    (3) Where a non-citizen will remain in Australia on a temporary visa if the visa were refused, or cancelled,
                    or the mandatory cancellation were not revoked, as the case may be, decision                       -makers should
                    proceed on the basis that the Government’s view is the Australian community is better protected by:
                          a)   ensuring that the non-citizen is available for removal from Australia if it becomes reasonably
                               practicable (including to a country that is a party to a third country reception arrangement),
                               even if their removal is not reasonably practicable at the time of               the decision or in the
                               foreseeable future; and
8.1.2.如果非公民犯下進一步的罪行或行為，澳洲社會將面臨風險
                從事其他嚴重行為
                    (1) 在考慮保護澳洲社區（包括個人、團體或
                    機構）免受損害，決策者應考慮政府的觀點，即澳大利亞
                    隨著潛在危害的嚴重性的增加，社區對未來危害風險的容忍度會降低
                    傷害增加。有些行為如果重複發生的話，會造成很大的傷害
                    嚴重的是，任何可能重複的風險都是不可接受的。
                    (2) 在評估非公民可能對澳洲社會構成的風險時，如果簽證
                    未被拒絕、未被取消或強制取消被撤銷（視情況而定），
                    決策者必須綜合考慮：
                          a) 非公民對個人或澳洲社區造成傷害的性質
                               從事進一步的犯罪或其他嚴重行為；和
                          b) 非公民從事進一步犯罪或其他嚴重行為的可能性，採取
                               考慮到：
                                     島有關非公民再次犯罪風險的資訊和證據；和
                                     二.作出決定時已實現康復的證據，重視所花費的時間
                                     自從他們最近一次犯罪以來，在社區中（注意到不應做出決定）
                                     為了進行復健課程而推遲）。
                    (3) 如果簽證被拒絕或取消，非公民將持臨時簽證留在澳大利亞，
                    或強制取消未撤銷（視具體情況而定），決策者應
                    政府認為澳洲社區受到以下方面的更好保護：
                          a) 確保非公民在合理情況下可以被驅逐出澳大利亞
                               可行（包括作為第三國接待安排的締約方的國家），
                               即使在做出決定時或在執行過程中將其刪除並不合理可行
                               可預見的未來；和
b)   the possibility that any temporary visa held by the non             -citizen would be subject to conditions
                               directed to the risk that the non-citizen poses or that a temporary visa held by the non-citizen in
                               the future be made subject to such conditions.
                    (4) Beyond the guidance above, decision-makers are not required to assess the risk of harm to the
                    Australian community in any particular way or to ascribe any particular characterisation to the quality of
                    the risk.
b) 任何非公民持有的臨時簽證可能受條件限制
                               針對非公民構成的風險或非公民持有的臨時簽證
                               未來將受到此類條件的約束。
                    (4) 除了上述指引之外，決策者無需評估對企業造成損害的風險。
                    澳洲社區以任何特定方式或將任何特定特徵歸因於質量
                    風險。

title: 8.3. Expectations of the Australian Community
text:
8.3. Expectations of the Australian Community
                    (1) The Australian community expects non              -citizens to obey Australian laws while in Australia. Where a
                    non-citizen has engaged in serious conduct in breach of this expectation, or where there is an
                    unacceptable risk that they may do so, the Australian community, as a norm, expects the Government to
                    not allow such a non-citizen to enter or remain in Australia, recognising the harm this does to the social

title: 8.4. Best interests of minor children in Australia affected by the decision
zh: 8.4　受決定影響的澳洲未成年子女的最大利益
text:
8.4. Best interests of minor children in Australia affected by the decision
                      (1)  Decision-makers must make a determination about whether cancellation or refusal under
                      section 501, or non-revocation under section 501CA is, or is not, in the best interests of a child affected
                      by the decision.
                      (2)  This consideration applies only if the child is, or would be, under 18 years old at the time when the
                      decision to refuse or cancel the visa, or to not revoke the mandatory cancellation of the visa, is
                      expected to be made.
                      (3)  Decision-makers should consider the best interests of any child victims of the non-citizen,
                      including the potential impact on child victims of any future offending.
                      (4)  If there are two or more relevant children, the best interests of each child should be given individual
                      consideration to the extent that their interests may differ.
                      (5)  In considering the best interests of the child, the following factors must be considered where
                      relevant:
                           a)   the nature and duration of the relationship between the child and the non-citizen, including
                                whether the relationship is non-parental, and/or there is no existing relationship and/or there
                                have been long periods of absence, or limited meaningful contact (i                    ncluding whether an
                                existing Court order restricts contact);
                           b)   the extent to which the non-citizen is likely to play a positive parental role in the future, taking
                                into account the length of time until the child turns 18, and including any Court orders relating
                                to parental access and care arrangements;
                           c)   the impact of the non-citizen's prior conduct, and any possible future conduct, and whether that
                                conduct has had, or could have, a negative impact on the child, including their physical,
                                emotional, psychological and economic development and/or evidence that the child has
                                suffered or experienced any trauma arising from the non-citizen's conduct;
                           d)   the likely effect that any separation from the non-citizen would have on the child, taking into
                                account the child's or non-citizen's ability to maintain contact in other ways;
                           e)   whether there are other persons who already fulfil a parental role in relation to the child;
                           f)   any known views of the child (with those views being given due weight in accordance with the
                                age and maturity of the child);
8.4.受該決定影響的澳洲未成年子女的最大利益
                      (1) 決策者必須根據是否取消或拒絕作出決定
                      第 501 條或第 501CA 條規定的不撤銷是否符合受影響兒童的最大利益
                      由決定。
                      (2) 此考慮僅適用於兒童在申請時未滿 18 歲或將不滿 18 歲的情況。
                      決定拒絕或取消簽證，或不撤銷強制取消簽證的決定，
                      預計將被製作。
                      (3) 決策者應考慮非公民的任何兒童受害者的最大利益，
                      包括未來任何犯罪行為對兒童受害者的潛在影響。
                      （4）如果有兩個或兩個以上相關子女，應給予每個子女單獨的最大利益
                      考慮他們的利益可能不同的程度。
                      (5) 在考慮兒童的最大利益時，必須考慮以下因素：
                      相關：
                           a) 兒童與非公民關係的性質與持續時間，包括
                                該關係是否是非父母關係，和/或不存在現有關係和/或
                                長期缺席或有意義的接觸有限（包括是否
                                現有法院命令限制接觸）；
                           b) 非公民在未來可能發揮積極的父母角色的程度，考慮到
                                考慮到孩子年滿 18 歲之前的時間長度，並包括任何相關的法院命令
                                父母的探視和照顧安排；
                           c) 非公民之前的行為以及任何未來可能的行為的影響，以及是否
                                行為已經或可能對兒童產生負面影響，包括他們的身體、
                                情緒、心理和經濟發展和/或孩子有證據表明
                                遭受或經歷過因非公民的行為而造成的任何創傷；
                           d) 與非公民的任何分離可能對兒童的影響，考慮到
                                考慮兒童或非公民以其他方式保持聯繫的能力；
                           e) 是否有其他人已經扮演了與孩子相關的父母角色；
                           f) 兒童的任何已知觀點（這些觀點根據
                                孩子的年齡和成熟度）；
g)   evidence that the child has been the subject of any form of abusive or neglectful conduct by the
                               non-citizen, be it physical, sexual, emotional, psychological or economic;
                          h)   any risk of the child becoming the subject of any form of abusive or neglectful conduct by the
                               non-citizen be it physical, sexual, emotional, psychological or economic;
                          i)   evidence that the child has been exposed to domestic or family violence;
                          j)   any risk of the child being exposed to domestic or family violence perpetrated by the non-citizen
                               or further serious or criminal conduct perpetrated by the non-citizen;
                          k)   evidence that the child has suffered or experienced any physical or emotional trauma
                               arising from the non-citizen's conduct.
g) 有證據顯示兒童曾遭受任何形式的虐待或疏忽行為
                               非公民，無論是身體、性、情緒、心理或經濟；
                          h) 兒童遭受任何形式的虐待或疏忽行為的風險
                               無論是身體、性、情緒、心理或經濟方面都非公民；
                          i) 兒童遭受家庭暴力的證據；
                          j) 兒童遭受非公民實施的家庭暴力的任何風險
                               或非公民所犯下的其他嚴重或犯罪行為；
                          k) 孩子曾經遭受或經歷任何身體或情緒創傷的證據
                               由非公民的行為引起的。

title: 9. Other considerations
text:
9. Other considerations
                     (1) In making a decision under section 501(1), 501(2) or 501CA(4), the considerations below must also
                     be taken into account, where relevant, in accordance with the following provisions. These
                     considerations include (but are not limited to):
                     1)   the strength, nature and duration of ties to Australia
                     2)   legal consequences of the decision;
                     3)   extent of impediments if removed.
9. 其他考慮因素
                     (1) 在根據第 501(1)、501(2) 或 501CA(4) 條做出決定時，也必須考慮以下因素
                     酌情依以下規定予以考慮。這些
                     考慮因素包括（但不限於）：
                     1) 與澳洲聯繫的強度、性質和持續時間
                     2）決定的法律後果；
                     3) 障礙物移除後的程度。

title: 9.1. The strength, nature and duration of ties to Australia
zh: 9.1　與澳洲連結的強度、性質及持續期間
text:
9.1. The strength, nature and duration of ties to Australia
                     (1)  Decision-makers must consider any impact of the decision on the non-citizen's immediate family
                     members in Australia, where those family members are Australian citizens, Australian permanent
                     residents, or people who have a right to remain in Australia indefinitely.
                     (2)  Where consideration is being given to whether to cancel a non                  -citizen's visa or whether to revoke
                     the mandatory cancellation of their visa, the decision-maker must also consider the strength, nature and
                     duration of any other ties that the non-citizen has to the Australian community. In doing so, decision-
                     makers must have regard to:
                          a)   how long the non-citizen has resided in Australia, including whether the non-citizen arrived as a
                               young child, noting that less weight should generally be given where the non                    -citizen began
                               offending or engaging in other serious conduct soon after arriving in Australia or soon after
                               reaching 18 years of age.
                          b)   any positive contribution made by the non-citizen to the Australian community;
                          c)   the strength, duration and nature of any family or social links with Australian citizens, Australian
                               permanent residents and/or people who have an indefinite right to remain in Australia.
9.1.與澳洲關係的強度、性質與持續時間
                     (1) 決策者必須考慮決策對非公民直系親屬的影響
                     澳洲境內的成員，這些家庭成員是澳洲公民、澳洲永久居民
                     居民或有權無限期留在澳洲的人。
                     （二）正在考慮是否取消或吊銷非公民簽證的
                     強制取消其簽證時，決策者還必須考慮其強度、性質和
                     非公民與澳洲社區的任何其他聯繫的持續時間。在此過程中，決定——
                     製造商必須考慮：
                          a) 非公民在澳洲居住了多長時間，包括非公民是否以澳洲公民身分抵達澳大利亞
                               年幼的孩子，注意到通常應該在非公民開始的地方給予較少的重量
                               抵達澳洲後不久或不久後犯罪或從事其他嚴重行為
                               年滿 18 歲。
                          b) 非公民對澳洲社會所做的任何正面貢獻；
                          c) 與澳洲公民、澳洲公民的任何家庭或社會連結的強度、持續時間和性質
                               永久居民和/或擁有無限期留在澳洲的權利的人。

title: 9.2. Legal consequences of decision under section 501 or 501CA
zh: 9.2　依第 501 或 501CA 條作出決定的法律後果
text:
9.2. Legal consequences of decision under section 501 or 501CA
                     (1)  Decision-makers must consider the direct and immediate statutory consequences under the
                     Migration Act of a decision under section 501 or 501CA. Except where otherwise required by law,
                     decision-makers are not required to consider the statutory consequences under any other Act of
                     a decision under section 501 or 501CA.
                     (2)  Decision-makers should be mindful that unlawful non-citizens are, in accordance with section 198,
                     liable to removal from Australia as soon as reasonably practicable in the circumstances specified in
                     that section, and in the meantime, detention under section 189, noting also that section 197C(1) of the
                     Act provides that for the purposes of section 198, it is irrelevant whether Australia has non-
                     refoulement obligations in respect of an unlawful non-citizen.
                     (3)  A non-refoulement obligation is an obligation not to forcibly return, deport or expel a person to a
                     place where they will be at risk of a specific type of harm. Australia has non-refoulement obligations
                     under the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees as amended by the 1967
                     Protocol (together called the Refugees Convention), the Convention against Torture and Other Cruel,
                     Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (the CAT), and the International Covenant on Civil and
                     Political Rights and its Second Optional Protocol (the I            CCPR). The Act, particularly the concept of
                     'protection obligations', reflects Australia's interpretation of          non-refoulement obligations and the scope of
                     the obligations that Australia is committed to implementing.
9.2.依第 501 或 501CA 條作出決定的法律後果
                     (1) 決策者必須考慮該法規定的直接和立即的法定後果
移民法第 501 或 501CA 條的決定。除非法律另有規定，
                     決策者無需考慮任何其他法案的法定後果
                     根據第 501 或 501CA 條所做的決定。
                     (2) 決策者應注意，根據第 198 條，非法非公民：
                     在上述規定的情況下，應在合理可行的情況下盡快將其驅逐出澳大利亞
                     該條，同時根據第 189 條進行拘留，也注意到《刑法》第 197C(1) 條
                     法案規定，就第 198 條而言，澳洲是否擁有非
                     對非法非公民的驅回義務。
                     (3) 不驅回義務是指不將某人強行遣返、遞解出境或驅逐到某個國家的義務。
                     他們將面臨特定類型傷害風險的地方。澳洲有不驅回義務
                     根據經 1967 年修訂的 1951 年《關於難民地位的公約》
                     議定書（統稱為《難民公約》）、《禁止酷刑及其他殘忍行為公約》、
                     不人道或有辱人格的待遇或處罰 (CAT) 以及《公民權利和政治權利國際公約》
                     政治權利及其第二項任擇議定書（I CCPR）。該法案，特別是概念
                     「保護義務」反映了澳洲對不驅回義務及其範圍的解釋
                     澳洲承諾履行的義務。
(4)   International non-refoulement obligations will generally not be relevant where the person concerned
                     does not raise such obligations for consideration and the circumstances do not suggest a non-
                     refoulement claim.
                     (5)   Without limiting the generality of paragraph 9.2(1), decision-makers should proceed on the basis of
                     the information available and are not required to, and generally should not, speculate about
                     circumstances that may result from future administrative decisions, including whether another visa
                     would be granted or whether the non-citizen would be removed to a country other than the country by
                     reference to which the protection finding was made.
(4) 當有關人員
                     沒有提出此類義務供考慮，且情況並未顯示非
                     遣返索賠。
                     (5) 在不限制第 9.2(1) 款一般性的情況下，決策者應基於
                     現有的資訊不需要，一般也不應該推測
                     未來行政決定可能導致的情況，包括是否需要另一簽證
                     是否會被授予或非公民是否會被驅逐到該國以外的國家
                     保護調查結果所參考的內容。

title: 9.2.1. Non-citizens covered by a protection finding
zh: 9.2.1　獲保護認定涵蓋的非公民
path: 9.2. Legal consequences of decision under section 501 or 501CA
text:
9.2.1. Non-citizens covered by a protection finding
                     (1)   Where a protection finding (as defined in section 197C of the Act) has been made for a non-citizen
                     in the course of considering a protection visa application made by the non-citizen, this indicates that
                     non-refoulement obligations are engaged in relation to the non-citizen.
                     (2)   Section 197C(3) ensures that, except in the limited circumstances specified in section 197C(3)(c),
                     section 198 does not require or authorise the removal of an unlawful non                     -citizen to a country in respect
                     of which a protection finding has been made for the non-citizen in the course of considering their
                     application for a protection visa. This means the non-citizen cannot be removed to that country in
                     breach of non-refoulement obligations, even if an adverse visa decision under section 501 or 501CA is
                     made for the non-citizen and they become, or remain, an unlawful non-citizen as a result. Instead, the
                     non-citizen must remain in immigration detention as required by section 189 u                       nless and until they are
                     granted another visa or they can be removed to a country other than the country by reference to which
                     the protection finding was made.
                     (3)   Decision-makers should also be mindful that where the refusal, cancellation or non-revocation
                     decision concerns a protection visa, the person will be prevented by section 48A of the Act from making a
                     further application for a protection visa while they are            in the migration zone (unless the Minister
                     determines that section 48A does not apply to them — see sections 48A and 48B of the Act). Further, as
                     a result of a refusal or cancellation decision under section 501 or a non-revocation decision under section
                     501CA, the person will be prevented from applying for any other class of visa (see
                     section 501E of the Act).
9.2.1.保護結果涵蓋的非公民
                     (1) 已針對非公民作出保護認定（如該法第 197C 條所定義）
                     在考慮非公民提出的保護簽證申請的過程中，這表明：
                     不驅回義務是針對非公民的。
                     (2) 第 197C(3) 條確保，除第 197C(3)(c) 條規定的有限情況外，
                     第 198 條並未要求或授權將非法非公民驅逐至某國
                     其中在考慮非公民的過程中對他們作出了保護結論
                     申請保護簽證。這意味著非公民不能在以下時間內被驅逐到該國家：
                     違反不驅回義務，即使根據第 501 或 501CA 條作出不利簽證決定
                     為非公民製作，他們因此成為或仍然是非法的非公民。相反，
                     非公民必須按照第 189 條的要求留在移民拘留所，除非並且直到他們
                     獲得另一個簽證，或者他們可以被驅逐到除所指國家以外的國家
                     做出了保護調查結果。
                     (3) 決策者也應注意，如果拒絕、取消或不撤銷
                     決定涉及保護簽證，該法案第 48A 條將阻止該人做出
                     當他們在移民區時進一步申請保護簽證（除非部長
                     確定第 48A 條不適用於他們－參見該法案第 48A 和 48B 條）。進一步地，如
                     第 501 條下的拒絕或取消決定或第 501 條下的不撤銷決定的結果
                     501CA，該人將被禁止申請任何其他類別的簽證（參見
                     該法第 501E 條）。

title: 9.2.2. Non-citizens not covered by a protection finding
zh: 9.2.2　未獲保護認定涵蓋的非公民
path: 9.2. Legal consequences of decision under section 501 or 501CA
text:
9.2.2. Non-citizens not covered by a protection finding
                     (1)   Claims which may give rise to non-refoulement obligations can also be raised by a non-citizen who is
                     not the subject of a protection finding, in responding to a notice of intention to consider cancellation or
                     refusal of a visa under section 501 of the Act, or in seeking revocation of the mandatory cancellation of
                     their visa under section 501CA. Where such claims are raised, they must be considered.
                     (2)   However, where it is open to the non-citizen to apply for a protection visa, it is not necessary at the
                     section 501/section 501CA stage to consider non-refoulement issues in the same level of detail as those
                     types of issues are considered in a protection visa application. The process for determining protection visa
                     applications is specifically designed for consideration of non-refoulement obligations as given effect by the
                     Act and where it is open to the person to make such an application a decision                    -maker, in making a decision
                     under section 501/section 501CA, is not required to determine whether non-
                     refoulement obligations are engaged in respect of the person. Having considered the person's
                     representations, the decision-maker may choose to proceed on the basis that if and when the person
                     applies for a protection visa, any protection claims they have will be assessed, as required by section 36A
                     of the Act, before consideration is given to any character or security concerns associated with them.
                     (3)   Non-refoulement obligations that have been identified for a non-citizen with respect to a country, via
                     an International Treaties Obligations Assessment or some other process outside the protection visa
                     process, would not engage section 197C(3) to preclude removal of the non-citizen to that country. In these
                     circumstances, in making a decision under section 501 or 501CA, decision-makers should carefully weigh
                     any non-refoulement obligation against the seriousness of the non-citizen's criminal offending or other
                     serious conduct. However, that does not mean an adverse decision under section 501 or 501CA cannot
                     be made for the non-citizen. A refusal, cancellation or non-revocation decision will not necessarily result in
                     removal of the non-citizen to the country in respect of which the non-refoulement obligation exists. For
                     example, consideration may be given to removal to another country.
9.2.2.不屬於保護調查結果範圍的非公民
                     (1) 可能引起不驅回義務的索賠也可以由符合下列條件的非公民提出：
不是保護調查結果的主題，在回應打算考慮取消或
                     根據該法第 501 條拒絕簽證，或尋求撤銷強制取消簽證
                     他們根據第 501CA 條獲得簽證。如果提出此類主張，則必須予以考慮。
                     (2) 但是，如果非公民可以申請保護簽證，則無需在
                     第 501 條/第 501CA 條階段以與這些問題相同的詳細程度考慮不驅回問題
                     保護簽證申請中會考慮各種類型的問題。確定保護簽證的流程
                     申請是專門為考慮不驅回義務而設計的
                     採取行動，並在做出決定時向決策者提出此類申請的人開放
                     根據第 501 條/第 501CA 條，無需確定是否非
                     對該人負有驅回義務。考慮到該人的
                     的陳述，決策者可以選擇繼續進行，前提是如果該人
                     申請保護簽證時，他們所提出的任何保護要求將根據第 36A 條的要求進行評估
                     在考慮與其相關的任何特徵或安全問題之前，先考慮該法案的規定。
                     (3) 透過以下方式確定非公民對某國的不驅回義務：
                     國際條約義務評估或保護簽證以外的其他一些程序
                     程序，不會利用第 197C(3) 條來阻止將非公民驅逐到該國。在這些
                     在根據第 501 或 501CA 條做出決定時，決策者應仔細權衡
                     針對非公民刑事犯罪或其他行為嚴重性的任何不驅回義務
                     嚴重的行為。然而，這並不意味著根據第 501 條或 501CA 條做出的不利決定不能
                     是為非公民製作的。拒絕、取消或不撤銷的決定不一定會導致
                     將非公民驅逐至存在不驅回義務的國家。對於
                     例如，可以考慮將其移送至另一個國家。

title: 9.3. Extent of impediments if removed
zh: 9.3　被移送後可能面臨的障礙程度
text:
9.3. Extent of impediments if removed
                    (1) Decision-makers must consider the extent of any impediments that the non-citizen may face if
                    removed from Australia, in establishing themselves and maintaining basic living standards (in the context
                    of what is generally available to other citizens of that country), taking into account:
                               a)   the non-citizen's age and health;
                               b)   whether there are substantial language or cultural barriers; and
                               c)   any social, medical and/or economic support available to them in that country.
                    (2) Where a non-citizen is unable to be removed from Australia to their home country:
                               a)   decision-makers are not required to consider the extent of impediments under
                                    paragraph 9.3(1) that the non-citizen may face if removed to their home country.
                               b)   If the non-citizen has permission to enter and remain in a third country, decision                  -makers
                                    must consider the extent of impediments that the non-citizen may face if removed to the third
                                    country. However, decision-makers should generally not speculate whether a non-citizen
                                    may be removed to a particular third country.
                    (3) Where a non-citizen has already returned to their home country, decision                    -makers must consider the
                    extent of impediments under paragraph 9.3(1) that the non-citizen may face if they remain in their home
                    country. Less weight should generally be given to the               extent of impediments where the non-citizen was
                    voluntarily removed to their home country.
9.3.如果移除障礙的程度
                    (1) 決策者必須考慮非公民可能面臨的任何障礙的程度，如果
                    離開澳大利亞，建立自己的地位並維持基本生活水平（在上下文中
                    該國其他公民通常可以獲得的內容），考慮到：
                               a) 非公民的年齡和健康狀況；
                               b) 是否有重大的語言或文化障礙；和
                               c) 他們在該國可獲得的任何社會、醫療和/或經濟支持。
                    (2) 如果非公民無法從澳洲遣送回其祖國：
                               a) 決策者無須考慮以下障礙的程度
                                    非公民被遣送回原籍國後可能面臨的第 9.3(1) 段。
                               b) 若非公民有權進入並留在第三國，決策者
                                    必須考慮非公民如果轉移到第三國可能面臨的障礙程度
                                    國家。然而，決策者一般不應猜測非公民是否
                                    可能會被轉移到特定的第三國。
                    (3) 如果非公民已經返回祖國，決策者必須考慮
                    非公民留在家中可能面臨的第 9.3(1) 段規定的障礙程度
                    國家。對於非公民所遇到的障礙程度，通常應給予較小的權重。
                    自願返回祖國。

title: ANNEX A - Application of the character test

text:
ANNEX A - Application of the character test
附件 A - 性格測驗的應用

title: Section 1. Overview of the character test
zh: 附件 A，第 1 節：品格測試概述
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
Section 1. Overview of the character test
               Discretionary visa cancellation or refusal
                    (1) Under section 501 of the Act, a person may be refused a visa if the non-citizen does not satisfy the
                    decision-maker that they pass the character test. A person may have their visa cancelled if the decision-
                    maker reasonably suspects that the person does not pass the character test, and the person does not
                    satisfy the decision-maker that they pass the character test.
                    (2) Persons who are being considered under section 501 of the Act must satisfy the decision-maker that
                    they pass the character test set out in section 501(6) of the Act. In practice, this requires the decision-
                    maker to determine, on the basis of all relevant information including information provided by the person,
                    that the person does not pass the character test by reference to section 501(6) of the Act.
                    (3) Section 501(6) of the Act prescribes the circumstances in which a person does not pass the
                    character test. A person need only be found to not pass one ground, in order to not pass the character
                    test.
                    (4) In considering a person with unresolved criminal matters, decision-makers should note:
                          a)   where a person already fails the character test, any other outstanding criminal matters would not
                          generally prevent consideration of their case under section 501;
                          b)   a person who does not already fail the character test, and is the subject of criminal charges
                          in Australia, which have not yet been finalised before the relevant court, would not generally be
                          considered under section 501 until the charges have been finally determined;
                          c)   where a person is in Australia, and they are facing charges in another country, and the charges
                          will not be resolved in absentia, the conduct that is the subject of those charges may be considered
                          in the context of section 501(6)(c)(i) and/or (ii).
                    (5) If the person does not pass the character test, section 501(1) of the Act enables a visa to be refused
                    and section 501(2) of the Act enables a visa to be cancelled.
               Mandatory visa cancellation
                    (1) Under section 501(3A), a person's visa must be cancelled if:
                          a) the decision-maker is satisfied that the person does not pass the character test because of the
                          operation of:
                                     i.  paragraph 501(6)(a) (substantial criminal record), on the basis of
                                    paragraph 501(7)(a), (b) or (c) (the person has been sentenced to death, imprisonment for
                                    life, or to a term of imprisonment of 12 months or more); or
                                     ii. paragraph 501(6)(e) (sexually based offences involving a child); and
                          b) the person is serving a sentence of imprisonment, on a full                -time basis in a custodial institution, for
                          an offence against a law of the Commonwealth, a State or a Territory.
                    (2) In considering whether a person is liable for mandatory cancellation, decision                    -makers should note:
                          a)   that the term 'serving a sentence of imprisonment, on a full-time basis' does not include periodic
                          detention or home or residential detention. However, a person who has been serving a sentence of
                          imprisonment on a full-time basis and who is participating in a work release scheme, or is permitted
                          home visits is liable for mandatory cancellation;
                          b)   that mandatory cancellation is not enlivened unless and until a decision maker makes a finding
                          that they are satisfied that the requirements as set out in section 501(3A)(a) and (b) are met. Once
                          a decision maker is satisfied that these requirements are met, the decision maker must cancel the
                          person's visa.
                    (3) The purpose of mandatory cancellation of the visas of certain visa holders who are in prison is to
                    ensure that persons who pose a risk to the safety of the Australian community remain either in criminal or
                    immigration detention until that risk has been assessed. In this context, there are some circumstances in
                    which it may not be appropriate for a decision-maker to consider whether a person does not pass the
                    character test (and is therefore liable for the cancellation of his or her visa). These circumstances include
                    where a non-citizen is serving a sentence of imprisonment but will not have a visa which is in effect at
                    the end of that sentence. This situation may arise:
第一節 性格測驗概述
               酌情取消或拒簽證
                    (1) 根據該法第 501 條，如果非公民不符合以下條件，則可能會被拒絕簽證：
                    決策者認為他們通過了性格測驗。如果以下決定，一個人的簽證可能會被取消：
                    製造者有理由懷疑該人未通過品格測試，該人不
                    讓決策者相信他們通過了性格測驗。
                    (2) 依該法第 501 條被考慮的人必須使決策者確信：
                    他們通過了該法案第 501(6) 條規定的品格測試。在實踐中，這需要做出決定——
                    製造商根據所有相關資訊（包括該人提供的資訊）確定，
                    該人未通過該法案第 501(6) 條規定的品格測試。
                    (3) 該法第 501(6) 條規定了一個人未通過考試的情況
                    性格測驗。只要發現一個人沒有過一關，就沒有過不了品格
                    測試。
                    (4) 在考慮刑事事項尚未解決的人時，決策者應注意：
                          a) 若一個人已經未通過品格測試，任何其他未決的刑事事項將不會
                          通常阻止根據第 501 條審議其案件；
                          b) 尚未通過品格測試且受到刑事指控的人
                          在澳大利亞，尚未由相關法院最終確定，一般不會
                          根據第 501 條進行考慮，直至最終確定指控；
                          c) 一個人在澳大利亞，並且在另一個國家面臨指控，並且指控
                          不會缺席解決，這些指控所涉及的行為可能會被考慮
                          就第 501(6)(c)(i) 和/或 (ii) 條而言。
                    (5) 若該人未通過品格測試，該法第 501(1) 條允許拒絕簽證
                    該法第 501(2) 條允許取消簽證。
               強制取消簽證
                    (1) 根據第 501(3A) 條，如果出現以下情況，則必須取消某人的簽證：
                          a) 決策者確信此人因下列原因而未能通過品格測試
                          操作：
                                     島 第 501(6)(a) 段（嚴重犯罪紀錄），依據：
                                    第501(7)(a)、(b)或(c)段（該人已被判死刑、監禁
                                    終身監禁，或 12 個月或以上監禁）；或
                                     二.第 501(6)(e) 段（涉及兒童的性犯罪）；和
b) 該人正在拘留機構全職服刑，原因是
                          違反聯邦、州或地區法律的犯罪行為。
                    （2）決策者在考慮是否承擔強制取消責任時，應注意：
                          a) 「全職服刑」一詞不包括定期服刑
                          拘留或家庭或住宅拘留。然而，一個已經服刑的人
                          全職監禁並且正在參加工作釋放計劃或被允許
                          家訪有被強制取消的責任；
                          b) 除非決策者做出調查結果，否則強制取消不會生效
                          他們確信第 501(3A)(a) 和 (b) 條規定的要求得到滿足。曾經
                          決策者認為滿足了這些要求，則決策者必須取消
                          人的簽證。
                    （三）強制取消某些入獄簽證持有者的簽證的目的是
                    確保對澳洲社區安全構成風險的人仍然處於犯罪或
                    移民拘留直至風險評估。在此背景下，存在一些情況
                    決策者可能不適合考慮一個人是否沒有通過
                    品格測試（因此有責任取消其簽證）。這些情況包括
                    非公民正在服刑但沒有有效簽證
                    那句話的結尾。可能會出現這種情況：
a)  where a person in prison has been granted a Bridging E visa (BVE) in order to maintain their
                           lawful status while in prison. In circumstances where the BVE will cease upon the person's release
                           from prison, it is not recommended that mandatory cancellation c                 onsideration be commenced.
                           b)  where a person is the holder of a criminal justice visa (CJV). CJVs are granted to non                    -citizens
                           whose entry and/or continued presence in Australia is required for the purposes of the administration of
                           criminal justice. A criterion for a CJV is that a crimi       nal justice stay certificate (CJSC) or a criminal justice
                           stay warrant (CJSW) about the non           -citizen is in force. If the CJSC or CJSW is cancelled any CJV
                           granted because of the CJSC or CJSW is cancelled by operation of section 164 of the Act. The only
                           other power under which CJVs may be cancelled is on character grounds under section 501 of the Act.
                           However, in circumstances where the CJV holder is serving a sentence of imprisonment, this is unlikely
                           to be appropriate.
a) 監獄中的人員已獲得過橋 E 簽證 (BVE) 以維持其權利
                           在監獄期間的合法身分。在該人獲釋後 BVE 將終止的情況
                           出獄後，不建議開始強制取消考慮。
                           b) 持有刑事司法簽證 (CJV) 的人。 CJV 授予非公民
                           為了管理的目的，需要其進入和/或繼續留在澳大利亞
                           刑事司法。 CJV 的一個標準是持有刑事司法暫緩證明 (CJSC) 或刑事司法暫緩證明
                           關於非公民的暫緩執行令 (CJSW) 已生效。如果 CJSC 或 CJSW 被取消，則任何 CJV
                           根據該法第 164 條的規定，因 CJSC 或 CJSW 授予的資格被取消。唯一的
                           根據該法第 501 條，可以根據品格理由取消 CJV 的其他權力。
                           然而，在 CJV 持有者正在服刑的情況下，這種情況不太可能發生
                           要適當。

title: Section 2. Application of the character test
zh: 附件 A，第 2 節：品格測試的適用
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
Section 2. Application of the character test
第二節 性格測驗的應用

title: 1. Substantial criminal record (section 501(6)(a))
zh: 附件 A，1　重大犯罪紀錄（第 501(6)(a) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
1. Substantial criminal record (section 501(6)(a))
                    (1)    A person does not pass the character test if the person has a substantial criminal record. The
                    term 'substantial criminal record' is defined in section 501(7) of the Act.
                    (2)    For the purposes of the character test, a person has a substantial criminal record if:
                           a)  the person has been sentenced to death; or
                           b)  the person has been sentenced to imprisonment for life; or
                           c)  the person has been sentenced to a term of imprisonment of 12 months or more (including
                           an aggregate sentence for more than one offence – see s 5AB of the Act); or
                           d)  the person has been sentenced to 2 or more terms of imprisonment where the total of those
                           terms is 12 months (if a person has been sentenced to 2 or more terms of imprisonment to be
                           served concurrently (whether in whole or in part), the whole of each term                    is to be counted in working
                           out the total of the terms)**; or
                           e)  the person has been acquitted of an offence on the grounds of unsoundness of mind or insanity,
                           and as a result the person has been detained in a facility or institution; or
                           f)  the person has been found by a court to not be fit to plead, in relation to an offence; and as
                           a result, the person has been detained in a facility or institution.
                    **Example: A person is sentenced to 2 terms of 3 months imprisonment for 2 offences, to be served
                    concurrently. For the purposes of the character test, the total of those terms is 6 months.
1. 重大犯罪紀錄（第 501(6)(a) 條）
                    (1) 若一個人有重大犯罪紀錄，則不能通過品格測驗。的
                    該法第 501(7) 條對「重大犯罪記錄」一詞進行了定義。
                    (2) 就品格測驗而言，如果符合以下條件，則某人有重大犯罪紀錄：
                           a) 該人已被判死刑；或
                           b) 該人已被判處終身監禁；或
                           c) 該人被判處 12 個月或以上監禁（包括
                           一項以上犯罪的累計刑罰－參見該法第 5AB 條）；或
                           d) 該人已被判處 2 項或以上監禁，其中監禁期總數
                           刑期為 12 個月（如果一個人被判處 2 次或以上監禁）
                           同時任職（無論全部或部分），每個任期的全部時間均計入工作時間
                           總項）**；或
                           e) 該人因精神不健全或精神錯亂而被無罪釋放，
                           結果該人被拘留在設施或機構中；或
                           f) 該人被法院認定不適合就犯罪行為進行辯護；和作為
                           結果，此人被拘留在設施或機構。
                    **例：某人因 2 項罪行被判處 2 項 3 個月監禁，待服刑
                    同時。出於品格測試的目的，這些期限總計為 6 個月。

title: 2. Immigration detention offences (section 501(6)(aa) & (ab))
zh: 附件 A，2　移民拘留相關罪行（第 501(6)(aa) 及 (ab) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
2. Immigration detention offences (section 501(6)(aa) & (ab))
                    (1) A person does not pass the character test if the person has been convicted of an offence that was
                    committed;
                           a)  while the person was in immigration detention; or
                           b)  during an escape by the person from immigration detention; or
                           c)  after the person escaped from immigration detention but before the person was taken
                           into immigration detention again.
                    (2) A person does not pass the character test if the person has been convicted of an offence against
                    section 197A.
2. 移民拘留罪（第 501(6)(aa) 和 (ab) 條）
                    (1) 若一個人曾犯下以下罪行，則該人未通過品格測試：
                    承諾；
                           a) 當該人被移民拘留時；或
                           b) 在該人逃離移民拘留期間；或
                           c) 在該人逃離移民拘留之後但在該人被帶走之前
                           再次進入移民拘留所。
                    (2) 若某人曾犯下下列罪行，則該人未通過品格測試
                    第 197A 條。

title: 3. Membership/Association (section 501(6)(b))
zh: 附件 A，3　成員身分／關聯（第 501(6)(b) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
3. Membership/Association (section 501(6)(b))
                    (1) A person does not pass the character test if the Minister reasonably suspects:
                           a) that the person has been or is a member of a group or organisation, or has or has had an
                           association with a group, organisation or person; and
3. 會員/協會（第 501(6)(b) 條）
                    (1) 如果部長有理由懷疑某人沒有通過品格測試：
                           a) 該人曾經是或現在是某個團體或組織的成員，或曾經或曾經有過
                           與團體、組織或個人有聯繫；和
b) that the group, organisation or person has been, or is, involved in criminal conduct.
                    (2) A suspicion is less than a certainty or a belief, but more than a speculation or idle wondering. For a
                    suspicion to be reasonable, it should be:
                          a)  a suspicion that a reasonable person could hold in the particular circumstances; and
                          b)  based on an objective consideration of relevant material.
                    (3) A member is a person who belongs to a group or organisation. The evidence required to establish
                    reasonable suspicion of membership of a group or organisation will depend on the circumstances of the
                    case. Decision-makers should note that failure of this limb of the character test does not require an
                    assessment that the person was sympathetic with, supportive of, or involved in the criminal conduct of
                    the group or organisation. It is sufficient under this element of the test that the decision                 -maker has a
                    reasonable suspicion that:
                          a)  the person has been, or is a member of a group or organisation; and
                          b)  the group or organisation has been, or is, involved in criminal conduct.
                    (4) In establishing association, the following factors are to be considered:
                          a)  the nature of the association;
                          b)  the degree and frequency of association the person had or has with the individual, group or
                          organisation; and
                          c)  the duration of the association.
                    (5) Decision-makers should note that in order for a person to fail the association limb of the character
                    test, the delegate must have a reasonable suspicion that the person was sympathetic with, supportive
                    of, or involved in the criminal conduct of the person, group or organisation — mere knowledge of the
                    criminality of the associate is not, in itself, sufficient to establish association. In order to not pass the
                    character test on this ground, the association must have some negative bearing upon the person's
                    character.
                    (6) In some cases the information concerning association will be protected from disclosure under the Act.
                    In all cases, great care should be taken not to disclose information that might put the life or safety of
                    informants or other people at risk.
b) 該團體、組織或個人已經或正在參與犯罪行為。
                    (2) 懷疑不等於確定性或信念，而大於猜測或無意義的疑惑。對於一個
                    懷疑是否合理，應該是：
                          a) 一個有理智的人在特定情況下可能持有的懷疑；和
                          b) 基於相關資料的客觀考量。
                    (3) 成員是屬於某一團體或組織的人。成立所需的證據
                    對團體或組織成員資格的合理懷疑取決於該團體或組織的具體情況
                    案例。決策者應該注意，如果性格測驗的這一部分失敗，則不需要重新評估。
                    評估該人同情、支持或參與犯罪行為
                    團體或組織。在這個測試要素下，決策者有一個足夠的
                    合理懷疑：
                          a) 該人曾經或現在是團體或組織的成員；和
                          b) 該團體或組織曾經或正在參與犯罪行為。
                    （四）建立協會應考慮下列因素：
                          a) 協會的性質；
                          b) 該人曾經或與個人、團體或個人交往的程度和頻率
                          組織；和
                          c) 關聯的持續時間。
                    (5)決策者應注意，要使一個人的角色的聯想肢體失敗
                    測試中，代表必須合理懷疑該人同情、支持
                    屬於或參與個人、團體或組織的犯罪行為－僅了解該人、團體或組織的犯罪行為
                    合夥人的犯罪行為本身並不足以建立合夥關係。為了不通過
                    在此基礎上進行品格測驗時，此關聯必定對該人的性格產生負面影響
                    性格。
                    (6) 在某些情況下，根據該法，有關關聯的資訊將受到保護免遭揭露。
                    在所有情況下，都應格外小心，不要洩漏可能危及他人生命或安全的資訊。
                    線人或其他處於危險之中的人。

title: 4. Involvement in certain criminal activities (section 501(6)(ba))
zh: 附件 A，4　涉及特定犯罪活動（第 501(6)(ba) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
4. Involvement in certain criminal activities (section 501(6)(ba))
                    (1) A person does not pass the character test if the Minister reasonably suspects the person has been,
                    or is involved in, conduct constituting one or more of the following:
                          a)  an offence of people smuggling (as described in sections 233A to 234A of the Migration Act;
                          b)  an offence of trafficking in persons;
                          c)  the crime of genocide, a crime against humanity, a war crime, a crime involving torture or
                          slavery or a crime that is otherwise of serious international concern.
                    (2) In order to fail this limb of the character test, a person is not required to have been convicted of an
                    offence constituted by the conduct.
4. 參與某些犯罪活動（第 501(6)(ba) 條）
                    (1) 若部長有理由懷疑某人有以下行為，則該人未通過品格測試：
                    或參與構成下列一項或多項的行為：
                          a) 人口走私罪（如《移民法》第 233A 至 234A 條所述；
                          b) 人口販運罪；
                          c) 種族滅絕罪、危害人類罪、戰爭罪、涉及酷刑的犯罪或
                          奴役或其他引起國際嚴重關注的犯罪行為。
                    (2) 為了未能通過品格測試的這一部分，一個人不需要被定罪
                    該行為構成犯罪。

title: 5. Spreading hatred and extremism (section 501(6)(baa))

5. Spreading hatred and extremism (section 501(6)(baa))
                    (1)   A person does not pass the character test if subsection 501(6A) applies to the person.
                    (2)   Subsection 501(6A) applies to the person if the Minister reasonably suspects any of the

                    Note: ‘member’, ‘association’, ‘terrorist organisation’, ‘state sponsor of terrorism’, ‘prohibited hate group’,

5. 散播仇恨與極端主義（第 501(6)(baa) 條）
                    (1) 若第 501(6A) 條適用於該人，則該人未通過品格測試。
                    (2) 若部長合理懷疑任何以下情況，則第 501(6A) 條適用於該人：
                    以下事項均已滿足。
                    註：「會員」、「協會」、「恐怖組織」、「恐怖主義國家支持者」、「被禁止的仇恨團體」、

title: 5.1. Membership of an organisation (section 501(6A)(a))

text:
5.1. Membership of an organisation (section 501(6A)(a))
                    (1) The person is, or has been, a member of an organisation; and
5.1.組織的成員資格（第 501(6A)(a) 條）
                    (1) 該人現在是或曾經是某個組織的成員；和
(2) at any time the person was a member of the organisation, the organisation was a terrorist organisation, a state
                    sponsor of terrorism or a prohibited hate group.
(2) 在任何時候，該人是該組織的成員、該組織是恐怖組織、國家

title: 5.2. Association with an organisation (section 501(6A)(b))
zh: 附件 A，5.2　與組織的關聯（第 501(6A)(b) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
5.2. Association with an organisation (section 501(6A)(b))
                     (1)  The person has, or has had, an association with an organisation; and
                     (2)  at any time during the person's association, the organisation was a terrorist organisation, a
                     state sponsor of terrorism or a prohibited hate group; and
                     (3)  the person intends, or intended, by the association, to support terrorism, extremism or hatred or
                     to further acts of terrorism, extremism or hatred.
                     For the purposes of s 501(6A), a person has an association with an organisation if the person meets or
                     communicates with the organisation. An association may consist of a single meeting or communication.
5.2.與組織的關聯（第 501(6A)(b) 條）
                     (1) 該人現在或曾經與某個組織有聯繫；和
                     (2) 在該人交往期間的任何時間，該組織是恐怖組織，
                     恐怖主義或被禁止的仇恨團體的國家支持者；和
                     (3) 該人意圖或該協會意圖支持恐怖主義、極端主義或仇恨，或
                     助長恐怖主義、極端主義或仇恨行為。
                     就第 501(6A) 條而言，如果某人滿足或
                     與組織溝通。協會可以由一次會議或交流組成。

title: 5.3. Conduct constituting a hate crime (section 501(6A)(c))
zh: 附件 A，5.3　構成仇恨犯罪的行為（第 501(6A)(c) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
5.3. Conduct constituting a hate crime (section 501(6A)(c))
                     (1) The person has been or is involved in conduct constituting a hate crime (whether or not the
                     person, or another person, has been convicted of an offence constituted by the conduct).
5.3.構成仇恨犯罪的行為（第 501(6A)(c) 條）
                     (1) 該人曾經或正在參與構成仇恨犯罪的行為（無論是否
                     人或其他人因該行為構成犯罪而被定罪）。

title: 5.4. Making or endorsement of statements (section 501(6A)(d))
zh: 附件 A，5.4　發表或認同言論（第 501(6A)(d) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
5.4. Making or endorsement of statements (section 501(6A)(d))
                     (1)  The person has made one or more public statements, or has endorsed a statement publicly,
                     (whether in Australia or overseas, and including online statements) that involves the dissemination of
                     ideas based on superiority over or hatred of other persons on the basis of race, colour, or national or
                     ethnic origin; and
                     (2)  in the event the person were allowed to enter or to remain in Australia, there is a risk of harm to
                     the Australian community or to a segment of that community.
                     Antisemitic statements are an example of statements that involve harmful ideas based on
                     superiority over or hatred of other persons on the basis of ethnic origin.
5.4.作出或認可聲明（第 501(6A)(d) 條）
                     (1) 該人發表了一項或多項公開聲明，或公開認可了一項聲明，
                     （無論是在澳洲還是海外，包括線上聲明）涉及傳播
                     基於種族、膚色、民族或民族的優越感或仇恨他人的思想
                     種族血統；和
                     (2) 如果該人被允許進入或留在澳大利亞，則有受到傷害的風險
                     澳洲社區或該社區的一部分。
                     反猶太主義言論是涉及有害思想的言論的一個例子
                     基於種族出身而對他人的優越感或仇恨。

path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
5.5. Encouragement of statements (section 501(6A)(e))
                     (1)  The person has encouraged one or more other persons to make a statement publicly (whether in
                     Australia or overseas, and including an online statement) that involves the dissemination of ideas
                     based on superiority over or hatred of other persons on the basis of race, colour, or national or ethnic
                     origin; and
                     (2)  in the event the person were allowed to enter or to remain in Australia, there is a risk of harm to
                     the Australian community or to a segment of that community.
                     Antisemitic statements are an example of statements that involve harmful ideas based on
                     superiority over or hatred of other persons on the basis of ethnic origin.
5.5.鼓勵發表言論（第 501(6A)(e) 條）
                     (1) 此人鼓勵一個或多個其他人公開發表聲明（無論是在
                     澳洲或海外，包括線上聲明）涉及思想傳播
                     基於種族、膚色、民族或族裔對他人的優越感或仇恨
                     起源；和
                     (2) 如果該人被允許進入或留在澳大利亞，則有受到傷害的風險
                     澳洲社區或該社區的一部分。
                     反猶太主義言論是涉及有害思想的言論的一個例子
                     基於種族出身而對他人的優越感或仇恨。

title: 6. Not of good character on account of past and present criminal or general conduct (section 501(6)(c))
zh: 附件 A，6　因過去及現在的犯罪或一般行為而品格不佳（第 501(6)(c) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
6. Not of good character on account of past and present criminal or general conduct (section
               501(6)(c)(i) and (ii))
                     (1)  A person does not pass the character test if the person is not of good character, having regard
                     to their past and present criminal and/or their past and present general conduct.
                     (2)  The concepts of criminal conduct and general conduct are not mutually exclusive. Conduct can
                     be both general and criminal at the same time or it may be either general or criminal conduct: Wong v
                     Minister for Immigration and Multicultural Affairs [2002] FCAFC 440 at [33].
                     (3)  In considering whether a person is not of good character, all the relevant circumstances of the
                     particular case are to be taken into account to obtain a complete picture of the person's character.
                          a)  In Godley v Minister for Immigration and Multicultural and Indigenous Affairs (2004) 83 ALD 411,
                              Lee J said at [34] 'the words "of good character" mean enduring moral qualities reflected in
                              soundness and reliability in moral judgement in the performance of day to day activities and in
                              dealing with fellow citizens. It is not simply a matter of repute, fame or standing in the community
                              but of continuing performance according to moral principle. A person of ill repute by reason of
                              past criminal conduct may nonetheless, on objective examination at a later stage in life, be
                              shown to be a person reformed and now of good character.'
                     (4) In order to fail this limb of the character test, a person need not necessarily have a recent criminal
                     conviction, or have been involved in recent general conduct which would indicate that they are not of
6. 因過去和現在的犯罪或一般行為而品行不佳（第
               501(6)(c)(i) 和 (ii))
                     (1) 若一個人的品格不好，則不能通過品格測試
                     他們過去和現在的犯罪行為和/或他們過去和現在的一般行為。
                     (2)犯罪行為與一般行為的概念並非互相排斥。行為可以
同時既是一般行為又是犯罪行為，或既可以是一般行為又可以是犯罪行為：Wong v
                     移民及多元文化事務部長 [2002] FCAFC 440，第 [33]。
                     (3) 在考慮一個人是否品行不良時，應考慮該人的所有相關情況
                     必須考慮具體情況，才能全面了解該人的性格。
                          a) 在 Godley 訴移民、多元文化和原住民事務部長 (2004) 83 ALD 411 一案中，
                              Lee J 在 [34] 中說，「『良好品格』一詞是指反映在
                              日常活動中道德判斷的健全性和可靠性
                              與同胞打交道。這不僅是聲譽、名氣或社會地位的問題
                              而是根據道德原則持續表現。因以下原因而名聲不佳的人
                              儘管如此，在人生的後期階段進行客觀審查時，過去的犯罪行為可能是
                              事實證明，他是一個改過自新、品格良好的人。 」
                     (4) 為了不通過性格測驗的這一分支，一個人不一定最近有過犯罪經歷
                     被定罪，或參與最近的一般行為，這表明他們不屬於
'good character'. However, the conduct in question must be sufficient to indicate a lack of enduring
                     moral quality that outweighs any consideration of more recent good behaviour.
                          a) In Godley, Lee J went on to say 'For a finding to be made under section 501(6)(c) that a person is
                               not of good character it is necessary that the nature of the conduct said to be criminal , be
                               examined and assessed as to its degree of moral culpability or turpitude. Furthermore, there must
                               be examination of past and present criminal conduct sufficient to establish that a person at the
                               time of decision is not then of good character. The point at which recent criminal conduct, (as the
                               term 'present criminal conduct' is to be understood), becomes past criminal conduct must be a
                               matter of judgement. If there is no recent criminal conduct that circumstances will point to the
                               need for the Minister to give due weight to that fact before concluding that a visa applicant is not
                               of good character'.
                               'Before past and present general conduct may be taken to reveal indicia that a visa applicant is
                               not of good character continuing conduct must be demonstrated that shows a lack of enduring
                               moral quality. Although in some circumstances isolated elements of conduct may be significant
                               and display lack of moral worth they will be rare, and as with consideration of criminal conduct,
                               there must be due regard given to recent good conduct.’
「品格好」。然而，相關行為必須足以顯示缺乏持久的
                     道德品質勝過對近期良好行為的任何考慮。
                          a) 在 Godley 案中，Lee J 繼續說：「根據第 501(6)(c) 條所做的調查結果表明，一個人
                               不具有良好品格，因此被稱為犯罪的行為的性質必須是

                               在得出簽證申請人不符合要求的結論之前，部長需要適當考慮這一事實
                               品格良好」。
                               「過去和現在的一般行為可能會暴露簽證申請人的跡象
                               必須證明品格不佳的持續行為顯示缺乏持久的
                               道德品質。儘管在某些情況下，孤立的行為要素可能很重要
                               並表現出缺乏道德價值，他們將是罕見的，並且與考慮犯罪行為一樣，
                               必須適當考慮最近的良好行為。

title: 6.1. Past and present criminal conduct
zh: 附件 A，6.1　過去及現在的犯罪行為
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
6. Not of good character on account of past and present criminal or general conduct (section
text:
6.1. Past and present criminal conduct
                     (1) In considering whether a person is not of good character on the basis of past or present criminal
                     conduct, the following factors are to be considered:
                          a)         the nature and severity of the criminal conduct;
                          b)         the frequency of the person's offending and whether there is any trend of
                                     increasing seriousness;
                          c)         the cumulative effect of repeated offending;
                          d)         any circumstances surrounding the criminal conduct which may explain the conduct such as
                                     may be evident from judges' comments, parole reports and similar authoritative documents;
                                     and
                          e)         the conduct of the person since their most recent offence, including:
                                   i.   the length of time since the person last engaged in criminal conduct;
                                   ii.  any evidence of recidivism or continuing association with criminals;
                                   iii. any pattern of similar criminal conduct;
                                   iv.  any pattern of continued or blatant disregard or contempt for the law; and
                                   v.   any conduct which may indicate character reform.
6.1.過去與現在的犯罪行為
                     (1) 根據過去或現在的犯罪行為來判斷一個人是否品行不良
                     的行為，應考慮以下因素：
                          a) 犯罪行為的性質和嚴重程度；
                          b) 該人犯罪的頻率以及是否有任何趨勢
                                     日益嚴肅；
                          c) 重複犯罪的累積效應；
                          d) 與犯罪行為相關的任何可以解釋該行為的情況，例如
                                     從法官的評論、假釋報告和類似的權威文件中可以明顯看出；
                                     和
                          e) 自最近一次犯罪以來該人的行為，包括：
                                   島 自該人最後一次從事犯罪行為以來的時間長度；
                                   二. 累犯或持續與犯罪者有聯繫的任何證據；
                                   三.任何類似的犯罪行為；
                                   四. 任何持續或公然無視或蔑視法律的行為；和
                                   v. 任何可能顯示品格改變的行為。
