                                   二. 有嚴重違反移民法、違反簽證條件或
                                          簽證在澳洲或其他國家逾期居留；或
                                   三. 參與戰爭罪或危害人類罪；
                          b) 該人是否已被從澳洲或其他國家驅逐或驅逐出境，以及
                                導致遣返/遞解出境的情況；或
                          c) 此人是否曾：
i.    dishonourably discharged; or
                                   ii.    discharged prematurely;
                              from the armed forces of another country as the result of disciplinary action in circumstances, or
                              because of conduct that, in Australia would be regarded as serious.
                      (3) Where a person is in Australia and charges have been brought against that person in a jurisdiction
                      other than an Australian jurisdiction, and those charges will not be resolved in                    absentia, the conduct
                      that is the subject of those charges may be considered in the context of its impact on the person's
                      overall character.
我。    被不光彩地開除；或
                                   二. 提前出院；
                              由於某種情況下的紀律處分而被另一個國家的武裝部隊驅逐，或

title: 7. Risk in regards to future conduct (section 501(6)(d))
zh: 附件 A，7　未來行為的風險（第 501(6)(d) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
7. Risk in regards to future conduct (section 501(6)(d))
                      (1)  A person does not pass the character test if, in the event that the person were allowed to enter
                      or remain in Australia, there is a risk that the person might engage in any of the conduct specified in
                      section 501(6)(d) of the Act. The types of conduct spec               ified are discussed below.
                      (2)  The grounds are enlivened if there is evidence suggesting that there is more than a minimal or
                      remote chance that the person, if allowed to enter or to remain in Australia, might engage in conduct
                      specified in section 501(6)(d) of the Act.
                      (3)  It is not sufficient to find that the person has engaged in conduct specified in paragraph 501(6)(d) of
                      the Act in the past. There must be a risk that the person might engage in the future in the specified
                      conduct set out in section 501(6)(d) of the Act.
7. 未來行為的風險（第 501(6)(d) 條）
                      (1) 如果某人被允許進入，則該人未通過品格測試
                      或留在澳大利亞，則該人有可能從事上述任何行為的風險
                      該法第 501(6)(d) 條。下面討論指定的行為類型。
                      (2) 如果有證據顯示存在超過最低限度或
                      如果允許該人進入或留在澳大利亞，該人可能從事某種行為的可能性很小
                      該法第 501(6)(d) 條規定。
                      (3) 不足以認定該人從事了第 501(6)(d) 段所規定的行為
                      過去的法案。必須存在該人未來可能從事指定工作的風險
                      該法第 501(6)(d) 條規定的行為。

title: 7.1. Risk of engaging in criminal conduct in Australia (section 501(6)(d)(i))
zh: 附件 A，7.1　在澳洲從事犯罪行為的風險（第 501(6)(d)(i) 目）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
7. Risk in regards to future conduct (section 501(6)(d))
text:
7.1. Risk of engaging in criminal conduct in Australia (section 501(6)(d)(i))
                      (1)  A person does not pass the character test if, in the event that the person were allowed to enter
                      or remain in Australia, there is a risk that the person might engage in criminal conduct in Australia.
                      (2)  The reference to criminal conduct must be read as requiring that there is a risk of the
                      person engaging in conduct for which a criminal conviction could be recorded.
7.1.在澳洲從事犯罪行為的風險（第 501(6)(d)(i) 條）
                      (1) 如果某人被允許進入，則該人未通過品格測試
                      或留在澳大利亞，該人有可能在澳大利亞從事犯罪行為的風險。
                      (2) 提及犯罪行為必須理解為要求有犯罪行為的風險
                      從事可被記錄刑事定罪的行為的人。

title: 7.2. Risk of harassing, molesting, intimidating or stalking another person in Australia (section 501(6)(d)(ii))
zh: 附件 A，7.2　在澳洲騷擾、滋擾、恐嚇或跟蹤他人的風險（第 501(6)(d)(ii) 目）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
7. Risk in regards to future conduct (section 501(6)(d))
text:
7.2. Risk of harassing, molesting, intimidating or stalking another person in Australia (section
               501(6)(d)(ii))
                      (1) A person will not pass the character test if, in the event that the person were allowed to enter or
                      remain in Australia, there is a risk that the person might harass, molest, intimidate or stalk another
                      person in Australia.
                      (2) 'Harassment', 'molestation' intimidation' and 'stalking' are to be given their ordinary meaning.
                      Section 501(11) of the Act clarifies the scope of conduct amounting to harassment or molestation.
                      Conduct and behaviours that may fall under this category include, but are not limited to, the following:
                                a)   conduct that could be construed as harassment or intimidation (whether or not it
                                     breaches the terms of an Apprehended or Domestic Violence (or similar) Order);
                                b)   conduct that potentially places children in danger, such as unwelcome and/or inappropriate
                                     approaches, including, but not limited to, approaches made through electronic media; or
                                c)   conduct that would reasonably cause an individual to be severely apprehensive, fearful,
                                     alarmed or distressed regarding the person's behaviour or alleged behaviour towards the
                                     individual, any other individual, or in relation to their property or that of any other individual.
7.2.在澳洲騷擾、騷擾、恐嚇或跟蹤他人的風險（第 1 節）
               501(6)(d)(ii))
                      (1) 如果某人被允許進入或
                      留在澳大利亞，該人有可能騷擾、騷擾、恐嚇或跟蹤他人的風險
                      人在澳洲。
                      (2) 「騷擾」、「騷擾」、「恐嚇」和「跟蹤」應採用其通常意義。
                      該法第 501(11) 條明確了構成騷擾或騷擾的行為範圍。
                      可能屬於此類別的行為和行為包括但不限於以下：
                                a) 可能被解釋為騷擾或恐嚇的行為（無論是否
違反逮捕令或家庭暴力（或類似）命令的條款）；
                                b) 可能將兒童置於危險之中的行為，例如不受歡迎和/或不適當的行為
                                     方法，包括但不限於透過電子媒體進行的方法；或

                                     對該人的行為或據稱對他人的行為感到震驚或苦惱

title: 7.3. Risk of vilifying a segment of the community, of inciting discord or of representing a danger through involvement in disruptive and/or violent activities (section 501(6)(d)(iii), (iv) and (v))
zh: 附件 A，7.3　詆毀社會某部分、煽動紛爭或透過破壞及／或暴力活動造成危險的風險（第 501(6)(d)(iii)、(iv) 及 (v) 目）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
7. Risk in regards to future conduct (section 501(6)(d))
text:
7.3. Risk of vilifying a segment of the community, of inciting discord or of representing a danger
               through involvement in disruptive and/or violent activities (section 501(6)(d)(iii), (iv) and (v))
                      (1) In deciding whether a person does not pass the character test under
                      section 501(6)(d)(iii), (iv) or (v) of the Act, factors to be considered include, but are not limited to,
                      evidence that the person:
7.3.誹謗社區一部分、煽動不和或構成危險的風險
               透過參與破壞性和/或暴力活動（第 501(6)(d)(iii)、(iv) 和 (v) 條）
                      (1) 在決定一個人是否未通過品格測試時
                      該法第 501(6)(d)(iii)、(iv) 或 (v) 條，需要考慮的因素包括但不限於：
                      證明該人：
a)   might hold or advocate extremist views such as a belief in the use of violence as a legitimate
                                     means of political expression;
                                b)   might vilify a part of the community;
                                c)   has a record of encouraging disregard for law and order; Note: For example, in the course of
                                     addressing public rallies.
a) 可能持有或宣揚極端主義觀點，例如相信使用暴力作為合法手段
                                     政治表達方式；
                                b) 可能誹謗社區的一部分；
                                c) 有鼓勵無視法律和秩序的記錄；註：例如，在過程中
                                     在公眾集會上發表演說。
d)   has engaged or threatens to engage in conduct likely to be incompatible with the smooth
                                     operation of a multicultural society;
                                     Note: For example, advocating that particular ethnic groups should adopt political, social or
                                     religious values well outside those generally acceptable in Australian society, and which, if
                                     adopted or practised, might lead to discord within those groups or between those groups
                                     and other segments of Australian society.
                                e)   participates in, or is active in promotion of, politically motivated violence or criminal
                                     violence and/or is likely to propagate or encourage such action in Australia;
                                f)   is likely to provoke civil unrest in Australia because of the conjunction of the person's
                                     intended activities and proposed timing of their presence in Australia with those of another
                                     individual, group or organisation holding opposing views.
                    (2) The operation of section 501(6)(d)(iii), (iv) or (v) of the Act must be balanced against Australia's well

d) 從事或威脅從事可能與順利實施不相容的行為
                                     多元文化社會的運作；

title: 8. Sexually based offences involving a child (section 501(6)(e))
zh: 附件 A，8　涉及兒童的性犯罪（第 501(6)(e) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
8. Sexually based offences involving a child (section 501(6)(e))
                    (1) A person will not pass the character test if a court in Australia or a foreign country has convicted them
                    of one or more sexually based offences involving a child or found them guilty of such an offence, or
                    found a charge proven against them, even if the person was discharged without conviction.
                    (2) Sexually based offences involving a child include, but are not limited to offences such as:
                                a)   child sexual abuse;
                                b)   indecent dealings with a child;
                                c)   possession or distribution of child pornography;
                                d)   internet grooming; and
                                e)   other non-contact carriage service offences.
8. 涉及兒童的性犯罪（第 501(6)(e) 條）
                    (1) 如果澳洲或外國法院判定某人有罪，則該人將無法通過品格測試
                    犯有一項或多項涉及兒童的性犯罪或判定他們犯有此類罪行，或
                    發現對他們的指控已得到證實，即使該人未經定罪就被釋放。
                    (2) 涉及兒童的性犯罪包括但不限於下列犯罪：
                                a) 兒童性虐待；
                                b) 與兒童有不雅行為；
                                c) 擁有或傳播兒童色情製品；
                                d) 網路誘騙；和
                                e) 其他非接觸式運輸服務違法行為。
(3) This provision applies irrespective of the level of penalty or orders made in relation to the offence.
(3) 無論對犯罪行為的處罰或命令的等級為何，本規定均適用。

title: 9. Crimes under International Humanitarian Law (section 501(6)(f))
zh: 附件 A，9　國際人道法下的罪行（第 501(6)(f) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
9. Crimes under International Humanitarian Law (section 501(6)(f))
                    (1) A person will not pass the character test if the person has, in Australia or a foreign country, been
                    charged with or indicted for one or more of the following:
                                a)   the crime of genocide;
                                b)   a crime against humanity;
                                c)   a war crime;
                                d)   a crime involving torture or slavery;
                                e)   a crime that is otherwise of serious international concern.
9. 國際人道法規定的罪行（第 501(6)(f)條）
                    (1) 如果一個人在澳洲或外國曾被
                    因以下一項或多項行為被指控或起訴：
                                a) 種族滅絕罪；
                                b) 危害人類罪；
                                c) 戰爭罪；
                                d) 涉及酷刑或奴役的犯罪；
                                e) 引起國際嚴重關注的犯罪行為。

title: 10. National security risk (section 501(6)(g))
zh: 附件 A，10　國家安全風險（第 501(6)(g) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
10. National security risk (section 501(6)(g))
                    (1) A person will not pass the character test if the person has been assessed by the Australian Security
                    Intelligence Organisation (ASIO) to be directly or indirectly a risk to security (within the meaning of
                    section 4 of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation Act 1979                    ).
10. 國家安全風險（第 501(6)(g) 條）
                    (1) 如果一個人已經過澳洲安全局的評估，則該人將不會通過品格測試
                    情報組織 (ASIO) 直接或間接對安全構成風險（其意義範圍內）
                    1979 年《澳洲安全情報組織法》第 4 條）。

title: 11. Certain Interpol notices (section 501(6)(h))
zh: 附件 A，11　特定國際刑警組織通報（第 501(6)(h) 段）
path: ANNEX A - Application of the character test
text:
11. Certain Interpol notices (section 501(6)(h))
                    (1) A person will not pass the character test if an Interpol notice in relation to the person is in force, and
                    it is reasonable to infer from that notice that the person would present a risk to the Australian community
                    or a segment of that community.
11. 某些國際刑警組織通知（第 501(6)(h) 條）
                    (1) 如果國際刑警組織關於該人的通知有效，則該人將無法通過品格測試，並且
                    從該通知中可以合理地推斷此人將對澳洲社區構成風險
                    或該社區的一部分。

title: Endnote 1—About the endnotes
text:
The endnotes provide information about this compilation and the compiled law.
尾註提供了有關本彙編和已彙編法律的資訊。
The following endnotes are included in every compilation:
每個彙編中都包含以下尾註：
Endnote 1—About the endnotes
尾註 1——關於尾註
Endnote 2—Abbreviation key
尾註 2——縮寫鍵
Endnote 3—Legislation history
尾註 3——立法歷史
Endnote 4—Amendment history
尾註 4——修改歷史
Abbreviation key—Endnote 2
縮寫鍵－尾註 2
The abbreviation key sets out abbreviations that may be used in the endnotes.
縮寫鍵列出了尾註中可能使用的縮寫。
Legislation history and amendment history—Endnotes 3 and 4
立法歷史和修訂歷史—尾註3和4
Amending laws are annotated in the legislation history and amendment history.
修改法律在立法史和修改史都有註釋。
The legislation history in endnote 3 provides information about each law that has amended (or will amend) the compiled law. The information includes commencement details for amending laws and details of any application, saving or transitional provisions that are not included in this compilation.
尾註 3 中的立法歷史提供了已修訂（或將修訂）法律彙編的每項法律的資訊。這些資訊包括修訂法律的開始細節以及本彙編中未包含的任何應用、保存或過渡條款的詳細資訊。
The amendment history in endnote 4 provides information about amendments at the provision (generally section or equivalent) level. It also includes information about any provision of the compiled law that has been repealed in accordance with a provision of the law.
尾註 4 中的修訂歷史記錄提供了有關條款（通常是章節或同等級別）級別修訂的資訊。它還包括有關已根據法律條款廢除的已編纂法律的任何條款的資訊。
Editorial changes
編輯修改
The Legislation Act 2003 authorises First Parliamentary Counsel to make editorial and presentational changes to a compiled law in preparing a compilation of the law for registration. The changes must not change the effect of the law. Editorial changes take effect from the compilation registration date.
《2003 年立法法》授權第一議會律師在準備登記法律彙編時對已彙編的法律進行編輯和表述上的修改。變更不得改變法律的效力。編輯修改自編譯註冊之日起生效。
If the compilation includes editorial changes, the endnotes include a brief outline of the changes in general terms. Full details of any changes can be obtained from the Office of Parliamentary Counsel.
如果彙編包含編輯性更改，則尾註包括通用術語更改的簡要概述。任何變更的完整細節可以從議會法律顧問辦公室獲得。
Misdescribed amendments
錯誤描述的修正案
A misdescribed amendment is an amendment that does not accurately describe how an amendment is to be made. If, despite the misdescription, the amendment can be given effect as intended, then the misdescribed amendment can be incorporated through an editorial change made under section 15V of the Legislation Act 2003 .
錯誤描述的修正案是指沒有準確描述如何進行修正案的修正案。儘管有錯誤描述，如果修正案能夠如預期生效，那麼可以根據《2003 年立法法》第 15V 條進行編輯修改，將錯誤描述的修正案納入其中。
If a misdescribed amendment cannot be given effect as intended, the amendment is not incorporated and “(md not incorp)” is added to the amendment history.
如果錯誤描述的修正案無法如預期生效，則該修正案不會被納入，並且「（md not incorp）」將添加到修正案歷史中。
